AphroditeUpgrade_FlavorText01.zh-CN: 奥林匹斯王国最光彩的凡人都被她玩弄在股掌之上。
AphroditeUpgrade_FlavorText01.en: the most radiant of the olympians holds mortal beings in her thrall.

AphroditeUpgrade_FlavorText02.zh-CN: 她那摄人心魄的神秘力量可以让凡人做出自己难以想象的举动。
AphroditeUpgrade_FlavorText02.en: her intoxicating power spurs mortals into actions far beyond their reckoning.

AphroditeUpgrade_FlavorText03.zh-CN: 爱与美的女神，摄人和摧毁人的心智。
AphroditeUpgrade_FlavorText03.en: the goddess both of love and beauty can as easily destroy the heart as spur it.

AresKillQuestComplete.zh-CN: 杀死至少10000名敌人，之后去见阿瑞斯
AresKillQuestComplete.en: Slay 10,000 Foes or More, Then Seek Ares

AresUpgrade_FlavorText01.zh-CN: 他的杀意是他化名为【人类的末日】
AresUpgrade_FlavorText01.en: some call him 'death to men', such is his murderous intent.

AresUpgrade_FlavorText02.zh-CN: 他的工作将保证人类永不封神。
AresUpgrade_FlavorText02.en: his work eternally ensures that humankind falls ever short of godhood.

AresUpgrade_FlavorText03.zh-CN: 他会设法释放人类最凶残的本性。
AresUpgrade_FlavorText03.en: he fixates constantly upon releasing the most violent of mortal beings' impulses.

ArtemisUpgrade_FlavorText01.zh-CN: 圣洁的狩猎女神未逢敌手。
ArtemisUpgrade_FlavorText01.en: the virgin goddess of the hunt has never known an equal.

ArtemisUpgrade_FlavorText02.zh-CN: 奥林匹斯行踪诡异的女猎手，凭借一把神弓所向披靡。
ArtemisUpgrade_FlavorText02.en: the elusive huntress of olympus is unequaled with her bow.

ArtemisUpgrade_FlavorText03.zh-CN: 孤高为轻盈的狩猎女神带来了力量与专注。
ArtemisUpgrade_FlavorText03.en: solitude brings strength and focus to the lithe hunting-goddess.

AthenaUpgrade_FlavorText01.zh-CN: 刮目吧，这就是灰眼女神强大的防御能力。
AthenaUpgrade_FlavorText01.en: behold, the peerless defenses of the gray-eyed goddess.

AthenaUpgrade_FlavorText03.zh-CN: 来自奥林匹斯王国灰眼公主的祝福。
AthenaUpgrade_FlavorText03.en: blessings of the gray-eyed daughter of the king of the olympians.

AwardMenu_SubTitle.zh-CN: “在这里，即便是转瞬即逝的伙伴关系也可以万古长存“
AwardMenu_SubTitle.en: “Here, Even Mortal Companionship Can Be Eternal”

ChaosUpgrade_FlavorText01.zh-CN: 一片辽阔而有知的虚空曾孕育了世界，并且至今仍存世间。
ChaosUpgrade_FlavorText01.en: before the world existed, there was nothing but a vast and conscious void, which still remains.

ChaosUpgrade_FlavorText02.zh-CN: 奥林匹斯众神和泰坦的祖先，凡界和冥界的渊源。
ChaosUpgrade_FlavorText02.en: the forebear of olympians and titans, and of all things beneath the heavens or the earth.

ChaosUpgrade_FlavorText03.zh-CN: 一种古老的存在，从中衍生出各种生命。
ChaosUpgrade_FlavorText03.en: an ancient presence from which sprang forth every manner of existence.

DemeterUpgrade_FlavorText01.zh-CN: 四季更替，生死轮回，都凭某位伟大女神的一念之差。
DemeterUpgrade_FlavorText01.en: the cycle of the seasons brings death and renewal, on the whims of a mighty goddess.

DemeterUpgrade_FlavorText02.zh-CN: 没有她恩赐的丰饶和富足，就只剩下荒芜与凄凉。
DemeterUpgrade_FlavorText02.en: without her gift of nourishment and plenty, there is only desolation and the cold.

DemeterUpgrade_FlavorText03.zh-CN: 这位辈分最高的奥林匹斯神具有掌管天地万物的神力。
DemeterUpgrade_FlavorText03.en: the eldest of olympians holds sway over everything between heaven and earth.

DionysusUpgrade_FlavorText01.zh-CN: 最平简的事也会有举足轻重的影响。
DionysusUpgrade_FlavorText01.en: it turns out that the simpler things in life have a commanding influence.

DionysusUpgrade_FlavorText02.zh-CN: 疯癫的酒神对人类抱有幽默。
DionysusUpgrade_FlavorText02.en: the god of wine and madness has a certain sense of humor toward humankind.

DionysusUpgrade_FlavorText03.zh-CN: 人的天性就是努力挣脱穷理尽性与伤春悲秋的束缚。
DionysusUpgrade_FlavorText03.en: humanity so often struggles to relieve itself of cogent thought and keenly-tempered senses.

DusaLoungeRenovationQuestComplete.en: Employ the House Contractor to Help Renovate the Lounge

Dusa_ChoiceText01.en: Take back the Ambrosia? (She won't mind.)

Eurydice_OfferText01.en: The nymph offers several delectable treats.

Eurydice_OfferText02.zh-CN: 欧律狄克提供几样美食。

Eurydice_OfferText03.zh-CN: 歌者们献上了几样美食。

ExitBlockedBySellWell.en: Underworld Customs: Use Pool of Purging!

GhostAdminScreen_FlavorText01.zh-CN: 冥界居民无穷增长，修缮也须永不停息。
GhostAdminScreen_FlavorText01.en: perpetually must the underworld be maintained, for its population only grows and grows.

GhostAdminScreen_FlavorText02.zh-CN: 埋藏在地下的财富和死者的亡灵一样不计其数。
GhostAdminScreen_FlavorText02.en: the riches buried underneath the earth are as innumerable as the souls of the dead.

GhostAdminScreen_FlavorText03.zh-CN: 冥王圣殿不仅是冥王本人的家，也是他所有臣民的家。
GhostAdminScreen_FlavorText03.en: the house of hades accommodates not just the god of the dead himself, but also his subjects.

GhostAdminScreen_Hint.zh-CN: 使用通过逃脱行动获得的资源来翻新圣殿与冥界。
GhostAdminScreen_Hint.en: use resources procured through your escape attempts to renovate the house and underworld.

HermesUpgrade_FlavorText01.zh-CN: 没有一个凡人能达到众神使者这样的神速。
HermesUpgrade_FlavorText01.en: no mortal has ever approached the surpassing swiftness of the messenger of the gods.

HermesUpgrade_FlavorText02.zh-CN: 常言道坏事传千里，众神的信使难辞其咎。
HermesUpgrade_FlavorText02.en: it is said ill tidings travel quickly, and the messenger of the gods routinely sees to this.

HermesUpgrade_FlavorText03.zh-CN: 众神的传令官在刹那间能去往世上的任何地方。
HermesUpgrade_FlavorText03.en: there is no earthly distance that the herald of the gods cannot traverse in moments.

PoseidonUpgrade_FlavorText01.zh-CN: 海洋的主宰，撼地的大王。
PoseidonUpgrade_FlavorText01.en: lord and master of the seas, and also called the earth-shaker.

PoseidonUpgrade_FlavorText02.zh-CN: 天王与冥王的兄弟，不朽的海王。
PoseidonUpgrade_FlavorText02.en: strong-willed sea-commanding brother of lord zeus and of lord hades.

PoseidonUpgrade_FlavorText03.zh-CN: 海洋和陆地上的所有生灵都要臣服于他。
PoseidonUpgrade_FlavorText03.en: the seas and all the surface of the earth bend to his every whim.

StackUpgrade_FlavorText01.en: a taste of but a single pomegranate seed holds power in the underworld.

StackUpgrade_FlavorText02.zh-CN: 每一粒甜美浓郁的血红色果粒都蕴藏着强大的力量。
StackUpgrade_FlavorText02.en: there is a binding power in each sweet and acrid morsel of this blood-red fruit.

StackUpgrade_FlavorText03.zh-CN: 冥界的石榴籽蕴藏着一种与甜美外表不符的强大神力。
StackUpgrade_FlavorText03.en: the underworld pomegranate's seeds contain a godlike power that belies appearances.

WeaponUpgrade_FlavorText01.zh-CN: 为哈迪斯完成他的邪恶大业，工艺大师丢下了自己的工具。
WeaponUpgrade_FlavorText01.en: the master artisan discarded his own tools once his fell work for hades was complete.

WeaponUpgrade_FlavorText02.zh-CN: 时代最伟大的工匠在冥界留下了自己的印记。
WeaponUpgrade_FlavorText02.en: the greatest craftsman of his time even left his mark upon the underworld.

WeaponUpgrade_FlavorText03.zh-CN: 普天之下，他堪称千年不遇的天才。
WeaponUpgrade_FlavorText03.en: no one beneath the heavens would possess his talent for millennia beyond his time.

ZeusUpgrade_FlavorText01.zh-CN: 天堂和奥林匹斯的主宰。
ZeusUpgrade_FlavorText01.en: the lord and master of all olympus, and the heavens themselves.

ZeusUpgrade_FlavorText02.zh-CN: 泰坦征服者，统治着天与地。
ZeusUpgrade_FlavorText02.en: conqueror of the titans, who ruled the heavens and the earth before him.

ZeusUpgrade_FlavorText03.zh-CN: 手握闪电的天界与奥林匹斯的主宰
ZeusUpgrade_FlavorText03.en: lightning-wielding master of the heavens and the patriarch of the olympians.

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The House of Hades: That dark and lavishly appointed lair of the Underworld's King is home not just to him, but to his willful progeny.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 冥王圣殿：这漆黑奢华的巢穴里，住着的并不单单只有冥王一个人，还有他执拗的子嗣。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: What once was a small lounging area within the House of Hades now is sealed off, in utter shambles since the multi-headed Cerberus tore the space apart, mourning the missing Prince.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 冥王圣殿曾经的休息室现已被封闭，只剩一片废墟，因为三头犬刻耳柏洛斯忆主心切，一边哀嗥一边将这地儿毁了个精光。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Shades of the dead mill constantly within the House, complaining of their woes, and seeking audience from any who would listen.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 亡者的幽灵们时常在这里徘徊，抱怨自己苦难的同时也会寻找愿意倾听自己的人。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The lounging area within the House of Hades is a dismal place to be, in spite of its intended purpose to enliven the House's grim inhabitants.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 冥王圣殿的休息室本来是让这里的居民们放松活跃的地方，可这里还是显得沉闷十足。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: A commemorative board adorns one of the stoic walls within the lounging area, celebrating and proclaiming the accomplishments of those who serve Lord Hades best of all.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 休息室里一面坚实的墙壁上挂着一块板子，用以表彰那些为冥王哈迪斯鞠躬尽瘁的人。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The ancient casks of wine hidden within the recesses of the House of Lord Hades... few have tasted the intoxicating vintage they contain, and fewer still are permitted anywhere near their vicinity.

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The stalwart casks of wine within the House of Hades now are almost entirely devoid of content, having bravely stood against the combined thirst of the Olympians during a certain feast.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 冥王哈迪斯圣殿的酒窖里藏着许多古老的佳酿……几乎没人品尝过这些陈酿令人沉醉的味道，至于允许接近酒窖的人，就更屈指可数了。

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 冥王圣殿里的酒桶在某个盛宴坚执地抵抗了奥林匹斯众神的饥渴，现在只剩下一片空虚。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: A majestic gilded edifice of Mount Olympus, crafted with the utmost care from the true mountain's stone, now shines forever brightly even in the dim light of the House of Hades, as a parting gift from the Lord Master's kin.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 冥王的亲人赠送了一座用真正的山石精心打造的奥林匹斯山作为告别礼物，它那镀金的宏伟的轮廓即使是在幽暗的冥王圣殿中也闪耀着永恒的光芒。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: A vast and intricately crafted mosaic depicts the Underworld King presiding over the enormity of his domain, whilst its chthonic residents look on in awe of him.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 这副错综复杂的巨大马赛克绘画，描绘了冥王掌控着自己广阔领地的情形，而他的冥界子民们则敬畏地望着他。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Seldom does the overbearing throne of grim Lord Hades sit unoccupied; thus the House's denizens all go about their business, daring not so much as to ask why.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 冥王哈迪斯的威严王座非常少有地空了出来；而大家都忙着自己的事情，不敢询问其中的缘由。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The garden of Persephone the Queen, off-limits to the Prince throughout his life, now is laid bare to him at last in all its splendor.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 王子从未去过冥后珀耳塞福涅的花园，如今，这座光彩照人的花园终于向他敞开了大门。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: He ventures toward the stately throne of his Lord Father, half-expecting to be caught, but ill-expecting what he is about to find.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 他小心翼翼地走向威严的王座，心想着可能会被逮到，但没想着会在那找到什么。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: He does not know exactly what he seeks. He only knows that something always has felt off to him, that he does not belong. Who is he, really? Lord Hades never would indulge such questions. So, Prince Zagreus would find out for himself.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 他不确定自己到底在找什么。但总有什么东西让他感到浑身不自在，感觉自己不属于这里。他的身世到底如何？冥王哈迪斯不曾回答过这种问题。既然如此，扎格列欧斯王子只能自己去寻找答案了。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: He rifles through his Lord Father's possessions. There is not much of any import there. Ledgers and administrative parchmentwork. Correspondence from Olympus which he had ignored. No trace of any reference to his son.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 他翻遍了父亲大人的所有。完全没有找到关键信息。不论是账簿，行政文件。还是父亲从来不看的来自奥林匹斯的通信文件。都没有一字一句提到他的儿子。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: But then, there is the note... written finely in a hand and voice the likes of which the Prince had never seen or heard.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: 'Hades: I can no longer tolerate my life here in this place. So, I am leaving, even if it kills me. I won't be returning to Olympus. If there is a place where I belong in this world, it must be somewhere between heaven and hell. Perhaps it's on the coast and has a little garden. Take care of Cerberus; I shall miss him.'

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Thus did Prince of the Underworld Zagreus absorb the contents of this hidden letter, written in his mother's hand.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: His mother's hand, my mother's hand, wait, what?! You're saying this Persephone, that she's my... mother...? But, but Father always said that Nyx was my.... That liar. He lied to me, they both did. All my life!

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Uhhh erm thus did the Prince discover, inadvertently, the well-kept truth about his lineage. Entirely by chance, this did occur....

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 不过，王子发现了一张字条……上面有着他从未见闻过的优美字迹以及动听的声音。

zh-CN.speaker: Persephone
zh-CN.text: “哈迪斯：我不想再在这个地方折磨自己了。我要离开，付出生命的代价也在所不惜。我不会再回奥林匹斯。如果这世界有可以包容我的地方，那它一定在天堂与地狱之间。也许是在海岸边，附带一个小花园。照顾好刻耳柏洛斯；我会想他的。”

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 母亲写下的字条内容深深吸引了扎格列欧斯，这位冥界的王子。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 母亲写下的字条，母亲写下的，等等，你说什么？！你是说，这个叫珀尔塞福涅的人，她是……我母亲……？可，可我父亲一直说，说倪克斯才是我的……那个骗子。他骗我，他们两个都在骗我，把我蒙在鼓里！

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 咳咳，就这样，王子在不经意间解开了自己的身世之谜。完完全全的偶然，没错……

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Persephone... the one-time Queen of all the Underworld... where had she gone, and why? Engulfed by newfound questions and his rage, the Prince decided to confront his Lord and Master.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 珀尔塞福涅……曾经的冥后……她去哪儿了，她为什么要走？带着满心的疑问和怒气，王子决定与冥界之主当面对质。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Responsibility-rejecting Zagreus strides down his Father's hall, quite unconcerned about the urgency with which he is expected to behave under a set of circumstances such as this.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 拒绝承担责任的王子在父亲的大厅里大步流星地走着。这种时候，他本该表现出一定程度的紧迫感，但他完全没有在意大家的期望。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The door to the administrative chamber beckons just beyond the hall. The prince perchance believes that he may enter quietly, without drawing the notice of those laboring within.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 管理大厅的大门就在大厅的另一边向他招手。王子大概以为自己可以在不引起别人注意的情况下，悄悄地溜进去。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Among the countless splendid gemstones hidden underneath the earth, a great many are used to decorate the House of Hades, god of the dead, god of riches.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 在这地下数之不尽的华美宝石中，很多都拿来装饰冥王圣殿，死亡之神，财富之神。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Water is the source of life, yet still it flows within the darkest Underworld recesses, whilst restless shades of mortals look upon it and recall the short days they could drink it and draw breath.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 水是生命之源，但它仍在冥界最黑暗的深处流动着，那些焦躁不安的凡躯暗灵们一看到它，就会回想起自己也曾饮水呼吸的短暂生命。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The gemstone-bearing Prince commissioned such a finely crafted fountain for the House, that all the shades who witnessed it still think of him quite fondly, ever since.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 王子为这屋中修建了优雅的喷泉，从那时起，见证此事的暗灵无不思念着这位身着璀璨宝石的王子。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The dead have utterly no use for sustenance, although they try to feast upon it anyway, as though imagining the customs of the mortal life brings them some sense of peace.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 尽管死人完全不用进食，但他们依然会大开餐宴，藉着这样的凡间习俗来寻得一丝安宁。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Having invested heavily into the cooking-area within the House of Hades, the empty-stomached Zagreus can nonetheless find nothing fit to eat.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 虽然对冥王圣殿的厨房进行了大量投资，不过饥肠辘辘的扎格列欧斯还是找不到什么可口的食物。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Within the House's gallery now sits the bust of a distinguished poet, ruggedly handsome in his age, who, although yet to earn his fated fame, shall probably be better known someday.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 如今，圣殿的画廊里摆着一尊杰出诗人的半身像，与他本人年龄相仿，带着一股粗犷的帅气劲儿。虽说他现在还没像命中注定的那般名声大噪，不过日后应该会变得更有名气吧。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The frightful countenance of a bleached Bloodless warrior decorates the hall forever more, eternally in tribute to the savage servants of the House's lord.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 一个无血僵尸的苍白面容装饰着圣殿，为冥王那些残酷手下象征一道敬意。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The perfect-chiseled physicality of one of Greece's greatest-ever heroes now adorns the House's gallery, reminding most onlookers of many ways in which they fail to compare.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 希腊有史以来最伟大的英雄之一的雕像，如今成了圣殿画廊的精美装饰。而大多数的观赏者都明白，这位雕像人物的很多方面，他们都望尘莫及。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The light provided by the flames of deepest hell enhances the lounging area with a soft glow; and their warmth soothes the few living denizens there.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 地狱最深处的火焰发出的柔和光芒，照亮了休息室的区域，它的温暖抚慰了休息室里为数不多的居民。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Time seems to stand quite still within the eternal realm of the dead, evidenced even by the means of measuring its passage.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 在永恒的死亡国度之中，似乎连时间也变得停滞不前了，死者们用来度量时间的单位便证明了这一点。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: It is the dead of night, or the approximation of it in the realm of Hades. Prince of the Underworld Zagreus rises from a fitful slumber, with much mischief on his mind.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 在一个深夜，或者这个国度里与之相近的场景。冥界王子扎格列欧斯从断续的睡眠中醒来，迷迷糊糊。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The heavy-sleeping Underworld Prince arises, with the feeling that the brief nap he intended as a respite from the rigors of the day or night apparently was none-too-brief, at all...

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 熟睡不醒的冥界王子终于醒了。他原本只打算小睡一会儿，来缓解自己彻夜的疲劳，但他发现那恐怕并不是什么“小”睡……

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The bedchambers of Prince Zagreus lie in a perpetual state of utter disarray, despite his Lord and master of the House repeatedly insisting that he pick everything up.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 王子的卧室可以说是一团混乱。尽管他的国王，冥王圣殿的主人，再三叮嘱他记得收拾房间。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The shattered weapons of the siege of Ilion are now reduced to window-dressings in the Prince's ever-cluttered lair.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 围攻伊利昂的武器碎片已经沦为王子凌乱小窝的窗饰了。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The valor of the great-hearted Achilles is immortalized upon the Prince's wall, as though it might stir up more courage from within.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 无畏的阿喀琉斯的不朽英勇挂在王子房间的墙上，仿佛从中可以唤起额外的勇气。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The visage of the goddess Aphrodite now adorns the Prince's bedchambers, perhaps to provide consolation after when next he dies.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 女神阿弗洛狄忒的样貌装饰着王子的卧室，也许下一次死亡的时候能给予些许安慰吧。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The ever-smiling, wine-washed countenance of the great Lord Dionysus now adorns the Prince's chamber-wall, thus radiating questionable influence.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 酒神迪奥尼索司那张满是酒气、欢天喜地的笑脸，如今成了王子房间墙上的装饰品，散发着让人走上歧途的气场。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: A beautifully decorated, subtly enchanted bowl containing traces of the hapless Prince's past attempts to flee the Underworld now accents a particularly cluttered corner of his room.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 带有华丽装饰、精致魔法的碗，上面显示的是倒霉的王子之前企图逃离冥界的踪迹。现在这碗在房间的一个凌乱角落占有一席之地。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: A delicately crafted instrument of music-making now resides within the clamor-causing Prince's chambers, doubtless fearing, if it could, his heavy-handed touch.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 喜欢大吵大闹的王子，房间里多了一件精致的乐器。要是它也能有意识的话，它肯定会担心王子会笨手笨脚地去碰它。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: An object intricately carven solely for the purposes of recreation now resides within the pleasure-seeking Prince's chambers, although his lack for an opponent limits its appeal.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 如今，在热衷享乐的王子的房间里，摆着一件完全为娱乐目的而雕琢出来的精致雕塑。不过由于缺乏衬托，它显得没那么亮眼。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Much of the softness of the richly woven rug the Prince procured cannot be fully felt beneath his flame-licked feet.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 由于王子的双脚包裹在火焰之中，尽管他得到了那些厚实的棉织地毯，他恐怕没法充分感受那柔软的触感。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: With its just-right softness and death-themed embroidery, the new bedding of Prince Zagreus is the envy of all those who wish to rest in peace.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯王子的新寝具装饰着以死亡为主题的刺绣，柔软性也恰到好处，这让所有渴望安息的人羡慕不已。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The ever-energetic Prince alas remains incapable of sitting still, even with such a supple, comfortable seating arrangement nestled in his chambers now.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 即便房间里摆着一张如此柔软、舒适的座椅，精力过剩的王子还是没法老老实实地坐在上面。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: A massive set of weights positioned carefully in line of sight of any visitors shall doubtless make them think the Prince is stronger and in better shape than in reality.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 一套巨大的举重器材被特意放置在了来访者的视线范围内，毫无疑问，这会让他们误以为王子更强壮、更有肌肉。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The fate-abetting Prince perhaps believes it was through his own choice that he procured the Fated List of Minor Prophecies, but it was preordained.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 这位不认命的王子或许认为，他之所以能获得这张小预言命运清单是因为自己一次次正确的抉择，但实际上，那是命中注定的。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: All is quiet at this time; ever-dreaming Hypnos put a spell upon the House, as willful Zagreus had asked of him. All are fast asleep, save for the Prince. It is exactly as he planned.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 这时候一切都很安静；永远睡不醒的修普诺斯给这屋里施了咒语，这正是执拗的扎格列欧斯所要求的。除了王子以外，大家都陷入昏睡。正如他所计划的。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's been a while, Resources Director. I'll be sure to pay you a visit whenever I'm swimming in Underworld valuables and want to feel better about myself in my new role.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 已经有一段时间没见面了，资源总监。等我在冥界的宝藏中尽情畅游的时候，我一定会见你一面的，顺便祝愿我会更喜欢自己的新职位。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: In his Lord Father's very private chambers, Zagreus, the lock-removing prince, discovers a most delicately painted likeness of none other than Persephone, herself. A coat of dust suggests it has remained here for some time.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 在他父亲大人的私密房间里，门锁破坏者——扎格列欧斯发现了一幅极为精美的画，那上面不是别人，正是珀尔塞福涅。那上面蒙附的尘埃诉说着它已在此处沉眠许久。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The stoic Lord and Master of the House possesses wealth beyond imagining, a portion of which he has used for a crisp set of attire for every passing day.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 这位禁欲主义的圣殿主人拥有着超乎想像的财富，而他只花了其中很少的一部分，给自己购置了一套朴素的衣服，每天都穿。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Within the recesses of the administrative chamber lies the Eldest Sigil of the Master's House: a symbol of the Fate-given authority to rule beneath the earth, and means by which to travel the entirety of all that dark domain.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 管理大厅的角落里，放置着圣殿之中最古老的印记：那是命运赋予的统治整个地下世界的权力的象征，持有它就可以在这世界里自由穿行。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The cool, purified waters of the Styx are available in limitless supply to all servants of the god of the dead authorized to work endlessly within the House administrative chamber.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 那些在管理大厅里没日没夜工作的死神仆从们，如今可以喝到清凉、纯净的冥河水，想喝多少都可以。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The administrative chamber's ever-working shades remain utterly dedicated to their thankless toil all because of an inspiring rendition of how dedicated they ideally should be.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 由于某场振奋人心的演出，暗灵们明白了自己应当具有怎样的奉献精神。如今，管理大厅里那些全年无休的暗灵们，依然投身于这费力不讨好的辛苦工作之中。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Amongst the parchment-records of the dead and punished are the sealed documents known as the Knave-King's Sentence, forcing said king to endlessly toil with a boulder till the end of time.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 在这些关于死亡与惩罚的羊皮纸文件中，有一份密封起来的文档，被称为“无赖国王的判决书”。根据判决，这位国王必须不停地将一块巨石推到山上，直到永远。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Nestled among the towering administrative parchmentwork of the long-since-deceased lies an old document concerning a special pact signed by a once-living court musician, who attempted vainly to rescue his wife from death.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 在这座小山般的羊皮纸文件中，有一封老旧的文档，其中有一份特殊的契约。这份契约由某位当时还在世的音乐家签署，他试图将自己的妻子从死亡中拯救出来，但徒劳无功。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Buried deep within the archives, holding many binding pacts between Lord Hades and the dead, resides an old agreement; an exchange for services from an extraordinary warrior, for eternity within Elysium for his dear partner.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 这无数的档案都是冥王哈迪斯与死者签署过的协议，具有约束效力。而在这档案堆的深处，埋藏着一份古老的协议：某位了不起的战士愿意为冥界服务，以此换取让他心爱的伴侣永生永世留在至福乐土的权利。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The day or night's duties are sheer simplicity itself; at least at first, as when the prince simply signs in to signal the commencement of his shift.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 白天与晚上的工作非常简单明了，最起码开始是这样。王子只要简单打个手势，就代表他要换班了。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The often-failing prince attempts to sort the ledgers in the fashion necessary for the proper keeping of his father's realm.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 为了妥善管理父亲的国度，成事不足的王子打算按照使用需求对账簿进行分类。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The training-lacking prince's efforts to administer approvals to the judgment terms ultimately leave a lot to be desired.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 在管理批准审判条款的工作方面，缺乏训练的王子最终还是留下了很多遗憾。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The hard-laboring shades responsible for the administration of the prince's father's realm merely look on at the prince's ill-fated attempts.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 对于王子注定徒劳无功的尝试，负责管理王子父亲国度的工作人员采取了冷眼旁观的态度。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The relaxation-loving prince never paid suitably enough attention to learn properly how to arrange the record-bookings of the regions of his father's realm.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 喜欢偷懒的王子从来都没花多少时间去学习，也不知道该如何正确地安排他父亲国度的区域预订记录。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: This set of delicate responsibilities is easily achieved, at least by someone capable and trained to do the work, unlike the oft-distracted Underworld Prince.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 这一系列的精细工作其实很容易就能完成，只要是有能力、接受过相关训练的人就能做好，但心不在焉的冥界王子恐怕没戏。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: A careful record must be kept of all expenses paid within the House; a delicately-handled tabulation process which the prince is ill-equipped to fully undertake.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 完整的记录应当详实记录圣殿内所有的开销。这个过程需要耐心与细致，而王子的能力显然无法胜任。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: A steadily-updated ledger of the House's income in the form of brilliant gemstones, diamonds, Darkness, and the like, is merely one among the prince's least-liked aspects of his work.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 圣殿的账簿必须不断更新，时刻记录宝石、钻石、黑暗宝石等各种形式的进账。这份工作王子做的一塌糊涂，他搞砸的工作也不仅仅只有这件。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Records of expired House Contractor renovations line a desk in the administrative chamber, though the prince has absolutely no desire now to organize them alphabetically, by date.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 早就过期的圣殿承包商翻新记录就摆在管理大厅的桌子上，但王子完全不想把这些文件按照日期和名称顺序进行整理。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Attendance records of the working-shades who toil for the House need to be verified; the shades' due compensation, rapidly approved; and yet the prince cannot remember all the necessary steps.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 在圣殿里工作的暗灵必须再三核实到岗登记，暗灵们应得的补偿也要快速批准，但王子到现在都记不住这些必要的步骤。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Disorderly Prince Zagreus gazes upon the endless stacks of parchment-paper, each containing work-details to be registered and neatly organized, and starts to feel his optimism fade.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 不守规矩的扎格列欧斯王子望着这桌上一堆又一堆的羊皮纸文件，每一份文件都包含了需要登记整理的工作细节。王子原本的乐观情绪开始消退。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Prince Zagreus must have some favored tasks in the administrative chamber of the House; but surely none of them include the tasks demanding his attention, here.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯王子非要在圣殿的管理大厅里干些自己喜欢干的事情不可，不过可以肯定，这些事与他的本职工作完全不相干。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Reviewing lists of claims from shades with grievances is a very important service of the House, or so Lord Hades once attempted to impress upon his willful son.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 检阅那些忿忿不平的暗灵们的索赔清单，是圣殿中一项非常重要的业务。至少，冥王哈迪斯曾经试图让他任性的儿子牢记这一点。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: A litany of complaints submitted by restless shades across the Underworld must be evaluated, organized, and processed, but Prince Zagreus does not even know where to begin.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 必须有人负责评估、管理、处理冥界中那些不安分的暗灵们发来的投诉清单，但扎格列欧斯王子完全没有头绪该怎么做。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Supplies on all the desks in the administrative chamber must be carefully maintained and neatly placed in a specific way, which the forgetful prince has not yet memorized in full.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 管理大厅桌子上所有的用品都必须小心维护，并以特定的方式整齐摆放，但健忘的王子到现在都没有完全记住这些规矩。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Security reports concerning failed escape attempts from Tartarus require timely verification and official response, neither of which Prince Zagreus is fit to give.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 安全报告上记录了塔耳塔罗斯越狱失败的事故，需要进行及时核实并给出官方回应，但扎格列欧斯王子完全不知道该怎么办。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: At last, the work-disliking prince records a summary of the results of his attempts to be of any use to the administrative needs of his grim father's House.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 到最后，不爱工作的王子整理了一份记录，记载了他为了加强圣殿管理做过的事情，也记录了这些尝试的结果。

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: I'll level with you, pal. You have impressed somebody well above my pay grade here, and so... they have a little proposition for you, you listening?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Let me guess... they want me to fight all the way through the Underworld, having used the Pact of Punishment over there to make the going even more treacherous than it already is, and if I succeed, they'll reward me with some sort of useless trinket?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Wrong! We're talking something really big, here, pal, you see that thing back there? Trinket. Come on, what are you, scared?

zh-CN.speaker: 骨头
zh-CN.text: 我给你讲实话，兄弟。我上头的人很欣赏你。然后呢… 他们想找你合作一手，你有空不？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜猜……他们想让我启用那个惩罚契约，让环境变得更危险，然后我接着杀穿冥界，如果我成功了，他们就会奖励我一个没用的小饰品。

zh-CN.speaker: 骨头
zh-CN.text: 错！我们现在说的可是件大事，兄弟，看到后面那个东西没有？小饰品。你怎么回事，怂了吗？

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: I just knew you had it in you, pal, enjoying your new prize? Pact of Punishment, Shmact of Punishment, no problem, know what I mean? 'Course, that was just the easy one you got there, pretty sure I could've got that one, myself.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, just so I understand. I literally toiled through hell and back, and my reward is just... a statue of you? Don't get me wrong, it's lovely, it's just... I don't know what I expected.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Look, boyo, there was a little mix-up when we put in the request for that thing, see? I told 'em to make something that'll make me look good with my sources, and anyway that's how it all turned out. The other ones turned out much better, though, you'll see!

zh-CN.speaker: 骨头
zh-CN.text: 我就知道你行的，兄弟，新奖励怎么样？惩罚契约这种东西，都不是事，你知道吧？那当然了，你那个太简单了，我上我也行。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等会，我明白了。我辛辛苦苦在这杀了八百个来回，然后我的奖励就是……就是一尊你的雕像？没别的意思，我觉得这东西挺好的，但是就是……也许本来就没什么好期待的。

zh-CN.speaker: 骨头
zh-CN.text: 兄嘚，雕像这块，之前实行的时候有点误会，你知道不？我给他们说，用我的原料做一些让我看起来很帅的东西，然后就成这样了。其他的雕像肯定好看得多，到时候你就知道了！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Skelly, let me ask you something. Did you really commission three nearly-identical statues of yourself to goad me into using the Pact of Punishment?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: I am offended, pal! You haven't even seen the third one yet, so how can you insinuate a thing like that?! Maybe I was wrong about you. I thought you really were the one!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're only saying that to get me to apologize and try and unlock the last of your three identical statues, aren't you.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: How could you--? I would return those statues for a full refund right here and now, if I could move! And if there was a refund policy on them.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 骨头，我想问你点事。你真的想用三个跟你差不多的雕像来煽动我使用惩罚契约？

zh-CN.speaker: 骨头
zh-CN.text: 你这样说我就不高兴了！你有见到第三个吗？你到底想表达什么？！也许是我错怪你了。我还以为你能做到！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你这么说只是想让我道歉然后给你解锁最后一个雕像吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 骨头
zh-CN.text: 你怎么——？如果我能动的话，我现在立刻就把这些雕像全部退货退款！如果有退款这么一说的话。

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Look I'm sorry I messed up your statues, boyo. Really. When I saw them, I just kind of freaked. But then I figured there's no way he's going to see how they turned out, so, I just rolled with it, you know?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You shouldn't have underestimated me, mate. But... I shouldn't have said such awful things about your statues. You must have really gone out of your way to get them here.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Oh you better believe it, pal! So how about we call it even. We've been through a lot. Both of us! Really learned from this experience, and now, we share a deeper understanding, yeah?

zh-CN.speaker: 骨头
zh-CN.text: 把你的雕像弄这样我真的很不好意思，兄嘚，真的。我看到它们的时候，我也懵了。但我转念一想，反正你也不可能全部解锁，我就释然了，你懂我意思吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你这样也太小看我了，伙计。但是……我不该说你雕像的坏话。你一定花了很大功夫才收集了这些东西。

zh-CN.speaker: 骨头
zh-CN.text: 你最好这样想，朋友！那咱们扯平了。咱们可真经历了一场大冒险，可不咋的！这趟下来真是学到了不少，现在我们彼此了解更深了，对吧？

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The courtyard of the House of Hades is kept neat and orderly, in contrast to the terrifying sprawl that lies beyond.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 冥王圣殿的大厅整洁有序，与其背后涌动的暗流形成了鲜明的对比。

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Nice place you got here, boyo! Name's Skelly, how's it going, but enough with the small talk already, I'm here to do a job. So let me have it! Give me everything you got!!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I don't remember having you on payroll, mate. Who's your supervisor?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Oh-hoh, I'm not about to rat my sources, pal! Just try and beat it out of me!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 你这地方不错啊，兄嘚！咱也别跟这废话了，我是来这办正事的。咱们开始吧！看看你到底有多大能耐！！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我不记得地府有你这号人啊，伙计？哪个单位的？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 哦嚯，别想套我的话，兄弟，你得打到我自己说出来为止！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Don't suppose I can talk you into fighting back this time?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Not a chance, boyo, I'm paid to take it not to dish it out! Now give it to me!!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 所以这次你大概还是不会还手吧？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 你猜怎么着，兄弟，我就是被雇来挨打的！快点开始吧！！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Hey, you're getting pretty strong, there, pal! Though, I am being paid to tell you that! But not being paid to not tell you that last part...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I have to ask you something, mate. What do you even need the pay for, anyway?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: That, pal, is nobody's business but my own! Besides, it's impolite discussing money all the time! Now back to beating me to powder!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 哎，你变强了，兄弟！前面那句话是别人付钱让我说的！但是那个人没有付钱让我别说上一句话……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我一直想问，伙计，你要那些钱来干嘛呢？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 这个与你无关，兄弟！而且，张口闭口就是钱显得很没有素质！接着揍我赶紧的！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Let me give you a piece of advice, boyo. You run across a guy like me out there, you just give him a good stab right in the back without a second thought before he sends you crying back to Papa.

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 我给你提个小建议，兄弟。要是在外头看到跟我差不多的人，在他送你去见你爹前，你想都别想直接从背后捅他丫的。

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: You getting pretty strong, I'll give you that, boyo. Strong enough to smack a guy like me right up against the wall and I'd go straight to pieces, boom! You just remember, when you're duking it out, the walls are your friend!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Smack guys against walls. Sound advice as ever, mate.

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 你越来越强了，兄弟，这是实话。强到可以把像我这样的人锤到墙上然后嘣地一声给他来个灰飞烟灭！记住了噢，战斗的时候，墙壁是你最好的朋友！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 把敌人打到墙上去。似乎有点道理，伙计。

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Hey pal watch where you throw those bloodstone things of yours, you drop them, you go pick them up, you understand? But if somebody gives you grief, you got my permission to chuck one right in his eye!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'll just aim generally for the midsection since the eyes are a lot harder to hit in my experience.

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 哎，注意你甩出去的那些血精石样的东西，扔完了记得捡回来，知道不？但是要是有谁让你不爽了，我允许你直接用这个东西插爆他的眼珠子！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我觉得我还是瞄准躯干好了，以我的经验来看，眼睛这个部位还是很难打到的。

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: You're pretty quick, you know, boyo! Just be sure to use that fancy dash of yours and keep 'em guessing! Don't let 'em catch you standing still!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dash like mad instead of standing still. That's not the worst advice, I guess.

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 你好快啊，兄弟！记得多用你帅气的冲刺迷惑敌人！别傻站着不动给人打！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 到处乱冲比傻站着强！我觉得这建议还算可以吧。

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Little tip, boyo? You find any coinage while you're out there, you be sure to pawn it off to that old Charon, boatman guy? Use it or lose it, pal, use it or lose it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Thanks, mate, note to self: Always spend everything I earn instead of ever saving.

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 告诉你噢，兄弟。你在外头捡到的那些钱，一定记得在老卡戎，那个摆渡人那里花掉。不用就浪费了，兄弟，不用就浪费了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 谢了，伙计，我记着：路上拾到的所有东西，只花不攒。

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Once in a while, pal, you're going to see a real fancy bozo try to ruin your good time. You'll know him 'cause he's glowing like a light, but that's his special armor, see? You got to punch right through it, he's going to shrug you off until you do!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: For a good time, beware the fancy glowing bozos on my quest. Check.

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 在外头，你隔三差五就会遇到一种非常酷炫的家伙让你苦战一番。你一眼就能认这种怪物来，因为他全身都发光，其实说白了就是一种特殊护甲。你要先打爆他的护甲，不然他可难对付了！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 出门在外，留神浑身发光的特殊怪物。没问题。

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: You know something, boyo, I think you could do a real number on one of these columns holding up this place, and bring the whole thing down in just a few swipes, boom, boom, BOOM! I'd hate to be standing near one of them if you did!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wreck my father's finely crafted architecture every chance I get. That I can do for sure.

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 告诉你噢，兄弟。我觉得你应该可以轻松打坏那些用来支撑的石柱，三两下就能给它拆了，嘣嘣嘣！我可不想在你打坏石柱的时候站在旁边！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 一有机会我就打坏我父亲的华美建筑。这个没问题。

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Boyo, next time you make it to the big VIP area upstairs, you watch out for those weapon-wielding gents out there! The eyeball soul thing that pops out when you beat 'em? You got to squash those, too, or else they'll grab their gear and come right back!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Crush the souls of Elysium's Exalted shades to stop them from regenerating over and over. I'll definitely do that next time I'm there.

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 兄弟，下次你进到那种大型 VIP 会所的时候，留心那些拿着武器的家伙！打败它们后你会看见眼球状的魂一样的东西。那个你也要给它打爆，不然它们会直接原地卷土重来！！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 碾碎至福乐土里这些高贵暗灵的魂，不然它们会不停地复活。下次一定记得。

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: If you're having a rough time out there, boyo, you just remember something: You're a god, all right?! Way tougher than you think. They give you trouble, you just turn on God Mode, and you let 'em have it for me!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You act as though this God Mode is some sort of lever I can simply switch at will if ever I wish to unlock my latent strength, there, mate.

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 如果在外边遇到了困难，兄弟，你要记得：你是神，知道了吗？！这要比你想象得艰难得多。他们给你制造麻烦，你就开启神力模式，替我给他们点颜色瞧瞧！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你要假装这种神力模式就像开关一样，可以在想要解锁潜藏力量时随意开启，明白了吗，伙计。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Skelly, how do you know all this stuff, by the way? I mean no offense, but you're a skeleton who just stands around. Yet you have this wealth of knowledge of the Underworld?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Hey, I know people, pal! We'll just have to leave it at that. Now let's see you break some of these bones, huh?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 顺便问一句，骨头，这些事情你到底是怎么知道的？我无意冒犯，你不过是个干站着的骷髅而已，可你却对这个冥界的事情了如指掌，这是怎么回事？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 嘿，我有渠道，老哥，只要记住这一点就好了。你也是时候该砸砸我的骨头了吧？

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Well, pal? You have come a pretty long way, let me tell you. I think most of the smarts I've picked up, you know by now. And so... if I'm fresh out of tips for you... I guess there's only one thing left to do.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Stand there eternally to be whaled upon at my whim, using whichever weapon suits me at the time?

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 怎么了，兄弟？我跟你讲，你这一路走的还真远啊。我觉得我能想到的俏皮话，基本上你都听过了。如果说……我已经没什么建议可以给你的话……那我猜，我能做的事情，也只剩下一件了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你是指就那么干等着，等我什么时候一时兴起，用我最趁手的武器揍你一顿吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Say, mate? I picked up a painting for our lounge that looked a little like yourself. Reminds me... have you ever even been inside? Should come join us sometime.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Ah, you know, while I appreciate that, there, boyo... those kind of social spaces, they're not really for me. I kind of like it out here, just me, these bats whizzing around from time to time.... Besides! The old contract makes it pretty clear I got to stay right here.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What if I picked you up bodily and brought you in? Contract have anything to say about that?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，伙计，我找了一幅画挂在休息室里，画上的人有点像你。说到这个……你有没有进过休息室？你有空就应该过来喝一杯。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 啊，很感谢你邀请我啦，兄嘚……不过我是个社恐，社交这一套我还是算了吧。我更喜欢呆在这里，只有我一个人，偶尔能听到蝙蝠的声音……再说了！契约上说得很清楚，我必须待在这个地方。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那如果我把你举起来，强行带到休息室里呢？契约上提到这样的事情了吗？

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Got to say, you're really getting somewhere, boyo, I'm pretty impressed here! And they don't even pay me to do that, I'm just supposed to stand around!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Appreciate the vote of confidence, mate. Maybe you're right and someday I'll get out of here. Hey, if I never come back, you won't just be stuck here forever, will you?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Heh, hehehe, that's a good one! No! Probably not. Wasn't anything in the old contract about that... huh.

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 不得不说，你真是进步了不少，兄弟。我非常高兴！这可不是他们花钱让我说的，我就光站在这就行了！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 感谢你的支持，伙计。也许你是对的，总有一天我会逃出这里。呃，如果我不回来了，你不会一直永远留在这里吧？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 哈，呵呵呵，不错的笑话！不！我应该不会。旧契约里没有说……唔。

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Hitting a wall out there, boyo? Hey I know the feeling. You just keep at it, though! You're getting tougher, getting smarter... between the two of those, I'm thinking you'll pull through soon enough here.

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 你是碰壁了吗，兄嘚？嘿，我知道碰壁是什么感受，但你得坚持碰下去才行！这样你就能变得越来越壮，越来越聪明了……有了力量和智慧，我敢说，你马上就能度过难关了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Come on, mate, won't you say who hired you? Was it Achilles? Couldn't have been Nyx...? Is it that big a deal?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: I am an individual of some integrity, boyo, and protect my sources with my life! You'll have to kill me if you want to make me squeal!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 来吧，伙计，跟我说说到底是谁雇你来的？是阿喀琉斯吗？难道是倪克斯……？老纠结着不愿说干嘛？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 我是一个正直守信的人，兄弟。我会用生命来捍卫这个秘密！想让我泄密，你得先把我给杀喽！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Say, uh, Skelly? How'd you get here, anyway?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Oh, you know, just kind of zapped right in, like Papa lets us do! Some of us sometimes. Why do you ask?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I meant... how did you get to the realm of the dead, in the first place. Lord Hermes whisk you to the entryway? Thanatos scoop you up, Charon give you a lift, what?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Oh, haha! Well, that's a little personal, don't you think, boyo? I... I don't like to talk about it much. So, if I could have a little privacy...?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，呃，骨头？你到底是怎么来到这里的？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，就是“嗖”地一下就过来了，就像你老爹常做的那样！说不定什么时候就有什么人过来了。你问这个干吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我是说……你一开始是怎么来到冥界的。是赫尔墨斯带你进来的吗？是塔纳托斯把你接过来的吗？还是卡戎载了你一程之类的？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 哦，哈哈！这个问题可有点太私人了，你说呢，兄嘚？我……我不太想聊这个话题。所以，可以给我点隐私吗……？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Skelly, is it really true you don't want to talk about how you got here? Just curious who you used to be. What you were like. Your real name.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Hey, what makes you think this isn't my real name, pal? I'm offended!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sorry, what I meant was... I was just interested to get to know you better, after all you've done to help. Anything you can share? Trade you for a detail about me!

en.speaker: Schelemeus
en.text: ...Well all right... I was once a commander of men. Name of Schelemeus. Captain of the Cretan second fleet, sailing on Athens under King Minos. We were unstoppable... but then one day... one wrong turn... and we sailed straight into the waters of Charybdis.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Skelly, that's... that's incredible! So then... you and your crew, you perished at sea?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: I, uh, pfff, hahaha, boyo, you are something else, you know? All that Schelemeus stuff, I could have had you eating out of my hand for days!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, I get it. You got me. Fine, then, Schelemeus, but I don't appreciate the trick.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 骨头，你是真的不想谈谈你是怎么来这里的吗？我只是很好奇你以前的样子，你是个什么样的人，你的真名叫什么。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你凭什么觉得“骨头”就不是我的真名了，兄弟？这么说可扎心了啊！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 抱歉，我只是想说……你帮了我这么多忙，我希望能更好地了解了解你。有什么可以告诉我的事情吗？要是你愿意说，那我也说一件关于我自己的事情！

zh-CN.speaker: 瑟勒米乌斯
zh-CN.text: ……行吧，好吧……我活着的时候是个指挥官。我叫瑟勒米乌斯，是克里特岛第二舰队的船长，受米诺斯王之命前往雅典。我们的舰队势不可挡……但后来……我们拐错了个弯儿……就直接跑到海怪的地盘上了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 骨头，这可……这可真是太难以置信了，然后呢……你和你的船员，你们死在海上了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 我，嗯，噗！哈哈哈！兄嘚，你脑子怕不是秀逗了吧？这种破故事你都能信？真够让我乐上几天的了！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，好吧。这次算你赢了，瑟勒米乌斯。不过我可不喜欢你和我开这种玩笑。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Skelly... I'm serious. You really won't tell me anything about you? You're just going to leave me to speculate, forever?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 骨头……我是说真的，你真的不打算和我说说关于你的事情吗？你就打算让我一直这么遐想下去吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Say, Skelly... or should I say Schelemeus? I happened to have a chat with somebody familiar with that name. Large bull-headed fellow originally from Crete. You said you made it all up! What's going on?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Never said I made it up, pal! I just knew you weren't going to believe me, I mean, look at me! I look like a captain of the Cretan second fleet to you?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I don't know. I've never met one. Do they all just stand around doing nothing?

en.speaker: Schelemeus
en.text: Well, sounds like somebody's never had to lead like fifty-or-something sailors in a voyage across the sea in a Minoan galley with nothing but the stars to guide 'em! What do you think the captains do, pull the oars?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, what about Hermes? He gave me the impression you might have been somebody else. Nobody in particular. Not some great sea-captain.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: What is it with you gods talking behind the backs of all your friends, boyo?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Don't change the subject!

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Don't change the subject!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我说，骨头……或者说，应该叫你瑟勒米乌斯？我刚好碰到了某个从克里特岛来的牛头人，和他聊了聊，他听说过这个名字。你之前说，那些事情都是你编出来的！这是怎么回事？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 我可没说那些都是我编出来的，兄弟！我当时只是觉得你并不会相信我，我是说，看看我这个样子吧！你真觉得我是克里特岛第二舰队的船长吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我不知道，我从来没见过他们，他们全都站在那里无所事事吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 瑟勒米乌斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，听起来像是某个人从来没带过几十名水手横渡米诺斯海峡，而且在周围什么都没有的情况下，只能靠星星来辨别方向。你觉得船长是干什么的？划船的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等等，那赫尔墨斯呢？他暗示我你可能撒了谎。你可能不是什么重要人物，不是什么伟大的船长。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 趁你朋友不在的时候，众神都和你说了什么啊，兄嘚？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 别转移话题！

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 别转移话题！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That Lucky Tooth you gave me, Skelly. First off, thanks again, and secondly... is this even yours? Had a run-in with Hermes, who got me thinking.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: What, haha, you going to believe everything that gabby guy tells you, now, boyo? He doesn't know a thing about me!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Never said he did. Though since you let on... what's your relationship to him? Working for him?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: No! Nope. Definitely not working for him, closer to a peer relationship. Well, other than the fact that he's a god and I'm just... well, what you see is what you get with me, pal. Hey, you won't tell anyone, will you? I'm just here to help, I swear!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 骨头，关于你给我的那颗幸运牙齿，我首先得谢谢你，然后我想问……那颗牙真的是你的吗？我和赫尔墨斯碰了个面，当时的情形让我不由得怀疑起来。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 什么？哈哈，那个满嘴跑火车的家伙，他说啥你就信啥吗，兄嘚？关于我的事情，他连个屁都不知道！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我从来没说过他认识你，但既然你说漏了嘴……你和他之间是什么关系？你再替他卖命吗？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 才不是呢！没有，我可没替他卖命。非要说的话，我们更像是同事。不过，他是个神，而我呢……我就是你看到的这副鬼样子。嘿，兄弟，这些话你是不会告诉别人的吧？我真的只是来帮你的，我对天发誓！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: All right, fess up, Skelly, who are you working for? I know it's not Achilles. It's not Nyx. Dusa has no idea who you are. My father... no way. Hypnos? Give me a break. So the House is ruled out.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Sorry, pal, my lips are sealed. How about we change the subject?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: How about you tell me who your sources are?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Nope!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Tell me.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: No way.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Tell me!

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: I said no!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Tell me, Skelly.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Nuh-uh.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Come on, tell me, please?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: No. Means. No.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Why won't you tell me?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Nice try, pal.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What if I never hit you again?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So help me, Skelly, if you don't tell me who you're working for, there will be no more violence between us, ever.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: No... please, have mercy, boyo...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No mercy, Skelly. Tell me. Or else... it will be only pleasantries between us from here on out.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Nrrrghh, all right! But you got to promise me something, promise not to let on or tell anybody in your fancy House, all right? Or else I'm done for. I'm serious!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I promise. So...?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: ...It's Charon.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Charon! Huh.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Yeah. He's rich. He's got connections to guys like me, and I think he's got a horse in this chariot race you've got going on around here with Papa.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What's his angle?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: No idea. Maybe he likes you, maybe he's bored.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: And Hermes... he's working for Charon, too?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Yep! Now, let's pretend like none of this ever happened, so I can stick around, all right? Remember, pal, you promised!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 行了，实话实说吧，骨头，你到底是在给谁卖命呢？我知道你的主人不是阿喀琉斯，不是倪克斯，杜莎也不认识你。至于我的父亲……门都没有。修普诺斯？我看没戏。整个圣殿的人都可以排除了。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 抱歉啦，兄弟，我的口风可是很严的。不如咱换个话题聊聊吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不如和我说说你的老大是谁吧？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 没门！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 说说嘛。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 想都别想。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 就说说嘛！

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 我说不行了！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 来说说嘛，骨头。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 嗯嗯，不行。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 拜托了，就和我说一下嘛？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 不行，我说过了，不行。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你真的不能告诉我吗？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 你想得美，伙计。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果我以后再也不打你了呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 所以，你得帮我这个忙，骨头。如果你不告诉我你的老大是谁，那我以后就再也不打你了，想都别想了。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 别这样啊……拜托，做个人吧，兄嘚……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我不做人了，骨头，赶紧告诉我。否则……从现在开始，我就要对你和和气气的了。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 啊啊啊啊，好吧！但你得答应我一件事，你得答应我，别把这件事情告诉圣殿里的任何人，知道吗？否则我就玩完了，我可是说真的！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我答应你，所以呢……？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: ……是卡戎。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是卡戎！哎哟。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 丫可老有钱了，认识很多像我这样的人。你还记得你和你老爹之前参加的那个战车比赛吧？我觉得里面有匹马也是他的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 他到底想干什么？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 我哪知道，说不定他喜欢你，也说不定他就是闲出屁了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 还有赫尔墨斯……他也是在替卡戎办事吗？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 对啊！行了，咱们假装这些话从来都没说过吧，这样我才能继续在这里混，好吧？记住了啊，兄弟，你得说话算话！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Skelly, did you tell Charon and Hermes about our little conversation from before, about your sources? Because, I didn't tell them, but... they seemed to know.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Boyo, thought we agreed we weren't going to be having conversations on the subject from here on. Spares me having to spill my guts with my sources later.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I didn't get you into too much trouble, did I?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 骨头，你是不是告诉卡戎和赫尔墨斯我们之前谈话的事情了？因为那些话我根本没告诉过他们，可是……他们好像已经知道了。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 兄嘚，你不是说好了，说以后不会再跟我谈这些事情了吗？别再逼我拼着我这条老命，和你叨咕我我老板的事情了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我没给你惹上太多麻烦吧？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Skelly, what with everything out in the open now, with the Queen and Charon, and all that... mind if I mention some of this to Thanatos? Charon's his brother, after all.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Oh! Yeah, now that you mention it, I guess that part of the old contract no longer applies. So, go right ahead! Appreciate you asking, pal.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，骨头，既然所有的事情都公之于众了，包括皇后与卡戎的事情之类的……不介意我和塔纳托斯透露一些实情吧？毕竟他是卡戎的兄弟。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 哦！是啊，话说到这份上，那我猜旧契约上的那部分内容已经没用了。所以你就勇敢前进吧！谢谢你问起这件事情，兄弟。

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Pal, thanks again for that Nectar bottle from before, stuff just goes right through me like you won't believe! Though, I hope you're not going around giving that stuff away to every bozo you know.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, Skelly, you worried something bad is going to happen if I express a bit of generosity from time to time through our somewhat-illicit gift-giving custom around here?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: No, I'm worried you'll be wasting your time! If you give that stuff away, don't expect to get anything back. Well, not after the first time, anyway. Usually! I'm just saying... don't get your hopes up.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Maybe I just want to show thanks to my friends for its own sake!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 兄弟，我得再谢谢你之前送给我的那瓶蜜露。那玩意儿我咕嘟一口就给干了，那滋味就甭提了！不过，你应该不是个冤大头，随便见到哪个白痴，就把那玩意给人家吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 怎么了，骨头？你在担心，如果我总是时不时地送给别人点礼物，时不时破坏一下这里的规矩，会不会发生什么不好的事情，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 不，我是担心你在浪费时间！你把那些东西送给别人，别期待他们会给你回礼。除了第一次吧。基本就是这么回事！我只是想说……别指望太多。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 或许我只是单纯地想感谢一下我的朋友而已！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Skelly? You look like you know your way around Tartarus. Found some of this ancient Titan blood out there, and I was looking to score some more.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Ah, you've come to the right place regarding that, there, pal! It's your mean weapons back there that can find the stuff. Once you get all the way through Tartarus with one, that's all the blood you're going to get! For the time being anyhow.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: How am I supposed to keep track of which weapons I've earned these with, then?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: I don't know, there's always the invention of writing stuff down? You'll figure something out.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 喂，骨头，你应该蛮熟悉塔耳塔罗斯的吧。我在那里找到了这些远古泰坦之血，我打算多弄点这种血来。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 啊，那你可问对人了，兄弟！那些血得靠你那些邪恶的武器才能收集得到。只要随便用哪把武器通过塔耳塔罗斯，就能得到这些血了！起码现在是这样的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那我要怎么知道，我用过哪些武器得到过这种远古之血？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 那我哪知道啊，说不定有人发明过什么能用来记事的东西吧？你肯定能想出办法的。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Skelly, you mentioned the ancient bit of blood I found in Tartarus. Know what I'm supposed to do with this stuff?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Wouldn't know a thing about it! Definitely doesn't have anything to do with those Infernal Arms of yours, some of which appear to still be unavailable to you, as I understand?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 骨头，你之前提过我在塔耳塔罗斯找到的远古之血，你知道我应该用这玩意做什么吗？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 这我可一点都不清楚！而且我敢肯定，那些血和你身上的冥府兵器肯定一毛钱关系都没有。不过据我所知，有几把冥府兵器你还没拿到呢，是吧？

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: So the strangest thing happened while you were out, boyo! One of your weapon holder things back there, it picked up this eerie glow! Could see it from the corner of my eye!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Calm down, Skelly. I'm sure whatever it is is perfectly normal for a legendary semi-sentient Titan-slaying weapon from the dawn of time.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: That's just it! Those weapons of yours, they have seen some real business, pal. You're giving them a real workout, so maybe they're starting to like you or something? Loosening up a bit, you know? Like you and me!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 你外出的时候发生了一件非常奇怪的事情，兄弟。你那个摆武器的地方，发出了诡异的光！我从眼角都能看到！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 冷静，骨头。很明确地说，在这件杀死泰坦并且拥有一定自我意识的传说级远古武器上发生这样的事情，再正常不过了。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 就是这样！你的这些武器，个个都来头不小啊，兄弟。如果你能带它们出去实战一番，也许会增进彼此的感情也说不定？出去活动活动。就像你跟我！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: You know, pal, when you're not around and it's just me and all your weapons, I mean your Infernal Arms right over there, between us they are making me a bit uncomfortable.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Can't blame you, mate. I wouldn't want to be stuck in a chamber with a bunch of legendary, quite possibly malevolent killing artifacts. Anything I can do?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Oh I didn't mean it like a bad thing, boyo! The weirder you make those things, the more it gives me the shakes, and keeps me hopping like this nice and steady till the next time you get back! So, thanks!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 知道吗，兄弟。当你不在的时候，只有我和你的那些武器，就是那边的冥府兵器，在我们之间，它们让我感到有些不自在。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这不是你的问题，兄弟。我也不想和一堆传说中的，杀气腾腾的东西共处一室。我能怎么办呢？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 哦，我不是说这是什么坏事，兄弟！你把那些东西弄得越怪异，给我的感觉就越强烈，让我就像现在这样忙得不可开交，一直到下一次你再回来！所以，谢谢你！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Say, Skelly? Don't suppose you'd care to tell me how the infamous Twin Fists of Malphon came to be right here in this very courtyard, would you?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Nope! Not any of my business, pal, which is to say, I didn't see a thing! And even if I did, it isn't what I'm paid to do! Don't you have someone in your fancy House there paid to keep watch over stuff like that? Ask them!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 骨头，如果我问你，这恶名昭彰的玛尔封双子之拳是怎么来到这里的，你会告诉我吗？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 不会！根本不关我的事，兄弟。我意思是，我什么都没看到！就算我知道，也没人付我钱啊！你们圣殿那里不是有人专门收钱管这些东西的吗，你去问他们啊！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Hey, just want to say, pal, that spooky crimson phoenix stuff that you were going on about before? I mean, whoa, you just say some nonsense and you get a brand-new spear? I was so impressed, I decided to try that trick for myself!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, gods... Skelly, what did you do...?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Relax, boyo, just had a little chat with your old serving platter over there after you left, is all. That thing hits pretty hard! So, then, I say to it, I see you through the eyes of the crimson phoenix... and you want to know what happened after that?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So you carelessly spoke secret words imparted by the Fates themselves to an infernal weapon forged at the dawn of creation, then what? Say, did you walk up to Aegis, or just shout over your shoulder?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Over my shoulder! Anyway, what happened next was nothing! Your Aegis kept on bobbing like a dummy. So then I went and said that mumbo jumbo to every other weapon, but nope! Doesn't work at all. So much for your fancy sorcery, huh?

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 喂，我跟你说，兄弟，还记得之前那只吓死人的绯红凤凰吗？我是说，天啊，你不过是胡说八道了一通，就弄到了一根全新的矛！可把我馋的，我也打算什么时候试试这招！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，老天啊……骨头，你都做了什么啊……？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 别紧张，兄嘚，就是你走了之后，我跟你用过的那个大盘子聊了一会，仅此而已。那玩意打人可真疼啊！我对它说，我透过绯红凤凰的眼睛看着你……你猜后来怎么了？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这句密语可是命运之神在创世之初对某把冥府兵器说的，你就这么大大咧咧地地对它说了？然后呢？你是走过去对着埃癸斯说的，还是站在这朝它喊的？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 当然是喊的！反正后来什么也没有发生！你的埃癸斯还是像个傻瓜一样上蹿下跳。接着，我就对着每一件武器都说了这些乱七八糟的咒语，不过也没用！完全没用！你这秘密法术都是瞎编出来的吧？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So, what exactly happened with the formerly pink window over there? Now it's got these sinister orange flames and an enormous Pact of Punishment hanging ominously over the exit. Father stop by?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Pal, I don't know a thing about it, honest! I was just minding my own business, when all the sudden, wham! I get hit right in the back. I fall to pieces, no idea what's going on! When I finally come to, the window job was done...!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那边那扇粉色窗户之前是怎么回事？现在那里跳动着邪恶的橘黄色火焰，还有一块巨大的惩罚契约挂在出口那边，非常不详。父亲来过？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 兄弟，我什么都不知道，真的！我正在想事情,然后突然就砰的一声！正中我的背部。我整个摔散了，搞不清状况！等我回过神来，窗户那边就是现在这样了……！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Listen, boyo: I don't know exactly how to put this, so I'm just going to come right out. I need your help with something, and, I'll be honest, I don't think you're going to like it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: If it doesn't involve hacking away at you with reckless abandon, Skelly, I don't want to hear it. But... oh. You're being serious.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: I am. And funny you should put it like that. Boyo, I am asking you to get me out of here. Permanently, if you catch my drift. This standing around stuff... just kind of wears on you, after a while, you know?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...I know. I can only imagine. Tell me what I can do.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: That blade of yours back there. It's got a special power. You got to spruce it all the way up. Your Aspect, not somebody's else's. Then let me have it with that thing... and I'm out of here.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Then you'd be dead, forever? You're asking me to kill you.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: I know it's a lot to dump on you, but I got my reasons. I don't exactly have a lot of options, here, so... give it some thought. Till then, we'll act like nothing's changed, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 听着，兄弟：我不知道该怎么委婉地说出口，那我就直说了。我想让你帮点忙，但老实说，我觉得你会不高兴的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果不是关于如何毫不留情地把你干掉，骨头，那我就不想知道。但是……哦，你是认真的。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 是的。如果你这么说，我会觉得很好笑。兄弟，请你把我弄出去。永远逃离这里，如果你明白我的意思。在这里罚站这事儿……不一会儿就会让人感到精疲力尽，你知道吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: ……我知道。我只能想象。告诉我我能做点什么。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 你的剑又回到这里了。它拥有特殊的力量。你应该把它好好收拾一下。你的形态，不是别人的。那么，让我拿上它……然后离开这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 然后你就死了，永远地死了？你让我杀了你。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 我知道你面前有一堆烂摊子，但我也有我的理由。老实说，我其实没得选，所以呢……你好好想想吧。在那之前，咱们就当什么事情都没发生过，好不好？

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Listen, boyo: I don't know exactly how to put this, so I'm just going to come right out. I need your help with something, and, I'll be honest, I don't think you're going to like it.

en.speaker: Zagreus

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...I know. I can only imagine. Tell me what I can do.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: That blade of yours back there. It's got a special power. Your Aspect, now that it's maxed out. You got to let me have it with that thing... and then I'm out of here.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Then you'd be dead... forever? You're asking me to kill you.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: I know it's a lot to dump on you, but I got my reasons. I don't exactly have a lot of options, here, so... give it some thought. Till then, we'll act like nothing's changed, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 听着，兄弟：我不知道该怎么委婉地说出口，那我就直说了。我想让你帮点忙，但老实说，我觉得你会不高兴的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 是的。如果你这么说，我会觉得很好笑。兄弟，请你把我弄出去。永远逃离这里，如果你明白我的意思。在这里罚站这事儿……不一会儿就会让人感到精疲力尽，你知道吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: ……我知道。我只能想象。告诉我我能做点什么。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 你的剑又回到这里了。它拥有特殊的力量。你的形态，现在已经到了最高点。你得让我拿着它……然后离开这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 然后你就死了，永远地死了？你让我杀了你。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 我知道你面前有一堆烂摊子，但我也有我的理由。老实说，我其实没得选，所以呢……你好好想想吧。在那之前，咱们就当什么事情都没发生过，好不好？

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: So, uh, pal? My sources tell me that you made it pretty far. Which means... my usefulness is coming to an end.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Your usefulness, what, you just mean the standing around, letting me lay into you with whatever vicious attack sequence I fancy at the time?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Yeah! Once you achieve your goal... my contract's up. You won't need me anymore.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: But only if I leave for good, isn't that right? So if I stuck around... you'd stay here, too?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Probably, but... wait, you're really going to stay?

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 所以，呃，兄弟？我的线人告诉我，说你到了很远的地方。这意味着……我对你来说也不再有用了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你说你有用，怎么，你指的就是干站着，让我随心所欲地拿各种东西往你身上招呼吗？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 是啊！等你达成了你的目标之后……我的契约就完成了，你也不会再需要我了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 但只有我走了才会这样，对吧？所以如果我被困在这里……你也会留在这里，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 或许是吧，不过……等等，你真的打算留在这里吗？

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: So Mama's back in town from what I hear, boyo! It's awful nice knowing I trained you well.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, you must mean the Queen, and evidently you're aware of our relationship. You keep that quiet, understand, Skelly?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Ahh, and thus the pupil trains the master, for a change! I hear you, pal. Your secret's safe with me.

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 我听说，你妈妈又回到这里了，兄嘚！看到你被我训练得这么出色，我真是说不出有多高兴。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃嗯，你指的一定是冥后，而且很显然，你已经知道了我们之间的关系。这个秘密不准说出去，明白了吗，骨头？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 啊啊，于是学生摇身一变，成了老师！我明白了，兄弟，你的秘密我绝不会说出去。

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: You must have had yourself a real bash, with all those fancy gods and stuff! Could hear all the festivity from all the way out here. How was it, pal?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It... went better than expected, all in all. I hope you didn't feel left out! It was a pretty limited guest list. Kind of a diplomatic mission, I would say. Not quite as good a time as it might have sounded from the outside.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Ohh, don't you even worry about me, there, pal! I much prefer the solitary life, and besides! When things are good for you, they're good for me. Glad everything worked out.

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 你们肯定好好享受了一番盛典吧，有花里胡哨的众神，还有各种好东西！我从这里都能听到你们的欢闹声了。玩得还开心吧，兄弟？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 事情……比想象得要好，也就是这样了，希望你不会觉得被排挤在外！宾客的名单非常有限。要我说，这更像是某种外交任务之类的，实际上并不像外边传得那样其乐融融。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 哦，可千万别担心我，兄弟！我真的很喜欢一个人呆着，而且！只要你觉得开心，我也就觉得开心，我很高兴一切都很顺利。

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Less yakking, more smacking, boyo, now come on!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 少说话，多做事，兄弟，来啊！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Less chatter, more batter, boyo, hit me already!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 闭上嘴巴，来打我啊！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Less talking, more socking, here, pal!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 别说话，打我！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Come on, boyo, less gabbing, more stabbing over here!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 来啊兄弟，别说话，揍我就完事了！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Less prattle, more battle, boyo, give me all you got!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 别聊天了，兄弟，揍我快点！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Can't break these bones, pal, what you just try it!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 连这些骨头都打不坏吗兄弟，接着打！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: You want another a piece of this, or what?

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 你到底还打不打了！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Enough with the small talk, boyo, hit me, go on!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 别废话了，兄弟，揍我，赶紧的！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Trying to bore me to death with all this chit-chat, pal?

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 你是想靠嘴说死我吗，兄弟？

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: This look like a shoulder to cry on to you, boyo?

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 想靠在我肩膀上痛哭吗，硌不死你！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Let me have it already, boyo, no holding back!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 快点打我，兄弟，别放水！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Let's see what you can do in terms of hitting me, pal!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 看看你能不能给爷爷我揍出花儿来！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: You could be hitting me right now, boyo!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 说话的工夫够你揍我好几回了，兄弟！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Sure could go for somebody just whaling away on me right now.

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 爷现在什么都不想做只想被人暴打。

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: What's the matter, you gone soft or something, pal?

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 怎么回事，下不了手吗兄弟？

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: You going to hit me over here, or what?

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 你到底还打不打我了？

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Go on, boyo, give me your best shot, it's my job!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 来啊，兄弟，全力揍过来，爷挣的就是这个钱！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Sure could use a good smack in the jaw from you right about now!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 好想挨你一发升龙拳啊！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: You want to fight me, boyo, well hop to it, stat!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 想打架吗，兄弟，爷站在这给你打！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: What do I look like, pal, some kind of conversationalist?

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 找我聊天？兄弟你要疯啊是怎么的？

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Our relationship, boyo, requires no exchange of words!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 咱俩这关系，还用得着话语来维系？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: For you, mate! Thought you might get a kick out of this.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: For me, pal? Awful nice of you, just awful nice, but guess what, I got this for you! Tit for tat, you understand, a deal's a deal!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 给你的，伙计。我觉得你应该会喜欢这个东西。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 给我的吗，兄弟？你太好了，真是太好了，你猜怎么着，我给你这个！有来有回，知道吗，就这么定了！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Whoa-hoh, you being serious here, pal? You brought that all this way, for little old me?! That's real nice of you!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're not so bad yourself, mate. Thanks for always being here for me to savagely attack without a second thought.

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 哎哟呵，认真的吗，兄弟？你费这么大劲带过来，就为了我这么个老东西？你真是太好了！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你也不那么坏，伙计。感谢你一直以来承受我毫无顾忌的暴打。

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Whoaaaa, now get a load of what you got there, boyo! Wait, really, that's for me? Or you just pulling my leg?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm really giving this to you, mate. Now go enjoy it, will you? Once I've finished pummeling you some more just for the sake of it.

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 噢哦哦哦，我来看看你的这些东西，兄弟！等等，你真的是给我的吗，还是逗我玩？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 真的是给你的，伙计。你就收下吧，好吗？实在不行，我先揍你一顿，然后你好好收下可以不。

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Heeey now that's what I'm talking about, thanks, boyo! Won't forget you doing me a solid like this, cross my heart!!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No need to thank me, mate. But don't you dare forget it or I'll attack you repeatedly and without mercy.

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 哈，这才对嘛，谢谢你，兄弟！我对天发誓，永远不会忘记你的大恩大德！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不用谢我，伙计。但是你要是忘记了，我就要狠狠地揍你，天天揍你！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Oh look here, pal, I can't just keep accepting these from you! Not when they're paying me already, I got standards to uphold, you know?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I will look the other way if you do, mate. Now, here! Or else!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 嚯兄弟，我不能老拿你送我的东西！既然我是他们雇来的，那这个肯定是有规章制度的，你知道不？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那我就假装不知道，伙计，拿着！不然的话！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Haaah, you're kidding, what? Sometimes, boyo, you make me feel alive again, you know that? Being honest with you here, I'm grateful, really.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: If not for you, my friend, I'd have no one to viciously attack with no fear of reprisal whatsoever.

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 哈哈，你开玩笑呢吧？有时候，兄弟，你让我感觉自己又活过来一样，知道不？实话实说，我很高兴，真的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果没有你，我的朋友，我再找不到第二个能让我无忧无虑暴揍他的人了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Skelly, while I know your services have already been paid in full, your sources ought to know you've been doing an excellent job. So much so, I wanted to give you this.

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Whaaa, is that a vintage bottle of Ambrosia, pal?! I never even thought I'd get to try a thing like that, I mean, what am I, here? Know what, I want you to have this. To symbolize our friendship, and in case you ever need a hand out there.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 骨头，我知道你拿到了全部报酬，你的线人应该也知道你出色地完成了任务。尽管如此，我还是要把这个给你。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 这是什么，一瓶仙酒吗，兄弟？！我做梦都想不到我能得到这样的东西，毕竟，在这里我算什么呢？但是，我希望你收下这个。它象征着我们的友谊，而且没准你到时需要什么帮助呢。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hope you enjoyed that vintage bottle of Ambrosia last time, Skelly, because I got you another. Here!

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Aww, no way, boyo, you kidding me right now? Why are you even, I... look, I, I just stand around and let you beat me up, you don't have to do this. You don't even know who I am. Who I was.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're my friend, mate. That's all that matters. Although... I don't suppose you're willing to divulge those types of details? Just out of curiosity.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 希望你还喜欢上次给你的仙馔密酒，骨头，因为我今天又给你带了一瓶。

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 哎哟，不是吧，兄弟，你在和我开玩笑吗？你为什么要，我……呃，你看，我只是站着让你打了一顿，你没必要跟我这么客气。你甚至都不知道我是谁，我有什么来历。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你是我的朋友，伙计。这才是最重要的。但是……我觉得你可能不愿意透露这么多细节？只是出于好奇。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know, Skelly, I still cannot entirely get over that whole permanently-kill-you stunt you pulled on me. You had me deeply worried for a while, all for just a laugh?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Yeah, that's right! Not exactly much to do here, case you hadn't noticed recently! Good thing I'm able to stay occupied with intellectual pursuits.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That's what you call it, then? In any case, I did want to make sure: You sure that you're all right, having to stand around like this?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: You kidding, pal? This is the life! Imagine getting paid to stand around! And being pals with you!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道吗，骨头，我还是对你说的要让我永远死去这句话耿耿于怀。你让我担心了好久，现在就这么一笑了之？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 一点儿不错！如果你没注意到的话我可以提醒一下，待在这里真没什么事儿做！好处就是我可以继续忙于脑力工作了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你觉得这算是学知识？无论如何，我都要确定一点：你觉得这样好吗，就这么干站着？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 你在开玩笑吗，兄弟？这就是生活！想想看，这么干站着，还能得到报酬！而且还可以和你交上朋友！

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Hahaha, got you pretty good, again, didn't I, boyo?! I am asking you to get me out of here. Hahahaha! All that stuff about your blade, and your Aspect, I mean, you ate all of it right up! Woo, hoo-hoo!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It appears I've been the victim of an elaborate prank. Not sure that I appreciate it, Skelly. What if I were to never hit you again, how would you like that?

en.speaker: Skelly
en.text: Whoa, whoa whoa whoa whoa, whoa! Now come on, boyo, it was just a joke, I figured things could lighten up a little here. Don't need to do anything rash!

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 哈哈哈，又把你吓得够呛吧，兄弟？！我让你把我弄出去。哈哈哈哈！和你的刀剑有关的所有东西，还有你的形态，都被你吃得精光！喔，嚯-嚯！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我好像成了精心布局的恶作剧的受害者。我自己都不确定这是好事还是坏事，骨头。万一我再也打不到你了呢，你觉得怎么样？

zh-CN.speaker: Skelly
zh-CN.text: 哇，呀呀呀呀呀！好了，兄弟，我只是在开玩笑，我觉得这里的情况可能会有所好转。没必要这么着急！

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: My sisters and I. We've had a chance to talk, and we have come to an agreement, Zagreus. As you can see.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Megaera, Tis, you ready?

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmurdererr!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Three against one. Doesn't seem all that sporting, now, does it?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: We're each well past the need for any sport. We'll kill you, whatever it takes. Erinyes! Now.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我和我的姐妹谈过了，我们达成了一致协议，扎格列欧斯。如你所见。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿勒克图
zh-CN.text: 墨纪拉，提西，准备好了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 提西福涅
zh-CN.text: 刽子手！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 三个打一个。这样是不是不太符合体育精神？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我们这边没人在乎什么体育精神。只要能杀死你就行了。厄里倪厄斯！现在。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: What's the matter, Zagreus? You look a bit uncomfortable. Something you want to say to me? Or any one of us?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, it's just... there's something that I wanted to discuss with you, at some point, Meg, but after more consideration, I am thinking maybe now is not the time.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I understand entirely. Though you should know my sisters and I keep no secrets from each other, anymore. Isn't that right, Sisters?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 怎么了，扎格列欧斯？你看起来有点不舒服。你想对我说些什么吗？或者想对我们中的某一位说什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是这样，额……我本来想找个时间和你说点事，但经过慎重考虑，我觉得现在可能还不是时候。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我完全理解。你应该认识我的姐妹们，我们之间现在没有任何秘密。我说的没错吧，姐妹们？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Eugh, I almost want to thank you, Zagreus. I thought you'd never change that blasted Pact, and leave me here, in peace.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, you mean you aren't lonelier without Alecto's or Tisiphone's companionship? They seem so wonderful to have around.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: They're tolerable each to some extent. About as much as I can say for you. Now let's the two of us begin.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 啊，我甚至觉得欠你一声感谢，扎格列欧斯。我之前觉得你不会更改那个该死的契约，然后把我留在这里，自生自灭。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么，你是说，没了阿勒克图或提西福涅的陪伴，你并不觉得孤单？有他们在身边不是很好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 在某种程度上，他们相互忍让。至少我可以说，对你来说是这样的。咱们现在开始吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: See, Alecto? He is right on time, just as I said.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Megaera, bleed him!

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 看到了吗，阿勒克图？他总是很守时，就像我说的那样。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿勒克图
zh-CN.text: 墨纪拉，让他流血！

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Heads up, Tisiphone. I think I found a murderer for you.

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmuuurrrderrrr...

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 小心了，提西福涅。我好像找到了你的克星。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I have to level with you, Zagreus. For all we've been through... never once have I wanted you to meet my sisters.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I can't imagine why not! We had a lovely time getting to know each other. We laughed, we cried! My only regret was that you couldn't be there, yourself.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You don't know what you're saying. There's a reason that they're not permitted in the House. Though, come on. One of us is going back there, now.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我必须跟你坦白，扎格列欧斯。我们经历了这么多……从来没有哪次我想让你见一见我的姐妹们。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我真的想不清为什么如此！我们互相认识得真高兴，又笑又哭！我唯一的遗憾就是你自己无法到场。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你不知道你在说什么。不准她们进入圣殿是有原因的。不过，来吧。接下来我俩之间有一个要回到圣殿里了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You've really done it, Zagreus. My sisters have returned. All three of us now share the same assignment.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Is it wrong of me that I am somewhat honored to have garnered the attention of the Erinyes?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Oh I would say it's very wrong of you, indeed.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你真的成功了，扎格列欧斯。我的姐妹们回来了。现在我们三个都要做同一件事。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我还以为受到厄里倪厄斯的关注是件很荣幸的事呢，看来是我错啦。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 嗯，你简直是大错特错。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I sense something different about you, Zagreus. Your old weakness. Ah... the Mirror. I thought you said you weren't trying to compete with me?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I wasn't. But then you gave me a good idea to try. I'm not as weak as I once was. With or without the Mirror's help.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Is that so? Well then let's see if you're correct. Come on.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我感觉你有点不对劲，扎格列欧斯。你的老毛病。啊……圣镜。我记得你说过你不会再和我争斗了，不是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我本来是不会。但现在，你让我有了一种要试一试的想法。我已经不再像过去那么软弱。不管有没有圣镜的帮助。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 难道不是吗？那么我们来验证一下。来吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I heard that you escaped. Then, what are you still doing here? Forget something along the way?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know... I think I'd rather fight you to the death again than try to answer either of those questions, right now.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I don't know what you're up to, Zagreus. But I guess it doesn't matter, either way. All that matters is you're not getting past me.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我听说你已经逃走了，那你怎么还在这里？忘了什么东西吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 老实说……比起回答你的问题，我现在更希望能和你打个至死方休。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我不知道你想干什么，扎格列欧斯。不过这不重要，重要的是你不能从我这里通过。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Your mother has returned to us, already, Zagreus. And still you're going to keep battling your way out, past me and everything up there? Why?

en.speaker: Zagreus
