en.text: Father says there's no escape from here, and I like to repeatedly show him he's wrong. Besides, I think getting out there a bit from time to time does me some good.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Sounds like you've found yourself a steady line of work. Most jobs just need doing. If this one gives you some fulfillment, stick to it. Now, come on.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你的母亲已经回来了，扎格列欧斯。但你还是坚持战斗，要打败我和所有其他人，然后逃离这里，为什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲说没人能逃出这个地方，而我很乐于一次又一次地向他证明，他说错了。另外，我觉得时不时地逃出这个地方，对我也有好处。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 听起来你好像已经找到了份稳定的工作。还有很多工作要做呢，如果这份工作能让你有成就感的话，那就加油干吧。好了，开战吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: What is it that you're up to now, Zagreus? The Queen is back. But still you're making me show up like this?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Got some unfinished business with the Olympians to take care of, was in the area, figured I'd say hi. Hi, Meg!

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Don't start with me. You show up here, we fight, somebody dies. That's it. Now, who's it going to be?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你现在又是要干什么呢，扎格列欧斯？冥后已经回来了，但你还要我与你兵刃相见吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我和奥林匹斯众神还有些没处理完的事情，所以我必须得来这里，打个招呼才行。你好啊，墨纪！

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你不用跟我打招呼。你过来，咱们开打，打到有人死了为止，就是这样。好了，这次死的会是谁呢？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Been seeing an awful lot of each other lately, haven't we. You had enough of me, yet, Zag?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Never enough, Meg. You ready for another go at it, too, I take it?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Always. Although I do like to keep things fresh, so... surprise me.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 咱们最近见面见得还真频繁啊。你见我这么多次，还不觉得腻吗，扎格？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我永远都不会觉得腻，墨纪。我猜你也准备好再来一次了，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 是啊，虽然我是个喜欢新鲜的人，不过……让我大吃一惊吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Listen to me, Zagreus. Your mother is long gone. You're never getting out of here, and even if you did, what hope could you possibly have in finding her up in the world out there?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I've hope enough. Not that it's any of your business anymore.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Your family is here. And so is your responsibility. You're running from yourself. Though, I can slow you down a bit I think.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 听我说，扎格列欧斯。你母亲已经不在了。你根本没法逃出这个地方，就算你成功了，你真的有把握能在外面的世界找到她？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我当然有把握。然而这与你无关。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你的家就在这里，你要对这里负责。你这是在自我逃避，不过我应该可以拖慢你的脚步。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: What... where did you get the Rail? Do you know what you have? Where are your customary weapons?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I left them at home. And, I sort of know what I have, inasmuch as it's largely responsible for getting me this far. Would you like to see a demonstration?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Yes, I would. I always have, as a matter of fact.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 什么……你从哪得到的炮？你知道你拿着的是什么吗？你平时用的武器呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 扔家里了。我知道自己拿着什么，有了这个我才能一路杀到这里来。要不要我演示下给你看看？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 好啊，让我看看吧，老实说我一直都想见识见识。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: What's that you're holding, Zagreus? Please tell me that you didn't steal the most dangerous, unstable artifacts sealed shut within your father's vault.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, it wasn't I who stole them, if that's any reassurance to you, Meg!

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You are a hopeless fool. You cannot possibly know what you're doing with those things. You put them back exactly where you found them.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你手里那是什么，扎格列欧斯？可别告诉我你偷走了你父亲锁在仓库里最危险、最难以驾驭的东西。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，偷这东西的人可不是我，不知这么说能不能让你安心一点，墨纪！

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你这白痴真是没救了。你知不知道你这是在玩火？赶紧给我把那些东西放回去。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...Nyx really let Dusa go?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: She did... so you heard. I don't know what happened. You didn't even get a chance to say goodbye?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: No. Damn it. If you had anything to do with this...! Even if you didn't, come on and die!

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……倪克斯真的把杜莎赶走了？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 她真把她赶走了……你没听错。我都不知道之前发生了什么。你们当时连道别的机会都没有吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 没有，真该死。如果这件事和你有关的话……！就算和你无关，我也要杀了你！

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: What have you done with the Pact, Zagreus? This isn't even Asphodel, and I can barely tolerate the heat. Do you really want to die this terribly?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Appreciate all the concern, but I just thought I'd live a little, Meg. You ought to try it for yourself, sometime!

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You ought to try watching your mouth. You want a swift and painful death, you'll have one momentarily.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你对契约做了什么，扎格列欧斯？这里甚至连水仙花平原都没到呢，我就几乎要忍受不了这种热度了。你真的想惨死在这里吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 感谢关心，不过我还打算活一阵子呢，墨纪。你什么时候也应该体验体验努力求生的滋味！

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你少在这里大放厥词。要是你想死得无比惨烈，那我马上成全你。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Halt, Zagreus. Not one step further.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Come on, Meg. Haven't we had more than enough of each other by now? Besides, don't you have someplace else to be?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Your father sent me. All in all, I'd rather be on your bad side than his. Now you can turn back like a good little man, or I can send you home the painful way. What'll it be?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...I'll have to go with the painful way.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: A man after my own heart.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 停下，扎格列欧斯。不准再往前一步。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 别这样，墨纪。我们彼此之间都已经闹够吧？再说，你就不能去别的地方吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 是你父亲派我来。说归说，如果要选的话我宁可得罪你。你现在可以直接转身走人，或者我用痛苦的方式送你回家。你怎么选？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: ……我选第二项。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 正合我意。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Tell me something, Zag, because I'm curious. Do your Olympian relatives know the real reason you've been trying to escape?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'll get around to that in due time. They're family. They'll understand no doubt.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You're in over your head, you idiot. You'll fray what bonds are left between Lord Hades and those ingrates on Olympus.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 告诉我吧，扎格，我有点好奇。你的天神亲戚们知道你想逃离这里的真正原因吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这个我到时候自然会解释。我们都是一家人。他们一定会理解我的。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你想的太简单了，傻瓜。你不过是在磨耗冥王哈迪斯和那些奥林匹斯山上忘恩负义的家伙们之间仅存的纽带罢了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Things can't entirely be different between you and me. You know that, don't you, Zag? Not when it comes to this, at least.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I do. We wouldn't both be consummate professionals if it were any other way. You won't be going easy on me, will you?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I'm going to pretend you didn't ask me that. Now give me everything you've got!

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你我之间的关系不可能完全改变。你是知道的，不是吗，扎格？至少在这一点上是这样。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道。如果不是这样，我们两个都不会成为如此资深的专家。你非得对我这么苛刻吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我会假装没有听到你的问题。现在让我看看你都有什么。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: What is it, Zagreus? You've got that pleased-with-yourself look, which can only mean you have something obnoxious to tell me.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I never! Look, I'm simply pleased to see you, Meg. Hence the insuppressible smile. Could have been one of your lovely sisters here instead...

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You're not going to throw me off my guard that easily. My sisters wouldn't let me hear the end of it.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你这是什么意思，扎格列欧斯？你的脸上摆着一副无所谓的表情，你是不是要和我说什么令人讨厌的话？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 从来没有！我只是单纯的见到你很开心，墨纪，于是就情不自禁笑了起来。要知道，当时来的也可能会是你的姐妹啊……

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 想让我感到措手不及可没这么简单。我的姐妹们会对我说个没完没了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: And where, exactly, do you think you're going, Zagreus?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I think I'm going all the way to the top again, Meg. To find my mother. You won't stop me. Get out of my way.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: We both know that's not going to happen. Getting out of your way, I mean.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你以为你这是要去什么地方，扎格列欧斯？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我打算再次冲到地上世界，墨纪，去找我的母亲。你是拦不住我的，让开吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 咱们都知道这是不可能的。我是说，我是不可能让开的。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Your mother, Zagreus. You really think you'll find her once again, out there? Even if you make it out... maybe she's found another hiding place.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It isn't us she's hiding from up there. Father let her go. He never wanted to go after her. So I appreciate your concern, but I'll find her again.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: That sounds like information neither one of them would want for me to know. You know the punishment for spilling secrets, don't you?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，你真的认为你能在外面找到自己的母亲吗？就算你成功逃离这里……她也可能早就换了藏身之所了吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 她想避而不见的人不是我们。是父亲把她放走了，他根本就没想过要去追她回来。所以，虽然我很感谢你的关心，但我会再次找到她的。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 听起来感觉他们谁都不想让我知道这些信息。你知道泄露秘密的惩罚，对吧？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: What are you doing, Zagreus? The Underworld is sealed off. What you're attempting is impossible. You've seen what happens when you go too far.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: This place can't stay sealed shut forever, Meg. In the meantime, I thought I'd get some practice in, you know?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I'm not your practice partner, fool.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你到底在干什么，扎格列欧斯。整个冥界都是封闭的。你的想法根本不可能实现。你也知道当你走远了会发生什么。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这个地方不可能永远一直封闭下去，墨纪。这段时间里，我觉得我能多练习练习，懂我意思吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我不是你的陪练，笨蛋。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: May I help you with something, Zagreus?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Now that you mention it, you can, Meg. I was wondering what was Father carrying on with you about back home?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Eavesdropping again? If you must know, my job performance is under review. Though, I'm sure this job's about to go just fine.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我能帮到你吗，扎格列欧斯？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 既然你都问了，当然有，墨纪。我想知道父亲在家里到底跟你说了什么。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你又偷听？那我告诉你吧，是关于评估我工作表现的事。不过，我觉得这工作我做得应该还不错。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I sincerely hope that you enjoy these meetings with me while you can. I know I will.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Now that's a rather ominous thing to say to someone, Meg. Care to explain in terms an idiot like me could understand?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Lord Hades is exploring other options. He has no confidence in my ability to stop you anymore. Though, maybe it isn't too late for me to change his mind.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我真心希望和我见面能让你高兴，趁着还可以见到我的时候。我会的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等下，你这是话里有话啊，墨纪。可以向我这个笨蛋解释一下吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 冥王哈迪斯在寻找其他的方法。他深信以我的能力已经无法阻止你了。不过，也许现在改变他的想法还不晚。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: It's been a while, Zagreus. You must have made it pretty far last time. Let's see. Outer reaches of Asphodel?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Outer reaches of Asphodel. And I have to say, Meg, you are positively a sight compared with that blasted Bone Hydra stewing away up there.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: How very flattering, to have compared me to the remains of some mindless outsized lizard. Come, maybe I'll kill you just as easily as your new Hydra friend.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 有一阵子没见到你了，扎格列欧斯。你上一次一定走了很远吧，到了水仙花平原外围？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 到了水仙花平原外围。说实话，墨纪，跟那个泡在水里骸骨九头蛇比起来，你可真是太美了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你可真会撩啊，把我跟那大蜥蜴的残骸放一块儿比美。来吧，也许我杀你跟你那九头蛇朋友杀你一样简单。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: How many times have we been going at it like this, Zagreus? You tired of me, yet?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: We're both immortals, Meg. We'll be seeing plenty of each other for a while yet. I've come to welcome these occasions.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Then, good. Lashing you across the face beats waiting for the opportunity to do so. Come.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我们像这样闹了多久了，扎格列欧斯？开始烦我了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我们都是不死之身，墨纪。以后我们还要见很多次面呢。那可真是太好了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 好的。等了那么久，我今天必须打你脸。来。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I heard what happened. You crossed the River of Flame. You really did it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That Hydra was a total bastard, though. Bastards. But, you sound practically impressed with me, there, Meg! I feel so flattered!

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You'll soon feel something else. I don't know how you did it. But it changes nothing.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我都听说了。你渡过了地狱之河。你做到了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那个九头蛇真的太难缠了，简直是个混蛋。不过墨纪，你的语气听起来相当钦佩啊！啊，我飘了！

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 待会儿我就打到你真的飘起来。我不知道你是怎么打败它的，但这改变不了什么。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: How utterly disgusting... I was just counting, Zagreus, and as it happens, I have lost to you fifty times, already! If not more. Can you believe this? Ugh, how I've fallen.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, don't take it so hard, Meg! Once you die several dozen times, you start to get accustomed to the emotional pain, as well as the physical! Up for some more of either?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Of course! Who do you think I am? Although I guess there's no use keeping score with you.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 真是令人恶心……我在数数呢，扎格列欧斯。如果没记错的话，我已经输给你五十次了，说不定更多！你敢信吗？啊，我怎么就堕落成了这么一个废物。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，别太在意这个，墨纪！一旦你死得多了，你就会慢慢适应心理和生理上的痛苦了！那么，咱们继续吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 当然了！你以为我是谁？不过我猜，就算是去记这些数字也没什么用。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You know how many times you've beaten me, here, Zagreus? Can you even guess?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm... feels like a lot, admittedly, I mean, we've been going at this for a while, now. Four hundred and twelve times...?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...Five hundred times, exactly. Though I figure, you haven't been keeping track of how many times I've killed you. Ugh, maybe that's my problem. Well, plenty of time to work it out after this.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你知道你已经打败过我多少次了吗，扎格列欧斯？要不要猜猜看？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯……不得不说，感觉已经有很多次了。我是说，我们已经打了很长时间了，我大概打败了你四百一十二次……？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……已经整整五百次了，不过我猜你应该没去记我杀过你多少次。呃啊，或许这是我的问题吧。不过等我们打完之后，我有的是时间处理这个问题。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You beat Alecto, Zag. Could hear her screaming her head off about it all the way through Tartarus... I almost want to thank you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I almost want to say you're very welcome. Have you and she always been on bad terms like this?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: We have long-standing differences. It's worse with family. You know what it's like.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你打败了阿勒克图，扎格。整个塔耳塔罗斯都能听到她的叫骂声……我真的谢谢你。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你真的不用客气。你跟她的关系一直这样差吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我跟她有分歧不是一天两天了。明明是一家人。你应该懂这是什么感觉。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Huh. Not even Tisiphone could stop you. Your father must be sorely disappointed.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: He's difficult to please, that much is true. What happened to Tisiphone, anyway? She isn't much for conversation.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: It runs in the family. Tis only knows her work. And, professional distance is important.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 嗯。就连提西福涅都阻止不了你了。你父亲肯定失望至极。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 他本来就是个很难去讨好的人。提西福涅怎么样了？她没什么可说的。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 家族遗传。提西算是个工作狂。当然，保持职业距离也很重要。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: If there's anyone in all the Underworld who owes you, Zagreus, it's your friend, Sisyphus. He would be much worse off if not for you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, because I've been distracting you from administering lashings like before? I hate to think you prefer to whip with no fear of reprisal whatsoever, Meg.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Dereliction of duty and fear of reprisal are not one and the same. Though you don't seem to be concerned with either one.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 如果说整个冥界谁欠你最多，扎格列欧斯，那一定是你的朋友西西弗斯。如果没有你，他恐怕就要惨得多了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么意思，就因为我一直在分散注意力，不让你拿鞭子抽人家吗？我可不认为你是个喜欢拿鞭子抽人，从来不怕别人报复的家伙啊，墨纪。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 玩忽职守和怕被报复是两码事，不过你应该对两者都不关心吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Your weapon's looking rather dull, there, Zagreus. Great Daedalus decided not to grace you with his gifts this time around?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Now that you mention it, he hasn't, no. Though I'm prepared to say I don't need special augmentations to get past you.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Oh, we can put that to the test right now. Just remember, you need all the help you can get.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你的武器看起来钝得不行了，扎格列欧斯。伟大的狄德勒斯这次好像不打算帮助你了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 既然你都提到了，那他确实没有。不过我得说，想打败你，我还用不着这些额外的恩惠。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 噢，既然这样，那就来试试吧。记住了，你绝对会需要帮助的。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: That Mirror's made you stronger, Zagreus. You're fortunate to have Nyx helping you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No hard feelings. I think she feels partly responsible for all of this.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: She shouldn't. The only one responsible for all of this is you. And I thought even you would have understood that by now.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 那面镜子让你变强了，扎格列欧斯。能得到倪克斯的帮助你可真走运。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你别见怪啊。我认为她感觉自己要为所有这些事负责。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 她不用啊。要为这些事负责的只有你。我认为你现在应该明白我是什么意思了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Tsch. I can't believe it. You signed the Pact of Punishment. Have you completely lost your mind? Or just trying to insult me?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well if you're going to be so rude about it, maybe a little of each? Though, what do you even care which pacts I sign or don't?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I'm not an idiot. I see what you're doing. You want to be punished? Then, come on.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 哧。真不敢相信。你签下了惩罚契约。你是不是要疯？还是单纯惹我生气？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 既然你都这么说了，可能两种原因都有吧。我签什么契约跟你也没什么关系吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我也不是傻子。我知道你在做什么。你想被惩罚吗？那来吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Tsch. You really volunteered into a Pact of Punishment? You can't back out of it, now. You're even more of a fool than I already thought.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Maybe I just like a challenge, ever thought of that? Besides, what do you even care which pacts I sign or don't?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You're right. I don't care. You want to be punished? Then, come on.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 啧，你真的自愿签了惩罚契约吗？你现在可没得反悔了，我本以为你没这么蠢呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 或许我只是喜欢挑战，你有没有想过这一点？另外，我签不签惩罚契约，你又干嘛要在乎呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你说得没错，我不在乎。你想被惩罚是吗？那就来吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I have been longing for a fairer fight with you. Maybe that's why you signed the Pact? To pity me?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I have my reasons. Pitying you isn't one of them. Although I guess you don't believe me, do you?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: If it's punishment you want, how am I to say no?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我一直期待着跟你有一场公平的战斗。这就是你签订契约的原因？同情我？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我有我的理由。但是同情你不包含在内。不过我猜你大概是不会相信我的，对吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 既然这惩罚是你自己想要的，那我又怎会拒绝？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You know I can hit even harder than usual with the Pact of Punishment working against you. Maybe that's why you signed it? To pity me?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I have my reasons. Pitying you isn't one of them. Although I guess you don't believe me, do you?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: No, I don't think I do. Come on, then, and let's see where all your pity gets you.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你也知道，签订了惩罚契约之后，我打你就会打得更狠了。或许这就是你签订契约的原因吗？为了同情我？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我有我的理由。但是同情你不包含在内。不过我猜你大概是不会相信我的，对吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 是啊，我可不相信。好啊，那就让我见识见识，你的同情会让你落得什么下场吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: This should be over pretty quickly, I think, Zag. Never took you for the Forced Overtime type. That's not a Pact condition for the faint of heart.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You wound me, Meg! You know I like to barge into situations thoughtlessly and recklessly, and sort everything out later. Forced Overtime's the perfect fit!

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Ahh, well, when you put it that way. Look, don't go saying I didn't warn you.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我觉得这场战斗很快就会结束了，扎格。我可没想过你会签“强制加班”这种协议，像这样的契约条件可不适合胆小的家伙。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这话就太伤人了，墨纪！你知道我是那种什么都不想就冲锋陷阵的人，之后的事情等之后再说，“强制加班”真是再适合我不过了！

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 啊啊，好吧，既然你都这么说了，到时候可别怪我没提醒过你。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Hold it, Zagreus. I sense something, is that... ah. You've been in contact with Chaos. So even they are now involved with this.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Just because Chaos is giving me the power to crush you doesn't mean they're getting involved with this, does it?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You don't know who or what you're dealing with. Ask Nyx about them for me sometime. Here, I'll give you a chance to ask her very soon.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 等等，扎格列欧斯。我有种感觉，是不是……啊。你与卡俄斯联系了。看来连祂也牵涉其中。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 卡俄斯仅是给了我打败你的力量，不代表祂也涉足了吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你根本不知道自己在跟什么人打交道。那你有时间就替我去问问倪克斯吧。来吧，我现在就送你去见她。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I know that Thanatos assisted you in getting to this point. I don't appreciate his interference.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm sure you'll have a chance to tell him back at home.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: He has domain over the wretched shades, but his power has no sway with me. And neither does your own.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我知道是塔纳托斯协助你到达此处。对于此事我并不是很欣赏。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 回屋以后你会有机会告诉他的。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 他掌管那些可怜的暗灵们，但是这力量对我没用。你的也一样。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I still cannot believe that Thanatos is helping you. I mistook him for someone with integrity.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You mistook him for someone who blindly follows orders without considering the implications.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: How dare you...! If you like death so much, then here, let me indulge you. Thanatos will welcome you with open arms.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我还是不敢相信塔纳托斯在帮助你。我还以为他是个正直的人呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你以为的正直只不过是不计后果盲目服从命令而已。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你竟敢口出狂言……！如果你这么喜欢死亡，那我就帮你一把好了。塔纳托斯一定会张开双臂欢迎你回去的。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Prince Zagreus, you are trespassing beyond the limits of your authority. I am under orders to stop you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Come on, Meg, why so formal all of a sudden? We've been through this countless times. Wait, is it because...?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Oh, come on, Zag. Will you just learn to play along, for once? Come on and fight me like you mean it.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯王子，你正在擅闯你无权踏足的领域，我奉命阻拦你。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 拜托，墨纪，怎么突然就这么正式了？这种事情我们已经做了无数次了。等等，这是因为……？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 哦，拜托，扎格。你就不能陪我演一次吗？来吧，和我认认真真地打一场吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: What is it, Zagreus? You look a little hesitant to go another round with me. Or is it my imagination?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, it's just... can we really keep the personal and the professional completely separate like this, Meg? It's with mixed emotions that I fight you to the death, only to be happy to see you back at the House.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Then learn to keep your emotions in check. You keep them bottled up a while, they'll be that much stronger when it's time to let them out.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 怎么了，扎格列欧斯？你看起来有点不太想和我交手了，还是说，是我想多了？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，我只是想说……咱们真的可以像这样，把个人感情与专业态度彻底分开吗，墨纪？每次与你争斗至死的时候，我的心里都很纠结。而看到你回到圣殿的时候，我非常开心。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 那就学会克制住感情吧，把所有的感情都压抑下来。这样当它们释放出来的时候，就会变得更加强烈了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Nice gloves, there, Zagreus. Think you can take me up close with those things? Well within striking distance of my whip.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Not wearing them for fashion's sake, here, Meg. You won't mind if I give you my best shot with Malphon here, will you?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I'd mind if you didn't. Want to get your hands dirty, fine. Let's see it.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你这双手套不错，扎格列欧斯。你觉得戴上那双手套就能接近我了吗？我是说，跑到我鞭子的范围之内。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我戴上这副拳套可不是为了时髦，墨纪。如果我用玛尔封捶你一顿，你应该不会介意，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 如果你不这么做，我才会介意呢。想让自己的双手沾血吗？很好，让我见识见识吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: What happened to your weapon, Zagreus? I sensed its power long before you turned up. That isn't just some Daedalus enchantment on it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, Stygius and I have been getting much more closely acquainted lately, Meg. Would you care to see the fruits of our healthy symbiotic relationship?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You, in a healthy relationship? Why yes, then this I have to see.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你的武器怎么了，扎格列欧斯？还没见到你，我就感受到了它的力量，那可不仅仅只是狄德勒斯的加持。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，斯第格斯和我最近的关系更紧密了，墨纪。你要见识一下我们之间这种健康的共生关系带来的成果吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你，健康的关系？是啊，这正是我想要了解的。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Nice earring, Zagreus. Maybe I should have thought twice before giving you a thing like that.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Why, because the gift you generously gave me may end up being instrumental in your own demise? Sounds straight out of one of those tales the mortals like to go spreading around.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: They like it when best-laid plans fall completely to pieces, don't they? You better grow to like it, too.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你的耳环真不错，扎格列欧斯。或许在把它送给你之前，我应该多考虑考虑才对。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 怎么？是因为你慷慨赠送予我的礼物，最终可能会促成你的死亡吗？听起来正像是那些凡人们会津津乐道的故事。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 凡人们最喜欢看到精心安排的计划事与愿违，不是吗？你最好也能喜欢起这种滋味。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I sense something of death upon you, Zagreus. What's that you have, something from Thanatos is it?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, this old thing? It's just a listless butterfly Than gave me, which happens to fill me with even more supernatural strength than usual. Don't pay it any mind.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Not even Thanatos can help you here. But if I ever start a bug collection, I'll know who to call.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我感觉到死亡笼罩着你，扎格列欧斯。你拿的是什么？是不是从塔纳托斯那里弄来的？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，这个旧东西啊？是塔纳给我的，一只萎靡不振的蝴蝶，这东西可以给我拥有更加强大的超自然力量。别太在意就是了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 就算是塔纳托斯也帮不了你。不过，如果我要想收集昆虫的话，我起码知道要去找谁了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You know Battie's not going to work here, don't you? I'm definitely not going to help you out of this one.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Come on, Meg, you can do anything if you set your mind to it! Though, don't worry, Battie's just here for the show.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Then, let's make it a good one. Come on.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你知道巴蒂是派不上用场的，是吧？这次我可不会再让你逃出去了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 来吧，墨纪，只要你下定决心，你就能做得到！不过，不用担心，巴蒂只是摆在这里做做样子而已。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 那咱们就搞得盛大一些吧，来吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Your little bat companion not too much to handle, is she, Zagreus? I trust you're taking excellent care of her. Not that she needs your help.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh she's been positively perfect, thank you, Meg. Especially in how she puts us into contact when I need a hand. I hope it's not too much hassle, helping out from time to time?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: If you were hoping to avoid a hassle, you've definitely come to the wrong place.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你的小蝙蝠朋友没怎么给你惹过麻烦啊，是吧，扎格列欧斯？你一定有好好照顾她吧，不过她并不需要你的帮助。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，她好得很呢，谢谢关心，墨纪。而且每当我需要帮助的时候，她都能让我们之间产生联结。时不时让她帮忙，我只希望这不会给她添太多麻烦。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 如果你不想添麻烦，那你可来错地方了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Look at yourself, Zagreus, you are a total mess. Halfway to death or worse. You're making this too easy.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hit a few snags on my way to meet you, Meg. So, if you wouldn't mind going easy on me this one?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Not on your life or death. But I will kill you quickly, how's that?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 看看你自己，扎格列欧斯，你把自己弄成什么样了。半死不活的惨状。这下子要简单多了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 为了来见你，在路上我摔了几跤，墨纪。所以，这次可以下手轻点吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 想都别想，不过我会痛快一点，你看怎么样？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You're wounded, Zagreus. How unbecoming of a god. Not to mention that I have the upper hand.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I figured I'd give you a head start this time, so I let the wretched shades bludgeon me repeatedly along the way.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Fool. If you're half-dead already by the time you get to me, what hope can you possibly have for what lies ahead?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你受伤了，扎格列欧斯。你这样的神不太行啊。更别提我现在的优势了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这次我为了让你能获得优势，来这里的路上一直主动被暗灵们围着打呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 笨蛋。如果你到这里的时候就已经半死不活了，你哪来的信心可以打败我？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You look like you had trouble getting to me, Zagreus. Did you try asking for directions on the way?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You sound like Hypnos. He's getting to you, isn't he. Isn't he!

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You shut your mouth right now, with that. Come die.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 看样子你很难够着我呢，扎格列欧斯。来的时候有好好问路吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你说话跟修普诺斯似的。他在接近你，是不是。是不是！

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 不准你再说这件事。受死吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You're not escaping death this time, here, Zagreus. You ready to go home?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No, not just yet, though thanks for asking, Meg. If you intend to force me, know that I am going to resist, with all my might.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Well I appreciate the warning. Now prepare to die.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 这回你可必死无疑了，扎格列欧斯，做好回家的准备了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没，还没准备好呢。不过谢谢你这么问，墨纪。如果你强行要送我回家，那我只能全力反抗了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 很好，感谢你的提醒，准备受死吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Ever stubborn, aren't you. Maybe my whip might make you reconsider whatever it is that you're attempting here.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Your whip's not been all that persuasive in the past.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Maybe persistence will pay off for both of us. Come, then.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你就是这么固执。或许我的鞭子能打消你一直来这里的念头。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你的鞭子之前就没什么说服力。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 所以坚持这样下去应该对我俩都有好处。那来吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: And there you are again. Lord Hades ought to lock you up rather than let you run amok in his domain like this.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm sure he'd welcome all this feedback from you, Meg. Or maybe you're just pining for my father's job?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I have no envy for your father's position. Besides, I happen to enjoy my own responsibilities.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你又来了。冥王哈迪斯应该直接把你关起来，而不是让你在他的领地到处乱闯。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那我想他应该蛮乐意听到你的这些报告的，墨纪。还是说你想坐上我父亲的位置？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我对你父亲的位置毫无兴趣。并且我自己所肩负的责任就已经让我满足了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Oh, there you are. Just as I was beginning to think it's been too long since last I killed you, Zag.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Admit it, Meg. You can't stop thinking about me.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Don't flatter yourself. I think of you in pain. And now there's no more need for the imagination.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 噢，你来了。我刚刚还在想怎么这么久你都没来送死了，扎格。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 承认吧，墨纪。你就是一直在想我。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你可别自作多情了。我想让你痛苦。不过现在我不用想了，你来了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Well, Zag? Any last requests this time before I send you home?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Let's see, how about a swift and painful death, would that be possible?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Be cheeky all you like. You'll get exactly what you asked, and nothing more.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 那么，扎格？在我送你回家之前还有什么遗愿吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我想想，来个又快又疼的死法，怎么样？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 放马过来吧。马上就完成你的愿望。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Pff. And here you are again. You're slow to learn the way of things I see.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I may be slow to learn, but... least I'm rather patient!

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: This talk about your patience is beginning to test mine. Enough! Come on and die.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 啧，你又来了。你还真是愚钝啊。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 尽管我是愚钝了，但……至少我有耐心！

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我已经没有耐心继续这种讨论耐心的对话了。够了！过来受死吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Give up already, Zag. Or I'll keep killing you each time you come this far.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I have some bad news for you, Meg. Little by little, I'm getting stronger.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: That may be so. But you will never be my equal. Ever. You'd do well to remember that.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 投降吧，扎格。你每次到这里来，我都会杀死你。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那我要告诉你坏消息了，墨纪。我正在一点一点地变强噢。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 也许吧。但你永远也赶不上我。不可能的。你要好好记住这点。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You're never getting past me, Zagreus.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: While that's probably the case... maybe I will this time.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Keep telling yourself that. Maybe it'll help take your mind off the pain that is to come.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你永远不可能超过我，扎格列欧斯。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那么问题来了，也许这次我就能超过你。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 继续麻痹自己吧。也许这样就能让你忘记即将到来的痛苦。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Even if you manage to get past me, there's no getting out of Asphodel. You saw what it was like. You really want to go back there?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's not a matter of want. The way out is there in that direction, past the river of flame.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You're more stubborn than your father. I never thought that such a thing was possible.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 就算你打败了我，你也是没法逃出水仙花平原的。你也看到了那平原的样貌。你真的想去那里吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这不是想不想的问题。出去的路就在那个方向，渡过地狱之河。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你比你父亲还要固执啊。我从没想过这种不可能的事。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Finally, you're back. You won't get past me like you did last time. Though, I would like to see you try.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你还是回来了。这次你可别想打败我了。不过，我还蛮期待你的尝试。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Well, Zag? May I have this dance for old time's sake?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 那么，扎格？看在我俩认识这么久的份上，来跳支舞吧？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You ready for me this time, Zagreus? Come on and fight. No holding back.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 这次你准备好了吗，扎格列欧斯？来战斗吧。不准放水。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I guess we know the drill by now, don't we. Not that I don't enjoy our little arguments, in my own way.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 该做什么，我们心里应该都很清楚了噢。不过我还蛮乐意跟你耍耍嘴皮子的。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: He's here, Alecto. Tis. Let's get him, now.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 他来了，阿勒克图。提西。那就上吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Prepare yourselves, Sisters. And you, too, Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 准备好了，姐妹们。你也一样，扎格。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Together this time, Sisters. Go!

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 这次我们一起上，姐妹们。出发！

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Alecto. Tisiphone. Our guest is here.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 阿勒克图。提西福涅。来接客了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: He's here. Let's get to work, Sisters.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 他来了。开工了，姐妹们。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Well, Sisters? We have a reputation to uphold.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 姐妹们？声誉对我们来说也很重要。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You ready, Sisters? There he is. Now, on my mark.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 准备好了吗，姐妹们？他在那里。现在，听我号令。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: All right, Sisters, let's show him what we've got.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 好了，姐妹们，让他见识一下我们的本事。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Alecto, Tis, he's mine. Just back me up.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 阿勒克图、提西，他是我的。为我加油吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: No time for further talk, now, Sisters. Take him, now.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 没时间多说了，姐妹们。立刻把他拿下。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: No quarter now or ever, Erinyes. Attack!

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 绝对不要手下留情，厄里倪厄斯。攻击！

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Are you ready, Sister? Let's take care of him.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 准备好了吗，姐妹们？一起把他收拾了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Come, Sister, it's time to get to work.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 来吧，姐妹们，开始工作了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: He's here, Sister. Let's go.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 他来了，好姐妹。上吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: It's him. Prepare yourself, Sister.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 是他。准备好了，姐妹。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Alecto and I were just wondering when you'd arrive.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 阿勒克图和我都在想，你什么时候才能到。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: See, Alecto? He is right on time, just as I said.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 看到了吗，阿勒克图？他总是很守时，就像我说的那样。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You see, Tisiphone? He's here, just as I said.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你看，提西福涅？他来了，我没骗你吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Heads up, Tisiphone. I think I found a murderer for you.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 小心了，提西福涅。我好像找到了你的克星。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Let's go, Sister. Together, we can take him.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 上吧，小姐妹。我们一起将他制服。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...Well, Sister, we'll have to finish catching up some other time.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……好了，小姐妹，我们改日再叙旧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I wish it didn't have to be this way.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我真希望我们可以不要这样。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Why must we always have to fight.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 为什么就一定要战斗呢。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: It's time we had one of our little fights.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 刚刚我们吵了一架。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I so was hoping you'd show up just now.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我还在想你应该出现了吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Now that you're here, how about a little dance?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 然后你就来了，跳支小舞怎么样？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: How about we go once more for old time's sake?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 看在我们认识这么久的份上，再跳一次吧？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You ready for me, Zagreus?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 准备好了吗，扎格列欧斯？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: And here I was just wondering when you'd show up.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我还在想你什么时候会出现呢。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: And there he is at last, the Prince himself.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 终于出现了，是王子本人。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You've come to die to me again?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 又来我这里送死？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I killed you last time, I'll kill you again.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 上一次你死在我手里，这次也一样。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I guess you want to die again?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你又来寻死了吗？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: It seems you haven't learned your lesson yet.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 看样子你还是学不乖啊。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I hope you'll pose more of a threat this time.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 希望你这次能拿出点真本事。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You don't seem to learn. Then, come and die.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你似乎没什么长进。那来吧，受死吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You aren't getting past me, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你不可能打败我的，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I'll never stand aside for you.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我永远不可能跟你站一边。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I'm back again, and I'll keep coming back.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我又来了，我会一直不停地回来。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You'll get past me over my dead body.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 想通过这里你就要从我尸体上跨过去。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I'm never going to back down from you.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我永远不会放弃。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I guess we know how this is going to go.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我们都知道结果会怎样。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I'm pledged to stand against you, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我跟你势不两立，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I will keep coming back, the same as you.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我会跟你一样，我也会回来的。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I will not stand aside for you, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我永远不可能跟你站一边，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Don't know if I can stop you anymore, but I can slow you down.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 不知道我还能不能阻止你，但我绝对可以拖延你的时间。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I'll get you back for what you did last time.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 上次的事，这次我绝对奉还。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: One of these encounters, you'll let your guard down, and I'll kill you again for old time's sake.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 总有一天你会懈怠，而我会看在过去交情的份上杀了你。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Even if I can't stop you... I can get a few good hits in, I'm sure.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 就算我阻止不了你……我也可以让你吃点苦头，这一点我敢肯定。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I've got a lot of payback to administer here, let me tell you, Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 就这么说吧，扎格，我有很多仇等着报呢。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Ungh, I've practically lost count how many times you beat me in a row here, Zag...

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 呃，我已经记不清你连续打败我多少次了，扎格……

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I thought you might show up.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我想你也该出现了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You're right on schedule.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 真是准时啊。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: No need for small talk, Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 没什么好说的，扎格。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Up for another fight I see?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 又想来打一架了吗？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: What say we get things started.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 那就直接开始吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You ready for me, Zagreus?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 准备好了吗，扎格列欧斯？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Come on and show me what you've got.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 让我看看你都有什么本事。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Let's go, then, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 那开始吧，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I'm ready for you, Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我准备好了，扎格。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Not one step further, Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 不准再往前一步，扎格。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I can't just let you off without a fight.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我不能什么都不做就让你通过。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: It's you again, is it.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 又是你。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Come all this way again, just to see me.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 一路过来，只为见我一面。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Get on your guard, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 准备战斗了，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You're prompt sometimes, I have to give you that.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 有时候你真的挺准时的。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Halt, Zagreus. Not one step further.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 停下，扎格列欧斯。不准再往前一步。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Come for another round with me, Zagreus?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 咱们再来一个回合怎么样，扎格列欧斯？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Let's see if you can make it past me, Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 看看你能不能打败我，扎格。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: No hard feelings, Zagreus. And don't you dare hold back.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你可别生气啊，扎格列欧斯。你可不要故意让着我。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: One thing I like about you, Zag? You're always right on time.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你知道我喜欢你哪一点吗，扎格？你总是很守时。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I hope you're ready for me this time, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我希望你这次准备好了，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Don't think I'm going to go easy on you, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 别妄想我会对你手下留情，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You know it's strictly business here between us, don't you, Zag?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你知道这对我们来说是一件严肃的事，不是吗，扎格列欧斯？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I expect you to give me the best you've got, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我希望你能拿出全部能耐，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: If you so much as think of going easy on me, Zagreus, I'll kill you.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 如果你以为可以让着我，扎格列欧斯，我会把你杀了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: No holding back against me, Zagreus. Certainly not here.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 不许故意让着我，扎格列欧斯。这次绝对不行。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You'll find I don't grow weary of these run-ins with you, Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你会发现，对于与你的“邂逅”，我一直乐此不疲，扎格。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You know I can't just let you walk away without a fight.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你知道我不会就这么放过你。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You won't be getting out of here without a dance.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 除非和我比划比划，否则你休想离开这里。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: There's nothing you can do to hurt me, Zag. Though I would like to see you try.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你伤不到我的，扎格列欧斯。不过我还真想看看你会怎么对付我。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I'm starting to enjoy these little outings with you, Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我开始有点喜欢就这样和你小聚一场了，扎格。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Come on, Zag. Come at me with everything you've got.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 来吧，扎格。使出你的看家本领来攻击我。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Do you want me, Zagreus? Then come and get me.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你不是想打败我吗，扎格列欧斯？现在就放马过来啊。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I'll give you one thing, Zag. You never keep me waiting very long.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你从来不会让我等太久，扎格。这一点值得肯定。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You're looking pretty good, there, Zag. Though let me see what I can do.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你看起来状态不错呀，扎格。不过，让我来看看，我能做点什么。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: No pleasure without pain, right, Zagreus?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 不经历风雨怎能见彩虹呢，不是吗，扎格列欧斯？

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You ready, Megaera? Tisiphone? Let's go.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 准备好了吗，墨纪拉？提西福涅？上吧。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Check it out, Sis! The god of trash is here. Let's get to work.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 快看，姐妹们！垃圾之神来了耶。开工了。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Ugh, would you just look at him! That smug look, that posture, everything! Please tell me you're not going soft for this trash-god, Sister.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Come on, Alecto. When was the last time that we looked to one another for approval? Besides, as long as we kill him, what do you even care?

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You know, fair point, there, Sister! Very nicely said. Let's kill him, now!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 呃，快看看他那个样子吧！看他那副蠢样，他那个态度，他的一切！你该不是打算对这个小杂碎神手下留情吧，妹妹？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 得了吧，阿勒克图，咱们上一次征求对方同意是什么时候了？况且，只要我们杀了他，你还在乎些什么？

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你说得真是一点都没错，妹妹！说得太对了。咱们赶紧杀了他吧，别磨蹭了！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Look at this awful piece of trash, come here again to bleed all over our nice shiny floor. Ready to fight my lovely sister, there, redblood?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: He's not so awful once you get to know him, Sis. Not that it matters for what we're about to do.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: The both of you disgust me, Meg, you know that? Get it together and kill him this time, damn you!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 看看这个杂碎啊，他又想把血溅在咱们漂亮的地方上了。你准备和我可爱的妹妹打一架了吗，流红血的？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 妹妹，如果你了解他，就会觉得他没那么讨人厌。不过就算如此，我们要做的事情还是会做。

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你们两个真让我恶心，你该知道的吧，墨纪？你真该死的家伙，别磨蹭了，赶紧杀了这家伙！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You must have gone and signed a Pact! Isn't that right, redblood? Tell me right now.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, as a matter of fact, I have. Though I don't see how that's any business of yours, Alecto.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: I like working alone! And you don't see me doing that, right now, do you? So I would say it's my business, all right. Along with killing you!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你肯定是签过契约了吧！对不对，流红血的？赶紧给我说实话。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 老实说，确实如此。不过我可不觉得这件事和你有什么关系，阿勒克图。

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我喜欢一个人工作！但我现在已经没办法一个人工作了，对不对？所以要我说，这件事就是和我有关。杀死你这件事也一样是我的责任！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Whew, I thought I'd never get some quiet time again, you know, redblood? That damned Pact you stupidly agreed to, making me work with my sisters again. I'll get you for that!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm sensing a pattern that it really doesn't take much for you to have something to get me for, does it?

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Oh, that's rich! How smart of you, you're smart! Know what? I'll get you for that, too.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 哎哟！我还以为我永远都没得安宁了呢。你知道的吧，流红血的？都怪你签的那个该死的蠢契约，我不得不和我的妹妹们一起工作了，这件事我跟你没完！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我发现不管发生什么事情，你都能想办法赖到我的头上，跟我没完，对不对？

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 哦，你说得太对了！你可真是个机灵鬼啊，太机灵了！知道吗？这件事情我也跟你没完。

en.text: Ah, hah hah, hohohohohhh. Finally. I've been waiting for this! Really.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You must be one of Megaera's lovely sisters, I don't believe we've had the pleasure. Waiting for what, exactly?

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: ...So sick of, you know, doing my regular job, uninterrupted. Not having to clean up Meg's messes!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I get the feeling we're starting off on the wrong foot.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Anyway. I always wanted to kill a god. You'll have to do.

zh-CN.text: 啊，哈哈，嚯嚯嚯嚯嚯。终于。让我等到了！真的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你一定是墨纪拉的好姐妹之一吧，见到你很不荣幸。是在等什么呢？

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: ……好无聊，一天到晚，做着重复的工作。也没有帮墨纪清理烂摊子！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 初次见面就这样会不会给人不好的印象。

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 不管怎样。我早就想弑神了。你必须这样做。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Heard rumblings about some news back at your daddy's House, redblood. So his illustrious abducted Queen, she's come back home?!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, how do you even know all that? And should you really be talking about the Queen that way?

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: I don't answer to her! She can come and go as she wants for all I care. But you want to know who can't?! Yeah, you.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 关于你父亲的圣殿，我听到了一些传闻，流红血的。所以说，他那位绑架来的美艳冥后，已经回来了吗？！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等等，你是怎么知道这些事情的？而且你真的该用这种语气谈论冥后的事情吗？

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我可不归她管！她愿意什么时候来，什么时候走，都和我没关系。可你知道谁和我有关系吗？！没错，就是你。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: I got to ask, how come you keep on showing up, redblood? I thought you would have had enough beatings by now.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, you know, I've come to enjoy these visits with you so much, Alecto, that I've made it something of a regular routine. Form good habits, and then stick to them, I say!

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You call this a good habit, huh? Maybe for me, it is. Well, come here all you like, and I will be here waiting, every single time! About once every three times, anyway.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我想问问，你到底为什么要没完没了地过来，流红血的？我还以为你挨过的揍已经够多了呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，阿勒克图，我实在是太喜欢见你了，所以我打算把这当成日常修行。养成好习惯，然后坚持住，就是这样！

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你管这叫好习惯？或许对我来说确实是个好习惯。好吧，你想过来就过来吧，我每一次都会等你来的。或者说，差不多每三次里就有一次。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Heard you had a real bash down in your daddy's House, redblood. So sorry I couldn't make it. Next time, though, all right?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Next time, definitely, Alecto. We missed you for sure and wish you could have made it!

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Hohoho, I'm sure you did. But, you know, work comes first! So let's get busy.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我听说你在你父亲的圣殿里搞了个相当盛大的宴会啊，流红血的。真抱歉我没来得及参加，不过我下次会来的，好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 下次你一定要来，阿勒克图。我们都很想你，觉得要是你也能来就好了！

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 呵呵呵，我敢肯定你很想我。不过话说回来，工作得放在第一位！咱们还是先开工吧。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Hey, redblood. I have done a lot of thinking, and I've come to the conclusion that I want you never to speak to me again. Ever. Got that?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...Erm, I don't know how to respond to what you said without directly disobeying your request, Alecto. But for future reference, fine, I'll bite.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You'll die! There's no use standing here flapping our gums when we could cut to killing one another right away. Come on!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 嘿，流红血的，我想了很多事情，最终得出了这样的结论：我希望你再也别跟我说话了，永远都不准，懂了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: ……呃，我可不知道怎么样才能既回答你，又不违抗你的意愿，阿勒克图。不过如果以后的话，好吧，我尽量吧。

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你尽量去死一死吧！我们干嘛要呆在这里耍嘴皮子呢，不如真刀真枪地开打吧，动手吧！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Ahh, look at you, redblood. You're practically already dead! Now that's no fun at all.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sorry to disappoint you, Alecto. I know you enjoy being responsible for a hundred percent of my bloodshed.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Oh, that's all right, no hard feelings at all! You just be sure to get in better health before next I get to kill you, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 啊，看看你吧，流红血的，你差不多已经是个死人了！这可一点都不好玩了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不好意思让你失望了，阿勒克图。我知道你非常乐意对我流血而亡负百分之百的责任。

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 哦没事，没什么大不了的！下次来这里被我杀的时候，记得少流点血就是了。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You know I smelled your blood from three chambers away? Hope you saved some of it for me.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I've saved some of my blood, yes! Though I was thinking I'd hang onto it for now, if you don't mind.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Do I look like someone who doesn't mind, trash god? I'll take your blood, however much you've got.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我隔着三个房间就能闻到你血液的味道哦。希望下次能多留点给我。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我当然多留了一点！不过我觉得现在还得留着，希望你别介意。

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你这破神，你在说什么怪话？我要你的血，有多少要多少。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: What's the matter, redblood? You look a little paler than usual. Been bleeding much, having to get this far?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I ran into some setbacks, if you have to know. But don't worry, I'm sure I've plenty left to bleed.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Oh whew, that's a relief all right! I was so worried that I wasn't going to be the one to kill you this time.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 怎么了，流红血的？你面色不太好啊。为了来到这里流了不少血吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 来之前遇到了点困难，告诉你也无妨。不过没事，我的血量管够。

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 呼，又跨过一道大坎！这次不是我杀死的你，我很失望。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You're looking pretty beat already, there, redblood. So let's finish you off.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 看起来你被揍得很惨啊，流红血的，不如让我送你上路吧。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Next time, don't you go losing so much blood before you get here, trash! I like to take it out of you myself.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 下次来这里之前，可别再失血那么多了，废物！我还想亲手送你上路呢。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You're no god! You're nothing but a piece of trash. Born into all of this. And you don't even want it!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You seem to have me all figured out. And here I thought we were still getting to know each other.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Tsch. Well. You want to know what I want? Here, I'll show you.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你根本不是神！你就是一个垃圾。真是生在福中，不知福！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你还挺了解我的。我还以为我们还在互相了解阶段呢。

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 哧。好吧。想知道我要什么吗？我给你看看。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You know what I like about you? The way you bleed. Mmm.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That... is not the type of flattery I'm used to. You're making me a bit uncomfortable, I'll have you know.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Never met a god that bleeds like you. Red. Like a worthless mortal. Come on! Let's bleed you dry.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你知道我喜欢你哪一点吗？我喜欢你流血的样子。嗯嗯。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你这个……我不太接受你这种撩法。你让我感觉有点不自在了，你知道吧。

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 从来没遇到过你这种神。流红血。像个凡人废物一样。来吧！榨干你的血！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Let's get to work, redblood, what do you say? Me, I say you've kept this girl waiting long enough.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, I say I don't appreciate you calling me redblood. You're making me rather self-conscious about it, you know.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Oh, hoho, you're funny. But you'll break. They always do.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 办正事吧，流红血的，你觉得呢？本人认为，你让这位女生等太久了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 要我说我不太喜欢“流红血的”这个称呼。这样会让我感觉不太舒服。

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 哦，嚯嚯，你真有意思。但你难逃一死。跟他们一样。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: I have got to admit, you are really frustrating, you know, redblood? What is it going to take to make you scream, hm?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, you mean to say Meg never told you? And here I thought you two were close.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Ehh, we'll find out. I've got plenty of ideas left I've been meaning to try.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 不得不承认，你的表现真的不太好，流红血的。到底怎样才能让你惊声尖叫呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么，难道墨纪从来没告诉过你吗？我还以为你俩走得挺近呢。

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 呃，我们会知道的。我有很多想法，都想去尝试一下。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You know something, redblood? In retrospect, I should have known this wasn't going to be a quick job.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: They say both gods and mortals are notoriously poor at estimating how long it takes to get anything done.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Normally when I'm on the job, they grovel, then they scream. They shut up eventually, but not you. At least, not yet.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你知道吗，流红血的？根据以往的经验，我应该知道这不是马上就能完成的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 人们说不管是神还是人，在预估事情完成时间的时候都做得非常差劲。

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 一般来说，我工作的时候，他们会趴着，然后尖叫。最后他们都叫不出来了，但是你不一样。起码，现在是这样。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Huh! You really must like pain an awful lot, redblood. Or maybe it's just me.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You see, Alecto? Turns out we do have a common interest after all.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Did you just--? Don't you ever compare yourself to me again, you trash. You want more pain, I'm happy to oblige.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 呵！你是真的喜欢挨打啊，流红血的。也许是我也说不定。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你看，阿勒克图。看样子我们还是有共同爱好的。

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你竟然——？不准你再把你跟我相提并论，你这垃圾。你想挨更毒的打，我很乐意帮忙呢。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: I've got a lot to be thankful for, you know, redblood? Your daddy could have shut you in the lowest pits, and then we never would have met!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Perish the thought, Alecto. What would you have done with yourself if not for all our fated encounters?

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: I don't know! I mean, before we met, I flayed all sorts of other trash down here! But lately I've been keeping them waiting, because of you.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你知道吗，流红血的，我有很多人要感谢。你的父亲本可以把你一直关在冥界深处，这样我们根本就不会见面了！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 还是别这么想了，阿勒克图。要不是因为我们命中注定要相遇，你现在已经干出什么事情了？

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我可不知道！我是说，遇到你之前，我会把这里所有的杂碎都活剥了！但现在我会让他们慢慢等着，这都是因为你。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Good job, redblood! You made it all this way! But, I have got to send you back to daddy, now. Nothing personal!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wish you could join me, Alecto. Want me to put in a good word with Father next time, so you can come visit us at the House yourself?

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Oh, you know, I'd rather have my eyes put out, but thanks for offering! Now, time to head on home.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 干得漂亮，流红血的！你居然能走到这里！不过，我得把你送回你爸爸那里了，这可不是什么私人恩怨！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你要是能和我一起来就好了，阿勒克图。想让我下次在我父亲面前美言你几句吗？这样你就可以亲自来我们的圣殿里看看了。

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 哦，说真的，那我还不如把自己眼珠子抠出来，不过感谢你的提议！好了，你该回家了。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You know, redblood, my appointments usually don't come to me, much less again and again! Think I'm here to show you a good time, huh?!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Alecto, I just like to see you menacingly smile. And, hey, having to deal with you now and again beats having to fight Meg all the time.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Whaa?! You think dealing with me beats dealing with that weakling? Graaaah!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 说真的，流红血的，我的约会对象时常会放我鸽子，至于一次次来找我的，就更是没有了！你以为我在这里等你，是要和你度过什么甜蜜时光吗，哈？！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我只是很喜欢看到你那充满恶意的笑容，阿勒克图。另外，和你没事打上几架，总比不得不和墨纪动手要好多了。

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 什么？！你觉得和我打架比和那个废物打架有意思吗？哇啊啊啊啊！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: How many times is it going to take, redblood? How many?! Tell me! How can you stand running into me like this, over and over?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, habits can be hard to break. As for how many times, I've really no idea. Though I guess there's one way to find out.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: I'll give you one thing... I like it when my prey bites back. Come on, let's see some blood again.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你到底要试多少次才会放弃，流红血的？到底要多少次？！快告诉我！你像这样一次次朝我冲过来，你到底是怎么受得了的？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，积习难改。至于要多少次，老实说我自己也不知道。不过，我猜只有一个办法能弄清楚了。

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 告诉你一件事情吧……我很喜欢会还手的猎物。来吧，是时候见点血了。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Tisiphone's started to say the strangest things, lately, redblood. You wouldn't happen to know anything about that, would you?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, don't fret. I was just trying to help her expand her somewhat limited vocabulary.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Stay out of her head!! You really think she's got something to learn from you? Learn to shut up from her!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 提西福涅最近开始说怪话了，流红血的，你该不会刚好知道什么内幕吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，别担心，我只是帮助她扩充一下她贫乏的词汇量而已。

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 少跟她说些有的没的！！你真以为她需要从你这里学什么吗？你应该和她学学怎么闭嘴！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Eugh, still can't believe Megaera got mixed up with you, redblood. For all her weakness, I always thought at least she took her job here seriously. Eh, live and learn!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Not interested in your nasty remarks about her, Alecto. Though if you keep them up, I'm warning you, I might get mad.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Ohh, you might get mad? Defend Megaera's honor, since she's far too weak to do it her damn self? You think she's so pure! Hahaha! You're disgusting! Both of you.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 呃，我还是不敢相信墨纪拉居然和你搅到一起去了。她虽然是个废物，但我一直以为她至少对待工作还是挺认真的。哎，真是知人知面不知心啊！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你对她这些刻薄的评语我不感兴趣，阿勒克图。不要如果你打算继续说的话，我警告你，我可能会大发雷霆。

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 哦，你可能会大发雷霆？你打算保护她的名誉，因为她实在是太他妈弱了，她自己保护不了吗？你真以为她是朵白莲花吗？哈哈哈！你们两个可真让人恶心！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Oh hey, redblood! You're back for more. I like that stubborn stupidness about you, honestly. If only I could keep you alive even longer this time.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, you planning to kill me with insults this time?

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Haven't decided how just yet. This girl likes a little spontaneity.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 噢，流红血的！你回来挨打啦。老实说，我挺喜欢你这股子倔强的憨劲儿。看看这回你能在我手下活多久吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 干嘛，这回你想用嘴说死我吗？

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 还不确定让你怎么死。这位女生喜欢随性的。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Huh! Normally my marks don't make a habit of seeking me out again after I'm through with them.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I can imagine that, it's just, I've really come to appreciate these little back-and-forth exchanges that we have.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Ugh, I do so hate to let you down like this, redblood. But you're just not my type. Maybe I'll finally get it through your head this time.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 呵！一般来说，被我甩掉的人不会一次又一次地主动回来找我。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 可以理解，不过，我还挺喜欢这种反反复复见面交流的方式的。

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 唉，虽然我也不想让你失望，流红血的，但我是真的不喜欢你这型的。也许这回我真的能把你给说通了。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Know something, redblood? Try as I might, I still have not forgiven you for beating me last time. Call it a crippling character flaw, I don't know...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Forgiveness can take time. Though self-reflection is a healthy step. We're making progress!

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You think we're making progress? Here? Ah, hah, ha-hah, ha-hah, ha-hah, why you piece of trash! I'll show you progress.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你知道吗，流红血的？不管我有多努力，我还是无法原谅你打败过我这个事实。可能这是一种性格缺陷吧，我不知道……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 原谅是需要时间的。不过自我反省也是一种健康的做法。可算有进展了！

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你觉得我们的关系有进展？这里？啊哈，哈哈，哈哈，哈哈，又是你这垃圾！我让你看看进展。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Redblood, I'm getting awful sick of seeing your smug face, time, after time, after time.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Have you given any thought to just... leaving me alone, and going back to wherever it is you came from?

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You see? That is exactly what I mean. To think that Megaera had to put up with you for, I don't know how long.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 流红血的，一天到晚都能看到你那张神气十足的臭脸，我真的烦都烦死了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你难道就不能……别来，回你自己的地方去吗？

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 听到没有？这完全就是我想说的。真不知道墨纪拉怎么能忍你这么长时间。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Damn you for this, redblood. You're making me look bad, you know? Making me feel bad.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Alecto, I didn't ask you to repeatedly attempt to kill me. How did you expect me to respond?

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Ah-hahah-hahaha, hahah, you do know what happens when you make me feel bad, don't you...?

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 去死吧，流红血的。你让我感到难堪，知道吗？让我感到难堪。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿勒克图，我并没有要求你重复不停地要杀我。你让我怎么回答？

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 啊哈哈哈哈哈哈，哈哈，你应该知道让我感到难堪会怎样吧……？

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Huh, it's the god of trash, come once again to filthy up this place! You're getting real predictable, you know.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Considering I beat you last we met, I'd be much more concerned with your predictability than mine.

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Don't want to hear it from you, trash! Just want to see you bleed. Now you come here!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 呵，这不是那个小杂碎吗？又过来准备弄脏这个地方了嘛！说真的，你要做什么可真是一目了然。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 上次我们打架的时候，赢的人可是我。我觉得和我相比，你更让人觉得一目了然。

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你没资格对我说这种话，杂碎！我只想看到你流血的样子，来吧，动手吧！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Ohh, there he is, sisters. It's time to get to work.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 哦哦，他来了。姐妹们，开始工作了。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You ready, Megaera? Tisiphone? Let's go.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 准备好了吗，墨纪拉？提西福涅？上吧。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Let's tear him into shreds, sisters, come on!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 快点把他给撕成碎片，姐妹们，来吧！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Hey, check it out, sisters, he's back. You ready?

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 嘿，看啊，姐们们，他又来了。准备好了吗？

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: He's come crawling back again, sisters. Let's get him, then.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 他又一瘸一拐地来了，姐妹们。那就上吧。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: All right, sisters! Don't screw this up for me!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 好了，妹妹们！这件事可不准搞砸了。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: I'm taking point against this trash, sisters. You back me up.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我负责对付这个杂碎，妹妹们，你们来支援我。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: All three of us against this trash, sisters? All right!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我们三个一起对付这个杂碎，没问题吧，妹妹们？那就没问题了！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: The three Furies up against the trash god! What a fight!

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Oh, hohohohoho, look at him, sisters! Don't you just want to whip him all to shreds?!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 复仇三女神对战小杂碎神！真是一场恶战！

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 哦，呵呵呵呵呵呵，快看看他吧，妹妹们！难道你们不想用鞭子狠狠地抽他一顿吗？！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Much as I love chatting with you, Meg, Tisiphone... our prey is here.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 就像我愿意和你们聊天那样，墨纪，提西福涅……我们的猎物来了。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You ready, Sis? This redblood's nothing to the both of us.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 准备好了吗，姐妹们？这流红血的真是不堪一击。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Check it out, Sis! The god of trash is here. Let's get to work.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 快看，姐妹们！垃圾之神来了耶。开工了。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Well, Sis, what do you say we get started on him?

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 姐妹们，要拿他怎么办呢？

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: There he is, Sis! I'm ready if you're ready.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 他来啦，姐妹们！我早就准备好了。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: All right, Sister! Let's rip him all to shreds!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 好了，妹妹！准备把他大卸八块吧！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You ready for him, Sister? I most definitely am!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你准备好了吗，妹妹？我已经彻底准备好了！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You're never getting through the both of us without losing a lot of blood, trash god.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 想过我们两个这一关，恐怕你得流不少血才行啊，小杂碎神。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: My sis and I, we're going to tear you limb from limb, redblood!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我和我妹妹要把你削成人棍，流红血的！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Think you can scoot right past the both of us, trash god?!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你以为能从我们两个的手上逃掉吗，小杂碎神？！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: All right, Sis! You just back me up against this trash!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 好了，妹妹！我要对付这个杂碎了，你支援我！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: I'll just keep killing you, redblood. Not that I mind!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我会不停地杀死你，流红血的。一点也不介意！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: What are we going to do with you this time, now, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 这次要对你做点什么好呢？

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: I'm impressed, redblood. You really never learn.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 还行，流红血的。你是真的不带脑子啊。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Turns out, killing the god of trash never gets old.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 杀死垃圾之神就是这么好玩。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: How would you like to die this time, redblood? Here, let me guess.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 这次你想怎么死，流红血的？容我想想。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You just don't get it, do you? Though I bet I can make you learn.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你怎么就是不明白呢？不过我会让你明白的。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: I'm getting real sick of you, trash god. Come on!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我都烦了，你这垃圾神。来吧！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Bad news for you, redblood. I like dying.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 告诉你个坏消息，流红血的。我最喜欢死了。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Come on, redblood, let's see you kill me again!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 来啊，流红血的，再杀我一次。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You're stuck with me forever, trash. Remember that.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 别想摆脱我，你这垃圾。记住了。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: I'm really starting to hate you. You know that, redblood?

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我开始讨厌你了。你知道吗，流红血的？

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Why if it isn't the god of trash himself. I'm so honored.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 这不是垃圾之神本尊吗。荣幸之至。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Good news for you, I'm in a real bad mood right now.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 告诉你个好消息，我现在心情很不好。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Been looking forward to this chance to get you back, redblood.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我一直在等你回来，流红血的。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Heard you were in the area, and thought I'd take another stab at killing you.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 听说你在这里，我就想一定要把你杀掉。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Redblood, I really don't appreciate what happened here last time.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 流红血的，对于上次发生在这里的事情，我很不高兴。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You might get through me, trash god, but I'm going to spill your blood before you do!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 或许你能过了我这一关，小杂碎神，但我一定会让你血流成河！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Long as I slow you down, redblood, I've done my job.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 只要我能拖慢你，流红血的，我就尽到了我的责任。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You think just 'cause you got through Megaera, you'll get through me?

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你觉得因为你打败了墨纪拉，你就能打败我？

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Your daddy never should have given Megaera this job.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你老爹真不该把这任务交给墨纪拉。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Megaera couldn't make it, redblood, so it's me and you.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 墨纪拉失败了，流红血的，所以现在是你跟我了。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Hah! It's Megaera's hot mess. Let's clean you up.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 哈！墨纪拉留下的大烂摊子。让我把你给收拾了吧。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You got Tisiphone, so what. Now I'll get you.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你打败了提西福涅，又怎样。现在我要打败你。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You mess with Tis, redblood, you mess with me, get it?

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你竟敢对提西动手，流红血的，问过我了吗？

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Tisiphone's been having problems with you, huh. Let's see if I can help.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 提西福涅对你一直看不顺眼吧。让我看看能不能帮忙。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Nobody messes with Tisiphone but me, redblood.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 除了我没人能动提西福涅，流红血的。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: I'm going to enjoy this, redblood.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我可喜欢这样了，流红血的。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Just when I was beginning to feel bored.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我等你等到花都谢了。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: I'm going to tear you limb from limb, redblood.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我要把你砍成人棍，流红血的。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: The Fates must want to spill your blood as much as I do.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 命运之神应该也跟我一样想让你血溅四处吧。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Time to die, again, redblood. Let's get to killing you.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 准备再次受死，流红血的。杀了你。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: This job never gets old, redblood, I can assure you that.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我跟你说，我这工作永远都是那么有趣，流红血的。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Well if it isn't the god of trash himself. Come die.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 噢这不是大名鼎鼎的垃圾之神本尊嘛。受死吧。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Good, I was getting real tired waiting around to kill you.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 太好了，我等着杀你都等累了。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Aww, you came back all this way! I'm flattered, redblood.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 噢，你又来千里送命了！我太感动了，流红血的。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Got some kind of deathwish, don't you. Fine.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你就是这么想死啊你。行。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Oh, thank the Fates I get to deal with you this time.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 哦，感谢命运之神让我这次能对付你。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Let's see what you can do, redblood. Come on!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我们来看看你有什么本事，流红血的。来吧！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Well! Look who's back. The god of trash, himself.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 看看，谁回来了！是垃圾之神本尊呢。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Get ready for a bunch of pain and suffering, trash god.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 准备受苦受难吧，你这垃圾神。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, hold it right there, redblood.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 喂，喂，喂，不准动噢，流红血的。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Been waiting here to beat you to a bloody pulp, redblood!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我已经等不及想要狠揍你一顿了，流红血的！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Don't even open that damn mouth of yours, redblood. Except to scream.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你那张臭嘴还是不要张开为好，流红血的，尖叫的时候除外。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You must like pain, or something, don't you, there, redblood?

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你肯定是个受虐狂吧，对不对，流红血的？

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Somebody's dying soon, redblood! Ohh, I can't wait.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 有些人马上就要死了，流红血的！哦，我已经迫不及待了。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Come give me everything you've got, trash god!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 有什么能耐就都使出来吧，小杂碎神！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Let's see what you're made of, trash god! Come on!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 让我看看你有什么本事，小杂碎神！来吧！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Looks like my prayers to the god of trash have finally been answered, huh?!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 看起来，我对杂碎之神的祈祷终于得到回应了，是吧？！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: What's the matter, there, redblood? Gone awful quiet! Did I hurt your feelings, huh?

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 怎么了，流红血的？怎么突然就闭嘴了？是我的话让你难受了吗，嗯？

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Ohh, I'm going to bleed you till you're dry.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 哦，我要把你的血榨得一滴不剩。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You want to mess with me again, redblood?! Well then, come on!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你又打算来找我的麻烦了吗，流红血的？！好吧，来啊！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: How is it possible I am so sick of you, but never sick of killing you, redblood?

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我明明这么烦你，可杀死你的过程我怎么都不烦。这是怎么回事，流红血的？

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Step on it, redblood! I've got lots of other trash to whip, you know!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 赶紧动手吧，流红血的！我还有别的垃圾要收拾呢，你知道的吧！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You want through that door back there, it's going to cost you blood!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 你打算从那扇门回去吗？这可是要付出血的代价！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Megaera's not just weak, she's got bad taste to match.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 墨纪拉不仅仅弱得可怜，她的品位也相当不怎么样。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Oh good, I was just itching for a live one, here, trash god.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 哦，太棒了。我刚刚还在手痒呢，你马上就来了，小杂碎神。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Live or die, your daddy doesn't care, redblood!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 无论你是死是活，你爸都不会在乎，流红血的！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Good thing your daddy hates you, or I wouldn't have the pleasure here, redblood!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 幸好你爸很讨厌你，否则我就没办法享受这种乐趣了，流红血的！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: I'm real sick of waiting here, so how about we make this real quick, redblood!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我已经受够了等待的滋味了，不如我们赶紧开始吧，流红血的！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Nothing like nice, fresh blood to warm things up in here, I always say!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 就像我总说的那样，没什么能比热气腾腾的鲜血更能活跃气氛的了！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: When I heard you were coming through, redblood, I told my sisters I would see you here.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 当我听说你要过来的时候，流红血的，我就告诉我的妹妹们，说我会在这里等你了。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Ohh, we are going to enjoy this, here, redblood!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 哦，咱们来好好享受一番吧，流红血的！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Heard you were in the area and volunteered for this, trash god.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我听说你来了，我就自告奋勇地过来了，小杂碎神。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: Time to spill it for me once again, redblood.

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 是时候让你再次为我血流成河了，流红血的。

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: I'll send you screaming home to daddy, now come on!!

zh-CN.speaker: Alecto
zh-CN.text: 我马上就要让你一边惨叫一边回家了，来吧！！

en.speaker: Alecto
en.text: You mess with Tis, redblood, you mess with me, get it?

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmmuurrderrerrr...!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿勒克图
zh-CN.text: 你竟敢对提西动手，流红血的，问过我了吗？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Heads up, Tisiphone. I think I found a murderer for you.

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmmuurrderrerrr...!

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 小心了，提西福涅。我好像找到了你的克星。

en.text: Mmmm... mmmurderer...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, you must be one of Meg's sisters! Nice to finally meet you. My name's Zagreus. Not Murderer. Definitely not.

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Murderer... mmmmurderrrerrrrrrrr...!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm... look, I've done some things that maybe aren't great, but I am very, very sure I haven't murdered anyone.

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmmmmurderrrerrrrrrrr...!

zh-CN.text: 杀……杀手……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你应该就是墨纪的姐妹之一吧！很高兴终于见到你了。我的名字是扎格列欧斯。不是杀手。绝对不是。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃……你听我说，我确实做过一些不好的事，但是我确定一定以及肯定，我没有杀过任何人。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm here on official business this time, Tisiphone, so, uh... stand aside! Although, I guess the whole point of this job is that you're meant to try and stop me anyway, isn't that right?

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmm, hrr-hrr-hrrdderrr...

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我这次是来执行公务的，提西福涅。所以，呃……立正，站好！不过我猜，你这份工作的重点就是无论如何都要阻止我，是这样的吧？

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 嗯呃呃，杀呃——杀啊啊手呃呃呃……

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, sorry that you couldn't make the feast back at the House, Tisiphone. Though, I don't really think it was your kind of scene. Although, Ares was there, he's probably done some murders, right?

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Murrddderrrr? Murrdderrr. Murddder!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，圣殿里举行宴会的时候你没能赶回来，这真是太遗憾了，提西福涅。不过我猜，你也不喜欢那样的场合。不过阿瑞斯也参加了宴会，他肯定干过不少谋杀这类的事情，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 杀——手？杀手。杀——手！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmmmurrr... derr...?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm... how about, no? No murder. No murder!

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmmmuurderrr....

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯……试试说不，好吗？不杀。不杀！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Murder...? Murder, murrrder...!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I was really hoping we could change the subject. Please?

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Muurderer... muuurrderer!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我真的觉得我们可以换一个词。谢谢你？

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 杀手……杀手 ！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmm... mmm.... mmmrrrr....!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Let me guess. Murder? Murderer, perhaps? One of those two.
