en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmm, mmmurder... mmmurder!!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 容我想想。杀？杀手？就这两个词。

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 杀，杀手……杀手！！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmmrrrrr... mmurrr, derrr....

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Please, I'm not a murderer, you don't have to do this.

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Murderer. Muurrdererrr....

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 求求你，我真不是杀手，你不用老是这样说。

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 杀手。杀手……

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Murdererrr... murder, murder, murder!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: We're not getting through to one another, are we. I'm sorry that it has to be this way.

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Murderer. Murdererrr!!

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 杀……杀手，杀手 ，杀手！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 看样子确实是没法正常沟通了。对于接下来要发生的事情我很抱歉。

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 杀手。杀手！！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Murder? Murder...? Murder....

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I don't understand. But I'm not who you think I am. My father sent you to stop me, that's all.

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Murderer... murderer! Murderer!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我真的不懂。但是我真的不是你想的那样。我父亲派你来阻止我，是这样的。

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 杀手……杀手！杀手！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mrrr... murr.. derr... murrdderr!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No, murder. Zagreus. My name is Zagreus! Can you say that, Tisiphone? No murder. Zagreus!

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Murr... derr... zerrr....

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 杀……杀……手……杀手！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不是杀手，是扎格列欧斯，我叫扎格列欧斯！你能说出这个名字吗，提西福涅？不是杀手，是扎格列欧斯！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mm, murrr... derr... zerrr!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You really did say murderzer, didn't you! That's progress! Zagreus! I'm Zagreus, I'm not a murderer! Can you say Zagreus?

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Derr... zerr... zahh... zahh, graaahh!

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 嗯，杀……手……扎格！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你刚刚是不是说杀手扎格了！你有进步了！是扎格列欧斯！我是扎格列欧斯，不是杀手！你能说出“扎格列欧斯”这个词吗？

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 手……扎……扎……扎，啊啊啊！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Zerr... znnhh... zrrrnggh...!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Do you remember me, Tisiphone? My name is Zagreus. Prince of the Underworld? Pretty close with Megaera, I guess. Try saying Zagreus again for me?

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Zrrnngh... zaahh... zahh... gree... mrrsss...?

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 扎……扎嗯……扎啊啊……！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你还记得我吗，提西福涅？我是冥界王子扎格列欧斯，还记得吧？我猜，我和墨纪拉的关系还挺亲密的吧。可以再试试说“扎格列欧斯”这个词吗？

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 扎啊啊……扎啊……扎……各……马斯……？

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Zzaaahhh... durrr... err... Zzahh... durr.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, you're so close, Tisiphone! Remember, Zagreus? That's me. I'm not your enemy, you know, don't you know that? I'm only Zagreus!

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: ...Zzzzzaaahhh... gree... usss.... Zzaagreeusss! Zaagreuss!!

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 扎啊啊啊……手……呃……扎啊……手。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，你马上就成功了，提西福涅！还记得吗？我是扎格列欧斯。我不是你的敌人，你是明白的吧？我只是扎格列欧斯而已！

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: ……扎啊啊啊啊啊……格呃……乌斯……扎啊格呃列欧斯！扎格呃列欧斯！！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Zzzaaggreussss.... mm... murrdererr....

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No. Wait. Just the first part. No murderer. Just Zagreus. Or... let's see, how about... happy? Can you say happy?

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmrrr... Zzzrrderrrerrr....

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 扎啊啊格呃呃列欧斯……嗯嗯……杀手……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不对，等等。只要说前面那半句就行了，只要扎格列欧斯就好了。或者说……我们试试别的……幸福？你会说“幸福”这个词吗？

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 嗯呃呃……扎啊啊啊呃呃……

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Murdderr... Zzaagreusss... murddererrr...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, well... let's try again with happy, how about that? Happy? No murder, only happy. Come on, now!

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Murderr... murderr Zzagreusss!

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 杀手……扎啊格呃列欧哦斯……杀手……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，好吧……我们再来试试幸福这个词吧，怎么样？幸福？不要说“杀手”，只说“幸福”。来，试试吧！

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 杀手……杀手……扎啊啊格呃列欧斯！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmmmurddererrr... znnnhh... zrrrnnggh...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Eugh, I guess the happy thing just isn't doing it for you. Though, maybe trying to kill me like this is as close as you can get. You learned my name at least, that's something, right?

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Murrddderr... Zzaagreusss...

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 杀手……杀手……扎啊啊啊……扎啊啊啊啊……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧，我猜幸福什么的你并不理解。不过，或许像这样想要杀我，对你而言已经最详实类似于幸福的东西了吧。至少你已经记住我的名字了，还是有进步的，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 杀手……扎啊啊格呃列欧斯……

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmmuurdderrr... murrdderrrerrrrr....

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...Then we're back to square one. Look, I was just trying to get through to you with all the Zagreus and happy stuff. But, if you can understand any of this, Tisiphone, I think you're all right, just the way you are. Friends?

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: ...Zzrrngh... zrrnnggh... zzrrdderrrerrr!...

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 杀手……杀啊啊手……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: ……看来我们又回到原点了。你看，我只是想教会你说“扎格列欧斯”啊，“幸福”啊之类的词。不过如果你已经能理解这些词的话，提西福涅，那我觉得你就算是说不出来，也不算什么问题。我们算是朋友吗？

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: ……扎啊啊啊……扎啊啊啊……扎啊啊啊啊啊手！……

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Zzz, zzaa... Zaaggreus? Mmurderrrer?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, uhh, any second thoughts, by any chance, about the whole happy thing? Just making sure.

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Zagreuss murderrrer!

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 扎，扎啊……扎啊格列欧斯？杀手？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，呃，以防万一，想问一下，你有没有考虑过说幸福这个词？我只是想确定一下而已。

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，杀——手！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmmmm, mmm, mmrrrrr....

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 师，师，师啊杀……

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mm, mmurrdererrrrr.... Murdererr!

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 师啊，杀手…………杀手！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Murder...? Murrdderrr. Murddder!

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 杀——手？杀手。杀——手！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Muurdddderrrerrr.... murdderrerrrr...!

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmm, murdder? Murdderrer?

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 嗯呃呃，杀手？杀啊啊手？

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Murder. Murder. Murder. Murder. Murder!

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 杀。杀。杀。杀。杀！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Murderer. Murderer...! Murderer!

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 杀手。杀手……！杀手！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmmuurrderrerrr...!

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmmurrrderrerrr...?

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmm-hhhm-hmm-mmurrdderrr...

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 嗯呃呃，杀呃——杀啊啊手呃呃呃……

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmuuurrrrrderrrr....

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Murrdderrr? Murrdderrrr....

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmm... mmmrrrr... mrrrrr!

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 师……师啊…………啊啊啊！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mm, mmm, mmrrrnnggghh!

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 师，师啊，杀啊啊啊啊啊！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Murderrrr!

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 杀！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Zzzaah, zzz, zrnnghh... muurddderr...!

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Zz, zzzaggreuss.... Zagreus!

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 扎——扎格——列欧斯……扎格列欧斯！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Zzzagreus? Mmmurdderr Zaggreuss!

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 扎啊啊格列欧斯？杀手扎格呃列欧斯！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Mmmurrdderrr.... Zzaaggreusss...!

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 杀手……扎啊啊格呃列欧斯……！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Zzz, zzaa... Zaaggreus? Mmurderrrer?

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 扎，扎啊……扎啊格列欧斯？杀手？

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Zzhhrr, zzzrnn, Zzzrrderrerr...

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 扎啊啊，扎呃呃，扎啊啊啊啊手……

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Zagreuss. Zagreuss...! Zagreuss!

zh-CN.speaker: Tisiphone
zh-CN.text: 扎格呃列欧斯，扎格呃列欧斯……！扎格列欧斯！

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Zzzaaagggreussss....

zh-CN.text: 扎啊啊啊格呃呃列欧斯……

en.text: Zzagreuss? Zzaaggreusss. Murderrerrrrr....

zh-CN.text: 扎啊格列欧斯？扎啊啊啊格呃呃列欧斯，杀手……

en.speaker: Tisiphone
en.text: Zzz... zzuh, zzzrnnn! Murdderrrr!

zh-CN.text: 扎……扎啊啊，扎啊啊啊！杀手！

en.text: Zz, zrrngh, zzrraugghhh!

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Ah, hahaha, it's finally time, Asterius. He's here! Aren't you, now, you vile, insignificant hellspawn? Prepare now to be overrun!!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, this is unfair... that's a bronze-plated Macedonian Tau-Lambda! What's an obnoxious bellyacher like you doing with the most durable chariot created, to date?

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Pah! You don't deserve to know. Suffice it that Asterius and I were handsomely rewarded once again. And we shall not hesitate to exploit our hard-fought spoils against you!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，哈哈哈，终于等到了，阿斯忒里俄斯。他来了！我以为是谁呢，这不是卑鄙无耻不入流的地狱之子吗？等着被蹂躏吧！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，不公平……那是马其顿塔乌-拉姆达镀铜战车！像你这样讨厌的牢骚鬼要这辆迄今为止最伟大的战车做什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 呸！关你什么事。只要我和阿斯忒里俄斯能再漂亮地赢一场就够了。而且我们会毫不犹豫地从你手中拿走辛苦得来的战利品！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: He would pit you against me, Asterius. I can see it in his mis-matched eyes! I cannot shake the terrible vision that, someday or night, it shall be me, standing alone here, whilst you...? Whilst you take sides against me! With that fiend!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Asterius, about that, please consider it a standing offer, if you like. I'd rather have you as a friend than as a foe. Not sure that I can say the same for Theseus, of course.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: You poisonous worm! I knew you had a more sinister trick at play, because your fighting style certainly is of no concern just on its own! Are there truly no depths to which you would not stoop?!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 他会让你我二人反目成仇，阿斯忒里俄斯，他那双邪恶的眼睛就说明了一切！我没办法摆脱那可怕的景象，有朝一日，我会站在这里，而你呢……？而你却和我为敌！和那只恶魔并肩而战！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 关于这一点，阿斯忒里俄斯，如果你愿意的话，我的提案长期有效。比起与你刀剑相向，我更希望能和你成为朋友。不过，同样的话我恐怕是不会对忒修斯说的。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你这只恶毒的蛆虫！我早就知道你还有别的把戏，因为你战斗的本事简直不值一提！为了达到目的，你还有什么事情做不出来？

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: ...I'm telling you, you're wrong, Asterius! He is no royalty, most certainly not any I would recognize! He's but a nameless, long-forgotten minor god born of the depths, and bound to stay in them!

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I, too, once was berated by such words, king. We've faced this enemy how many times? And in my estimation, he's fought bravely, here.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Bravely?! Hiding behind those pillars is what you call bravely, Asterius? We shall have to discuss this strange lapse of judgment after we achieve our victory!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: ……听我一句劝吧，阿斯忒里俄斯，你错了！他才不是什么有王室血统的人呢，反正肯定不是我认识的家伙！他不过是个被遗忘的无名小神，他诞生于深渊之底，也应该生生世世呆在那里！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 国王，我以前也听信过他的鬼话。这个敌人我们已经交手过多少次了？在我看来，他战斗得很英勇。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 英勇？！他就会躲在那些柱子后面，你却管这叫英勇，阿斯忒里俄斯？等打败他之后，我们得好好讨论讨论你怎么会产生这种怪想法！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: ...I'm telling you, you're wrong, Asterius! He is no royalty, most certainly not any I would recognize! He's but a nameless, long-forgotten minor god born of the depths, and bound to stay in them!

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: I hope you're perfectly pleased with yourself, hellspawn. Because Asterius has been quite cross with me! Such as he is. He says I have misjudged the likes of you! Outrageousness.

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You don't hear me, king. We still have a lot to learn about this foe. Each time, he's differently equipped. Weapons, god-given abilities, and such. Despite our efforts... it's been difficult to read his strategies.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: And now, you're saying I can't fight, Asterius? Even though I had no difficulty besting you within that maze of yours?! Come on, let's do this fight!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 我希望你已经准备好了，地狱之子，因为我和阿斯忒里俄斯狠狠地吵了一架！没错，他说是我看错了像你这样的人！真是气死我了。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我的话你根本没听进去，国王。关于这个敌人，我们还有很多事情要弄明白。他每次来这里，装备都不一样，拿的武器、能力之类的也都不一样。无论我们怎么努力……都没办法看透他的战术。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 是吗？你是在说我打不过他吗，阿斯忒里俄斯？别忘了，我可是在你的迷宫里，轻轻松松就把你打败了啊！？别废话了，赶紧打完这一仗吧！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: I hope you're perfectly pleased with yourself, hellspawn. Because Asterius has been quite cross with me! Such as he is. He says I have misjudged the likes of you! Outrageousness.

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You don't hear me, king. We still have a lot to learn about this foe. Each time, he's differently equipped. Weapons, god-given abilities, and such. Despite our efforts... it's been difficult to read his strategies.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: And now, you're saying I can't fight, Asterius? Even though I had no difficulty besting you within that maze of yours?! Come on, let's do this fight!

zh-CN.text: 我的话你根本没听进去，国王。关于这个敌人，我们还有很多事情要弄明白。他每次来这里，装备都不一样，拿的武器、能力之类的也都不一样。无论我们怎么努力……都没办法看透他的战术。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 是吗？你是在说我打不过他吗，阿斯忒里俄斯？别忘了，我可是在你的迷宫里，轻轻松松就把你打败了啊！？别废话了，赶紧打完这一仗吧！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Well, worm! Come fight us, I suppose. And take fullest advantage of the havoc that you sowed! We are no team! We're merely two combatants, simultaneously booked to be here, now.

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: King, I think you are over-reacting, here. Try to be reasonable. And be more considerate about my point of view. Don't think I am asking for too much.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: You're asking the impossible of me! But, let us fight. And let us lose, I'm sure, because if we are not a team, what are we, then, Asterius...?

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 是你啊，蛆虫！你是来和我们打架的吧，看看你把我们的关系破坏成了什么样子！我们已经不再是什么队友了！不过是两个单打独斗的人，刚好在这里各自为战罢了。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 国王，我觉得你实在是太小题大做了，冷静点，好好考虑考虑我的观点吧。我觉得我的要求并不过分。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 别让我做我做不到的事情！赶紧开打，然后认输吧。我知道肯定打不赢，因为如果我们不是队友的话，那我们到底算什么呢，阿斯忒里俄斯……？

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Well, worm! Come fight us, I suppose. And take fullest advantage of the havoc that you sowed! We are no team! We're merely two combatants, simultaneously booked to be here, now.

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: King, I think you are over-reacting, here. Try to be reasonable. And be more considerate about my point of view. Don't think I am asking for too much.

en.speaker: Theseus

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 国王，我觉得你实在是太小题大做了，冷静点，好好考虑考虑我的观点吧。我觉得我的要求并不过分。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 别让我做我做不到的事情！赶紧开打，然后认输吧。我知道肯定打不赢，因为如果我们不是队友的话，那我们到底算什么呢，阿斯忒里俄斯……？

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You'll have to excuse the Champion, there, short one. He hasn't been himself. Though he'll still fight you to the death, I'm sure.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That's good, because you had me worried for a moment, there. Hey maybe I can knock some sense back into him, what do you think?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I'm not so sure. I've tried. But I know better than to underestimate you. Fight us, then.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你得原谅我们的最强战士，小矮个，他最近脾气不太好。不过我敢肯定，他还是会与你恶战到底的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这样就好，我一开始还有点担心呢。嘿，或许我可以让他开开窍，你说呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我不太确定，我已经试过了。不过我知道，最好还是不要低估你为好，我们要上了。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You'll have to excuse the Champion, there, short one. He hasn't been himself. Though he'll still fight you to the death, I'm sure.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That's good, because you had me worried for a moment, there. Hey maybe I can knock some sense back into him, what do you think?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I'm not so sure. I've tried. But I know better than to underestimate you. Fight us, then.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你得原谅我们的最强战士，小矮个，他最近脾气不太好。不过我敢肯定，他还是会与你恶战到底的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我不太确定，我已经试过了。不过我知道，最好还是不要低估你为好，我们要上了。

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Please fight with me, again, Asterius. I mean, just like before! You must forgive me my indecencies of late. This blasted fiend! His lies and treachery get right under my skin. Or the phantasmagorical equivalent!

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Swear something to me, king. That you'll discard your fears about our bond. The short one here is never going to break it. He doesn't even understand it. The only one who can break it is you, yourself.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: I... oh, my dear friend, Asterius. I see, of course, you're right, you're right. You're right! And I solemnly do swear to you, indeed, that I shall never again doubt our brotherhood! Nor shall I ever listen to this fiend! Together, now and always!!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 请再次和我并肩作战吧，阿斯忒里俄斯。我是说，就像从前一样！你一定得原谅我最近犯下的蠢事。那只该死的恶魔！他的谎言和背叛，或是幻象之类的法术，毒害了我的心灵！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我的国王，向我发誓，发誓你永远都不会再怀疑我们之间的羁绊。那个小矮子是不会摧毁我们之间的羁绊的，他甚至根本无法理解这种感情。唯一能摧毁这种羁绊的人，只有你自己。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 我……哦，阿斯忒里俄斯，我亲爱的朋友。我明白了，你说得没错，你说得没错，你说得没错！我郑重地向你发誓，我永远不会再怀疑我们的兄弟之情了！我也再也不会听信这个恶魔的鬼话了！我们是好兄弟，永远都是！！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Please fight with me, again, Asterius. I mean, just like before! You must forgive me my indecencies of late. This blasted fiend... his lies and treachery get right under my skin. Or the phantasmagorical equivalent!

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Swear something to me, king. That you'll discard your fears about our bond. The short one here is never going to break it. He doesn't even understand it. The only one who can break it is you, yourself.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: I... oh, my dear friend, Asterius. I see, of course, you're right, you're right. You're right! And I solemnly do swear to you, indeed, that I shall never again doubt our brotherhood! Nor shall I ever listen to this fiend! Together, now and always!!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 请再次和我并肩作战吧，阿斯忒里俄斯。我是说，就像从前一样！你一定得原谅我最近犯下的蠢事。那只该死的恶魔！他的谎言和背叛，或是幻象之类的法术，毒害了我的心灵！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我的国王，向我发誓，发誓你永远都不会再怀疑我们之间的羁绊。那个小矮子是不会摧毁我们之间的羁绊的，他甚至根本无法理解这种感情。唯一能摧毁这种羁绊的人，只有你自己。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 我……哦，阿斯忒里俄斯，我亲爱的朋友。我明白了，你说得没错，你说得没错，你说得没错！我郑重地向你发誓，我永远不会再怀疑我们的兄弟之情了！我也再也不会听信这个恶魔的鬼话了！我们是好兄弟，永远都是！！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Come forth, blackguard, and you shall soon be crushed under the massive wheels of the finest chariot the world has ever known!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You only have that chariot because of me, you know. It's all because of a condition of the Pact of Punishment! Nothing you did or earned. So drop the act!

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Hahahahah, what?! You claim to be my benefactor, when in truth, you are my figuratively mortal enemy?! I'll do the chariot-equivalent of trample you!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 来吧，无赖，很快你就会命丧于有史以来最华丽的战车的巨轮之下！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你能得到那辆战车，都亏了我。都要拜惩罚契约的条款所赐！你根本不配。别装腔作势了！

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 哈哈哈哈，你说什么？！你只不过是我象征性的死敌，但你却说这是你的功劳？！我要像战车那样碾压你！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Come, blackguard! And be crushed beneath the raging wheelwork of the Macedonian Tau-Lambda, once again!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Theseus, you do know you look even more ridiculous than normal wearing that mask? I get the chariot and the unsporting weaponry, but why wear that thing?

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Bah! This blessed mask was crafted by great Daedalus, himself! A work of art, and my entitled claim as champion! What has he ever done for you?!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 来吧，无赖！再次被马其顿塔乌-拉姆达战车碾成齑粉吧！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 忒修斯，你知道吗？你戴上那个面具之后，看起来比平时更滑稽了。我理解你喜欢乘着战车，喜欢挥舞那把华而不实的武器，但那个面具是怎么回事？

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 胡说八道！这个被祝福的面具可是伟大的狄德勒斯亲手打造的！这件艺术品正符合我的最强战士身份！恐怕他没为你做过什么吧？

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Well now, Asterius, he's returned! And this time, we shall have to vanquish him without the aid of our divine armor! A worthy challenge, no?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Be cautious not to underestimate him, king. He has proved troublesome before.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Nonsense, my friend! For how can one underestimate that which deserves no esteem whatsoever?! Together, now, attack!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 好了，阿斯忒里俄斯，他回来了！而这一次，我们必须在没有神圣护甲的保护下打败他！这是一次值得尝试的挑战，不是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 注意，不要小看他，国王。他之前也是不好对付的人物。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 别瞎扯了，我的朋友！对于一个毫无尊严的人，我还能如何小瞧？！现在，我们一起进攻！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Well, you senseless monster, I suspect you're not so pleased with yourself, now! Behold!! For my glorious chariot has been restored!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, indeed, nice work! Though must have cost a fortune in gemstones and diamonds, restoring an old Macedonian. I thought it was totaled after last time.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: The only thing which shall be totaled here, you heartless property-destroying scourge, is you yourself! Asterius!! Together, let us break him!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧，愚蠢的怪物，我怀疑，现在，你自己对自己都不是很满意吧！看好了！！我的荣耀战车已经修好了！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，确实，干得不错！不过，要修复一辆老旧的马其顿战车肯定用了不少宝石和钻石。我以为，经历过上次一战，它早就报废了呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 在这里，唯一应该被报废的东西，是你这个没心没肺，暴殄天物的祸害！阿斯忒里俄斯！！我们现在联手把他击垮！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: My chariot and I stand ready for you, daemon! And I assume Asterius, as well! I feel it in my phantom heart, we shall not fall to you this time!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know, my opinion of the Macedonian Tau-Lambda has fallen precipitously of late. Though perhaps it's not the chariot but the driver.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Silence!! Show me a finer chariot-driver anywhere within Elysium, why, you cannot! I'll run you down for such an insult to my pride!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 我的战车和我都已经准备好了，怪物！而且我猜阿斯忒里俄斯也是一样！幽灵也有心，而且我觉得，这次我们不会输给你！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道吗，我最近对马其顿塔乌-拉姆达战车的看法急转直下。但这可能和战车本身无关，主要是驾驶者的关系。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 安静！！你说说在至福乐土还有谁更适合驾驶战车，你肯定说不出！我要把你撞飞，因为你侮辱了我的自尊心！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Ready yourself and your fine armor, friend Asterius! I shall drive circles around him, whilst you dispatch him with your mighty axe!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Your strategy might work a little better if you didn't shout it loud enough for me to hear. Though I have to say I'm impressed you can drive, fight, and shout all at the same time.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: And I, fiend, am impressed that you yet live and breathe! A temporary state Asterius and I shall soon alleviate! To war!!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 准备好，穿上更坚固的护甲，阿斯忒里俄斯，我的朋友！我会驾着战车围着他转圈，你趁机用巨斧将他干掉！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果你别这么大喊大叫的，说不定这套策略能更有效。不得不承认，我对你的印象深刻，又能驾驶战车，又能打，嗓门还特别大。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 而且，你竟然还活着，这一点让我感到不可思议！不过阿斯忒里俄斯和我很快就会结束这种现状！开战吧！！

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: He's here, king. Activating armor. It's fortunate repairs on your chariot were completed in time.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Nonsense, my friend! We could defeat this vile hellspawn with or without the additional divine protection we've been granted here! Get him!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 他来了，国王。正在激活护甲。你的战车及时修好了，真是幸运。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 别瞎扯了，我的朋友！无论有没有额外的神圣保护，我们都可以击败这个卑鄙无耻的地狱之子！干掉他！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Avert your eyes, fiend, lest the shining bronzework of the Macedonian should strike you blind! We are prepared to face your devilry!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Prepared for me, really? I've dismantled your ridiculous chariot before. Even Poseidon knows you're just a blowhard with a fancy ride.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: How dare you to invoke my Lord Poseidon's name?! And, to besmirch our complicated past! No god shall ever favor you as he has favored both Asterius and me!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 赶紧闭上眼睛吧，恶魔，否则马其顿号这些璀璨夺目的青铜饰品，恐怕要把你眼睛闪瞎了！我们已经准备好要让你好看了！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 已经准备好了？你确定吗？你那辆滑稽的战车我早就拆过一次了，就连波塞冬都知道，你不过是个花架子罢了。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你竟敢提起波塞冬大人的名字？！我们之前的事情也不像你说得那样！他很喜欢我和阿斯忒里俄斯，可根本没有哪个神会喜欢你！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Hold, fiend! You'll walk not one more step toward the light of day, so long as I am here.

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Two against one. Seems hardly fair.... Ah, well! <Snort> Let's kill him and be done, king.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Theseus?! The Bull of Minos?! You two are legends! I'd be honored if we had a sporting contest here!

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Ahh, a naked attempt to sway me from my convictions. Defend yourself, you blackguard! And may the gods show you some mercy, for I shall not!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 站住，恶魔！只要我还在这里，你休想跨过这里重见天日。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 二打一。似乎不太公平……啊，好吧！<鼻息声>赶快杀了他吧，我的王。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 忒修斯？！米诺斯公牛？！你们是传说级人物啊！如果能与两位公平竞技的话我会非常荣幸。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，竟想通过这种话来动摇我的信念。准备战斗吧，你这坏东西！希望众神会仁慈待你，因为我没有仁慈！

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I warned you, short one. Now you face a foe more terrible even than I. The only other foe whom I have ever faced, who bested me.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Hold, fiend! You'll walk not one more step toward the light of day, so long as I am here.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Theseus?! No way! You two are legends! I'd be honored if we had a sporting contest here!

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Ahh, a naked attempt to sway me from my convictions. Defend yourself, you blackguard! And may the gods show you some mercy, for I shall not!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我警告过你了，小矮个。现在你面对的是比我还强大的敌人。唯一一个打败过我的人。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 站住，恶魔！只要我还在这里，你休想跨过这里重见天日。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 忒修斯？！不是吧！你们是传说级人物啊！如果能与两位公平竞技的话我会非常荣幸。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，竟想通过这种话来动摇我的信念。准备战斗吧，你这坏东西！希望众神会仁慈待你，因为我没有仁慈！

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Beware, short one. Now you face a foe more terrible even than I. The only foe whom I have ever faced, who bested me.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Hold, fiend! You'll walk not one more step toward the light of day, so long as I am here.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Theseus?! No way! You two are legends! I'd be honored if we had a sporting contest here!

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Ahh, a naked attempt to sway me from my convictions. Defend yourself, you blackguard! And may the gods show you some mercy, for I shall not!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 准备好，小矮个。现在你面对的是比我还强大的敌人。唯一一个打败过我的人。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 站住，恶魔！只要我还在这里，你休想跨过这里重见天日。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 忒修斯？！不是吧！你们是传说级人物啊！如果能与两位公平竞技的话我会非常荣幸。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，竟想通过这种话来动摇我的信念。准备战斗吧，你这坏东西！希望众神会仁慈待你，因为我没有仁慈！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: So! The fiend returns to challenge us again, Asterius! Despite having experienced such a thorough thrashing by us last time!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know full well that wasn't a fair fight. Face me yourself and we'll see how you fare.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Silence, you monster! I'll hear no more such wicked lies, half-truths, or quarter-truths! You, however, soon shall hear my blessed spear! Specifically, the sound it makes whilst sliding into your exposed midsection! Defend yourself!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 看来！那只恶魔又来挑战我们了，阿斯忒里俄斯！明明上一次从我们这里已经吃过苦头了！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你明白这不是一场公平战斗。出来干一架，我就知道你的斤两了。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 住口，你这怪物！我不想再听见你恶毒的谎言和半真半假的说辞了！不过，你很快就会听到我神圣之矛了！尤其是，它刺入你身体的声音！准备战斗吧！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: So! The fiend returns to challenge us again, Asterius! Or, rather, to besmirch the honor of this competition!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Besmirch what honor? You're just complaining that you lost. Even though I was outnumbered!

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Silence, you monster!! I'll hear no more such wicked lies, half-truths, or quarter-truths! You, however, soon shall hear my blessed spear! Specifically, the sound it makes whilst sliding into your exposed midsection! Defend yourself!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 看来！那只恶魔又来挑战我们了，阿斯忒里俄斯！又或许，他是来玷污这场竞技的荣誉！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我玷污个屁。你只不过是不甘心自己输了而已。你们二打一都能输！

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 住口，你这怪物！我不想再听见你恶毒的谎言和半真半假的说辞了！不过，你很快就会听到我神圣之矛了！尤其是，它刺入你身体的声音！准备战斗吧！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: What are those bestial gloves of yours, blackguard? Beginning to show more of your true and savage nature, here perhaps?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: No. He bears the Twin Fists in the aspect of a king called Gilgamesh. That king, he, too, wrestled a beastlike man, who then became a friend. Maybe that's why I knew this fight would come.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: What are you telling me, Asterius? Now is certainly not a good time for waxing philosophical, I think! And, surely this King Gilgamesh of whom you speak is much more competent a fighter than this filth!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你那双邪恶的拳套是怎么回事，恶棍？看来，你终于打算在这里显露你那残暴的本性了，对不对？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 不。他戴着的双子之拳有着一位名叫吉尔伽美什的王的力量。那位王，他也曾与一个野兽般的人搏斗，然后他们成为了挚友。我有预感这场战斗注定发生，也许那就是原因。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你到底想说什么，阿斯忒里俄斯？我觉得这种时候可不适合讲什么哲学故事！而且我敢肯定，你说的这个吉尔伽美什国王，肯定比这个无赖更擅长战斗！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: What are those bestial gloves of yours, blackguard? Beginning to show more of your true and savage nature, here perhaps?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: No. He bears the Twin Fists in the aspect of a king called Gilgamesh. That king, he, too, wrestled a beastlike man, who then became a friend. Maybe that's why I knew this fight would come.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: What are you telling me, Asterius? Now is certainly not a good time for waxing philosophical, I think! And, surely this King Gilgamesh of whom you speak is much more competent a fighter than this filth!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你那双邪恶的拳套是怎么回事，恶棍？看来，你终于打算在这里显露你那残暴的本性了，对不对？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 不。他戴着的双子之拳有着一位名叫吉尔伽美什的王的力量。那位王，他也曾与一个野兽般的人搏斗，然后他们成为了挚友。我有预感这场战斗注定发生，也许那就是原因。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你到底想说什么，阿斯忒里俄斯？我觉得这种时候可不适合讲什么哲学故事！而且我敢肯定，你说的这个吉尔伽美什国王，肯定比这个无赖更擅长战斗！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: So, hellspawn! You seek to break through to the surface of the world. But you shall not achieve your goal, whilst I yet live and breathe! Or the equivalent of it, here in the splendors of Elysium!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Then you leave me with little choice but to make you shut up, already. And your bull-headed manservant there.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: That Minotaur whom you address is my dear friend, you preconceiving stain upon the earth! Asterius and I are brothers here in death as we were enemies in life. Not that you could ever understand fraternal bonds as strong as ours!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 地狱之子！你想逃离这里去到凡界。但是只要我还有一口气，你就别痴心妄想了！在这壮阔的至福乐土里，永远不行！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那我现在除了让你闭嘴别无他法了。还包括你那个牛头人男仆。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 弥诺陶是我的好朋友！而你只不过是这大地上的一个污点！阿斯忒里俄斯在这里与我是兄弟，而生前，我们是敌人。这是你永远都无法理解的坚固情谊！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Ah-hah, the fiend comes crawling back once more, drawn as he is much like the unassuming moth unto the flame of righteousness!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh no! Not the flame of righteousness! Are you finished? Let's get this started, I've come a long way.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Hear that, Asterius? Our fiendish visitor is begging us for mercy. Begging us, no doubt, to drop our guard!! Together now, my friend, let's vanquish him, and may the glory of Olympus guide us!!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 啊哈，这恶魔又一瘸一拐地来了，如同飞蛾扑火一般，一声不响跃进正义的火焰中。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦不！不是正义的火焰！说完没有？直接开始吧，我可是走了好长时间呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 听见没有，阿斯忒里俄斯？我们的恶魔客人正在求饶呢。这种行为，毫无疑问，是想让我们松懈！！一起上，我的朋友，消灭他，愿奥林匹斯的荣耀指引我们！！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: And where do you think you're going, fiend?! Thought you might scoot right past Asterius and myself without a fight?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No, on quite the contrary I've been under no impression that avoiding conflict is an option here. So say your piece, and let's get on with it.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: You, hellspawn, shall not traverse that gate behind me whilst my compatriot and I equivalently live and breathe! Prepare for death!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你还想去哪儿，恶魔？！你觉得自己能直接从我和阿斯忒里俄斯眼皮子底下溜走吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不，完全没有，我觉得避免战斗是不可能的。真实诚，那来战斗吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你，地狱之子，只要我和我的同胞还有一口气在，你就休想通过我身后的这道门！准备受死吧！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Ah, hahaha, you are just in time, Fiend from Lowest Depths! Asterius and I have trained extensively since our last skirmish here!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So all you do here in Elysium is train for martial competition? You're constantly awaiting your next fight to the death?

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: And who are you to judge, you misbegotten, shameful, unfilial maggot? It is an honor to have the opportunity to spend my afterlife perpetually standing in your ruinous path!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 啊哈哈哈，你来得正好，冥界深渊的恶魔！自从上次战斗之后，阿斯忒里俄斯和我进行了大量的训练！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 所以你在至福乐土的工作就是训练打架？一直准备着下一次的生死搏斗？

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你有什么资格说这样的话，你这无耻又不孝的丑恶蛆虫。能在死后世界里永远挡在你前进的道路上是我的荣耀！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: See here, Asterius! The god-hated fiend is back once more to be destroyed by our joint, righteous fury!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: God-hated? You'll have to be more specific. I have the gods on my side. Though I suppose you do, too. Why can't they make up their minds?

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: They have made up their minds! They stand united against darkness, as do I! With the exception of Asterius, here, who serves the light! Let's serve it now, my friend! To battle!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 看到没有，阿斯忒里俄斯！这众神记恨的恶魔又来讨我们的打了，正义狂怒！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 众神记恨？你能说得再仔细点吗。众神可都站在我这边。不过我想你也跟我一样。为什么他们就不能专一些呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 他们已经非常专一了！他们跟我一样，协力对抗黑暗！阿斯忒里俄斯则不一样，他为光明而战！开始吧，我的朋友！战斗！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Upon my word, the fiend again darkens these halls! Alas, Asterius, it seems I was mistaken and he hasn't learned his lesson after all!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: And what's this lesson that I ought have learned? Is it to always slay you first since you're so damn insufferable all the time?

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Your lesson, monster, is to never, ever take up arms against those favored by the gods themselves! You shall never see the light of day as I once did! Uh, no offense, Asterius.

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 不得不说，恶魔又亵渎了这大厅！可惜，阿斯忒里俄斯，看样子我错了，他还是什么都没有学到！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那你倒是说说我有什么可学的？第一个要杀的永远是你这个屁话连天的东西？

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 怪物，你要学的，就是永远不要跟受神保佑的人作对！你永远不可能像我曾经一样重见天日！呃，不是说你，阿斯忒里俄斯。

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Well, hellspawn, you stained my honor last we battled here. But as you plainly see, I have returned! As has Asterius! And we've no shortage of honor left to spare!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Shouldn't I be the Champion of Elysium, now that I've beaten you? Isn't there someone else around to challenge me, say, Heracles? Someone less chatty?

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Ah, hahaha, very clever, fiend. Invoking Heracles' name, in an attempt to drive me to a jealous rage. It shall not work! But you shall dearly pay nevertheless!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 地狱之子，上一次的战斗，你玷污了我的荣誉。但正如你所看到的，我又回来了！阿斯忒里俄斯也一样！我们有的是荣誉！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 既然我打败过你，那我应该是极乐世界最强了吧？难道不是有其他人要来挑战我吗，比如说赫拉克勒斯？话少的人？

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 啊哈哈哈，挺机灵的，你这恶魔。说出赫拉克勒斯的名字，企图让我因妒生恨。没用的！但是你依然要为此付出沉重代价！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: The monster has returned, in a vainglorious attempt to wrest the title Champion from me!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I couldn't care less about your title. Though, shouldn't you share it with the Minotaur? He's more than half the reason you've been any trouble.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: You'll not drive a wedge between us, fiend. Asterius and I share a fraternal bond forged from the strongest bronze! Nay, adamant! But you have caused us both offense, so, die!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 怪物又回来了，企图从我手上夺走最强的头衔！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好像谁在意你这破头衔似的。你不是应该跟弥诺陶分享这个头衔吗？你遇到的麻烦跟他可都脱不了干系。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 少在这里挑拨离间，恶魔。阿斯忒里俄斯与我的情谊铸自最坚固的青铜！坚定不移！你惹到了我们两个，去死吧！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: I have recovered, as you can plainly see, monster! As has Asterius! And this time we are filled with renewed vigor, to destroy you utterly!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So we're locked in an endless cycle of violence, basically. I guess that's one way for you to pass the time here in this stodgy place.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: You take that back about Elysium! Or, better: I shall make you eat those careless, inappropriate remarks! Come, Asterius, to war!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 我又复原了，正如你看到的，你这怪物！阿斯忒里俄斯也一样！这次我们充满了全新的力量，要把你给毁灭！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 所以我们是被困在了这个暴力循环中。我想这就是你在这个枯燥无味的地方消磨时间的方式吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 不准你这样说至福乐土！我要让你把你说的这些话全部吞回去！来，阿斯忒里俄斯，战斗了！

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: We're well-equipped to deal with you, short one. Though I know better than to disregard your might.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Speak for yourself, Asterius! I, for one, know only pure contempt for this foul daemon and his underhanded fighting style! A style we shall easily dismantle, now!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我们的装备精良，对付你绰绰有余，小矮个。不过，我也知道，你的实力不容小觑。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你的话只代表你自己，阿斯忒里俄斯！我呢，打心眼里瞧不起这个卑鄙的坏蛋和他卑劣的勾当！而我们现在可以轻松克制他！

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: We're well-equipped to deal with you, short one. Though I know better than to disregard your might.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Speak for yourself, Asterius! I, for one, know only pure contempt for this foul daemon and his underhanded fighting style! A style we shall easily dismantle, now!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我们的装备精良，对付你绰绰有余，小矮个。不过，我也知道，你的实力不容小觑。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你的话只代表你自己，阿斯忒里俄斯！我呢，打心眼里瞧不起这个卑鄙的坏蛋和他卑劣的勾当！而我们现在可以轻松克制他！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: What hope have you, monster, versus the blessed bonds of brotherhood?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Best not belittle him, king. He is more powerful than he appears. We must remain alert, this time.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Oh, I am perfectly alert right now, Asterius! And were I still alive, I would be positively salivating at the thought of running through this pustule with my spear, or whichever means I had available! Now, let's go!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 怪物，面对我们受庇佑的兄弟情，你毫无胜算。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 最好不要小看他，国王。他的实力比他的外表要强大得多。我们这次必须保持警惕。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，我现在就处于全面戒备状态，阿斯忒里俄斯！而且只要我还活着，我做梦都想用我的矛挑破这个讨厌的脓包，不管用什么方式都在所不惜！现在，我们开始吧！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: What hope have you, monster, versus the blessed bonds of brotherhood?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Best not belittle him, king. He is more powerful than he appears. We must remain alert, this time.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Oh, I am perfectly alert right now, Asterius! And were I still alive, I would be positively salivating at the thought of running through this pustule with my spear, or whichever means I had available! Now, let's go!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 怪物，面对我们受庇佑的兄弟情，你毫无胜算。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 最好不要小看他，国王。他的实力比他的外表要强大得多。我们这次必须保持警惕。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，我现在就处于全面戒备状态，阿斯忒里俄斯！而且只要我还活着，我做梦都想用我的矛挑破这个讨厌的脓包，不管用什么方式都在所不惜！现在，我们开始吧！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Theseus, before you flap your ghostly gums at me again, I'd like to hear from good Asterius this time! He almost never gets a word in, thanks to you.

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: The king speaks for the both of us, short one. Though if you wish to hear me say something to you, I will oblige.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: And I, too, shall oblige! That is, oblige my trusty spear, which yearns to penetrate your soft and vulnerable, altogether pallid flesh! Now, die!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 忒修斯，我知道你狗嘴里吐不出象牙，这次我想听听阿斯忒里俄斯的意见！你说的太多，他几乎插不上话。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 国王的意思就是我们俩的意思，小矮个。但如果你想听我说，我很乐意表达自己的看法。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 还有我，我也是！也就是，服从我这支趁手的长矛，它渴望着刺穿你那柔软无力，而又苍白的血肉！现在，受死吧！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Why, look, Asterius, the fiend returns! The rumors that he fled to haunt the surface must have been mere lies!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well no, in this case, those rumors must have been quite accurate, it's just, I'm back! Realized I didn't want a future for myself that didn't include crushing you repeatedly like this.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Oh, hoho, such clever excuse-making from one so versed in treachery! Well, if you are indeed contained within this realm, then we shall be delighted to make sure it always stays that way! Now come and fight!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 哎哟，快看啊，阿斯忒里俄斯，那个恶魔回来了！有人说他去地上世界肆虐了，看来这不过是谣言而已！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 老实说，不是，这些传言说得一点都没错，只不过我又回来了！我只是意识到，我可不希望以后没办法再一次一次把你碾死，就像这样。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，呵呵，对你这个刁滑奸诈的家伙来说，这个借口找得还真聪明！很好，如果你还呆在冥界的话，那我们很乐于让你一辈子都走不出这里！来吧，和我战斗吧！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Have you yet heard, monster?! The Queen Persephone is back! To rule the Underworld in all her terrifying grace! Perhaps one of these days or nights she shall be present in the stands, to witness your destruction at our hands!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Yeah, about that? She's my mother. So maybe watch your fool mouth with me, or else I might just put in a bad word!

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Oh, you disgust me, daemon, that you would even dare to say such things about the Queen! Prepare now to be vanquished in her name!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你听说了吗，怪物？！冥后珀尔塞福涅回来了！她要以她恐怖的手腕来统治冥界了！说不定哪天，她也会出现在看台上，亲眼看着你被我们大卸八块！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是吗，真的吗？她可是我的母亲。所以你说话小心点，否则我只要说你几句坏话，你恐怕就要凉了！

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，你可真让我恶心，恶魔，你竟敢对我们的冥后口出如此污秽之语！给我准备好，我们要以她的名义消灭你！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: What's this, Asterius? This blackguard thinks that he can saunter in here whilst bleeding profusely, and confront the two of us?! A hollow fool!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Ran into trouble on the way with your combative friends here in Elysium. One more unfair advantage in your favor.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: How would you know of fairness, fiend? You belong in the lowest depths, forgotten in the mists of time! Come, let us send you there!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 看啊，阿斯忒里俄斯。这个坏东西，流了这样多的血，竟然还敢走进来，与我们对峙？！蠢到没边了！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我来的路上跟你那些好战的至福乐土朋友起了些争执。你又掌握了一个不公平的优势。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你懂个屁的公平，恶魔？你属于冥界深渊，你应在时间迷雾中被遗忘！来吧，让我们送你一程！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Look at this contemptible fiend, stumbling half-dead already into our hallowed colosseum! What transpired, monster, did perchance my Exalted brethren trouble your dark path?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Theseus? I would appreciate it if you could be more considerate of the substantial effort necessary just to reach this point where I can make you shut your mouth.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Effort, pah! You shall be imminently slain, and effortlessly, I am quite certain of that! Asterius, to arms!!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 看看这个令人鄙视的恶魔，在我们神圣的竞技场跌跌撞撞，半死不活！怎么了，恶魔，让我身怀高级技能的弟兄们偶然撞破了你的卑劣行径？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 忒修斯，如果你能体谅我们这么努力地想让你闭嘴，我会对你充满感激。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 努力，呸！你马上就性命不保了，我非常肯定，不费吹灰之力就可以送你上西天！阿斯忒里俄斯，拿起武器！！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: What hope can you possibly have of vanquishing us, hellspawn, when you are visibly upon the verge of death? You are, more than usual, a miserable sight!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Thanks for your concern, there, Theseus. But I trust I have plenty of life left in me with which to destroy you, if not your companion as well.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Hah! What would you know of trust! Being a vile, grievously-wounded-already creature such as you are! Asterius, let's end his misery!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你怎么还痴心妄想地想要打败我们，地狱之子，你自己马上就要一命呜呼了？你现在看起来显得更可怜！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 谢谢你的关心，忒修斯。但我相信自己还有足够的力量打败你，至于你的同伴就不好说了。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 哈！你哪里来的自信！本来就这么卑鄙，更何况现在还遍体鳞伤！阿斯忒里俄斯，我们帮他结束痛苦吧！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: What's this? Our enemy has come to mock us, Asterius! He holds the Yarn of Ariadne, and would flaunt it in our faces!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, this? I just picked it out of a Well. Was supposed to help me get here. No offense intended, more than usual. What's it to you?

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: As if you wouldn't know! That Yarn is a token of days long gone. When Asterius and I battled in the Labyrinth, to the death! Together, we now face a greater threat. Attack us if you dare!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 不是吧？我们的敌人竟然嘲笑我们，阿斯忒里俄斯！他拿着的是阿里阿德涅的纱线，还在我们面前炫耀！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你说这个？是在一口井外找到的。一路上帮了我不少忙。若有得罪，还请谅解。跟你有什么关系？

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 好像你不知道一样！那纱线是非常古老的东西。那时候我还在迷宫中，跟阿斯忒里俄斯进行着殊死搏斗！现在，我们遇到了更大的威胁。有胆就攻过来吧！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Again you mock me with the Yarn of Ariadne, blackguard. You ought know that woman's name means absolutely nothing to me, now!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You seem pretty put off by a random bit of twine, there, Former King of Athens. Care to share your innermost thoughts on the subject, or best keep them bottled up?

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Nothing shall be bottled here, you filth! That she became enamored of me was not my responsibility, besides! She was naive! The same as you.

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你又用阿里阿德涅的纱线来奚落我，无赖。你应该知道，那个女人的名字现在对我来说毫无意义！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 看起来几根线就缚住了你的手脚，雅典的老国王。要和我们分享你对这件事最真实的想法吗，还是将它将它憋在心里？

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 我根本没在压抑什么，你这个肮脏的东西！再说，是她后来对我神魂颠倒，这不是我的错！只是她太天真了！跟你一样。

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: That blasted Yarn of Ariadne, once again!! Have you no shred of dignity at all, monster? Or would you stoop to any desperate means to draw me out?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Just happened to have it on me, Theseus. But it seems to keep upsetting you. Maybe you should seek this Ariadne in my father's realm, and make amends?

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Maybe you should shut up!! That Ariadne's dead to me. She has been since we were alive! I cherish her memory, yes. But only because, if not for her, I'd not have met Asterius! Now, meet his axe!!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 又是该死的阿里阿德涅的纱线！！难道你连一点尊严都没有吗，恶魔？还是你打算用这种下作手段让我放松警惕？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我只是碰巧拿到它了，忒修斯。但它好像还是会让你心烦意乱。或许你应该到我父亲的领地里找找这位阿里阿德涅，做点补偿？

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 或许你应该闭嘴！！对我来说，阿里阿德涅已经死了。我们还活着的时候她就死了！是的，我很珍惜对她的回忆。但只是因为，如果不是她，我就不会认识阿斯忒里俄斯！现在，来见识一下他的斧头的威力吧！！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Why, look, Asterius! It seems the fiend has brought some sort of nondescript yarn-ball! Not seen the likes of it. Indeed, it holds no sway on me, at all!

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: King. The princess Ariadne was my sister, if you don't recall. Please do not denigrate her memory. <Snort> You're making me upset.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Ah, no, my friend! I meant you no offense! But I'd no love for her, was that my fault?! Pff, forgive me. I... I shall seek her out. Someday or night. But first!! This daemon has to be destroyed. Together, no?!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 看呐，阿斯忒里俄斯！那个恶魔好像带来一个奇奇怪怪的纱球！并不那么起眼。是的，它完全不会影响到我！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 国王。你可能不记得了，阿里阿德涅公主是我的妹妹。请不要玷污她的形象。<鼻息声>你把我惹毛了。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，不，我的朋友！我无意冒犯你！但我不爱她，这是我的错吗？！啧，原谅我。我……我要找到她。迟早有一天。但首先！！必须铲除这个恶魔。要一起来吗？！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Why, look, Asterius! It seems the fiend has brought some sort of nondescript yarn-ball! Not seen the likes of it. Indeed, it holds no sway on me, at all!

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: King. The princess Ariadne was my sister, if you don't recall. Please do not denigrate her memory. <Snort> You're making me upset.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Ah, no, my friend! I meant you no offense! But I'd no love for her, was that my fault?! Pff, forgive me. I... I shall seek her out. Someday or night. But first!! This daemon has to be destroyed. Together, no?!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 看呐，阿斯忒里俄斯！那个恶魔好像带来一个奇奇怪怪的纱球！并不那么起眼。是的，它完全不会影响到我！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 国王。你可能不记得了，阿里阿德涅公主是我的妹妹。请不要玷污她的形象。<鼻息声>你把我惹毛了。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，不，我的朋友！我无意冒犯你！但我不爱她，这是我的错吗？！啧，原谅我。我……我要找到她。迟早有一天。但首先！！必须铲除这个恶魔。要一起来吗？！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Now hold a moment, fiend! Asterius made me aware that you recently asked of him an autograph. A tribute to his fame! As I am Champion, I am prepared to generously offer mine, as well.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh! No thanks. Appreciate the offer, though. How about a fight, instead?

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Ah, pffsch, you...! 'Twas merely a jest! I'd not have given you the cloth about my loins, much less my name! But a fight you certainly shall have!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 先等一下，恶魔！阿斯忒里俄斯提醒我了，你最近向他要过签名。向他的名声表达敬意！作为最强战士，我也可以大方地给你我的签名。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢！不了，谢谢。不过还是要谢谢你对我这么大方。要不来打一场？

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，啧，我说你……！只是开个玩笑！我连腰布都不会给你，更别说签名了！但要打一场的话，绝对没问题！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Ready yourself, Asterius, my friend! For our most hated enemy has come to challenge us again, before this loving crowd!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I don't understand this place at all. How is it you're still champion after all this time? After losing repeatedly and often, I mean.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: What would you know of it?! There's more, much more, to being champion than empty victories! It is a way of thought. A bearing! A certain dignity which you shall never have!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 做好准备，阿斯忒里俄斯，我的朋友！我们最痛恨的敌人又出现了，要在这群可爱的观众面前挑战我们！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我真搞不清楚这个地方是怎么回事，你怎么还能是这里的最强战士呢？我是说，我明明都吊打过你这么多次了。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你又知道什么？！成为最强战士，需要的可不仅仅是空洞的胜利，而是更多更多东西！这是一种思考的方式，一种人生态度！一种你永远都无法理解的尊严！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: The gods are testing us once more, Asterius! For, how else to explain this fiend approaching us, bearing such blessings as would normally be fit only for heroes such as we?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You do know I'm related to them, right? The god of the dead is my father? I'm sure word's gotten around. Not that I want deferential treatment from the likes of you.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Good! For you'll get nothing of the sort. The gods are on my side, not yours, monster! What business would they have, abetting you?

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 一定是众神又在考验我们了，阿斯忒里俄斯！否则，我们面前的这个恶魔，身上却带着通常只有像我们这样的英雄才能得到的祝福，这又该怎么解释呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道我和那些神有血缘关系，是吧？你也知道冥王是我父亲吧？我很确定这些消息早就传开了。不过，我这么说，可不是为了能得到你这种人的优待。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 那就好！别以为我会给你什么优待。众神是站在我这边的，他们才不是你的盟友，怪物！他们在打算什么呢？煽动你过来吗？

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Beware, Asterius! The daemon comes! The daemon, who would sever the fraternal bonds we share, if we so much as drop our guard!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What? You think I'm here to ruin your friendship? Look, to each his own in that regard, though since you bring it up, I really don't see why Asterius puts up with you.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: You see? Just as I said! Cover your bovine ears, Asterius, for this monstrosity would poison us to get the upper hand!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 当心了，阿斯忒里俄斯！那个恶魔来了！千万不能掉以轻心，否则他就会毁了我们之间的兄弟情谊！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你想什么呢？你以为我是为了毁了你们的友情，才会来这里的吗？听着，我明白每个人都有自己的择友标准，但既然你把话挑明了，我也就实话实说了。我真不明白阿斯忒里俄斯到底是看上你哪里了。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你看吧？我早就说过了！快捂住你的耳朵，阿斯忒里俄斯，这只怪物打算靠挑拨我们的关系来占得上风！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: You know, hellspawn, I have been thinking on this for some time, and I've a declaration I must make: I shall hear no more of your silver-tongued lies. You come here, and we fight, and that is all!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What are you even talking about? I barely get a word in edgewise, much less Asterius over there. You know what? Fine. I've had it with you, anyway.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: And I've had it with you! Now, come, Asterius, let's shut this blackguard up! Or shut him down, whichever you prefer.

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 听着，地狱之子，这件事我已经考虑好久了，这句话我必须得跟你说：我再也不会听信你的谎言了。你什么时候来这里，我们只打架，不干别的！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你到底在说什么傻话呢？我根本不知道你在说什么，阿斯忒里俄斯就更听不懂了。不过算了，你爱怎么样就怎么样吧，反正我也已经受够你了。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 我也受够你了！好了，阿斯忒里俄斯，咱们让这个无赖赶紧闭嘴吧！或者让他永远都开不了口，看你喜欢哪个吧。

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: There is but one thing I shall give to you, blackguard. Other than the razor-sharp point of my blessed spear! You are resilient. Time after time, you challenge us! Sometimes I fear I shall develop some sort of grudging respect for you!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I've no such fear, myself, Theseus. Though, I appreciate you noticing. You're quite an inspiration, you know? I wouldn't come all this way to destroy just anyone.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: To be destroyed, you mean! I see you plain, monster. You seek the glory of this fight, before this crowd? You yearn for it! Then, you shall have it! Just as often as you please!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 除了让你尝尝我锐利的长矛，我还有另一件事要告诉你，无赖！你确实很有毅力，一次一次地挑战我们！有时候我甚至会担心，我会不会因此而不得不尊重你！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我从来都没担心过这种事情，忒修斯，不过，很高兴你能注意到这一点。说真的，你其实是个很能鼓舞人心的家伙。我大老远地来到这里，可不是为了吊打某个无名小卒。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 我看你是被吊打吧！我已经明白了，怪物，你想要在这么多人的面前夺得胜利的荣耀吗？你渴望荣耀吧！那就来赢得它吧！你想打得多少次，就打多少次吧！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: I vividly recall our every clash against you, daemon. Each victory! And even the defeats. But you? You've not learned anything, have you?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's all right, Theseus. We have a splendid painting of you back at the House, for those moments when I invariably forget you exist. You were quite dashing with long hair, you know!

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: So, I am honored even in the lowest pits of hell? And yet, remembered in my carefree youth. Not in the wisdom of my latter days! Well then, remember this!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 每一次和你交手的记忆，每一场胜利，我都能清楚地回想起来！那些失败也历历在目。可你呢？你一点长进都没有，对不对？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 别介意这个，忒修斯。我们在圣殿里挂了一副你的肖像画，万一我忘了你长什么样，看一眼就能想起来了。不过说真的，你留长发的样子还真是挺时髦的！

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 所以就算是在地狱的深处，我也能得到尊敬吗？不过，他们记住的却是我无忧无虑的青年时代，而不是我富于智慧的成年！好吧，那你就记住这个吧！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: What, ho, that is a handsome spear you doubtless claimed deceitfully from some more-worthy bearer than yourself!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, this old thing? How nice of you to notice. It once belonged to the hero, Achilles. A little past your time, but maybe you've heard of him? Seeing as he's much more famous than you ever were.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: How dare you say such things to me! I was the greatest king of Athens in my day! The tales of my exploits with Asterius and many other challenges shall long outlive whatever comes of you!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 什么，嚯，你手上那把帅气的长矛肯定是你从别人手里骗来的吧，你根本配不上它！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，你说的是这件老古董吗？很高兴你注意到了。它曾经属于英雄阿喀琉斯。和你不是一个时代的，不过你可能听说过，对吧？他好像比你出名多了。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你竟然敢跟我说这种话！我是当时雅典最伟大的国王！即使你被历史的长河淹没，我和阿斯忒里俄斯的丰功伟绩还有很多我们克服过的其他挑战还是会被世人传颂！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Tell me something, monster: Whence did you steal that kingly blade you're brandishing about? It seems ill-fitting for one such as you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, this? I wouldn't say I stole it, so much as naturally wooed the Fates into bestowing it upon me. You could say I'm kind of testing it out.

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Ahh, well then! I pity whosoever shall lay hands upon that cursed thing, once you are finished with this testing of yours. I think that we can make it rather quick!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 和我说实话吧，怪物：你手里那边充满王者风度的利刃是从哪里偷来的？那把武器和你的气质一点都不搭。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，这个吗？我可不觉得这是偷来的，更像是命运女神把它赐给我的。我算是在试试它到底有多厉害吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，好吧！等你测试完之后，不知道会是谁拿着这把被诅咒的玩意儿，我真为他感到难过。我觉得我们可以废话少说，赶紧开战了！

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: There, king! He has the weapons I told you about... the fists of Gilgamesh. Follow my lead this time.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 快看，国王！他手上的就是我和你说过的那件武器……吉尔伽美什之拳，这次我来引导战局吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: There, king! He has the weapons I told you about... the fists of Gilgamesh. Follow my lead this time.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 快看，国王！他手上的就是我和你说过的那件武器……吉尔伽美什之拳，这次我来引导战局吧。

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Prepare to be sent back into the depths whence you came!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 准备回到冥界深渊中去吧！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Ahh, at last! Come, Asterius, let's vanquish this blackguard!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，终于！来，阿斯忒里俄斯，咱们干掉这个坏东西！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Come, hellspawn, and get destroyed by the two greatest fighters in Elysium!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 来，地狱之子，让至福乐土里最强大的两位战士毁灭你吧！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Dare you clash against the Champion of Elysium and his most trusted friend?

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你敢跟至福乐土的最强战士和他最信任的朋友作对？

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: If you seek a swift and righteous death, you fiend, you've come to the right place!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 如果你寻求的是迅速的正义裁决，恶魔，你找对地方了！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Come forth and die, preferably with some amount of dignity!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 前来受死吧，能带点尊严那最好不过了！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: It's time, Asterius! Let us assert our greatness through single-minded combat!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 是时候了，阿斯忒里俄斯！通过这专心的战斗来证明我们的强大！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: By the gods of Olympus, you'll go no further on your wicked quest!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 以奥林匹斯众神的名义，你不准再在邪恶征途里前进一步！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: There is no greater pleasure in Elysium than vanquishing the likes of you!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 至福乐土里再没有比击溃你更美好的事情了！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: I swear upon my honor, fiend, you shall not pass!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 我以我的荣誉发誓，恶魔，你不得通过！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: No matter how you try, you cannot shake the bond we share, monster!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 哪怕你再巧舌如簧，你都撼动不了我们之间牢不可破的情谊，怪物！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: You stop right there, blackguard, and make your plans for death!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 给我站住，坏东西，做好死的觉悟吧！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: We've nothing left to say to one another, hellspawn! Other than: To battle!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 我们之间没什么好说的了，地狱之子！唯有：战斗！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Few others in Elysium are so unwise to take up arms against Asterius and myself!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 至福乐土里只有少数人胆敢对抗我和阿斯忒里俄斯！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: You challenge us to battle, hellspawn?! Then, Asterius and I accept!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你是在挑战我们吗，地狱之子？！那么，阿斯忒里俄斯和我接受挑战！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Attack us if you dare, blackguard! Asterius and I stand ready!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 有胆就攻过来吧，坏东西！阿斯忒里俄斯和我准备好了！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: I see my brethren failed to thwart your advance. Well, you shall go no further!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 看来我的弟兄们没能阻止你的前进。在这里你别想再继续前进了！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Come forth, blackguard, and be vanquished by my righteous spear!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 上前来，坏东西，接受我正义之矛的制裁吧！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Asterius and I shall smite you back into the lowest depths of hell!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 阿斯忒里俄斯和我要将你打回冥界深渊！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: You are beneath the notice of the gods, monster! Whilst I have earned their favor!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 众神不会正眼看你的，你这怪物！因为我得到了他们的庇佑！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: You return at your peril, hellspawn. You'll get no quarter here!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你又把自己置于危险之中了，地狱之子。不会对你仁慈的！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Upon my faith, you'll take not one more step toward the light of day!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 我保证，你休想跨过这里见天日！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Face us, filth! However many times it takes, until you cannot stand it any longer!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 来面对我们吧，污秽之物！随便你怎么挑战我们吧，直到你再也受不了为止！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Behold, Asterius! Our hated enemy has come to be dispatched before a loving crowd, once more!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 注意了，阿斯忒里俄斯！我们不共戴天的敌人，要再一次在可爱的观众面前被碾碎了！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Try as you might, monster, you shall not shake either my own resolve, or that of my dear friend!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 怪物，随便你怎么努力，你都动摇不了我的决心，也动摇不了我朋友的决心！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Our foolhardy challenger approaches once again, I see! Well, then, prepare to be run through!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 看得出来，我们死脑筋的挑战者又出现了！很好，那就等着被战车碾过去吧！

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You face the Champion, and me. Ready yourself.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你的敌人是最强战士，还有我。准备好。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You face the Champion, and me. Ready yourself.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你的敌人是最强战士，还有我。准备好。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Let us destroy him quickly, king. Or, perhaps slowly.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 快点毁灭他吧，我的王。慢慢折磨他也行。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Let us destroy him quickly, king. Or, perhaps slowly.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 快点毁灭他吧，我的王。慢慢折磨他也行。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Waste not more words with this one, king. Let's fight.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 别跟这人空费口舌，我的王。开始战斗。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Waste not more words with this one, king. Let's fight.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 别跟这人空费口舌，我的王。开始战斗。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: It is as the king said. You will not leave Elysium except through us.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 正如国王所说。除非打败我们，否则你无法离开至福乐土。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: It is as the king said. You will not leave Elysium except through us.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 正如国王所说。除非打败我们，否则你无法离开至福乐土。

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Look who has managed to come crawling back, Asterius? Let us deliver him again!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 阿斯忒里俄斯，看看谁回来了？我们再把他送回去吧！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: Try as you might, monster, Asterius and I shall stop you!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你尽管来，怪物，阿斯忒里俄斯和我会阻止你的！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: You must take sick, appalling pleasure in defeat, hellspawn!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你一定对战败有一种病态的喜好，地狱之子！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: I shall never yield the title Champion of Elysium to the likes of you!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 我永远不会把至福乐土最强战士的头衔让给你这种东西！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: You think that you can get through me again, hellspawn? Come try!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 你觉得自己还能再打败我吗，地狱之子？来试试吧！

en.speaker: Theseus
en.text: I always shall rise up to thwart your wicked plans, monster!

zh-CN.speaker: 忒修斯
zh-CN.text: 我会一直在这里粉碎你邪恶的计划，怪物！

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Observe this gleaming coat of bronze with which I am adorned, now, short one. <Snort> Your doing, as I'm to understand.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: My father is to thank for that, not me. I've proven difficult for him to contain, so now I'm beneficiary of his latest Pact of Punishment. You're welcome!

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I hadn't thanked you, as of yet. Though, come. I'll repay you suitably for having me encased within this... suit.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 快来看我身上这层闪闪发光的装饰性铜镀层，小矮个。<鼻息声>据我所知，这是你的杰作。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是我的父亲，不是我。对他来说，我是个不好管理的孩子，所以现在，我成了他最新的惩罚契约的受益者。不要客气！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 到现在为止，我没有谢过你呢。不过，来吧。我要报答你，把我困在这身……护甲里。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Tell me, short one, where is your own armored suit? I would prefer not to do battle against one who's ill equipped.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know, my father keeps the dress code very strict down there in Tartarus. No armor in the House! Never tried the stuff.

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Dress code. <Snort> I, too, follow a code. And it's a code that strictly states I cannot let you pass without a fight.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 告诉我，小矮个，你自己的护甲在哪里？装备如此粗制滥造的家伙根本不配和我战斗。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你也知道，我的父亲在塔耳塔罗斯执行着一套非常严格的着装要求。在圣殿里不许穿护甲！这东西，永远都没想过。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 着装要求。<鼻息声>我也有自己的一套规矩。那就是，不经过一场战斗，严禁任何人通行。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Even with this armor I was unable to best you one-to-one. Perhaps I lack as yet the necessary training to take full advantage of its benefit.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I don't suppose you have some good acquaintances with whom to train, until such time as you see fit to face me once again?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: No. <Snort> King Theseus is occupied with preparations of his own. You are my good acquaintance now.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 即使有这身护甲，我还是没办法和你独自对决。或许我的功夫还不到家，不能发挥出它的全部潜能。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我觉得，我们再见面之前，你找不到合适的熟人来训练你？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 是的。<鼻息声>忒修斯国王自己也忙着训练呢。你现在也是我的熟人呀。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I am returned once more to my more-earthly capability, short one. And I am able to move freely once again.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Fine change of pace, Asterius! Who needs that old, spectacular, custom-fitting suit of legendary armor, anyway?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You mock me. Yet you know nothing of being trapped; enclosed in something and unable to break free. I need no armor to fight you.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我在尘世间的能力恢复了，小矮个。我又可以自由走动了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 真是不错的改变，阿斯忒里俄斯！谁会需要那身老旧，但却很华丽合身的传奇护甲呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你在奚落我。你根本就不知道被困在其中，浑身不自在是什么样的感受。我不需要护甲，也能和你打一场。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You haven't spoken to your fist-weapons yet, have you, short one? 'I see you overcome the wild and make peace with death.' That's what you're supposed to tell them. I'm sure of it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Just been a little tied up lately is all, but I will get to it, Asterius! I guess you'll want to know the result?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Yes. Here, I'll give you this chance to get home quickly, if you want to know, yourself.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你还没和你那对拳套说出那句话吧，小矮个？“我见到你征服了荒野，与死亡谈笑风生。”你应该对它说这句话，我非常确定。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我只是最近有点忙而已，不过我会和它说的，阿斯忒里俄斯！我猜你也很好奇结果吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊。如果你也很好奇的话，我就给你个机会，让你赶紧回家去吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: There, on your hands... the weapons you call Malphon. They're just as I saw in my dream. Monstrous. Like me.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Former property of someone called Gilgamesh. The beast-man he fought, Enkidu... you said they became friends? What said your dream about us on that front, sir?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: It didn't say much. Only that we would fight. Just as that Gilgamesh and Enkidu once did. Maybe the outcome will be the same, maybe it won't. We'll find out.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你的手上……就是你称之为玛尔封的武器，和我在梦中看到的一模一样。看起来很恐怖，就像我一样。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这对拳套曾经的主人叫吉尔伽美什，而他打败的那只兽人叫恩奇都……你说他们后来成为了朋友？你的梦里有没有说过我们以后的关系会怎么样，先生？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 没怎么说，只说了我们会互相厮杀，就像吉尔伽美什和恩奇都那样。或许我们会变得和那两人一样，或许不会，来亲眼看看吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You come from the bowels of hell. This is not your place.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Agreed on both counts! Just passing through, so if you'll excuse me...

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I will not. <Snort> The Champion of Elysium would never back down from such a contest. Neither will I.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, you're not the Champion of Elysium...? You're the Bull of Minos! I can't imagine who's even stronger than you. Is it Heracles? Tell me it's Heracles.

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I will not. <Snort> You talk too much, short one. Come get destroyed.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你来自地狱的深渊。你不属于这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我们双方都同意这一观点！我只是路过，如果可以的话我想……

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 不准通过。<鼻息声>至福乐土最强战士不会因为这样的竞赛就退却。我也不会。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等下，至福乐土最强战士怎么不是你……？你是米诺斯公牛！还有谁能壮得过你啊？赫拉克勒斯？肯定是赫拉克勒斯。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我不会的。<鼻息声>你该收声了，小矮个。接受毁灭吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You come from the bowels of hell. This is not your place.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Agreed on both counts! Just passing through, so if you'll excuse me...

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I will not. <Snort> The Champion of Elysium would never back down from such a contest. Neither will I.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你来自地狱的深渊。你不属于这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我们双方都同意这一观点！我只是路过，如果可以的话我想……

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 不准通过。<鼻息声>至福乐土最强战士不会因为这样的竞赛就退却。我也不会。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You have met the Champion, the king. Let us see if you are fit to face him once again.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You mean face both of you, together. Which doesn't seem particularly fair.

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Life isn't particularly fair, short one. Nor death. I'd have expected you to know as much. But here, have your fair fight.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你已经见过最强战士了，他就是我的王。让我们看看你是否有资格与他再战。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你意思是你俩一起打我一个。这样真的不是很公平。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 生命就是如此不公，小矮个。死亡也一样。我指望你明白这个道理。不过现在你可以公平战斗。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Let us clash here again before you face the Champion. We never will allow you through without a fight.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're nothing like Theseus. Why go along with everything he says and does? You're your own man. And bull.

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: King Theseus slew me in life, and saved me in death. I was cast into Erebus. A monster. He found me when he died. And used his influence to bring me here, with him.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That's nice of him and all, but sounds like you're even to me. Seeing as he killed you in the first place.

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: No; we're not. And I will fight for him, and alongside him, for eternity. As recompense for helping me to understand exactly who I am.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 在你面对最强战士之前，就由我来与你战斗。我们不会什么都不做就放你走。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你和忒修斯完全不是一路人。你干嘛要这样一直遵从他？你是一个有思想的人。或者说牛。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 忒修斯国王生前杀死我，死后救过我。那时我作为一个怪物被打入了厄瑞玻斯。他死后找到了我。他利用自己的关系，将我和他一起带到这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那他可真是个好人啊，不过听起来咱俩差不多。毕竟是他先杀的你。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 不；我跟你不一样。他让我知道了自己的身份，为了报答他，我会永远支持他，为他而战。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You bested the Champion, himself. Which means that I have little hope of vanquishing you, here.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So then, why bother fighting me? You don't have to do this. That Theseus is a highly questionable influence on you!

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I see you plain, short one. I, too, was born of darkness. But, I chose the path of light. Even in death, it was not too late. <Snort> Not even for a monster, such as I. I trust your deaths will likewise be enlightening.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你打败了最强战士。这说明我不是很有把握可以打败你了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 既然如此，那干嘛还要跟我打？你不用老是这样说。这个忒修斯，他对你造成的影响太大了！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我明白，小矮个。我也是生自黑暗的产物。但是我选择了光明的道路。就算死了，这也不算迟。<鼻息声>不仅仅对于我这样的怪物。我相信你的死亡也能起到同样的作用。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: This heat... it reminds me of when I was young. Living in darkness. Learning to fight. To kill.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I suppose you're about to put that learning to practice in another moment here?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I am. The heat fills me with strength. Let's see if it has any effect on you.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 这种热量……让我想起我年轻的时候。我生活在黑暗之中，学习战斗，学习杀戮。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 看来你打算把学到的一切再次应用在实战中了，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，热量让我充满了力量，让我看看它对你起不起作用吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Ah. I sense another furious battle here awaits us, short one. Although you're more inquisitive than usual...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Uhh, oh! It's just, I have an odd request. You see, the god of slumber, Hypnos? Colleague of mine. Huge fan. He's in desperate need of your autograph. Little personalized message? I don't suppose you'd be so kind. It'd mean a lot to him.

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Autograph. I see. Then, it appears there are such gods as favor me. I will inscribe a bit of parchment for your colleague, then.

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The god-forsaken Minotaur impresses then upon a parchment a brief message to the god of sleep, and gives it to the favor-asking Prince.

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Know, short one, that this favor is for you and not for Hypnos. Though he may challenge me himself, at any time.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，我察觉到有另一场激烈战斗在等待着我们，小矮个。你似乎有什么想知道的事…

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，噢！我就是，有一个奇怪的问题。睡神，修普诺斯你知道吧？我的同事。他是你粉丝。他特别想要你的亲笔签名。专门写给他的话之类的。你可能不会这样轻易就给他。但是这对他来说非常重要。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 亲笔签名。我明白了。嗯，看来还是有天神青睐我的。那我就来写点东西给你的同事吧。

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 遭众神遗弃的弥诺陶在羊皮纸上为睡神写下了些简短的话，并把它交给了这位替人求情的王子。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 听好，小矮个，我做这些是因为你，而不是修普诺斯。不过他也可以随时来挑战我。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Huh. You mean to fight with me bare-handed this time, short one? I'm not ashamed to say the Champion himself defeated me in such a manner back when we drew breath.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wouldn't say the Twin Fists of Malphon counts as empty-handed, sir, though it surprises me to hear you could be beaten in such a way.

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I was hungry and unprepared. Inexperienced. No longer. Come.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 哈，你这次要空手跟我对决吗，小矮个？我记得我们都还活着的时候，最强战士本人曾空手击败过我，这件事没什么丢人的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 双子之拳玛尔封可算不上空手啊，先生。不过你居然会被人空手击败，我真挺惊讶的。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我当时饿得没力气，毫无准备，也没什么经验。不过，我现在可不一样了，放马过来吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You must take pleasure in having to fight against me, short one. I, too, have come to look forward to it. Even if I end up falling to your strength.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, I was going to say, I'd much prefer we settle this more amicably, couldn't we? Perhaps I could interest you in a fine bottle of Nectar? Ambrosia, even?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: No, thank you. These battles are enough. Besides... you won that Ambrosia from us, fair and square.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你跟我战斗的时候，一定很愉悦吧，小矮个？我也是，我很期待和你战斗，就算是输给你也无所谓。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哎呀，我刚想说我更希望我们能和睦相处呢，你觉得怎么样？不如我请你喝一杯蜜露，或者仙馔密酒？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 不了，谢谢，只要战斗就足够了。另外……那瓶仙馔密酒是你从我们这里赢过去的，堂堂正正。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Well, you're back, short one. Or Prince. Whatever they call you. I'm not much for formality.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Not much for it either, here, Asterius. Though, speaking of which, how would you prefer to be addressed? The Minotaur, the Bull of Minos? Those aren't offensive to you, are they?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: They don't mean anything to me. They mean something to others. I have my name. You know it. Use it if you want. Now, enough.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，你回来了，小矮个，或者说，王子殿下。我不知道他们是怎么叫你的，我不怎么在乎形式。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我也不怎么在乎，阿斯忒里俄斯，不过你喜欢我怎么称呼你呢？是弥诺陶，还是米诺斯的公牛？不过这两个称呼对你来说没什么区别，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 这些称呼对别人有意义，但对我来说没有任何意义。我有我自己的名字，你也知道叫什么，就用我的名字来称呼我吧。好了，不多说了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Say, you're from Crete, originally, aren't you, Asterius? I know this is a stretch, but... I don't suppose you ever heard of a commander by the name of Schelemeus? Captain of the Cretan second fleet, something like that?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: The king of Crete commanded the greatest navy in the world. Even I knew that, having never seen the light of day, the ships, the sea. Schelemeus, huh...? I might have heard the name. So what?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, Schelemeus was a real person, then? But, Skelly said... ah, you know what, it's nothing, Asterius. Shall we?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Yes. Let's.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你是从克里特岛来的，是吧，阿斯忒里俄斯？我知道这挺麻烦的，不过……你不会刚好听说过某个叫瑟勒米乌斯的指挥官吧？他是克里特岛第二舰队的船长之类的，听说过吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 那时的克里特国王拥有着世上最强大的海军，就连我这个从来没见过外界，从来没见过战船和大海的人都知道这件事情。瑟勒米乌斯，是吗……？我可能听说过这个名字，所以呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么？原来瑟勒米乌斯这个名字不是瞎编的吗？可骨头说……啊，算了，不用在意了，阿斯忒里俄斯。咱们可以动手了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 很好，动手吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You've come, short one. I dreamed of this very moment.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Come on, Asterius, we've fought how many times already? What's there to dream about?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: No. I dreamed. And in my dream, there was something I had to tell you. Rather... something you have to tell the weapons you wear on your hands. Tell them, 'I see you overcome the wild and make peace with death.'

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, I know what that is, that's a waking-phrase. So I'm to speak it to Malphon. Wait, why are you helping me?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I don't know whether I'm helping you or not. But in my dream... an ancient hero fought a beast of a man, barehanded. They became friends, in the end, after a great battle. I long for a fight like that.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你来了，小矮个，我梦到了这一刻。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不是吧，阿斯忒里俄斯，咱们都打过多少次了？这有什么好梦到的？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 不，我梦到了。在我的梦中，我有件事情要告诉你，或者说……有某件事情，你必须对你手上的这件武器说才行。你要对它说：“我见到你征服了荒野，与死亡谈笑风生。”

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，我知道你说的是什么，那是句唤醒咒语。好，那我就对玛尔封说吧。等等，你为什么要帮助我？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我也不知道这算不算是在帮助你，但在我的梦中……一位古老的英雄与一只人型怪物赤手空拳决斗，经过一场激烈的厮杀之后，他们最终成为了朋友。我也渴望像这样的战斗。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I wonder something, short one. You keep coming back. But I don't know why. You're trying to get out of here, aren't you? But something's killing you up there.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You've deduced more or less correctly, Asterius. And yes, let's say there are some challenges remaining once I get out of Elysium. Though I'd best say no more of it than that.

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: That's fine. It's good to know you've fallen just as often as I have. I may not be the one to kill you. But I'll soften you up for whoever does.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 有件事我觉得很奇怪，小矮个。你一次一次回来，但我不明白你为什么要这么做。你是想从这里逃出去，但却被什么东西杀掉了，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你已经猜得八九不离十了，阿斯忒里俄斯。没错，这么说吧，离开至福乐土之后，前方还有其它的挑战在等着我。不过具体是什么，我就不打算多说了。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧，知道你死得和我一样多，我就放心了。或许我没办法杀死你，但我可以消耗你的体力，让接下来的人把你干掉。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You ever make it out of here, short one? I wonder, sometimes, what it must be like... the outside.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You've never been outside? Oh, right... the labyrinth thing. You lived in a horrible maze all your life. I haven't seen much of the surface, but... it's beautiful. Cold. When I'm there, though, I... feel out of place.

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Out of place. I understand, I think. I don't see why you'd want to go somewhere like that. It can't live up to the stories. Why ruin it? Speaking of which...

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你有没有从这里逃出去过，小矮个？有的时候我会想，外面的世界……是什么样子。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你从来没见过外面的世界吗？哦，对了……是那个迷宫，你一辈子都生活在那座可怕的迷宫里。我也没怎么见过地上世界，不过……那里很美好，也很冷。不过，在地上世界的时候，我会……觉得不自在。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 感觉不自在，我觉得我能理解。我不明白你为什么打算去外面的世界，那里不可能像传说故事中一样美好，为什么要毁了它呢？说起这个……

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Everyone's saying that the Queen is back. Do you know what that means, short one?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, for me, at least, it happens to mean quite a bit. I'm her son!

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: It doesn't mean a thing. We're still here to fight. Though, for what it's worth... my mother also was a queen. May yours treat you better than she treated me. Better than I'm about to treat you, here.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 大家都说冥后回来了，你知道他们说的是什么吗，小矮个？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，至少对我而言意义深远，因为我是她的儿子！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 这什么意义都没有，我们还是得大战一场。不过，话虽这么说……我的母亲生前也是位皇后。希望你的母亲对你，比我的母亲对我要好，不会像我接下来这样收拾你。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I smell the blood on you, short one. <Snort> You are severely wounded. This will not be a fair fight.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: An unfair fight is not worth having, then, wouldn't you say?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I would not. An unfair fight is better than no fight at all.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你身上有血的气息，小矮个。<鼻息声>你受了很重的伤。这场战斗不会太公平。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那不公平的战斗，还有什么好打的，你说对吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 不对。这总比没得打要好。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You're hardly in a state to fight against me, here. Won't take too long to bring you death.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Great! Thanks for the encouragement, Asterius. Don't let me keep you waiting on that, then.

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: If mere words can sap your will for battle, short one, then know this: You never stood a chance.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 以你现在的状态，根本没办法和我打。你的死期很快就到了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好！谢谢你的鼓励，阿斯忒里俄斯。那么，别让我再耽搁你了。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 如果只用几句话就可以削弱你的战斗意志，小矮个，那么记住这句话：你没有任何胜算。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You look as though you withstood many foes in getting here this time. Barely withstood, that is.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: They took a lot out of me, yes. But you have no idea just how long and arduous a trip it is from Tartarus to here!

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: What would you know of arduous? Try living in an ever-shifting maze of countless passageways. Now let me finish what your foes began.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
