zh-CN.text: 看起来，好像你这次打败了很多敌人之后才到这里来的。勉强算是。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 它们让我损失惨重，没错。但你不知道从塔耳塔罗斯到这里的道路有多么漫长而艰难！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道什么叫艰难吗？试着在一个不断变化，有无数条通道的迷宫里生活一段时间你就知道了。你的敌人没做到的事情，就交给我来完成吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: We meet again, short one. For further battle.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Short one?! That's a low blow, sir. I thought you were the big-honorable type.

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You mock my sense of honor. <Snort> Common tactic. Now prepare.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我们又见面了，小矮个。为了今后的战斗。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 小矮个？！真是没想到啊，先生。我还以为你是那种高大威猛讲荣誉的类型。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你在诋毁我的荣誉感。<鼻息声>很正常的战术。准备好。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You choose to challenge me again. Not many in Elysium so dare. Then, I accept.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, I never challenged you! The entrance to your chamber looks like any other pathway in Elysium. I have no quarrel with you, sir!

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: To step into my chamber is to challenge me. <Snort> It is a custom since the time I lived and breathed in darkness. I will send you into such a darkness now.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你选择再次挑战我。至福乐土里也没多少人敢这样做。我接受挑战。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你等下，我没有挑战你！只是你房间的入口看上去像是通往至福乐土的。我并没有针对你，先生！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 进到我的房间就是挑战我。<鼻息声>这是我从黑暗中出生以来就保持的习惯。我会让你也进入那样的黑暗之中。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: My next opponent has arrived in short order.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Short order? That was another jab about my height, wasn't it!

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I do not jab. <Snort> All of my strength goes into every strike. Observe.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 下一个对手短时间内就会来。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你说短？你又拿我的身高刺激我，是不是！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我没有刺激你。<鼻息声>我的每一击都用尽全力。注意。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You have returned to my chamber. I trust you are familiar now with what this means.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It means I've challenged you to a battle of strength and glory, because apparently that's all there is to do for fun around here for those such as yourself?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: That... <Snort> Yes. Essentially that is correct. Prepare.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你回到了我的房间。你应该知道这意味着什么。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这意味着我要挑战你的力量和荣耀，因为很明显这是你在这里仅有的娱乐活动。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 这……<鼻息声>对。基本上是这样。准备好。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: It would seem <Snort> that the time for additional fun has arrived.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Ah, yes, my favorite pastime: Getting butchered by a giant double-bladed axe. And sometimes trampled.

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Then, good. You have much to enjoy in store.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 看样子<鼻息声>额外的娱乐活动来了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，是啊，我的最爱：被人拿超大的双头斧子追着砍。那人还用脚踩我。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 好的。你还可以享受其他服务。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Well, short one. It seems I must attempt to maim you here, so that the king and I might finally stop you at the gates.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know, you hurt me with this 'short one' business almost as much as with that axe. Why isn't Theseus 'short one'? We're the same height!

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: No. The king is greater. He is the greatest king of Athens! What are you? A willful son of a fickle god. I am beneath your father's notice. And you are beneath the king's. Now fight me.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 小矮个。似乎我在这里把你打残，然后我和国王就能阻止你通过大门了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你知不知道，你每次管我叫“小矮个”的时候都跟你那斧子一样伤人。为什么忒修斯就不是“小矮个”？我们明明一样高！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 不；我的王要伟大的多。他是雅典最伟大的国王！再说你。浮躁的天神生下的任性的儿子。你的父亲没有正眼看过我。我的国王对你也一样。战斗吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: It is not often that my challengers return to face another slaughter at my hands.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Yeah, well. You're kind of in my way. What choice do I have?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Your choices led you here, and they will lead you to defeat, again.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 被我屠杀的挑战者一般都不会再主动回来。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 其实。是你挡我路了。我又能怎么办啊？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你的选择带你来到这里，来到这里再次接受失败。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You are more skilled than I expected, short one. A re-match is most certainly in order.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're going to force a rematch each time I manage to defeat you, aren't you?

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: We and our victories are all impermanent here in Elysium. We live, such as it is, for moments such as these.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你比我预想的要能干啊，小矮个。我们似乎可以再来一场了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 每次我要打赢你的时候你就要再来一场，是不是啊？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 至福乐土的胜利是非常短暂的。我们在这里就是为了战斗。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Your challenge is hereby accepted, short one.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 接受你的挑战，小矮个。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Another challenger. <Snort> Come get destroyed.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 又一个挑战者。<鼻息声>来接受毁灭吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I accept all challengers. No prior notice necessary.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我接受所有人的挑战。不用提前预约。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You have returned. <Snort> I'm always ready to oppose you.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你回来了。<鼻息声>我时刻准备着与你对战。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You enter my chamber once again, short one. Then, good.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你又一次进入了我的房间，小矮个。好的。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I expected you to reappear. <Snort> Let us fight.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我正等着你再次出现呢。<鼻息声>开始战斗吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Appears it's time we challenged one another once again. Prepare.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 是时候再一次挑战彼此了。准备好。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Good. <Snort> It feels as though I haven't crushed the life from anything in ages.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 好的。<鼻息声>我感觉自己好像已经好久没有碾碎过什么活物了。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Returned to battle me for glory, short one? <Snort> Excellent.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 又回来为了荣耀与我决斗吗，小矮个？<鼻息声>做的不错。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Come fight me again, short one. We have eternity to grow stronger.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 又回来跟我打了，小矮个。我们有的是时间来变强。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Thank you, short one. <Snort> Few in Elysium dare challenge me repeatedly.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 谢谢你，小矮个。<鼻息声>至福乐土里只有少数人敢不停地对我发出挑战。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: The short one from the bowels of hell has finally returned.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 来自冥界深渊的小矮个终于回来了。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I heard you had again entered Elysium. <Snort> At last.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我听说你又进入了至福乐土。<鼻息声>终于。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Hold nothing back against me, short one. Now, come.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 不准对我放水，小矮个。来吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Let us grow stronger in the ways of battle, short one.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 让我们在这无尽的战斗中变得更强吧，小矮个。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I always am prepared to fight whoever dares oppose me.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我时刻准备着与那些敢挑战我的人战斗。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Let us battle now before you face the Champion, himself.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 在你面对最强战士之前，先和我打一场吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You seek the Champion. You must confront me, first.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 要想面对最强战士，就得先打赢我。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Hrmm. <Snort> It has been long enough since my last fight.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 呃嗯。<鼻息声>距离上次的战斗已经过了很长时间了。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I've been waiting for another round against you. Let's go. Now.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我一直等待着和你再打一场。现在，我们开始吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: They said you were headed this way. <Snort> I said I'd stop you. Though, we'll see.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 他们说你朝这边来了。<鼻息声>我说我会阻止你的。不过，咱们来打打看吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Each time we fight... I think I learn a little more. Let's start.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 每次和你战斗……我都觉得学到了些新的东西，咱们开战吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I had a feeling you would cross my path again. I've been looking forward to this.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我早就觉得我们会再见面，我一直都在等着这一刻。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I'm going to run you down, or run you through. Your choice, short one.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 要么我把你砍翻，要么我把你踩扁。你来选吧，小矮个。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Told the king I'd try to stop you on the way. He thought I'd have no trouble. <Snort> We'll see.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我和国王说我半路就把你拦下来，他觉得这件事轻而易举。<鼻息声>咱们来看看吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Come on, short one. I've been waiting too long for this.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 来啊，小矮个，这一刻我已经等得太久了。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You know what it takes to leave this chamber alive, short one. <Snort> Come on and fight.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 要是想活着离开这个房间，你很清楚该怎么做，小矮个。<鼻息声>来和我打一架吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I have my armor, short one. Let's see what you have.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我有我的护甲，小矮个，让我看看你有什么吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Let's see if you can cut through my coat this time.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 让我看看你这次能不能刺穿我的甲胄吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: This armor's heavy. But makes me even faster than before. <Snort> Watch.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 这套护甲很沉重，但却能让我动作更快。<鼻息声>好好看着吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You are resilient, short one, I will give you that.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你可真是坚强啊，小矮个。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I'm prepared to slaughter you again, short one. Come fight.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我准备好再次屠杀你了，小矮个。来战。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Interesting. <Snort> Most never challenge me again once I destroy them.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 有趣。<鼻息声>大多数人被我打败之后都不会再回来挑战我了。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: What hope have you against the Champion, if you can't get through me?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你连我都打不过，你有什么胜算打赢最强战士？

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You have tenacity, short one. I have to give you that.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 真是不屈不挠啊，小矮个。不得不说。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You do not take all your defeats to heart, do you? That's good.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 那些败仗你没往心里去，是吧？那就好。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You're quick, short one. Let's see if you can get past me again.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 很敏捷，小矮个。看看你能否再次打败我。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Well, short one. I'm curious to see if you can best me once again.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 小矮个。我很好奇这次你能不能继续打败我。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: A worthy challenger returns. Let's see you defeat me again.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 可敬的挑战者回来了。来吧，再一次将我打败。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Glory and honor to you if you can vanquish me again. Come!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 击败我，我会为你感到荣耀！来吧！

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I welcome the taste of defeat, short one. It is akin to feeling alive.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我接受战败的滋味，小矮个。这让我有活着的感觉。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I'm still learning all your tricks, short one. Come show me more.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我还在钻研你那些个技巧呢，小矮个，多展示些给我看吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Let's see you get through me again, short one.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 来吧，继续将我打倒，小矮个。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I'm the one to challenge you this time, short one.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 这次换我来挑战你了，小矮个。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I have looked forward to repaying you in kind for our last fight.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我一直期待着上回的战斗能够再次上演。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You're strong, short one. But I am just as obstinate as you.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你很强，小矮个。但我跟你一样倔强。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: The Champion awaits, short one. If you can get through me again, that is.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 最强战士在等着你呢，小矮个，但你首先得过我这关。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Good. Now I can get you back for last time. All I need is one clean hit.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 很好，这下可以报上次的仇了，只要干净利落的一斧就够了。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Well fought. Though, your technique pales in comparison to that of the Champion of Elysium. I expect you'll soon see for yourself.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 打得不错。但是，你的技术比起至福乐土的最强战士来说，还是不太够格。到时候你就会明白了。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: I respect your strength, short one. The Champion of Elysium awaits. Until such time.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你的力量让我心生敬意，小矮个。至福乐土的最强战士等待着你。再会。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You were a worthy challenger. Most welcome here. Until we meet again.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你是个可敬的挑战者。欢迎你。我们后会有期。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: You have earned your passage. I go now to recover for the next occasion that we meet.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你可以通过这里了。我现在要去恢复恢复，准备我们下一次的战斗了。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Thank you for sparring with me, short one. I'm glad we've made a habit of it thus.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 感谢你与我战斗，小矮个。很高兴我们养成了这样的习惯。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Urgh... the might of Gilgamesh... I understand it now. But I won't make his friend's mistake. We'll fight again.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 啊啊……是吉尔伽美什的力量……我明白了。不过我可不会犯下他朋友犯过的错误，咱们来重打一场吧。

en.speaker: Asterius
en.text: Such strength... the strength of Gilgamesh. Thank you for the battle, short one.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿斯忒里俄斯
zh-CN.text: 这种力量……吉尔伽美什的力量。谢谢你与我一战，小矮个。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You now know that, even if you are able to surpass me, you shall ultimately perish, soon enough. And yet you still persist! Utterly senseless.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I found her, Father. And I'm going to find Mother again. And again, and again, until I have some answers, finally. She'd like some answers, too, beginning with why did you never tell her that I lived? You let her go, and left her to her grief!

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Silence, boy! Save all your ignorant and baseless accusations. You seem incapable of heeding my request that you not blather on about a matter you shall never understand. Then, I shall save my breath for this fight!

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你现在应该明白了，就算你能打败我，过不了多久，你也只有死路一条，就算这样，你也要反抗！真是毫无意义。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我找到她了，父亲。我打算继续去找我的母亲，一次又一次地去找她，直到我得到某些答案为止。她有些问题也想知道答案，比如说你为什么从来没告诉过她我还活着？是你放走了她，任由她沉湎在悲伤之中！

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 给我住口，孩子！你的无知和毫无根据的指责，还是省省为好。我要求你不要对你无法理解的事情插嘴，但你似乎没办法理解我的意思。既然如此，我就不和你费什么口舌了，来打吧！

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You were never supposed to live. Took all of Nyx's strength to circumvent what should have been a certainty. Now you cannot stay dead. Such is the wry humor of the Fates.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx saved me.... So according to the Fates I was never meant to be born, since neither you nor Mother are of the Underworld, something like that? Or was that just another lie you told, to Mother and whoever else?

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Bah! You think everything a lie. The realm beneath our feet was appointed to me on certain conditions, not that I had much of a choice. Among them: A one-time surface-dweller such as I would never have an heir.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You really believed that? Then why attempt to have a child, anyway?

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You don't know anything! Why anyone would choose to have a child is a mystery to me. The Fates said I would never have an heir. Perhaps this was all they meant.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你根本就不该活在世上，倪克斯花了所有的力量，才避开了这不可避免的结果。如今你想死也死不了，这就是命运三女神荒诞的玩笑。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是倪克斯救了我一命……所以根据命运女神的安排，我从一开始就不该生出来，因为你和我母亲都不是在冥界出生的，是因为这样的事情吗？还是说，这只是你对母亲和其他人撒的另一个谎？

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 啧！你以为一切都是谎言。我们脚下的这个王国，是出于某些条件才由我管理的，在这点上我也没什么选择的余地。其中一个条件就是：像我这样曾经住在地上世界的人，是不可以有后代的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你真的相信那些话吗？那你为什么还想要有个孩子呢？

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你什么都不知道！为什么会有人给我生个孩子，我自己也不知道是怎么回事。命运女神说，我是不会有孩子的。或许这才是她们的意图。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: To think Olympus has been aiding you. You must be so grateful to them for their aid, without which none of this would have been possible.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Yeah, about that. Father, did... did you let Mother go because you feared Olympus would find out? And... not respond well to the circumstances if they did?

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Tsch. Be grateful they have not found out as yet, for all your meddling. You do not know them as well as you think. Ask yourself why she left Olympus, and how. Or better yet, ask her.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, she seems quite lovely, so... knowing you, you probably tricked her into signing a pact to come join you, or something. Since you weren't allowed on Olympus, why not have Olympus come to you?

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Hah! Surprisingly not distant from the truth. I took her, boy! I took her down with me. Is that what you wish to hear? Does that anger you? Come, bring forth that anger, then!

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 想想看，整个奥林匹斯山都在帮你。你肯定很感激他们的协助吧，要是没了他们，你是不可能走到这一步的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊。关于这一点，父亲，你……你是故意让母亲走的吗，因为你担心奥林匹斯众神会发现这一点？如果……他们发现的话，恐怕不会有什么好脸色给你看，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 啧，你这么到处胡闹，而他们还没有发现真相，你真该心怀感激。奥林匹斯的众神可不像你想的那样。你扪心自问，她为什么要离开奥林匹斯山，是怎么离开的？或者说，你干脆去问她好了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，她看起来是个很可爱的人，所以说……她认识了你，说不定你骗她和你签署了什么协议，让她来到冥界。既然奥林匹斯众神不允许你留在那里，那他们怎么从来没找过你呢？

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 哈！你猜得和真相还真差不多。是我拐走了她，孩子！是我把她硬带到这里了，这就是你想听到的答案吗？这个答案让你愤怒吗？那就带着你的愤怒来吧！

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: So, boy. Did you ask her? About how she came to join me in the Underworld. Did you confirm all your suspicions, then?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You didn't drag her down to hell, yourself, apparently. You're not going to tell me who did, though I can well imagine. Your brothers got to reign forever on Olympus, while you got sent down into the Underworld. So they gave you a consolation prize... didn't they?

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You make such accusations, knowing next to nothing. Careless as ever. Poseidon had nothing to do with it! He knows even less than you. If you value her existence or your own, you would be wise to keep it that way. And to turn back!

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 所以，孩子，你问过她了吗？问过她是怎么来到冥界的了吗？她的答案证实了你的猜测吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 很显然，并不是你把她拐到冥界的。虽然你不会告诉我是谁把她弄过来的，不过我也猜得到。你的兄弟们打算永远统治奥林匹斯山，而你却被送到了冥界。所以他们打算给你个安慰……是这么回事吧？

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你一直都是这么马马虎虎。明明几乎一无所知，却口口声声地指控别人。波塞冬和这件事情一点关系都没有！他知道的内情甚至还没有你多。如果你还珍惜她，或者珍惜你自己，那你最好别再管这件事情，赶紧回去！

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: ...She was the Queen. Queen of the Underworld! My Queen. Commanding reverence, and awe, and fear. She was not just... what was the term you used? A consolation prize? You are as disrespectful to her as you are to me.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, what would you even know?! You claim so much respect for her, yet you didn't even respect her enough to tell her what happened after she left! But... what am I saying... I know you love her, still, Father. That best explains all the terrible choices you've made.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: ...All the terrible choices I've made. By the time you have existed for as long as I have, pray you will have made fewer. Although I fear you shall surpass me in at least this one regard.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: ……她是皇后，冥界的皇后！我的皇后，是能引起别人尊重、敬畏与恐惧的人。她可不仅仅是什么……你刚刚说的那个词是什么来着？安慰？你对她真是太不尊重了，就像对我一样不尊重。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，你现在知道尊重了？！你口口声声说尊重她，可她离开之后，你甚至连这里发生了什么事情都不告诉她，还敢说什么尊重！不过……话说回来……我知道你还爱着她，父亲。这最好能解释得通你怎么会做出那么多糟糕的抉择。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: ……我做了那么多糟糕的抉择。我只希望等你活到像我这么大的时候，你做出的糟糕抉择能比我少一些。不过我觉得，至少搞砸事情这方面，你比我更厉害。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: ...I have done virtually everything within my power to prevent this. All of it... for nothing. The Fates were not content to saddle me within the earth; they mock me, still.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Maybe they just think you're in the wrong. And that you're an obstinate, overbearing, miserable excuse for a husband and father. Don't you understand I'm trying to fix the problems you caused? Since you're so unwilling to do it yourself.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You're right. I was unwilling. I made my choices, in all this. I loved her, yes. I loved her terribly. But now... it seems I am merely delaying the inevitable. Go, then. Go to her. But, should harm befall her... I shall bring my worst wrath upon whomever is to blame... including you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What? You're letting me go, just like that? You're just afraid of getting struck down again. You're serious?

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: ……为了阻止这一切，我真的已经竭尽全力了，可这一切都……毫无意义。命运女神把我丢到地底还不满足，她们还要嘲笑我。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 或许她们只是觉得你做错了，觉得你是个顽固、霸道、悲惨的父亲与丈夫。我正在努力解决你造成的问题，你难道不明白吗？这都是因为你不愿意自己解决那些问题。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你说得没错，我确实不愿意，这一切都是我造成的。我很爱她，真的，我爱她爱得发疯，可现在……看起来，我不过是在拖延不可避免的事情罢了。去吧，去找她吧。可要是有人敢伤害她的话……我一定会让那个人尝到我最恐怖的怒火……就连你也不例外。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么？你就打算这么让我走了吗？你该不会只是害怕又败在我手上一次吧？你是认真的吗？

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Heh. Confronting you like this... it's different now. Still... it is a responsibility, just as before. There is to be no escape from my realm. Ultimately, I must see to that, myself.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That's the spirit, Father! As for me, I find the candor of our interactions here to be rather refreshing, I must say. Especially the interactions between my weapons and your physique. You're tough, but you're an easy target.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: And you are scrawny, though slippery, blast you. All that pent-up rage behind your smiling words... come, unleash it once again. I expect you to go all out. To the death!

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 呵，像这样站在你面前……感觉已经不一样了。不过……这是我的职责，这一点没有变。没人能从我的王国逃脱，我必须亲自确认这一点才行。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 就是这个态度，父亲！对我来说，我得承认，我们在这里的互动让我感觉耳目一新，特别是我的武器与你的身体之间的互动。你的身体很结实，但想击中你实在是太容易了。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 而你虽然骨瘦如柴，却很敏捷，你这个小混蛋。你笑着说出的那些话后面，压抑的那些愤怒……来吧，再把它释放出来吧。我希望你能全力以赴，至死方休！

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I was reviewing the terms of the Pact of Punishment to which you are bound. Even when my servants resort to extreme measures, they were still unable to surpass you, then. So now, it is my turn.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Caught you unprepared, did I? After Theseus and his Macedonian, I half-expected to see you thundering around on some golden chariot of your own, drawn by sable steeds, that sort of thing. But it's just you.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: It is just me, indeed. However... that should be more than necessary, here. No holding back this time, Zagreus. Are you ready?

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我刚刚在看你的惩罚契约上面的条款。就算我的仆人们采取了极端措施条款，他们也依然不是你的对手。所以，只能我亲自出马了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 上次被我打了个措手不及，是吧？见过忒修斯和他的马其顿号之后，我或多或少以为，你会乘着由黑色战马拉的金色战车，或是类似的东西四处游荡，可你什么都没乘。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 是啊，确实是我的错觉。不过……那应该已经超出必要程度了。这次我不会留情了，扎格列欧斯。你准备好了吗？

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: What have you done with my ancient weapon, boy? I sense Varatha's form there in your feeble grip, but... there's some garish power you've awakened in it, haven't you?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, just took a splash of Titan Blood at the right time was all. There's more to your ancient weapon than you gave it credit for, I guess. Though let's not keep it waiting, no?

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: No, let's not. Gigaros is the mightier weapon, with none of the treacherous past. It needs no fanciful shape-shifting tricks to run you through. Behold!

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你对我的远古武器做了什么，孩子？我能从你孱弱的手中感受到了瓦拉塔的形态，但是……你似乎唤醒了它某种华而不实的力量，是不是？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，只是适时地吸收了一点泰坦之血罢了。看来你也不是很了解你口中的远古武器啊，不过咱们闲话少说，开打吧？

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 很好，废话少说。吉加罗斯要更加强大，它没什么悲惨的过去，也不需要那些花哨的变形来获得力量。接招吧！

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I never had any respect for Stygius, that blade you bear. Perhaps unfairly, due to Brother Poseidon's sloppy form when once he wielded it. But now it seems quite different in your care.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I think we've grown quite close to one another, yes. Enough to where I've come to know a different side of this fine blade right here. This is the aspect of some Arthur fellow! Maybe the two of you could get acquainted properly?

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Arthur! No name either of gods or kings of any realm I know. Then, introduce us, as you say! To this new amateur, to whom your blade rendered its services.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我从来没正眼瞧过斯第格思，也就是你手里那把剑。或许这并不公平，可能是因为波塞冬用它的时候，它的样子实在是太臃肿了吧。不过到了你手上，它已经大不一样了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我觉得我们之间已经有了足够的羁绊，足以让我发现这把利刃的另一面。这就是某个叫亚瑟的形态！或许你们两个可以好好认识一下？

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 亚瑟！我听说过的神明或帝王之中，可没有叫这个名字的。既然如此，就如你所言，帮我们互相介绍一下吧，让我认识认识你的利刃所服侍的门外汉。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: The bow is the weapon of a coward, boy. I said so even to Hera's face. I'm unsurprised that you are drawn to it, and yet... something has changed about it, I can tell.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, you mean that Coronacht has taken on the aspect of a divine preserver person of some sort, of whom I've seen mere glimpses but seems definitely very capable, and really rather brave?

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I know not why the old Infernal Arms endear themselves to you. And, I entirely care not in whose weakling aspect you bring them forth, only to fall to me.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 只有懦夫才会用弓，小子，这句话我甚至当着赫拉的面说过。你会喜欢上这把弓，我真是一点都不意外，不过……我看得出来，这把弓有点不太一样了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么，您指的是科罗纳赫特继承了某个圣人的形态吗？虽然我可能只见过那个人几面，但那个人看起来无人能敌，而且非常勇敢，你是这个意思吗？

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我不知道这把老旧的冥府兵器为什么会出现在你面前。而且，我根本不在乎你说的那个弱者是什么样子，反正那个人迟早都会落在我的手上。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: There you are, bearing my brother's blasted shield... flaunting it about so recklessly. Though, what have you done to it, now?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Not much, really, besides awakening the aspect of a supposedly unstoppable, dragon-slaying warrior called Beowulf. If it has the power to protect him against a giant lizard, I figure it may help me against you.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You presently shall find I'm no mere giant lizard, boy. Though we shall see whether this Beowulf is any help to you.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 原来是你啊，你拿着我哥哥的盾牌……如此鲁莽地招摇过市。不过，你到底对它做了什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 老实说没做什么，我只不过是唤醒了某个勇猛无双的屠龙英雄，某个叫贝奥武夫的战士的形态。如果这面盾牌的力量足以帮助他对付大蜥蜴的话，我猜，它应该也能帮助我对付你才是。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你马上就会发现，我的力量可不是什么大蜥蜴能比的，小子。不过，让我们来看看这个贝奥武夫能怎么帮助你吧。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Resorting to mere fisticuffs with me... though, how you got Malphon to look like that, I've no idea. Pray tell, whose monstrous claws are those? A manticore's?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: These claws, I'll have you know, Father, belonged once to an ancient god-king known as Gilgamesh. You ever meet?

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Hrm. Provided he was flesh and blood at some point, then he resides within my realm. Presumably within Elysium somewhere, sadly bereft of his manticore claws, thanks to you. Come, show me what they can do.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 看来你想和我打一场拳击啊……不过，你是怎么把玛尔封变成那个样子的，我一点都不清楚。和我说说吧，那对怪物爪子是谁的？是狮身蝎尾兽的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 让我来告诉你吧，父亲。这对爪子曾属于某位远古的神王，名字叫做吉尔伽美什。你见过他吗？

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 嗯嗯，只要他是有血有肉的生物，那他就肯定在我的王国里，说不定是在至福乐土的某个地方吧。可都是因为你，他失去了利爪，真是可悲。来让我见识见识这对利爪的威力吧。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You approach me with that loathsome Rail, boy. Emanating a hellish fury more even than usual, at that. Little surprise you took a shine to it. It was the weapon that I hated most of all.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, someone called Lucifer apparently thought differently, and took a crack at his own father with it, once. This one's for him, then.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Invoking names you know nothing about. Presuming, all the while, far too much. You take that monstrous artifact for another friend? You would be wiser to be wary of its influence. But, let us fight.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你拿着一把令人厌恶的弩炮，小子，它蕴含的地狱怒火甚至比以前更加强大。你让它焕发出了更强大的力量，我一点都不意外，毕竟这可是我以前最痛恨的武器。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不过，某个叫路西法的家伙却很喜欢这把武器。他拿着这把武器，朝他的父亲开了火。我猜，这把武器应该就是给他用的吧。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你一直都是这么傲慢，总是对那些你一无所知的名字夸夸其谈，真是太自以为是了。你把那把畸形的武器当朋友了吗？你要是有点脑子的话，应该当心它的力量才对。不过，话不多说了，开战吧。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Ah, but there you are, boy, finally. Despite my knowing you are always late for everything, here you've outdone yourself by quite some time.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh shut up, and get your fork, and burn away that regal cape, and let's get to this, then. I'd no idea you had all these capes to spare! Must have a whole entire storage chamber full of them.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Your mockery of me may temporarily embolden you, but achieves nothing useful, in the end.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 啊，你来到这里了，孩子，终于。在我印象里你总是慢人一拍，不过现在你似乎早就不再那样了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 别说了吧，把你叉子拿上，身上那高贵披风给我焚了，我们干一架。我就搞不懂你哪来那么多披风！一定有一个专门的披风室吧。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 讥讽最多只能给你临时壮壮胆子，到最后并没有什么实质作用。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: This cold white substance falling slowly from the heavens. Snow, they call it. Look carefully upon each fleck. Tiny crystals! But structurally weak. They melt! This surface realm... it is held up by mine.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: If you're quite finished teaching me about this snow phenomenon, can we get on with brutally trying to kill each other, here?

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You wish to have your mortal-colored blood spill once again upon this bed of snow, then fine. Let us proceed.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 从天堂飘落下来的这冰冷的白色物体。他们说这叫雪。仔细看的话，每一片。都像是小水晶！但又十分脆弱。会融化！这片领域……都属于我。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果你教完降雪现象这一课了，应该接着进行疯狂互殴环节了吧？

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 如果你执意要让这雪白地面染上你凡人色的血，那来吧。我们继续。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You still have yet to see the sun itself. You know only the light of Ixion, but the sun? It is positively blinding. Hideous.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It has been snowy nightfall every single time now that you mention it. I didn't know it snowed so much up here.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: It hasn't always. But, that's of no consequence to us. Especially when there's a raging battle to be fought.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你到现在连太阳都没见到过。你只知道伊克西翁发出的光，但是阳光呢？阳光会强烈到刺瞎你的眼睛。非常可怕。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 既然你都提到了，现在每天黄昏都会下雪。上面从来不会下这样多的雪。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 并不总是这样。但是这对我们而言无关紧要。尤其是现在正要开始激烈战斗。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: If you are here, then... the Olympians must still be lending you their aid. Just as before! I scarce believe the Queen's preposterous idea worked. That all it took to settle an old score was a blasted family feast.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Come on, Father, even you must have enjoyed that feast to some extent. We ought to do it more often! Good thing you trusted Mother's judgment on that one. So, then, to the death, once more?

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Indeed. To the death, as always, boy. Zagreus. Ready yourself.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 既然你又来了……奥林匹斯众神肯定又借给你他们的力量了，就像以前一样！我真不敢相信，我的皇后那异想天开的点子居然真的行得通。只要一顿该死的家族盛宴，就能解决所有的旧怨。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 别这样，父亲。就算是你，有时候也得享受一下盛宴的欢乐，咱们以后应该多举办些盛宴才对！很高兴你在这件事情上相信了母亲的判断。那就再来一次，至死方休吧？

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 是啊，和以前一样，至死方休吧，孩子。扎格列欧斯，准备好吧。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: ...I never grew accustomed to the air, up here. It gusts senselessly whichever way it pleases. I suppose you must prefer it to the stillness of the air below.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know, you're right. The air up here seems pretty good so far. But I will reserve judgment till I've had my fill. I have to say, though, Father: The Helm of Darkness suits you. I'm touched you'd dust it off on my account.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: It should not have had to come to this. For all your antics with me and around the House, I always kept my temper, have I not? Unlike you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, let's see. You've berated me repeatedly and often. You've lied to me. Mustered your wretched forces to kill me, over and over. But, sure, I'll grant you that you've always kept most of your anger bottled up. All that's about to change, then?

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: We're gods, boy. Killing one another is our lot. Although, I always thought I was above it. I told you that you cannot leave this place. It seems I must enforce my rules myself. I'm sending you home, now.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: ……我一直都不习惯这里的空气。毫无规律地四处乱吹。比起下面的一片死寂，你应该更喜欢这里的空气吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这倒没错。这里的空气目前来说还行。不过在我受够之前我还是持保留意见。我还是得说，父亲：黑暗之盔还蛮适合你的。你专门为我把它打理了一番，我很感动。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 事情本不该如此的。就算你对我，在圣殿，做了那么多莫名奇妙的事情，我依然憋着自己的怒气，是不是？不像你。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那就来看看吧。你一直在指责我。你骗了我。一次又一次召集你的人马来杀我。但是没错，我承认你一直憋着自己的怒气。所有这些都将改变。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我们是神，孩子。互相杀戮就是我们的命运。我一直以为自己可以不用这样。我告诉过你，你不能离开这里。看来现在必须由我亲自来执行了。现在我要送你回家了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: ...I never grew accustomed to the air, up here. It gusts senselessly whichever way it pleases. I suppose you must prefer it to the stillness of the air below.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know, you're right. The air up here seems pretty good so far. But I will reserve judgment till I've had my fill. I have to say, though, Father: The Helm of Darkness suits you. I'm touched you'd dust it off on my account.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: It should not have had to come to this. For all your antics with me and around the House, I always kept my temper, have I not? Unlike you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well let's see. You've berated me repeatedly and often. You've lied to me. Mustered a bunch of incompetent wretches to try to kill me. But, sure, I'll grant you that you've always kept most of your anger bottled up. All that's about to change, then?

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: We're gods, boy. Killing one another is our lot. Although, I always thought I was above it. I told you that you cannot leave this place. It seems I must enforce my rules myself. I'm sending you home, now.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: ……我一直都不习惯这里的空气。毫无规律地四处乱吹。比起下面的一片死寂，你应该更喜欢这里的空气吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这倒没错。这里的空气目前来说还行。不过在我受够之前我还是持保留意见。我还是得说，父亲：黑暗之盔还蛮适合你的。你专门为我把它打理了一番，我很感动。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 事情本不该如此的。就算你对我，在圣殿，做了那么多莫名奇妙的事情，我依然憋着自己的怒气，是不是？不像你。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那就来看看吧。你一直在指责我。你骗了我。甚至召集自己的人马想杀死我。但是没错，我承认你一直憋着自己的怒气。所有这些都将改变。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我们是神，孩子。互相杀戮就是我们的命运。我一直以为自己可以不用这样。我告诉过你，你不能离开这里。看来现在必须由我亲自来执行了。现在我要送你回家了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You know now what you're doing here is without any purpose whatsoever. Even if I don't slay you myself, you'll simply perish when you cross that threshold there. And yet you still persist?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I do. Besides, making these treks helps pass the time during the ongoing Underworld renovations. And I'll be in tiptop shape once they're complete!

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Would that we had a little more support; the renovations could have been complete by now! As ever, you think only of yourself. But if you must insist like this, then you will find me waiting for you once you get here. Every single time.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你应该知道你在这里做的一切都毫无意义。就算我没有亲手杀死你，你通过那个入口后也会直接消散。这样你还不放弃吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不放弃。另外，我做这样的事也方便在冥界修复的同时消磨自己的时间。等到修复完成，我就会变成一流的高手！

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 如果再多一点帮助；整个修复说不定早就可以完成了！还是一样，你只想着你自己。如果你仍不肯放弃的话，我会一直在这里拦截你。一次都不落下。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Why? Why do you keep showing up? In spite of knowing that the outcome shall be just the same as how it always was?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Beats having to toil away under your overbearing supervision. And besides, as you may be aware, I've recently made up my mind to leave this place.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Eughh... utterly incorrigible. When next we meet here, then, we'll keep it brief. I have grown weary of our aimless conversations. Now prepare!

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 为什么？为什么你就是不放弃？就算你知道结果不会变，你还是不肯放弃。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这可比在你手下艰辛工作要好得多。另外，你应该也知道了，我已经决心要离开这个地方了。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 呃啊啊……简直不可救药。下次我们再见的时候，就不要说这么多了吧。这种无意义的对话让我感觉很烦。准备好！

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You bear the Sigil of the Dead. I wear the Helm of Darkness. Even devoid of artifacts as these, we fight here without witnesses... in shadow.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: If only everybody knew you had a mighty son most capable of cutting you down to size, with or without the ability to vanish suddenly.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: A very boastful son, who often thinks too much of his ability. Come, then! I'll make you vanish suddenly.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你戴着死者印记，而我戴着黑暗之盔。不过就算没了这些神器，也不会有人在阴影之中……围观我们的决斗。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 要是每个人都知道你有个厉害的儿子就好了，无论你有没有突然消失的能力，你儿子都能把你揍得鼻青脸肿。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我这个喜欢自卖自夸的儿子，总是觉得自己无人能比。那就过来吧！我只要几招就能弄死你。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: ...That pomegranate blossom... I caught its subtle scent as you approached. The Queen has her mother's strength. And much more self control.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, you're afraid of a little flower, now, Father? One that imbues me with the fiercest might of Olympus, granted, but still! It looks harmless, at least.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I fear your little flower there much more than you. The Queen and her mother... they possess power over life. Thus, power over death.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: ……那是石榴花的香气……你过来的时候，我就闻到了它清淡的香味。我的皇后拥有她母亲的力量，而在自控方面更是要好得多。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 怎么，你还怕起一朵小花了吗，父亲？这朵花赐予了我整个奥林匹斯山最所向披靡的力量！不过至少它看起来人畜无害。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 恐怕你那朵小花的力量，比你的力量要强得多。我的皇后和她的母亲……她们拥有掌控生命的力量，所以，也有掌控死亡的力量。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Extreme measures permitted, even still? You must have forgotten to change the conditions of your Pact of Punishment.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wasn't an oversight. You're strong, Father. I want to be as strong, and more. Not that I'm taking after you, or anything.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You wish to test yourself against the full extent of my wrath, then very well. You have earned that right. Besides yourself, only the Titans have. Now, then... attack!

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你还开着极端措施条款，是吗？你肯定是疏忽大意，忘记更改惩罚契约上的条款了吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我没疏忽大意。你很强，父亲，我想变得像你一样强，甚至比你更强。这倒不是说我想以你为榜样什么的。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你想尝尝我拿出全力有多厉害，很好，你赢得了这个权利。除了你之外，只有泰坦巨人见识过我真正的怒火。很好，开战吧！

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You vanquished me... even when I threw everything I had at you, and more. I fought you as I fought the Titans themselves, and still I failed.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, don't take it so hard, Father. There's always next time, right? Meaning, this time. Maybe I won't be so fortunate.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Of that, I am most certain. Come, let us see the limits of our abilities, then. I warn you: I shall hold nothing back. To the death!

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 即便我拼尽全力、超出极限与你战斗……你还是打败了我。我拿出了和泰坦战斗的劲头，可我还是输了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，别这么难过嘛，父亲。总会有下一次机会，是吧？我指的也就是这一次，说不定这次我就没那么幸运了。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 这一点我很确定。很好，来吧，让我们看看彼此的极限。我得警告你，我是不会手下留情的。至死方休！

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: ...Nary a whif of Mount Olympus on you, this time. How is it that you clambered all this way, without the generous support of your dear family? Doubtless you merely purged their blessings for some coin.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, I resent that, Father! I'm more than capable of getting here all on my own, now, thanks.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Such arrogance has led to many a mortal's downfall... and many a god's.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: ……这次，你身上连一丝奥林匹斯众神的味道都没有。没了你那些亲人们的慷慨相助，你到底是怎么一路来到这里的？很显然，你只是把他们的祝福拿去换成钱罢了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，这么说就太不像话了，父亲！我就算只靠我自己，想来这里也绰绰有余，不必客气。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 这种傲慢曾让无数凡人惨遭不测……神明也是如此。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Odd. No stink of Olympus on you, this time. Have you truly come all this way without assistance from your relatives? Or were you overzealous at a Pool of Purging?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wouldn't you like to know? Not even Nyx believed that I could come this far without aid from the Olympians. Maybe I just have a knack for proving everybody wrong.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You have a knack for being struck down in various, ignoble ways, that much is certain. Come, then! Show me what you, yourself, can do!

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 真奇怪，这次你身上没有奥林匹斯众神的臭味。你真的是完全没靠亲戚们的帮助，自己一路走到这里的吗？还是说，你玩净化池玩过头了？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你不想知道是怎么回事吗？就连倪克斯都不相信我可以在没有奥林匹斯众神帮助的情况下走出这么远。或许我就是有本事向别人证明：他们都错了。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你很擅长用各种各样蠢方法害死自己，这一点毫无疑问。好了，来吧！让我看看你的本事吧！

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Be still. These waters... teeming with Poseidon's river denizens. That one there, before me... it's been taunting me, I think, for quite some time.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You offering to take me fishing, Father? Sounds more pleasant than having you slaughter me again, or the other way around.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You mistook my meaning. First, you shall have my spear. Then, that thing shall, if it has not yet come to its senses. Though, if you vanquish me, I'm certain your uncle shall not mind if you extract it, yourself.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 站着别动。这片水域里……充斥着波塞冬的河流中的居民们。就我面前的那条鱼……我觉得它一直都在嘲笑我，已经笑了很久了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你是想和我一起钓鱼吗，父亲？听起来比打打杀杀的要好多了。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你误会了我的意思。首先，我要让你尝尝我长矛的滋味。其次，如果那条鱼还不知死活地呆在这里，它也会尝到长矛的滋味。不过，如果你能打败我的话，我敢肯定你的叔叔不会介意你把那条鱼钓走。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: It is a testament to the awful might of Demeter that, even with the surge of heat created by the Pact of Punishment you toy with recklessly, this place remains a frozen waste.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: The Pact did make the road here a little more fraught than usual. But if it couldn't stop me, I can't imagine it could stop Demeter.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Forget her, and the blasted Pact. I'll stop you, myself.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 它见证了得墨忒尔恐怖的力量。即便你拿着惩罚契约胡闹，弄出了滚滚的热浪，这地方依然是一片冰封的废土。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 惩罚契约确实让这一路过来的旅程变得有点坎坷。不过，如果它连我都拦不住的话，那恐怕就更拦不住得墨忒尔了。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 别管她了，也别管那破契约了，我要亲自阻止你。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Enjoying the delicate warmth of the surface, b-- Zagreus? Apparently, the generosity of the goddess of seasons knows no bounds.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Does feel a bit different, maybe. Though, Demeter said something about how this spot, in particular, would remain bereft of warmth, as a reminder. Do you think she knows what happened with Mother, really?

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Demeter may harbor vengeful feelings and suspicions, but she is no fool. Experience teaches us to know when to quit. Though, evidently, that is a lesson you have yet to learn.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你还喜欢地面世界的温暖气候吗，孩——扎格列欧斯？很显然，四季女神对你的慷慨是无穷无尽的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 或许确实感觉不太一样。不过，得墨忒尔说了些关于这个地方的话。她说这里依然要保持严寒，以此提醒人们。你觉得，她真的已经知道发生在母亲身上的事情了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 得墨忒尔可能心怀仇恨或是怀疑，可她一点都不愚蠢。经验让我们明白什么时候该收手，不过显然，你还没学到这一课呢。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Look at yourself, boy. You barely stand, and yet believe you can surpass me in your current state?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's not exactly easy getting here, you know. But I'm not going back. Not yet.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Perhaps not yet. But very, very soon.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 看看你自己，孩子。你站都站不稳，以你这样的状态你还能打赢我不成？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 一路杀过来可不容易，你知道吗。但我绝不回去。现在不会。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 现在是不会。但是马上，你就会了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Varatha... I recognize its presence, now. That's not just any three-pronged lance you wield. I could never stand to look at it, once my brothers and my sisters and myself... once our foul work was done.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You mean once you'd chopped up your cruel and overbearing Titan parents, right? Shame you threw it out. It's quite useful.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Perhaps the Fates decided that its wielders ought to all eventually wind up on its receiving end. Come, then! Let us see what the great Achilles has taught you.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 瓦拉塔……我认得出来。你手里的可不是什么普通的三头长矛。我不敢正眼看它，我和我的兄弟姐妹曾经……曾经做过的那些丑恶的事。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你是指你们曾经把自己的泰坦爹妈大卸八块那件事吗？真可惜你把它给扔了。还挺好用的。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 也许命运之神决定让持有过这长矛的人最终都与它脱不开干系。那来吧！让我们看看伟大的阿喀琉斯都教了你什么。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: So! You think that you can vanquish me with my fool brother's old, forgotten blade. Poseidon was never any good with Stygius. Grew envious of my spearwork. Now he's famous for that fork of his! Always taking credit where none is due.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Must be hard, knowing that everybody's going to think you learned your spearwork from Poseidon, not the other way around. As for Stygius, I can assure you it's in good hands now.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Your assurances mean nothing to me, boy. You think yourself quite capable? Then show me.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 哼！你觉得自己拿着我兄弟那把破旧刀剑就能打败我了吗。波塞冬一直用不好斯第格思。后来他嫉妒上了我的枪法。再后来他就跟他那把叉子一起出名了！实不至名不归的东西。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 一定很难过吧，所有人都认为你是跟波塞冬学的，而事实恰恰相反。至于斯第格思，我向你保证它现在在正确的人手里。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你的保证对我毫无意义，孩子。你真的认为自己能独当一面了吗？证明给我看吧。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You come here bearing brother Zeus' Aegis. I wonder how much more insulting you could be.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What? I haven't even started to insult you here yet, Father. Flustered by the old Shield of Chaos, then?

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Doubtless Zeus does not even remember wielding it. I never should have relied on him for anything after that! Then, come. Let's see if you're any better with it than your great uncle.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你身上的是宙斯的埃癸斯。你还想怎样羞辱我？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 干嘛？我还什么都没说呢，父亲。只是见到这块旧混沌之盾就受不了了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 宙斯甚至都不记得用过它没有。从那以后我就不应该再依靠他！来吧，让我们看看你跟你的伟大叔叔比起来，孰强孰弱。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Hrm. It grew distinctly colder just as you arrived. So Demeter has been in contact with you, then. That witch. Tell me how much she knows.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What? I don't... wait, this everlasting winter, it's her doing, isn't it? Why? Don't mortals die when it's cold? Sounds like a lot of extra work for you.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Then you are ignorant. Keep it that way, with her. Lest you risk everything, you understand? The consequences would be far worse than a foul stretch of weather. But, enough talk, now.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 嗯，你一来这里，这里就明显变冷了。看来你已经和那个叫得墨忒尔的女巫建立了联结，和我说说她都知道些什么吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么？我没有……等等，这场阴魂不散的寒冬都是她搞出来的吗？这是怎么回事？凡人不是会冻死的吗？听起来给你增加了不少工作量啊。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 看来你真的是什么都不知道，不过你们就保持这个样子吧，这样你就不会孤注一掷了。明白我的意思吗？万一你孤注一掷，后果恐怕会比这恶劣的气候要严重得多。好了，废话就说到这里吧。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Hrm. It grew distinctly colder just as you arrived. So Demeter has been in contact with you, then. That witch. Tell me how much she knows.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: She lost her daughter... who's my mother. But, Demeter still thinks I'm Nyx's son, and... what have you done, Father? This everlasting winter, it's her doing, isn't it? Freezing mortals to death. Why don't you stop this?

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: The two of you know nothing, then, it seems. Keep it that way, especially with her. Lest you risk everything, you understand? The consequences would be far worse than a foul stretch of weather. But, enough talk, now.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 嗯，你一来这里，这里就明显变冷了。看来你已经和那个叫得墨忒尔的女巫建立了联结，和我说说她都知道些什么吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 她失去了自己的女儿……也就是我的母亲。但是，得墨忒尔仍然认为我是倪克斯的孩子，而且……你到底做了什么啊，父亲？这场无尽的寒冬是她弄出来的，是吧？凡人都冻死了，你为什么你不去阻止她？

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 看来你们两个什么都不知道。不过就保持这个样子吧，特别是对她来说，这样你就不会孤注一掷了。明白我的意思吗？万一你孤注一掷，后果恐怕会比这恶劣的气候要严重得多。好了，废话就说到这里吧。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: ...The sea... the heavens, and the earth. All of this belongs to my brothers. We are their kin by birth. But we are foreigners in their country.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No. No mournful speeches. Now get out of my way.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You impertinent brat. Fine. Impulsiveness runs in the family.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: …海洋…天堂和大地。全都属于我的兄弟。我们是亲生兄弟。但在他们的国度我们却算外人。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 停。不搞煽情讲话。滚开吧。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 没有礼貌的臭小子。行。这股冲动劲是家族遗传的。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: There was a time when Cerberus would never have permitted any soul to exit through that gateway there behind you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, that can't possibly be true! What about Orpheus, Theseus, Heracles, Odysseus? Countless tales of brave men delving into the Underworld, then leaving whence they came!

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: They left on my authority alone. Nor did they take for granted my good graces. You believe you are entitled simply to walk out of here. From your birthright and your responsibilities! But I am here to tell you, no.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 曾经，刻耳柏洛斯不让任何灵魂从你身后那扇大门离开这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这不可能吧，那俄耳甫斯怎么解释？提修斯？赫拉克勒斯？奥德修斯？传说中的英雄们都是想来就来想走就走。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 那是因为我允许他们走。他们也自知这待遇不是白给的。你要是觉得自己可以大摇大摆走出去。就因为你是我儿子，还有你所谓的责任吗？我现在告诉你，你错了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: My brothers and my sisters and myself. We, too, wanted to slay our parents. The Titans. Bastards. And worse.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: And you succeeded. Chopped up some of them into many tiny bits, and sprinkled them throughout the pits of Tartarus so that they can't regenerate! Or so I hear. Inspiring, really!

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: We had no recourse at the time, save to collaborate. Developed a specific plan, and saw it through. And, the Titans...? You think me cruel, yet know nothing of cruelty. But, here, you want something to hate, then have it!

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我和我的兄弟姐妹们，我们也想杀死自己的生父母。那些泰坦，真的是一群杂种，混账不如。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 然后你们成功了。把其中的泰坦切成无数碎片，抛撒到塔耳塔罗斯的深渊之中，这样他们就再也不能复原！我是这样听说的。很精彩！

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我们当时除了团结起来，别无他法。我们制定了一个特别的计划，然后计划成功了。然后呢，泰坦呢……？你觉得我很残酷，说明你对残酷一无所知。如果你想朝什么东西发泄怨恨，那你有了！

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I must admit to something, boy. Achilles taught you reasonably well. I expected that if anyone could train you into martial competence, it would be him.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Though you didn't expect that, one day, I would end up using everything I learned from him against you.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I anticipate more than you know. But Achilles merely practiced against mortals. Now, you practice against me.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我不得不承认，孩子。阿喀琉斯教得很好。我就知道如果有谁能将你训练地如此勇猛，那只能是他。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 但你不知道的是，有一天，我会用我从他那学到的每招每式来对付你。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我的眼光比你长远的多。但是毕竟阿喀琉斯只是对抗凡人。而你要对抗的是我。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Come all this way again, to fall to me? Would that you paid me such respects back at the House.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 一路过来，就为了败给我？如果你回到圣殿也这么尊重我就好了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: What is it going to take for you to understand that your place is in the House?!

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 到底要怎样你才能明白，你注定没法离开？！

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I shall give you no quarter, boy. Although I doubt that you expected otherwise.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 不可饶恕，孩子。我怀疑你可能有别的想法。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: The sea and air are very still this eve. Though I suppose that is about to change.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 今天傍晚的空气与海面都很平静。不过我想是时候改变一下气氛了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Know only that I take no pleasure in what I am now forced to do.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 但我现在不得不做的事并非我的本意。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: There you are. Then let us now commence this ugly business yet again.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你来了。那就让我们继续这丑陋的事务吧。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: The heavens and the seas belong to my brothers; but know that you are still in my domain.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我的兄弟掌管着海和天；但你所处的是我的领地。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You bypassed Cerberus again, I see. Unfortunately for the both of us.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你又从刻耳柏洛斯身边溜走了吧。这对我们而言都很不幸。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I had other pressing business to attend to. But I cannot let you leave.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我虽然有其他要务在身，但我不能让你离开这里。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: No matter how many times you try, your stubbornness shall get you nowhere with me.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 不管多少次都一样，倔强对你没有任何帮助。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You're back, with Stygius in hand. Come then, and show me your technique!

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你回来了啊，手里还拿着斯第格思。来吧，让我看看你的本事吧！

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: The Blade of the Underworld cannot help you here, you realize that, boy?

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 冥界之刃在这里是帮不了你的，明白了吗，孩子？

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Your heart-seeking Coronacht may have brought you this far, but shall not help you, here.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你的索心弓科罗纳赫特也许能帮你来到这里，但在这里，它帮不了你。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: That heart-seeking bow you wield... it is nothing but a tool for cowards, boy.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你手上那把索心弓……只是给懦夫用的东西罢了，孩子。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: So, Varatha and Gigaros are to clash again upon this empty field. Let us have at it, then.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 很好，瓦拉塔和吉加罗斯将在这片土地上再次碰撞，动手吧。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I knew someday the Eternal Spear would turn on me. Let's see you wield it, boy.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我早就知道，总有一天永恒之矛会指向我。让我见识见识你的本事吧，孩子。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: The Shield of Chaos... what a monstrous thing. How suitable for you.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 混沌之盾……多么阴森的东西啊，很适合你。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You bear the Aegis so much like your uncle Zeus once did.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你挥舞埃癸斯的样子，就和你宙斯叔叔当年一模一样。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You think the Rail of Adamant can vanquish me? We'll momentarily find out.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你觉得这尊狮鹫坚炮能打败我吗？马上就能知道结果了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You would take aim at me with Exagryph? Then, very well.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你竟敢用伊格瑞菲瞄准我？真是有出息了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You would attack me with the savagery of the Twin Fists? Then, come.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你要用那野蛮至极的双子之拳来对付我吗？那来吧。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Again, you seek to use the power of Malphon against me. Fine.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你又想用玛尔封的力量来对付我了，好吧。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You are predictable in your arrivals here. Less so during the fight itself.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我早就知道你会来这里，至于你要怎么战斗，我就说不好了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I was just thinking on when last I vanquished you. Come, refresh my memory.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我刚刚还在想上一次打败你是什么时候呢，来吧，让我再打败你一次。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: No matter how often you defeat me, I shall face you here.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 不管你打败我多少次，我都会在这里。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Remember, I can always get here much, much faster than you.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 记住，我永远都能比你先到达这里。我比你更快，快得多。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: No matter how quickly you're able to get here, I shall be waiting.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 不管你腿脚有多快，我永远会在这里等着你。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Again, you draw me from all my responsibilities back at the House.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 又来了，我又要放下手里的全部工作，从圣殿过来跟你战斗了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I cannot let you go, boy. Some night such as this one, you'll understand.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我不能让你走，孩子。总有一天，你会明白我的苦心。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I shall be interested to see if you can vanquish me again, here, boy.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你这次还能不能击败我呢，孩子？我很感兴趣。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Come, show me everything you've learned of how to fight.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 来吧，使出你的毕生所学，与我战斗吧。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You've slipped by Cerberus again, I see. Then, draw your weapon, boy.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你又从刻耳柏洛斯身边溜走了，拔剑吧，孩子。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I see it's time again that we begin our bloody business here.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 看来，我们又要在这里战个你死我活了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: This blasted place... how can you even stand it on the surface, here?

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 这该死的地方……你到底是怎么忍受地表的环境的？

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Who shall be first to return home this time, do you suppose?

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 猜猜看，这次谁会先回圣殿呢？

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: It seems it's time again I sent you home, myself.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 看来这次我又得亲自送你回家了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Your rampage through my realm ends here and now.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你一路上过关斩将，不过你的旅途到此为止了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I thought you might arrive right about now. Then, let us have our fight.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我还在想你也该到了吧。好了，开始战斗吧。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You'll go not one step farther past this threshold, boy.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你休想跨过这道坎，孩子。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: The world beyond my realm is not for you. You're going home.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我的国度之外的世界并不适合你，你得回家了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I wonder, boy, who's going to kill whom this time around.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我想知道，孩子，这次谁会是赢家呢？

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I cannot fathom why you wish to die repeatedly like this.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我真是想不明白，你为什么偏要这么一次又一次地求死。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Already here? It seems our Underworld still has many failings I shall have to deal with, after this.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你已经来了吗？看来和你打完之后，我要好好处理处理冥界里的那些废物了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Come show your father what you've learned of late. Do not hold back.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 来，让你的父亲见识一下你最近的长进吧，别手下留情。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Would that you cleaned your chambers with the same devotion you show getting to these heights.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 要是你在打扫房间的时候，也能像逃出这里一样充满干劲就好了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Untold murderous wretches in my realm, all at my beck and call, yet still you made it here.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我的王国里有无数穷凶极恶的暗灵，都听从我的命令，可你依然来到了这里。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You have circumvented all of my security measures again. But can you get through me?

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你又一次逃过了我所有的安保措施，可你能过得了我这关吗？

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I trust you have retained enough of your strength through this ordeal to make this worth our while?

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我相信即便是这么多磨难之后，你也依然保留着足够的实力，让我们不枉大战一场，是吧？

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Catch your breath if necessary, and then let us see if you shall earn your bonus for this day.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 如果需要的话，稍微休息一下吧，让我看看你这次能不能赢得奖励。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Bah! Not one of my overseers managed to stop you, again? Must I do everything myself?

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 啧！我那些主管又一次失败了，是吗？我真的事必躬亲不可吗？

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I've other work to get to! Arm yourself, and let us end this quickly, boy.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我还有别的工作要做！赶紧准备就绪，咱们速战速决吧，孩子。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: It seems our realm has many weaknesses. I shall deal with them shortly, then.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 看起来我们的王国依然有很多漏洞，我会尽快把这些问题解决掉。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Let us see if the support you're getting from Olympus amounts to anything of use.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 让我看看，你从奥林匹斯众神那里得到的援助有没有用吧。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Blast, but you're persistent, even now! Though let us see how strong you are, as well.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 该死的，不过你可真是锲而不舍！既然如此，咱们来看看你到底有多强吧。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I should be getting back to my desk. But I suppose the work can wait.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我应该回去工作才对，不过我觉得那些工作可以先放放。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Ah, there you are, boy! I was beginning to think I'd need a thicker cloak.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 啊，你来了，孩子！我刚刚还在想，我是不是得穿件更厚实的披风才对。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Well, Zagreus. Even if I vanquish you, arriving here is a sufficient feat.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，扎格列欧斯。就算你被我打败了，能来到这里也已经很了不起了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I must admit, this is a welcome change of pace from all the parchmentwork.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 不得不承认，偶尔能从文书工作中抽出身来，还真是挺不错的。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I suppose that you must be eager to repay me for last time, then?

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我猜，你肯定迫不及待想要报上次的一箭之仇了吧？

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I expect I shall be able to vanquish you again. Though, we shall see.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我觉得这次赢的人还会是我，我们大可以走着瞧。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Perhaps the blasted Fates shall favor me, for once.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 或许该死的命运女神也该垂青我一次了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Our last exchange left much to be desired, for my part. But this time, we shall see.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我们上一次交手有很多不足之处，是我这边的问题。不过这一次，我们走着瞧吧。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: ...Tsch. To have been brought this low... by my own ungrateful child. I would expect such treatment from my brothers, but from you...? Nrrrgghhh....

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: ……哧。竟然把我逼到如此地步……你这逆子。我以为只有我的兄弟可以做到这样，你竟然也……？呃啊啊啊……

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: ...Such contempt, for your own father. But we are not finished here, yet.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: ……竟然如此蔑视自己的父亲。还没结束呢。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: ...Your youth provides you with a certain mindless strength. But, such power has its limits.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: ……年轻的身体给与了你这种无脑的力量。但是这种力量，是有极限的。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: ...Now that we had our little warm-up, it is time that we began in earnest.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: ……现在热完了身子，要开始认真了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: ...You strike at your own father. What choice does that leave me.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: ……你竟敢对自己的父亲出手。我总不能站着挨打吧。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: ...Hmph. All right, then, boy. You've stirred my anger suitably, by now.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: ……哼。好吧，孩子，你算是把我惹毛了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Urgh... no... I'm... not... finished... with you... yet!!

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 呃啊……不……咱们之间……还没完事……还没完！！

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I... how... you.... Go. Go, then. Go!! Get out of here! Get out!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I told you that I would, Father. And I'm going to. Goodbye.

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: ...Wait. Wait, just... if you... if you find her. If you somehow find her? Tell her something for me, tell her... Tell her Cerberus is doing very well.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What? Wait. I don't think I owe you any favors, here. Though, answer me one question, and I'll give it some thought, how's that?

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: ...I know your question, boy. But, ask it anyway.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Persephone. My mother. Why did she leave?

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: ...I... urgh... blood and darkness...

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我……怎么……可能……走吧，走吧。快走吧！！离开这个地方！快滚吧！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我说过了我会走的，父亲。现在也没有改变主意。再见。

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: ……等等。等一下，如……如果……如果你找到她了。如果你遇见了她。替我跟她说一声，告诉她……告诉她刻耳柏洛斯现在很好。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么？等下。我又不欠你什么干嘛帮你带话。不过，要是你回答我一个问题，我就考虑一下，怎么样？

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: ……我知道你想问什么，孩子。问就是了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 珀尔塞福涅。我的母亲。她为什么要离开？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're not going to cooperate with me on this, are you? Even now, knowing Mother wants to see me again?

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Urgh! Blast you... you shall ruin everything... with all your damnable questions!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Then, die, already. And get the hell out of my way.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这件事情你就不能通融一下吗？你明明知道母亲也很想见我一面，不是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 呃啊！你这个混蛋……你总问那些该死的问题……你会把一切都毁了的！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那就去死吧，别再挡我的路了。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: ...Blast you, boy... we should have never sprung from Chaos... none of this...

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: ……你这个臭小子……我们根本就不应该从卡俄斯身上诞生……这一切都不应该……

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Urgh.... <Gasp> How... I... I went all out! And still...?

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 呃啊……<喘息>不可能……我……已经全力以赴了！可还是……？

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Blast you, boy. You think you are superior to me? You are a fool.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 小兔崽子。你觉得自己比我强吗？愚蠢。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Urgh...! With your youth comes a certain strength, it seems.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 啊啊啊……！ 看起来，是你年轻的身体给了你这股力量。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Tsch... I... I shall see you back at home.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 啧……我……我们回家再见。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: How? How is this possible, that this... urgh!

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 这，这怎么可能？这……啊！

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Ungh... The world you seek out there... it's even crueler than the one you know.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 呃……你所寻求的外面的世界……比这里要残酷的多。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Augh! Why... I was much stronger once, than this...

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 啊啊！怎么会这样……看来我已经大不如从前了……

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Aah, blast! That you of all my kin would be the one, to do this, to me....

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 啊，可恶！在我所有的家人之中，会对我做出这种事情的，只有你……

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Mmph... No matter how many times you beat me... we're family. There's no escaping that.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 嗯……不管你打败我多少次……我们依然是一家人，这一点永远不会改变。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Again, you have defeated me, somehow. And yet...

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 无论如何，你又打败了我。但是……

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: What shall it take... what shall it take for you to...

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你要付出……你要付出怎样的代价……

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Ungh, you... tell no one at the House. Do you hear me?

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 呃，你……不准把这件事告诉圣殿里的人，听到了吗？

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Rrngh, you stubborn... you shrug off death as though it means nothing to you...!

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 呃啊，你这顽固的家伙……你总是对死亡嗤之以鼻，就好像它对你而言毫无意义……！

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: ...I shall keep coming back... the same as you...!

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: ……我还会回来的……和你一样……！

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: You... you think that you're the only one... who shall keep fighting?

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 你……你以为你是唯一一个……会坚持战斗的人吗？

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: I must admit... you've learned something. At some point, in all this.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 我必须承认……你学到了不少东西。在某一个时刻。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Urgh... were it not for all my wretched kin upon Olympus, you...

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 呃……要不是因为奥林匹斯山上的那群混蛋亲戚，你早就……

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Rngh, vanquished again... by my own fool kin....

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 啊啊啊，我又输了……被我自己的傻儿子打败了……

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Guh! Boy, you speak none of this, to anyone!

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 啊啊！孩子，不准把这件事告诉任何人！

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Urgh! How did... you accomplish this...?

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 呃呃！你怎么……你是怎么做到的……？

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Nrgh! You cannot escape... none of us can.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 呃！你是逃不掉的……我们谁都逃不掉。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Augh... then, go, see what awaits you in this realm...

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 啊啊……去吧，去看看这个世界有什么在等着你……

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Gah... I, fell to you, again, I... how...?

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 啊……我，又败给你了，我……怎么可能……？

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Gah... you have your mother's perseverance. How is it that you got this strong?

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 呃啊……你和你母亲一样不屈不挠，你到底是怎么变得这么强的？

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Urngh! It seems... I was no match for you, this time.

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 呃啊！看起来……我这次不是你的对手。

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Augh... I'm not as limber as I used to be, while you...?

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 啊啊……看来我已经大不如从前了，而你却……？

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Nngh... for a student of Achilles... I fear that you surpass even his skill, by now...

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 呃啊……你是阿喀琉斯的学生……但我觉得，你现在的技艺已经比他更强了……

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Umphh... you broke through every one of my defenses, once again...

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 呃啊……你又一次把我的安保措施全都摧毁了……

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Argh... you bested me, I'll grant you, Zagreus...

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 啊……我承认，这次是你赢了，扎格列欧斯……

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Ungh... Olympus gave you quite the edge against me, then...

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 呃啊……奥林匹斯众神给你的力量，还真是挺强的啊……

en.speaker: HadesField
en.text: Grngh... you owe this victory to all your relatives...

zh-CN.speaker: HadesField
zh-CN.text: 呃啊……你之所以能赢，多亏了你那些亲戚……

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Mmmrrrrnnn....

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know, Charon, your associate Hermes apparently had a wager with you that I could beat you twice in a row at some point? I'd hate to disappoint him, so... no hard feelings?

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Nnnrrrraaaaaauugggghhh!!

zh-CN.speaker: Charon
zh-CN.text: 嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 卡戎，你的同伴赫尔墨斯和你打了个赌，赌我有朝一日肯定能连续打败你两次，对不对？我可不想让他失望，所以……希望你别见怪，好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: Charon
zh-CN.text: 呃呃呃啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Haaahhhhh....

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, Charon, look, I can explain. It's just, I've grown very accustomed to taking stuff throughout my father's realm. I wasn't stealing from you, honestly!

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Mmnnnrraaauuugggghhh!!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That was not an understanding sound. Wait, why are you brandishing your oar in such a menacing way?

zh-CN.speaker: Charon
zh-CN.text: 哈啊啊啊啊啊啊……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，你看，卡戎，我可以解释的。我只是，呃，只是习惯了随手拿走我父亲领土上的一切东西。我没打算偷你的东西，我是说真的！

zh-CN.speaker: Charon
zh-CN.text: 呃呃呃啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 听起来你没明白我的意思。等等，你干嘛要用那么吓人的姿势挥你的船桨？

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Haaahhhhh....

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're just testing me, here, right, Charon? I mean, when you place a huge sum of coin conspicuously within my reach, what do you expect me to do?

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Nrrnnhhh, hnnnn, hrrnn, hrrrrrnnn...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sounds good, mate, when I rob you from now on it's just my way of saying Charon, I would like to battle you to the death right now for a quick change of pace.

zh-CN.speaker: Charon
zh-CN.text: 哈啊啊啊啊啊啊……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你是在考验我，没错吧，卡戎？我是说，你把这么多亮闪闪的金币特意摆在我的面前，那你还指望我会怎么做？

zh-CN.speaker: Charon
zh-CN.text: 呃嗯嗯，哈嗯嗯，赫嗯嗯，呃嗯嗯嗯嗯……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 听起来不错，伙计。我抢你的东西的时候，我其实在我用自己的方式对你说这句话：卡戎，我想和你打个至死方休，好调剂调剂心情。

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hrrrnnnggghh....

zh-CN.speaker: Charon
zh-CN.text: 呼呃呃啊啊啊啊啊啊啊……

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Grrnrnhh, rrraahhh!

zh-CN.speaker: Charon
zh-CN.text: 呃呃啊啊啊啊，啊啊啊啊啊啊！

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hrraaaahhhhhh!!

zh-CN.speaker: Charon
zh-CN.text: 呼啊啊啊啊啊啊！！

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hrrn... grrraaauuuggghh!!

zh-CN.speaker: Charon
zh-CN.text: 嗯嗯……嘎啊啊啊啊啊啊！！

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Rrnn... hhrraaaauuuggghh!!

zh-CN.speaker: Charon
zh-CN.text: 哼嗯……呼啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Grrr... nrrraauuuggghhh!!

zh-CN.speaker: Charon
zh-CN.text: 咯呃……呜啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Urrh... urraaauuuggghh!!

zh-CN.speaker: Charon
zh-CN.text: 呃呃……呃啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Krrr... krraauuuggghh!!

zh-CN.speaker: Charon
zh-CN.text: 咳呃……咔啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hhh, hrreehhhhh!!

zh-CN.speaker: Charon
zh-CN.text: 呵呃，呵呃呃呃啊啊啊啊！！

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Haahh, nrraugh, haaaaah!!

zh-CN.speaker: Charon
zh-CN.text: 哈啊啊，呜啊啊，哈啊啊啊啊！！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Got you, mate! Twice in a row. I guess Hermes wins his little wager with you, then. You tell him I said hrrrrrnnnggghh!

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hrrrrrnnnggghh...

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是我赢了，伙计！我已经连续赢两次了。看来，赫尔墨斯和你打的赌是他赢了。你可以告诉它，我说了句喝啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

zh-CN.speaker: Charon
zh-CN.text: 喝啊啊啊啊啊啊啊……

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Why, look, Zagreus, here comes brave Athena, first to reach you among all my kin, in all her shrewdness. So proactive, you contacted Zagreus prior to even telling me, my dear!

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Lord Father, would that I could settle even more such matters quickly and discreetly, so that only the most vital of them rise up to the level of your notice, sir. Though, I'm certain Zagreus and I are very grateful you have intervened.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 快看，扎格列欧斯，勇武过人的雅典娜来了。她是个机灵能干的家伙，也是我的家人之中最先和你见面的人。你真是太主动了，甚至没告诉我就和扎格列欧斯碰了面，亲爱的女儿！

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 父亲大人，希望我能迅速、谨慎地解决更多诸如此类的事情，这样您只需要处理最重要的问题就够了。不过，可以肯定的是，我和扎格列欧斯都非常感激您的介入。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Nephew! By my divine authority, my oft-misunderstood son, Ares, now shall lend you a small token of his power. I'll make him helpful yet!

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: It shall be exactly as you say, Lord Father. Your wishes are identical to mine.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我的侄子！我经常无辜背负恶名的儿子阿瑞斯，现在将以我的神威为你赋予他的力量。我会让他帮忙的！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲大人，遵命。我们的目标是一致的。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Young man, I know you'd like to get to know the comely Aphrodite face to face, or I don't know, you can decide once you arrive at last! He can decide, isn't that right, my Lady Aphrodite, hm?

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Why, I never, Lord Zeus! That sounded rather like a crass remark, from you! How shocking that the golden standard for the rest of us should have such words for me!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 年轻人，我知道你很想和阿弗洛狄忒面对面地交流。不过，或许我想错了呢，还是等你来这里之后再说吧！他想不想来，得看他的意思，你说是吧，我亲爱的阿弗洛狄忒？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 你这么说是什么意思，宙斯大人！你的话听起来就像是在侮辱我一样！被我们大家尊为天父的人，竟然会对我说出这样的话，这真是太让我震惊了！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Now, Zagreus, once you arrive, we'll have to find for you a suitable mate, won't we? Fine young man such as yourself! Normally, there's much to choose from around here, with some exceptions, of course... such as my cunning daughter, Artemis. Willfully uninclined to take a mate, at all!

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Yes, Zagreus, in spite of all these perfect, chiseled prospects everywhere about, yearning to marry or embarrass me, for some reason, I prefer to spend my time mostly alone or with my nymph friends in the woods!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，你一来这儿我们就会给你找一位合适的伴侣。我敢说，一定要是一位和你一样优秀的年轻人！正常来说，这里有很多可供你选择的，不过也有一些例外，比如……我可爱的女儿，阿尔忒弥斯。她根本不打算寻求一位伴侣！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 是的，扎格列欧斯，尽管我到哪里都能遇到完美英俊的有为青年，他们与其说是想娶我，不如说是让我难堪，因为我宁愿独自待着或在森林里陪伴我的女仙朋友们！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Now, now, young man, whatever you have heard about good Demeter, I'm here to clear the air. She's like a sister to me, yes, but only thus. Although her Titan parents and my own met the same fate.

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Why, Foster-Brother Zeus! Such an unlikely bit of candor there, from you! Almost as though you felt compelled to speak the truth only whilst I'm directly within earshot.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 好了，年轻人，不管你听说的得墨忒尔是什么样的人，我都得澄清一下。没错，对我来说她就像姐姐一样，但也仅此而已。不过，她的泰坦双亲和我的父母都遭遇了差不多的命运。

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我的义兄弟宙斯啊！你这次还真是坦率得有点过头啊！我甚至觉得，只有我在场的时候，你才不得不实话实说吧。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Have you encountered Exagryph and said to it the waking-phrase I gave to you, young man? Why, I'd tell Exagryph myself! Remember, it's I see your prideful fall down from the heavens to the flames.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 你已经见过伊格瑞菲，对它说出那句我告诉你的唤醒咒语了吗，年轻人？哎哟，我要是能亲口说出这句咒语就好了！别忘了，那句话是我看到高傲的你从天堂跌落下来，落入了地狱的烈焰之中。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Now that is an entirely unusual design, even for Exagryph! So then the waking-phrase has worked. That aspect's bearer, Lucifer, was it? Struck his own lord father! Tried to, anyway. A not uncommon story it would seem.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 就算是对伊格瑞菲来说，这样的设计也是非比寻常！看来，我教给你的咒语起作用了。那个形态的主人是叫路西法，是吧？他用这门炮打了他自己的父亲！或者说，他有这个打算。看起来，这样的事情还挺常见的嘛。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I gather Lady Demeter's already got her frigid hold on you, certainly not the warmest member of the clan, now, is she? But do be patient with her, she's been through a lot.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜你早就被得墨忒尔女士冻得够呛了，很明显，她不是个擅长暖场的人，对不对？不过你得对她耐心点，毕竟她经历了很多痛苦的事情。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: My good sister Demeter already tried to poison you against me, as I understand, young man? Oh, foster-sister she prefers I say, loath as she is to accept her role as part of our great family.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 依我看，我那好姐姐得墨忒尔已经试着挑拨过你我的关系了，年轻人？她更希望我叫她养姊妹，毕竟她很不乐意承认自己属于我们这伟大的一族。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: You must forgive the Lady Demeter her scornfulness, Nephew, for she is still recovering after the sudden disappearance of her daughter, though it was quite some time ago the girl, poof! Just vanished. I try to lighten up the mood around it every now and then, but no, a sore spot, still!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 希望你能谅解得墨忒尔夫人的轻蔑态度，侄子，因为她至今未从她女儿的突然失踪中平复悲痛。很久之前那个女孩儿，嘭！就这样消失了。自那时起我就尽力想让笼罩其上的悲伤消散，但，不，它至今仍令人心痛！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Poor Demeter, young man. We still wonder what became of her fair daughter. Ran away with mortals, there, perhaps? Some of the tales, even more preposterous. Don't go believing everything you hear, and do be sensitive about the subject, hm? Demeter, she's been through quite enough.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 得墨忒尔真是个可怜人，年轻人，我们到现在都不知道她美丽的女儿怎么样了。有人说她跟凡人私奔了，还有的说法比这个还荒谬。你可不能全盘相信听到的传言，对这个话题也要敏感一点，好吗？得墨忒尔经历过的痛苦太多了。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: The Lady Demeter still prattles on about her missing girl, Zagreus. But I want you to understand something, all right? She's gone. We all have grieved. Perhaps Demeter shall finally accept what has occurred, and we can move forward, having grown stronger as a family.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 得墨忒尔女士还是不停地在提起她失踪的女儿，扎格列欧斯。不过，希望你能明白一些事情，好吗？她走了，我们都很伤心。或许得墨忒尔某一天会接受这个现实，到时候我们就可以走出阴霾，让我们的家族变得更加强大。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sure hope this works.... In the name of Hades! Olympus, this is an official message! For you, in all your splendor, Lord Uncle Zeus.

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: My, what is this you have for me, young man? Appears to be a message of some sort, bearing my thunder sigil! Though, there's one for everybody on Olympus? Have they as yet received their own? I must know what it says... it's from your father, who else could it be? I'd better check on this!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 希望这能有用……以哈迪斯之名！奥林匹斯山，这是一份官方来信！是给您的，宙斯叔叔，您的神力光彩夺目。

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 你这是要给我什么，年轻人？看起来像是信，上面还有我的闪电印记！每个奥林匹斯神都有自己的印记，是吧？他们也收到信了吗？我得看看里面写了什么……除了你父亲还能有谁写这个？我得赶紧好好看看！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I eagerly await learning some more about the contents of that fascinating message you had sent up here, Nephew! How mysterious, indeed. I'll be keeping an eye on all the others that come in!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 你之前送来的那封信，我已经迫不及待地想要了解更多内容了，侄子！这真是太神秘了，我会密切留意所有其它送过来的东西！

en.speaker: Zeus
