en.text: I have to tell you, Zagreus, that it was wonderful to meet with you, at last! We were so pleased to learn Persephone was safe! And Nyx, why, she's as stunning as they say. Shouldn't have lied to us about your parentage, but, I know things get complicated, here, and that what's done is done!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 有件事我必须告诉你，扎格列欧斯，终于能和你见上一面了，这真是太好了！听说珀尔塞福涅安然无恙，我们都很高兴。还有倪克斯，哎呀，她真是和传闻中的那样仪态万方。关于你的父母，你本不应该对我们撒谎。不过我也明白，这件事情很复杂，所以过去的事情就过去了吧！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Poseidon sought you out already, hm? My boastful brother gets on with Lord Hades even worse than I, so let me put a little spark into his storms for you!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 波塞冬找到你了吗？我的这个哥哥爱吹牛炫耀，我和他的关系已经够糟了，没想到他和冥王哈迪斯的关系更差，我可以从中挑拨一下，让他为你助战！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: My brave daughter Athena beat me to you this time, has she? No matter, with her blessing and my own, you shall be nigh unstoppable!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我勇敢的女儿雅典娜抢在我之前找到了你，是吗？没关系，有了她的祝福和我的祝福，你将势不可挡！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Has lovely Aphrodite put you in a trance already, Zagreus? Or might I offer you the blessing of Olympus to intensify her catastrophic power with my own?

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 可爱的阿弗洛狄忒把你催眠了吗，扎格列欧斯？或者，我可以向你提供奥林匹斯山的祝福，用我自己的力量来强化她灾难性的力量？

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: So my elusive Artemis has shown you favor, has she? The little scamp, she seldom shows respect to anyone, not even me! But I'll enhance her blessing nonetheless.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 行踪诡异的阿尔忒弥斯对你很好，是吗？这个顽皮的小家伙一向很放肆，对谁都是这样，包括我！但我还是要加强她的祝福。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Getting along with Ares, are you, Nephew? Heh. Would that you were my son instead of he, but no, I jest, I jest! Here, take my blessing, please!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 你和阿瑞斯相处得好吗，侄子？嗨。我真希望你才是我的儿子，而不是他，不，我只是开玩笑，开玩笑，请接受我的祝福吧！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: It pleases me to know, young man, that you and Dionysus have been getting on so well. He could use a level-headed friend, and you could use my blessing!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 年轻人，知道你和迪奥尼索司相处得很好，我很高兴。他需要一个沉稳的朋友，你也需要我的祝福！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Hmm! You've traveled rather quickly to this point... which reminds me, I've not seen swift Hermes anywhere of late! The rascal's likely dallying about!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 唔，你到这里真可谓迅速……不过这可提醒我了，我竟很久都没见到赫尔墨斯了！那个小鬼恐怕在到处磨蹭呢！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Nephew, I have somewhat of a favor I must ask. You tell your father, if you so happen to run into him again, that his brother Zeus forgives him, and would like to reconnect, and welcome him into the family again. You tell him for me, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 侄子，我得请你帮个忙。如果你再遇到你的父亲，告诉他，他的弟弟宙斯原谅他了，希望和他重归于好，欢迎他再次融入到家庭。替我告诉他，好吗？

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: So you are son to Hades by that Nyx, the night-goddess, is that correct, Nephew...? Well I suppose she's closest to a queen as your lord father's like to find down there. I tried to match him up with some more wholesome types, but no, and here we are.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说，你是哈迪斯和黑夜女神倪克斯的儿子，对吗，侄子……？好吧，你父亲在冥界能找到的这些人里面，我猜也就她看起来最像个皇后了。我试过给他介绍过更适合当贤妻良母的人选，但没成功，结果你看，就变成这样了。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: After we learned about your plight and your existence from the goddess Nyx, all of us on Olympus rallied to assist you just as best we could. A family such as mine protects its own!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 当我们从女神倪克斯那里得知你的困境和存在后，奥林匹斯众神都聚集起来，尽我们所能帮助你。像我们这样的家庭肯定是会保护家人的！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: My brothers Hades and Poseidon once fought bravely by my side, you know that, don't you, Nephew? We prevailed against the Titans and established law upon the earth. Your father then descended to the land of death, and we've not seen much of each other since.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我的兄弟哈迪斯和波塞冬曾经与我一起英勇作战，你知道这些的，对吗，侄子？我们战胜了泰坦，并在凡间建立了律法。后来，你的父亲到冥界去主持大局，从那以后我们就很少见面了。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Your father must have told you that his governance over the Underworld is due more to the weaving of the Fates than by his choice. Admittedly, he got the short end of the stick. Whereas Poseidon and myself, why, we've been doing rather well indeed.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 你父亲一定告诉过你，他之所以掌管冥界，更多的是命运之神的安排，而不是他的选择。无可否认，这对他不公平。而波塞冬和我，唉，我们过得还不错。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: My brother Hades always was a lonesome man, you know. I pitied him! But I could never quite extract him from his thorny shell. Now he stews resentfully down there. You needn't bear the brunt of his frustrations.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道，我哥哥哈迪斯是个孤独的人。我很同情他！但我永远无法把他从痛苦的深渊拯救出来。现在，他虽然呆在那里，但心中愤愤不平。而你没必要跟着他受罪。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Old Hades has continued to ignore my every effort to reach out to him, young man. Ah well, but he is obstinate, indeed. You are wise to seek your family's better half.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 老哈迪斯一直无视我每次向他伸出的援手，年轻人。不过，他的确很固执。你努力发现家人好的一面是明智的。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: By the way, Nephew, I hear-tell your mother Nyx is quite the catch! If you'll forgive my saying so, of course. Your father's never had much of a sensibility around companionship, though perhaps this concubine of his brought something out in him, at last!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 顺便一提，侄儿，我听说你的母亲倪克斯是个美人儿！抱歉，我的说法可能不太妥当。你的父亲一直都不在乎什么伴侣、陪伴之类的事情，但看来你的母亲终于让他有所改观了！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: If and when you reach the surface, Zagreus, you call upon me then and there, all right? I'll personally see to it that you'll be escorted up to Olympus, and your quest shall be complete!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，如果你到了凡界，一定来找我，好吗？我会亲自护送你到奥林匹斯山，完成你的任务！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I know just how much you must want out of there, young man. And I want that as well! Heh. Good thing for you, as I get what I want around here. Ask anybody!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道你有多想逃出这个地方，年轻人，我也想从这里逃出去！嗨。好消息是，我在这里得到了自己想要的东西，你到处打听一下吧！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: You fight your father's legions with Varatha, the Eternal Spear? The irony must not escape him, for he long ago stood by my side against the Titans, with that thing in hand!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 你会用永恒之矛瓦拉塔英勇对抗你父亲的军团，对吗？这样荒唐的事肯定没法瞒过他，因为，很久以前他就和我一起与泰坦族人一起厮杀，手里就拿着那件兵器！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: It seems the bow called Coronacht is safe and sound there in your hands, young man. I've not seen that old thing in quite some time!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 看来那把叫做“科罗纳赫特”的弓在你手里是安全可靠的，年轻人。我有好长一段时间没看到那件旧兵器了！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: That shield of yours, called Aegis, why, in fact, it's mine from long ago, young man! I've no more need of it, of course, though how you found it, you shall have to tell me once you're here!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 那面盾叫埃癸斯，事实上，很久以前那是我的兵器，年轻人！当然，我不再需要它了，不过，你是怎么找到它的，你到了以后得告诉我！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Well, if it isn't the one and only Rail of Adamant in your possession, there! To strike one's enemies from afar is really the only way, I think, and it's about as good a substitute for lightning bolts as you're likely to find!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 你手上的不就是唯一的一把狮鹫坚炮吗！我觉得，你就应该从远距离把敌人干掉，虽然你用不了天雷，但这玩意其实也相当不错了！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Now, isn't that Malphon the Twin Fists there in your possession, Zagreus? Last god I saw bedecked in those old gloves was Demeter herself, oh, way back when! She was a real fighter at the time, not just a naysayer!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 这不是玛尔封的双子之拳吗，扎格列欧斯？上一次见到这双旧手套的时候，还是得墨忒尔本人戴着它呢，噢，那真是好久好久以前了！她当时不光爱唱反调，而且可能打了！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Ah, now that's the Aegis that I know and love! Or used to love, at least, the dear old thing! Now I quite love these shocking bolts of mine. Though I am proud you've given Aegis a good home, and bear it in my name!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，这不是我最喜欢的埃癸斯嘛！或者说以前最喜欢的，我亲爱的老战友！现在我最喜欢的是我这些闪电，不过你给了埃癸斯一个好归宿。我真为你感到骄傲，以我的名义挥舞它吧！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Hark, young man, for I've a vision I must share with you! A waking-phrase for Exagryph, to be precise. Please beseech the weapon thus: I see your prideful fall down from the heavens to the flames. An odd connection to a past or future bearer, apparently one who defied a god!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 哈，年轻人，我必须告诉你我看到了什么！确切地说，我看到了唤醒伊格瑞菲的咒语，对那把武器说出这句话吧：我看到高傲的你从天堂跌落下来，落入了地狱的烈焰之中。这把武器曾经的主人和未来的主人之间，有着某种奇怪的联系。很显然，他们都敢于挑战神明！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Nephew, I wanted to mention, it was odd how by every account you'd come quite close to breaking free from there at last, of late... only to be abruptly cut off from our contact! I suppose having suffered some ill fate? Perhaps your realm's guardian, Cerberus, is even deadlier than reputed!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 侄儿，我一直想问，最近你每次都快要成功逃脱的时候……我们之间的联系就突然被切断了！难道是命运作祟？说不定，你们的守门者刻耳柏洛斯比传说中的要更厉害呢！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Your dear mother Persephone is a shrewd woman, Zagreus. More than an equal to your mighty father! I'm pleased to know you've made amends with her, and taken new responsibilities within your House! Naturally, I'll continue to pitch in. And, I hope that we'll meet again, someday!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 你亲爱的母亲珀塞弗涅是个机灵的女人，扎格列欧斯，完完全全配得上你强大的父亲！听说你和她已经修复了关系，而且你在圣殿里也有了新的职务，我感到很高兴！当然了，我会继续帮你的忙的。希望以后有一天，能和你再见一面！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I must say, Nephew! Although it pleases me that we, here, reconnected with your father's realm... just between us, it pleases me even more that you are able to keep sticking it to him! You keep that up, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我不得不说，侄子！看到我们与你父亲的王国重新建立了联系，我真的很高兴……另外私下和你说，看到你能让你的父亲吃点苦头，这让我更高兴了！你就再接再厉，好吗？

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Zagreus, you have a clever mother in Persephone! A very clever mother. And a lordly father! They make quite the team, that's evident! True rivals for Hera and me!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，你的母亲珀尔塞福涅是个聪明人！她很聪明，你的父亲也很有王者风范！不用我说，他们可真是天作之合！都快要赶上我和赫拉了！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: The lord and ruler of Olympus and the world, why, he needs a healthy sense of humor, no, young man? Now there's an awful lot of spoil-sports out here, can't take even a little joke, well, I know all their mothers, fie on all of them, I say! Let's joke away!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 就算是奥林匹斯之王、全世界的统治者，也应该懂点幽默感，对吧，年轻人？但现在就有一群专扫他人兴致的人，玩笑都开不起。这些人的妈我全都认识，去他们的妈吧！我们想开玩笑就开玩笑！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I suppose even down in the Underworld, you would have heard such tales of me, young man. They're all untrue, hahaha! Except the tales of my bravery. Those are completely accurate, though all too modest, in most cases, I must say.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜，就算是在冥界这样的地方，你也听过关于我的传说吧，年轻人。那些都是瞎编的，哈哈哈！当然，关于我英勇事迹的传说除外，那些都是真人真事。不过我还是觉得，那些故事完全没展现出来我真正的英姿。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Ah, must be my gleaming Thunder Signet that I transferred to you! Why, I could feel its call from all the way up here!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，那肯定是我之前传给你的雷霆之印吧！我在这里都能感受到它的召唤！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Why you look positively dreadful, Zagreus. That place is doing you no favors, I can tell! Luckily, I'll do you favors aplenty!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，你看上去好憔悴啊。我看得出来，你在那边的日子过得很苦！幸运的是，我会为你提供很多帮助！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: You seem in dire need of some assistance, Nephew. So, of course, I dropped what I was doing and then sought you out as quickly as I could!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 侄子，你看起来有麻烦。不管是什么事，我都会尽快赶到你身边！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Zagreus, you must have left most of your lifeblood back the other way, hahahaha! Oh, I jest, I jest! But you look terrible.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，你的热血好像都挥洒在路上了啊。哈哈哈哈！开玩笑的，开玩笑！但是你看起来真的很不妙。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: No, no one likes to die, young man! But since you seem about to any moment now, you keep your head held high, do you hear me?

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 不，没人喜欢死亡，年轻人！不过既然你随时都有可能丧命，那还不如保持乐观态度呢，明白了吗？

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Well, let's face it, Zagreus, you are as good as dead right now. But you'll just slosh right back out of the River Styx, and give it a good try again, won't you?

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，实话实说吧，扎格列欧斯，你现在跟死人没什么两样了。不过你肯定会从冥河里爬出来，然后重新来过，对吧？

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Remember, young man, dying is for mortals. So don't go making a habit of it, there! But if you have to do it, do it fighting, like a hero would!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 记住，年轻人，只有凡人才会死亡。所以别没事寻死！但如果不得不死，那就像个英雄一样，战斗至死吧！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I wonder, Nephew, whether you're prepared as yet to harness the surpassing power I shall grant you now? Don't take this blessing lightly, and may you use it well.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我在想，侄子，你准备好驾驭我赐予你的超级神力了吗？不要小看这个祝福，希望你能好好利用它。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: How about, young man, we cease with all the trifling down there and cause a real storm for once? Take now the fiercest of my powers, and you show your no-good father what you're made of!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 年轻人，不要再混日子了，轰轰烈烈的来一场真正的战斗怎么样？现在用我赐予你的强大神力，让你没用的父亲大开眼界！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Is this really him? OK. In the name of Hades! Olympus! I accept this message.

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Greetings there, young man! Look, your father's always been rather difficult, and he's not so much as called in quite some time. You'll have a better home where you belong, here on Olympus! And to help you on your journey, have my blessing.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这真的是他吗？好吧。以哈迪斯之名！奥林匹斯山！我收到了这条消息。

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 你好啊，年轻人！听着，你父亲一向不好相处，和我们断绝联系也有一断时间了。不过，如果你来奥林匹斯山的话，你会有个更温暖的家！这里的家人们也会在征途中帮助你，接受我的祝福吧。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: We meet again, young man! Yours isn't my affair, I know, and yet I cannot help but take an interest in your plight. Your father cast his lot; he need not take his anger out on you.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我们又见面了，年轻人！我知道不该多管闲事，但我还是忍不住对你的处境感到担忧。你父亲被分到冥界是命运的安排；他没必要把气出在你身上。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Hello, young man, and might I offer you a little taste of the heavens themselves? Though, don't go telling your old sulky father I've been spoiling you rotten!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 你好，年轻人，想尝尝天堂的味道吗？不过，千万别告诉你那脾气古怪的老父亲，我一直这么宠你！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I and all of us upon Olympus are anticipating your success, dear Nephew! Now let me see if I can't help spur you along.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 亲爱的侄子，我和奥林匹斯山上的众神都期待着你的成功！现在，让我看看能不能帮帮你，送你一程。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Well, my nephew, you're admittedly in quite a bind down there, but what is life without its struggles, hm? You'll make it here, eventually, I'm certain.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧，我的侄子，你在那里显然很难熬，但是没有挫折的生活，还能叫生活吗？我相信，最后你肯定会成功的。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I like the fire in you, Zagreus, and I have every confidence you'll someday clamber from the shadows there into the light!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我喜欢你身上的火焰，扎格列欧斯，我相信，总有一天，你会从黑暗中逃脱，来到光明的世界！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Here on Olympus, Nephew, we take care of one another and support each other, quite unlike how it must be there in your father's grim domain. No wonder you intend to leave!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 侄子，在奥林匹斯山上，我们互相照顾，互相支持，和你父亲掌管的严酷冥界完全不一样。怪不得你想离开那里！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I'd ask you offer my respects to your lord father, Zagreus, but I suspect you won't have such a chance anytime soon, considering how far you'll come with my support!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，请向你的父亲大人转达我的敬意，但考虑到你在我的帮助下能逃多远，我觉得你最近不会有这样的机会！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Remember you've as many chances as it takes, young man, to fight your way out of the dark and join us in the splendor of Olympus!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 年轻人，请记住，你有大把的机会杀出重围，逃离黑暗的冥界，并最终到达奥林匹斯山的光明彼岸！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Your grim-faced father's such a spoilsport, Nephew, the way he keeps impeding your escape. Ah, well, just keep at it, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 侄子，你凶神恶煞的父亲真是个扫兴的老家伙，他总是阻挠你的逃跑计划。我们是要坚持下去，知道吗？

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: My greetings, young Nephew, and more importantly, my blessing and my strength be with you as you journey towards your rightful home.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 年轻的侄子，你好，更重要的是，我的祝福和力量最终会帮助你找到真正的家。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Faith and courage, Zagreus, for each and every one of us upon Olympus is behind you all the way throughout this whole affair.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 要坚持你的信仰和勇气，扎格列欧斯，奥林匹斯众神会全程为你加油鼓劲，做你坚强的后盾。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: What can I say, young man? You may not make your father very proud, but it is just the opposite with me! Now go, get out of there!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我能说什么呢，年轻人？你父亲也许不会为你骄傲，但对我，却恰恰相反！现在就行动吧，离开那里！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Now, Nephew, how about we put both of our backs into this one, and see to it that you go farther through those depths than you have ever managed yet!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 好了，侄子，让我们联合起来，这次你一定要在深渊里走得比以前更远！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Know that many mortals ask me for my blessings constantly, and I mean all the time, young Nephew, but for you! You needn't ask at all!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 要知道，许多人不断地向我祈求祝福，我的意思是一直如此，小侄子，但是为了你！根本不用你说！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Far be it from me to raise my hand against your father, dear Nephew! Although I do suppose old Hades has it coming, doesn't he.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 亲爱的侄子，我决不会对你父亲动手的！不过，我认为老哈迪斯还是会来的，不是吗？

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I've every confidence in you, young man! Now you remember that, and take my blessing here, and fight your way on out of there for me!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我对你很有信心，年轻人！现在你要记住这一点，带上我的祝福，为我从那儿杀出一条路来！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Nephew, I want you to go and show that surly Hades everything you're made of! And, I've arranged for you a little bit of help along the way!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 侄子，你得让那个总是板着脸的哈迪斯见识见识你的本事！而且，我已经在路上为你安排了一点帮助！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: How is old Hades doing, anyway, Nephew? I suspect he's every bit as prickly as ever, whereas you are nothing of the sort!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 老哈迪斯怎么样了，侄子？我猜他还是像以前那样脾气暴躁，而你根本不是那种人！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I eagerly anticipate getting to meet you face-to-face someday, dear Nephew, just as soon as you can up and out of there!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 亲爱的侄子，我真想快点和你见面，赶快动身，离开那里吧！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Good Nephew, I return once more to lend to you my power! I'd like to see your discontented father try and stop you now!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 好侄子，让我再次赐你神力！真想看看，你的父亲现在就气得跺脚，想办法阻止你的样子！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: It is my solemn wish, dear Zagreus, that eventually we settle up our differences with your lord father. But for now, we fight!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 这是我真正的愿望，亲爱的扎格列欧斯，我们最终会解决我们和你父亲的分歧。但现在，我们开始战斗吧！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Hail, my most honorable, beloved nephew, and I bring to you the blessing of Olympus, so that you might finally get out of there, already!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨，我最尊贵的，亲爱的侄子，我给你带来了奥林匹斯山的祝福，这样你就可以离开那里了！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I just know you'll reach the surface here eventually, Zagreus! And I look forward to our meeting when you do!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道你最后一定能到达地面，扎格列欧斯！期待到时候与你见面！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: We'll keep you safe here from your father, Zagreus! But while you're still inside that Underworld, there's only so much we can do.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我们会保护你不受你父亲的伤害，扎格列欧斯！不过，你身处冥界，我们能做的事情也只有这么多了。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: You've a good head on your shoulders, Zagreus, so stay positive, stay healthy, and let nothing stand between you and your goal!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 你的脑子很机灵，扎格列欧斯。保持乐观，保持健康，别让任何东西阻挡你前进！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I wish you well in your continued quest, and offer my sincerest blessings, and of course my power, there, Nephew!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 祝你接下来的征途一路顺利，在此我将送上我最诚挚的祝福。当然，还有我的神力，侄儿！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: You've seen the sheer destructive power of the heavens! Just imagine what it's like above the surface of the earth!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 你已经见识过天界那强大的破坏力了！想象一下地面世界的样子吧！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Someday when we'll be resting easy on these heights, why, we'll look back at this and laugh, I'm sure of it!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 总有一天，我们会在地面上舒适地休憩，笑着回忆现在发生的事情，这一天肯定会来！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Ahh, but if it isn't my most favored nephew! Striving always toward the surface of my world. Your father cannot possibly believe he can contain you, can he?

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，我最亲爱的侄子！就算不是这样，你也要朝着我所在的地上世界努力前进。你父亲从没想过他能困住你，是吗？

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: You have my blessing now as ever there, young man.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 祝福你，年轻人。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I trust you shall be getting out of there in due course, Nephew.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我相信你会在合适的机会离开那里的，侄子。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I shall be watching over you, young man, though it is dark down there!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 年轻人，虽然下面的世界一片黑暗，但我会一直关注你！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: May the might of Olympus guide you through the shadows, Nephew.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 侄子，愿奥林匹斯山的力量指引你穿越黑暗。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Don't let your father get to you, young man, and climb on out from there.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 年轻人，别让你的父亲伤害你，从那里爬出来。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Zagreus, we won't be giving up on you, so you keep at it, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，我们不会放弃你的，所以你要坚持，知道吗？

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I shall make the heavens themselves now aid your ascent, Nephew.

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 侄子，现在我要用天国的神力帮助你逃出地狱。

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: You'll watch yourself down there, won't you, young man?

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 在下面要注意安全啊，知道了吗，年轻人？

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: All of us, we're here for you, young man!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 年轻人！我们统统都在为你打气！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Please do be careful not to make your situation any worse, Nephew!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 当心不要搞砸噢，侄子！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I'm here for you, young man, so you take heart, and more than that, take this!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我是为你而来的，年轻人，所以你可以放心，然后收下这个！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: All of us believe in you, though certainly no one so much as I!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我们都相信你，但很显然，没人比我对你更有信心！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Here's something I can do to help, young man!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 年轻人！这能够帮到你！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: You just take all the time you need in terms of fighting your way out of there, young man!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 尽你所能逃出冥界吧，你有的是时间，年轻人！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Now, don't lose heart, young man, and we'll keep at it with you here, as well!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 别灰心，年轻人，我们也会一直陪着你的！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: As my kin, you are a born fighter, Zagreus! So put your back into it, and you climb right up!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 作为我的亲人，你是个天生的战士，扎格列欧斯！加油吧，努力往上爬！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: It shall be glorious, indeed, the day you finally burst from that oppressive den into the light!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 当你冲破无底深渊，沐浴在光明之下的时候，一定会是充满荣耀的一刻吧！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I know you have it in you to surpass your father, Zagreus. Assuming you are anything like me!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道你有能力超越你的父亲，扎格列欧斯，如果你和我有相似之处的话！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: How fares your lovely mother? Things still good with her and Hades, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 你可爱的母亲最近还好吗？她和哈迪斯的感情都没问题吧，嗯？

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: You tell your good lord father that his brother Zeus shall be always watching over you!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 你得告诉你的好父亲，告诉他，他的宙斯弟弟会始终在天上照顾好你的！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I trust your good lord father's treating you all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜，你的好父亲最近对你还不错吧？

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I know you're busy, Zagreus, though someday you shall have to visit us!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道你很忙，扎格列欧斯。不过等你有空了，一定要来见我们一面！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I'm never quite so busy that I can't make time for family, young man!

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 只要是和家人有关的事情，我肯定能抽出时间，年轻人！

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: We're all in this together, aren't we, Nephew?

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 我们齐心协力，是吧，侄子？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Lord Zeus, erm, Uncle? Please accept this offering, and all my gratitude.

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Goodness, Nephew, that's an offering, indeed! I'm thankful for your piety to me, and as a show of generosity to you, in turn, I present this!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 众神之王宙斯，嗯，叔叔？请收下这件贡品，以及我的感激之情。

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 天哪，侄子，真是好样的，真不错！感谢你对我的虔诚，既然你这么热心，我把这个给你！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I thank you, my Lord Uncle Zeus, for your benevolence and your thunderous might.

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: You honor me, young man, as well you should, for I am ruler of Olympus, am I not? Such courtesies are shown me constantly, yet I appreciate them all.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 感谢您，众神之王宙斯叔叔，感谢您的仁慈和雷鸣般的力量。

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 你应该尊敬我，年轻人，因为我是奥林匹斯山的统治者。我经常受到这样的礼遇，但我都很感激。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Lord Zeus, I bid you please accept my humble offering, for all you've done for me.

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Why, that is rather generous of you, and I'm grateful for it, Nephew! How good of you to make attempts at reciprocity!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 宙斯大人，请您接受这份薄礼，感谢您为我所做的一切。

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 你太客气了，我很感动，我的侄子！你真是太好了，竟学会了礼尚往来！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: This offering is but a trifle, Uncle Zeus, for all your magnanimity.

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: So fine a gift again, my dear Nephew? Would that my sons and daughters on Olympus here would show me such respect from time to time!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 宙斯叔叔，对您的宽宏大量来说，这份贡品简直不值一提。

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 又送来这么好的礼物，我亲爱的侄子？但愿我在奥林匹斯山上的儿女们能时常这样孝顺我！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Please, Lord Uncle Zeus, accept this gift of Nectar in your honor, though it is such a pittance in comparison to all the generosity you've shown.

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I'm very pleased to see a show of such respect and admiration for your uncle, Zagreus. You'll go quite far here on Olympus with an attitude like that! Not everyone's as mannered, nor as wise.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 拜托了，宙斯叔叔。尽管这件礼物与您展现出的慷慨相比，实在是微不足道，但也还是请您收下这蜜露吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 看到你能这么敬仰你的叔叔，扎格列欧斯，我很高兴。凭着这样的态度，你在奥林匹斯必将前途无量啊！不是谁都能像你这样又聪明又有礼貌的。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: If you can hear me, mighty Uncle Zeus, I wish to make to you this simple gift, and with it send my humble wish that someday you and Father settle all your differences, and be at peace.

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Ah, most splendid of an offering, young man. And while we've yet to even meet in person, I already feel as though the two of us are close, why, closer than you must be even with your father! Oh, hahaha! Perhaps we ought go telling everybody I'm your real father, am I right?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果您可以听见我的声音，强大的宙斯叔叔啊，我希望赠与您这份薄礼，并且衷心祝愿您和我的父亲终有一天可以化解矛盾，重归于好。

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，真是一份不错的礼物啊，年轻人。虽然我们还没有真正见过面，但我已经感觉到我们是如此亲近了，比你和你父亲的关系还亲近呢！噢，哈哈哈！不如咱们直接告诉大家，我才是你真正的父亲，你看如何？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: If you can hear me, mighty Uncle Zeus, I wish to make to you this simple gift, and with it send my humble wish that someday you and Father settle all your differences, and be at peace.

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Ah, most splendid of an offering, young man. I already feel as though the two of us are close, why, closer than you must be even with your father! Oh, hahaha! Perhaps we ought go telling everybody I'm your real father, am I right?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果您可以听见我的声音，强大的宙斯叔叔啊，我希望赠与您这份薄礼，并且衷心祝愿您和我的父亲终有一天可以化解矛盾，重归于好。

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，真是一份不错的礼物啊，年轻人。虽然我们还没有真正见过面，但我已经感觉到我们是如此亲近了，比你和你父亲的关系还亲近呢！噢，哈哈哈！不如咱们直接告诉大家，我才是你真正的父亲，你看如何？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: King of the Olympians, Lord Zeus! Forgive this offer of Ambrosia, for I know you have no limit of it there. But here, it is the finest gift that can be given, and even still it isn't anything compared to all you've done for me. Thank you, Uncle.

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Now, now, Nephew, you are most generous, indeed, in showing all this deference to me. But we must keep some distance, shouldn't we? Lest all the others here, why, they would be most jealous if they caught me playing favorites! Even though you are my favorite! Presently, at least.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 众神之王，宙斯大人！请接受这不起眼的仙馔密酒。我知道这东西对您来说再平常不过了，但在这里，这已经是最上等的礼物了。即便如此，这仍然比不上您为我所作的一切。谢谢您，叔叔。

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 好啦，侄儿，你真的是太慷慨了，太尊重我了。不过我们得保持距离，你说对吧？不然被其他人发现我对你这样偏心的话，肯定会吃醋的！不过，我确实最喜欢你！起码目前是这样。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Well, my hellborn kin, I have to say that there are times I wish I could have been acquainted with your father somewhat more, if you'll forgive my saying so. My father and my uncle, here... they're predisposed quite differently than I.

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Perhaps if you were not so odd, and made more effort to be somewhat more approachable, Ares, then we'd have more in common, you and I! Should you need any tips on that, why, you just let me know!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，这不是我在地狱里的家人吗。我不得不说，有时候我在想，要是能和你的父亲多熟络一些就好了，希望这句话不会冒犯到你。我的父亲和我的叔叔，这么说吧……他们的性格和我一点都合不来。

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 阿瑞斯，如果你性子别那么乖僻，能多努努力让自己招人喜欢的话，那你我之间肯定会有更多相似之处的！如果需要我的建议的话，只要和我说一声就行了，知道了吧！

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: I wished only to speak to you in private once again, my kin, except, you see...

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: ...Except you see, dear Cousin, that some members of our family are predisposed toward the unspeakable. I caution you around my half-brother, is all. Now carry on.

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: You interrupt me once again, dear sister. You know I do not care for that. I warn you to stay out of my affairs. I shall aid my kin as I see fit.

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: You only do as you see fit, Lord Ares. Mind that you continue pulling in the same direction as us all.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我只是想私下再跟你谈谈，我的家人，不过，你知道……

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: ……不过，亲爱的兄弟，你要知道，我们家人有些怪癖好。在我同父异母的弟弟面前，我只能提醒到这里了。现在，继续吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你又来打扰我了，亲爱的姐姐。你知道我不在乎那些。我警告你不要干涉我的事情。我将尽我所能帮助我的亲人。

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你只做你认为对的事，阿瑞斯大人。注意，你要和我们继续朝着同一个方向前进。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: I so anticipate the day you finally arrive upon Olympus. There are few amongst us here with interests such as those I think we share.

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: There are at least a few of us who share such interests here, isn't that so, Lord Ares? As for you, dearest, you take all the time you need!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我期待着你最终到达奥林匹斯山的那一天。这里还能有几个人与咱们志趣相投。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 这里至少还有几个人有这样的志趣，不是吗，阿瑞斯大人？至于你，亲爱的，你需要多少时间都可以！

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Wars waged over love, my kin... can you imagine that? The lady Aphrodite and I can endlessly discuss such circumstances. I trust, from time to time, you stop to ask yourself how come you choose to fight. Not that you need a reason, of course.

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Oh, Lord Ares, truly there isn't the need to cloud our little godling's thoughts and judgment with such comments, is there, hm? Let's give him what he wants, and we can carry on in private, about that.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 为了爱情而发动战争，我的家人……你能想象得到这种事情吗？像这种话题，我和阿弗洛狄忒女士能讨论上三天三夜。我相信，你时常会停下来，反思自己为什么要用战斗的方式解决问题。当然了，想战斗是不需要理由的。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 哦，阿瑞斯大人，没必要对这位小小神说这些话，让他的思想和判断蒙上阴影，不是吗？我们只要给他想要的东西就好，至于其它的事情，我们可以私下里做。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Ah, my kin! I was just inquiring with Lord Dionysus here, under which circumstances are the greatest mortal feasts of all prepared? Because I have a certain hunch, regarding that...

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Yeah, yeah, Ares, I will hand it to you, man. There's nothing like a feast after a war, all right! Provided you're on the surviving side, that is! Otherwise I guess they'll be feasting with you down there, Zag!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，我的家人！我刚刚在询问迪奥尼索司大人，对凡人而言，什么样的盛宴才是最美味的？因为关于这个问题，我有我自己的看法……

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 没错，没错，阿瑞斯。我就直说了吧，伙计。没什么能比大战之后的盛宴更美味的了！当然了，你得是活下来的一方！否则我猜，那个人就只能来这里和你共进晚餐了，扎格！

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: The cold of death is quite becoming of the Goddess Demeter, do you not think so, my death-dealing kin? She is becoming well accustomed to it, too.

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I think that you forget yourself, Lord Ares, sir. For I am much your elder; my famines had already slain the mortals by the tens of thousands by the time such thoughts of doing so first crossed your mind.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 对得墨忒尔女神而言，死亡的酷寒和她的气质很搭。你不这么觉得吗，我杀人无数的家人？就连她自己也已经习惯于这一点了。

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我觉得你有点太得意忘形了，阿瑞斯大人。我比你要年长得多，恐怕你才刚刚动起想杀人的念头，我带来的饥荒就早已杀死成千上万的凡人了。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Ten thousand souls have fallen to you, now, my hellborn kin. I am rather beside myself, I must admit. Fine work.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 上万亡灵因为你而陨落，我的地狱之子。我确实有点失控，这一点我必须承认。很好。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Here goes, then. In the name of Hades! Olympus, this is an official message! Lord Ares, please consider our proposal... once you're able to decipher it.

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: My, what is this, my kin? Some sort of invitation for me, I presume. Not just for me... this symbolizes all the others, here? Most intriguing. I shall investigate the meaning of this as quickly as I'm able, then. But first!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那就这样吧。以哈迪斯之名！奥林匹斯山，这是一份官方来信！阿瑞斯大人，请考虑一下我们的提案吧……如果您能明白它的意思的话。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，这是什么，我的亲人？我猜是某种给我的邀请函吧，而且不仅仅是给我的……这里也标记了所有其他人，是吗？真有意思，我会尽可能地弄清楚这是什么意思。不过，先办重要的事情！

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: I wish to tell you once again I had a splendid time during our recent shared festivities, my kin. At last, I've finally seen your death-filled realm firsthand! I learned a great deal. And I look forward to learning more from our successful collaboration, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我想再告诉你一次，在咱们最近共同的庆祝活动之中，我玩得很开心，我的亲人。我终于亲眼目睹了你们那充满死亡的国度！我学到了不少东西。我希望能从我们之间的顺利合作中学到更多东西，你说呢？

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Lord Zeus has gotten to you first, I see? My father's gifts are generous, indeed, though... I think I can help in my own way.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我明白了，宙斯大人先来找的你吧？我父亲送礼的确很大方，不过……我可以用自己的方式来帮助他。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: The blessing of your uncle Lord Poseidon might have helped you to this point, but here: My gift shall see you further still.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你叔叔海神波塞冬的祝福可能在这一点上对你有帮助，但在这里：我的礼物会让你走得更远。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: You bear the blessing of Athena, yes? She would protect you from your enemies, whilst I would rather that you slay them, and be done.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你得到了雅典娜的祝福，对吗？她会让你不受敌人的伤害，但我宁愿你杀了他们，然后一了百了。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Mm, I see you have the Lady Aphrodite's blessing there already. Love and death, together, hand in hand? Sounds most agreeable to me.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，我看你已经得到了阿弗洛狄忒女士的祝福。爱与死亡，一齐到来？听起来，甚合我意。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: So Artemis, my lonely half-sister, got to you first? She merely helps you hunt, whilst I shall help you kill. Observe.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 所以阿尔忒弥斯，我那孤独的同父异母的妹妹先找了你？她只能帮你打猎，而我将帮你消灭敌人。这一点你要注意。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: That drunkard Dionysus cannot help you near as much as I, my hell-born kin. Compare the gift he gave to what I offer you.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 酒鬼迪奥尼索司对你的帮助远不及我，我冥界出生的亲人。把他给你的礼物和我给你的比较一下。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Our messenger Hermes has been in contact with you by now, yes? Perhaps you shall not see him very often, for my work keeps him rather preoccupied, shepherding souls and such.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我们的信使赫尔墨斯应该和你联系上了吧？或许你不经常见他，因为我的工作几乎占用了他的所有时间和精力，比如看管亡灵之类的工作。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: I faintly sense the mark of Goddess Demeter upon you, hm? Her power over plentitude is opposite to mine in some respects. But, lately, she has channeled it in manners more agreeable to me.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我在你身上隐约感受到了女神得墨忒尔的印记，是吗？她的力量很强大，在某些方面与我的力量正好相反。不过，她最近似乎在朝我的方向靠拢。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Ah, you bear your own father's blessing, my kin? Such a surprise... I know the two of you are now in league, and yet... I am still quite accustomed to the thought that you harbor war-like hatred for one another. Perhaps there's still a trace of that, though, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，你戴着你父亲的祝福，是吗，我的亲人？这可真是意外……我知道你们两个已经和好了，不过……我还是会有这种想法，觉得你们依然对彼此怀有类似于战争的恨意。或许你们之间依然残留着恨意，你说呢？

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Did you happen to know, my kin, that you have slain more than a hundred foes since you began your quest? You have! For I am keeping count. And I am most impressed.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我的亲人，你可曾知道，自从你踏上征途以来，你已经消灭了一百多个敌人？是真的！我一直在数。我真的非常震惊！

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: You are a most impressive death-dealer, my kin. For by my estimation, you have slain at least a thousand souls down there! Souls mostly having died before, but still.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你基本上就是个亡灵贩子，工作干的不错，我的亲人。根据我的估算，你在这里至少已经屠杀了上千亡灵！大多数亡灵都经历了死亡，但也有少数例外。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: I know that you have many aspirations, my good kin. To be plain with you about my own motive for a moment: As long as you continue bringing swift and steady death, you shall have my unyielding support.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道你有很多远大的抱负，我的好兄弟。那我也和你挑明我的动机吧：只要你能继续杀人如麻，你就会得到我坚定不移的支持。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: The more you slay your enemies, my kin, the stronger the bond between us, I think. Can you not feel it, too? Though, perhaps your lust for blood overpowers your other senses, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我的亲人，我觉得你杀掉的敌人越多，我们之间的羁绊就越是紧密。其实你也能感觉得到，不是吗？不过，或许你对鲜血的渴望已经掩盖了你其它的感知能力，是吗？

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Perhaps you know a god called Thanatos? The two of us are very close associates, you know. Do give him my best wishes, should you see him soon.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你应该认识一位叫塔纳托斯的神吧？我跟他关系很好。下次你见到他的时候，帮我向他问个好。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: I trust that Thanatos is doing well? Although he brings to mortals merciful release, whilst I most certainly do no such thing, I do appreciate his take on it.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我相信塔纳托斯过得不错？虽然他会给凡人带来幸运的解脱，而我几乎肯定不会做这种事，不过还是要感谢他有这样的担当。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: It is my understanding that you have grown rather close with Thanatos, my kin? A perfect choice of mate; though I confess I'd not expected Death to have affection for another save himself.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我没猜错的话，你和塔纳托斯的关系不错吧，我的亲人？他真会选朋友啊；不过我承认，我没想到，除了他自己，死神还会对另一个人产生感情。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: You traveled rather far down there since last we met, my kin. And that means you have dealt incalculable death. I must commend you thus.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 自从我们上次见面以来，你已经走了很远的路程，我的亲人。也就是说，你消灭了不计其数的亡灵。所以，我必须为你竖大拇指。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Ahh, my kin! I sensed fresh bloodshed from you recently, the real kind! For you have slain the living near the surface, have you not? Mere vermin, yes, but good enough for me.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，我的亲人，我感觉到你最近的杀气很重，真的很重！你在凡界附近大开杀戒了吧？虽然只是杀了些鼠兽，但我也能感觉得出来。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Recently, there was a burst of violence on the surface, near to where you are, but higher up. 'Twas altogether odd, but must have forced you to return once more. No matter; time is on our side.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 地面世界最近爆发了冲突，差不多就是你在的地方，不过要更靠上面。总之很奇怪，肯定是这场冲突让你不得不返回的吧。不过不要紧，我们有的是时间。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: I sense so much death at the gates of your father's realm, of late, my kin. Now, I know that seems perfectly ordinary on the face of it, except... there's something more. I wonder if you know the reason why...

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我的家人，我最近在你父亲的死亡之门上感受到了数不胜数的死亡。我知道那扇门看起来平淡无奇，只是……它绝不是它看起来那么简单。不知道你知不知道其中缘由……

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: I know your efforts to come here have repeatedly been thwarted, my good kin. However, we have caused such violence in the intervening time, that we must take this as a real victory. Let us continue for however long it takes.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我的好亲人，我知道你一直都想来到奥林匹斯山，也知道你的努力屡屡受挫。不过，我们在这段时间里散播了如此多的暴力，我们完全可以把这当做真正的胜利。无论这场旅途要走多久，我们都一起走下去吧。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Surely you've heard rumblings about a war which has erupted on the surface, here? Doubtless you've seen an influx of fallen mortals. It's quite a decent one, I have to say! Though, unlikely to rise to the ranks of the greats. Too few armies involved in it, I fear.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 地表世界爆发了一场大战，你在这里应该也能听到战争的轰鸣吧？我敢肯定，你已经见到无数死去的凡人涌入这里了。我不得不说，这张战争打得还真不错！不过，恐怕还没办法算作大战的级别，因为参战的军队还是太少了。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: War's such a wondrous thing, my kin. It solves so many different problems, whilst perpetuating its own inevitability. Let's keep it up, then, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 战争可真是奇妙啊，我的家人。它不仅能解决各种各样的问题，还能保证始终都会爆发战争。我们继续下去吧，怎么样？

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Do you ever think to yourself that you were born a bit too late, my kin? For my part, I wish that I could have been there myself when my father and the others waged ferocious war against the Titans. Ah, it must have been a sight!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你有没有想过自己实在是有点生不逢时，我的家人？我个人觉得，要是我的父亲联合众神对泰坦发动战争的时候，我就能在场就好了。天啊，那一定会是一场了不起的大战！

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: I sense that you have forged a greater bond with your instruments of destruction there, my kin. Then that is very good. And may their altered forms serve you quite well.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我察觉你和你的杀戮工具建立了深厚的情谊，我的亲人。这是件好事。它们在变形后帮了你不少忙吧。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Why, I believe that is the Frost Fair Blade you bear! I understand it shall become the instrument of choice of yet another god of war, someday. I long to meet him, this fellow student of death.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 哎呀，你手里拿的应该是冷艳锯吧！我明白，总有一天，它会成为另外一位战神的趁手兵器。我真希望能早点见到那位带来死亡的同道中人。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Ah, that blade of yours... it looks as though it could relieve a mortal of his head with ease. Excalibur, is it? I've studied all the Fates' designs, and this one is among my favorites.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，你手上的那把剑……看起来能毫不费力地把凡人的头砍下来。它是叫誓约胜利之剑，是吧？我看过命运女神所有的安排，而这把剑是我最喜欢的武器之一。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: The fated bow Sharanga, in your grasp! That is not a form I'd expected you to wield. You have exquisite taste in weaponry, my kin!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你手里的不是命运之弓沙兰迦嘛！我倒是没想过你会用这样的武器。你挑武器的品位相当不错嘛，亲戚！

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Is that the fire-eating shield of the great warrior Beowulf, which you have there? I knew the Fates had plans for it, but I did not expect for you to be a part!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你手上的那面盾牌，莫非就是传奇战士贝奥武夫那面能吞噬火焰的盾牌吗？我知道命运女神早就安排好了他的命运，不过我没想到你也在其中！

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Those are the gauntlets of the fated king Gilgamesh, are they not? A bringer of destruction, and an agent of the Fates. You are full of surprises, my kin!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 那双拳套属于注定要成为王的吉尔伽美什，不是吗？带来破坏的武器，命运女神的代言人。你总是能带来惊喜，我的亲人！

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: You bear the warring instrument of one called Lucifer, I see. I've little to go on about him, but it is clear he knows a thing or two about destruction, is it not?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 看得出来，你手上那把武器以前有个叫路西法的家伙也用过。我对他了解得不太多，不过很显然，他在搞破坏方面是个行家，没错吧？

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Ah, you bear the Blood-filled Vial which I granted you! The mortal's blood contained therein... I drew it myself! Too seldom am I able to become directly involved in such matters.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，你拿的是我送给你的鲜血之瓶！那里面装的凡人的鲜血……是我亲自采集来的！我很少能有机会亲手去做这么琐碎的事情。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Know that I admire your Lord Father very much. For his grim work lets me continue mine. I trust that one day you shall settle your dispute.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 要知道，我非常敬佩你的父亲大人。正是因为他糟糕的工作，我才能继续干我的工作。我相信，有一天你会解决你们的争端。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: You are the son of Night herself, they say? A fascinating character, ill-liked upon Olympus, although I myself have always longed to meet her.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 他们说，你是黑夜女神的儿子，是吗？她是个充满魅力的人。虽然她在奥林匹斯山的形象不太好，但我一直希望能够见到她。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Ah, my favorite Underworld death-dealer. I so look forward to the pain you shall inflict this time around.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，我最喜欢的冥界亡灵贩子。真想快点看看你这次的傲人战绩。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Would that a sudden scourge of war would help you out of your predicament. Why, I would stir one up for you without a second thought.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 但愿突如其来的战祸能帮助你摆脱困境。哎哟，我会毫不犹豫地为你挑一个。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Ah, my closest kin in all the Underworld, I see you there, I think! What sort of violence shall we sow together this time, you and I?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，我整个冥界最亲密的家人啊，我觉得我看到你了！这次，我们两个要去带来什么样的破坏呢？

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: There's so much insufferable talk of peace up here, my kin. It is quite the relief to focus on much more important things, with you.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 这里谈论和平的人太多了，我的家人，我都要受不了了。能和你一起去做更加重要的事情，这可真是一种解脱。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: You must know I often hunger for destruction, almost uncontrollably at that. Though I am finding you are able to sate that appetite of mine.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我渴望破坏，有时候我自己都控制不了这种冲动，你是知道的吧。不过，我发现你却能有办法满足我对破坏的渴望。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: May all the death you bring become the stuff of legends told in fearful mortal whisperings around the world, my kin.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 愿你带来的所有死亡都能成为不朽的传说，在凡人恐惧的低语声中万世流传，我的家人。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Would that I knew the goddess Nyx, myself, my kin! So many of my wars are waged by night. I am most grateful, and I wish her well.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 要是能见倪克斯女神一面就好了，我的家人！我有无数场战争都是在夜里打起来的。我对她非常感激，祝愿她一切安康。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: How is your mother Nyx of late, my kin? Have you yet given to her my regards? For I should think that Night and War would share a common ground.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你的母亲倪克斯近来如何，我的亲人？你有替我向她问好吗？我觉得黑夜与战争有些共通的地方。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: How is Nyx of late, my kin? Have you yet given to her my regards? For I should think that Night and War would share a common ground.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯近来如何，我的亲人？你有替我向她问好吗？我觉得黑夜与战争有些共通的地方。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Do tell your mother Night Herself that I am often thinking of her here, although we haven't met. She must believe that there are those upon Olympus who admire her.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 请务必转告黑夜之母，虽然我们还没见过面，但我经常会想念她。一定要让她明白，奥林匹斯山上也有她的追求者。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Do tell Night Herself that I am often thinking of her here. She must believe that there are those upon Olympus who admire her.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 请务必转告黑夜之母，我经常会想念她。一定要让她明白，奥林匹斯山上也有她的追求者。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Perhaps once all of this is over, my good kin, you might arrange 'twixt myself and your dark mother, Nyx, some sort of chance to meet? Do think upon it, and declare to her my interest if you please.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 等这一切结束之后，我的好亲人啊，说不定你可以帮忙安排我和你的黑夜之母倪克斯见个面什么的？好好考虑一下吧，务必帮忙转告她我的想法。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Perhaps once all of this is over, my good kin, you might arrange 'twixt myself and the goddess Nyx some sort of chance to meet? Do think upon it, and declare to her my interest if you please.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 等这一切结束之后，我的好亲人啊，说不定你可以帮忙安排我和黑夜女神倪克斯见个面什么的？好好考虑一下吧，务必帮忙转告她我的想法。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Your mother Nyx and I, we have begun a correspondence, my good kin. I do appreciate you putting us in touch. She is a lovely specimen, if you don't mind my saying so, perhaps?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我和你的母亲倪克斯已经开始通信了，我的好亲人。很感谢你在中间搭桥牵线，她真的是一个可爱的样本。你应该不会介意我这种说法吧？

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: The goddess Nyx and I, we have begun a correspondence, my good kin. I do appreciate you putting us in touch. She is a lovely specimen, if you don't mind my saying so, perhaps?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我和倪克斯女神已经开始通信了，我的好亲人。很感谢你在中间搭桥牵线，她真的是一个可爱的样本。你应该不会介意我这种说法吧？

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: You shall be pleased to hear that your own mother Nyx and I, why, we intend to meet. I'm quite excited to exchange ideas in the flesh.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 告诉你一个好消息，我和你的母亲倪克斯打算见面了。能和她面对面交流，我很激动。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: You shall be pleased to hear that Nyx and I, why, we intend to meet. I'm quite excited to exchange ideas in the flesh.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 告诉你一个好消息，我和倪克斯打算见面了。能和她面对面交流，我很激动。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Please send your mother Nyx my warm regards, won't you, my kin? Would that the others on Olympus knew and understood your kind as I now do.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 请代我向你母亲倪克斯问好，我的亲人，好吗？要是奥林匹斯的其他人也能像我一样了解你们就好了。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Please send the goddess Nyx my warm regards, won't you, my kin? Would that the others on Olympus knew and understood your kind as I now do.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 请代我向倪克斯女神问好，我的亲人，好吗？要是奥林匹斯的其他人也能像我一样了解你们就好了。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: You know, my kin, I had misunderstood that Nyx was your mother. But, Persephone? I never took her for the sort to have an interest in your realm. Alas that we never had opportunity to discuss the subject here.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 说真的，我的亲人，我以前一直以为倪克斯是你的母亲。不过，其实是珀尔塞福涅吗？我以前从来没觉得她会对冥界有任何兴趣。不过，之前我们也没机会讨论这个话题。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Your good mother, Persephone... dread Queen of the Underworld! I certainly misjudged her when we had occasion to interact whilst she resided on Olympus. Perhaps I, too, should consider a life there in your realm...

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你的好母亲珀尔塞福涅……恐怖的冥界皇后！我们一起住在奥林匹斯山的，我有机会和她交流的时候，很显然是我错估了她。或许我也应该考虑考虑搬到你们这边才是……

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: You bear Varatha, the Eternal Spear...! I thought it lost! Have you any idea how many lives it drank during your father's glory days?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你还带着永恒之矛，瓦拉塔！我还以为它丢了！你知道它在你父亲辉煌的时候消灭过多少敌人吗？

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Ah, you wield Coronacht, the Heart-Seeker. It pierced three Titans in one shot back in the war amongst our kind. Please do take care of it!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，你挥舞着索心弓科罗纳赫特。在泰坦与我们的战争中，它一个回马枪就刺穿了三个泰坦。请务必保管好它！

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: You have the Shield of Chaos, Aegis... quite unlike the one my good sister Athena likes to flash around. You have much better taste.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你有混沌之盾埃癸斯……和我的好妹妹雅典娜喜欢到处炫耀的那个很不一样。你的品味好多了。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Why, you are wielding Exagryph, the Rail of Adamant! A most fascinating device. Imagine the new face of war, should its secrets someday be revealed, and spread to mortalkind!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 哎哟！你在使用狮鹫坚炮伊格瑞菲！这是个非常有趣的兵器。想象一下新的战争形式，也许有一天它的神秘面纱会被揭开，并传播到人类世界！

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Well if it isn't Malphon, the Twin Fists, bound to your very capable hands! So many weapons are so indirect, I think. With Malphon, you are about as close to the destruction as can be.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 哎呀，那不是双子之拳玛尔封嘛，它已经在你的掌握之中了！我个人觉得拐弯抹角的武器实在是太多了。不过有了玛尔封，你几乎就可以成为破坏的化身了。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: The greatest wars require great alliances, my kin. And so, I shall entrust to you some of the greatest methods of destruction I've devised thus far.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 伟大的战争需要伟大的盟友，我的亲人。所以，我把最为精妙的屠杀技巧传授予你。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: The winds of war blow fiercely on the surface now, my kin. Thus I am able to confer upon you even greater power than has been my custom.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 战争的风暴在阳间愈演愈烈，我的亲人。因此，我要打破惯例，赋予你更强的力量。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: You seem to be upon the verge of death, my kin. I cannot wait to hear of it! The experience of death, time after time! You are one of a kind!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你似乎正处于生死边缘，我的亲人，我迫不及待地想听听你的感受了！能一次次地体验死亡，你可真是独一无二啊！

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Ah, my kin, but you have suffered terribly to come this far. No matter, for we soon shall pay your enemies in kind.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，我的亲人，但是你走了这么远的路，吃了这么多苦头。没关系，因为我们很快就会让敌人付出代价。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: So much letting of blood, so much of it, your own. Let's see to keeping you alive and in the fight a while longer, then.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你流的血太多了，那都是你自己的血。咱们还是想办法让你活下来吧，这样你才能打更多的仗。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: You're on the verge of yet another brush with death, I see, my hell-born kin. Do send some others down with you, would you?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 看得出来，你又要一命呜呼了，我地狱里的亲人啊。下次叫几个人一起帮忙，好吗？

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: A mortal surely would have already succumbed to injuries such as the ones you've suffered, there. Impressive how you carry on, like that.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 要是凡人受了像你这么重的伤，他肯定早就没命了。你居然还能硬撑下来，真是让人佩服。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: This one was bound to show up I guess. In the name of Hades! Olympus! I accept this message.

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: You've got quite the fighting spirit in you there, I have to say. Most intriguing, and yet no surprise for someone born in hell itself. You come on out of there, and tell me all about it. I'm a fellow student of death, you see.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜这一天一定会出现。以哈迪斯之名！奥林匹斯山！我收到了这条消息。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我不得不说，在那里，你的斗志很强。真是耐人寻味，不过对于一个出生在地狱的人来说，倒也不足为奇。你快离开那里，好好和我说说。你知道，我是专门研究亡灵的。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: I must say you deal death rather exquisitely. Though, perhaps I could be of some further assistance in such matters, yes?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 不得不说，你的亡灵屠杀功夫十分了得。不过，也许在这类事情上我还可以再帮点忙。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Ah! I figured that you must have been the source of all that bloodshed underneath the earth. Let me see if I can make your death-dealing a little more efficient.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 啊！我猜地下世界的所有杀戮都是你的杰作。让我看看，能不能让你的亡灵屠杀功夫更加精进。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Well, my hell-born kin, my blessing now is yours to do with as you wish; provided you inflict a little suffering for me?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 好了，地狱出生的亲人，现在你获得了我的祝福，可以随心所欲了；只要替我给他们一些小小的惩罚就好。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: I've just the thing for you this time, my kin. May I present my instruments of pain?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 这次我正好有你想要的，我的亲人。我可以展示一下杀人秘籍吗？

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: I surely hope your bloodshed's going well, and long that there shall be no end to it. I am, as ever, here to serve your benefit.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我希望你的杀戮战局还算顺利，希望这种事情永远不要有尽头。我将一如既往地为你服务。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: How fares your endless war against the dead? Let it be known that I am happy to take sides in such affairs. Please, I insist!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你与亡灵无休止的战争进展如何？让大家都知道，我很乐意在这种事情上偏袒其中的一方。不要犹豫，去告诉他们吧！

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Death rears its head in all too many forms, I'm sure you know. Though you may never find them all, I nonetheless encourage you to try.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 亡灵会以许多形式出现，我相信你知道。虽然你可能永远都无法把他们全都找到，但我还是鼓励你去试试。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: The wretched dead you face perhaps forget themselves. Go, then, remind them of the agony which brought them to your realm.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你所面对的凶残亡灵也许会忘记他们自己是谁。那么，就去提醒一下他们，是怎样的痛苦把他们带到了你的领地。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Life and death are inextricable, and war is often what connects the two. Don't you agree?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 生与死是密不可分的，而战争往往将二者联系在一起。你不同意吗？

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: This world has a limitless capacity for pain; and so, it truly is no inconvenience to help you to bring out a little more.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 这个世界承受痛苦的能力是无限的；所以，帮你多解救几个痛苦的灵魂真的是小菜一碟。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: The living and the dead alike desire what I represent. Their appetite for bloodshed cannot easily be sated. A goal to strive for, no?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 活着的人和死去的亡灵都渴望我所代表的力量。他们对嗜血杀戮的渴望很难得到满足。这是个奋斗的目标，不是吗？

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Perhaps the dead you stand against have long forgotten the experience of anguish and despair. I trust that you shall soon remind them for me?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 也许你所对抗的亡灵早已忘记了痛苦和绝望的经历。我相信你很快就会替我提醒他们一下。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Beautiful, isn't it? The strife which follows you. You have a real knack for this, and I for one am happy to assist.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 漂亮，不是吗？随之而来的冲突。你在这方面很有一套，我很乐意帮忙。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Some would question the destruction which you sow, but I shall never do so. I fully understand your impulses. Allow me to indulge them.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 有些人会对你的血腥屠杀有所质疑，但我永远不会这样想。我完全理解你的想法。请允许我放任这些念头。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Not once has your Lord Father thanked me for delivering vast portions of his clientele. Surely you shall be more grateful for my gifts.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我为他介绍了这么多的客户，你的父亲大人从来都没有谢过我。当然，你一定会对我的礼物更加感激的。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Do you suppose the dead feel pain unlike the living? This is for me an endless fascination, so go on, and give me more to think about.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你以为亡灵与活人感受到的痛苦不一样吗？这对我来说，永远充满魅力，所以继续吧，这对我来说是件多多益善的事。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: As you continue waging war against the dead, I gladly lend you my support; family to family, no questions asked.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道你要继续向亡灵宣战，所以我很乐意帮助你；家人之间，不存在任何问题。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: It is a veritable crime your father distances himself from all the rest of us. It is fortunate that you yourself are not so disagreeable.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你父亲有意要疏远我们大家，这真是罪过。幸亏你不是那么令人讨厌。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Let us together deal some death, shall we?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 让我们一起好好收拾一下这些亡灵，好吗？

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Shall we continue our campaign against the dead?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我们可以继续征讨亡灵吗？

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: What do you say we bring the dead some pain, for old time's sake?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 看在老交情的份上，我们给这些亡灵一点颜色瞧瞧，你说呢？

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: The devastation you have caused has not escaped my notice!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你造成的毁坏没有逃过我的眼睛！

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: We stand before a golden opportunity, to inflict pain. Let us proceed!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我们迎来了一个制造痛苦的千载难逢的好机会。我们继续吧！

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: There is no problem war cannot sort out.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 没有战争解决不了的问题。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Ah there you are, my kin! I have a gift to aid your bloody work.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，你来了，我的亲人！我有一份礼物，可以帮助你完成这项血腥的工作。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: My blessing be with you, and may death follow in your wake.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我的祝福与你同在，只愿你能杀它个片甲不留。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Please spread some suffering down there for me, my kin.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 替我让冥界的那些恶鬼多尝点苦头，我的亲人。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: I shall empower you to acts of greater violence than before.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我将赋予你比以前更强大的力量。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: War needn't carry out solely above the earth, my kin.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 战争不是阳间的专利，我的亲人。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: I trust that the destruction which you sow is going well?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我相信你可以给那里带去毁灭性的打击。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: The recent devastation which you caused, that was impressive work.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你最近的战绩真是令人刮目相看。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Whenever you bring death, why, you've my full support.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 只要你愿意去杀光那帮恶鬼，我随时都可以鼎力相助。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: How fares the ceaseless slaying of your foes, quite well, my kin?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 将你的敌人赶尽杀绝，听起来不错吧，我的亲人？

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Perhaps my blessing shall let you deliver death still more efficiently.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 说不定我的祝福可以让帮助你多杀几个恶鬼。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Your father's realm shall be quite full, I think, once you and I are through.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 当我们完成使命的时候，你父亲的领地将变得拥挤不堪。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: The finest instruments of death at my disposal shall be yours.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我手上有很多可以斩妖除魔的武器，它们威力强大，任你选用。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: I'd like to offer you a choice amongst my most exquisite tools which inflict suffering.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 这些威力无比的武器任你选择。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: What say we start our next war with a special flair, my kin?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 用我们的特殊天赋发动一场新的战争，你觉得如何，我的亲人？

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: I've not seen ample blood spilled recently, so let's please make up for lost time.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 好久没见到过血流成河的场面了，现在得把浪费掉的时间补回来。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: There are so many types of death... and yet, the sudden, violent kind is unsurpassed, I think.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 就算是死，也有很多种死法……不过我觉得，突如其来、充满暴力的死亡才是最美妙的。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: I am quite eager to commence jointly killing your enemies, my kin.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我已经迫不及待地想要和你一起屠戮敌人了，我的亲人。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: What do you say we start another of our famous killing sprees, my kin?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 不如我们再来大肆屠杀一番吧，你说呢，我的亲人？

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: It's not been long since last I saw bloodshed... but far too long for me, nevertheless.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我上一次大杀特杀，还是不久之前的事情……不过对我来说，已经太久了。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: My finest implements of death I now avail to you, my worthy kin.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我把最适合杀人的工具送给你吧，我出色的亲人。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Let us make this blood-letting truly one to remember, then, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我们来把这场杀戮化成一场血雨腥风吧，怎么样？

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: May you sow such destruction as to shake this mountain to its core, my kin.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 愿你能用移山填海的力量，为这个世界带来毁灭，我的亲人。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: I shall now give to you the means to wreak such havoc there, my kin!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 让我赐予你大肆破坏的力量吧，我的亲人！

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: I was quite pleased to hear again from Nyx of late, my kin.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 最近我又收到了倪克斯的来信，我很开心，我的亲人。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: May the wondrous goddess Nyx continue to watch over you, and darken the eyes of your foes.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 愿了不起的女神倪克斯继续庇佑你，遮住你敌人的视线。

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: To think you have the goddess Nyx's aid, as well as mine!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 想想看吧，倪克斯女神会帮你，我也会助你一臂之力！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Lord Ares, please accept this offering, for giving me such strength as necessary to succeed.

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: You are a flatterer, my death-inflicting kin. And I am feeling generous, as well, so here! A small token for you of my affection.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿瑞斯大人，感谢您赐予我成功所需的力量，这份薄礼请笑纳。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你这个马屁精，杀人不眨眼的小兄弟。我是很大度的，所以，就到这里吧！这是我送给你的一点心意。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Lord Ares, I honor you for all the strength you've given me to overcome my foes.

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Such a splendid offering, to me! How very thoughtful, there, my kin. I am taken aback, though I accept!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿瑞斯大人，我尊敬您，因为您赐予我战胜敌人的力量。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你送给我这么好的礼物！你可真是体贴啊，我的亲人。虽然我接受了这个礼物，但还是吃了一惊！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Lord Ares! Please accept this token of my deep appreciation for your generous support.

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: An offering, for me? Indeed! How gracious that you keep me in your thoughts. Know that, likewise, I keep you in mine.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿瑞斯大人！请接受这个礼物，这是我对您的慷慨支持的诚挚谢意。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 礼物，给我的？是的！你总是为我着想，这是多么仁慈啊。我要告诉你，我也会将你记在心里。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Lord Ares, it is my privilege to have met you, and have learned your death-inflicting way.

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: I do appreciate this gift to me, although you really shouldn't have! The suffering which you inflict is ample compensation in itself.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿瑞斯大人，很荣幸认识您，并学会了您致人于死地的技能。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 虽然你没必要送我礼物，但我还是很感激！你的战绩本身就是送我最好的礼物。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You have shown me nothing but respect and granted me your favor repeatedly, Lord Ares. This is the least that I can do, in kind.

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Most often when I'm given offerings, it is with wishes that I lend my favor in a coming war. Yet from you, my kin, I sense no such motive. I'm quite taken aback by that, I must admit.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿瑞斯大人，您对我非常尊重，一直赐予我您的礼物。这是我的一点薄利，还请您笑纳。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 绝大多数时候，人们给我礼物是希望能得到我的青睐，在即将到来的战争中助他们一臂之力。不过我的亲人，你却并非出于类似的动机。我必须承认，这让我很吃惊。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Lord Ares! As bloodshed has become somewhat of a necessity in my situation, I am very grateful that you're with me in this. I know never to take it for granted.

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: You're most gracious with me, my kin; and I remain enthralled as ever by your blood-soaked way of life. I trust the violence I have wrought on your behalf has been quite satisfactory?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿瑞斯大人！我目前的处境逼得我不得不大开杀戒，我很感激您能与我并肩作战。我明白，我不应该理所当然地接受您的好意。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 你真是太客气啦，我的亲人，你在尸山血海中前进的生活方式让我很是着迷。我以你的名义带来的破坏，应该还让你满意吧？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I offer this Ambrosia in your name and honor, Lord Ares. To the god of war! How many foes have I vanquished with your aid and guidance? But more than that, I'm pleased to know you, and to be your cousin.

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Ah, such an exquisite gift this is, indeed. Yet, the destruction you have sown, the sheer carnage... nothing can surpass that, I should think. Should you ever go to war, my kin... genuinely go to war, I mean... do look me up. I imagine I would take your side.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这瓶仙馔密酒是献给您的礼物，敬伟大的战神！有了您的帮助，我都数不清自己消灭过多少敌人了。不仅仅如此，能认识你，成为你的表兄弟，我感到很开心。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，真是份精美的礼物啊。不过我觉得，你造成的破坏，你带来的屠杀……这一切才是最无与伦比的礼物。如果你什么时候打算参战的话，我的亲人……我是说，真的要去参加那种会让生灵涂炭的战争的话……一定要叫上我，我一定会站在你那一方的。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Tsk, um, Zagreus... rather than greet you as I normally would do, instead, allow me to present you my illustrious, kind, generous lord father, your greatest Uncle Zeus!

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Erm, thank you for the introduction, Daughter! Now, you run along, go frolic with your nymphs, or something! Leave me to assist my nephew, here. Bestow on him your faint blessing, if you must.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 啧，嗯，扎格列欧斯……今天我要向你介绍一个人，他就是我那集威望、善良、慷慨于一身的父亲大人，你的叔叔宙斯！

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，谢谢你的介绍，女儿！现在没你的事啦，去跟你的仙女们玩儿去吧！让我来帮助我的侄儿吧。如果你想的话，现在就给予他你那微不足道的恩赐吧。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: You know my father and my uncle, by now, right, Zagreus? I don't know which of them is worse. Uh, I mean... superior! Superior, despite technically spending most of his time in the seas, beneath Olympus, isn't that right, Uncle?

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Oh, Artemis, you needn't boast to little Hades there on my account! Besides! Whether you're in the sea, above it, or beneath, makes little difference to your measure as a god! You two are young as yet! Keep at it, and you'll soon be practically as great as I!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 你已经见过我的父亲和我的叔叔了吧，扎格列欧斯？我说不好他们两个哪个更烦人，呃，我是说……更了不起！虽然确切地说，你绝大部分时间到呆在海里，呆在奥林匹斯山下面，你也依然很了不起！不是吗，叔叔？

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 哦，阿尔忒弥斯，你就不用向小哈迪斯吹嘘我的事迹了！还有！无论你是在海里，是在天上，还是在地底下，这都改不了你是个神的事实！你们两个还很年轻呢！继续努力，过不了多久，你们就可以变得和我一样了不起了！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Hey, uh, Zagreus! There's something I've been wondering, and don't take this the wrong way or anything, OK? Oh, no. It's her.

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Why, Artemis, you're absolutely tongue-tied! Due to our little godling in the Underworld, or a little due to me? Hm-hm, you shall figure it all out I'm sure!

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Look, what was I, ugh, just, never mind. I'll talk to you some other time, I guess.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨，呃，扎格列欧斯！我一直想知道一件事，不要误会我的意思，好吗？哦，糟了。她来了。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 阿尔忒弥斯，你几乎说不出话来了！是因为我们的冥界小小神，还是因为我？嗯……嗯，我相信你会把一切弄清楚的！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 话说，什么来着，我，呃，算了。还是改天再和你说好了。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Erm, Zagreus, despite my hunter's instincts here, it seems I was unable to elude Aphrodite in this particular case, who insisted that we present ourselves to you at the same time, for whatever reason...

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Oh, come now, Artemis! I'm sure you're very capable of hiding from a common beast, but I can see you plain. Why not be honest with yourself, next time?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，扎格列欧斯，虽然我有猎手的本能，但看来我这次是躲不掉阿弗洛狄忒了。她坚持无论出于什么理由，我们都应该同时在你面前出现……

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 哦，别害羞嘛，阿尔忒弥斯！我肯定你很擅长躲避普通的野兽，但在我眼中，你就像白纸一样，一眼就看透了。不如你下次对自己诚实一点吧？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Zagreus, I wish we all could hear you so that good Lord Ares here might be persuaded that my powers are entirely for different purposes than his!

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Perhaps our skillsets once were meant for different purposes, dear Artemis; but who are we to doubt the end result? Observe what shall transpire once we grant our kin our combined might.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，我希望大家能够听到你的声音，这样阿瑞斯大人就会明白，我跟他的神力为的是截然不同的目的！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 也许我们的力量就是为了不同的目的才会存在的，亲爱的阿尔忒弥斯。不过，我们又哪有权利去怀疑这样结果呢？不如把我们的力量结合起来，把它赋予我们的亲人，看看会发生什么吧。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Zagreus, I was just hoping for a little privacy before this hunt, which is consistently my preference here, except, you see, Lord Ares always seems to come sniffing about, first sign of any hunting instruments!

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Why, my dear Artemis, the hunt is but a prelude to a war, is that not so? For if all mortalkind knew naught of hunting, why, they would not be nearly so adept at killing one another.

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Look, Lord Ares, if I lend you better marksmanship ability, you think that you could bother someone else?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，我希望在狩猎开始前能有点儿个人隐私，这是我一直以来的习惯。可你也看到了，阿瑞斯大人似乎总是在留意有没有狩猎用具出现的迹象！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 我亲爱的阿尔忒弥斯啊，狩猎只不过是战争的前奏罢了，你说对不对？如果凡人连打猎都不会，那就更不用说自相残杀了。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 听着，阿瑞斯大人，如果我愿意借给你更优秀的射击能力的话，你可以别再来烦我了吗？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Oh, great, it's you, Zagreus! Here, let me offer you some fine new Boons, as well as Lord Dionysus here, who I am sure would love to talk your ear off just as much as mine!

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Eh, tells me I'm being awful loud, and to back off, all sorts of nasty stuff like that, what can you do, though, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，太棒了，是你啊，扎格列欧斯！来，让我给你一些新的祝福吧。迪奥尼索司大人也要给你一些祝福，我敢说他和我一样喜欢和你聊天！

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 呃，感觉我就像是个吵闹鬼一样，是个烦人的家伙，让人唯恐避之不及。不过，哎，我又能怎么样呢？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Oh, hi there, Zagreus, I was just failing to persuade the Lady Demeter to ease up off the snowy stretch that we've been having for a while. Some of the mortals are quite weary of it now, and it sure doesn't make the hunting any easier!

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: The mortals are resourceful, Artemis. Their one redeeming quality, perhaps! They'll find a way through our long winter here. They ought to, since they brought it on themselves.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，嘿，扎格列欧斯，我一直在劝说得墨忒尔女士女士，让她别再下那么多雪了，但一直都没太奏效。有些凡人已经要被压垮，这样的话，狩猎恐怕就要困难得多了！

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 可别小看凡人噢，阿尔忒弥斯，这大概是他们的一个优点吧！他们总会找到度过漫长冬夜的方法。他们也应该这样做，因为这是他们自找的。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Um, Zagreus, did you attempt to chat with Coronacht just yet? Remember, tell the bow I see you drawn in the arms of the seventh avatar! Something good's supposed to happen if you do, some divine archer-person's aspect I should think? You going to try it soon, or not?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，扎格列欧斯，你刚刚是不是打算和科罗纳赫特说话？记住，要和它说我看到第七化身的手将你拉开！只要你对它说这句话，应该就会有好事发生了，或许是能唤醒什么弓术之神的形态吧？你打不打算马上试试看？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Hey, look at that! The message must have worked! Practically can see that shiny bow from here! I've never wielded Coronacht myself, at least not yet. Though if the Fates are sending visions to me of its past or future bearers, why, I guess I'm bound to get my shot eventually!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，快看啊！那句咒语肯定是起作用了！我在这里几乎都能看到那把弓发出的亮光！我还没用过科罗纳赫特呢，至少到现在为止还没用过。不过，如果命运女神已经让我看过那把弓过去和未来的主人，那我猜我肯定能有机会用它一次！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Found you, Huntress, here. In the name of Hades! Olympus, this is an official message! Especially for you, Lady Artemis!

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Some kind of special message for me...! Oh, looks like there's one for everybody on Olympus, then. Felt rather special for a moment, there! And now you're making me check in with all the others. Great!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 找到你了，女猎手。奥林匹斯山，这是一份官方来信！是特别送给你的，阿尔忒弥斯女士！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 是给我的某种特别信息……！哦，看起来奥林匹斯山上的所有人都收到了这封信。有那么一会儿，我还以为自己是特别的呢！好吧，看来我不得不和其他人打交道了，真是太棒了！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Have to say, I had a pretty decent time with everybody at our little visit recently! Met you, Uncle Hades, even great Achilles! Still don't quite appreciate you tricking us, but eh! I can get over it eventually. Anyway, you still could use assistance from me, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 不得不说，在最近那次小小的访问中，我和大家一起度过了相当不错的时光！我遇到了你，哈迪斯叔叔，甚至是伟大的阿喀琉斯！我还是不怎么喜欢你欺骗我们，不过呃！我觉得我还是能克服这件事情的。总之，你以后还是可以来找我寻求帮助，好吗？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Ah, good old Father Zeus, he must have blessed you with his lightning bolts, did he? Always looking out for everyone.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，仁慈的老父亲宙斯，他一定用闪电球为你祝福了吧，对吗？他一直这么关心每个人。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Uncle Poseidon blessed you, didn't he. To think that big, fat oaf is your own father's brother. I'm told to be respectful near him, but it's hard.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 波塞冬叔叔已经为你祝福了，不是吗？想想吧，那个大胖子是你父亲的兄弟。他们告诉我要尊重他，但这很难。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: You met Athena earlier, I guess? I'd never trade my bow for all that pomp and armor, but... I guess to each her own.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜你之前见过雅典娜，对吧？我永远不会拿我的弓去换那些华丽的装备和盔甲，但是……大家各有所爱吧。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: You're pretty close with Ares, aren't you? And here they said it couldn't be done. If I were you I'd watch myself with him.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 你和阿瑞斯关系很亲近，不是吗？这里的人都说这是不可能的。如果我是你，我就会提防着他。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: So Aphrodite reached you first, did she? Sounds exactly like something she'd do. She has a knack for trouble. So, let's just stay focused, here!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 阿弗洛狄忒先找到了你，是吗？听起来很像她会做的事。她就是爱惹是生非。所以，我们还是注意点吧。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: That lush and lecher, Dionysus, counts you as a friend? I'm hoping that there must be some mistake, yeah, Zagreus?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 那个贪杯的色鬼，迪奥尼索司，他会把你当朋友吗？我希望这一定是搞错了，是吗，扎格列欧斯？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: You seem particularly light on your feet, there, Zagreus. I'd figure Hermes, himself, was speeding you along, except I've not seen him about in... been a while, really.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 你的脚步看起来特别轻盈，扎格列欧斯。我甚至觉得是赫尔墨斯本人在帮你加速，不过我已经……有相当一段时间没见过他了，真的。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: So even Demeter's become involved in this! Didn't think she would. Though you'll be glad she did! Provided you stay on her warm and fuzzy side, of course. Working on that, myself!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 所以说，就连得墨忒尔都卷进来了！真是没有想到。不过你应该感到庆幸！是啊，这样你就能躲在她温暖的皮毛后面了，我也想啊！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Something's troubled me a little, about you. You fight so desperately. At first I thought you simply lacked in patience. But now I see it's urgency that drives you. What is it that you're after, really...?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 你有些事让我有点不安。你这么拼命地战斗。起初，我以为你只是缺乏耐心。但现在我明白了，真的是时间紧迫。你到底想要什么？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Let's see. You blundered headlong into danger for the past six chambers or more. And you made such a racket I could almost hear it from Olympus. I have to say, your hunting skills are rather unconventional.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 让我看看。你在之前的六个密室里跌跌撞撞，陷入险境。你的阵仗如此之大，甚至我在奥林匹斯山上都能听到。不得不说，你的狩猎技术真是标新立异。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: I'm with you every step till you arrive here, Zagreus. Then I will probably ignore you like the rest. Just warning you ahead of time, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 在你到达之前，我会一直伴随着你，扎格列欧斯。但在那之后我可能就会像对待其他人那样不理你了。事先提醒你一下哦，记住了吧？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Say, were you hunting vermin near the surface lately, Zagreus? That's practically just like the real thing! It must have been a thrill!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 最近有在靠近地面的地方猎杀鼠兽吗，扎格列欧斯？就像真的一样！一定很刺激吧！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: You've become a right accomplished vermin hunter, Zagreus! Maybe you'll get to use those skills against worthier creatures soon enough.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 你已经成为一名合格的鼠兽猎手了，扎格列欧斯！也许你在以后遭遇更强大生物时，能用到这些技巧。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: That Fury down in Tartarus has been a real problem, hasn't she. I see the huntress instinct in her. She thinks she knows your weaknesses. Don't let yourself become predictable.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 塔耳塔罗斯密室中的愤怒女神很难对付，不是吗？我看到了她特有的狩猎绝技。她认为她了解你的弱点。不要暴露自己的弱点。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Hey, I once heard Lord Hades has in his employ the greatest hero of the Trojan War, you happen to know anything about that? I'm kind of a fan. You see Achilles, tell him he's the best for me!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，我听说哈迪斯大人雇佣了特洛伊之战中最伟大的英雄，你知道他吗？我是他的超级粉丝。要是你见到阿喀琉斯，告诉他，他是我心目中最棒的！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: So, I have heard that Achilles, himself, taught you how to fight! No wonder you can hold your own down there, that is amazing...! You be sure to honor him from time to time, got it?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我听说阿喀琉斯亲自教你如何战斗？难怪你能在那里坚持住，太不可思议了！你一定要一直尊敬他，明白吗？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Living on Olympus here, I'm surrounded by my family, but I always felt alone. I know that's not the same as your experience, but, I'm just saying I relate to what you're going through.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我住在奥林匹斯山，家人们陪伴在我身边，但我还是总觉得孤独。我知道这和你的经历不太一样，但我只是想说，我理解你的感受。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: I think you might enjoy it on Olympus, there's... a lot of feasting here, I guess, and the air is cool and crisp, and it's much brighter than it is down there. Sounds like a dream, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我想你会喜欢奥林匹斯山的……我猜这里有很多宴席，空气凉爽清新，比地下的世界明亮得多。听起来像个梦，对吗？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: I hope that once you make it to Olympus we'll go hunting sometime, you and I, you know? I like being on my own and all, but it's been nice, talking to you like this.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我希望你到奥林匹斯山之后，我们可以一起去打猎，好吗？虽然我喜欢一个人呆着，但能和你像这样聊天我很高兴。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: I grow so tired of the others here, you know? Much rather be out with the woodland nymphs than with these gods upon this mountaintop. You must know what it's like.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我已经开始烦我身边的人了，你知道吗？比起奥林匹斯山那些家伙，我更愿意和森林仙女们在一起，你一定也有同感吧。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Not everybody on Olympus is a total disappointment, Zagreus. Why, someday maybe you could meet Callisto, she goes hunting with me all the time! Bet you don't see many woodland nymphs down there.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 奥林匹斯山也不是每个人都不行啦，扎格列欧斯。说不定以后你会遇到卡利斯托呢，我每次都和她一起狩猎！我猜，你在冥界应该没怎么见过森林仙女吧。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Hey Zagreus, that Nectar you sent? Callisto and the nymphs and I, we popped it open recently, and it was really good! Had us positively frolicking about. So, thanks!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，扎格列欧斯，还记得你送的那瓶蜜露吗？我、卡利斯托和仙女们最近尝了一下，味道很不错！我们喝得很开心，谢谢你啦！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: You must have a friend or two, don't you? It's hard being alone all of the time. At least I have Callisto and the other nymphs, and... I have you! A distant friend is still a friend, isn't that right?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 你一定也有一两个好友吧？独自一人太难了，起码我还有卡利斯托和其他仙女们，而且……我还有你！就算相隔千里，朋友也依然是朋友，对吧？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Hope you don't mind, I told Callisto all about you recently! Don't worry, I was quite discreet about it, the two of us were on the hunt, not like I just shouted out your story from the mountaintops!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 希望你别介意，我最近一直在和卡利斯托聊起你！别紧张，我很谨慎，当时我俩打猎时悄悄说的，我可没有把你的事大肆宣扬啊！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Zagreus, if only you could turn yourself into a woodland creature and just fly or burrow out of there! My Callisto, she can turn into a bear, you ever seen those? Monstrous, furry things, quite huggable, if they don't kill you first!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，如果你可以变成森林生物就好了，这样你就能飞出冥界，或者打个洞钻出冥界了！我的卡利斯托能变成一只熊，你见过吗？巨大的、毛茸茸的生物，抱起来手感很好，前提是你别被它弄死！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: You've never even seen the woods, have you? I hope you do, someday. You could meet Callisto and the others! It's quite beautiful, and green, and calm, it's... anyway.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 你从来没见过森林吧？希望你什么时候能来一次，还可以见到卡利斯托和其他人呢！那里非常宜人，郁郁葱葱，宁静祥和……总之就是很好。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Don't know what it is about you, Zagreus, but I feel like I can be me with you, you know? Maybe it's that you don't constantly talk over me like everybody else, besides Callisto and the nymphs I guess. Not that I can even hear you, but, you know what I mean, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 不知道你是怎么想的，扎格列欧斯，但我感觉和你在一起的时候，我可以做我自己，你知道吗？也许是因为你不会像卡利斯托、仙女们或其他人那样，一张嘴就说个不停吧。虽然我听不到你的声音，不过你明白我的意思，对吧？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Hey, how'd you get your hands on a nice bow like that? You take good care of Coronacht for me, so I can try it too once you're up here.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你是怎么弄到这么漂亮的弓的？你替我保管好科罗纳赫特，这样，你来到地上的世界后，我也可以试试。
