en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Have to admit, you're very capable with Coronacht. Now I can hit a bull's eye in my sleep, but you'll be right there with me if I don't keep practicing I think!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我得承认，你确实很擅长使用科罗纳赫特。虽然我现在闭着眼睛都能命中靶心，但如果我不努力练习的话，恐怕你很快就会追上我了！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Hey, that's the Eternal Spear, Varatha, isn't it? Your father used to use that, didn't he. A bit ornate for hunting, but a spear's a spear, is what I like to say!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，那是永恒之矛瓦拉塔，对吧？那是你父亲以前用过的武器，是吗？拿来狩猎的话有点不太实用，但再不实用的长矛也是长矛，我是这么想的！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Hey, that can't possibly be the spear once wielded by the great Achilles, there, can it?! The shape is unmistakable, I mean, have you even the slightest just how many mortals got completely slaughtered by that thing? Oh, it has seen some use!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 哇，那该不会是伟大的阿喀琉斯曾经用过的矛吧？！这形状，不会错的，你知道这把长矛屠戮过多少凡人吗？噢，它确实能派上用场！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: That's not the Coronacht I know, isn't that... Chiron the centaur's bow? So that was Coronacht, as well? Seems every decent bow was just a version of that thing! Except for mine, of course.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 那可不是我见过的科罗纳赫特，那不是……半人马喀戎的弓吗？所以说，它还是科罗纳赫特啰？似乎无论是多么厉害的弓箭，都不过是它的化身之一！当然，我这把弓例外。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Say, that's the bow Stepmother Hera herself once wielded, isn't it? Her aspect of Coronacht! I'd know it from the... frankly rather sinister skulls all over it. It's very Hera, trust me.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我说，这不就是继母赫拉本人用过的那把弓吗？这是科罗纳赫特的形态！我一看到这把弓上面那些……相当阴森的头骨就知道了。说真的，这很符合赫拉的风格。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: When did you get your hands on Malphon, the Twin Fists? Hands in, I ought to say! I heard that one time, Demeter, she smacked her father right square in the face with those! Bet you can probably relate.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 你什么时候得到的双子之拳玛尔封？伸出手来，让我看看！据说，得墨忒尔曾经用这双拳套把她父亲的脸都打歪了！我猜你能明白我说的是什么意思。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Well, look at you, with Exagryph, the Rail of Adamant! Seems much too noisy-complicated as a hunting weapon when you could just use a nice quiet bow, but hey, to each her own.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 哇，你手上的不是是伊格瑞菲，狮鹫坚炮嘛！作为狩猎武器而言，它的动静有点太大了，这点就不如弓了。不过，各有所爱嘛！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Now listen, Zagreus, admittedly this is a little strange, even from me. I have a message for your bow! That's right, just go on up to Coronacht next time, and tell it with a firm, commanding voice, I see you drawn in the arms of the seventh avatar! Let me know how it goes, OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 听着，扎格列欧斯，我知道就算是由我来说，这也有点怪。不过，我有一条口信给你的弓！没错，等你下次再碰到科罗纳赫特的时候，你要用沉稳、确切的声音对它说：我看到第七化身的手将你拉开。到时候发生什么，要记得告诉我，好吗？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Hey, that's my Adamant Arrowhead on you! Normally, it's for killing things, but in your case it makes it even easier for me to hunt you down, even in the dark. Now that I found you... here!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 喂，那是我的狮鹫箭头！一般来说，它是用来杀死猎物的。不过照你这么来用的话，我想把你干掉就更轻松了，就算在黑暗之中也能看得到你。我看到你了……就在这儿！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Your name, it means 'great hunter', Zagreus! I guess your mother Nyx must have expected someday that you'd pick up a few pointers from myself!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 你的名字，意思是“伟大的猎手”，扎格列欧斯！你的母亲倪克斯给你起名的时候，肯定是希望有朝一日你能从我这里学点什么！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Hey, hold a moment, Zagreus, I could have sworn... you were so close, before, but now you're back? Ah, must have tripped up just when victory was close at hand, it happens all the time. We'll get you out of there, you'll see!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，等一下，扎格列欧斯，说真的……你之前马上就要出去了，可你现在怎么回来了？啊，你肯定是胜利唾手可得的时候大意了吧，这种事情很常见啦。我们一定能帮你逃出去，走着瞧吧！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Hey, you all right there, Zagreus? Wouldn't do to have you die on me just moments after meeting here like this.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你还好吗，扎格列欧斯？我才不会刚见面就让你死在我面前。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Oh! Look at you, you're hurt there pretty bad, but, just stay focused on the hunt, and it'll help to keep the pain at bay.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 噢！看看你，伤得很重，但是，只要专注于狩猎，它会帮助你远离痛苦。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Look, I'm just goddess of the hunt, not medicine, so... I don't know if this is going to help right now, but, here!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 听着，我是狩猎女神，不是医术女神，所以……我也不知道这样能不能帮到你，总之试试吧！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Your hunt has evidently not been going very well so far, I see. Though, maybe we can still turn it around.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 很显然，你的狩猎进展得并不很顺利，我看得出来。不过，或许我们还有机会翻盘。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Well, one good thing about all of the blood you've lost is it was even easier to track you down this time!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 好消息是，你流了这么多血，这下子我能更容易找到你了！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: All right, get ready for this, Zagreus, because I seldom share the greatest of my hunting secrets like I am about to.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 好，准备好，扎格列欧斯，我很少像现在这样教别人狩猎绝技。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: All right, no need to keep on toying with your prey. Here comes one of my finest blessings, now!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧，没必要继续玩弄猎物。这是我最好的祝福了，拿好！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: I don't reveal my greatest hunting techniques for just anybody, Zagreus, so you better appreciate what you're about to get, and use it to go far!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我可不会把我最出色的狩猎技术随随便便展示给什么凡人，扎格列欧斯。所以我要传给你的技巧，你最好心怀感激地学会，然后靠着它继续前进！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: How about we not take any chances this time, Zagreus? So here, this is the best I've got. You better not waste it!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我们这次还是不要心存侥幸了吧，扎格列欧斯？拿去吧，这是我最好的东西了，你最好别把它浪费掉！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: There's only one heavenly archer I know of. Well, several, really. Anyway! In the name of Hades! Olympus? I accept this message.

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: I heard about you. Look, I'm not like all the others on Olympus. The power of the hunt helps keep me company, so... maybe it'll help you, too!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 据我所知，天界只有一位弓箭手。好吧，其实有好几位！以哈迪斯之名！奥林匹斯山？我收到了这条消息。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我听说过你。听着，我和奥林匹斯山诸神并不一样。狩猎的力量始终与我相伴，所以……也许它也会帮助你！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Hey. You're not alone. You're not alone down there, OK? Here, let me show you.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿。你并不孤独。你并不孤单，知道吗？来，我给你展示一下。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: The dead must make a rather easy target, wouldn't you say? Let's see what you can do to them, given your choice of these.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我们很容易就能击中亡灵。给你这些选择，让我们看看你能做些什么。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: You busy, Zagreus? Thought maybe I could interest you in some of these old hunting tricks of mine.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，你忙吗？我猜，也许你会对一些古老的狩猎技巧感兴趣。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: How fares the hunt this time around, OK? I bet it could be better, so, erm, here! Maybe this'll help.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 这次打猎怎么样了，一切还好吗？我打赌它会更好，所以，呃，来吧！也许这会有帮助。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Let's take a little hunting expedition, yeah? You'll do most of the work, but hey, I'll be with you in spirit!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 让我们来一次狩猎探险，怎么样？嘿，主要由你自己来做，我在精神上支持你！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Sorry you're still stuck down there. Sometimes I feel stuck myself, but, a good hunt always sets me straight.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 抱歉，你还被困在下面。有时我觉得自己被困住了，但是，一次好的狩猎总会让我清醒过来。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: When I am on the hunt, my mind is clear, and nothing stands between me and my target. Though, have a blessing just in case you can't relate!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 在狩猎时，我的头脑是清醒的，没有什么能阻挡我和我心中的目标。尽管如此，还是接受我的祝福吧，以防你无法施展！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: I'd love to know about your life down there. I'll try and help you live through it this time so that way you can tell me?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我很想知道你在冥界的生活。这次我会试着帮你度过难关，这样你就能告诉我了？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: The wretches whom you face down there have died already, sometimes more than once. Should make for easy targets, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 你在冥界打的那些暗灵们已经死了，有时不止一次。它们应该很容易对付，对吧？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: I've never come across a target I couldn't take down. I expect the same of you, you hear me? Hopefully you hear me.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我从来没遇到过我打不垮的敌人。我希望你也一样，听到了吗？希望你能听到我的话。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Good hunting, Zagreus! The sooner you get out of there the sooner you can save me from my insufferable relatives. Please?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 祝你猎运长久，扎格列欧斯！你越早离开那里，就能越快地把我从那些令人无法忍受的亲人手中解救出来。来吧？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Hey, Zagreus, good luck out there, this time. I'd tell you 'may your aim be true' but I can guarantee it, actually.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨，扎格列欧斯，祝你这次好运。我会告诉你“愿你的梦想成真”，但我真的可以保证你实现梦想。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: The hunt requires utter concentration, so, I'll leave you to it, and... just watch your every move in silence over here...

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 狩猎需要全神贯注，所以，我就不打扰你了，我只要……在这里静静观察你的一举一动……

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: You want to make it out of there, you... don't have to listen to a word I say, to be quite honest, but... my huntress blessings ought to help.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 说实话，想要成功，你……不必听我说什么，但……我的祝福应该会有所帮助。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Well, Zagreus, you getting out of there this time, or am I going to have to keep on hunting by myself for the time being? Probably?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧，扎格列欧斯，你这次要离开这里，还是我要继续独自狩猎呢？很可能？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Looks to me like you could use a little help, so I'll just have a look in my big bag of blessings here, and, oh! Here's just the thing.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 看起来你需要一点帮助，所以我要看看我的祝福的储备，然后，哦！就是这些。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: The hunt comes down to kill-or-be-killed. Except for us immortals, who have to live with our shame, which is worse?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 狩猎的结果要么是杀了猎物，要么就是被猎物杀掉。但对我们这些不朽之神来说，被杀与不得不带着失败的耻辱永生，你觉得哪种更糟？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Those wretched things harassing you throughout that Underworld just won't give up, will they? Well, just keep killing them, I guess!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 那些在冥界里折磨你的暗灵是不会放弃的，不是吗？我想，我们还是继续对付它们吧！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Need a hunting partner, Zagreus? Not that I'm able to join you myself down there, or even hear you respond for that matter, but, anyway, here.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 需要狩猎伙伴吗，扎格列欧斯？虽然我不能自己去冥界找你，甚至无法听到你的回应，但是，无论如何，这个给你。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Zagreus, it's me! I'm here to join the hunt with you again. Let's show them what we can do.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，是我，我又来陪你狩猎了。让他们看看我们的厉害。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Hello again, you ready for this hunt? Me, I've been looking forward since last time, so, let's get on with it.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 又见面了，你准备好了吗？我从上次开始就一直盼望着，所以，我们赶快开始吧。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Stay on your guard, tread lightly, and all that.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 保持警惕，小心行事，就行了。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Keep a sharp eye out there, won't you?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 睁大眼睛，好吗？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Good hunting down there, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 祝你在狩猎时能有好运，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: What are you hunting this time, I wonder.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我想知道，你这次要打什么。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: I'll be looking out for you. If you don't mind of course.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我会照顾你的。当然，如果你不介意的话。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Remember, Zagreus, kill-or-be-killed.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 记住，扎格列欧斯，在狩猎中，要么是你杀了猎物，要么就是你被它杀掉。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: How about I join you for this hunt, OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我和你一起去打猎怎么样？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Hey, you take care of yourself, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你要好好照顾自己，好吗？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Got you something I bet you could use.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我给你准备了点东西，你肯定用得到。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: The finer points of hunting are not easy to communicate, though you're learning from experience, at least!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 狩猎的细节部分是很难说清楚的，不过你可以通过实践来学习！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: My senses sure are going to be sharp if I keep trying to keep up with you like this in all that dark down there.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 如果我能在这么黑的地方跟紧你的话，我的感觉一定会变得更加敏锐。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: A good, clean shot is all it takes, most of the time!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 很多时候，只要一次精准的射击就够了！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: You getting anywhere down there yet, Zagreus?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 在下面有什么新的进展吗，扎格列欧斯？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: What are you waiting for, let's get to hunting, then!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 还愣着干什么？开始狩猎吧！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Not much of a hunt when your prey knows exactly where you are, but it'll do!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 如果你的猎物已经很清楚你的位置了，那也就算不上什么狩猎了，不过结果差不多！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: I hope your every strike cuts to the vital bits of all your prey, there, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 祝愿你每一击都能命中猎物要害，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: I brought some hunting gear for you to try, if you could give me your attention, Zagreus?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我给你带来了一些狩猎的装备，注意到了吗，扎格列欧斯？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: All right, Zagreus, catch your breath, decide, and then what say we get you out of hell maybe?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 好了，扎格列欧斯，喘口气，思考一下。我们就这么逃离冥界吧，怎么样？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: What are we hunting this time, Zagreus? Don't tell me wretched dead, again?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 这次要狩猎什么呢，扎格列欧斯？不会又是暗灵吧？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: You see how easily I tracked you down? Unless you went out of your way for me, that is?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我很容易就找到你了，看到了吗？还是说，你是特意想让我找到你的？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: I have a Boon for you, here, Zagreus, though just be sure you don't embarrass me.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我有一个祝福要给你，扎格列欧斯，不过你可别让我难堪啊。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Well, perfect timing, Zagreus, now stock up and head out.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，时间正好，扎格列欧斯，准备好出发吧。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: You want to make it out of there, my Boons are just about the only way to go.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 如果你想离开这里，那么我的祝福就是唯一的出路。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Don't you let your father or let anybody push you around, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 不要让你的父亲或是任何人随意摆布你，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Bet I can help you break out of your father's realm in no time, Zagreus!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜，我马上就能帮你逃出你父亲的地盘了，扎格列欧斯！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Decided I would pack you something extra for this hunt, if you can handle it!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我给你带来了额外的狩猎用品，不知你能不能驾驭得了！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Enough toying around with our prey, there, Zagreus. What do you say we finish it, this time?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 别再玩弄我们的猎物了，扎格列欧斯，这次不如彻底了结了吧？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: I know it must be such a struggle for you, Zagreus, so here! In case this helps.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我明白你一直都很辛苦，扎格列欧斯。这个给你！这应该能帮上忙。

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: A great hunter ought to have great tools, Zagreus, so here! Please allow me.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 强大的猎人应当拥有强大的装备，扎格列欧斯，请务必收下！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Wish I could hunt with you myself, but here's the next best thing, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 真希望能和你一起狩猎啊，不过现在这样很不错，对吧？

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: You know how long it took Callisto to become a master of the hunt? I'm sure you can still learn a thing or two!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道卡利斯托花了多长时间才成为狩猎大师吗？我敢肯定你还有要学的东西呢！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: I was about to head out with Callisto for a hunt, though I can spare you a quick Boon, I guess!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我正打算去和卡利斯托一起狩猎，不过临走之前，我可以给你一个祝福！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: I have to meet Callisto soon, but it won't take me but a moment here to get you on your way!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我得去见卡利斯托了，但在这之前顺便帮你一把还是没问题的！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Someday perhaps you'll join me and Callisto for a hunt! But as for now...

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 或许有一天，你可以和我、卡利斯托一起狩猎呢！不过现在嘛……

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Greetings to you from the forest! Callisto and the woodland nymphs say hi!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 来自森林的问候！卡利斯托以及森林仙女们向你问好！

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: You'd make a real asset on the hunt, I think. Not that Callisto and I need assistance, though.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 你在狩猎这方面还真是前途无量呢，不过，我倒不是说我和卡利斯托需要帮手。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Lady Artemis, I hope that you'll accept this offering, for all your kindness and support.

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Hey thank you for this, really. And, I've just the thing to offer in return. It's just a gift, OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿尔忒弥斯女士，我希望你能接受这份礼物，谢谢你的好意和支持。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，真的要谢谢你的帮助。我只是想报答你。这只是个礼物，好吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: My lady Artemis! This is nothing, next to all your grace and favor.

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Hey wait, this is an offering, for me? I, oh, that's very kind, though, let's get back to hunting, now, OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我的阿尔忒弥斯女士！比起你的恩典，这根本不值一提。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，等等，这是给我的礼物？我，哦，那真是太好了，不过，我们还是回去打猎吧，好吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Lady Artemis! I am indebted to you, for the strength and cunning you have given me.

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Look, Zagreus, I don't know what to say, except for... thanks!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿尔忒弥斯女士！真的要谢谢你，因为你赐予了我力量和智慧。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 听着，扎格列欧斯，除了感谢……我真的不知道该说什么！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: My lady Artemis, your favor's been invaluable to me. No finer huntress ever walked the surface of the earth, or underneath.

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: You're being very nice to me, and that makes me suspicious, understand? So, you want more of that... you keep this up.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我的阿尔忒弥斯女士，您的帮助对我来说就是无价之宝。再好的猎手也没办法在地面或地下行走。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 你对我太好了，我不禁怀疑你是不是真心的。所以，如果你想要更多帮助……就要继续保持。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: At the risk of incurring your wrath, Lady Artemis, I hope you will accept this from me, and see that my gratitude for all you have done for me is genuine.

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: What do you know, another gift of Nectar, that's... quite thoughtful of you, Zagreus! Normally don't care much for the stuff, but, every now and then, I mean... why not?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 希望这不会冒犯到您，阿尔忒弥斯女士。请务必收下这礼物，我对你一直以来的帮助表示由衷的感谢。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 真想不到，又是一瓶蜜露，你可真是……太好了，扎格列欧斯！虽然我平时不怎么喝这个，但偶尔喝上一瓶……又有什么不好呢？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: In your honor, Lady Artemis! Your mighty blessings have helped me through so many trials now, and I always welcome your level-headed presence here.

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Look, I like being worshiped just as much as anybody, Zagreus, though bear in mind that you can always leave the worship of me to the forest nymphs, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我尊敬的阿尔忒弥斯女士！您强大的恩赐帮我度过了如此多的艰难险阻，我一直都很欢迎您这样冷静的人大驾光临。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我和其他人一样喜欢被人崇拜，扎格列欧斯。不过记住，你也可以把对我的崇拜留给森林的仙女们，好吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I know you have no shortage of Ambrosia on Olympus, Lady Artemis, but I imagine it's less often that the stuff go all the way from there to here, and back. What can I say? You make me proud to be a member of this family.

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: I never felt like I could be myself with everybody on this mountaintop, you know? So much posturing, and bickering, and... I just head out to the woods most of the time. Maybe you understand me better than the rest, I've no idea still. But I appreciate you've made attempts to try.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道你们奥林匹斯从来不缺仙馔密酒，但是我想，从冥界送过来的仙馔密酒可能不太多吧。我能说什么呢？能成为您的大家族的一份子，我感到很骄傲。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 我觉得，我和奥林匹斯山上的那些家伙一直都相处不来，你知道的吧？他们装腔作势，拌嘴争吵……我大多数时候都会呆在森林里。我也不清楚你是不是比其他的神都更加了解我，但我很高兴你愿意试着来了解我。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Dearest, your lord uncle wishes to address you from our mountaintop, although I had assured him that the two of us, we had everything well under control!

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Come now, Zagreus, the only thing Lady Aphrodite has under control is her long list of salivating suitors, am I right? Aphrodite, how about you bestow your blessing and be off, and I'll take it from here.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 亲爱的，你的天神叔叔希望能在奥林匹斯之巅和你聊聊。不过我早就和他保证过，说我们两个一定能把所有的事情都安排好。

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 说真的，扎格列欧斯，阿弗洛狄忒女士唯一能安排好的事情，就是她那些垂涎欲滴的追求者。我没说错吧，阿弗洛狄忒？不如你赶紧把你的祝福给他，接下来的事情都交给我吧？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: The thing to know about this family, dearest, is that, each of us, we have our little quirks. Although, we always stick together and our love for one another perseveres!

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Oh, hoh! What do we have here, little Hades? Seems to me that you have company! Well, I'll just leave the two of you alone. My lips are sealed tighter than a warship hull!

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Oh, feel free to stay, Poseidon! I was just explaining what an idiot you are, though you're able to articulate this best! Anyway, dearest, what was I on about...?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 关于这个家庭，亲爱的，要知道，我们每个人都有自己的小怪癖。尽管如此，我们总归还是团结在一起，我们对彼此的爱坚不可摧！

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 哦，哈哈！看看这是什么呀，小哈迪斯？在我看来，你有伙伴了！好了，我就让你们两个单独呆着吧，我的嘴可比坚固的船身还紧！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 哦，波塞冬，你留下来也没关系。我正和扎格解释你有多蠢呢，你这不就过来亲身示范了嘛！那，亲爱的，我刚刚说到哪了……？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: You must forgive us, little godling, meaning our extended family here upon Olympus! Some of us are terribly stuck up, and must be making matters much more complicated than they have to be.

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I wonder, dearest Aphrodite, whether you'd be willing to repeat such things directly to my countenance?

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Oh, you must know full well that I would do much more than that directly to your countenance, Athena dear! Quite frankly, you could use a lot of work!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 小小神，你一定要原谅我们，我是说我们这个奥林匹斯大家庭！我们之中确实有几个自大的混蛋，他们总是想把事情搞得复杂起来。

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我在想，亲爱的阿弗洛狄忒，你是否愿意当着我的面再说一次那些话？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 噢，你肯定很清楚，我想做的可不仅仅是当着你的面说说那么简单，我亲爱的雅典娜！坦白说，你还差得远呢！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Dearest, you must know, Goddess Athena and myself, we don't always share a common view, perhaps because she overthinks things constantly, while my heart leads me on!

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I'm glad we understand each other, then. It would be most embarrassing to be caught bickering amongst ourselves in front of Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 亲爱的，你要知道，我和女神雅典娜一直都意见不合。可能是因为她总是想得太多，而我喜欢遵从内心！

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 很高兴我们互相理解了，要是让扎格列欧斯看到我们在争执，那就太尴尬了。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: I think for many of us, dearest, it can come as a surprise to learn that love and war often go hand in hand. Opposite forces, yet this connects them, doesn't it. The fiercest passions of gods and mortals! Isn't that right, Lord Ares?

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Mortals are so bent on clinging to their lives, that many among them would gladly kill for it. The surge of emotion which they feel... one passion is no different from another, Lady Aphrodite, dear.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 我想了很多关于我们之间的事情，亲爱的。我发现爱情与战争总是形影不离，这真让我吃了一惊。明明是截然相反的力量，却又如此紧密地结合在一起，不是吗？对众神与凡人而言，这正是最炽热的感情。我说得没错吧，阿瑞斯大人？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 凡人注定贪生怕死，其中有不少人为了自己能活下去，不惜杀死别人。他们所感受到的激情……其实没什么本质区别，亲爱的阿弗洛狄忒女士。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Oh dearest! I have brought you keen-eyed Artemis, who, in her focus on the hunt, has not developed social graces suitable enough to come to you herself!

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Social graces, she says! Going about like that! I'm sure you know that I can find you when it's necessary, Zagreus. Though, how to get away from Aphrodite, I have no idea.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 哦，我最亲爱的！我把眼观六路的阿尔忒弥斯带来了。她只会专心狩猎，不太明白来找你需要什么样的社交礼仪！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 她还说什么社交礼仪！就像这样！我敢肯定你明白，有必要的时候我会去找你的，扎格列欧斯。不过，至于怎么从阿弗洛狄忒这里逃开，我恐怕就不知道了。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: My powers, dearest, oft go hand-in-hand with those of Dionysus, with his power to persuade the mind to find such beauty where it isn't, really!

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Ah, haha, no need to flatter me like that, there, Lady Aphrodite! Beauty's almost entirely within the mind, I'm sure! And in the muscles and the jawline and the winning smile and, well, who am I to tell you, yeah?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 亲爱的，我的力量与迪奥尼索司的力量相辅相成。有了他的力量，人的心灵就能在根本没有美的地方发现美，真的！

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 啊，哈哈，没必要这么恭维我，阿弗洛狄忒女士！我敢肯定，美差不多只存在于心灵之中！当然，也存在于结实的肌肉、紧致的下颚与胜利的笑容之中。不过，这些话哪轮得到我跟你说呢？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: The venerable goddess of the seasons, Demeter, chooses to look as stately as can be, can you believe it, dearest? Although, why one would mark so many fine lines upon their face, I wouldn't know.

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Oh, Aphrodite, dear... you wouldn't know a thing of substance if it offered you a cloak. Your chosen countenance makes plain the full extent of your intentions, and your interests alike.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 你敢相信吗，亲爱的？尊敬的四季女神得墨忒尔想要让自己看起来尽可能地尊贵。不过我不明白，为什么人要往自己的脸上画那么多线呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 噢，亲爱的阿弗洛狄忒……千万不要被假象迷惑。外表能够反映你的全部想法，也能反映你的兴趣所在。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: OK, I think I'm ready. In the name of Hades! Olympus, this is an official message! And I hope it finds you well, Lady Aphrodite!

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Why, this is something, dearest! Such an enigmatic message you have sent. How positively captivating; I must know what it says. It bears the marks of others on Olympus, so... perhaps we ought to share some common knowledge on the subject, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好了，我觉得我准备好了。以哈迪斯之名！奥林匹斯山，这是一份官方来信！希望这封信能安全地交到你的手里，阿弗洛狄忒女士！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 哎呀，这可真是不同寻常啊，我最亲爱的！你发来的这条神秘信息，真是太让人心醉神迷了，我得弄清楚它说的是什么意思。这上面还有奥林匹斯其他人的印记，所以说……或许我们应该群策群力来解开这个谜语，是吗？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Oh, dearest, you've no idea what a delightful time I had while visiting you recently! So many new sights and sounds and smells, why, it was wonderful! And you are burdened with a big responsibility, aren't you? Mind if I lend my graces to you still from time to time...?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 哦，我最亲爱的，你可不知道我上次见你的时候有多么愉快！那么多新的景色、声音和气味，哎呀，那真是太美妙啦！另外，你现在肩负着重大责任，是吗？不介意我时不时地向你伸出援手吧……？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Lord Zeus has made acquaintances with you? Oh I sometimes forget that he's your uncle! His favor's well worth having, I assure you.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 宙斯大人认识你？哦，对，我总是忘记他是你叔叔！我向你保证，他的帮助真的非常值得。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: That oaf Poseidon spoke to you already, didn't he? All bluster, muscles, and bravado, that one. I'm glad you're not the type.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 那个呆头呆脑的波塞冬已经和你谈过了，是吗？他只知道咆哮、炫耀肌肉和虚张声势，那个波塞冬。我很高兴你不是那种人。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: You've met Athena, dearest, so you know not all the ladies on Olympus are alike. And I, for one, am grateful to our forebears for that!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 亲爱的，你见过雅典娜了，所以你肯定知道奥林匹斯山上的女士们并不都是一样的。作为其中一位女性，首先，我要感谢我们的祖先！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: I sense the mark of my Lord Ares on you, love. He's poorly understood among the gods, yet surely you can see fair qualities in him, and me?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 我感觉到阿瑞斯大人在你身上留下的印记，亲爱的。众神之中没有几个人能理解他，但你肯定你看到我和他身上优秀的品质吧？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: The sullen Artemis reached out to you, did she? Oh, that's adorable, dearest! Just don't make any sudden movements with her, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 幽怨的阿尔忒弥斯已经和你有接触了，是吗？哦，太可爱了，亲爱的！千万不要对她轻举妄动，知道吗？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: You are so fortunate to have received the Boon of Dionysus prior to my own! He, the most noble and important of us all, the god of wine, himself!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 你真幸运，还没得到我的恩赐，就先得到了迪奥尼索司的恩赐！他是众神最高贵，最重要的神，酒神，就是他！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Why, did sorrowful old Demeter get all the way to you before I did? She stubbornly refuses me when I offer to help! Unlike you, little godling!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 忧伤的老得墨忒尔在我之前先找到你了吗？我想要帮她，可她固执地拒绝了我！你和她可不一样，小小神！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: How I love to have these unexpected little run-ins with you, love! You are just so spontaneous, and I've a liking for that sort of thing!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 真喜欢咱们这些意想不到的小相遇，亲爱的！你的表现真是太自然了，我喜欢这样！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Keep following that heart of yours, dearest! It's good enough a guide, believe you me. Mine tells me you are going to succeed!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 继续跟随自己的心，亲爱的！它是个很好的向导，相信我。我的向导告诉我，你会成功的！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: You do know that I'm married, don't you, love...? I'd forgive you if you didn't, for my husband, he's always... busy with his work. I'm grateful that you're there for me to talk to.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 你知道我结婚了，不是吗，亲爱的……？如果你不知道，我会原谅你的，因为我丈夫总是……很忙。感激你陪我聊天。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: You're going to love it on Olympus, little godling. The air is beautiful and brisk, the gardens lush, the feasting plentiful...! Why, it must be the opposite of everything to which you are accustomed!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 你会喜欢奥林匹斯山的，小小神。那里空气清新，花园郁郁葱葱，盛宴丰盛……！哦，它肯定和你所习惯的一切都是相反的！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: What shall we do here once you finally arrive? Perhaps we could go out and meet some mortals! I know all too many maidens and/or noble gentlemen who'd absolutely love to get to know you.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 你到了以后，我们该去干点什么呢？也许我们可以出去见一些凡人！我认识许多年轻女孩和/或贵族绅士，他们很想认识你。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: A little bird once told me that the shade of the great hero called Achilles now resides within your father's residence, dearest? I always wished to meet with him someday...

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 一只小鸟曾经告诉我，伟大的英雄阿喀琉斯的魂魄现在就在你父亲的住处，亲爱的，是吗？我一直希望有一天能见到他……

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: You met Achilles after all, godling. He was quite instrumental in a war of my design. Still, he resisted my attempts to sway his actions. You tell him, simply, I admire him.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 毕竟，你之前见过阿喀琉斯，小小神。他在我设计的一场战斗中起了很大的作用。但他还是抵抗住了我的诱惑。你就告诉他，我对他很钦佩。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: The great hero Achilles, he continues to ignore my polite outreach, doesn't he? Why, I've attempted to reach out at least several times! Your father's realm is really quite a lot. How terribly frustrating it must be!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 伟大的英雄阿喀琉斯，他一直都在无视我礼貌性的搭讪，真是的。我都尝试过好几次了！你父亲的领地真是太广阔了，你肯定感觉很沮丧吧！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: You've had a brush with Megaera, the Fury, haven't you? Oh I know a thing or two about that one. Though, lately we Olympians no longer mingle with those living in the Underworld. You're the only exception!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 你和复仇女神三姐妹之一墨纪拉有过接触，不是吗？哦，我对那有点了解。不过，最近奥林匹斯山众神不再和那些生活在冥界的亡灵混在一起了。你是唯一的例外！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: A little birdy told me recently that you and Megaera the Fury, why, you've grown quite close! Now do be careful around her, and, try not to get attached, there, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 一只小鸟最近告诉我，最近你和复仇女神三姐妹之一墨纪拉走得很近！现在，在她身边一定要小心，尽量不要和她在一起，知道吗？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Why, you have my Eternal Rose, don't you? I am so very touched that you'd think first of me among my mighty kin. It pleases me to know I'm in your thoughts!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 这不是我的永恒玫瑰吗？我太感动了，我有那么多强大的亲人，但你却第一个想起了我。你这么挂念我，我真是太高兴了！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Oh what is going on down there, dearest? I thought for certain you would make it out, but seems that nasty place has kept you grounded, hasn't it. But don't despair, and you take heart, won't you?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 噢，到底是怎么回事啊，亲爱的？我还以为你能逃出去呢，可你似乎被这鬼地方给困住了，是吧。但是别失望，振作起来，你可以的吧？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Something has stirred within your heart, dearest! Oh, I can always tell! A certain kind of love, for family? Yes, that must be it, I think! What could have transpired with you, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 有些事情让你心驰神往，我最亲爱的！我一眼就看出来了！是某种家族之爱，是吗？没错，我觉得肯定是！到底是什么事情让你这么在意呢，嗯？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: To think your father and that sweet Persephone, they were together down there, all along! I was so certain that your father's heart was cold. That's just the thing with love, dearest! That, sometimes, it surprises even me!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 想想看，你的父亲和珀尔塞福涅那个可人儿，他们能一直在冥界恩恩爱爱！我以前还以为你父亲是个铁石心肠的人呢。这就是爱情的魔力，我最亲爱的！有时候，它的力量就连我都会大吃一惊！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: My dearest little godling, how fares everything with you of late? I love to have these little interactions with you, simple as they are, for they have brightened many of my evenings here.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 我亲爱的小小神，最近过得如何？我喜欢和你之间这些小小的互动，简单明了，让我在这里的无数个夜晚不再孤独。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Little godling, you must know the seven types of love by now, don't you? It's quite a complicated field, though several types intrigue me most of all. In fact, why, I have several types of love for you, right here!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 小小神，你现在一定知道了七种不同的爱都有哪些了吧？不是很容易理解，不过，有几种我最感兴趣。实际上，我对你的爱就有好几种！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Dearest, why... I sense your heart is very full, indeed! You positively emanate with love. You must have grown quite close to many dear to you. Perhaps so you may do the same with me...? I'm so delighted to have seen your spirit shine.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 亲爱的……我感觉到你的心已经非常充实了！你全身都散发着爱。你一定跟很多人都拉近了关系，或许我们也可以拉近一点关系……？真的很高兴能看到你的精神焕发的样子。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Oh, my, dearest! I have to say, your heart is positively bursting with such love for so many you have come to care about! Your dearest friends, your burning passions, family, everyone! Why, you're like a living testament to my entire body of work!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 哦，我最亲爱的！我得说，你的心里充满了浓浓的爱意，因为你有那么多在乎的人！有你最亲密的朋友们，有你深爱的伴侣、家人，所有人！哎呀，你简直就像是我工作成果活生生的证明一样！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: I cannot help but wonder, dearest, why Lord Hades would have kept your mere existence hidden from us all this time. Perhaps he knew that, once you met us, you would stop at nothing to come seek us out!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 亲爱的，我不禁想知道为什么冥王哈迪斯要一直对我们隐瞒你的存在。也许他知道，一旦你碰到我们，你会不顾一切地来找我们！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: I sense you finally acted on your pent-up passion for the Fury Megaera, yes, little godling? These types of things, they don't escape my notice, and they're always so enjoyable to see!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 我感觉到了，你终于释放出了你对复仇女神墨纪拉压抑已久的感情，对吧小小神？这种事情从来逃不过我的法眼，真的非常有趣！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: How's fearsome Megaera the Fury treating you of late, hmm, dearest? I know her type so very well, indeed. She acts as though there's nothing that can get under her skin, isn't that right?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 可怕的复仇女神墨纪拉最近待你如何呀，嗯，亲爱的？我最了解她这种类型了。她总是表现得一副坚不可摧的样子，对不对？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Mmm, so my heart tells me that you've developed quite the bond with moody Thanatos, haven't you, there? I always figured that his brooding quality was just an act!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 嗯，我的心告诉我，你和多愁善感的塔纳托斯建立起了羁绊，对不对？我早就知道他是那种闷骚类型的！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Little godling, would that I knew every last detail of how you and Thanatos are getting on of late! The notorious incarnate of death, and the newly discovered son of Hades, fraternizing? It's positively scandalous I think!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 小小神，我真想了解最近你和塔纳托斯之间的一切细节啊！恶名昭彰的死神化身，和新晋登场的冥王之子，两人亲密无间？这禁断的关系究竟！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Erm, dearest? If my perfectly developed senses are correct, then you appear to be quite smitten with a little gorgon that you've met down there...? Why that must be adorable, if rather strange!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 嗯，亲爱的？如果我的感觉没错的话，你似乎被一个小蛇发女妖给迷住了……？真是太可爱了，虽然有点怪！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Why, something's changed about the beating of your heart, dearest! Oh, it's the little gorgon, isn't it. You Underworld dwellers and your complicated feelings! I can never get enough. My blessings to the both of you, then, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 你的心跳变了，亲爱的！噢，是那个小蛇发女妖，对吧？你们冥界的人和你们复杂的情感，真是吸引人啊！我就一起祝福你们俩吧，怎么样？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Oh, look at you, you poor, poor thing, you're hurt! Though, let me see if I can make it better.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 哦，看看你，可怜的家伙，你受伤了！不过，让我看看，也许我能治好你的伤。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Tsk, you're in no condition for an outing with me, dearest. Though, perhaps you might recover from your hardships with my aid?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 啧，以你现在的情况，你没办法和我出去约会，亲爱的。不过，也许你可以在我的帮助下从困境中恢复过来？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Dearest, why, your heart rate's fluctuating wildly! Has it really been that bad up to this point? I'll try to help however much I can.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 亲爱的，你的心跳频率波动很大！情况真有这么糟糕吗？我会尽我所能帮忙的。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Oh, you're just in an awful situation, aren't you. Yet, I can tell your proud heart keeps on beating, for the moment anyway! Don't die just yet!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 噢，你还真是遇上麻烦了呢。不过，你骄傲的心脏依然在跳动着，起码现在是这样！可别死了噢！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Ah, little godling, you're about to die! Why, none of us want that, because if so, you won't get to enjoy my blessings here!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 啊，小小神，你快死了！你可不能死啊，如果你死了，你就得不到我的恩赐了！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: I have been waiting for a special moment to confess my great appreciation for your deeds... this moment's special enough, isn't it?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 我一直在等待一个特殊的时刻，来表达我对你的感激之情……这一刻很特别，不是吗？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: My loveliest of blessings is reserved only for those who've earned my deepest adoration. So, congratulations, love! And here you go!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 我最可爱的祝福只留给我最敬佩的人，所以，恭喜你，亲爱的！接受我的祝福吧！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Sometimes, our hearts become so full that they could burst! If only you could see how much I care. I would do anything to aid you in your plight! My heartfelt blessings be with you, dearest.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 有时候，我们的心实在是装得太满了，甚至会被撑开！要是你能明白我有多在乎你就好了，我愿意做任何事来帮助你！我衷心给予你我的恩赐，亲爱的。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Little godling, you must know that the heart has infinite capacity for empathy. And I so feel for you there, that I have mustered for you some of the most beautiful of blessings I can offer!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 小小神啊，你要知道，人心都是肉长的。我真的是太在乎你了，我愿意给你我能提供的、最美的恩赐！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I must be a mess, let's see here. Hi there! In the name of Hades! Olympus, I accept this message.

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Why hello, hello, there, little godling. I have to say you're quite the specimen, and so, I've decided I shall aid you for the moment. You interested?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我一定是一团糟，我们来看看这里。你好！以哈迪斯之名！奥林匹斯山，我收到了这条消息。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 喂喂你好啊，小小神。不得不说你可真是个好样本呢，所以我呢打算帮助你一下。怎么样。怎么样？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Did you miss me, little godling, hm? I thought I'd steal away a bit and that together we might make up for lost time.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 你想我了吗，小小神，嗯？我想我会省略一些步骤，这样我们可以一起弥补我们错过的时间。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Hello again, there, little godling, let's get to it, hm? I want what you want; there's no further need for words.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 你好，又见面了，小小神，我们开始吧，嗯？我们的目标是一致的，不必再言其他。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Oh, boo, looks like you've rather got yourself into a bind, there, haven't you. Though, not to worry, dearest. I can pull some strings.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 哦，嘘，看来你把自己弄得一团糟，对吧。不过，不用担心，亲爱的。我可以动用一些关系。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: There, there, dearest, you'll tell me all your troubles just as soon as you arrive, so let's just get you out of there for now.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 好吧，好吧，亲爱的，你一到这里就要把所有烦恼告诉我，我们现在就把你救出去。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: What is it, love, are you still having problems with the dead? I swear, you'd think they had enough of me in life!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 怎么了，亲爱的，对那些亡灵，你还有什么问题吗？我敢肯定，你会觉得他们在往生前就受够我了！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: What did I miss since last time, anything of interest, hm? You'll have to fill me in once you break free, dearest.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 上次以来，我错过了什么有趣的事情吗，嗯？亲爱的，一旦你成功逃离，你就得一五一十地告诉我。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Well, look at you, there, love! So well-prepared to take on any danger that may come! But, I must wonder, are you well-prepared for this?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 哦，看看你，亲爱的。你要对任何可能发生的危险有所准备！但是，我必须知道，你准备好了吗？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Ready yourself, dearest, because you and I? We're going to have ourselves a little outing I expect that neither one of us shall soon forget.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 你准备好了吗，亲爱的，因为你和我？我们要出去约会一下，我们谁也不会很快忘记的。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Would you by any chance have room, there, in your heart for a most-gentle blessing from a goddess such as me?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 在你的心里，还容得下来自女神最温柔的祝福吗，比如我？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Don't lose heart, now, little godling! I won't have you giving up before you get to see me in the flesh among the gardens of Olympus here...!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 别灰心，小小神，现在就开始行动！在奥林匹斯山的花园里见到我之前，我不会让你放弃的……！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Dearest, I've known many gods and godlings through the ages. And, I have to say, you're quite intriguing, even for our kind.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 亲爱的，我认识很多神和小小神。而且，我不得不说，你很有趣，即使是对我们族群来说。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Oh, dearest, I suspect we'll have ourselves a most exciting time together, you and I! Just do your best and it'll all be fine!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 哦，亲爱的，我们会度过一段最激动人心的时光，只有你和我！只要尽力，一切都会好起来的！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: I am always here, or close enough, to help you through whatever troubles you may face, my little godling. So do not hesitate to call upon me, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 我会一直在你身边，或者就在你附近，我会帮助你度过任何困难，我亲爱的小小神。所以不要犹豫，来找我，好吗？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: I'd ask you show me a good time, there, love, although I almost can't imagine a good time where you reside! So dreary, constantly!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 我想让你给我展示那里的一段美好时光，亲爱的，尽管我几乎无法想象你所住的地方能有什么美好时光！如此沉闷，一直都是这样！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: I missed you terribly, my little godling! All that I ask is that you do not die on me again, why, I don't think that I can take it anymore!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 我很想你，我亲爱的小小神！我只求你不要再前功尽弃，哦，我想我再也受不了了！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: How you must yearn to reach the surface, little godling! It likewise stirs in me a yearning to assist you, by all means at my disposal!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 你是多么希望从那里逃出来啊，小小神！这同样也让我更想尽我所能地帮助你！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: No need to worry any longer, dearest! I bring you strength and comfort, and I shall be watching every step of yours most carefully.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 不用再考虑了，亲爱的！我会给你带来力量和安慰，我会非常仔细地关注你的每一步。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Ah, how I long to see you face-to-face! Until such time, however, this old means of keeping touch shall have to do. So you take care, now, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 啊，我多么希望见到你本人！然而，在这之前，我们必须使用这种旧方法保持联系，所以你要小心，知道吗？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: You know I would do anything to have you here among us, don't you, love? Oh, I just hope my blessings are enough...!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 你知道，为了让你成为我们中的一员，我可以做任何事，知道吗，亲爱的？哦，我只希望我的祝福足够……！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Love tends to blossom in the strangest places at the strangest times, you know that, don't you, dearest? All one can do is entertain the chance.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 爱往往会在最陌生的时间，在最陌生的地方产生，你知道吗，亲爱的？我们能做的就是抓住机会。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Don't work yourself too hard down there, you promise, little godling? We need you in good shape and spirits on Olympus here.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 在冥界不要太勉强自己，答应我好吗，小小神？我们希望你到奥林匹斯山后，身体和精神都好好的。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: What do you say we skip the chat and get right to it, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 不聊了，直接开始吧，你觉得呢？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Oh, would you look at whom I found, all by his lonely self.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 哦，你看我找到谁了，他一直都是这么孤孤单单。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Let's see what mischief we can make, between the two of us!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 我们来看看，我俩之间会发生什么有趣的事！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: You want my blessings, dearest, here they are!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 你想要我的祝福吗，亲爱的，在这里！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: I hope I didn't keep you waiting very long, did I?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 我希望我没让你等太久。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Even immortal hearts can break, my little godling.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 即使再坚若磐石的心也有柔软的一面，我亲爱的小小神。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: What do you say we go and make new friends together, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 我们一起去交新朋友怎么样，嗯？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: You seem like you could use a helping hand, there, love.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 你看上去需要帮助，亲爱的。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: The bond of love is strong enough to suffer any hardship, dearest.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 爱的纽带能够抵御一切艰难困苦，亲爱的。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Times of adversity make love grow even stronger, little godling.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 艰难逆境只会让爱更加强大，小小神。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: I hate to see you struggling, dearest! Please do be careful, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 我不想看到你痛苦的样子，亲爱的！请小心一点，好吗？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Love conquers everything, you see that, don't you, dearest?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 爱可以征服一切，你明白这个道理对吧，亲爱的？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Think of all those you love, and may they spur your courage, little godling.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 想一想你所爱的人，愿他们激发你的勇气，小小神。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Your passion to achieve your goal is quite inspiring, I have to say!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 你实现目标的激情非常鼓舞人心！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: It's such a pity I can barely see you in that awful darkness, little godling.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 你在那种黑暗的地方我完全看不清你，真是可惜啊，小小神。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Love spurs the heart to greater acts of valor, doesn't it, dearest?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 爱会鼓舞人们做出伟大的勇敢行动，对吧，亲爱的？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Take heart, now, little godling. And how about you take this from me, as well.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 振作起来，小小神。现在我把这个送给你。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: I'd love to help you however best I'm able, my little godling.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 我愿意尽我所能来帮助你，我的小小神。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: I have the loveliest selection of my blessings for you this time, dearest!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 我为你带来了我充满爱意的祝福，亲爱的！

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: I think I'll give you something very special this time, little godling.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 这次我应该给你一点特别的东西了，小小神。

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Is not the purest act of love to aid somebody in their time of need?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 在他人需要之际帮助他们，不就是最纯洁的爱意之举吗？

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: I'm feeling wonderful of late, dearest, so here, enjoy the benefits!

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 最近我感觉非常美妙，亲爱的，来，享受这些恩赐吧！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Lady Aphrodite, I am truly blessed simply to have made your acquaintance, so, this is for you.

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Lasting relationships are built on reciprocity. So if you lavish me with gifts, why, what am I to do but give you something in return?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿弗洛狄忒女士，我真的很荣幸认识你，所以，这是给你的。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 持久的关系建立在互惠互利的基础上。所以，如果你给我许多礼物，哦，我除了礼尚往来，还能怎么做呢？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: My lady Aphrodite, if not for our acquaintance, I am certain that my days or nights would be much drearier indeed.

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Why, dearest, such a wonderfully thoughtful gift, for me? I love it, and I would be lying if I said you shouldn't have!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我的阿弗洛狄忒女士，如果不是认识了你，我的生活一定会沉闷得多。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 哦，亲爱的，你送我的礼物真是太贴心了。我很喜欢，如果我说你不应该送给我的话，那我就是撒谎！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Lady Aphrodite, I'm afraid there really isn't much here worthy of you, but perhaps this can suffice.

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: My, but if this isn't such a treasure to behold, and I accept it as a sign of your affection! Of something even more, perhaps...?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿弗洛狄忒女士，这里没有什么配得上你的礼物，但也许这个勉强够得上。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 天哪，但这件礼物太贵重了，我就把它作为你的爱意接受了！更重要的是，也许……？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dear Aphrodite, surely you have all the offerings you can stand, but I would ask that you accept one more.

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Ah, dearest, but it stirs my heart to know you care so deeply for our wonderful relationship! To celebrate it with such princely gifts!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 亲爱的阿弗洛狄忒，我知道你有许多贡品，但我还是想请你再接受一个。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 啊，亲爱的，你如此关心我们之间的良好关系，让我好激动！用高贵的礼物来庆祝它！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dear Aphrodite, the incomparable beauty of Olympus is less difficult to fathom, having already met you. I am so grateful to have earned your favor.

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: My, but don't you come on rather strong, there, little godling! Though, I can take much more of your affections, you shall see!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 亲爱的阿弗洛狄忒，在见面之后，我便发觉，您当之无愧奥林匹斯山上无与伦比的最美的神。能够得到您的青睐是我莫大的荣幸。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 真是的，你可真是会说话呢，小小神！不过，就算是更多的爱，我也乐于接受噢，你明白的吧！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Aphrodite, you must have more worshipers and suitors than all your kin upon Olympus combined. I may not fall exactly into either category, though I hope you know my gratitude for all you've done for me is true.

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: You know, dearest, I am more worshiped than perhaps anybody else upon Olympus! You'd think getting such praise would roll right off my back by now, but no! I love receiving it. Especially from you.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿弗洛狄忒，您的追随者和爱慕者应该比所有奥林匹斯山的亲人们加起来还要多吧。也许我既不是爱慕者，也不是追随者，但希望你明白，我对你的感激发自真心。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 我亲爱的，我的崇拜者比奥林匹斯山的任何神都要多！你是不是在想，如此多的爱慕，我一定倍感压力吧，并没有！我最喜欢别人的爱慕了，尤其是你的爱慕。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: My lady Aphrodite, once more you've graced me with your presence and your favor, which inspire the best from me. Let this modest gift of Ambrosia signify I'm forever in your debt.

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: My little godling. I'd say you've honored me more times than I could count, but that would be a lie, now, wouldn't it. I so admire your devotion and your perseverance! If ever you do reach us on Olympus, I should very much enjoy getting to know you even better, then.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿弗洛狄忒女士，您再次眷顾了我，出现在我面前，这对我来说是极大的鼓舞。谨以这微不足道的仙馔密酒，来表达我对您无尽的感激之情。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 我的小小神啊，我本想说你已经无数次让我感到荣幸了，但这恐怕就有点夸张了，是吧？我非常欣赏你的毅力和奉献精神！如果我们能够在奥林匹斯相见，我会非常乐意进一步了解你。

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Hey Zag, my Dad, he's here and wants to have a word, be cool man, go along with what he says, OK?

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: That Dionysus, always much too kind with introductions, though at least he shows me suitable respect. Perhaps someday he can instruct you in the customs of Olympus here.

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 嘿，扎格，我的父亲来了，想说两句话，你要好好的，听他的话，好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 那个迪奥尼索司，尽管他对我表示了起码的尊重，但对我的介绍总是太过客气。也许，有一天他能教你奥林匹斯山这里的风俗。

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Uh, Zag, erm... your uncle's passing through. Not Dad, erm, the other one I mean, and he just wanted to check in, see how you're doing, so...

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Ah-hah, there you are, my little nephew! Dionysus showing you the ropes, or what? You want a real feast, though, you just stick with me! Now take my blessing, go!

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Oh, anyway we're here, man, waiting up for you! We know you're going to make it, I would say eventually?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 呃，扎格，嗯……是你叔叔过来了。不，不是我爸，呃，我是说你另一个叔叔，他只是想过来看看，看看你怎么样，所以……

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 啊哈你在这里，我的小侄子！迪奥尼索司在给你指点迷津，还是什么？但如果你想品尝真正的美味，只是一直与我紧密配合！现在，再带上我的祝福，去战斗吧！

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 噢，伙计，不管怎样，我们都会在这里等你！我们知道你会成功的，我是说你最终一定会取得胜利！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Hey, Zag, when you arrive, it's going to be a real scene, I'll tell you now! Even Athena here will cut loose for a bit, let down her hair, you know, put on something more comfy, yeah, it's going to be great!

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Perhaps Lord Dionysus here is the true god of strategy, as it appears he is uncannily aware of my next move, Cousin. Although, be that as it may, I shall attempt to remain focused on your situation. Not his feast.

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 嘿，扎格，我敢说，等你来这里的时候，一定会很热闹的！你看，就连雅典娜都不像平时那么板着脸了，把头发放了下来，也换上了更舒适的衣服。没错，到时候肯定会很热闹的！

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 迪奥尼索司大人似乎总是能不经意间看穿我的意图，或许他才是真正的策略之神，表亲。不过，即便如此，我也会努力更关注你的情况，而不是他的盛宴。

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: You know, Zag, maybe once you get here, you could get old Ares to just lighten up a little, you know, man? Always dragging down the mood, with talk of blood, and nastiness, all sorts of stuff like that!

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Why, my Lord Dionysus! I fail to see why such discussion is perceived as unbecoming of a feast. A successfully conducted war is certainly a cause for celebration, is it not?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 说真的，扎格。等你来了之后，说不定连老阿瑞斯也能变得开朗一些呢。你知道的吧？他总是谈论什么鲜血啊，死亡啊之类的破事，把这里的气氛都搞僵了！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 这有什么呢，迪奥尼索司大人！我不明白你们为什么要把这种话题当做洪水猛兽。只有战争顺利结束，人们才有理由庆祝，不是吗？

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Look, Zag, you should know by now that when it comes to feasting, it's Yours Truly here who puts on the best performance. But I do have Lady Aphrodite's help!

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Wine does have a rather special way of making everybody look even more beautiful than ever, Dionysus dear! And from such beauty, why, long-lasting love is born! And also shorter-lasting love, much of the time.

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 你看，扎格，你现在应该已经明白了，要是论庆祝，那可没人比你这位老哥更在行了。不过，这也多亏了能有阿弗洛狄忒女士的帮助。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 酒确实有种特殊的魔力，能让每个人都变得比平时更有魅力，亲爱的迪奥尼索司！而正是因为这种魅力，才能诞生长久的爱情！不过，更多时候诞生的是转瞬即逝的爱情。

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Zag, man, I was just attempting here to get our good friend Artemis to finally make an appearance at one of my feasts, it's just... wouldn't you know, she's all preoccupied, something about a hunt?

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: That's right, Lord Dionysus, a hunt! Which requires lots and lots of total quiet, and clear-minded focus. So, if you'll excuse me?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 扎格伙计，我希望我们的好朋友阿尔忒弥斯也能在我的酒宴上露个面，不过……你也知道，她对此完全不感兴趣，她好像只在乎什么狩猎？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 没错，迪奥尼索司大人，正是狩猎！狩猎需要保持彻底的安静，头脑也要始终冷静才行。所以，不介意我先行告退吧？

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Hey Zag, got a favor here I mean to ask, could you maybe persuade the Lady Demeter to ease up on the whole 'not let anything grow' thing she's been going on about?

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I daresay, my Lord Dionysus, that partaking of less wine for some amount of time might do you good. Regardless, you'll not coax a better crop from me.

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 嘿，扎格，我想问你些事情。你能不能帮忙劝劝得墨忒尔女士，让她稍微停一下这种“万物停止生长”的把戏？

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我敢说，迪奥尼索司大人，少喝酒对你是还是有好处的。再怎么说，你也不可能从我这里骗走更多东西了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hope this lives up to your expectations, mate. In the name of Hades! Olympus? This is an official message! Should be a good time, Lord Dionysus!

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Whoa, hold just for a moment, Zag, now, I can recognize an invite when I see one, man! And this is definitely almost certainly some sort of invite, one for me, and... one for everybody else, it looks like, here? Hoh, I'm excited, that is something really special, I can tell!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 希望这不会让你失望，朋友。以哈迪斯之名！奥林匹斯山，这是一份官方来信！你应该会很觉得很有趣，迪奥尼索司大人！

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 哇啊，等一下，扎格。要是有人送我邀请函，我是肯定不会看错的！很显然，这封信就是某种邀请函，又给我的……还有给其他人的。看起来是这么回事，没错吧？哎呀，我的兴致来了。看得出来，这东西相当特别！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Look, Zag, I don't entirely recall what happened at that feast you threw for all of us down there, but let me tell you, I am under the impression it went smashingly! It was amazing, man! Let's have another one sometime, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 你看，扎格，你邀请我们去的那场盛宴上发生的事情，我已经记不太清楚了。不过我可以告诉你，我感觉那场盛宴真的是无与伦比！真是无以复加！咱们下次再开一场那样的宴会吧，好不好？

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: So Zag, you met my dad by now, your uncle Zeus? He's cool and loves a feasting, just... be sure to keep him in your thoughts. OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 那么扎格，现在，你见到我爸爸，也就是你的宙斯叔叔了吗？他很酷，喜欢大吃大喝，只是……你一定要记着他，好吗？

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Hoh-ho, no way Zag, looking like you got yourself a gift from old Poseidon there? He's quite the catch, but here, hope you saved some room for more!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 呵呵，没门，扎格，你好像从老波塞冬那里得到了礼物？他是个很好的人选，但在这里，希望你能为更多的人留点空间！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Hey man, I heard Athena had a word with you already yeah? She's cool, though, once you get to know her. Here! I got something that ought to suit her style.

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 嘿，伙计，我听说雅典娜已经和你谈过了，是吗？不过，认识她后，你就会知道她还是很酷的。这里！我有些东西应该适合她的风格。

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Whoa, hey, you must have had a run-in with the lovely Aphrodite, am I right, or am I right, there Zag? But I have just the thing to go with her!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 哇，你一定和可爱的阿弗洛狄忒有过冲突，对吗，扎格？但我刚好有适合的玩意儿来配合她！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Hey, Zag, got to tell you, I cannot believe that little Artemis is hanging out with you! She doesn't hang with anybody, man! But I digress, take this!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 嘿，扎格，得告诉你，我不敢相信小阿尔忒弥斯会和你厮混在一起！她从来不和任何人来往，伙计！我有些离题了，拿着这个！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: You hanging out with Ares, are you, Zag? He's quite the chap, I'll give him that, I'll give him that, and now, I'll give you this!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 你和阿瑞斯混在一起，是吗？他是个很不错的家伙，我会把那个给他，现在，我把这个给你！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Felt a shiver in the air just now, and that can only mean that chilly Demeter decided to give you a little help, there, huh? Or maybe it's just cold, I mean, this is a mountaintop!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 我刚刚感觉到空气中有一丝寒意，这只能说明冷酷的得墨忒尔给予了你一点帮助，对吧？还是说，就是单纯的冷罢了，毕竟我这里可是山顶呢！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Hey, Zag, uh... I may just be losing it or something here, but isn't that your dad's own blessing that you've got? That's something, man, I didn't know that he was helping you!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 嘿，扎格，呃……可能是我哪里搞错了，不过你带着的不是你父亲本人的祝福吗？这可太让人意外了，朋友，我没想到就连他也在帮你！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Now how's my favorite Underworld god surviving, Zag, you holding up or what? Right better momentarily, I bet!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 我最喜欢的冥界之神是怎么活到现在的，扎格，你撑住了还是怎么？我敢打赌，这最好是暂时的！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Man oh man, Zag, someday you will be the guest of honor at the biggest feast that you have ever seen! Though I know you have got your hands full for the time, so, first things first!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 天啊，扎格，总有一天，你会成为可以享受盛宴的贵宾！虽然我知道你现在忙得不可开交，但首先你要解决最重要的问题！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Sometimes I have to wonder, man, what's going through your head, I mean, I know you hear me and the others but it's so damn dark down there I can't hear you at all!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 有时候，我不得不想，伙计，你脑子里到底在想什么，我是说，我知道你听到了我和其他人的声音，但是那里太黑了，我听不到一点你的声音！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Let me tell you something, Zag, I know your dad he's got to be a real handful, I relate to that, you understand me, mate? So you get out of there, and you'll be more than welcome here, with us!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 让我告诉你，扎格，你爸爸一定是个很难对付的人，我同意你的看法，明白吗，伙计？所以你离开那里，我们非常欢迎你来这里，和我们住在一起！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: I've got a feeling this time, man, like things are really going to take a turn for you, and I mean for the better, almost certainly, I think!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 我有种感觉，伙计，我感觉你的事情终于要有转机了。我指的是好的那种转机，我基本能确信这一点！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: The key to any halfway decent feast is lots and lots of preparation, man. Or maybe just having to improvise, you know?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 如果你什么事情都准备得妥妥当当，最后肯定只能搞出虎头蛇尾的酒宴。我是说，我们得即兴发挥啊，是吧？

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: I got to hand it to you, Zag, you don't back down, you don't ever back down, what is this, like the twentieth time that you've attempted to escape?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 我要把它交给你，扎格，你不要退缩，永远都不要退缩，这算什么，就像你第二十次试图逃离一样？

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: You're getting somewhere, getting somewhere, man, I understand you made it up to Asphodel before, now that is progress, keep it up, you keep on going, yeah?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 你会成功的，会成功的，伙计，我知道你以前曾经到达过水仙花平原，现在还到了更远的地方，继续加油，继续努力，不要放弃，好吗？

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Heard you wrestled with some Satyrs near the surface, Zag! Nice work making it that far, and I just want to let you know that they are definitely not my crew, man! Satyrs I know aren't like that at all!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 听说你和凡间附近一个叫萨提尔的家伙打了一架，扎格！没想到你能走这么远，而且我也只是想让你知道，他们绝对不是我的人，小伙子！我认识的萨提尔完全不是这样！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Ah, Zag, what happened last time, man? It seemed like you were rather close, but then, we couldn't see you anymore from here, and now you're back? Well, give another go!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 啊，扎格，我的小伙子，上次发生了什么？你上次好像离我们很近，但我们突然就看不见你了，现在你又回来了？只是又尝试了一次而已！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Want you to know something, here, man. It's been a bit of a long haul, but you are getting closer to the surface, and you'll get there someday, and we're with you, however long it takes, OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 有件事想让你知道，朋友。这场旅途挺漫长的，但你正在一步一步接近上面的世界，总有一天你一定能到达那里。无论要花多长时间，我们都会在你身边，好吗？

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Hey, back when we had that feast, there, man, I, I hope I didn't, you know, make for any inconveniences or anything down there, did I...?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 嘿，伙计，上次咱们举行盛宴的时候，我，我希望我当时没给你们造成什么不便或者麻烦之类的，我没有吧……？

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Zag, I cannot believe your mom's Persephone, that's something else, I got to tell you, man! I never took her for the sort to be all into Underworld stuff!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 扎格，我真不敢相信你的母亲居然是珀尔塞福涅。不得不说，这可是在是太惊人了！我从来没想过她居然会和冥界有什么关系！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Say, isn't that the Overflowing Cup I handed down to you, I'm glad you like it, man! I guess it's overflowing still, because I figure otherwise I couldn't tell at all!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 嘿，那不是我给你的满溢酒杯嘛！我很高兴你喜欢，伙计！我猜里面的酒还是冒出来的，因为就算不是这么回事，我也看不出来！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: You, man, must be mates with just about everybody down there, by now, yeah? Doling out Nectars left and right, just livening the place right up!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 我说，伙计，你肯定差不多和每个人都混熟了吧，是吧？看看你，一会请这个喝杯蜜露，一会请那个喝一杯，把这里的气氛完全搞起来了！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Say, let me just point out you've got a lot of Nectar on you, man! Oh, I can tell, I like the stuff a lot, myself, but even I don't pack that much, and I mean, wow!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 我就直说了吧，你身上带了很多蜜露啊，伙计！我看得出来，我自己也很喜欢这东西，不过就算是我，也不会随身带这么多。你可真是，哎哟！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Say, man, if I'm not mistaken, I think you got yourself a bottle of Ambrosia, there? I'd no idea you could get that stuff downstairs! Do me a solid, though, hang on to any more you find, or better yet, give it away! I'd hate to think even a drop has gone to waste!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，伙计，如果我没弄错的话，你身上是带了瓶仙馔密酒吧？我真不知道你在冥界是怎么搞到这种东西的。不过帮我个忙吧， 如果你再找到这种酒，就自己喝了，或者干脆请别人喝了！我可不想看到这种好酒被浪费掉，一滴都不想！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Well, would you just look at yourself, Zag! You are like a walking stockpile of Ambrosia, aren't you? Taking the best care of it, at that. I knew I could count on you, but... <Sniff> I didn't know I could be just so proud of you, you know, man?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 嘿，快看看你自己的样子吧，扎格！你简直就像个会走的酒窖一样，是吧？这一点你做得真是没人能比。我早知道你靠得住，<嗅嗅> 不过，我没想到你能让我感到这么骄傲，伙计！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Zag, turns out I am quite the judge of character, and you, man, have an awful lot of it, I mean, you've given out how much Ambrosia now? To all your mates, and more?!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 扎格伙计，我看人的眼光一向很准，你和我之间相像的地方简直是太多太多了。我是说，你已经送出去多少片仙馔密酒了？你所有的同伴都给过了吗？而且不止如此？！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: You got to let me in on something, Zag, how did you gather up so much Ambrosia, there? I mean, sometimes I think the stuff is plentiful up here, but you are positively swimming in it, man!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 你可真是让我吃惊啊，扎格，你到底是怎么弄到那么多仙馔密酒的？！我是说，有时候我以为我这里的酒就够多了，但看看你那边，简直都能在里面游泳了，伙计！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: You are the talk of the mountain, you know that, man? Good on you, getting on just about everybody's good side up here, I mean, that is a feat, all right!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 你知道吗，伙计？你已经是整个奥林匹斯山的热门话题了！你干的不错，几乎所有人对你的印象都很好。我是说，这可真是个成就啊，真的！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Hey Zag, ever see a fellow by the name of Orpheus down there, you ever heard of him? I bet you have, and I have had a funny thought, a little jest that maybe we could try, if you'd be up to have a little harmless fun?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Harmless fun at the expense of Orpheus? You have my full and complete attention, Dionysus mate.

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: ...That chap comes up with the most smashing songs, so I was thinking, maybe we could spin him a tall tale, something like how maybe you and I, like, we're connected or something? He'll buy it, tell him, tell him for me, yeah?!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 嘿，扎格，在冥界见过一个叫俄耳甫斯的家伙吗，你听说过他吗？我敢打赌，你听说过，我有一个有趣的想法，一个有趣的小玩笑，如果想来点没有恶意的小玩笑，也许我们可以尝试？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 以牺牲俄耳甫斯为代价，没有恶意的玩笑？我会密切关注你，迪奥尼索司的朋友。

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: ……那家伙唱歌可行了，所以我在想，也许我们可以给他编个故事，说你和我之间存在着某种联系，怎么样？他绝对会信。告诉他，替我和他说说这件事，好不好？！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Hahaha, Zag! I heard you got to Orpheus, he's got this whole entire ballad now, about how you are really me, or maybe it's the other way around, I've no idea, hahahaha! Here!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 哈哈哈，扎格！我听说你整俄耳甫斯的事了，他都写出来了，说什么你才是真正的我，或者我才是真正的你什么的，我记不住了。哈哈哈哈！来吧！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Zag, I heard that Orpheus, he found his missing bride, why, isn't that the sweetest thing, isn't it, man? I'll drink to that, and I think so should you!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 扎格，我听说俄耳甫斯他找到他失踪的新娘了。真是件大好事啊，对吧？为这件事干杯，你也应该来一杯！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Erm, hey, man, you been having some bad run-ins with that Fury, Megaera, is that her name? Now isn't she a real firebrand! Maybe this'll help you out next time you meet!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 呃，嘿，伙计，你和复仇女神墨纪拉有过不愉快的冲突吗？现在，她变成了一个不折不扣的煽动者！也许，这能在你们下次见面时对你有所帮助！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Whoa, Zag, heard you're hanging with the Fury Megaera of late, well cheers to that, man, bet she's something else, but you just watch for that whip of hers, OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 哇噢，扎格，听说你最近和复仇女神墨纪拉走得很近，可喜可贺呀小伙子，不过她可不简单，特别是要小心她的鞭子。

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Hey man, I'm hearing up here that you got in good with Megaera, the Fury, is that right, I mean, I hope it is, because, hahaha, yeow, know what I mean? They say she's something else!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 嘿，伙计，我听说你最近和复仇女神墨纪拉关系不错，是吧？我希望是，因为，哈哈哈，你懂的。你懂我什么意思吧？大家都说她可不简单！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Hey, you're in good with Thanatos, isn't that right? A real broody sort, sometimes I think maybe I ought to just invite him to a feast, but then, what if he cools the whole thing down, makes everybody kind of ehhhhh, you know?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你和塔纳托斯的关系不错，是吧？他简直是个白痴。有时候我在想，我是不是也应该邀请他参加我的酒宴，可我转念一想，万一他把气氛搞砸了呢，万一他害得所有人都呃呃呃呃呃了呢，你懂的吧？

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Heard that you took care of Theseus down in Elysium of late, there, Zag! Nice work, never liked that one, between us. There's this nice lass helped him out one time, and he just dumped her rotten, I don't like that, man!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 听说你最近在至福乐土好好教训了忒修斯一顿，是吗，扎格！干得漂亮，我一直就不喜欢他，你可别说出去。以前有个可爱的姑娘帮过他一次，但他翻脸不认人。我不喜欢这样的人，小伙子！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Why, you've a Yarn of Ariadne, right there, Zag, I know the lass for whom that yarn is named! She was a right attractive one, we had our little time, long story, though, will save it till you get here!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 为什么你有阿里阿德涅的纱线，扎格，我认识这个叫阿里阿德涅的小姑娘！她很有魅力，我们两人还有一段小故事，不过说来话长，等你来到这里再和你细说吧！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Whoaa Zag, man, you look positively knackered, you be sure and take it easy if you can out there, all right? Here, maybe this'll help!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 哇，扎格，兄弟，你看起来精疲力尽，你如果能逃出去，一定要轻轻松松的，好吗？给你，也许这会有所帮助！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Oof, Zag, look, I know you're not in a good spot right now, you must be really out of sorts! Though maybe this might numb the pain a bit!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 哦，扎格，听着，我知道你现在处境不好，你一定很不舒服！也许这能稍微缓解一下你的痛苦！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Eugh, you're a proper mess right now, got to be candid with you, man, you're bleeding everywhere, get it together, yeah?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 呃啊，你这也太狼狈了吧。我说真的，伙计，你的血流得到处都是，你还能撑得住吧？

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Now what's the matter, down there, Zag, it's like you've been up feasting day and night, you're barely standing, everything OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 你这是怎么了，扎格？是你没日没夜地喝酒，喝得连站都站不起来了吗？一切还好吧？

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Ooh, you're in no shape to be going off, what happened to you, there? Well, here, you know what? Let me see if we can get you back into it, man!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 哦哦，你这个样子可是撑不下去的啊，你这是怎么了？好吧，不然就这么着吧？让我看看我能不能想办法让你恢复一下，伙计！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Oh-hoh, Zag, have I got something special here for you, I mean this here is top-notch stuff, even among the top-notch stuff I have to give, just look at this!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 哦吼，扎格，我有一件特别的东西要给你，这可是个好东西，和什么极品相比都毫不逊色，你看！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Look, man, I am feeling generous right now, know what I mean? And so, here's something extra potent for you, ought to keep you going for a while longer than you're used to, there!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 小伙子，我最近都很慷慨，你知道我的意思吗？对了，它的力道特别持久，应该可以让你比过去更精力充沛，收下吧！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That was... revelry? People having a good time? Well, sure, then! In the name of Hades! Olympus, I'll accept this message.

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Heeey, there, Zag, man, how's it going? Look, you have got to get here with the rest of us already, we've been saving you a spot! Let me see what I can do, make life a little sweeter for you in the meantime!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那是……狂欢？人们玩得很开心。好吧，当然，那么：以哈迪斯之名！奥林匹斯山，我收到了这条消息。

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 嘿，扎格，伙计，你还好吗？听着，你一定要和我们其他人一起到这里来，我们给你留了位置！让我看看我能做些什么，让你的日子能好过一点！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Looks like this feast is getting started still, am I not right about that, Zag? Come on, let's show everybody a good time.

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 看来，这场盛宴已经开始，我说的不对吗，扎格？来吧，我们让大家好好乐一乐。

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Just getting warmed up down there, yeah, Zag? Here, I've a fine selection of my blessings, just for you!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 冥界已经热闹起来了，是吗，扎格？在这里，我有一个很好的礼物要送给你，那就是我的祝福，只属于你一个人的祝福！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Whooaa, Zag, I bet you could use a little pick-me-up right about now, and I am here to offer you whichever one you please!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 哇哦，扎格，我打赌你现在想喝点什么来提提神，我这里应有尽有，想喝什么，任你挑选！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Hey Zag, how is life, you hanging in there, yeah? I reckoned maybe we could raise a glass here, to your health, but then I thought, 'No, wait! I can do a little more than that!' So, here we go!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 嘿，扎格，最近怎么样？你一直就在那里住，是吗？我想，也许我们可以在这里喝点什么，这有助于你的健康，但后来我想，“不，等等！我能做的可不止这些！”来，收下这个吧！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Hey, how you living life down there right now, all right I take it, yeah? No, wait, though, I have just the thing!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你在下边过的还好吗，好吧，我接受，好吧？尽管我只有这些东西，你也不要犹豫，得早些下手！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Why, hello, Zag! Fancy running into you, though there's no need to work yourself so hard, you hear me, yeah? I reckon this should take the edge right off!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 哦，你好啊，扎格！能遇到你真好，但你也不用那么勉强自己，你听到了吗？我想，这应该会对情况有所影响！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: How goes it this time, man, everything fine? Though hold that thought, I wager we can make things finer yet!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 这次怎么样，伙计，一切都好吗？尽管坚持这个想法，但我敢打赌我们能让情况变得更好！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: That Underworld of yours, place is a real pit, isn't it Zag, a shame you're stuck down there. But we are going to get you out of there, together, you and I!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 你所在的冥界，其实就是个大坑，不是吗，扎格，被困在下面可不是件光彩的事。但我们会把你解救出去，你我二人一起出去！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Soon as you get up to Olympus, man... it's going to be a feast like you have never seen, you mark my words! Now take this, and good luck!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 伙计，只要一到奥林匹斯山……你就会被眼前从未见过的繁华盛景所震撼，记住我的话！接受我的礼物，祝你好运！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: You give those musty shades and corpses a fair fighting chance down there, you hear me, Zag? Though just in case you need a hand...

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 你要给那些阴森恐怖的暗灵和行尸走肉一个公平的战斗机会，听到了吗，扎格？不过万一你需要帮忙……

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: You got this, man! I so believe in you, it's almost like the Greeks believe in me! And they believe in me an awful lot, you know!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 你明白了，伙计！所以，我相信你，就像希腊人相信我一样！他们非常信任我，你知道的！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Time for another go at getting out of there, eh, Zag? Well not to worry, we'll make something happen, let's hop to it then!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 是时候，再出去闯一次了，嗯，扎格？好吧，别担心，我们会成功的，那就开始行动吧！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Now listen up here, Zag, 'cause this time I have got something for you that's going to put some extra fire in your step, you ready, man?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 听着，扎格，这一次我有东西要给你，它会助你一臂之力，你准备好了吗，伙计？

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: You wait for just a moment, Zag, 'cause I got just the thing for this occasion, you are going to love it, get a load of this!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 等一下，扎格，因为我正好有适合这种情况的礼物，你会喜欢它的，试试这个！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Now, Zagreus, I'm certain everything is going fine for you right now, but just in case, but just in case! I got a little something, just for you!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 现在扎格列欧斯，我知道你现在一切都很好，但这是为了以防万一！不过，以防万一，我有点东西给你！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: It's me, Zag, hey, I know you haven't got a lot of time to listen to me prattle on like this, and so, I'm cutting to the chase here, look!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 是我，扎格，嘿，我知道你没有太多时间听我这样唠叨，所以，我现在就直奔主题了，你看！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Hey again as ever Zag, now you keep at it like you have been and I bet we'll all be hanging out up here in no time flat! I'm with you all the way!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 嘿……扎格，我们又见面了，现在你要像以前一样坚持下去，我敢打赌我们很快就可以成功突围，逃离冥界！我会一路相随！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Oh, hey, let's see, man, I am thinking that this time around this smattering of my concoctions ought to do you right!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 哦，嘿，伙计，让我们想想，我想这次我的这点药物应该对你有所帮助！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Here's to an interesting time, how about that, yeah?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 这肯定会很好玩，你觉得怎么样，嗯？

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: I'd like to make a toast, to you of course my friend! Good luck out there!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 我打算敬杯酒，当然是敬你啦，我的好朋友！祝你一路顺风！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: All right, man, I have got your back, and you have got this, go!

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Hey, hey, have I got just the thing for this particular occasion, man!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 好吧，伙计，因为你这么帮助我，而且你还获得了这个礼物，我们出发吧！

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 嘿，嘿，我有适合这种特殊情况的东西，伙计！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Hey, Zag, what is going on, you going to get out of here this time? Why, yes, I think you are!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 嘿，扎格，怎么了，这次你会离开这里吗？哦，我觉得你会的！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: OK Zag. You and me. We're getting through this, now or never, ready, yeah?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 好了，扎格，只要有了你和我的力量，我们一定能成功的。不成功，便成仁。你准备好了，是吧？

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Oh hey, Zag, here's a toast to your success, so... clink! Cheers and all that!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 哦，嘿，扎格，为了你的成功……我敬你一杯！干杯！干杯！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Here's something for you man, grab it and go!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 这是给你的，小伙子，拿走吧！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: I got you, Zag, got just the thing, right here!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 我明白了，扎格，现在我只有这件东西！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Ah there you are, man, I got what you need!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 啊，你来了，小伙子，我这里有你想要的东西！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: I know you're busy, man, so here you go, get on with it, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 我知道你很忙，小伙子，在这里，你拿着吧。

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: It's good to kind of see you down there man, now here, take this!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 很高兴在这里看到你，小伙子，这个给你！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Sure is dark there, Zag, I hope you're hanging in there, yeah?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 那边的确是暗无天日，扎格，你一切都还好吧？

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: You getting anywhere, yet, man? 'Cause if you're not, it's cool, we've all got time!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 你有什么进展吗，小伙子？如果没有也没关系，我们有的是时间！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Got something that is going to knock you off your feet, here, man!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 我这里有一件东西，你肯定喜欢的不得了，小伙子！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: You ready for this, Zag, now here's a good one, courtesy of me!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 准备好了吗，扎格，这可是件好东西，我的一点心意！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: It's going to be a real feast here once you make it, man!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 如果你成功了，在这里会为你举办一场盛宴，小伙子！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Only the best for you, man, now check this out, you'll see!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 留给你的都是最好的东西，小伙子，你看看这个！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: This here, Zag, is among the best I have to offer, it is good!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 我这里最厉害的东西就是这个，这可是名副其实的极品！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: I'm feeling really good right now, and thought I'd pass that right along!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 我现在的心情特别好，我也想把这份快乐传给别人！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Here's something extra special for you, man, now cheers!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 这里有件特别为你准备的东西，小伙子，恭喜你！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Past time we got things going for you there, what do you say, you ready for this, man?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 要给你的东西我们都准备好了，你觉得怎么样？准备好了吗，伙计？

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: I got to make it to a feast in just a little bit, here, man, but quickly, take this, yeah?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 我打算在这里举行一场小小的盛宴，马上就好了。这个你收下，好吗，伙计？

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: I know it's been tough times of late, but look, you just keep going, and you'll make it, man!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 我知道你这段日子过得困难，不过只要努力往前走，你就一定能到达终点，伙计！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: This time for sure, I mean, I know you're going to make it to the top, together with me, man!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 这一次我敢肯定，你一定能和到达山顶，一定能和我团聚，伙计！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Hey I propose a toast to you, there, man, and may you always kill whatever's in your path, and on and on!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 嘿，敬你一杯，伙计！祝你能人挡杀人，佛挡杀佛，把所有拦路的东西都处理掉！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: A toast, man, to your health! Or to the lack of it, for anybody who gets on your bad side, yeah?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 为你的健康干杯，伙计！或者说，为你的疾病干杯，那些不喜欢你的人肯定是这么祝酒的，是吧？

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Have I got just the thing for you, here, man, you ready? Here we go!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 你要的东西我这里刚好就有。准备好了吗，伙计？我们出发吧！

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: What do you say we go all out this time, how about it, Zag, you with me, man, or what?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 这次我们全力以赴吧，你觉得呢，扎格？你要不要跟我一起干，伙计？

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Been saving something for the right occasion, though I figure it's as good a time as any, yeah?

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 我一直藏了些好东西，等着合适的时机拿出来用。不过我觉得，现在就是合适的时机了，是吧？

en.speaker: Dionysus
