en.text: Hey, cheers to you, and everything you do, there, Zag! Only the best from me to you, man!

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 嘿，干一杯吧，为你所做的一切干杯，扎格！我给你的东西都是最好的，伙计！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Lord Dionysus, it's been great getting to know you, so, please accept this humble offering.

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Now that is something, a right princely gift, there, Zag, and just so happens I got something here I have been meaning to give you!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 迪奥尼索司大人，很高兴认识你，所以，请接受这份谦卑的礼物。

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 这倒是一件适合王子身份的好礼物，就在那里，扎格，碰巧我也有些礼物一直想要给你！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: A toast in your honor, Lord Dionysus mate. Have I mentioned how pleased I am to have made your acquaintance?

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Hoh-oh, what, is that for me, really, I mean, cheers man, that is awful generous of you, I'm much obliged!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我敬您一杯，迪奥尼索司大人。我有没有说过，能认识您，我有多么高兴？

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 哦，什么，这对我来说，真的，我是说，干杯朋友，你真是太慷慨了，真的非常感谢你！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Lord Dionysus mate, you have made the mood down here materially less miserable, and I am much obliged.

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: What, is that for me, why Zag, I mean you really shouldn't have, you know I can't get enough of this stuff, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 迪奥尼索司大人，是你让这里的惨状得到明显改善，非常感谢。

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 什么，那是给我的吗，哦，扎格，我是说你太客气了，我就好这口。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Lord Dionysus mate, you must have no shortage of supreme vintage at your disposal, but this one's from me.

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Why Zag, how positively thoughtful, man, I mean I love it, positively love this stuff, and I am very moved that you would think of me for it!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 迪奥尼索司大人，您一定收藏了非常高级的葡萄酒，但这是我献给您的。

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 哦，扎格，你想得可真是周到，朋友，我很喜欢它，喜欢得不得了，你能把它送给我，我很感动！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, on no occasion whatsoever, cheers to you again, Lord Dionysus mate! This place is so much less dreary under your influence!

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Ah, this is the greatest, Zag! This feast I'm headed to? I was getting a little concerned I wasn't going to have quite enough to go around for everyone. Well, you just saved my evening, man! Too bad you couldn't be there, yeah?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，让我敬你一杯吧，迪奥尼索司大人，我的好伙计！幸亏有了你，这个地方才没那么让人觉得闷！

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 啊，这可真是太棒了，扎格！我正要去参加一场盛宴，我刚刚还在担心能不能让所有人都喝得尽兴呢，不过你已经打消了我的疑虑，伙计！你不能一起去，这实在是太遗憾了啊，你不觉得吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dionysus mate, sometimes things weigh heavily on me, but then I hear from you, and it's like I don't have a care in the world! To your health!

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Oh, you're really too much for me sometimes, you know that, man? Got to tell you, I don't think I ever felt so close to somebody so damn far away. But through the gift of drink? It's like we're with each other in spirit, all the time, you know?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 迪奥尼索司，我的好伙计。有时候我感觉肩上的担子太重了，可只要一听到你的声音，我就觉得什么事情都不用担心了！为你的健康干杯！

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 哦，说真的，你有时候可真是太客气了，伙计！实话和你说吧，我并不觉得我真的能和哪个远在千里之外的人关系这么亲密。可只要有酒，我们简直就像是一心同体的兄弟，永远都连在一起，你懂的吧？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What does one offer to the god of wine? The very best, is what, and down here, this is it, mate! I'm grateful I've got some of your spirit in me. To have such a connection, with you despite all the distance between us...!

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Zag, I cannot believe what you are offering to me! Ambrosia, man, for me? And talk about a bottle that has seen some wild days and nights, I mean if it got all the way to you down there, only to come back up! Know what? I'm saving it, till we can share it, here!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么礼物能配得上酒神呢？当然是世界上最好的酒啦，收下这个吧，伙计！我很感激能受到你的影响。尽管我们之间相隔这么远，可我们还是紧密地连接在一起……！

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 扎格，我简直不敢相信这份好礼！这可是仙馔密酒啊，是给我的吗？这可是让很多人日夜狂欢不止的美酒啊。这瓶酒去了冥界，又回到了奥林匹斯山。你知道这意味着什么吗？这意味着我要把它藏起来，等你什么时候来了，我们一起喝个痛快！

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Noble cousin, my lord father has taken keen interest in your journey and your plight, and now seeks to aid you with the thunder of heaven itself. And you've my support, as well, of course.

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: I thank you for the generous introduction, fair Athena, and I always rest assured when you are close at hand. I trust with our combined might, our good Zagreus is virtually certain to succeed!

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 尊贵的兄弟，我的父亲对你的旅途，以及你在旅途中遭受的苦难非常在意，他希望能用雷电的力量来帮助你祛除障碍。当然，我也会为你提供帮助的。

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 谢谢你如此慷慨的介绍，我可爱的雅典娜。只要有你在我身边，我都会觉得充满把我。我相信，有了我们的力量，我们的好孩子扎格列欧斯一定能成功！

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: When I first notified Lord Father Zeus and other members of our family of your existence, Zagreus, it was Uncle Poseidon here who first leapt up, and pledged his power over sea and earth to you. Is that not so, Uncle?

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Exactly so, Athena! You, with that fine memory of yours! For it isn't everyday I learn my doleful brother Hades sired a fine son! He does not know how good he has it, there! And you, Nephew, could have it even better, here!

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，当我第一次通知父亲大人和其他家族成员，和他们说了你的事情的时候，当时第一个站出来的是波塞冬叔叔，他说愿意把大地与海洋的力量借给你用。是这样的吧，叔叔？

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 正是这样，雅典娜，你的记忆力可真不错！我听说我那阴沉的兄弟哈迪斯生出了个好儿子，这种好消息可不是每天都能听说的！他可不知道他是个多好的人！还有你，侄子，你比他还要出色，毫无疑问！

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Your predicament has pulled our family together, united in a desire to assist you, Cousin. Even those who typically do not think much of those other than themselves.

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Oh, if only I had wisdom such as yours, Athena dear, so that I was more capable of picking up on subtle jabs and insults such as that! You're not fooling anybody with your feigned benevolence, you know.

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: The world is not all lies and deceit as you make it out to be, Aphrodite. Sometimes, a lending of assistance is no more than it appears to be. Now either back up Zagreus, or stand aside.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 是你的困境让我们这个大家族联合起来，共同为你提供帮助，表兄弟。甚至连那些自私自利，平时不怎么关心别人的人也都来了。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 哦，我要是有你这样的智慧就好了，亲爱的雅典娜，这样我就能想出更恶毒的言辞来侮辱别人了！我告诉你，你别以为你那装出来的仁慈能骗得过谁。

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 阿弗洛狄忒，这个世界并不像你说的那样，并非只有谎言与欺骗。有的时候，我们伸出援手，就是因为我们发自内心想这么做。你要么帮助扎格列欧斯，要么离远点。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: If you've a moment, Zagreus? One of my relatives has claimed that I usurp your time. So I invited her to contact you.

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Um, hello, Zagreus... Athena here is grandstanding or trying to prove a point, or something. I don't know. Anyway, nice talking to you.

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Well, I suppose that's settled, then. I am afraid such interactions aren't uncommon here amongst my family; but what's a family without flaws?

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你有空吗，扎格列欧斯？我的一个亲戚说，我打扰了你。所以我让她和你联系。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，你好，扎格列欧斯……雅典娜是在哗众取宠，还是想证明什么观点，或是别的什么，我不知道？不管怎样，很高兴能和你说说话。

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 嗯，那我就认为问题解决了。恐怕这样的互动在我的家庭中并不少见；但是没有缺陷的家庭会是什么样子呢？

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Some members of our family do not yet fully understand just how precarious your situation is, Cousin. My Lord Dionysus here, he goes about as though this is a festive matter of some sort!

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Oh, come on, Athena girl, you really mean to tell me that discovering a long-lost relative isn't a cause for celebrating right away, I mean, you can't be telling me a thing like that? Because if Zag isn't a cause for feasting, I don't know what is!

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我们家庭中的某些成员并没有完全了解你所处的困境，表兄弟。比如这位迪奥尼索司大人，在他看来，这就好像这是某种值得庆祝的节日一样！

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 哦，别这样嘛，小雅典娜。你真的觉得，遇到了好久不见的表亲，不是件值得庆祝的事情吗？我是说，你该不会是想说这种傻话吧？因为在我看来，要是连扎格来了都不值得庆祝的话，那恐怕没什么值得庆祝的了！

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I bring to you the Lady Demeter, Cousin. I've asked that she please rest assured knowing we have your matter well under control. Though, in her infinite compassion, she has taken up your cause, nevertheless!

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Oh, you needn't lavish me with your faint praise, Athena dear. In all your boundless intellect, I'd have expected you would know I see through your intentions, plain as day.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我要带你去见得墨忒尔女士了，表兄弟。我和她说过请她尽管放心，你的事情我们都已经安排妥当了。不过即便如此，她还是充满热情地关心着你的事情！

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 哎呀，你大可不必用这种阿谀奉承的手段来跟我套近乎，我亲爱的雅典娜。以你的无上智慧，想必你应该知道我早就看穿你的心思了吧。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: The biting cold surrounding you must mean the Goddess of Seasons decided to take an interest in your struggle, Zagreus? I did not count on Demeter being a part of this. Take heart, though use discretion around her.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你身边的寒气非常逼人，这意味着四季女神也对你的旅程很感兴趣吧，扎格列欧斯？ 我倒是没想到得墨忒尔也会参与进来。不过你得小心点，在她身边的时候要保持谨慎。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: This is it, then. In the name of Hades! Olympus, this is an official message! Lady Athena, I trust you'll quickly figure this one out.

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Is this some kind of offering for me? No, hold a moment, this appears to be a message! Part of one. Then, can this mean...? I have to notify the others. I trust they also have received something from you, or shortly shall.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧，那就这样吧。以哈迪斯之名！奥林匹斯山，这是一份官方来信！雅典娜女士，我相信你很快就能弄清楚它的含义。

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 这是给我的祭品吗？不，等等，这看起来像是某种信息！是某个完整信息的一部分。所以，莫非这意味着……？我得通知一下其他人。我相信他们也从你这里收到了信息，或者说，马上就会收到。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: It was my privilege to have visited your father's House, and briefly had a chance to meet you, Zagreus. Nyx and your mother each are very shrewd; perhaps you've taken after both of them. As for your new responsibilities... exposing weak points in defenses is my specialty.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 能参观你父亲的圣殿，还有短暂的机会你你见面，我感到很荣幸，扎格列欧斯。倪克斯和你的母亲都是非常聪慧的人，或许你也继承了她们的优点。至于你的新职责嘛……找到防御方面的薄弱环节是我最擅长的事情。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I understand you've been in contact with my father. Your uncle Zeus, I mean. He's taken interest in your plight; you should feel honored!

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我知道，你一直和我父亲有联系。我是说，你的宙斯叔叔。他非常关注你的困境，你应该感到荣幸！

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: You've met the master of the seas, Poseidon, haven't you? Our uncle's affable but quick to anger. Be on your guard with him, is my advice.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你见过海神波塞冬了，对吗？我们的叔叔和蔼可亲，但非常易怒。你要对他保持警惕，这是我的建议。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Cousin, you've met Aphrodite, no? She likes beguiling others with her charms; but her intentions with you I believe are pure. You'll find our strengths are complementary.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 兄弟，你见过阿弗洛狄忒，不是吗？她喜欢用魅力迷惑别人，但我相信她对你的意图是纯洁的。你会发现我们的优势是可以互补的。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: My warlike brother Ares reached you, didn't he. I've always found his conduct quite disturbing. At least it seems he's helping you for now.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我好战的兄弟阿瑞斯找到你了，不是吗。我一直觉得他的行为很令人讨厌。至少，现在他好像在帮你。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I'll tell you something, Cousin: If even Artemis is aiding you, it's proof your cause is just. She doesn't often take an interest in family affairs.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我告诉你，兄弟：即使阿尔忒弥斯在帮助你，也能证明你在做的事情是正义的。她不常对家庭事务感兴趣。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Did Dionysus truly visit you before? He tends to seek out revelry, not conflict. I'm pleased to know he's making himself useful here.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 迪奥尼索司以前真的去拜访过你吗？他喜欢寻欢作乐，而不是到处生事。我很高兴知道，他让自己在这里发挥了作用。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: You arrived sooner than anticipated, Cousin, and my estimations seldom are inaccurate. All for the best, of course. Perhaps you're simply faster than I thought.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我的估计很少出错，不过你来得比我想象得更早，表兄弟。当然，这是件好事，或许只是你的脚程比我预期得更快吧。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Zagreus, perhaps it is a fancy of imagination, but it seems almost as though, this time, you bear the blessing of... your own father! If Lord Hades is assisting you in any way in this, then I shall hold out hope that your relationship yet has capacity to heal, to some extent at least.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，或许这只是我在胡思乱想。但这次，你身上的祝福看起来是……你的父亲给你的！如果连冥王哈迪斯都在协助你的话，那我觉得，你们之间的关系还有修复的余地，至少在一定程度上可以缓和。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: So you've another blessing from Lord Hades, then. Zagreus, I'm under no delusion you and your father shall become the closest friends, from here. Neverthless, I do believe it's possible to move forward even such a relationship as yours. Believe me... I know.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 看来，你又得到了冥王哈迪斯的祝福，扎格列欧斯。看来不是我想多了，你和你的父亲一定会成为亲密的朋友的。不过，即使是像这么亲密的关系，也是可以更进一步的。相信我……我明白这一点。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I so look forward to our meeting face to face amongst the gods, dear Cousin. Olympus shall be merrier and wiser once you're here.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 亲爱的兄弟，我很期待我们能在众神面前见面。你到达奥林匹斯山后，这里就会变得更加快乐和贤明。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Hail and good tidings to you, noble Cousin. May you be swift and thorough vanquishing the dead who dare oppose you.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 尊贵的兄弟，向你致敬，有个好消息。祝你能够迅速而彻底地战胜那些敢于反抗你的亡灵。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Remain relentless in your effort to escape, dear Cousin. In spite of all our differences, perseverance is a quality we all possess.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 继续保持坚持不懈的尽头，逃出冥界吧，亲爱的表兄弟。虽然我们之间有许多不同之处，但持之以恒是我们共同的优点。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: You can always count upon assistance from me, Zagreus. I always shall prioritize the needs of our family above everything else.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你随时可以依靠我，扎格列欧斯，我始终会把家人的事情放在第一位。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Let my voice be a glimmer in the darkness, noble Cousin; though, may the blessing I am about to provide be even more than that.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 让我的声音为你驱散黑暗，指清道路吧，尊贵的表兄弟。不过，希望我的祝福能带给你更多力量。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: You've met your distant relatives by now. We don't all share the same demeanor, nor see eye to eye. Though, all of us, I think, wish you the best.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你已经见过你的远亲了。我们的行事方式各不相同，看起来也不一样。不过，我想，我们所有人都会为你祝福。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: The one called Nyx... she is your mother, as I understand? We Olympians rarely consort with the chthonic gods. Though Nyx herself reached out to me about your plight, and I was spurred to act.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 据我所知，那位叫倪克斯的女神就是你母亲，对吗？我们奥林匹斯众神很少与冥府诸神有来往。尽管倪克斯亲自向我诉说了你的困境，但她还是让我采取一定的行动。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Please send the goddess Nyx my kind regards. That she supports you in your effort to escape her own domain suggests a selflessness I would not have expected.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 请代我向倪克斯女神问好。她支持你努力逃离她自己的领地，这表明了她对你无私的爱，这一点我没想到。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: It's such a cruelty that your father hid the knowledge of your birth and life from us, my cousin. It's unacceptable.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你父亲向我们隐瞒了你的出生和生活状况，这真是太狠心了，我的兄弟。这让人无法接受。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Your father Hades and my father Zeus have not communicated in some time, and Zeus refuses to explain. Something transpired between the two of them. Perhaps you know better than I.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你父亲哈迪斯和我父亲宙斯已经有一段时间没有联系了，宙斯也不愿意解释原因。他们俩之间发生了一些不愉快。也许你比我更清楚。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: There's something that I've wished to tell you, Zagreus: There is no shame in your upbringing. Many of us on Olympus, we likewise were born and raised under the strangest circumstances. Someday I'll have to tell you about mine.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我有件事想告诉你，扎格列欧斯：你的身世并不可耻。我们奥林匹斯山上的许多人同样在奇怪的情况下出生和长大。总有一天，我会告诉你我的身世。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: You're nothing like your father, Zagreus. I mean that as a compliment. He cut himself off from the rest of us. Many times have we attempted peace, to no avail.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你一点也不像你父亲，扎格列欧斯。和你说这些，我是想称赞你。他不愿意和我们来往。我们曾多次试图和平解决问题，但都没有成功。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: It comforts me to see how far you've come, Cousin. And I am confident that you shall make your way, eventually. I shall look forward to our conversations then.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你走了这么远的路，我真的很佩服你，我的兄弟。我相信你最终会成功的。真想到时候和你好好聊聊。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: You reached the flames of Asphodel, well done! You may have quite a distance still to go, but having crossed through Tartarus is no small step, Cousin.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你已经抵达水仙花平原了，干得漂亮！或许终点依然离得很远，但你成功穿过了塔耳塔罗斯，这已经很了不起了，表兄弟。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I see you've made it all the way to hallowed Elysium, Cousin? A significant way toward the surface, and if you could get there the one time, surely you have what it takes to do it again, and overcome the dangers that await therein.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我看到你已经抵达神圣的至福乐土，是吗，表兄弟？你已经朝地上世界走了很远一段路了。既然你能完成这样的旅途，那你一定也能完成接下来的旅途，克服旅途中的一切艰难险阻。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I understand you nearly reached the surface lately, Zagreus. My confidence remains unshaken that you shall get out of there, eventually. No matter what sorts of unknown horrors lie shrouded beyond the boundary there.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我发现你已经快要到地面世界了，扎格列欧斯。我对你的信心坚定不移，我无论前方有什么样的险境在等着你，我都相信你一定能逃出冥界。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Were you not close to having reached the surface lately, Cousin? Then, this can only mean some unforeseen impediment prevented your escape.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你之前不是马上就要到地面世界了吗，表兄弟？看来，这意味着某些看不到的阻碍让你的逃脱计划失败了。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: There must be some unconquerable force or foe awaiting you, just at the border of your realm and ours. We cannot even see it through a shroud of darkness, there. I shall make certain that your family knows it may take considerable time to surpass... so fear not, for we are patient, here.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 在你的世界与我们的世界之间，肯定有某种难以逾越的障碍或是敌人在等待着你，就连我们也没办法透过黑暗，看清它真正的面貌。我想让你明白，你的家人们都知道，你可能要花上很多时间才能越过障碍……所以不用担心，我们都会耐心地等你来的。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Despite whatever difficulties you've encountered, dear Cousin, again and again, you have never yielded. I must admit, your strength of will is quite inspiring. For, even I have doubts, from time to time. It's all the clearer to me why the goddess Nyx spoke so highly of you.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 亲爱的表兄弟，尽管你遇到了无数磨难，一次又一次地失败了，你却从来没有退缩过。我得承认，你强大的意志力让我很受鼓舞。因为即使是我，有的时候也不禁会犹豫不决。现在我明白了，为什么倪克斯女神对你的评价那么高。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: It's fortunate your troubles with your mother were resolved. Persephone, I mean! To think I led all of my family to believe your mother was the goddess Nyx, instead. It seems I was an unwitting accomplice to a bit of a deception, there. But Nyx, I know she merely tried to help.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你和你母亲的问题已经解决了，这真是个好消息。我指的是珀尔塞福涅！想想看，我居然误导了我所有的家人，以为你的母亲是倪克斯女神。看来我也成了这场骗局中被蒙在鼓里的帮凶。不过我明白，倪克斯只是想帮助你们而已。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: You bear my Owl Pendant, noble Cousin! Wherever it should go, I faintly see its shimmer from afar. Even where you reside! For owls see in total darkness, after all.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你戴上了我的猫头鹰吊坠，尊敬的表兄弟！无论它在什么地方，我都能从远处看到它发出的微光，甚至能看到你住的地方！毕竟，就算是在一片漆黑之中，猫头鹰也能视物。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I have grown closer than expected with the goddess Nyx in all of this, Cousin. It is quite evident to me how much she cares for you. I must admit I envy your relationship, sometimes. For I've made do without a mother's presence in my life.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 由于这件事情，我和倪克斯女神之间的关系变得比我想象得更加亲密，表兄弟。她对你的关切溢于言表。我不得不说，有时候我会嫉妒你们之间的关系，因为我从来都没有母亲。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Lord Ares has suggested he and goddess Nyx have grown much closer to each other, in all this. Nothing untoward, if you must know. Ares and I have often disagreed, about so many things, and yet we share a fondness for the Night herself, it seems.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 阿瑞斯大人暗示我说，因为这件事情，说他和倪克斯的关系变得密切得多。如果你想知道的话，也没什么好保密的。阿瑞斯和我在很多很多事情上都常有分歧，不过，我们对黑夜的喜爱似乎如出一辙。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Sometimes I think about the goddess Nyx, and how I long for her to be the mother that I never had, Cousin. Is it improper that I say such things to you? One would expect I would already have somebody on Olympus, yet... it often feels as though I am the mother, here.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 有的时候我会想到倪克斯女神，我会想，如果她能成为我缺少的母亲就好了，兄弟。这种话是不是太唐突了？人们常常以为，我在奥林匹斯山上有我的家人，可是……我总觉得我在这里担当的是母亲的角色。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: The goddess Nyx has indicated you possess a list of prophecies from the Three Fates. I've such a list upon Olympus, here! It seems to be connected to your own, as several prophecies already are fulfilled. Isn't it such an honor to urge Fate along?

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯女神告诉我说，你那里有一份从命运三女神那里得到的预言清单。我在奥林匹斯山这里也有一份这样的清单！它似乎和你那一份是连在一起的，我看到一部分预言已经达成了。能和你一起见证命运，这真是太荣幸了，不是吗？

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: You cannot withstand your father's legions, Zagreus. But if you possess one of my greatest blessings, things may unfold differently, I think.

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: For you, my cousin Zagreus, I wish to offer the most potent of the blessings I am able to bestow. Make wise your use of this, and rise toward us!

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你是无法对抗你父亲的大军的，扎格列欧斯。但如果有了我最强大的祝福，或许结果就会不一样了吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 为了你，我的兄弟扎格列欧斯，我给予你最有力的祝福。你要好好利用它，奋起反抗，前来与我们汇合！

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Dear Cousin, would that I could give to you everlasting, tireless resolve. Though, come to think of it, this may be suited as a counterpart.

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: The circumstances spur me now to offer you the greatest of my powers, Cousin. Take my strength, and strike the darkness down!

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 亲爱的表兄弟，如果我能给予你我永不动摇、永不懈怠的决心就好了。不过想想看，这件祝福应该也差不太多吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我只能根据现在的情况，赐予你我最大的力量，兄弟。接受我的力量，消灭黑暗军团！

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Supporting you through your ordeal, Cousin? It's reminiscent of the thrill of doing battle by the side of those whom I hold dear. I may be safe upon our mountaintop, though I am with you there, as well... for every well-earned victory, and bitter loss.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 需要我帮你渡过难关吗，表兄弟？和你一起战斗，让我想起了和至亲之人并肩作战的愉悦。或许我安全地呆在奥林匹斯山上，但我也同样与你同在……与你一起享受每一场胜利，一起面对惨痛的失败。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: You brandish the Eternal Spear we call Varatha...! So then it wasn't lost during the war. A magnificent weapon, in deserving hands.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你挥舞着我们称之为瓦拉塔的永恒之矛……！那么说，它并没有在战争中丢失。真是件厉害的武器，和你很相称。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Why, you wield Coronacht the Heart-Seeker...! I never took you for an archer, though the power of that bow is undeniable. Use it wisely!

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 啊，你挥舞着索心弓科罗纳赫特……！我从来都没想过你是个弓箭手，尽管那弓的力量是不可否认的。你要好好使用它！

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: You bear Aegis, the original itself...! My own shield was forged much later, in its image. You'll have to tell me someday how you found it.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你拿着埃癸斯，一件来自远古时期的兵器……！我自己的盾牌就是在很久以后按照它的样子打造的。有时间，你一定要告诉我你是怎么找到它的。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: You got your hands on Malphon, the Twin Fists, I see. No ordinary weapon. Prone to fits of savagery quite unbecoming of a well-trained warrior. Then watch yourself, and throw not caution to the wind.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 看得出来，你手上的是双子之拳玛尔封。这可不是什么寻常的武器，最适合那些无法成为训练有素战士的野蛮人。记得要保持谨慎，不要不计后果地冲动行事。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: The Rail of Adamant, itself, has found its way into your hands, Cousin? A malignant thing, if you were to ask me, and not one I would ever use, myself. Unless, perhaps, I had no other choice. I suppose it must have been that way for you.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 狮鹫坚炮已经辗转到你的手中了吗，表兄弟？在我看来，这是件充满恶意的武器，我自己是绝对不会使用它的，除非我实在是走投无路了。我猜，你也是因为走投无路才会用它的吧。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: You're badly injured aren't you, Cousin? I wish that I could will the pain away, though at the least I can provide you this.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你伤得很重，兄弟？我希望我能消除你的痛苦，但至少我能给你这个。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Look at you, Zagreus, you're barely fit to fight from all the injury that you've sustained! I'll try to keep you going for as long as possible.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 看看你，扎格列欧斯，你伤痕累累，基本上不能再战斗了！我会尽量帮助你，不断前进。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: It seems to me that you've sustained life-draining injuries already, Zagreus. But don't lose hope. We can sustain you in a proper fighting shape.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 看起来你似乎受了相当程度的伤，扎格列欧斯。但不要放弃希望，我们会帮助你，让你可以继续战斗。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: You may have suffered many wounds but shall not perish imminently, Cousin. Not if I have anything to say about it. Here.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 或许你已经伤痕累累，但你绝不会马上倒下，表兄弟。只要我在这里，这种事情就不会发生。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Oh, Zagreus... your recent battles evidently haven't gone as hoped. Nevertheless, always strive onward, while you still draw breath.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 哦，扎格列欧斯……你最近的战况显然不太顺利。不过只要你还活着，就要不断努力前进。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's got to be her. Then, here goes nothing... Ahem. In the name of Hades! Olympus, I accept this message.

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Hail, noble Cousin. Now, let's get you from that miserable place. I'll see that all of us upon Olympus do our part, beginning here with me.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 一定是她。嗯，就不管那么多了……啊哼。以哈迪斯之名！奥林匹斯山，我收到了这条消息。

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你好，尊敬的兄弟。现在，就让我们把你从那个悲惨的地方救出来。我会让包括我自己在内的奥林匹斯众神尽量帮助你。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Keep fighting, Cousin. Fight from out of that eternal gloom. I trust that you'll be joining us upon Olympus shortly.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 继续战斗，兄弟。冲破牢笼，逃离那无边的黑暗冥界。我相信你很快就能加入我们的奥林匹斯山大家庭。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I have your back, Cousin. Rise now to your rightful station with my blessings!

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我支持你，兄弟。带上我的祝福，闯出黑暗世界吧！

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: May the light and fury of Olympus guide you from the dark, Cousin. I've a token of it for you here.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 愿奥林匹斯山的光明和愤怒指引你走出黑暗，兄弟。我这里有一个纪念品要给你。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Push forward, noble Cousin. I shall be keen to see you circumvent the perils that the Fates arranged for you this time.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 奋勇前进，我的兄弟。我希望你这次能避开命运之神安排的重重险境。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Vanquish all who stand against you, noble Cousin. I and your relatives upon Olympus shall assist you in so doing.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 击败所有敌人，兄弟。我和你在奥林匹斯山上的亲人会帮助你实现目标。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Sometimes I think about what you've endured, to have been living in that loathsome squalor, Cousin. I swear, you'll have your justice.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 有时，我会想起你受的苦，一直生活在那令人厌恶的恶劣环境中，兄弟。我坚信，你会得到正义的结果。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Do not fear your father's cruel legions, Cousin! Their lives are long since forfeit, and they cannot stand against one of your birthright, nor against my power.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 不要害怕你父亲残酷的军团，兄弟！他们早已丧失生命，根本无法抵挡你与生俱来的能力，也不能抵挡我的力量。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Yours is a brazen plan of action, Zagreus, and I admire it. The boldest strategy often prevails. Especially with my support.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你的逃离计划天衣无缝，扎格列欧斯，我很钦佩你能制定这样的计划。往往，只有最大胆的计划才能最终取得成功。有了我的支持，更是如虎添翼。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Take heart, Cousin; for you have found me even in the suffocating darkness of the Underworld. May my power be of some assistance.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 兄弟，放心吧，即使在冥界令人窒息的黑暗中你也能找到我。愿我的力量助你一臂之力。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Your struggles have not gone unnoticed, Cousin, so take heart. Eternity awaits you once you finally break free.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你的努力并没有被忽视，兄弟，所以你要振作起来。一旦你成功挣脱黑暗世界，极乐世界就在不远处等着你。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Here on Olympus is the opposite of everything about that lifeless squalor you reside in, Zagreus. Fight on and come to us!

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 奥林匹斯山与你所居住的那片死气沉沉、肮脏不堪的地方正相反。继续战斗，争取早日逃脱苦海，来到我们这里！

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Cousin, I grow angry merely thinking of your situation. May what power I can offer be of service as you struggle towards your fate.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 兄弟，一想到你的处境，我就很气愤。愿我的力量可以为你的命运之战提供帮助。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Your father chose to sever ties with all of us, and stew alone within his land beneath the earth. But you are not beholden to his actions. Fight!

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你的父亲选择与我们所有人断绝联系，独自在冥界痛苦煎熬。但他这样做和你没有关系。你要战斗！

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Your labors make you stronger, noble Cousin. And, the blessings I now offer ought to make you stronger still.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你的反抗会让你更强大，我尊贵的兄弟。而且，我现在给你的祝福应该会让你更加强大。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I've found you once again, dear Cousin, and my strength is yours; so much of it as I can send there to the bowels of the earth.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 又见面了，亲爱的兄弟，让我赐予你无穷的力量，我可以把它送到冥界深处。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I'm here again to lend to you my power, noble Cousin. Though your own strength of will is how you'll finally break free of that cruel place.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我再来这里是为了赐予你我的力量，兄弟。尽管你的意志力才是你最终摆脱阴曹地府的关键。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I'm pleased to see your father's stubbornness is manifest in you as such determination, Zagreus. My blessing be with you.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我很高兴看到，你父亲的固执在你身上体现得如此坚定，扎格列欧斯。我的祝福与你同在。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: What wretched fools dare stand against you, Cousin? Punish them, so that they learn something they ought have learned in life.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 是哪个可怜的傻瓜敢和你作对，兄弟？惩罚他们，让他们学到生活中应该学到的东西。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Hold fast to your resolve, Cousin, and climb on toward the surface. No matter how often your foothold falters, I am here.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 坚持你的决心，兄弟，逃离冥界，来到凡界。不管你的意志出现多少次动摇，我都在这里支持你。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I shall not keep you, Zagreus, except to offer you some of my power to improve your chances of escape. Now quickly choose, and go.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我可以分给你一部分我的力量，让你更有机会逃出冥界。除此之外，我就不耽误你的时间了，扎格列欧斯。赶紧选择你的奖励，出发吧。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: May wisdom and good fortune guide you toward the light of day this time, Cousin.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 愿智慧和好运指引你走向光明，兄弟。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: The Underworld's wretched dead shall fear you yet, Cousin.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 冥界那些无耻的亡灵提到你都是心惊胆战，兄弟。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Strength and wisdom guide you from the darkness, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 愿力量和智慧指引你走出黑暗，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: The low cunning of your lifeless enemies is not a match for your divine might.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 死气沉沉的敌人根本不是你的对手。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Remember I am always watching over you, dear Cousin.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你要记住，我会一直关注你，亲爱的兄弟。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: You'll have your justice in due course, Cousin. I promise you.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 兄弟，我向你保证，你会得到公正的结果。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: The might and fury of Olympus courses through you, noble Cousin.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 愿你获得奥林匹斯山的威力和愤怒，尊贵的兄弟。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I take it you've a plan in mind this time for how you're going to escape, don't you, Cousin?

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我猜，你这次已经想好要怎么逃出这个地方了，是吧，表兄弟？

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I shall not keep you, Zagreus, except to offer you my power to improve your chances of escape.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我可以分给你我的力量，让你更有机会逃出冥界。除此之外，我就不耽误你的时间了，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Remain relentless in your effort, Zagreus. For perseverance is a quality we all possess.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 继续努力尝试吧，扎格列欧斯，持之以恒是我们共同的优点。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I and your family on Olympus all stand ready to support you in your efforts, noble Cousin.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我，以及你在奥林匹斯山所有的家人，都愿意帮助你逃出这里，尊敬的表兄弟。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Remember, doubt and hesitancy are your real enemies, Cousin.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 记住，迟疑和犹豫才是你真正的敌人，表兄弟。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I know that you are more than capable even without my power, Cousin. But just in case...

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我明白，就算没有我的力量，你也一样相当了不起，表兄弟。可以防万一……

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Envision your success, and choose the means by which you shall achieve it, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 好好想想你成功时的情形，选择能让你成功的做法吧，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I shall not offer empty words, dear Cousin; I shall instead offer you this.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我是不会给你空口承诺的，亲爱的表兄弟，我会给你这件礼物。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: With our ferocity combined, Cousin, what chances do your father's forces even have?

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 只要我们团结一心，表兄弟，你的父亲哪还有胜算呢？

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: My support alone is not enough to see you through this, Zagreus; but it certainly shall help.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 只靠我的帮助，是没办法帮你逃出这里的，扎格列欧斯，但它或多或少会起到作用。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Your foes shall soon find it impossible to overcome your strength, combined with mine.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 只要我们勠力同心，很快，你的敌人就会发现他们根本不堪一击。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I've every confidence that you shall imminently put my blessing to good use.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 你一定能充分发挥我祝福的力量，我对此充满信心。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Let not your sense of purpose waver, Zagreus. Visualize the outcome you desire.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 不要让你的决心动摇，扎格列欧斯，想象你渴望的结果吧。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Make not the same mistake twice, and you shall always grow wiser, no matter what else.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 犯过的错误不要再犯，这样你就能变得越来越有智慧，就是这么简单。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I shall do everything within my power to defend you from the perils of your journey, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 只要能保护你免受旅途的危险侵扰，我愿意做任何事情，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Take heed against your father's legions, Zagreus. And take also my power.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 要留意你父亲的大军，扎格列欧斯，收下我的力量吧。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Do not forget that changing strategy can be the key to victory, Cousin.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 别忘了，不断改变策略才是取胜的关键，表兄弟。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I cannot glean the details of your predicament right now, Cousin. Though maybe this shall help.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我没办法帮助你解决你所有的难题，表兄弟，但这个说不定能帮得到你。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: The might and honor of Olympus shield you against the darkness and the dead, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 愿奥林匹斯的力量与荣耀保护你，让你免受黑暗与死亡的威胁，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I take it having an impenetrable defense against your enemies may be of some use, Cousin?

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我在想，如果能让你在敌人的面前刀枪不入的话，或许会帮得到你吧，表兄弟？

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I'm not in any mood to trifle with your father's nonsense this time, Zagreus. So, use this.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我这次可不想再和你那个不可理喻的父亲讲道理了，扎格列欧斯，就用这个吧。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: These are among the mightest defenses I can offer, Zagreus. Choose wisely, then.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 这些是我能给你的最强装备，扎格列欧斯，好好选一选吧。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I've readied several of my most potent blessings so your victory can be achieved, Cousin.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我已经准备好了我最强大的祝福，这样就能助你获胜了，表兄弟。

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Observe, dear Cousin, for this time I offer you uncommonly superior protection.

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 好好看着吧，亲爱的表兄弟，这次我要赐予你前所未见的保护了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm indebted to you, Goddess, for all that you and your side of the family have done for me.

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Well it simply isn't in my nature to allow such offerings to go unanswered, noble Cousin. In turn, I wish for you to have this, with my compliments.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我很感激你，女神，你和你的家人为我所做的一切。

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 好吧，我的天性也许就是不允许有人对这样的礼物无动于衷，尊敬的兄弟。相反，我希望你可以收下这饱含我敬意的礼物。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: For you, Lady Athena, without whom I would assuredly be lost.

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: This is an unexpected gesture, Cousin! I do appreciate it, though please do not feel obliged. I offer you my friendship, not a loan to be repaid.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 给你，雅典娜女士，没有你我肯定会迷路的。

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 真没想到，兄弟！我真的很感激，不过请不要觉得有什么负担。我帮助你是出于我们的友谊，而不是为了利益关系。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I have a simple token for you, Goddess. Although it's insufficient thanks for all the aid you've given me.

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: You are most gracious, Cousin, to extend this offering. You honor me, yet I would ask you think of your well-being for the time, not mine.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我有一个简单的令牌要给你，女神。但这对于你给我的所有帮助而言，真是不算什么。

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 兄弟，你真是太客气了，这份礼物没有你说的那么好。你尊敬我，但我想也请你暂时考虑一下你自己内心的感受，而不是只考虑我的感受。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Goddess Athena, please accept this gift. Your wisdom ever guides me toward the light.

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: My, how very generous of you, to offer me this gift! I'm very grateful, though I ask that you not go out of your way on my account. Let's please stay focused, here?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 雅典娜女神，请接受这份礼物。您的智慧将指引我走向光明。

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我的天啊，你居然会送给我这件礼物，你真是太慷慨了！我非常感激，不过，我也希望你不要被这些事情分心。我们还是得专注于眼前的事情，你觉得呢？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: As I remain committed to my task, Goddess, I'm reminded none of this would have been possible without your aid. And so, I must give thanks, even if through a meager offering.

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I know there isn't much that you can do to show your gratitude at present, Zagreus. But I would ask that you save it for when your task is complete. You've more important matters to attend to now!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 女神，我在旅途的过程中意识到，如果不是因为您的帮助，我是没办法走到这里的。虽然我只能献给您一些微薄的礼物，但我仍然希望能表达我的谢意。

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我明白，你目前也没有什么太好的办法来表达你的谢意，扎格列欧斯。不过，我觉得你还是等事情都做好了之后再感谢我吧，你现在还有更重要的事情要做呢！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: As I remain committed to my task, Goddess, I'm reminded none of this would have been possible without your aid. And so, I must give thanks, even if through a meager offering.

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: I know there isn't much that you can do to show your gratitude at present, Zagreus. But I would ask that you save it for a better time. You've more important matters to attend to, now!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 女神，我在旅途的过程中意识到，如果不是因为您的帮助，我是没办法走到这里的。虽然我只能献给您一些微薄的礼物，但我仍然希望能表达我的谢意。

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我明白，你目前也没有什么太好的办法来表达你的谢意，扎格列欧斯。不过，我觉得你还是等时机更合适的时候再感谢我吧，你现在还有更重要的事情要做呢！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Lady Athena, I know there's more at stake for you in this than just my plight... you care so much about this family. That care and your determination spurs me on. I'm ever grateful.

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Perhaps there really is no time quite like the present when it comes to showing thanks to one another, my dear Cousin. You've opened my eyes to the possibility, though I remain steadfast in my resolve to fight for you.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 雅典娜女士，我明白比起帮助我，你其实还有很多重要的事情要做……你真的很在乎这个大家庭。你的指引与决心让我很受鼓舞，我对你非常感激。

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 或许像现在这样的时候，最适合表达对其他人的谢意，我亲爱的表兄弟。是你开阔了我的眼界，让我见识到了可能性。当然，我也会一如既往地为你而战。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I know this Ambrosia originated on Olympus, Lady Athena. Though through its long voyage to these depths, I trust its savor is more worthy of your grace. No one's ever had a greater cousin. And I'll never forget what you've done for me.

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Zagreus? When Nyx revealed herself to me and I first learned of you, I saw it as an opportunity to bridge the great divide between Olympus and your father's realm. But, having had all these glimpses into who you are, it is an even greater honor to have forged this partnership with you.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道这瓶仙馔密酒是在奥林匹斯山酿造的，雅典娜女士。虽然它一路辗转到了冥界，但我认为只有您的恩典才配得上它甘甜的味道。没有哪个兄弟姐妹能比您更优秀了，我永远都不会忘记您对我的恩情。

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯？当倪克斯第一次在我面前露面，听说你的事情的时候，我觉得这会是个好机会，可以弥补奥林匹斯与冥界之间的巨大鸿沟。不过，当我真正了解你是怎样的人之后，我觉得能和你成为伙伴才是更大的荣幸。

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Now, little Hades, you have met my brother Zeus! He's sometimes known as king of all the gods! Although, in many ways, he's not as powerful as I! Nor anywhere as dashing. Why, I, oop--!

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Now, Brother... you know better than to say such things about me, I should think. I know that tact does not come easily to you, though I'd be careful what you say to our good nephew, there.

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Buh, erm, anyway, as I was saying, little Hades! Brother Zeus is king of all the gods! And the most dashing, powerful, and hey, let's face it, godliest of all!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 现在，小哈迪斯，你遇见了我的兄弟宙斯！人们经常把他称为众神之王！但在很多方面，他并没有我强大！没有任何地方像这里这么令人兴奋。哦，我，哎呀——！

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 现在，好兄弟……我宁愿相信你心里清楚该怎么说我。我知道，你为人并不很圆滑机敏，不过我会留心你对我们的好侄子说的话。

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 呃， 嗯，不管怎样，就像我说的，小哈迪斯！我的宙斯兄弟是众神之王！他最有冲劲，最有力量。而且，嘿，不夸张地说，他也是最有神仙范儿！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: As you can see by now, we are a big and clever family, little Hades! My niece Athena here being the cleverest of all. You'd never know that she was childless, the way she looks after and cares for all of us!

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Surely my cleverness comes from your brother and yourself, Lord Uncle Poseidon. And I would only add, my feeling is we've more than enough children in this family, thus no further need for more of them, for now.

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 如你所见，我们是个大家庭，大家都很聪明，小哈迪斯！我的侄女雅典娜是最聪明的一个。光看她照顾我们的方式，你还会以为她早就是当妈的人了呢！

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 我的聪明是从你的兄弟和你身上学来的，波塞冬叔叔。而且我得补充一句，我觉得我们这个大家庭不谙世事的孩子实在是太多了，已经不需要再有人来当孩子了。

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Now, little Hades, you must know by now I've other nephews here, don't you? For instance, Ares comes to mind, the god of war! Some mighty wars have taken place at sea, is that not so?

en.speaker: Ares
en.text: Indeed, they have, good Uncle Poseidon. Mortals show great ingenuity when war is concerned; it drives their sense of progress, more than anything at all. Perhaps someday they shall wage war even in Father's skies.

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 你看，小哈迪斯。除了你之外，我也有别的侄子，你肯定是知道的吧？比如说战神阿瑞斯！有的大战也是在海上打起来的，不是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 确实如此，伟大的波塞冬叔叔。只要是涉及到战争，凡人们就是展示出伟大的创造力，正是战争催促着他们不断进步，战争的影响比其它的一切倒要更强。或许有朝一日，他们甚至会在父亲的天空中开战呢。

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: The thing about me, Nephew, is I get along with everybody, here! A skill apparently that's rather rare! Take my niece Artemis, for instance! Can't ever take a simple jest, at all! You won't easily attract a mate with such a sour look about you, girl!

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Oh, and wouldn't that be such a pity, Uncle Poseidon. I wonder what could be the cause of this sour look that I perpetually have up here? Maybe Zagreus knows.

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Hahaha! See exactly what I mean, Nephew?

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 关于我嘛，有件事得和你说说，侄子。我和这里的所有人都相处得来！这种本事可不是人人都有啊！就比如说我的侄女阿尔忒弥斯吧！她一丁点玩笑都开不起！丫头，你如果总是摆着这么张臭脸，可是勾搭不到男人的啊！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，这可太遗憾了，波塞冬叔叔。我想知道，到底是因为谁，我才总摆着这么张臭脸的？说不定扎格列欧斯知道呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 哈哈哈！你看到了吧，侄子？

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: My foster-sister Goddess Demeter, despite her stern approach, she often likes to make good sport of me, Nephew! Why, here she is right now!

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: If you're quite finished blathering, Poseidon, our young Zagreus has more important things to do. He needs your blessings, not your point of view. Don't you, young sprout?

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我的表姐是女神得墨忒尔。尽管她看起来很严肃，但她经常拿我开玩笑，侄子！她现在就在这儿呢！

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 希望你能少唠叨一点，波塞冬，我们年轻的扎格列欧斯还有重要的事情去做呢。他需要的是你的恩赐，不是夸夸其谈，对不对，小朋友？

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Ah-haha! I knew that I could count on you, Nephew! So the ungrateful Theseus, the winsome prize he earned was just some chariot, correct? And he was vanquished on it, anyway! That's what he gets! Boasting his prize was greater than any in his mortal days, pah!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 哈哈哈！我就知道你靠得住，侄子！所以说那个忘恩负义的忒修斯，他所谓的了不起的奖赏，不过是辆破战车而已，是吧？而且他还被打败了！总之，这都是他自作自受！他还活着的时候，就总胡吹大气，说他的奖赏比什么都要好，我呸！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Ah-haha-hah, little Hades, I was certain you'd the wherewithal to thin the ranks of the betraying river denizens who fled my surface-seas to your father's domain!! I bid you good fish-hunting forevermore!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 啊哈哈哈，小哈迪斯。那些不忠的水下居民竟敢从我的地盘叛逃到你父亲的领地，我敢说，你一定有法子减少他们的数量，是吧！！祝你永远都能钓到好鱼！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: All right, here goes. In the name of Hades! Olympus! This is an official message! Uncle Poseidon, hope you can make this out.

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: What's this, Nephew? Why, isn't this a note? Or, part of one, addressed to me, but it appears there should be other pieces, for the others here? Ah, it's like a sunken treasure, then! Which means I must seek its mysteries at once!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好了，准备送信吧。以哈迪斯之名！奥林匹斯山，这是一份官方来信！波塞冬叔叔，希望您能弄清楚它的含义。

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 怎么，侄子？这不是本日记吗？或者说，是其中的一部分，寄到了我这里。不过看起来应该还有其它的部分，是寄到了其他人那里吗？啊，这就像是沉船的宝藏一样！这意味着，我得赶紧解开它的奥秘了！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: You know, Nephew, I had a positively raucous time down there, with your old father, and Persephone, was she a sight! I never thought I'd see her again! So then, we're one big happy family, at last! But you've a job to do, and we upon Olympus, we'll do our fair share!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 说真的，侄子，我和你老爹，还有珀尔塞福涅在冥界度过了一段相当快乐的时光！她可真是个美人儿啊！我从没想过能再见她一面！所以说，咱们终于成为幸福的大家庭了！不过你还有工作要做，我们奥林匹斯山上的众神会尽可能地帮你！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: So, Nephew, my honored brother Zeus already has endowed you with his thunderous might? Well you shall soon forget about all that, after a taste of this!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 那么，侄子，我尊敬的宙斯兄弟已经赋予了你雷鸣般的力量？好吧，尝尝这个，你很快就会忘记这一切！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Ahh, you've received a blessing from Athena there already, little Hades! So careful all the time, that one, but here, I'll help you live a little, just in case!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 啊，你已经获得雅典娜的祝福了，小哈迪斯！那个人一直都很小心谨慎，但在这里，我会帮你应付一阵子，以防万一！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Oh-hoh, so you've already heard from Aphrodite, have you, Nephew? Understandable, but first things first, now let me add a little something to all that!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 哦，你已经受到阿弗洛狄忒的教诲了，是吗，侄子？可以理解，但首先，现在让我再加上一点东西！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Hoy, Nephew! It's my understanding you've been blessed already by one of my other nephews, Ares! As you can see, not all of us are cut from the same cloth; and thank the Fates for that!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 哦，侄子，据我所知，你已经获得我的另一个侄子阿瑞斯的祝福了！如你所见，并非我们所有人都是一样的人，我们要感谢命运之神的安排！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: I sense that you've been marked by the elusive Artemis, correct, Nephew? She shies away from most of us, so if she's taken somewhat of a liking to you, great!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我觉得你被难以捉摸的阿尔忒弥斯看上了，对吧，侄子？ 她避开了我们大多数人，所以如果她有点喜欢你，那就太好了！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Whenever Dionysus calls a feast, I'm turning up sooner or later, hear me, Nephew? So make room for one more blessing, and, let's go!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 每当迪奥尼索司要举行宴会时，我都会出现的，听到了吗，侄子？所以，再给一个祝福腾出点空间，我们出发！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Little Hades, it appears that you are moving right along! Almost at an uncanny pace!! I wonder how you got to be so fast! Aquatic exercise?!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 小哈迪斯，看来你在不断前进！几乎以不可思议的速度！! 我想知道你怎么做到的！从水路走的吗？！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Nephew, how is it you're navigating your cruel father's realm at such a blinding speed?! There's only one Olympian who moves that quick! Besides myself! Where is he, anyway?

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 侄子，你怎么能以如此惊人的速度在你残忍的父亲的领地航行呢？？只有一个奥林匹斯神有这么快的速度！除了我自己！他到底在哪里？

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Why, little Hades, there's a certain chill about you, meaning you received an ice-cold blessing courtesy of Elder Goddess Demeter, correct? Now, personally, I think water's best in liquid form, but who am I to judge?

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 小哈迪斯，你身上散发着一股寒意，这意味着老女神得墨忒尔给了你一些冰冷的恩赐，对吧？个人来说，我觉得流动的液态水是最好的，但这件事哪轮得到我插嘴呢？

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: You've come to know your Uncle Zeus, by now, correct? Just want to let you know, good Zeus gets very busy on the regular, so you just stick with me, I've always time for you, Nephew!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 你现在已经认识你的宙斯叔叔了，对吧？只是想让你知道，我们的好宙斯经常很忙，所以你就跟我在一起吧，我一直都有时间陪你，侄子！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Nephew, your cruel father, Hades, he's my elder brother, you know that? Not exactly the expressive type, and never was. We seldomly saw eye-to-eye on things!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 侄子，你残忍的父亲，哈迪斯，他是我哥哥，你知道吗？不喜欢说话，从来都不是。我们对事物的看法完全不同！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: I daresay, little Hades, you've some spunk in you! Why, I think you take after me more than my crusty elder brother! You'll get away from that old codger yet!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 说真的，小哈迪斯，你是个挺有胆量的家伙！这么说吧，我觉得比起我那个执拗的老哥，你和我的脾气更像！你一定能摆脱那个老家伙的！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: My crusty elder brother Hades must have tried to poison you against us lot! I can imagine it as clear as water, Nephew! I'm proud that you've resisted his undoubtedly most-twisted words!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我脾气暴躁的哈迪斯大哥一定是想挑拨你与我们之间的关系，这点事根本瞒不住我，侄子！我很欣慰，你没有被他的连篇鬼话所蒙蔽！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Last time your father and I spoke, he told me I was all washed up, can you believe the nerve of it, Nephew? Why, he took the words right out of my mouth!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 上一次我和你父亲聊的时候，他说我看起来就像要完蛋了一样。侄子，他就当着我面说的这句话，你敢信？说真的，他把我想说的话给抢了！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: It's likely, little Hades, that you currently reside just underneath one of my boundless seas! Normally you'd have to be submerged to use this power, but you know what, close enough!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 小哈迪斯，说不定你现在就在我那无边无际的大海之下呢！通常来说，你必须在水里才能使用这种力量！不过，反正你现在和在水里也差不多啦！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: You know I've many vitally important things to do besides lending my aid to you repeatedly, Nephew? But, all of that can wait! Family comes first!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 你是知道的吧，侄子？除了一次又一次帮助你之外，我其实还有很多其它的重要事情要做。不过那些事情都可以等等！家人的事情才是最重要的！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: If you should ever make it here, Nephew, know this! I shall be pleased to stand in for the father figure I can tell you never really had. We can engage in all sorts of aquatic competitions, solve riddles, visit the sea-nymphs! Oh, it would be great, wouldn't you think?

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 如果你真的能来奥林匹斯山的话，侄子，我跟你说！我觉得你从来都没享受过真正的父爱，而我很乐意扮演你父亲的角色。咱们可以一起参加各种各样的水上比赛，解答谜语，一起去找海上仙子！哦，那可真是太棒了，你说是吧？

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Nephew, why, the seas up here, they're just about as widely feared as your vast Underworld down there! For water can be deadlier than bronze!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我说，侄子，地上世界的人惧怕大海，就像惧怕冥界一样！因为有时候，水会比刀剑更加可怕！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: My oceans, they are filled with danger, not just water, little Hades! Many of the dead you face, they met their mortal end at sea, and not on land!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我的大海里不仅仅只有海兽，还充满了危险，小哈迪斯！你见过的许多死人，都不是在陆地上丧命的，而是在海里淹死的！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Ahh, it seems to me you've had yourself a spot of lady trouble, lately, isn't that correct, Nephew? I mean the Fury down in Tartarus, of course! You going to let her keep on bossing you around?!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 啊，在我看来，你最近有点麻烦，是不是，侄子？我当然是在说塔耳塔罗斯的复仇女神！你要让她继续对你指手画脚吗？！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Hah! I heard you showed that good-for-nothing Fury after all, I knew you'd handle that old crone, Nephew! And if she troubles you again, you just remind her who's in charge down there!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 哈！我听说你在复仇女神面前表现得一无是处。但我知道你会搞定那个老太婆的，侄子！如果她再找你麻烦，你只要提醒她掌管冥界的人是谁就行了！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Good tidings, Nephew! I've learned that you have managed to get all the way to Asphodel, fine work! Now, you just keep on going!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 好消息，侄子！我知道你已经一路来到了水仙花平原，干得好！现在继续前进！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Ohh, Nephew, you've stood against the Bull of Minos, have you? Well I must apologize for any inconvenience there, because, he was a living testament to my revenge! Long story, boring really, rather sordid, too. Stay strong!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 哦，侄子，你已经跟米诺斯公牛对峙过了，是吗？我必须为我带来的不便道歉，因为他是我复仇行动活生生的见证。说来话长，真的很无聊，也很无耻。坚强点！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Word reaches us that you've come very far, indeed, Nephew! Striking distance from the surface! You just keep at it like that, and with our help, we'll have you out of there for sure!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 听说你真的走了很远的路程，侄子！离凡界越来越近了！就这样坚持下去，在我们的帮助下，我们一定会把你拯救出去的！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: I wonder what monstrosities await you near the surface, little Hades? There's your father's terrifying hell-hound, for one thing! Ah, well, I'm sure you'll find a way to sail past whatever's in your way!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我不禁想知道，在凡界附近会有什么怪物在等着你，小哈迪斯？比如说，你父亲那只可怕的地狱猎犬！啊，好吧，我相信，无论使用什么方法，你总能想办法过了它那一关的！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Now don't lose heart, Nephew! Because in spite of all your efforts, it is probably the case that you still have a long and painful road ahead!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 一定要努力坚持下去，侄子！虽然你已经付出了相当的努力，但前方的道理可能依然很漫长，充满波折！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Ah, I thought for certain you were well on your way out of there last time, Nephew! But, no matter, we'll just get you on another voyage to the top!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 啊，我还以为你马上就要到奥林匹斯山了呢，侄子！不过不要紧，往地表世界前进就是了，我们再帮你一次也没问题！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Little Nephew, why, I could have sworn you made it to the surface recently, and yet, you're all the way back there, again? Must be some sort of terrible monstrosity preventing your way out!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 小侄子，这是怎么回事？我敢确定你之前明明都已经来到地上世界了，可你怎么又回到这里了？肯定是某种可怕的怪物挡住了你的去路！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: I'll tell you, Nephew, I was quite taken aback to learn Persephone, she was your mother all along! Just disappeared up here, one day! Ran off, I figured, as she's got some mortal blood in her. But she was with your father! That rascal is my brother, after all!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 说真的，侄子，珀尔塞福涅的事情让我大吃一惊，原来她才是你的母亲！有一天她突然就从这里消失了！我以为她是跑了，因为她体内也流着一部分凡人的鲜血，结果她居然跑去和你父亲在一起了！哎呀，那个老混蛋毕竟还是我大哥啊！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: So how is crusty old Hades faring down there of late, Nephew? Fewer worries there upon his brow? That Underworld of yours all running smoothly, and all that? We'll keep on pitching in from over here. Least we can do!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 所以呢，哈迪斯那个老家伙最近怎么样了，侄子？让他皱眉头的事情有没有变少点？你们的冥界一切都还顺利吧？我们会在这里留意一切的，至少这些事情是我们该做的！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Persephone, she says you're really stuck down there, born of the Underworld, something like that? Well, if you ask me, that's no kind of attitude to have! You can do anything you set your mind to, Nephew! Take it from me!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 珀尔塞福涅说，你是在冥界诞生的，一直被困在了那个地方，她是这么说的吧？这么说吧，要我看来，这种态度可不对！无论你想干什么，侄子，尽管放手去干就对了！我跟你保证！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: If you do ever get the opportunity to spend some time up here, Nephew, know I shall take you on a grand tour of the surface! From the depths of my seas to the height of Olympus! Sure, maybe not today, or tomorrow, or even the next aeon! But sometime, we should go!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 如果你能有空在这里呆一段日子，侄子，我一定要带你去地上世界好好观光一圈！从我的海洋深处，一直到奥林匹斯山的山顶！当然，或许今天不行，明天不行，再过很长时间也不行！不过咱们肯定能有时间去好好看看！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Been nice to see my brothers getting on again, just like old times! Well, not exactly like old times, and come to think of it, there always was a bit of tension there between those two, but still! It's better than before!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 看到我的兄弟们想过去一样和睦相处，我可真高兴！确切地说，和过去也不太一样。仔细想想，以前那两个家伙之间总是有些摩擦，不过这样也好！反正比之前要好！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Your good mother Persephone, she's here all safe and sound, thought you should know, there, little Hades! Shame you can't be here with her, too, but ah! Doubtless we'll someday meet again!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 你的好妈妈珀尔塞福涅，她在这里安然无恙，不过我猜你早就知道了，小哈迪斯！你不能和她呆在一起，真是太遗憾了，不过啊！不用担心，咱们总有一天会再见面的！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Ah-hah! I sense you have in your possession that fine shell I sent to you, a little gift plucked straight out of the sea! You keep it close so I can better track you down!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 啊——哈！我发现了，你很喜欢我送给你的那个漂亮的贝壳，那是我特地带给你的海上特产！只要你戴着它，我就能更清楚地看到你的行踪！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: My, my, little Hades, you brandish Exagryph, the Rail of Adamant! That weapon's power was so terrifying that we sealed it away. Oh well! Surely its mortal-damning secrets shall be safely guarded in your hands!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 哦，天呢，小哈迪斯，你挥舞着狮鹫坚炮伊格瑞菲！那武器的威力太可怕了，所有我们把它封存了起来。噢，好吧！它致命的秘密在你手中一定万无一失！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Huh! Why, if my eyes do not deceive me through those murky depths, you brandish Malphon! Let me tell you, little Hades, those old gloves have done some dirty work before your time!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 哈！要是那阴暗的深渊没让我看错的话，你挥舞的正是玛尔封！我告诉你，小哈迪斯，在你出生之前，这双手套可做过不少脏活儿呢！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Why, little Hades, it is awful murky where you are, but if I'm not mistaken, and I never am, you wield fearsome Stygius! She once belonged to me, you know! Not quite my type, but we sure had our times! You take good care of her for me!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 为什么，小哈迪斯，你现在所在的地方很阴暗，但如果我没弄错，我从来没有弄错，你挥舞的是可怕的冥界之刃斯第格思！她曾经属于我，你知道的！但她不是我喜欢的类型，但我们确实创造过一个辉煌的时代！你要替我好好照顾她！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Say, is it me, or do you bear your father's ancient spear, Nephew? I always wanted one a bit like that. And now I have one even better. Hah!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我说，是我看错了，还是你拿的就是你父亲以前的那边长矛，侄子？我以前一直想要一把那样的长矛，不过我现在这把比它更好，哈！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: This time, Nephew, let's really show your father what you're made of: Water! For the most part! Mortals, at least, are mostly made of it. Bet you did not know that!

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Ohh, have I got something for you this time, little Hades! Something special I have saved for when you really proved yourself!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 侄子，这次你可以把你爸打得落花流水了！没错，你身体绝大部本都是水构成的！至少凡人身体的绝大部分都是由水组成的。我猜你以前肯定不知道吧！

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 哦，这次我有东西给你，小哈迪斯！我为你保留了一些能够用来真正证明自己实力的特殊礼物！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: The mortals like to give me thanks for all my generosity, Nephew! But little do they know, I have been saving up a bunch of it for you!

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: There's nothing stronger than the sea, Nephew, neither above it nor below!! And, if you are in need of further proof, behold: The greatest of my blessings, just for you!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 凡人们都在歌颂我的慷慨，侄子！但他们可不知道，我偷偷留了很多好东西，都是给你的！

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 没有什么比大海更强大的了，侄子，无论是在它上面还是下面！啊！如果你需要更多证据，请注意：我最大的祝福，只为你！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Say, word has reached me that you squared against one known as Theseus, now champion there in Elysium? He was a handful even when he lived! So much so that my honored brother Zeus, he took to calling him my son, can you believe the nerve?

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我听说，你和至福乐土如今的最强勇士，那个叫忒修斯的家伙打起来了！他活着的时候就罕有敌手！他实在是太优秀了，就连我尊敬的兄弟宙斯都称他为“我的孩子”，这种事你敢信吗？

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: So, little Hades, doubtless you have seen that we upon Olympus also lend our favor to the mighty Theseus, who bars your passage from Elysium! Now, don't you take it personally, there, because our blessings go to all who deserve them. Although, we try to save the best for you!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我说，小哈迪斯，毫无疑问你已经看到了，我们奥林匹斯众神也同样把祝福赐予了强大的忒修斯，而他会在至福乐土阻止你继续前进！跟你说实话，我们这么做不是为了针对你，而是所有配得上祝福的战士，都会得到我们的祝福。不过，我们会尽可能把最好的祝福留给你！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: That scoundrel Theseus! Apparently he earned himself some sort of winsome prize, for all his blustering there in Elysium! Though, I'm quite certain that, no matter what he and his bull friend have at their disposal, you've the power to defeat them, utterly! So go do it, surely I'll get word!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 忒修斯那个无赖！看起来，他在至福乐土确实有一群拥趸，这也让他赢得了某种丰厚的奖励！不过我很肯定，无论他和他那个牛头朋友有什么手段， 你都肯定你彻底击败他们！所以你就尽量上吧，我肯定能听到你胜利的消息！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Why, Nephew, you've procured the Rod of Fishing, I detect! Fine handiwork if I say so myself! Its line is nigh-invisible and causes denizens of my domain to flock to it like mortals to temples of mine! Good fortune with that thing!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 侄子，我发现你弄到了！做工真的很不错啊！它的鱼线几乎细得看不到，我领地上的居民疯狂地涌向它，就像凡人涌向我的神庙一样！祝你钓鱼愉快！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: I'm told a number of the underwater denizens from my domain were captured fair-and-square through your surpassing skill using the Rod of Fishing, little Hades!! They're yours, I've millions more!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我听说，我领域很多水下的居民，都被你给光明正大地用钓鱼竿给逮住了，小哈迪斯！！他们都属于你了，我这边还多的是呢！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: All these river denizens you've caught, little Hades... it can only mean we share a deep connection, don't you think? I, with my power over the entire vastness of the seas! And you, with the power to ensnare a hapless fish with but a flick of the wrist!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 你钓上来那么多条小鱼，小哈迪斯……这只意味着一件事，那就是，我们之间有很深厚的联系，你不这么想吗？整个大海都是我的地盘，我可以随意翻手为云，覆手为雨！而你也是，只要轻轻一翻手腕，就能钓上来一条倒霉的小鱼！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Say, what exactly is that very mighty-looking spear I think I faintly see in your possession there, it's... why, I've not seen a thing like that except on very distant shores! It's almost as impressive as my trident here! Almost, I say!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我依稀看见你手持的那柄看起来很强大的长矛了，这东西……除了在遥远的滨海之外，我没在别地方见到过！它看起来几乎和我的三叉戟一样厉害！我是说，几乎！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: You bear some sort of splendid-looking weapon, there, Nephew! Must be another aspect of fair Stygius, my old discarded blade! Never did see that one myself, but, I saw many others that were splendid, too!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 你拿着的武器有点酷炫啊，侄子！一定是被我丢掉的那把剑，斯第格思的另一种形态吧！我从来没见过它这个样子，但是我见过很多其它酷炫的样子！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Hoh, you look positively in atrocious shape, there, Nephew! What's the matter, one too many run-ins with the wretched dead before I intervened?

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 哟呵，侄子，你看起来气色不怎么样啊！怎么了，是不是和那些该死的暗灵发生了太多冲突？不过不要紧，我来帮忙了！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Seems to me that you're in dire straits, there, little Hades! Why, you're bleeding everywhere! Here, let me try and do something for that.

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 在我看来，你现在处境艰难，小哈迪斯！哦，你浑身都在流血！来，让我试着做点什么。

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Ah, what happened to you, little Hades?! I can tell even from here that you've been beaten like a skiff during a storm!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 啊，你这是怎么了，小哈迪斯！我在这里都能看清楚，你被打得像风暴中的小船一样！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Now, don't go dying on me, yet, Nephew! You have to live! Or else the Boon I offer you shall go to waste!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 可别就这么死在我面前啊，不行，侄子！你必须得活下来！否则我给你的祝福可就都浪费了！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Your hated enemies, they almost got the best of you, I fear! But you can still turn it around, especially now that you have my aid!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我觉得，你那些该死的敌人差点就把你干掉了！不过你还是有机会翻盘的，尤其是你还有我这个帮手呢！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's uncle number two, it's got to be. Then, in the name of Hades! Olympus, I accept this message.

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Hoy there, little Hades! You recognize your uncle, do you not? We've a lot of catching up to do, but first things first, you get yourself out of that dour Underworld! As for me, I'll see if I can stir things up a bit to cover your advance!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 一定是二叔。然后，以哈迪斯之名！奥林匹斯山，我收到了这条消息。

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 喂，小哈迪斯！你认识你叔叔，不是吗？我们有很多事情要做，但首先，你要逃离冥界！至于我，我看看能不能挑起点事端，来掩护你的前进！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Hoy, Nephew, it's excellent to see you once again, and in good spirits, still? Then, come, let's make some waves!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 吼吼，侄子，很高兴再次见到你，你的精神还算好吧，嗯？那么，来吧，让我们掀起一些波澜！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Ahoy, little Hades, it is I! The greatest of your uncles! Here to aid you in your daringest escape attempt! And I do admire your persistence!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 嘿呀，小哈迪斯，是我，你所有叔叔里面最伟大的那个！让我来帮你逃出这个鬼地方吧！顺便说一句，我真佩服你的毅力！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Good tidings once again, there, little Nephew!! It is I, returned as ever here to make a splash against your many, many foolish enemies!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 还有一个好消息，小侄子！啊！那就是，我会像往常一样回到这里，帮你对付许许多多愚蠢的敌人！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Ahoy, Nephew! I bet you have your hands full dealing with your enemies down there, so let me see what I can do. And I can do a lot!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 嘿哟，侄子！我猜你在正在全力对付敌人吧，让我看看我能做点什么吧！我能做的事情可多了去了！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: It seems you're getting somewhere, little Nephew! Good, but here, allow your favorite Uncle to bestow a little boost!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 你好像已经有进展了，小侄子！很好，但是在这里，请允许你最喜欢的叔叔给你一点鼓励！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Ah, hahaha! Found you down there, Nephew! Now let's overwhelm your enemies in a typhoon of godly might, what do you say?

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 啊，哈哈哈！终于找到你了，侄子！现在，咱们来用神力把敌人一扫而空吧，你觉得怎么样？

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Little Hades, have I ever told you I detest the dead? Well, I admit it, I just cannot stand a mortal past his due. So how about we get you far away from all such filth, agreed?

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 小哈迪斯，我有没有告诉过你，我讨厌亡灵？好吧，我承认，我只是不能忍受凡人死后没有受到惩罚。那我们就让你远离这些肮脏的东西，好吗？

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: What do you say, there, Nephew, ready to get wet, or no? Oh I suspect you are, so let's get to it, and dispense some liquid justice!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 你说呢，侄子，准备好过河了吗？哦，我觉得你准备好了，所以我们开始吧，并在沿途进行一些正义之举！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: How fares your feud against my crusty elder brother lately, good? Big Hades, he is disagreeable with all of us, not just with you, so, don't you take it personal, and stick with me!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 最近，你和我那脾气暴躁的哥哥之间发生的争执怎么样了，你们还好吗？大哈迪斯，他对我们所有人都不友好，不仅仅是对你，所以，你不要觉得他是针对你个人的，和我在一起！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Looks like you could use the power of the sea, wouldn't you say so, little Hades? Good thing I'm here, so that together, we might wash your enemies away!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 看起来你可以用大海的力量，不是吗，小哈迪斯？幸好我在这里，所以我们可以一起对付你的敌人！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Enough kidding around without me, Nephew! I am here, so let's go bust you out, much like a raging river through a frail little dam!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 别拿我开涮了，侄子！我在这里，让我们帮助你逃出去，就像一条汹涌的河流冲过一个脆弱的小水坝！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: You're looking somewhat stronger than before, there, little Nephew, but you're much too scrawny still, to be quite blunt. So, here! Let's fatten you right up!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 小侄子，你看起来比以前强壮了些，但坦率的说，你还是太瘦了。所以，在这里！让我们把你喂胖些！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Hoy, my nephew! I think I have kept you waiting long enough, so then, let's go! And break our enemies to pieces, like so many ships upon the shoals!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 啊哈，这不是我的侄子嘛！我大概让你等得够久了，那么，我们出发吧！咱们一起把敌人撕成碎片，就像巨浪撕裂小船一样！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: I'll have you know, the power of the seas themselves is yours once more, Nephew! So how about you put it to its rightful purpose, and go smash some stuff!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我会让你知道，你又获得了大海的力量，侄子！现在，就把这力量用在正确的目标上，去对付你的敌人吧！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Are you perchance in need of godlike aid, Nephew? Well, excellent! Because I happen to command the sea, and I shall hereby let you take it for a whirl!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 侄子，你需要神的帮助吗？好吧，太好了！因为我正好掌管海洋，所以我要赐予你海洋的力量！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Who dares to mess with little Hades? You simply point me at them, Nephew, and we'll leave them shivering and sopping wet, you'll see!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 谁敢惹我们的小哈迪斯？只要告诉我他们是谁，侄子，我们就会让他们浑身发抖，受到海洋的打击，到时候你就知道了！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: At last I found you once again, Nephew! You eating well and getting strong, correct? I'll help you with the latter category in a moment. Here!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我终于又找到你了，侄子！你吃饱喝足，变得越来越壮了，对吧？我马上就可以让你变得更强，来，收下这个！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: The awesome bounty of the sea is yours to do with as you please, Nephew! I've mustered forth a sample, anyway!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 侄子，你可以随心所欲地获得大海的慷慨祝福！无论如何，我收集了一份样品！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Hoh, little Hades! I'd heard you were preparing to rain terrible destruction on your enemies! So I got here as quickly as I could! I'm not too late, am I?

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 嘿哟，小哈迪斯！我听说你打算让敌人好好吃点苦头了，所以我就马不停蹄地赶过来了！还不算晚，是吧？

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: All of us must sail through troubled waters now and then, correct, Nephew? Fortunately, navigation is my speciality, so let's be on our way!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我们每个人肯定都会经历困境，对吗，侄子？幸运的是，在大海中航行是我的专长，所以我们出发吧！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Your victory's most certainly at hand now that I'm here, Nephew! So long as you make sure to take advantage of the absolutely awesome power I bequeath!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我来了，你的胜利就在眼前，侄子！只要你确保使用我赐予你的巨大力量！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Why, if it isn't the most favored of my nephews, stuck as ever though you may yet be! We'll get you from there, little Hades, don't despair, Uncle Poseidon's here!!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 哦，如果我侄子不太喜欢它，你就要像自己不喜欢一样把它解决掉！我们会把你从那里救出来，小哈迪斯，不要绝望，波塞冬叔叔来了！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Good tidings, my most favored nephew! All is relatively well, I hope? But hope alone is worthless without action, is it not? So here, let's act together!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 好消息，我最宠爱的侄子！一切都还好吗？但光想不干没有用，不是吗？所以来吧，咱们一起开干吧！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Just wait until you see the seas, Nephew! My underwater realm is the most glorious of the world's habitats. It positively teems with life, and it's much cooler there than in that sweaty Underworld of yours!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 等一会儿，就看到大海了，侄子！我的水下王国是世界上最美丽的住所。它充满了活力，比闷热的冥界凉爽多了！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Well, Nephew, supposing it's high time for the high seas to lend their might once more?

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 好吧，侄子，想象一下，现在就是我们可以再次借助海洋力量的时候了？

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Your uncle's offering to shake things up once more, what say you, little Hades?

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 叔叔又想大干一场了，你觉得呢，小哈迪斯？

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: No more dallying about, now, little Nephew! Time instead we really got somewhere!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 好了，别再小打小闹了，小侄子！是时候干票大的了！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Good tidings, little Hades! It is I! And I am always here to help!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 好消息，小哈迪斯！我来啦！我随时愿意帮你的忙！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Fear not, Nephew, it is I, your uncle! Come to wash away your troubles, here and now!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 别害怕，侄子，是我，你叔叔！过来吧，让海水洗刷掉你的烦恼，就是现在，就在这里！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Just point me toward your enemies, Nephew, and they'll become sworn enemies of mine!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 侄子，只要告诉我你的敌人是谁，他们就会成为我的死敌！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Let's get you out from underneath the sea, there, little Nephew!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我们要把你从无边的苦海中拯救出去，小侄子！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Ahoy, my godly Nephew, I've arrived, so set aside your worries and let's drench the dead!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 啊，我虔诚的侄子，我到了，放下你的烦恼吧，让我们把这些亡灵一网打尽！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: How about we set you up here with some real water-power, little Hades?

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 不如我让你见识一下真正的海洋之力吧，怎么样，小哈迪斯？

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: I take it you could use some liquid courage at this time, no, little Hades?

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我觉得你需要一些海水来提提精神，你说呢，小哈迪斯？

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: How about a swim, there, little Hades? A swim, that is, within the Pool of Blessings! Now, dive in!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 不如来游个泳吧，小哈迪斯？就在这祝福的水池里游泳吧！来，潜下去吧！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: I'm here, Nephew, to aid you in your time of need, with this!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我来了，侄子。我赶过来帮你的忙了，还带了这个！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: I heard that you could use the awesome power of the sea, Nephew!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我听说你需要伟大的海洋之力，侄子！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Go on and make a splash for me, why don't you, little Hades!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 来，溅起点水花让我看看吧，怎么样，小哈迪斯！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: The treasures of the sea are limitless, so here! You take your pick!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 海洋的宝藏是无穷无尽的，来吧！随便你挑！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: What do you say we make some waves, right, little Hades?

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 不如我们来乘风破浪吧，怎么样，小哈迪斯？

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Don't let the wretched dead dampen your spirits, little Hades! Dampen theirs!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 别让那些该死的死人坏了你的兴致，小哈迪斯！你得去坏了他们的兴致！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Here comes another cool, refreshing blessing for you, Nephew!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 又来了一份清凉提神的恩赐，侄子！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Water can even cut through solid stone, with enough time! So you keep at it, there!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 只要有足够的时间，滴水也能穿石！坚持不懈就对了！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: I know that you can do it, little Hades! Whatever it may be!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我才不管你想做什么呢！我知道你肯定能做得到，小哈迪斯！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: It's darker than the bottom of the sea in there! Are you alive, Nephew?!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 这里比海底还要阴森！你还活着吗，侄子？！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: The secrets of the sea can all be yours! Eventually at least, I have just three for now!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 整个大海的秘密你都可以随便看！不过，我现在只带来了三个！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: You still alive down there, Nephew? Because if so, why, this ought to keep it that way!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 你还活着吧，侄子？如果你还活着的话，就继续努力活下去！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Must get so stuffy in that dreary place, Nephew! So why don't you cool off a bit, with this!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 这个阴暗的地方肯定又闷又热吧，侄子！不如来清爽一下吧，就用这个！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: You have a dirty job down there, Nephew, but I can help you to clean up a bit!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 你在下面有很多脏活要做，侄子，但我可以帮你清洁一下！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: All that I ask, here, little Nephew, is for you to do your best! As I would do!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 你要做的事情，就是尽可能地努力，小侄子！就像我这样！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Ahoy, and now prepare yourself! For I've a rare treat here, especially for you!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 哎哟，你可得准备好了！我这个珍贵的礼物是特地为你准备的！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: I am ever impressed with your will to succeed, Nephew, so here! Great blessings be with you!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 你求胜的决心让我大受感动，侄子，收下吧！愿这强大的恩赐与你同在！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: You've earned only the very finest of my blessings, little Hades! Why? Why not!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我准备把我最好的祝福都给你，小哈迪斯！我为什么要这样？我为什么不这样！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: If you are ever going to get out of there, only the mightiest of all my blessings will suffice!

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 如果你真的打算逃出冥界的话，恐怕只有我最强力的祝福能帮助你了！

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: My favorite Nephew ought have access to my greatest blessings, should he not?

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我最喜欢的侄子，就应该得到我最强力的祝福，对不对？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Uncle Poseidon, it's been excellent to know you, sir, so, please, this is for you.

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Oh I am positively moved by your affection, little Nephew! Though, I think I have just the thing for you, in turn! Here, I shall transfer it to you!!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 波塞冬叔叔，很高兴认识您，先生，所以，这是孝敬您的，请笑纳。

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 哦，我真的被你的爱感动了，小侄子！不过，我也正好有东西给你！在这里，我会转给你的！！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Uncle Poseidon, this here is for you. Would that my father were as easygoing as yourself.

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Ah-hah! A show of generosity from my most favored nephew! Your gift is mightily appreciated!! I'll just go ahead and add it to the pile.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 波塞冬叔叔，这是孝敬您的。我父亲要是像您一样随和就好了。

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 啊哈哈！是我最宠爱的侄子送我的大礼！非常感谢你的礼物！！我就直接把它放在我的礼物堆上啦。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Mighty Poseidon, greatest of my uncles, arguably, please accept this gift!

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: For all the times I'm offered gifts or sacrifices, little Nephew, I still always very much appreciate it! I mean, look! I'm grinning ear to ear!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 威猛的波塞冬，我最伟大的叔叔，我想说，请接受这个礼物！

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 小侄子，无论是礼物，还是你贡献的献祭品，我都很感激！我是说，看！我笑得都合不拢嘴了！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Uncle Poseidon, I have a special catch for you! Although it pales next to your sheer awesomeness.

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Whaaa, now would you look at that! Is that an offering to your most favored uncle, me? You know what, Nephew? I've decided I shall take it! Thanks!!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 波塞冬叔叔，我有一个特别的礼物要送给您！尽管这和您的神力相比不算什么。

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 哇，现在，快来看看这个！这是给你最喜欢的叔叔，也就是我的礼物吗？你知道吗，好侄子，我决定收下它了！谢谢你！！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I salute you, Uncle Poseidon! Your strength and confidence inspire me, and you accepted me as part of the family without question. It means a lot.

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Ahh, Nephew, but you needn't shower me with offerings and praise, you know! Why, I've no need of showering at all! Not when I've the sea itself, to do with as I please!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我向您致敬，波塞冬叔叔！您的力量与信心鼓舞了我，而且您把我当做您真真正正的家人，这对我而言非常重要。

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 啊啊，侄子，说真的，你真没必要破费，献给我这些礼物和赞美！我根本不需要什么珍宝！我自己就是海神，海里的珍宝我想怎么拿就怎么拿！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Whenever I encounter you, Uncle Poseidon, my spirits lift, and I feel there must not be anything that can stop me. I only wish we met sooner, though I'm grateful to have met you at all.

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: I thought I told you, Nephew, not to make such offerings to me? Ah, probably forgot! Or getting you mixed up, perhaps, for I have many other nephews, thanks to Zeus! Though, between us, I don't like any one of them as much as you!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 波塞冬叔叔，每次见到您的时候，我都觉得斗志昂扬，感觉没什么困难能阻止我前进。我很庆幸能遇到您，如果我能早点遇到您就好了。

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 我不是和你说过了嘛，侄子？不用破费给我这些礼物。啊，我大概是忘说了！或者是把你和别的侄子弄混了，毕竟我有那么多侄子呢，都是宙斯搞出来的！不过，私下里偷偷地说，你才是我最喜欢的侄子！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Uncle Poseidon, sometimes I wonder what my life would have been like had you been a part of it sooner. Your encouragement, your enthusiasm... it means a lot. To you! This Ambrosia's been to hell and back!

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Hohhh, but isn't this a kingly offering, indeed, my little Hades! I know how difficult it must have been to get, so distant from Olympus as you are! I'll never understand how come your father's cruel to you, for if you were my son, I would be proud! Proud anyway, but you get the idea.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 波塞冬叔叔，有的时候我不禁会想，如果能早点遇到您的话，我的生命会变成什么样子呢。您的鼓舞，您乐观的态度……对我非常重要。这是敬你的！让冥界的仙馔密酒回到奥林匹斯山上吧！

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 哎哟哟，这可真是不得了的礼物啊，我的小哈迪斯！你离奥林匹斯山那么远，我都想得到这瓶仙馔密酒有多难弄到！我真不明白你的父亲为什么要对你那么严格，因为如果我是你爸的话，我一定会感到骄傲的！虽然我总是很骄傲，不过，你明白我是什么意思。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Well, now, young sprout, you've met the so-called King of the Olympians, and I. Whom do you now suppose is genuinely ruler of this snow-encrusted mountaintop of ours?

en.speaker: Zeus
en.text: Oh, hah-hah-hah, Lady Demeter! Your wit is just as dry as the earth lying quite fallow in your care! Perhaps you should go tend to that again, though let's we go ahead and help our young man first!

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 那么，小朋友，你已经见过我了，也见过那所谓的奥林匹斯众神之王了。在这白雪皑皑的奥林匹斯山上，你觉得我们两个谁才是真正的统治者？

zh-CN.speaker: 宙斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，哈哈哈，得墨忒尔女士！你的智慧就像被你照顾过的土地一样干涸萎靡！或许你应该在这方面多下点工夫，不过，咱们还是先来帮帮咱们这位年轻人吧！

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Ah, little sprout. I was just notifying Lord Poseidon here that all of his domain exists because it pleases me; remember, my good foster-brother, I could freeze your oceans solid if I chose.

en.speaker: Poseidon
en.text: Ah, hahahah! Excellently stated, venerable Goddess Demeter! I'm reminded once more of your vast experience, though, I think we all prefer our oceans liquidy, isn't that right, Nephew?!

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 啊，小朋友，我刚刚只是和波塞冬大人说一下，他的领地之所以还能安然无恙，只不过是因为我乐意罢了。记住了，我的好弟弟，只要我想，我随时都能让你的海洋结冰。

zh-CN.speaker: 波塞冬
zh-CN.text: 啊哈哈哈！完全没错，我尊贵的女神得墨忒尔！这又让我想起你以前做过的事情了。不过，我们应该喜欢液态的大海吧，是吧，侄子？！

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: To think, young sprout, our strategist Athena, warrior-goddess, sprang from Zeus' head! I would expect that no high intellect could come from there.

en.speaker: Athena
en.text: Please do not mind the Lady Demeter's good-natured sense of humor, Zagreus. She and my father often like to jest with one another, even in the most difficult times.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 想想吧，我的小朋友，骁勇善战的女神雅典娜，她可是从宙斯的脑袋里蹦出来的！从那种地方出来的家伙应该也聪明不到哪里去。

zh-CN.speaker: 雅典娜
zh-CN.text: 请不要介意得墨忒尔女士善意的玩笑，扎格列欧斯。就算是在最艰难的日子里，她和我的父亲也时常互相打趣。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Young Zagreus, once you arrive, do tell Lord Ares here that his great power's not worth anything without my own. Wars have their causes, among which, many I control.

en.speaker: Ares
