en.text: I do not question that your influence can stir a mortal's impulses toward war, O Goddess Demeter. At least we can agree that our domains are quite compatible!

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 小扎格列欧斯，你到了之后，一定要记得告诉阿瑞斯大人，他的神力跟我比，简直是不值一提。战争的起因有很多，但很多都在我的掌控之中。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿瑞斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，得墨忒尔女神，您的影响能激起凡人对战争的渴望，这一点我毫不怀疑。我们各自的领域是很能合得来的，至少在这一点上我们可以达成共识。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Remember something for us, Zagreus. A frozen heart holds no sway over anyone at all. Isn't that right, oh Aphrodite, dear?

en.speaker: Aphrodite
en.text: Oh, I don't know, my dearest Demeter! The frozen heart has tendency to thaw, and then begin to beat with renewed vigor after that. I trust your time shall come! It can never be too late, except for mortals, the poor things.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 要记住，扎格列欧斯，冰冷的心是无法收获爱情的。噢，我亲爱的阿弗洛狄忒，我说得对吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿弗洛狄忒
zh-CN.text: 哦，这我哪知道啊，我最亲爱的得墨忒尔！冰冷的心总有一天会融化，焕发出新的光彩。我相信你有朝一日也会老树逢春的！无论爱情什么时候来，都不会太晚。但对寿命有限的凡人除外，那些家伙真够可怜的。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Why, Zagreus, my gentle Artemis here was just saying how concerned she was for your predicament! I'm sure she'd like it if we both could help you in this case.

en.speaker: Artemis
en.text: Concerned? I don't see anyone concerned, you have this, Zagreus! You don't need anybody's help, and you can get through this all on your own, though just in case, and I mean just in case! Um, here.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你看，扎格列欧斯，我温柔的阿尔忒弥斯只是对你的困境表示关心而已！我想，如果我们都能帮助你的话，她应该会很高兴吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿尔忒弥斯
zh-CN.text: 关心？我可没看到有谁关心。我有句话要对你说，扎格列欧斯！你不需要别人的帮助，你完全可以凭自己的力量完成这场旅途。不过万一，我是说，万一发生意外的话！呃，收下这个吧。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: The crops shall wither and decay so long as I may please, young Zagreus. Although we do have those upon Olympus who take issue with my reasoning...

en.speaker: Dionysus
en.text: Erm, yeah, milady, I take issue here! I mean how are the grapes supposed to grow and wine supposed to flow when you are so uptight, now, just ease up a little there, let's see what we can do!

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 只要我想，庄稼就会永远枯萎腐朽下去，年轻的扎格列欧斯。不过，奥林匹斯山上有人对我的做法有点意见……

zh-CN.speaker: 迪奥尼索司
zh-CN.text: 呃，是啊，女士，我有意见！我是说，你现在这么紧绷着，葡萄还怎么生长，美酒还怎么流淌啊？你得缓和一下情绪，看看我们能不能帮帮你！

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I see the noble King of the Olympians has reached you prior to me, Zagreus. I wonder which of all his many lies he's told you last.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 看得出来，高贵的奥林匹斯众神之王在我之前先和你碰面了，扎格列欧斯。我不禁在想，他和你胡扯的那些鬼话，什么时候会被拆穿呢？

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: My foster-brother's wayward son appears! I, too, once lost a child, Zagreus. I was quite foolish with her from the start. Her father was a baseborn farm-boy; worshiped me! He's gone as well, of course. Only the cold remains.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我兄弟的任性儿子来啦！我也失去过一个孩子，扎格列欧斯。是我太蠢了，我一开始就不应该生这个孩子。她的父亲是底层出身的农民，是我的崇拜者！当然，他也不在了，留给我的只有寒冷。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: My daughter to a baseborn farm-boy, she... why, little sprout, I wasn't very kind to her, I think. Certainly not once her father passed. It was her mortal blood that made her weak! Born to mortals, taken by mortals, I suspect. So now, they pay.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我和一个乡下农民生下来的女儿，她……我得说，小朋友，我对她不是特别好。她父亲去世之后，我对她更加苛刻了。她之所以那么孱弱，就是因为她凡人的血统！生为凡人，死亦凡人，这就是代价吧。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I don't suppose... no, it is nothing, little sprout, it's just... I hear such wicked rumors now and then, about my daughter, lost to me, and what became of her. Kore, we called her, then. Persephone is what she called herself. Before she vanished utterly, leaving no trace....

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我不觉得……不，没事，小朋友，只是……我听闻了很多骇人的流言，说我的女儿是怎么离开我的，说我的女儿变成了什么样子。我们以前叫她科瑞，而她现在自称为珀尔塞福涅。她就这么消失不见了，无影无踪……

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: After my daughter Kore disappeared, I left this mountaintop. Wandered the earth, in search. For naught, of course. It was a necessary journey, I suppose. May yours fare better.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我的女儿科瑞消失之后，我离开了奥林匹斯山。我找遍了整个凡间，可徒劳无功。我猜，那段旅途还是很有必要的吧。希望你的旅途比我更加顺利。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hope Mother knows what she's doing, in the name of Hades! Olympus, this is an official message! Lady Demeter, this is for you.

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: What's all of this, young Zagreus, a message of some sort, for me, indeed? I... can't decipher it, although... it bears the marks of my two foster-brothers here, and... well! It seems we'd better compare notes!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 希望妈妈明白她在做什么。以哈迪斯之名！奥林匹斯山，这是一份官方来信！得墨忒尔女士，这是给您的信。

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 这是怎么回事，年轻的扎格列欧斯？是给我的信息吗，真的吗？不过，我……破解不了里面的意思……它上面还带着我两个兄弟的印记，而且……好吧！看起来我们得把收到的信合在一起才行！

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Why, little sprout, young Zagreus... my grandson! I can scarce believe it, still! To think that, Kore, or... Persephone, my daughter... she had been with Foster-Brother Hades, all this time! A match I wouldn't have expected... or approved. That's why she left! Our blasted hearts do what they want.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 怎么了，小朋友，年轻的扎格列欧斯……我的外孙！我到现在还几乎不敢相信！想想看，科瑞，或者说……珀尔塞福涅，我的女儿……她这么长时间一来，一直和我的兄弟哈迪斯在一起！我恐怕是想不到的……也绝不会同意这桩婚事。所以她才会离开！我们的心真是自由不羁，想干什么就干什么。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: My little grandson, little sprout, I've thought... if my Persephone's alive, why then... this winter, hasn't it endured for long enough...? It's grown to have a certain stubbornness, but I... I am the goddess of the seasons, Zagreus. Perhaps it's time I changed them once again.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我的小外孙，小朋友，我想过……如果我的珀尔塞福涅还活着的话，那样的话……这场冬天是不是延续太久了……？它已经开始变得有点不肯消融了，不过我……我是掌控四季的女神，扎格列欧斯。或许，是时候改变季节了。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I've lifted the cold from the earth, much as I said I would, grandson. But, near your father's realm... I have decided it shall stay the way it is. Bereft of warmth. As a reminder to us all, about all this.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 外孙，就像我说的那样，我已经解除了人间的严寒。至于你父亲的国度附近……我决定还是让它保持原样。它会提醒我们所有人，失去温暖的世界会是什么样子。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: You bear the blessing of Poseidon, Zagreus? Someday I shall remind him of his place, and freeze his watery domain entirely.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你带着波塞冬的恩赐吗，扎格列欧斯？总有一天，我要把他的海洋全都冻住，给他好好上一课。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Athena has imparted you her wisdom, Zagreus? A simulacrum of the real thing, at any rate. True wisdom only comes with age, I think.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 雅典娜给予你她的智慧了吗，扎格列欧斯？不过在我看来，那些都只是冒牌货罢了，真正的智慧是靠岁月积累而来的。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: All of the love and beauty in the world can wither in a season, Zagreus. Remember that when next the goddess Aphrodite makes her promises.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 所有的爱与美都会在转瞬之间凋谢殆尽，扎格列欧斯。阿弗洛狄忒下次再和你保证什么的话，一定要记得这一点。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Lord Ares already got hold of you, has he? He's good at making mortals kill each other, yes. But he has utterly no knack for subtlety.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 阿瑞斯大人已经接触过你了，是吗？让凡人自相残杀他确实是一把好手，不过他也只是个莽夫罢了。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: The gentle Artemis already found you, Zagreus? She takes my orders well; one cannot blame her, for she'd have nothing to hunt if not for me.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 温柔的阿尔忒弥斯找过你了吧，扎格列欧斯？她很听我的话，这也难免。毕竟，要是我想和她过不去的话，她恐怕就没东西可狩猎了。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: You stumbled into Dionysus, Zagreus? One of these days I shall prevent his vineyards all from ripening; put to the test his carefree attitude.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你撞见迪奥尼索司了吧，扎格列欧斯？总有一天，我要让他那些葡萄园再也产不出葡萄，看他还怎么逍遥得起来。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: The mark of Chaos is upon you, isn't it? A force older than I! Yet one which you ought not trust so readily. No rhyme or reason to that one at all.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你身上带着卡俄斯的印记，是吗？他的力量比我还要古老啊！不过，你还是不能轻易信任他，因为那个家伙做事完全不讲道理。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Is that the bloodlike stain of pomegranate on you, Zagreus? A hardy fruit resistant to a winter's chill. How fascinating they survive, down there.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你身上那血渍一样的印记是石榴吗，扎格列欧斯？那种耐寒的水果能抵御严冬。它们居然在冥界也能生长，真是奇妙。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I don't often divulge such blessings as I am about to, Zagreus. Don't thank me for it, but make certain that you use my power well.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我要给你新的恩赐了，扎格列欧斯，我很少会给予他人这种恩赐。不必谢我，我只希望你能好好使用这股力量。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I have affection for you, little sprout. No need for reciprocity, but now I'll offer you the fiercest of my capabilities.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我很喜欢你，小朋友。现在，我要赐予你我最凶狠的能力了，不必回礼。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I must admit I have grown fond of you, young sprout; nevertheless, I shall not spoil you like some ill-mannered child.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我得承认我已经有点喜欢你了，小朋友。不过，我可不会像惯小孩一样惯着你。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: My, but you're as determined as my foster-brothers were, when my sisters and I stood with them 'gainst the Titans way back when.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 噢，不过你充满了决心，就像我的兄弟们以前那样。想当年，我和我的兄弟姐妹们团结一心，与泰坦大战。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Our family, why, I think we understand something of loss, now, don't we, Zagreus? Unlike the mortals on the surface. Always begging me for plenty. They'll get none. But as for you, I have a plethora to offer!

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 至于我们的家庭，我觉得，我们已经明白了什么叫做失去，不是吗，扎格列欧斯？地面上那些凡人只会伸手祈求，我是什么都不会给他们的。可你不一样，我会给你很多很多恩赐！

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: You are entirely too young to have had meaningful experience with loss, young Zagreus. Pray to me that you never have to learn.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你现在还小，还没经历过真正的失去，年轻的扎格列欧斯。向我祈祷吧，祈祷你永远不会体会到那种滋味。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: You live within the bosom of the earth, and know its warmth. But there is no such warmth up here, young Zagreus. You truly wish to feel the bitter cold of the outside? Then, here.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你生活在大地的怀抱之中，也明白这里有多么温暖。但是上面的世界可没有这种温暖，年轻的扎格列欧斯。你真的想感受外面的刺骨寒冷吗？那就来吧。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Someday, you'll gain the surface, Zagreus; and you shall see firsthand what mortalkind has wrought. You'll find it has some commonality with your domain.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 总有一天你会到达地面，扎格列欧斯。你会亲眼见证凡人们的所作所为，你会发现，上面的世界和这里有很多相似之处。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Motherhood's a curse, young Zagreus. Be thankful you're immune. You sprang from Nyx herself, or so I hear? I sprang from Theia, whoever she was. And I once bore a child, too. Long gone. A mother's work... isn't it such a waste?

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 身为人母是一种诅咒，年轻的扎格列欧斯，庆幸你永远不会受到这种诅咒吧。我听说，你是倪克斯所生？我是忒伊亚的后裔，不过我也不知道她是谁。我以前也有过一个孩子，而我的孩子早就不在了。这就是身为母亲要做的事情……真是徒劳，不是吗？

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Your father Hades and I share a common fate, each having lost a child fully grown; except that he's a hollow fool, whose child left! Whereas my daughter never would have. Ever!

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你的父亲哈迪斯与我命运相似，我们都失去了一位长大成人的孩子。不同的是，他是个没心没肺的白痴，连他的孩子都抛弃了他！可我的女儿绝不会这么做，绝对不会！

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Your father always had a sternness to him that his brothers lacked. Thought him a decent sort, comparatively anyway; though evidently he is no such thing.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你的父亲对自己很严格，这正是他的兄弟们所欠缺的。我还以为和其他人相比，他要更加体面正派一些了，但很显然是我错了。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Should you achieve your goal, and see this surface-world, Zagreus, I've but one bit of knowledge to impart: Don't ever fall for mortals. Use them if you must, but do not waste your love on those who waste away.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 如果你成功实现目标，到达了地面世界的话，我给你提一个醒，扎格列欧斯：永远不要和凡人走得太近。有必要的话，可以利用他们，但不要把你的爱浪费在这些日渐枯萎的人身上。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I have a brother, Helios, the Sun. A nonsense-talker with a flaming chariot. Why, he once told me that my Kore, that she went into that Underworld of yours! Preposterous. The clouds now blot him out entirely.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我有个兄弟叫赫利俄斯，是太阳神。他驾着火焰战车，满嘴胡话。他有一次居然告诉我，说科瑞来到了你们冥界！真是荒谬。现在乌云已经把他完全遮住了。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: This land is not unlike your own in certain ways. For, Helios the Sun has not shone down upon it for some time. How long, I really couldn't tell you, little sprout! Long enough for mortals to take notice, certainly.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 从某些方面来说，上面的世界和你们的世界也差不多，因为太阳神赫利俄斯已经有段日子没让太阳照耀大地了。至于多久，我真的不能告诉你，小朋友！我只能说，久到引起凡人们的注意了。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: My sisters Hestia and Hera surely would assist as well, young sprout. Except they and our foster-brothers haven't been getting along of late. Though as for me? I'll never leave this mountaintop of mine.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我的姐妹赫斯提亚和赫拉当然也会帮忙，小朋友，不过最近她们和我的兄弟们相处得不是太好。至于我吗？我永远不会离开我这座山顶。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: We all are willful children, are we not? I'm daughter to Hyperion, you know; a Titan so obscure and hated that Lord Zeus, he started calling me his birth-sister, so much did he dislike this bit of truth! And to get a rise out of me, too.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我们都是些任性的孩子，是吧？你也知道，我的父亲是许珀里翁，一个非常遭人厌恨的泰坦。那时候，就连宙斯大人都管我叫亲姐姐，看得出来他有多反感这个事实！他这么做，也是为了能让我振作起来。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: As seasons give to one another, so do generations, I suppose. Hyperion, my father? He'd not a one redeeming quality. My sisters and my foster-brothers and myself; this world owes us a debt for ridding it of him and his kind.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 四季不断更替，一辈一辈的人也是如此吧。至于许珀里翁，我的父亲？他是个一无是处的渣滓。我的姐妹们，兄弟们，还有我，我们把许珀里翁和他的族人从这个世界上铲除掉，这个世界欠我们一份恩情。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I ought to warn you that my foster-brother Zeus, he has just a disgusting sense of humor, little sprout. He'd have you think he sired half the countryside! I have to shudder at the very thought.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 至于我的表兄弟宙斯，我要给你提个醒，他有一种令人恶心的幽默感，小朋友。他会让你以为，他已经把一半的乡下姑娘都睡过了！我一想到这个就浑身难受。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: There's so much nonsense that the mortals say to one another of our family, Zagreus. How viciously the rumors spread! Whether from that oaf, Zeus, or likely from the mortal drunkard-poets with no better use of their limited time!

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 关于我们的家庭，凡间有很多不着边际的传闻，扎格列欧斯。流言蜚语传播得比什么都快！有的是宙斯那个白痴自己传的，还有的是喝多了的吟游诗人们传的，他们短暂的人生就不能干点更有用的事情吗！

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I warn you, Zagreus, best not to make attempts to grow much closer with me, thus. I'm much your elder, after all, and you're my little sprout. What say we keep it that way, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 所以，我得警告你，扎格列欧斯，你最好别想着和我拉近关系。我是你的长辈，对我来说，你只是个小嫩芽。我们保持现状就好，不是吗？

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I... I am so very moved, I... have a daughter once again. And... I've a grandson, too! I thought, I felt something when first I met you, but... I brushed it off. Just like a fleck of snow...

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我……我实在是太开心了，我……我的女儿又回来了，而且……我还有了个外孙！我觉得，我第一次见到你的时候就感觉到了什么，可是……我却忽视了它，就像掸掉了一片雪花一样……

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Someday, my little sprout, you'll gain the surface of your father's realm, and see my handiwork. Until such time, I'll come to your aid as I can. It's quite the entertaining pastime, honestly!

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 总有一天，我的小朋友，你会离开你父亲的领地，来到地表，然后看到我的杰作。在那之前，我会尽可能地帮助你。老实说，这样打发时间很有意思！

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: By the way, we had entirely a lovely time within your father's house, Grandson. And, to see Kore once again, it... warmed my heart. I'm beyond grateful that your mother's safe. And that you've an important job to do. Here, I shall help.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 顺便说一句，我们在你父亲的家里度过了一段相当美好的时光，外孙。而且能再次见到科瑞，我……我的心里感到很温暖。你的母亲安然无恙，我对此无比感激。你还有重要的事情要做是吧，来，我会帮你的。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I meant to tell you something, Grandson... you needn't have deceived the rest of us. You could have sent word that my daughter was with you down there, all along! Ah, but families are a complicated thing. Just swear that you'll be candid with us, next time.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我本打算和你说些事情，外孙……你不必欺骗其他人，你本可以说我的女儿就在冥界，一直和你们呆在一起！啊，不过家庭的事情总是很复杂。只要记得，下次对我们坦诚相待就好。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: You must visit us sometime up here, Grandson! I understand the surface hasn't been agreeable with you... though perhaps if not in this age, then the next, we shall have you over. It's brisk up here... but nice enough, I think.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 一定要记得来看看我们，外孙！我明白，地面上的世界可能并不适合你……不过，就算这段时间不来，以后也过来看看吧，我们都欢迎你。这里有点喧闹……不过我觉得还不错。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Young sprout, I cannot fully understand my daughter's choices, such as what she saw in your gloom-filled father to have eloped with him. But if you are the result, then she is clearly wiser than I estimated.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 小朋友，我还是不太能理解我女儿的选择。我不知道她看上了你那个满脸忧郁的父亲哪一点好，还选择和他私奔了。不过，看到你我才发现，她确实比我想象得要更有智慧。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I made mistakes raising your mother, sprout. When she was my Kore. I was blind to the possibility that she could have left me, but... I see it now. If you become a parent yourself, someday... may you listen more than I.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 在养育你母亲的过程中，我犯了不少错误，小朋友。当她还是我的科瑞的时候，我没想到她可能会离开我，也因此被蒙蔽了双眼，不过……我现在明白了。若你以后也为人父的时候……或许你会比我更擅长倾听。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: You tell my Kore... erm, Persephone, that is... the Queen! You tell her that her mother sends her warm regards. You tell her that. And you take care of her.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 替我告诉我的科瑞……呃，珀尔塞福涅，也就是……冥后！告诉她，她的母亲向她致以亲切的问候。替我告诉她这句话，照顾好她。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Grandson, my daughter Queen Persephone, she sent me the most precious message, courtesy of Hermes, as of late. I'm pleased to hear that you are getting on all right. Though, I know you're at work, so here!

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 外孙，最近我的女儿珀尔塞福涅拜托赫尔墨斯，给我发来了弥足珍贵的信，我很高兴听到你们一切都好。不过，我也知道你有事要忙，所以收下这个吧！

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: The Frostbitten Horn which you bear once overflowed. It holds a certain power still, of course. But never again shall mortalkind take it for granted.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你手上这支冰冻之角的神力曾经溢出去过。当然，它依然残留着相当的力量，但千万别让它再落到凡人手里。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: The heat has risen quite considerably there, is that not so? Then if my foster-brother's tampered with the temperature, I'll have to cool things off.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 这里也太热了吧，你说是不是？如果是我的兄弟把温度弄乱了，那我得把它降下来才行。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: The heat of your surroundings must be difficult to bear, my little sprout. It's fortunate I've just the thing for that.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你周边的高温一定很难忍吧，我的小朋友。好消息是，我刚好有办法解决这个问题。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: That chill sensation I detect must indicate that you are near the surface, Zagreus. If you can overcome the final challenges ahead, you soon shall see the long winter yourself.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我感觉很冷，扎格列欧斯，你一定离地表很近了。如果你能通过最终的挑战，就能亲眼见到漫长的寒冬了。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: That's Sister Hera's Heart-Seeker you have! The very weapon which she used to put our predecessors down. It hasn't lost its potency I see. Fear not, I shall not mention this to her, if I see her.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 是赫拉妹妹的索心弓！她就是用这把弓消灭了以前的神。看来它还没有失去力量，不过要是见到她的话，我不打算和她提这件事情。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Why, isn't that there Sister Hestia's oddly constructed armament you bear? She always was so predisposed to flame; I thought she'd never give it up! If it's to be in any hands, then may as well be yours.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 这不就是赫斯提亚姐姐那尊怪异的狮鹫坚炮吗？她就是喜欢玩火啊，我还以为她绝对不会丢弃这尊大炮呢！如果这尊尖炮一定要落在他人手中，那就不如归你所有了。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I scarcely can see... are those the Twin Fists that you bear, young sprout? I once made ample use of them myself, if you'll imagine it. Wielding the cold since has been adequate for me, but you? May you put them to work as I once did.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我几乎都认不出来了……这是双子之拳吧，小朋友？我以前经常用它，不知道你能不能想象得到。后来我发现，还是寒冰更适合我，希望你能跟我以前那样善用它。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Why, you've the look of one who has endured a terribly long winter, Zagreus! I trust you'll cling to life a little longer, now.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你的表情跟刚熬过一场严冬似的，扎格列欧斯！我觉得你应该还不会死。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I sense your grip on life is coming loose, young Zagreus. Now turn that cold you feel against your enemies.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我察觉到你生命的气息正在变弱，年轻的扎格列欧斯。将那死亡的冰冷转化为力量，对付敌人吧。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: You seem to be in dire need of some assistance, Zagreus. I think perhaps I have a bit to spare.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 看样子你现在急需帮助，扎格列欧斯。我想我现在应该可以帮点忙。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: You're in the winter of your current stretch of life, aren't you, Zagreus? Do try and live a little longer for me, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你的生命也已经进入寒冬了啊，扎格列欧斯。就算是为了我，也要活得久一点，好吗？

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: You waste away just like a common mortal, Zagreus. How rather unbecoming of a god.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你怎么能像凡人一样浪费自己的生命，扎格列欧斯？这和你神明的身份真不相称。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: The flame of life is easily extinguished by the cold, young Zagreus. Surely you feel the warmth within you giving way?

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 生命的火焰很容易就会被严寒吹熄，年轻的扎格列欧斯。你感到体内的温暖正在消失吗？

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Cold comfort for your terrible predicament, young Zagreus, but I am here.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 年轻的扎格列欧斯，虽然我帮不了你，但我会陪在你身边。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Last time I felt a chill like this was... on the surface, but, who...? Well, one way to find out. Then, in the name of Hades! Olympus, I accept this message!

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I understand, young Zagreus, that you would seek to leave that bitter darkness for this bitter cold? Quite honestly I fail to see why. But I'll aid your plight, why not? For I can offer plenty of assistance, and you soon shall grow fond of it, I think.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 上次我感觉这么冷的时候还是在……地表，但是，会是谁呢……？好吧，以哈迪斯之名，看来只有一种方法能弄清楚了！奥林匹斯，我收到这条消息了！

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我明白了，年轻的扎格列欧斯，你想摆脱这恼人的黑暗，进入无尽的严寒之中吗？我不明白你为什么要这么做，不过我还是乐意帮帮你。我可以提供很多帮助，你很快就会知道了。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I once had plentitudes of blessings I would offer readily, young Zagreus; but I am feeling not as generous of late.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 年轻的扎格列欧斯，曾经我有大量的恩赐可以随意慷慨予人，但是现在我却不想这样做了。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Did you detect perhaps a certain spirit-shaking chill within the air, young Zagreus?

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 感受到这让灵魂都瑟瑟发抖的严寒了吗，年轻的扎格列欧斯？

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Plenty of blessings left to go around; although, only for you, young Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 还有很多恩赐呢，不过都是专门为你准备的，年轻的扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Your enemies shall have no shelter from the cold whilst I am at your side, young Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 当我与你并肩作战时，你的敌人将在严寒之下无处可藏。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: There's something to the barrenness, where you reside; perhaps someday it shall be more like that up here.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你居住的地方一片荒芜是有原因的，也许某一天，那里会变得像上面的世界一样。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Your realm there is much like the wind-swept surface here. Mostly devoid of life, such as it's been of late.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你所在的国度有点像地表上被风扫过的样子，毫无生机，最近一直都是这样。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Olympus must seem like a distant paradise to you, young Zagreus; it is a frozen waste to me. But still, it's home.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 对你来说，奥林匹斯就像一个遥远的天堂，年轻的扎格列欧斯。对我来说，它就是一团被冻住的垃圾，但它起码是家。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Your foes shall more than catch cold by the time we're through, don't you agree, young sprout?

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你的敌人们此时的处境应该比着凉感冒严重的多，对不对，小朋友？

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: All those who stand opposed to you, why, we shall shatter more than their resolve, I think, young Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 对于那些你作对的人，我们要粉碎的可不仅仅是他们的决心了，年轻的扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: One of these seasons I suppose I ought to double-check the mortals haven't gone extinct without my intervention at each step.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 到了这种季节，我应该去检查一下凡人的处境。看看少了我的干预，他们是不是已经灭绝了。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: None can endure an everlasting winter's chill, young Zagreus; not even your father's lifeless servants there beneath the earth.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 没人可以挺过这样的无尽严冬，年轻的扎格列欧斯，就算是你父亲那些不死的仆从们也挺不过去。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: The seasons have a certain beauty to them, I suppose. Though struggle onward, and you needn't take my word for it.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 可能每个季节都有自己的美。努力前进吧，不用把我每句话都当真。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I've known your father and his brothers here for many seasons now; they bicker endlessly with me and one another.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 在许多季度以前，我就认识你的父亲和他的兄弟们了。他们要么没完没了地跟我斗嘴，要么互相吵架。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I have to tell you something, little sprout. I take cold comfort knowing that my foster-brother Hades is no better at his parenting than I.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我要告诉你一些事情，小朋友。听说我的表哥哈迪斯也不怎么会当父亲的时候，我松了一口气。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I'd gladly scour all your father's realm if doing so would free you from his clutches, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 如果这样做就能让你从你父亲手里解放的话，我非常乐意，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I'll have you know something, young Zagreus: The bitter cold and frost is just as inescapable as death itself.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 有件事情你得明白，年轻的扎格列欧斯：和死亡一样，刺骨的寒冷与冰霜也是无法逃脱的。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: The seasons turn relentlessly, without regard, and thusly should you doggedly push forward on your path.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 季节总是在无情地变化着，你要做的就是努力前进。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I shall bring desolation upon those who wrong you, little sprout.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我会让那些负你之人枯萎，小朋友。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I hope that you're aware how seldomly I give my blessing as of late, young Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 希望你知道，最近我几乎不再给别人我的恩惠了，年轻的扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: There's no escaping from the bitter cold, you know.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 没人能逃得过严寒。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Your adversaries soon shall know something of loss, I think.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你的敌人马上就会知道什么叫做失败。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Let us see to it your foes are left with nothing.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 让我们看着你的敌人灰飞烟灭吧。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: There shall be only souls for harvesting this day, I think, young Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 该收割灵魂了，年轻的扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: My warm regards, and all my blessings to you, little sprout.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 向你致以温暖的问候，以及我的恩赐，小朋友。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: The bitterness of cold and death go hand in hand, I do suppose.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我想，严寒和死亡总是携手并行的吧。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: When all is taken away, the cold yet remains, young Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 当一切都被夺走时，唯有严寒尚在，年轻的扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I am not feeling quite so generous of late, young Zagreus, but nevertheless: Choose.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我最近待人不是很慷慨，年轻的扎格列欧斯，不过无妨：选吧。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Your lifeless foes must foolishly believe they've nothing left to lose.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 那些早已失去生命的敌人，一定是误以为已经没什么可失去的了。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Go with my blessings, Zagreus; though you may take but one.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 带着我的恩赐上路吧，扎格列欧斯，不过你只能选一个。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Decay is the inevitable state of things; we are merely helping it along.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 对于世间万物来说，衰亡不可避免，我们只是加快了它的进度。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: The cold of Mount Olympus shall bring utter ruin on your enemies.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 奥林匹斯山的严寒将为你的敌人带来毁灭。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Death and cold, they are irrevocably bound together, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 死亡和严寒总是如影随形，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: The climate in those depths needs cooling, then, I take it, Zagreus?

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 这地底深处需要降降温了，是吧，扎格列欧斯？

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: You bring with you the season of decay, young Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你给这里带来了衰亡的季节，年轻的扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Your foes shall all wither before you like unwatered crops.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你的敌人会像干枯的庄稼一样在你面前凋萎。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: The frost eventually shall cover everything, young Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 冰雪终将覆盖一切，年轻的扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: You'll find that life gives way quite easily to cold, young sprout.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 生命很容易会被严寒摧垮，小朋友。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Look carefully upon my blessings, Zagreus, and take no more than one.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 仔细看看我给予的恩赐吧，扎格列欧斯，你只能选择一个。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I trust that harvesting dead souls is not unlike the harvest we have on the surface, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我觉得，收割死人的灵魂，和地面世界上的收割也没什么不同吧，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: You're like a little flame there in your father's realm; easy enough to spot.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 在你父亲的领地里，你就像一小团火焰一样，非常耀眼。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: It seems to me your foes are ripe for harvesting, young Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 看来你的敌人已经准备好被你收割了，年轻的扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Any who stand against you soon shall wither from the cold, young sprout.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 所有阻挡你的人，都将在严寒之下枯萎凋零，小朋友。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I seldom feel too generous of late, and yet for you, young Zagreus? Why not.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我最近没有什么慷慨助人的打算，不过对你就不一样了，年轻的扎格列欧斯。来吧。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I once offered the mortals generosities as this in much more copious supply.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我以前也曾慷慨地为凡人们提供恩惠，给他们的比现在还要多。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: It soon shall be exceptionally cold down in the Underworld, I think.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我想，这冥界用不了多久就会变得冰寒刺骨了。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I'd never give out blessings such as this to merely anyone, I hope you know.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 希望你知道，我从来没有这样给予过什么人恩赐。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I've quite the harvest here from which to choose, my little sprout.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我这里收成颇丰，小朋友，你选一个吧。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Soon, the season there shall turn exceptionally cold, young Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 很快气候就会变得严寒刺骨了，年轻的扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: It is particularly cold outside, today; and soon it shall be so in there for you.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 今天外面非常寒冷，你那里很快也会这样。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Well, my little sprout, we shall have to get you through this winter's cold.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 嗯，我的小朋友，我们会帮你熬过这场严冬。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: A crisp and pleasant winter's evening to you, Zagreus; now, here.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你好，扎格列欧斯，真是凉爽宜人的冬夜啊，来吧。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: My finest winter blessings to you, little sprout.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 这是我最好的冬季恩赐，小朋友。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Well, Grandson, it's growing rather cold, don't you agree?

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你看，外孙，最近还真是挺冷的，你说呢？

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I'm here to ease some of your burdens, my young sprout. That's what we grandmothers are for.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我很乐意减轻你的负担，我的小朋友，这就是我们外婆的职责。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I trust you're keeping yourself warm enough in all of this, Grandson?

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我相信你穿得很暖和，足以抵挡这一切严寒，是吧，外孙？

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: When all this is over, please do come and visit us sometime, Grandson.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 等这一切结束之后，一定要时不时地来看看我们，外孙。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I'd tell you not to work too hard, Grandson, although your family is in need of more hard-working sorts.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我希望你工作别太卖力了，外孙，不过你的家人正需要能努力工作的人手。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Foul weather's on the forecast for your foes, Grandson.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我会在你的敌人头上降下狂风暴雪，外孙。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Don't let my foster-brother bully you about, you hear, Grandson?

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 可别被我的兄弟们欺负了，知道了吗，外孙？

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Let's cool down that hot head of yours a bit, why don't we, Grandson?

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 不如咱们来让你冷静冷静吧，你说呢，外孙？

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: My best regards to Queen Persephone and your lord father, little sprout. You keep it up.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我向冥后珀尔塞福涅与你的父亲致以最诚挚的问候，小朋友，再接再厉。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I trust your mother Queen Persephone is faring well if she has as fine a son as you, young Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 如果有你这样的儿子的话，年轻的扎格列欧斯，我相信你的母亲珀尔塞福涅一定能过得很好。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Your mother sends you all her love from Mount Olympus, Grandson.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你的母亲从奥林匹斯山向你致以满心的爱，外孙。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: All the best from Queen Persephone, young sprout. She misses you, you know.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 珀尔塞福涅向你致以最诚挚的祝福，小朋友。你知道吧，她很想你。

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Persephone is doing well here on Olympus, Zagreus. You ought to visit, too, sometime.

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 珀尔塞福涅在奥林匹斯山上一切都好，扎格列欧斯，你有空也应该来看看。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Good Lady Demeter, you've shown me warmth and generosity, and I am very grateful for it. Please, accept this as a small token of my appreciation.

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: An offering well suited for the season, there, young Zagreus! In turn, as you are honorable and obedient, you'll have from me what the mortals have not.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 得墨忒尔女士，您带给了我温暖与慷慨，我非常感激。请务必接受这件代表感谢之情的小小薄礼。

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 这件礼物非常适合现在的季节，年轻的扎格列欧斯！你是如此可敬、听话，作为回报，你会得到凡人所未曾得到的东西。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: A little offering for you, good Lady Demeter. I'm deeply grateful for your willingness to aid me in all this.

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I must acknowledge and accept your thoughtful gift of Nectar, Zagreus; would that the mortals showed deference thus.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这是给您的小礼物，得墨忒尔女士。对于你给予的帮助，我深表谢意。

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我接受满怀你感激之情的蜜露，扎格列欧斯，希望凡人们也能有这种尊重。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: May this small offering bring you some joy there on Olympus, Lady Demeter. Thank you for all your help.

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: A conscientious gift, my little sprout; and I am grateful for your generosity. A bit of Nectar cuts straight through the cold, I say.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 希望这件不起眼的礼物能为您在奥林匹斯山上的生活带来愉悦，得墨忒尔女士。感谢您的帮助。

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 真是一份用心良苦的礼物，我的小朋友。很感谢你的慷慨，一瓶蜜露足够斩断这严寒了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Your power and your wisdom has been of such help, good Lady Demeter. I'm honored, and this is the least I can do in exchange.

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: I was quite certain that the youth today was lacking any sort of tactfulness, young Zagreus. For once I'm thankful to be proven wrong.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 您的神力和智慧对起了很大帮助，我的好女士得墨忒尔。我很荣幸，这是我最起码该做的。

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 我还以为现在的年轻人都没什么头脑可言呢，年轻的扎格列欧斯，事实证明我错了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Lady Demeter, I am forever in your debt for the affection that you've shown to me, and for the power you've bestowed.

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: The everlasting winter means that Nectar's been in rather short supply; that you would think of me for such an offering is duly noted, then.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 得墨忒尔女士，你给了我那么多爱，还赐予了我那么多力量，我永远欠你的情。

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 由于这无尽的寒冬，蜜露也不太够了。即便如此你还是想起了我，我很感激。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I often remember that there's sweetness in this world only by your grace, Lady Demeter. I'm thankful that we've grown closer through all this.

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: You would make further offerings to me? Even though I have made quite clear I've lately not been at my charitable best, young Zagreus? You're either naive or you're much too kind, or both.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我经常会想起，只有有了你的恩赐，这个世上才会有甜蜜和美好，得墨忒尔女士。能与你变得越来越亲密，我感到很开心。

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 你还会送我礼物吗？虽然我说的很清楚，但最近我手头的确不太宽裕，你知道吗，小扎格列欧斯？你要么是太天真，要么就是太过善良，或者既天真，又善良。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, Grandmother? If you don't mind I call you that. Knowing we're related like this fills me with pride. Your power over life... I think I've some of it in me! And I could not have come this far without your help. Please, for everything... this is for you.

en.speaker: Demeter
en.text: Why, Grandson, how you honor me, with this... I am so very grateful that we've met, and that... you're you, if that makes any sense at all. I have my sisters, but... I'd no one else, for very long, indeed.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，外婆？希望你不介意我这么叫你。知道你是我的亲人之后，我感到非常骄傲。你掌控生命的力量……我想我也拥有一部分这样的力量！而且，如果不是因为有你的帮助，我也不可能走到这么远。请收下这份心意吧……感谢你做的一切。

zh-CN.speaker: 得墨忒尔
zh-CN.text: 哎呀，外孙，你这样，我实在是太荣幸了……我很感激能遇到你，而且……你就是你，不知道你能不能听得懂。我也有姐妹，可是……除了她们之外，我始终是孤身一人，已经一个人呆了太久了。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: What's going on, there, Coz? Can I call you Coz? Got something here for you should make your battles to the death end that much quicker!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你怎么了，兄弟？我可以叫你兄弟吗？我有东西给你，可以帮你更快收拾这些亡灵！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Sorry, boss, my pop had pressing matters to attend to. But I'm here! Relaying you that message, and relaying this.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 对不起，老大，我父亲有些急事要处理。但我在这里！我把消息传递给你，你再传递出去。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Here to tell you that Poseidon's on his way, boss. Sometimes he is a little slow. But you'll meet up with him again eventually!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我来是想告诉你，波塞冬已经在路上了，老大。有时，他速度有点慢。但最后，你还是会遇到他的！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Expecting someone else, there, boss? A certain half-sister of mine perchance? Well, tough break, I got here first. Want one of these, or not?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你在等人吗，老大？或许是我某个同父异母的姐妹？好吧，真倒霉，我先到了。要不要来一个？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Soon as I heard you were looking to see Ares, boss, I got here as fast as I could! He's never going to beat me. Much less in all that armor.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我一听说你在找阿瑞斯，老大，我就尽快赶到了这里！他永远追不上我。更不用说穿着那些护甲了。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Aphrodite said she's running just a little late, Coz, though I'm sure you understand. Besides, I'm here! In spirit anyhow.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 阿弗洛狄忒说她会晚点到，兄弟，但我相信你明白这是怎么回事。再说，我还在这里！某种精神上的支持。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Wanted to let you know my sister Artemis is out looking for you. You should be running into her in any chamber, now!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我本想告诉你，我妹妹阿尔忒弥斯正在外面找你。你现在应该可以在任何一个密室中碰到她！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Afraid that Dionysus couldn't be here for you, boss. Though punctuality has never been one of his stronger suits.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 恐怕迪奥尼索司不会来找你，老大。尽管守时从来不是他的强项。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: That chill you were expecting in the air, that wasn't Demeter this time, here, boss! No, that was just me whisking to you in a flash. Makes for a little pleasant breeze I think!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 感觉到空气中的凉爽了吧，这次可不是得墨忒尔弄出来的了，这儿，老大！啊，刚刚那应该只是我疾驰而过，带起来了一点宜人的微风吧！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You did it, Coz! And by it I'm referring to the act of beating down my seemingly invincible boatman associate, who fancies himself pretty tough as Underworld deities go! He wasn't sure you had it in you, and if I may be so bold, neither was I!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你成功了，兄弟！我指的是，你打败了我那个看起来根本不可战胜的划船同伴，他差不多是冥界神明里最能打的了！他之前恐怕是没想到你居然这么有能耐。老实说，我之前也没想到！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hey looking like you're getting some good use out of that fancy plume of yours! Keep going like that, maybe someday you'll be half as quick as me!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，看起来你很好地利用了你华丽的羽毛！继续保持，也许有一天你可以达到我一半的速度！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: I got a keen eye, boss, so I happened to notice that you've got a certain tooth you're carrying about. Know you're from the land of the dead and all, but don't you think that comes across as just a little odd?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我的眼神很不错，老大，我刚好注意到你身上带着一枚牙齿。我知道你是从死者的世界来的，可你不觉得这实在是有点太怪了吗？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Heard that you finally got out of there, Coz! Big congratulations due for that: Congrats! The secret's safe with me, of course! The others here, they think you're still at it. Though, I guess you are!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我听说你终于逃出那个地方了，兄弟！我得好好恭喜你一下：恭喜啦！当然了，你的秘密我是不会说出去的！其他人以为你还在努力逃脱呢，不过，你看起来确实就像是在努力逃脱！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: I heard a certain someone's back at home with you down there now, Coz! I'd call it wonderful news, except it isn't news, at least not yet! Though if the time comes that you want to spread the word, just give the signal here!

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: So you get to keep breaking out of there, time after time, so that your father can keep finding ways to make it even harder to escape? Something like that? Sounds like an interesting assignment, Coz!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我听说某个人回家了，在冥界陪着你了，兄弟！我觉得这是个好消息，只不过它还没成为消息，至少现在还算不上！不过如果你打算把这个消息传开的话，给我个信号就行了！

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 所以说，你一次一次逃出这个地方，这样你的父亲就能找到办法，让这个地方变得更加难以逃脱，是吗？这份工作听起来可真有意思，兄弟！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I get to be the messenger this time. In the name of Hades! Olympus, this is an official message! Lord Hermes? Got here as quickly as I could.

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Why, that looks like you've got a message just for me, this time, how special is that, boss? Some sort of invite from the looks of things. You sure that I'm supposed to have this, seeing as I'm not officially involved?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这次要轮到我来送信了。以哈迪斯之名！奥林匹斯山，这是一份官方来信！赫尔墨斯大人在吗？马上赶到这里吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 哎呀，看起来，这次像是你有信要给我啊，有什么特别的吗，老大？看起来像是邀请函之类的东西。你确定这封信是要给我的吗？是觉得我没有正式参与进来吗？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Got to tell you, Coz, that was a real something of a feast back your place! A little awkward, having to pretend we just met, but hey, I'm an Olympian! Means I can posture with the best of them. Good times, Coz! Glad it all worked out.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我得告诉你，兄弟，你那里举行的那场盛宴实在是太棒了！咱们得假装是第一次见面，这件事有点让人尴尬，不过嘿，我可是奥林匹斯神啊！这意味着我想装就能装得很像。总之是段美好的时光，兄弟！很高兴一切都顺利。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Afraid your regularly scheduled Olympian could not be here right now, because I'm that much faster, boss!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你期待的那位奥林匹斯之神恐怕是来不了了，因为我先到了，老大！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You might have been expecting someone else, here, boss. But I just couldn't help beating them to the punch this time!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 或许你想叫的人不是我，老大，可我就是忍不住想赶在他们之前帮你的忙！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Got here just as quickly as I could, Coz. Which turns out to be quite a bit faster than my relatives!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我尽可能快地赶过来了，兄弟。看来我比我的亲戚们要快一些啊！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: I'm sure that keepsake that you brought will come in handy soon enough, there, boss!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我敢肯定，你带来的那件信物很快就能派上用场了，老大！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: My relatives are normally quite quick to heed the call of anybody bearing one of their keepsakes! Huh!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 通常来说，我的亲戚们很快就会注意到有人戴着他们的信物！哈！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: I may not be the god you're looking for right at the moment, boss, but I will get you on your way to them in no time here!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 或许你想找的神明并不是我，老大，但我马上就能带你去见你要找的那个！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You heard already from my pop, haven't you, Coz? Wonderful guy. Don't get to spend a lot of time together, though! You know how that is. Well, see you!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你听说我父亲的消息了，是吗，兄弟？我的好哥哥。不过，不要花太多时间在一起！你知道这是怎么回事。好吧，再见！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You know, Coz, my pop never gives his lightning blessings to me! He's quite invested in what happens to you, isn't he?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 说真的，兄弟，我老爸从来都没给过我他的闪电祝福！他真的很在乎你的处境，不是吗？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Want to bring you in on something, boss. Reason that Uncle Poseidon got to you before I did is, I let him. He's under the impression he's as spry as ever! Hah!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我想告诉你一个消息，老大。波塞冬叔叔之所以能在我之前先找到你，是因为我故意放水了。他还以为是他自己宝刀未老呢！哈！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: So then Athena's looking out for you, that's good, that's good! She likes to put a lot of thought and stuff in everything, it's all a little much, if you ask me!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 所以，雅典娜是对你有所提防的，很好，很好！她喜欢在每件事上都花很多心思，如果你问我，我会说她有点过于谨慎了！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You know who keeps me awful busy, Coz? Ares. Nothing like a good old war amongst the mortals to create demand for lots and lots of messages to go around!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道是谁让我这么忙吗，兄弟？那就是阿瑞斯。没有什么比一场人类之间的古老战争更能让信息满天飞！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Did Artemis manage to locate you already, boss? She's pretty good at that, I have to say. I'm faster! But she's fast, she's pretty fast, all right.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 阿尔忒弥斯找到你了吗，老大？我不得不说，她很擅长找人。我更快了！但是她速度也很快，相当快。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Aphrodite's really something, don't you think so, Coz? Normally I'd stop for no one here. But when it comes to her, exceptions must be made!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 阿弗洛狄忒真的很了不起，你不这么认为吗，兄弟？通常，我不会为任何人在这里停留。但说到她，我肯定会破例！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You ever get the feeling life's been moving all too quickly for you, boss? Well Dionysus doesn't, as you're probably aware. Throws quite a feast, though!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你有没有感觉生活节奏太快了，老大？你可能知道，迪奥尼索司并没有这种感觉。不过，这可真是一场盛宴！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Been downright chilly up here lately, Coz! We've Demeter to thank for that! Me, I try to stay out of her way, she doesn't think I'm of much help to her. Although I'm sure she's warmed to you at least!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 最近这里突然变得好冷啊，兄弟！应该是得墨忒尔搞的鬼吧！至于我嘛，我尽可能地打算离她远点，因为她觉得我对她派不上用场。不过我敢肯定，她对你还是很温和的！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Say, isn't that your father's blessing on you, Coz?! I almost can't believe it, but you've done such a good job of things, how could he not approve?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我说，你身上的不就是你父亲的祝福吗，兄弟？！我简直都不敢相信了。不过想想看，你把事情都做得这么好，他又怎么能不支持你呢？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Whoa, what's good, there, Coz? Though, who am I kidding, we can cut the small talk. I don't mind. I interrupt my brothers and my sisters all the time!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 哇，有什么好消息吗，兄弟？不过，怎么可能有好消息，别闲聊了。我这人脾气急，我总是打断兄弟姐妹们的话！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Boss, you've probably caught yourself thinking: Hermes sure is quick! So how come it took so long for him to show up in the first place? Well, I'm afraid that's not for you to know. But! It's not because I was late. Not late for anything.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 老大，你可能会想：既然赫尔墨斯跑得这么快，那他怎么这么久才出现呢？嗯，这件事的原因恐怕就不是你该知道的了。不过！这绝对不是因为我来晚了，我这辈子就没晚过。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hey, uh, could you do a little favor for me, Coz? My brothers, sisters, family, and whatnot, they're unaware I'm working with you, here. It's no big deal, but let's keep it that way for now. All right?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，呃，兄弟，能帮我个忙吗？我的兄弟姐妹、家人、亲属们，他们不知道我和你有联系。没什么大不了的，继续保持联系，好吗？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Happened to be in the area, boss! Seeing as the mortal folk up here keep dying off, and someone's got to bring their souls to your domain, now, don't they.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 老大，我只是恰好路过这里而已！因为这里的凡人不断死去，所以现在必须有人把他们的灵魂带到你的领地。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Know that saying 'don't be hasty', boss? That comes from me. I swear! A little way to stave off competition, masquerading as the wisdom of a sage. Those stupid mortals will buy anything!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道欲速则不达这句话吗，老大？这句话就是我说的，我是说真的！我把这句话说得像是至理名言一样，这样就能免得有人比我还快了。那些愚蠢的凡人真是什么话都信！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Not that I really know exactly what you're up to, Coz, but! If I did, I don't think anybody on Olympus is aware of it. Or, if they are, they're keeping their mouths shut. The same as me!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我不太清楚你到底有什么打算，兄弟！不过就算我知道，我猜奥林匹斯山的众神也没留意到。就算他们已经留意到了，也肯定谁都不会告诉。换做是我，我也会这么做！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You ever wonder how I got this fast, Coz? Lots of practicing, I'll tell you that! And being born unnaturally quick, I guess!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你有没有想过我为什么能跑得这么快，兄弟？实话告诉你，秘诀在于不断地练习！当然，这可能和我一生出来就跑得飞快也有关系吧！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Once took a skinny little chap down to the Underworld, got the business end of a sharp spear, he did! He had it coming, though, a lot of lying, cheating, and the like. Last that I heard, he's still making his amends down there. Eh!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 有一次，我带着一个骨瘦如柴的小家伙去冥界，结果被他拿长矛给刺了一下！他确实是个不错的家伙，不过也是个撒谎大王，一句真话都没有。我上一次听说他的时候，他还在那里圆他编出来的谎呢，呵！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Boss, I know you've heard a certain rumor from a very skinny individual who's uninclined to move. You best keep that one to yourself, all right? Or else our jig is up, and your father wouldn't like that, nor would you. So, cheers!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 老板，我知道你从某个不愿意动弹的懒骨头那里听说了某个传言，不过你最好别和其他人说，好吗？否则我们就要有麻烦了。你的父亲是不会喜欢这样的，你也不会喜欢。所以说，你懂的吧！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Say, you're in good with what's-his-name, the one who gave you his lucky tooth? So he's an all-right sort, then. Has to be, if you put up with him!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 那个给你幸运牙齿的家伙，看来你们相处得不错，是吗？看来他为人其实没那么差嘛。不过如果你打算和他混在一起，你也只能这么想了。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: So, now you've found me out, haven't you, Coz? Heard from the big boat-man himself. Well, good! We're pleased to be of service. And we've got a lot of dirt on you, so you be sure to keep our secrets, too. All right?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 哎呀，你发现我了，是吧，兄弟？你是听那个大个子船夫亲口说的吧。没问题！我们很愿意为你服务。而且，我们也知道很多关于你的秘密，所以我们的秘密你可千万别告诉别人。好吗？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: So my professional associate, the fearsome boatman on the River Styx? You got to know him pretty well in all of this, right, Coz? Hard getting through to him, I know, but his heart's in the right place! It's why I'm working with him, after all this time!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 所以，我那位专业的同事，冥河上令人生畏的船夫。经历了这么多事情，你已经和他很熟了，是吧，兄弟？我知道和他交流可能会很费劲，但他的心始终都在做正确的事情！这就是为什么这么长时间以来，我一直都和他共事！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Heard you've been seeing the Fury, Megaera, Coz? Got the impression she was quite a handful, though I guess the same can probably be said of you, there, huh? You two have fun!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我听说你最近很喜欢去见复仇女神墨纪拉，是吗，兄弟？我感觉她是个出类拔萃的家伙，不过你也一样是个出类拔萃的家伙，是吧？祝你们两个玩得开心！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: I can't believe you got into a fight with my professional associate, you daft or something, Coz? Just about everybody that I know, they're all at least a little bit afraid of that one and his boat, yet you think you can take him, huh?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 真不敢相信，你居然和我那个专业伙伴打起来了。你是疯了还是傻了，兄弟？我认识的所有人，几乎都多多少少怕那个家伙，可你却觉得你能打得过他，是吗？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: So you took on my good professional associate, is that right, Coz? And you beat the big boatman himself! I knew you were pretty tough, but not that tough! Impressive work! He's impressed, too. He isn't even mad!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 所以说，你和我那个专业的伙伴打了一架，是吗，兄弟？而且你还把他打赢了！我早就知道你是个狠角色，但没想到你居然这么厉害！真了不起！当然，他也很厉害。他甚至一点都不生你的气！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hey, uh, so I kind of placed a bet with the old boatman, my associate that is, that you could beat him in a fight, twice in a row! No pressure, or anything, but just in case you prove me right one of these days, I would appreciate it, Coz!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，呃，我算是和那个老船夫打了个赌吧，我是说我的同事。我赌你能连续两次打赢他！不要觉得有压力什么的。不过，万一你能证明我的眼光没错的话，那我一定会很感激你的，兄弟！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Message from Olympus for you, boss! It says, 'It sure is nice up here upon this mountain, not having to escape the Underworld! Come join us soon, won't you?'

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 这是来自奥林匹斯山的消息，老大！它是这样说的，“在这座山上真是太好了，不用逃离冥界！快来加入我们，好吗？”

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Message for you, boss. It says, 'You're rather slow. If only somebody could help you out with that.' Huh, fancy that, what a coincidence!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 这是给你的信，老大，上面是这么写的：“你太慢了。要是有人能帮你解决这个问题就好了。”哈，真巧，我不就在这里嘛！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Got you a message, Coz. Says here, ahem: 'Hurry up and get out of there already.' It's from the surface of the earth, says so right here.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我给你捎来一个口信，兄弟。它是这样说的，啊哼：“快一点，赶快离开那里。”这封信来自凡界，它说的一点都没错。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Another message here! It says, 'One small spoon dried oregano, two spoons extra virgin olive oil, one large onion, minced, a dash of salt to taste,' wait, this isn't for you. Though you should try it sometime if you ever make it out!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 又来了一条消息！上面说：“一勺干牛至，两勺初榨橄榄油，一只大洋葱，捣碎，加少许盐”，等等，这不是给你的。不过如果你哪天成功逃出去，倒是可以试试。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Message for you, Coz, it says, 'On behalf of all Olympus, we would like for you to know that was a right good bottle of Ambrosia that you offered to the god of travel, Hermes, who appreciated every drop.' Sincerely, me!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 这是给你的信，兄弟，上面写着：“谨代表奥林匹斯众神，我想告诉你，你之前献给给旅行之神赫尔墨斯的仙馔密酒，他很喜欢，喝得一滴都不剩。”写信人就是我！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Another message for you, Coz, this one says, 'Hey, mate! If you ever do make it up here up on this mountaintop for whatever reason, we should hang out, all right? I can show you around.' Your friend, Hermes.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 又有一封信要给你了，兄弟，信上说：“嘿，朋友！如果你真的能登上奥林匹斯山，那我们一定得好好聚聚，好吗？我可以带你参观这个地方。”你的朋友，赫尔墨斯。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You know, boss, just between us? Out of all special delivery recipients I've had over the ages, here, I've got to say, you're the most interesting one!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 这句话我只跟你说，老大。我这么多年送过很多份特别快递，但在所有的收件人中，你是最有意思的一个！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You know, Coz, all this time that I've been bussing souls across the borders of your father's land, it's good to have the chance to help somebody out the other way!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道吗，兄弟，一直以来我都在你父亲掌管的领地为亡灵奔波，能有机会帮助别人摆脱困境真是太好了！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hey, Coz, you're now well accustomed to our little chats, but I want you to level with me here. You're the boss, if you prefer, I would be happy to shut up, no harm no foul. Just give the signal, hey?

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hermes_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Perish the thought, Lord Hermes. It's been great hearing from you from time to time.

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Well, all right, boss. Just making sure that I'm not interrupting anything!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Now that you mention it, Lord Hermes, yes, let's keep our interactions nice and quick.

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: I hear you, boss, we'll cut straight to the chase next time, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，兄弟，你现在已经习惯了我们的聊天，但我想听你的实话。你是老大，如果你愿意的话，我很可以闭嘴，没关系。只是给我传递消息，嗯？

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: Hermes_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 赫尔墨斯大人，别瞎想了。能时不时收到你的来信真是太好了。

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧，老大。我只是想确定我没有打断任何事情！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 既然你提到了，赫尔墨斯大人，是的，希望我们能有事说事，节省大家的时间。

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我听到了，老大，下次我们就开门见山地说。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Ahem! Pardon the interruption, boss. You let me know if you prefer that I pipe up again next time, more like I used to!

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hermes_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I miss hearing from you, Hermes. Let's carry on like we did before.

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hah, sure thing, boss. It's good to have a chat from time to time!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Appreciate you checking in, Lord Hermes. I think we should keep at it like we have been, nice and quiet.

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: No problem whatsoever, boss. Just checking in.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 啊哼！对不起打扰了，老大。如果你希望下次我能像以前一样加快速度，直接告诉我就可以！

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: Hermes_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我想念你的来信，赫尔墨斯。让我们像以前那样保持联系。

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 哈，没问题，老大。偶尔聊聊天真好！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 谢谢你的关心，赫尔墨斯。我觉得我们应该一直这样保持下去，美好又平静。

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 没问题，老大。只是报到一下。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Thought I'd check in again real quick, there, boss. You want my witty conversation next time, or straight to the Boons?

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hermes_OfferText03

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know, yes, let's go back to having witty conversation from you, Hermes. That sounds great.

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hah, good! I like these little chats! Take care, now, boss.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Straight to the Boons, Lord Hermes. We both appreciate cutting straight to the chase.

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: I get it, boss. Words are too slow, aren't they. Won't bother you again word-wise, but I'll be seeing you!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我想我会很快再报到的，老大。下次你想让我谈天说地，还是想直接获得恩赐？

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: Hermes_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是的，你知道，谈天说地，赫尔墨斯。听起来不错。

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 哈，很好！我喜欢这些聊天！现在，当心点，老大。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 直接给我恩赐，赫尔墨斯大人。我们都喜欢直接切入主题。

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我明白了，老大。你说话太慢了，不是吗。以后就长话短说，我还是会和你见面的！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Thought I'd check in again real quick, there, boss. You want my witty conversation next time, or straight to the Boons?

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hermes_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Definitely witty conversation, Lord Hermes. Boons are more than welcome after that.

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hah! Good, I like these little chats! Take care, now, boss.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Straight to the Boons, Lord Hermes. We both appreciate cutting straight to the chase.

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: I get it, boss. Words are too slow, aren't they. Won't bother you again word-wise, but I'll be seeing you!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我想我会很快再报到的，老大。下次你想让我谈天说地，还是想直接获得恩赐？

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: Hermes_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 当然要听你谈天说地啦，赫尔墨斯大人。在那之后遇上恩赐可就再好不过了。

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 哈，很好！我喜欢这些聊天！现在，当心点，老大。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 直接给我恩赐，赫尔墨斯大人。我们都喜欢直接切入主题。

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我明白了，老大。你说话太慢了，不是吗。以后就长话短说，我还是会和你见面的！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Met your father face to face only the one time, Coz. Despite rendering services to him for quite a while. Memorable experience, I'll give it that! Seems like he's not done anything with all the messages my side keeps sending him.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我只亲眼见过你父亲一次，兄弟。尽管我为他服务了很长一段时间。我会说，那是段难忘的经历！似乎他对我传达的消息一直无动于衷。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You're pretty close with Thanatos, aren't you, boss? We don't often run in the same lanes, though our duties sometimes intersect a bit. Odd chap. Seems good at what he does, though!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你和塔纳托斯关系很亲近，不是吗，老大？尽管我们的职责有时有些交叉，但我们从来都不走同一条路。他是个奇怪的家伙。不过，他似乎很擅长自己的工作！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Saw Thanatos again lately, here, boss, and want to tell you, almost looked as though he cracked a smile when he mentioned you! Never seen anything like that with him!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 老大，我上次在这里又遇到了塔纳托斯，我想告诉你，在提到你的时候他露出了笑容！从没见过他这样子！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: I hear you're close with Orpheus down there, you get the chance, you tell him I said hey! He's pretty decent with that lyre of his, last time I checked.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我听说你在下面和俄耳甫斯关系不错。如果有机会的话，替我向他问声好吧！我上次见他的时候，他弹里拉琴的技术可相当不错。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hey boss, in all your travels there, you happen to run into a lass by name Eurydice? Hope she's all right! I feel bad because we didn't get a proper send-off last we met.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，老大，你去过这么多地方，有没有遇到过一个叫欧律狄刻的姑娘？我希望她一切都好！上次见她的时候，我都没好好和她道别，我感觉很过意不去。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: I caught wind you found Eurydice down there, that's great! Long as she's on the up and up, I can eject her from the tiny worry center of my mind.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我听说你已经见到欧律狄刻了，这真是太棒了！只要她一切都好，我就不用总是惦记着她的安危了。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: That's quite a nice Bone Hourglass you got, there, boss! So you're in good with my professional associate, as well. A real gentleman!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你的骨头沙漏真不错，老大！所以你和我的工作伙伴关系也很好。真是一个真正的绅士！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Why, look at you, there, boss! I recognize that fancy plume you got! Just an iota of my speediness in there, but still! Much more than most can do.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，看看你，老大。我认得你华丽的羽毛！虽然比我的速度差的很远，但还是可以的！还是比大多数人的速度快得多。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Whoa, what's gotten into all those lifeless wretches that you're always fighting with down there? They're really moving lately! Whatever's made them go all out, it wasn't me!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 哇，你在冥界对付的那些暗灵到底是怎么想的？他们最近活动真的很频繁！也不知道他们在拼个什么，但绝对不是因为我！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Got all your father's lifeless wretches hot and bothered, going all out all because of that Forced Overtime condition of his, isn't that right, Coz? Well, if they're interested in getting things done quickly, I am sure you can oblige them in a bit!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你父亲那些死气沉沉的暗灵都变得全力以赴了，这都是因为你父亲强迫他们加班，是这样吧，兄弟？ 好吧，如果他们都打算赶快把工作解决掉的话，那我敢说，你肯定也能把他们都解决掉！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Looks like those lifeless wretches you're contending with down there are really on the move this time around, aren't they, boss? Oh, well, you're faster still, I'm sure!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 看起来，你要对付的那群死气沉沉的暗灵这次是来真的了，是吧，老大？哦，别担心，论动作还是你要更快一些，这点我敢肯定！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Somebody's on a tight deadline, I take it, Coz? Courtesy of your father's Pact, well, you believe me, I know how that is, so I won't keep you, just keep moving, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜，某个人的时间很紧促啊，是吧兄弟？这都是你父亲的契约搞的鬼。我知道被时间追着跑是什么滋味，所以我也不耽误你了。赶紧前进吧，好吗？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: I realize you're on a tight deadline, there, boss, so let's dispense with all unnecessary chit-chat here and get you on your merry way, posthaste!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道你的时间很近，老大，所以咱们就别说那些没用的了，让我赶紧送你上路吧！一路顺风！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You racing against time to keep things interesting, or what, there, boss? Turns out that time goes pretty quick. I like racing against it, too!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你现在得争分夺秒，这可真有意思，是吧，老大？说实话，时间流逝得相当快，我也喜欢和时间赛跑！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hah! Can't help but notice you've been timing yourself, boss! Good habit that. Keep an eye on the time, you'll get faster and faster! Not as fast as me, mind.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 哈！我发现你一直在为自己计时，老大！真是个好习惯啊。注意时间，你会越来越快的！提醒一下，还是没法跟我比。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You know, Coz, since you're timing yourself, case you haven't noticed, doesn't count against you when we stop to have these chats! Insisted on that little rule myself.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道吗，兄弟，因为你在给自己计时，所以你没注意到，当我们停下来聊天的时候，这个时间并没有计算在内！这是我自己坚持的小规则。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hey, you stopped timing yourself, boss, everything all right? If that's not a cry for help, well, I don't know what is. Um, here!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，老大，别给自己计时了，一切都好吗？如果那不是呼救声，那我也不知道那是什么了。嗯，在这里！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Good, boss, I can see you're clocking yourself once again. Little term I like to use, means beating yourself up whilst keeping time!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 很好，老大，我看到你又在为自己计时了。我喜欢用这个词，是想要提醒自己注意时间！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Look, Coz, if you aren't always going to time yourself, that is a choice of lifestyle I have to respect. And learn to understand.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 听着，兄弟，你老是在给自己计时，虽然我不赞同，但我会尊重的。学会理解。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Another message from Olympus, boss. This goes, 'Zagreus, take absolutely all the time you need making your way to us; we know the going must be treacherous, and we assure you our support, however long it takes.' Well, how about that!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 又有从奥林匹斯山寄给你的信了，老大。我给你念一下吧，“扎格列欧斯，来见我们的路上千万不要着急。我们知道你的旅途充满危险，无论要花上多久，我们都始终会支持你。”好了，感觉怎么样！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Heard you got through pretty quick last time! Not bad, not bad!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 听说你上次行动挺快的！不错，不错！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You'd think that once you break free to the surface we could see you from Olympus a bit more than usual, but no! It's like you're shrouded in eternal night up here, hm? Something like that. Odd, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你在想，等你成功地逃出冥界，来到地上世界之后，我们奥林匹斯山上的人就应该能多见你几次了。可并不是这么回事！你就像是被包裹在永恒的黑夜之中一样。这可真够怪的，是吧？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hey, you beat your fastest time fighting through all of that! Not that I'm keeping track! I'm keeping track.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你打破了你的战斗时间记录！我没有在跟踪你！我只是记录。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hey Coz, that last run-through that you did, I almost can't believe how quick you pulled that off! You're really pretty good!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，兄弟，你最后一次闯关时，我简直不敢相信你跑得这么快！你真棒！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hey, you got out of there in practically no time at all before! Let's see if you can have another go like that!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你冲出冥界的时间，比以往都快了不少啊！看看你能不能再次刷新记录吧！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You're getting faster, Coz, keep at it, just like that! Can always go a little faster than before is what I always say!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你跑得越来越快了，兄弟，继续保持就对了！我常说人就是应该一点一点快起来！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hey, Coz, looks to me you beat your fastest time climbing up out of there! That's nicely done! Can you go faster still?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，兄弟，你好像打破了之前逃出冥界的最快纪录！这可真是太了不起了！你还能再快一点吗？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: What do you know, you beat your personal best time escaping recently! I hope my blessing helped a bit with that!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道吗？你最近刷新了逃出冥界的最快纪录！希望我的祝福当时有帮到你的忙！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Well look at you, Coz! Rushing to victory after successive victory. Caught wind of your accomplishments down there! Well then, let's keep the streak alive!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 看看你，兄弟。一次又一次取得胜利。我听说你取得的成就了！好呀，让我们继续冲呀！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Heard the news you broke your streak of victories of late, boss. Happens, right? You seem the sort to bounce right back, though. Let me help with that!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 听说你最近打破了连胜记录，老大。这是真的，对吧？不过，你好像很快反弹回去了。我来帮帮你。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Everybody on Olympus, they're still going on about Persephone, Queen of the Underworld! They had no idea she was down there all along, none whatsoever, Coz! And as for me, now I can deliver you my blessings more officially, I think!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 奥林匹斯山上的每个人，都还在讨论关于冥界皇后珀尔塞福涅的事情！他们根本就不知道她一直都在那里，一点头绪都没有，兄弟！至于我嘛，我觉得，我现在可以以更正式的身份，把我的祝福带给你了！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Even though everything's out in the open, now, and all my brothers, sisters, and whatnot are going to keep helping you fight your way out of there, I've still been keeping to myself, of late! That way nobody slows me down.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 虽然现在所有事情都挑明了，我所有的兄弟姐妹也将会继续帮助您逃出冥界，但我还是喜欢独来独往！这样的话，就不会有人拖我的后腿了。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Some members of the family up here, I know they haven't helped at all, but just don't take it personal or anything, all right? Think of it this way: You've got more of us getting along and talking properly than I have ever seen!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道有几位些家庭成员并没有提供过帮助，但这件事别太往心里去，好吗？这么想吧：多亏了你，大家才会变得更加团结，言谈举止也比以前更得体了，我从来都没见过他们这样！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Your mother got from there just fine, don't worry, Coz! She had me looking after her, and such. Seemed real nice! Told me to tell you hi.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你的母亲一切都好，不用担心，兄弟！有我负责照顾她呢，她看起来真的很不错！她让我给你带个好。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You know, I never knew the pomegranate seeds down in the Underworld held such power if not for your mother mentioning it, Coz! And here I thought they were just tasty, that was it!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 说真的，兄弟，要不是你母亲说起来的话，我根本就不知道冥界的石榴籽居然还有这样的力量！我还以为它们就是很好吃，没别的了呢！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Thought I'd check up on you, there, boss. You doing well, everything good and all? Can't hear you one iota, mind, so then, don't answer that!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我只是想看看你的情况，老大。你还顺利吗，一切都还好吗？我这边听不到你说话，所以你不用回答也行！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Come quickly, boss! You need to hurry up and get out of there, you're running out of time!! You're not, really, but it's a bit of motivation, hey?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 快点，老大！你的时间马上就要快用完了，你必须快点逃出这个地方！！实际上并没什么时间限制，不过这样能激励你一下，是吧？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Oh, you ready for this, boss? Got you the Premium Express this time. Absolute cream of the crop right here! You're going to go real far.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，你准备好了吗，老大？这次我们给你带来了特快专递。这绝对是百里挑一的速度！你会取得非常好的成绩！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Guess what, Coz? It's the Premium Express, delivered straight to you, fresh from the richest mountaintop up here! You're going to like this.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你猜怎么着，兄弟？这是特快专递，直接送到你这里，从最富饶的山顶上刚送过来的！你会喜欢它的！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Express-delivered message for you, Coz. It says: 'Congratulations! You're my hundredth customer today.' And here is what you get!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 快递给你的消息，兄弟。它是这样说的：“恭喜！你是我今天的第一百位顾客。”这是你应得的奖励！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Eugh, I have to tell you, you look awful, Coz. You're barely holding on! Let's see if we can't perk you right back up.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，我得告诉你，你脸色很吓人，兄弟。你几乎撑不住了！我们看看能不能让你振作起来。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Whew! Looks like times hit you hard since last we had a run-in, Coz. Well, when life is tough, just hurry through the rubbish bits, I say!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 哇！自从上次我们相遇后，你好像受到了很大的打击，兄弟。好吧，日子不好过的话，我说，还是赶紧逃离这种困境吧！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Whoa you're a hot mess, there, Coz, what happened getting here? Ah well, I hope your travels run a little smoother here on out.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 哇，你真是一团糟，兄弟，出什么事了？我希望，你的计划能能顺利一点。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: There's a fine line between being quick and being hasty, boss. And if you're hurt as bad as I think, I think you might be on the hasty side!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: “快”和“快过头了”这两者之间是有界限的，老大。如果你的伤势真的想我想得那么严重的话，那我猜你可能有点快过头了！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Well, good news is you got to me, but I can tell you hit a lot of bad news on the way! You stay alive, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 好消息是，你又见到我了，不过坏消息恐怕就要有一大堆了！你还活着，是吧？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Oof! What happened getting here, boss? Let me guess, you got whipped, burned, beat up with spectral clubs... something like that?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 哎哟！你这是怎么了，老大？让我猜猜看，你被人用鞭子抽了，被岩浆躺了，还被幽灵用棍子揍了……是这么回事吧？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You're looking worse for wear, I hate to tell you, boss. But, we can pick you up and get you going here, I think!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我真不想这么说，老大，但你看起来糟透了。不过我觉得，我们可以帮你个忙，让你打起精神来！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: This mark, almost like a bat wing. In the name of Hades! Olympus! I accept this message.

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hey boss, found you, good. Hermes, at your service. Pleasure! You are the talk of Olympus! Normally I wouldn't get mixed up, but for you, I will be making an exception. Now, come on, we both got places to be!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这个标记，很像蝙蝠的翅膀。以哈迪斯之名！奥林匹斯山！我收到了这条消息。

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，老大，终于找到你了，太好了。赫尔墨斯，很乐意为你效劳。很荣幸！你是奥林匹斯山的大红人！通常情况下，我不会乱掺和，但为了你，我打算会破例。来吧，我们都有别的地方去呢！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: All right, Coz, here's the goods, fresh from our mountaintop. Take all the time you need deciding! If you want to be a slowpoke.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧，兄弟，这是刚从我们山顶带来的消息。不着急，慢慢考虑，做出决定！如果你想成为一个慢性子。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Won't need but a moment of your time, here, boss! And you'll more than make up for it right quick, you got my guarantee!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 不会耽误你太多时间，这里，老大！这对你百利无一害，我保证！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: All right, Coz, express delivery to where-in-blazes are you at right now? Anyway take one of these, and go about your business!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧，兄弟，快递消息送到你现在所在的地方了吗？不管怎样，拿一个，继续你的壮举吧！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: I know you're kind of in a hurry, boss. But let me show you what a real hurry's all about in just a moment here!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道你有点急，老大。不过，现在，我来告诉你，什么是雷厉风行！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Package for you, boss! And I think you know what's inside. Well, maybe not exactly, but... just pick something, will you?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你有包裹，老大！我想你知道里面是什么。好吧，也许你不太清楚，但……你可以挑点东西。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Come on, Coz, you can do this! And furthermore, I think you can do this rather quick! Now go!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 来吧，兄弟，你能做到！而且，我认为你可以做得相当快！行动！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: It's you, boss, that's good! But you're standing still! That's bad. Let's get you up and moving about again, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 是你，老大，太好了！但是你现在站着不动！真糟糕。让我们把你扶起来，再继续突击吧。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hey, boss! Not much to report up here. But I've not exactly come this far to bring you news, have I?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，老大！这里没什么好报告的。但我大老远来这里不就是为了给你带消息吗？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Afraid there's no one faster than myself, here, Coz. But good news is, you are about to close the gap a little bit!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 这里恐怕没有人比我快，兄弟。但好消息是，你马上可以缩小一点差距！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Slow day so far, there, boss? Well all of that's about to change, you got my guarantee!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 今天真慢，老大？好吧，一切都要改变了，我向你保证！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: How 'bout we pick the pace up just a little, Coz? Or maybe by a lot! Whatever you've the mood and stomach for right now.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我们再加快一点怎么样，兄弟？或者，再把速度提高一些，不管你现在是什么心情，有没有胃口。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Last thing I ever want to do is slow you down, boss. So, enough chit-chat. Now pick and go. Go!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我最不想干的事情就是耽误你前进，老大。咱们已经聊得差不多了，选个礼物，然后出发吧。出发！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You've got a ways to go yet, boss. Good news is, the slowest part of this particular trip is hereby over... now!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你的旅途还没结束呢，老大。好消息是，这场旅程最耗时间的部分已经结束了，全结束了！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: All's well enough here on the surface, Coz. Though, sooner you can make it out of there, the better it'll be!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 凡界一切都很好，兄弟。不过，你能越快离开那里，就越好！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Another go up to the surface, boss? Might suggest that you be very quick about it. And might give you this!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 再次向凡界进发，老大？你得加快速度。可能会给你这个！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Let's hustle, shall we, boss? Honestly, I don't know how the rest of you can stand it, trudging about like you don't have someplace to be!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我们快点，好吗，老大？老实说，我不知道你们其他人怎么能忍受，像没地方可去似的迈不开脚

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hiya, boss! I'd ask what's new, but I already know! I have my ways. And you have to get right on out of there.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你好，老大！我想问问有什么新鲜事，但我已经知道了！我有我的方法。你必须马上离开那里。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Wish I could just fly in and haul you out of there, Coz, but there's some rules even I can't break. Though nice to see you have a go of it!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我真希望我能飞进去把你从那里拖出来，兄弟，但有些规则连我也不能违反。虽然很高兴看到你能尝试一下！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: I come with urgent tidings, boss! Unfortunately not addressed to you. But someone got you these!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我带来了紧急消息，老大！很遗憾，没有你的信。但是有人给了你这些！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Sorry, Coz, no messages this time. Guess that's what happens when your whole existence is kept secret from the world!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 对不起，兄弟，这次没有你的信。这是因为整个世界都不知道你的存在！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: There's not much new worth mentioning up here, though looks like you have got your hands full down there, boss!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 这里没什么值得一提的新玩意儿，不过你看起来真是忙得不可开交啊，老大！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You've got a tough climb up ahead, Coz, so you just pace yourself, all right? Just kidding, go as quickly as you can. It works for me!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 前面的道路非常崎岖，兄弟，你可千万得悠着点，别冲得太快，好吗？我开玩笑呢，有多快就跑多快吧！反正我一直都是这样！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Come on, now, boss, let's get you moving here!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 来吧，就是现在，老大，让我们加速行动！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Got here in practically no time at all, boss. Ready now?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 很快就到了，老大。现在准备好了吗？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hey Coz, package for you here. Knock yourself out!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，兄弟，这里有你的包裹。别客气！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Got a customary care package for you, Coz.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我给你准备了一个常规补给包，兄弟。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hey, what's it going to be this time, boss?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，这次有什么事呢，老大？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Come on, Coz, let's pick up the pace a bit!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 来吧，兄弟，让我们加快一点速度！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Go get yourself out of there in a hurry, Coz.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 快点离开那里，兄弟。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: No rush, but go on and pick one of these, boss.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 别着急，去挑一个吧，老大。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Message for you, Coz: It says 'Take one, it's free, enjoy!'

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 有你的信，老大：信上说，“拿一个礼物吧，免费的，好好享受！”

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: What's going on, there, boss? Are things all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 怎么了，老大？你没事吧？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You want the usual, or what, there, boss?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你想和往常一样，还是怎么，老大？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Special delivery and all that, boss! Here, take your pick.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你有个特快专递，老大！给，你挑吧。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hey boss! You take one of these, and go for it.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，老大！拿一个，继续你的壮举吧。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Just so happened to be in the area, here, boss!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我只是恰好路过这里而已，老大。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Making sure you got this, Coz. You got this, Coz!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 确保你拿到了这个，兄弟。你成功了，兄弟！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Here comes a little boost to get you up and out of there in no time, boss!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 这里有一个小奖励，可以帮助你很快逃离出去，老大！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Now, don't just stand there, Coz, pick one of these and go!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 好了，别在那里傻站着了，兄弟。挑一个，然后马上出发吧！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Your quickness is my number one priority, here, boss.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你的速度是我最关注的，老大。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: No time to waste and so on, Coz. Now, choose!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我们没有时间可以浪费，兄弟。现在，挑一个吧！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Caught wind you need my services here, boss?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 听说，你要找我，老大？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Thought I'd check in, Coz. See how things are going. Slow, right? Not for long.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我会报到的，兄弟。看看情况如何。有点慢，对吧？不会太久。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Ready to hustle? Good! I'll take that as a yes.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 准备好加速了吗？很好！我当你点头了。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Let's get you quickly on your way, there, Coz!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 让我们帮你快点上路吧，兄弟！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Message for you, boss. It says: 'Here, choose one of these, and go!'

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 这是要传递给你的消息，老大。它是这样说的：“选一个，然后就出发吧！”

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Another message for you! This one says: 'Hey boss! Take this!'

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 另一条信息是给你的！上面说：“嘿，老大！带上这个！”

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Just thought I'd check up on you, boss, and bring you this!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 只是想来看看你，老大，然后把这个带给你！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hope you enjoyed the life of being slow, because all that's about to change, right here!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 希望之前慢腾腾的生活你还满意，因为从现在开始，你就要健步如飞了！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: All right, boss, here, let's get you on your way!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 好了，老大，咱们准备出发吧！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Past time we got you out of there, right, boss?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 是时候离开这里了，是吧，老大？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Just thought I'd drop by, give you this, and go!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我只是过来见你一面，给你带个东西就走！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: We'll have you racing out of here in no time, Coz!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我们马上就要全速冲出去了，兄弟！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: How goes it underground of late, there, boss?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 冥界的生活最近还好吗，老大？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Nice day we're having on the surface! You should see it, boss!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 地面上的天气可好了，你真应该来看看才对，老大！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Another day, another race up to the top! You ready, boss?

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 新的一天，新的逃亡大挑战！你准备好了吗，老大？

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Well, here we go again! Let's go, then, boss!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 好了，我们要出发了！那就走吧，老大！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Got here as quickly as I could, boss. Now what say we get you promptly the hell out of there!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我会尽快赶到这里，老大。现在，让我们马上帮助你逃离这里！

en.speaker: Hermes
