en.text: Hey Coz, gathered you were just about to make another go of breaking out of there! Thought I'd stop by and give you a boost.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，兄弟，我知道你准备再次发起突击！我会过来帮你一把。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You're raring for your next trek out of there, right, boss? Well then I guess I got here just in time.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你很期待下一次突击，对吗，老大？好吧，我想我来的正是时候。

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Heard you were heading out again, boss. Changed my schedule around a bit, not a big deal, and figured I'd drop in!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 听说你又发起突击了，老大。我把我的日程安排改了一下，没什么大不了的，我会顺便去看看你的！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You're off again, are you? All right well then safe travels! Or swift travels, failing that!

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你又发起突击了，是吗？好吧，那就祝你突击顺利吧！或者如果失败的话，就来一次痛快的！

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You ready for another go at this, Coz? Well then think I can speed you on your journey there.

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你准备好再次突击了吗？好吧，我想我可以帮你加快速度。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Lord Hermes, please accept this gift as a small token of my appreciation. Thank you for always keeping me on my toes.

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Oh! Mighty keen of you to leave a tip, there, boss. And I've a tip for you: Don't be slow! Maybe this will help with that.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 赫尔墨斯大人，请接受这件礼物，作为我的一个小小的感谢。谢谢你一直让我保持警惕。

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 噢！你能给我小费，我真是太高兴了，老大。我给你一个提示：速度要跟上！也许这能有点用。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Lord Hermes, please accept this gift as a small token of my appreciation. Thank you for always keeping me on my toes.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 赫尔墨斯大人，请接受这件礼物，作为我的一个小小的感谢。谢谢你一直让我保持警惕。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Lord Hermes sir, you've asked for nothing in return, and so, please take this humble offering, because... it's nothing, really!

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Well now, that's awful kind, there, Coz! No need to thank me, though. Not so profusely anyhow!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 赫耳墨斯大人，你没有要求任何回报，所以，请接受这份谦卑的礼物，因为……这真的没有什么！

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧，那真是太好了，兄弟！但是你不用谢我。至少谢礼不用这么重嘛！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Lord Hermes sir, you've asked for nothing in return, and so, please take this humble offering, because... it's nothing, really!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 赫耳墨斯大人，你没有要求任何回报，所以，请接受这份谦卑的礼物，因为……这真的没有什么！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hermes, my friend? May I call you my friend? I hope this modest offering will lift your spirits but won't slow you down.

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: I look like I got the sort of time to sip Nectar, Coz? Well, guess what, I do! So, cheers!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 赫尔墨斯，我的朋友？我可以叫你我的朋友吗？我希望这份谦卑的礼物能让你振奋起来，但不会拖你的后腿。

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 我好像有时间来喝口蜜露了，兄弟？好吧，你猜怎么着，的确是这样！所以，干杯吧！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hermes, my friend? May I call you my friend? I hope this modest offering will lift your spirits but won't slow you down.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 赫尔墨斯，我的朋友？我可以叫你我的朋友吗？我希望这份谦卑的礼物能让你振奋起来，但不会拖你的后腿。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Ever since we met, Lord Hermes, life here in the Underworld has been much faster-paced, and I am ever grateful. This is for you.

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Hey, boss, I appreciate the tip. But just as a reminder, all my services are paid in full already! No need for special thanks. Though... cheers.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 赫耳墨斯大人，自从我们相识以来，冥界的生活节奏已经快了很多，我非常感激。这是给你的。

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，老大，很感谢你给我的小费。但提醒一下，我所有的服务都已经全额支付了！不用特别感谢。不过……干一杯倒是无妨。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Ever since we met, Lord Hermes, life here in the Underworld has been much faster-paced, and I am ever grateful. This is for you.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 赫耳墨斯大人，自从我们相识以来，冥界的生活节奏已经快了很多，我非常感激。这是给你的。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I never could have come this far this quickly had it not been for your tireless support, Lord Hermes, sir. I'm in your debt.

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You know, Coz, I got to say I had a few concerns when we first met, your father being who he is and all. But you're all right!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 赫耳墨斯大人，先生，如果不是你的不懈支持，我决不会这么快就走到这一步。我欠你一份人情。

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道，兄弟，我不得不说，我们第一次见面时，我有一些担心你父亲是谁，他是什么样的人。但你没问题！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I never could have come this far this quickly had it not been for your tireless support, Lord Hermes, sir. I'm in your debt.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 赫耳墨斯大人，先生，如果不是你的不懈支持，我决不会这么快就走到这一步。我欠你一份人情。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: This one's for you, swift and sure-footed messenger of the gods! You make what you do look easy. But I know you're going out of your way. Thank you so much, Hermes.

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: My rule is not to let things get too personal as far as work-related matters are concerned, Coz. But you're family! And, well, you're a right decent chap, I think. Offering up a bit of Nectar to me in the middle of all this!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这是给你的礼物，为众神送信的敏捷信使！你为我做的这些看起来只是举手之劳，但我明白，这并不是你分内的事情。真的很感谢你，赫尔墨斯。

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 兄弟，凡是涉及到工作的事情，我一般都不掺杂个人感情。可你是我的家人啊！而且，我觉得你也是个相当不错的家伙。你明明这么忙，还能想起来请我喝瓶蜜露呢！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: This one's for you, swift and sure-footed messenger of the gods! You make what you do look easy. But I know you're going out of your way. Thank you so much, Hermes.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这是给你的礼物，为众神送信的敏捷信使！你为我做的这些看起来只是举手之劳，但我明白，这并不是你分内的事情。真的很感谢你，赫尔墨斯。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I salute you, Lord Hermes, with this rarest of delicacies! Pretty rare here, anyway. You never show it, but I can only imagine how hard you must be working to back me up. Cheers, mate!

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: You know, the last time anybody offered me Ambrosia from the Underworld was never, before now! That's quite a gesture on your part. You could have just as well taken my services for granted and I'd not have minded in the least! But, thank you, Coz.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 赫尔墨斯大人，让我用这最珍贵的蜜酒来敬你一杯吧，总之在我们这里是挺珍贵的。虽然你从来没说过，但我明白，你肯定在我身上花了相当多的心思。干杯吧，朋友！

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 说真的，冥界里还从来都没人请我喝过仙馔密酒呢！对你来说，这肯定是份相当珍贵的礼物了。你本可以心安理得地享受我的帮忙，我也一一点都不会介意！不过你还是给了我礼物，谢谢你，兄弟。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I salute you, Lord Hermes, with this rarest of delicacies! Pretty rare here, anyway. You never show it, but I can only imagine how hard you must be working to back me up. Cheers, mate!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 赫尔墨斯大人，让我用这最珍贵的蜜酒来敬你一杯吧，总之在我们这里是挺珍贵的。虽然你从来没说过，但我明白，你肯定在我身上花了相当多的心思。干杯吧，朋友！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Message for you, Lord Hermes! It says, 'This offering is dedicated to the incomparable god of swiftness, from whom the news is always good, because he's bringing it. You are a real mate, you know that? I really owe you one.' Zagreus.

en.speaker: Hermes
en.text: Look, Coz, I am going to accept this choice Ambrosia from you one last time, all right? But from this point, I am doubling down on all professional responsibilities, here. Strictly business between us! Although, secretly, you're one of my best mates. Want you to know.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这里有一封送给你的信，赫尔墨斯大人！信上说：“无与伦比的敏捷之神啊，这是送给你的礼物。只要能收到信，我就会很开心，因为你带来的总是好消息。你知道吗？你是我真正的好朋友，我真的欠你个人情。”寄信人：扎格列欧斯。

zh-CN.speaker: 赫尔墨斯
zh-CN.text: 听着，兄弟，这是我最后一次接受你的礼物，知道了吗？不过从现在开始，我会有事没事就来看看你。这件事情可绝对不准和别人说，这是我们之间的小秘密，知道了吗？我只想告诉你，你是我最好的好朋友。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Message for you, Lord Hermes! It says, This offering is dedicated to the incomparable god of swiftness, from whom the news is always good, because he's bringing it. You are a real mate, you know that? I really owe you one. Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这里有一封送给你的信，赫尔墨斯大人！信上说：“无与伦比的敏捷之神啊，这是送给你的礼物。只要能收到信，我就会很开心，因为你带来的总是好消息。你知道吗？你是我真正的好朋友，我真的欠你个人情。”寄信人：扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I sense that you have not yet spoken with the all-seeing artifact you call Aegis. Tamper with the Fates' design, then, all you like. But if you change your mind, do speak the words to it: I see you stand your ground against the serpent's flame.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我发现，你还没有对那件叫埃癸斯的全视圣物说出那句咒语。如果你不愿意遵守命运女神的安排，随你便就好。不过如果你改变主意的话，记得对它说：“我看到你傲然屹立在巨蛇的烈焰之中。”

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You have not yet used the waking-phrase that I imparted? Or perhaps you merely chose not to present me the result. I would quite like to see it, at some point. Remember, Son of Hades: Say to the all-seeing artifact, I see you stand your ground against the serpent's flame.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你还没说出我告诉你的那句唤醒咒语，是吗？或者说，你只是单纯地不想让我看到结果而已。不过终有一日，我是会看到它的。记住，冥王之子，对那件全视圣器说：“我看到你傲然屹立在巨蛇的烈焰之中。”

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Out of the infinitely spanning possibilities, here before me stands the Son of Hades, bearing my all-seeing artifact, appearing in the aspect of a bearer yet unborn, who shall be known throughout the north as Beowulf. How very droll.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 在一切无穷无尽的可能性中，冥王之子来到了我的面前，拿着我的全视圣器。而它的形象却属于某个尚未出生的战士，他日后会颇负盛名，整个北境称他为贝奥武夫。这真是太奇妙了。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I faintly sensed that you were able to confront your father while in possession of my small round catalyst. It seems my asking you, and your success, was in accordance with the Fates' design, as well. The result is more amusing even than expected. Thus, thank you.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我隐约地感觉到，你之前面对你父亲的时候，带着我给你的圆形催化剂。看来无论是我对你的请求，还是你成功地击败了你的父亲，都符合命运三女神的安排，而结果甚至比我预想得更加有趣。所以，谢谢你。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I have detected some unusual activity within the reaches of the Underworld, Son of Hades... vast sums of Darkness, collected in an ancient catalyst, which I see now almost like a beacon, shining in the night. This either is the work of Nyx, or you, or both. I am anticipating the result.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我注意到冥界中有一些不正常的活动，冥王之子……大量的黑暗在远古催化剂的作用下聚合起来。它现在看起来就像个信标，在黑夜中发出光芒。这可能是倪克斯的成果，可能是你的成果，也可能是你们二人共同的成果。我很期待后续的发展。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: It pleases me immensely, Son of Hades, to have seen the goddess Nyx again. The significant amount of time that has elapsed since last this happened dulled sufficiently old pains, I think. Thus, it becomes a basis on which our connection may, in time, take shape again.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 冥王之子啊，能够再见到女神倪克斯真的令我倍感欢欣。印象里，上一次见到她已经是很久很久以前了。在这漫长的岁月里，旧日的伤口也早就被抚平了。因此，这一定会成为我们再次建立起联系的基础吧。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: As we become acquainted, Son of Hades, I shall make myself quite clear in one respect: I fear I have a lack of patience for discussion. When visiting, please merely listen, then accept my mark, and then depart. Respond only when necessary. Or when prompted. Yes?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...Merely listen, so it's just like when I get those messages from the Olympians. Wait, you did just prompt me, Master Chaos, didn't you? Or should I have remained silent just now?

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I cannot offer you advice. But you were prompted, yes. You may speak freely, then, or anytime, despite my wishes that you not do so. Absolute silence is my general preference. It may not be yours.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 既然我们已经慢慢熟悉起来了，冥王之子，有一件事我必须说明白：我恐怕没什么耐心和别人讨论。所以你来找我的时候，只要好好听着，接受我的印记，然后离开就好了。只有当有必要，或是我提示你的时候，你再开口，明白了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: ……只听不说，这和我从奥林匹斯众神那里接收信息也没什么不一样。等等，卡俄斯君主，你刚刚提示过我了，对吧？还是说，我应该保持沉默才对？

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我无法为你提供建议，但是我确实提示了你，没错。你现在可以自由说话了，直到我改变主意为止。我确实喜欢绝对的寂静，但你可能并不喜欢。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I understand that Zeus and all his kin on Mount Olympus think that you are born of Hades and the goddess Nyx? I was amused to learn of this deception. Nyx has mothered many of the Underworld's own, so, why not you?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: She isn't my birthmother, no, but she is like a mother to me. Do you know her?

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Oh, I know the goddess Nyx quite well, of course. Though, it has been a while since we last communicated, and I fear... well, I was not the charitable sort, back then. It is my hope that Nyx is faring well.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我应该知道吗，宙斯和他在奥林匹斯山上的所有亲人都认为你是哈迪斯和女神倪克斯的孩子？了解这一骗局使我愉悦。倪克斯养育了很多冥界的孩子，那她怎么就不能养育你呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 她并不是我的亲生母亲，对，但她也像我的母亲一样对待我。她您认识她吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，我当然认识女神倪克斯。不过，距离我们上次沟通已经有一段时间了，我担心……好吧，那时候我可不是那种仁慈的人。我希望倪克斯一切顺利。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I knew you would arrive. But only in the moments prior to the fact. Thus, I am experiencing residual surprise. Your movements through the Underworld are as though a veil of darkness enshrouds you. The goddess Nyx's influence, perhaps? Respond.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I... do not know how to respond to that, exactly, Master Chaos, but, Nyx, yes, she has been aiding me, in my attempts to flee my father's realm.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You move in darkness, not as infinitely black as hers, but reminiscent to me, nonetheless. I would invite her to try to elude me, and then attempt to locate her. A minor amusement for the both of us. Now, I have you for this, I see.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我遇见到了你回来，但只有当你即将到来之前，我才能预见到。因此，我还是可以感受到这为数不多的惊喜。你在冥界的行动，就好像被黑纱包裹住了一样，或许是因为女神倪克斯的缘故？请回答。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我……我不知道该怎么答复，卡俄斯君主。不过，确实是倪克斯，她一直在帮助我，帮助我逃离我父亲的国度。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你确实是在黑暗中行动，虽然与她无尽的黑暗不尽相同，但还是让我想起了她。我曾经邀请她有意躲开我，而我则想办法找到她，算是我俩之间小小的娱乐活动吧。我想，现在可以换成你了。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Lately, Son of Hades, I have sensed what I would call a sort of shift within your father's residence. Did something noteworthy occur, perhaps? Respond.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Master Chaos, it's Persephone, my mother. She's returned! She's chosen to return. So... things feel different, certainly, with her around, although... I didn't feel any sort of shift.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You may not sense these shifts as I. The lightness of this space bends and adjusts with time. What you describe... it must have been the cause. I trust that the occasion is a welcome one. And I am pleased that you returned, nevertheless.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 冥王之子啊，最近我感觉到，你父亲的居所发生了某些我称之为“变化”的事物。最近是发生了什么值得留意的事情吗？请回答。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 卡俄斯君主，是珀尔塞福涅，我的母亲，她回来了！她是自愿回来的，所以……这里有了她之后，一切肯定都应该不太一样了。不过……我倒没觉得有什么变化。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 您对变化的感知可能不会像我一样敏锐。这片空间的亮度，正在随着时间的变化弯曲、调整。而你所描述的这些事情……肯定就是这些变化的起因。我相信在这种场合下，这样的变化是可喜的。而且不管怎样，我很高兴你回来了。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Again I sensed some sort of shifting in your father's residence. You seek to ask something of me about it, do you not? Respond.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, I'm glad you asked, it's just... my mother, she's... we're reaching out to the Olympians. Trying to reconnect the family. It's been a while, relatively, since she and Father saw the others, but... in case a gathering occurs, I did wish you to know you're cordially invited, too.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Cordially invited...? A generous proposal, Son of Hades, though unless your gathering is to occur within my space, please understand it would be difficult for me to bring the full entirety of my presence there. However... I think I can arrange to be with you in some capacity. Thank you.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我再次感觉到你父亲的居所发生了某些变化，而你希望我能为这些变化做些什么，是这样吗？请回答。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，很高兴您问了，只是……我的母亲，她……我们正在努力与奥林匹斯众神的联系，想要重新建立家人之间的纽带。她和我父亲见面，已经有一段时间了，不过……万一我们举行聚会的话，我想让您知道，我们也诚挚地邀请您来参加。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 诚挚的邀请……？这真是个慷慨的提案，哈迪斯之子。不过希望你理解，除非你们能在我的空间内举行聚会，否则我很难把我的全部实体都带过去。不过……我觉得我可以在一定程度上和你一起参加聚会，谢谢。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: It pleases me your gathering of the Olympians occurred. I must inform you... I had never once before detected quite so many of my offspring in a single space. At least not without violent intent. I appreciate that you included me, and that you have returned. Shall we continue, then?

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你把奥林匹斯众神聚在了一起，我很高兴。我必须和你说……我以前从来没在任何一个地方，见到过我这么多后代，而且所有人都没有暴力的意图。我很感谢你也邀请我去，也很感谢你能回到这里。所以，我们可以继续了吗？

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: It pleases me your gathering of the Olympians occurred. I must inform you... I had never once before detected quite so many of my offspring in a single space. At least not without violent intent.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你把奥林匹斯众神聚在了一起，我很高兴。我必须和你说……我以前从来没在任何一个地方，见到过我这么多后代，而且所有人都没有暴力的意图。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You bear the blessing of the great Lord Zeus. He still believes he holds dominion over both heaven and earth. I think, perhaps, he has forgotten about me.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你带着伟大的宙斯大人的祝福。他仍然相信他对天地都有统治权。我想也许他把我忘了。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Lord Poseidon offered you his blessing, it would seem. He can be rather boastful and belligerent, exhibiting the most unattractive manners of your father and Lord Zeus alike.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 看起来，波塞冬大人似乎给了你祝福。他可能表现得相当自大和好战，表现出你父亲和宙斯大人最不喜欢的举止。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: This wise goddess Athena has imbued you with her charms, I see, O Son of Hades. Perhaps to her you are a tool with which her broken family may as yet be mended.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，你是冥王之子，我知道，智慧女神雅典娜已经给你灌输了她的魔法。也许对她来说，你只是一个工具，可以用来修补她破碎的家庭。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: It is not unexpected that you consorted with the violent Ares, and now bear his Boon. He still worships me, you know; yet, I would say he does not know me very well.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你和暴力的阿瑞斯交往，现在带着他的恩赐，这并不意外。他仍然崇拜我，你知道的；但是，我想说，他不太了解我。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: The charms of goddess Aphrodite are upon you unmistakably, although I shall be curious to see if her command over one's sense of love shall have any effect beneath the earth.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 毫无疑问，你身上戴着的是阿弗洛狄忒女神的护身符。不过我很想知道，她操纵别人爱意的能力，能否在这冥界发挥作用。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I understand the hunting-goddess Artemis recently has turned her gaze towards you. It is unexpected she would offer her assistance, even to a relative in need.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道狩猎女神阿尔忒弥斯最近把目光转向了你。出乎意料的是，她会提供帮助，即使是对一个需要帮助的亲人。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: The drunkard Dionysus offered you his services, I see? He can be rather unpredictable, and therefore offers me a source of some amusement.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 酒鬼迪奥尼索司为你提供了服务，是吗？他有许多鬼点子，所以也给我带来了一些欢乐。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Swift Hermes spurs you on, I see, O Son of Hades. Beware the narrow distance between hastiness and swiftness; a distinction I am not so sure the god of travel fully understands.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，冥王之子啊，迅捷的赫尔墨斯已经找过你了。要注意，迅捷和性急之间有着微妙的区别，不过这位旅行之神恐怕还不能完全理解这其中的区别吧。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Embittered Demeter has reached you, hasn't she? She once was full of warmth, you know; but lately, as I understand, she is more prone to taking it away.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 怨愤的得墨忒尔接触过你了，对吧？曾经的她会带给人温暖，但据我所知，如今的她更乐于剥夺这种温暖。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You have met many of the Olympians by now, each spurring you toward their mountaintop. They place such value on familial bonds, yet none of them remember who I am. Do not place too much faith in them, O Son of Hades.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 到现在为止，你遇到了许多奥林匹斯神，他们每一位都激励着你走向他们所在的山顶。他们如此看重家庭纽带关系，却没有人记得我是谁。冥王之子，不要过于相信他们。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I ask you listen but not speak, O Son of Hades, whilst the Olympians? They do not ask at all. They merely send their messages to you, unprompted, providing a choice of blessing, but no say. I seek to understand their point of view. But it is difficult.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我请你只要听，不要问，冥王之子，而奥林匹斯的神是怎么做的呢？他们连请都不请。他们只会自顾自给你发送信息，让你选择他们的恩赐，但却什么都不解释。我试着理解他们的观点，但这太难了。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: When you extend an offering to the Olympians, for a fleeting instant, it appears as though they are able to hear your prayer. Or so I have observed. How interesting that your thoughts are capable of breaking free, yet you cannot.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你向奥林匹斯众神进贡的时候，有那么一瞬间，他们似乎可以听见你的祈祷。至少这是我所观测到的结果。真是有趣，虽然你的思想可以挣脱束缚，但你的肉体却做不到这一点。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Your father and his brothers, when they sealed the Titans in the darkest reaches of this world, that was the last they saw of me, as well. You are dissimilar from them, and I feel safe communicating thus with you.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 当你父亲和他的兄弟们把泰坦封印在世界最黑暗的地方，那也是他们最后一次见到我。你和他们不一样，我觉得这样和你交流很安全。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I was at times uncharitable with the goddess Nyx, when we were closer, long ago. After she bore her first children, I nevertheless expected her attention to remain undivided. I kept creating. When finally I slowed, I realized my mistake. But our connection had been severed, by that point.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 很久以前，当我和倪克斯女神关系比较亲密的时候，我有时对她非常严厉。在她生下第一个孩子之后，我仍然希望她不要因为孩子而分心。我一直都在创造，当我终于放慢脚步时，才意识到了自己的错误。可那个时候，我们之前的联系已经被切断了。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I sense that something is the matter, Son of Hades. Speak, then, what is on your mind? I can decipher some of it without your telling though would rather hear it from you voluntarily.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, Master Chaos? The goddess Nyx, she... seems to want to speak with you again. I wonder, would you maybe contact her sometime? She seems convinced it is your move to make if you so choose.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: The goddess Nyx wishes to hear from me...? Now that is unexpected, Son of Hades, and I wonder if, perhaps, this is a jest of yours. Though, your intentions evidently are sincere. Then, I shall make no promises in this, except that... I am considering the possibility.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我感觉出了什么问题，冥王之子。说说吧，你在想什么？就算你不说，我也能猜个八九不离十，但我还是更喜欢你自愿讲出来。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，卡俄斯君主？女神倪克斯，她……好像想和你再谈一次。我想，你能不能找个时间和她联系一下？她似乎确信，如果你愿意的话，你可以自己决定。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 女神倪克斯想收到我的信息……？这真是太意外了，冥王之子，你没有在开玩笑吧。不过，我可以看出你的意图是真诚的。虽然我不能保证，但是……我会考虑这件事情的可能性的。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Son of Hades, should eventually you spawn your own offspring... I recommend maintaining sub-infinite distances with them in space and time. Even if they are most tiresome, there always seems to come a point when one wishes to be in their presence once again.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 冥王之子啊，到了最后，你也会有你自己的后代……我建议你与他们在时间与空间上不要相隔太远。哪怕他们再怎么令人讨厌，你总会有想要见到他们的时候。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: After some consideration, and on your recommendation, I attempted lately to make contact with the goddess Nyx again. She is quite distant from me now, of course. If you happen to know... did she receive the message well? Respond.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, Master Chaos, she can be a little difficult to read at times, but... I got the impression she was quite surprised, even excited to have heard from you again. She said that she would think about how to respond. Or, whether to respond.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I see. Well, she shall find a way, if it is warranted. I always did expect the world from her. There were times when I expected her to shine as bright as day, though she is Night. When she achieved a certain level of ability... she left. And I could not find her.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 在经过了考虑，以及你的建议之后，我最近决定再次与女神倪克斯联系。当然，她现在离我很远。如果你刚好知道的话……她有没有收到我的消息吗？请回答。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，卡俄斯君主，她最近可能没什么空闲，不过……又收到了你的信，她感到很惊讶，甚至可以说是激动。她说她会考虑怎么答复您的，或者说，要不要答复您。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 明白了，嗯，如果可以的话，她会考虑清楚的。我以前总是希望能从她身上看到整个世界。有那么段时间，我希望她能像白昼一样明亮，尽管她是夜之女神。当她获得了一定的力量之后……她离开了我，我再也没有找到过她。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: My daughter, the goddess Nyx. When I learned the Olympians mistakenly assumed she was your mother, I did not fully consider the possibility that she essentially was a mother to you... the technicality of birth, aside. She cares for you to the extent a mother can.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我的女儿，倪克斯女神。当我得知奥林匹斯众神误把她当做你的母亲的时候，我并没有考虑到，她实际上可以担任你的母亲角色这种可能性……物质上的生育方面除外。她尽她所能地照顾你，就像你真正的母亲一样。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Prior to your intervention, Son of Hades, I expected that the goddess Nyx had forgotten about me... whether purposefully, or from passage of time. I believed that to be forgotten was the one true inevitability. Perhaps, however, I was incorrect.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 冥王之子，在你出手干预之前，我曾以为倪克斯女神已经彻底忘记了我的存在……无论是她有意忘记的，还是随着时间流逝，渐渐忘记的。我曾坚信，被人遗忘是无法避免的必然，但看来，或许是我错了。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I find that it is difficult maintaining my connection with many consciousnesses, such as yours, and that of the goddess Nyx. Yet I am also finding that this difficulty is fully warranted. Our connections give me much to consider as I await our next exchange.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我发现，我很难同时维持与多个意识之间的联系，比如说你的意识，还有倪克斯女神的意识。但我也发现这种困难是完全有意义的，我们的联系可以给我很多可以思考的事情，让我在等待下次见面之前思索。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Ah, here is my favorite among those immortals dwelling underneath the Earth. How may I change your life today, O Son of Hades?

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，这是我最喜欢的那些住在冥界的神。冥王之子，现在，我怎样才能改变你的人生呢？

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: May you enjoy a moment's peace within my space before venturing on in uncertainty. To my surprise, I must admit I do appreciate the company.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 愿你在我掌管的领地享受片刻宁静，然后继续未知的冒险。令我惊讶的是，我必须承认我很感激有人陪我。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Have you grown trusting yet of the Olympians, for all their generosity? Perhaps you ought to let them know the truth about your journey's goal. They are vain, and think that it is them you seek.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'll never get out of here if not for their help, but... I can't let them know about Mother. She wants to remain hidden from them.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: A difficult position to be in, Son of Hades. The Olympians may not appreciate being misled. But you can trust that I shall keep your secret. I wish to see how your predicament plays out.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 面对奥林匹斯神的慷慨馈赠，你对他们的信任增加了吗？也许你应该让他们知道你出击的真正目标。他们可真是自负，以为你要找的就是他们。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果没有他们的帮助，我永远都无法离开这个地方。但……我不能让他们知道母亲的事情，她不想在他们面前露面。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 这真是个困难的处境，冥王之子。奥林匹斯山上的神不喜欢被欺骗。但请你相信，我会帮你保守秘密。我想看看事情会怎样发展。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Such darkness emanates from you, O Son of Hades, that I once again did not entirely anticipate you would arrive just now. I suspect even your father must have difficulty keeping track of you through the domain he calls his own.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，冥王之子啊，强烈的黑暗笼罩着你。这次我依然没有完全预料到你的到访。想必就算是你的父亲，在他自己王国之中，也很难察觉到你的行踪吧。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You move in darkness, practically unseen, Son of Hades. It is quite difficult even for me to sense your presence at times. The Olympians catch their glimpses now and then. But you are always in a shroud. Thus is the influence of Nyx.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你在黑暗之中穿行，冥王之子。几乎没人能看得到你的身影，有时甚至连我都难以察觉到你的存在。奥林匹斯众神会时不时地窥见你的行动，但你却始终裹在暗影之中，这正是倪克斯的力量。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: How strange it is to be subjected to the Fates. But do not fall into the cognitive delusion that they have already made your choices for you, Son of Hades. Rather, they are keen about anticipating every choice that everyone shall make. Such as the following.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 受到命运之神的摆布，这种一定感觉很奇怪吧。但是，冥王之子啊，千万不要产生错觉，误以为命运已经为你做好选择了。相反，命运之神只是预测了每个人可能会做出的选择，比如下面这样。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I sense your consternation, Son of Hades, as you look about this space; you have another question, and are free to ask.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, it's just... I sometimes wonder, Master Chaos... if you created all of this, then... who created you? What was this place before you arrived?

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: All of this simply came to be, and so did I, presumably after a former time had finally reached its end. I hesitate to say it was an act of will. It was more like a sudden shift, as when a conflagration happens from a spark. I arrived at such a time, and all else then arrived, from me.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 冥王之子啊，在你观察这空间的时候，我察觉到了你的惊愕。你还有另一个问题想问我，你现在可以问了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，就是……卡俄斯君主，有时候我会想……如果是您创造了这一切，那么……是谁创造了您呢？在您诞生之前，这地方是什么样子？

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 它就是这样自然而然出现了，我也一样，大概就是上一个时代结束了吧。我不清楚这到底是不是有谁有意为之。这更像是一种突然之间的转变，就像星星之火可以燎原一样。我在这样的时候诞生了，随后，其它的一切也从我身上诞生了。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: When you expire, and then suddenly return to life within your father's residence, perhaps it is akin to when I first gained consciousness so long ago. Perhaps I, too, had just expired, only to reawaken.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 当你死亡，随后突然在你父亲的圣殿复活的时候，这种感觉和我第一次获得意识的时候或许很相似。也许我也是刚刚死去，复活醒来而已。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You may have wondered, Son of Hades, how it is you came to find me in this space, when I have gone unseen by most for quite some time. I have wondered this, as well, and think that our connection to Goddess Nyx is the most likely answer.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你一定想知道，冥王之子啊，我大部分时候我都会隐藏自己，但你为何却在这里找到了我。我也想知道答案，而我认为，我们与女神倪克斯的联系很可能就是答案。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Son of Hades, I believe I have deduced something I ought have sooner recognized. Your mother must have been one who called herself Persephone. Her stay within the Underworld was brief, from my perspective, but impactful, nonetheless. You seek her now? Respond.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I do. She's somewhere on the surface. That's why I keep on finding you like this. I'm trying to find her.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I hope that your attempts achieve success. She is beyond my senses, presently, though of course I am still able to assist you in your journey, thus.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 冥王之子啊，我已经推断出了我早就该发现的信息。你的母亲一定就是那位自称珀尔塞福涅的女人。依我判断，她在冥界待的时间不长，但却产生了十足的影响。你在找她吗？请回答。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是的，她就在地面世界，这就是为什么我一直在找你的原因。我想要找到她。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我希望你能成功。现在我还感觉不到她，不过我可以在你的旅途中提供帮助。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Son of Hades, I believe I have deduced something I ought have sooner recognized. Your mother must have been one who called herself Persephone. Her stay within the Underworld was brief, from my perspective, but impactful, nonetheless. You seek her now? Respond.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, Master Chaos... you should know I have located her, already. Though where she is, I cannot stay for long. So I am visiting, as often as I can. It's... not unlike our visits here. Only, somehow, even harder to get to where she is.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I see. Then, it is good to know that you have been in contact. And I trust that your successive visits shall be worth their while. Not unlike our visits here.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 冥王之子啊，我已经推断出了我早就该发现的信息。你的母亲一定就是那位自称珀尔塞福涅的女人。依我判断，她在冥界待的时间不长，但却产生了十足的影响。你在找她吗？请回答。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，卡俄斯君主……我得告诉你，我已经找到她所在之处了。不过她在的地方我没法长待，所以我只能尽可能地一次次去看她。这和……我们之间的见面倒是蛮像的，只是她在的地方更加难以到达。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我明白了，你们已经见过面了，我很高兴。我相信，你接下来的会面都是值得的，这和我们之间的见面倒是蛮像的。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Son of Hades, if you locate the one who called herself Persephone, shall it then come to pass that we no longer see each other in this way? Respond.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh! I... Master Chaos, I don't know what to expect from there. But, to be direct with you, if I could leave the Underworld forever... I think I would. Though, I would miss you. Many others here.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: ...I would miss you as well. Thank you for telling me.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 冥王之子啊，如果你找到了那位自称珀尔塞福涅的人，是不是意味着我们再也不能相见了？请回答。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢！我……卡俄斯君主，我也不知道接下来会发生什么，但我可以对你实话实说。如果我能永远离开冥界的话……我想我会这么做的。不过我会想念你，也会想念很多这边的人。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: ……我也会想念你的，谢谢你告诉我。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Tell me something, Son of Hades. If the one who called herself Persephone is back, then... why do you continue to return? Respond.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Master Chaos, it seems I've developed something of a talent around breaking out of here. Or, there, I mean, the Underworld, so... it's become more of an official role for me, I guess. If escape shouldn't be possible, then someone needs to find the gaps.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Indeed. Then, you shall visit with me still, despite accomplishing the principal object of your journey back when first we met. Good.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 和我说说吧，冥王之子。如果那个自称珀尔塞福涅的人回来了，那么……你为什么还会来这里呢？请回答。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 卡俄斯君主，看起来我多少已经培养出了逃出这个地方的才能，也就是说，逃出冥界。所以……对我而言，逃脱成了一件正式的职务吧，我猜。如果要确保没人能逃出这里的话，那就必须有人能找到看守方面的漏洞才行。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 确实如此。尽管你已经达成了我们第一次见面时的主要目标，但你还是可以来见我，这很好。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I am impressed that you were able to procure a specimen out from the flowing currents here in my domain, with nothing but a simple instrument. I shall look forward to your subsequent attempts.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你居然真的能用这么简单的工具，就从我的领域这流动的介质里获得样本。我很期待你后续的尝试。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I trust the small round catalyst which I provided you has been of value, Son of Hades? It is my hope it makes your journeys to this space less difficult, perhaps inducing them on a more frequent interval.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 看来，我之前给你的圆形催化剂很有用，冥王之子。希望它能让你来这里的旅途变得没那么困难，或许也能让你更频繁地来到这个空间。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You have arrived within a certain shroud of darkness, Son of Hades. The goddess Nyx's ancient shawl. I had not sensed its void in a considerable amount of time.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你的身上带着某种特别的黑暗气息，冥王之子。那是女神倪克斯的古老披肩，我已经很长时间没感受到过它的存在了。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You have traveled recently beyond my senses, Son of Hades. I persist here only in the fathomless depths. I know what lies out there, having created it. But I know nothing of what it is like, right now. Do not tell me. I prefer to think of all the possibilities.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你最近去过的地方，已经超出了我的感知范畴，冥王之子。我待在这深不可测的冥界之渊，这里是我创造出来的，我也知道这里有什么。但我现在却不知道它到底是什么样子了。先不要告诉我，我更愿意去想象所有的可能性。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: From the rumblings of the earth, I have deduced your father, himself, stands against you when at last you are about to leave these depths. It must be quite an interaction between you. Have I deduced correctly? Respond.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That's right, Master Chaos. My father personally takes it upon himself to stop me in the event none of his underlings beat him to it. He... can be a handful.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Well, then. Consider bringing to one of your future interactions the small round catalyst, which I provided you. The one in the shape you call an egg? It shall serve no purpose there at all. Yet if you succeed, then it shall bring us some amusement, shall it not?

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 从大地的轰隆声中，我推断出当你终于要离开这个深渊的时候，你父亲本人出现了，阻止你离开这里。你们之间肯定发生了激烈的互动。我的推论正确吗？请回答。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是这样的，卡俄斯君主。如果我父亲的手下没能阻止我的话，他就会亲自来带我回去。他……是个棘手的敌人。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 如果是这样的话，在接下来的互动中，试试我送给你的圆形催化剂吧。它看起来就像个鸡蛋一样，你是这么称呼的吧？它的存在没有任何目的，但如果你能成功的话，它就会为我们带来一些乐趣，不是吗？

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: It seems to me that you are very close to death, O Son of Hades, and yet you deigned to visit me within my space. I could hasten your demise, if you so choose?

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我看，冥王之子，你已经快要死了，但你却屈尊来我的领地看我。如果你愿意，我可以让你死得快些？

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I almost did not notice you, O Son of Hades, for you are closer now to death than life. Perhaps, though, we can stave off the inevitable for a little while.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 冥王之子，我几乎没有注意到你，因为你现在更接近死亡，而不是生命。不过，也许我们可以暂时避开这件不可避免的事。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Your deaths are but a temporary setback, Son of Hades. Though it appears to me you are quite close to having such a setback, now.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你的死亡不过是临时的挫折而已，冥王之子。不过我感觉，这种挫折马上就要降临在你头上了。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Your next experience with death seems to be imminent, though let us see if I can hasten or forestall it.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你的下一次死亡很快就将来临了，看看我们是能加快它呢，还是拖慢它呢。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: It may seem cruel that I would wish you death, O Son of Hades. But from my perspective, it means you are much more likely to return to me.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 冥王之子啊，这听上去可能有点残忍，但我希望你死。因为根据我的判断，你死了之后更有可能会回到我身边。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Although you may succumb soon to your injuries, please make the most of your remaining life, rather than anticipate the next. The future is uncertain to all save the Fates.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 尽管你很快就伤重而死了，但还是希望你能充分利用余下的生命，而不是寄希望于下一次。除了命运之神以外，没人能知道自己的未来。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You come to my domain bearing an all-seeing artifact that sprang from me after the dawn of time. It is considered a defensive instrument, I do believe. Though, I suspect you have discovered, or soon shall discover, it is nothing of the sort.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你带着一个全视全知的制品来到了我的领域，它正是创世之初从我的身体中诞生的。我本打算把它做成作为一件防御性的工具，不过我猜你已经发现了，或者马上就要发现了，实际上并不是这么回事。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I expected your arrival, Son of Hades. For I am able to see through you. Rather, through the all-seeing artifact, which sprang from me after the dawn of time, and now resembles, in your hands, its foremost form. Respond.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, you must mean the Shield of Chaos, here? Your shield, Master Chaos, I should say. It's a remarkable artifact. Imposing, too! Your original creations must have been astounding.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Your response is acceptable. And I am grateful to have had my recent firsthand glimpses of this vast domain.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我已经预见到了你的到来，冥王之子，因为我能看到你所看到的一切。或者说，有了这件创世之初从我的身体中诞生的全视饰品，我可以通过它看到一切。在你的手中，它显现出了最初的形态。请回答。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么，您是指混沌之盾吗？我是说，您的盾，卡俄斯君主。它可真是无与伦比，无比威风！您的那些原初造物一定非常惊人吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我接受你的回答，我也很高兴，我最近已对这广阔的领域初窥端倪。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Ah, you have that all-seeing artifact of mine, but in the old guise that the great Lord Zeus once used when he retaliated violently against his parentage. I watched his movements through it for some time.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，你又拿着我的那件全视制品了，不过是以宙斯大人拼死反抗他父亲时用过的模样。有段时间，我就是通过它观察宙斯的动向。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I bear a message for you, Son of Hades. One recorded in an age when certain concepts it describes did not yet all exist. Remember this: I see you stand your ground against the serpent's flame. A waking-phrase, to which you and the all-seeing artifact of my creation may respond.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: A waking-phrase... and an all-seeing artifact, you must mean Aegis, right? So I'm to say to it, I see you stand your ground against the serpent's flame, and it'll wake right up. Though, can you tell me what it means, or who?

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Oh, I can tell you almost anything. However, I would much prefer it if you learned most of the answers you seek by yourself.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我有一事要传达给你，冥王之子。此事所描述的概念在其所处时代尚未出现。记住这句话：我看到你傲然屹立在巨蛇的烈焰之中。这是一句唤醒咒语，我创造出来的那件全视圣器和你或许会有所回应。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 唤醒咒语……还有全视圣器，你指的是埃癸斯，是吧？只要我对它说：“我看到你傲然屹立在巨蛇的烈焰之中，”它就会被唤醒。不过，你可以告诉我这句话是什么意思吗？是谁说的？

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，你想知道的一切，我差不多都可以告诉你。不过，我更希望你能靠自己的力量找到绝大部分问题的答案。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: This is not someone I recognize... so, in the name of Hades! Erm, hello? May I ask who's calling?
...The Olympians have all grown soft... would you not agree?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm... have we met?

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Oh, we have met, in a way. I know everybody, here, and there. You wish to leave this place? Then, it is my wish to make your doing so a little bit more interesting... and, if you encounter the Olympians someday, do give them my regards.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我不认识这个人……好吧，以哈迪斯之名！呃，你好？请问是谁在呼唤我？
……奥林匹斯山上的神都变得软弱了……你不这么认为吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃……我们见过面吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，我们通过某种形式见过面。我认识这里和那里的每个人。你想离开这里吗？那么，我希望你这样做的时候能更有趣一点……如果有一天你遇到了奥林匹斯山上的神，请代我向他们问好。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I sensed a certain rumbling here within the bowels of the earth. It is as though it had ingested something that did not sit well... perhaps the earth itself wishes to spit you up and out...?

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我在这里听见了来自地下深处的打斗声音。它好像吃了什么不对劲的东西……也许地球自己想把你吐出来……？

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: The Olympians are vying for your favor, are they not? So often they forget themselves. They force their blessings onto you, whilst I? I merely offer you a choice.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 奥林匹斯山上的神在博你的好感，不是吗？他们常常忘乎所以。他们把祝福强加给你，而我呢？我只是给你一个选择。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Your path is yours to shape as you see fit, regardless of the Fates' design. Together we may twist that path a bit, if you would like.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 不管命运之神的安排如何，你的人生由你自己决定。如果你愿意的话，我们可以一起走一段路。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I both expected you to come and am surprised to see you, Son of Hades. Where shall your journey take you from this point?

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 看到你来到这里，我既高兴，又惊讶，冥王之子。从这里出发，你会去到哪里呢？

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Please tell me how my power over all existence may be of small assistance to you this time, Son of Hades?

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 请告诉我，冥王之子，我控制万物的力量可以怎样帮助你呢？

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: The tremors underneath the earth foretold of your arrival at this very moment, Son of Hades; and, I have anticipated it.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 地下的震颤预示着你此刻的到来，冥王之子；而且，我已经预料到了。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You chose to visit me again within these darkest reaches of the earth, as I, in turn, now choose to offer you the means to alter your reality.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你选择在地球上最黑暗的地方再次拜访我，所以我，礼尚往来，现在提供一些方法帮你改变命运。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Back when I conceived the world and the immortals, Son of Hades, I did not expect you would be standing here before me now.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 当我构思世界和神时，冥王之子，我没想到你现在会站在我面前。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You have arrived at last, just as I wondered how we might best alter one another's courses of existence here today.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你终于到了，刚才我还在想，我们今天如何改变彼此的人生，从而和平相处。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Son of Hades, let me welcome your return here to my space within the Underworld, and bid you choose an alteration to the fabric of reality.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 冥王之子，欢迎你回到我在冥界的领地，请你选择一种方式来改变命运。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: It pleases me that you are here again; for, through you I can tinker with reality, along the fringes that are not yet fully formed.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我很高兴你又来了，因为，通过你，我可以修补命运，沿着尚未完全成形的边缘。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Your presence never ceases to intrigue me, Son of Hades; for you are not like the Olympians on high, who have forgotten me, or thusly choose to act.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 冥王之子，你的存在永远吸引着我，因为你不像那些忘记了我，或者就知道行动的奥林匹斯众神。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: From my perspective I have summoned you, whilst you believe you came of your volition; both statements can be true, is that not so?

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 从我的角度来看，是我召唤了你，而你认为你是自愿前来的；这两种说法都可能是真的，不是吗？

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Come forth, O Son of Hades, and together, let us sow my namesake through the depths of what your father thinks his own domain.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 冥王之子，出击吧，我们一同把我的名号深深根植在你父亲自认为是自有领地的深渊。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: How fares these days the never-ending cycle of rebirth and death for you, O Son of Hades? Sufficiently amusing, I should hope?

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 冥王之子，你这永无止境的轮回和重生之路，如今过得如何？我希望这足够有趣。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Out of the infinitely spanning possibilities before us, Son of Hades, I have arbitrarily selected only three again from which to let you choose.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 在我们面前无限延伸的可能性中，冥王之子，我只选择了三个选项让你选择。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: The Fates have much in store for you, O Son of Hades. Perhaps, however, we can tamper with their weavings here to some extent.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 冥王之子，命运之神为你安排了许多故事。然而，也许我们可以在一定程度上改变命数。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Let us conspire to expand and frustrate your lord father's sense of both what is and is not possible within his Underworld.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 让我们一起来创造新的可能性，让你父亲大人知道，冥界不再是他所想的那样。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Infinite possibilities can be tedious to choose from, so, let me provide you with a significantly smaller set with which you may yet change the Fates' designs.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 担心你有选择困难症，所以，我帮你缩小了选择范围，你可以用它们来冲破命运之神的束缚。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Through the expanse of time, I often wondered, is it necessary to be fair? The immortals are my offspring; surely I should treat them equally. And yet I find that there is little sport in doing so.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 在漫长的岁月中，我常常在想，我们一定要追求公平吗？诸神是我的后代；我当然应该对他们一视同仁。但我发现这样做毫无乐趣可言。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Among infinite possibilities, consider only these.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 在无尽的可能中，只考虑这些吧。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Choose carefully, in general, and now.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 总而言之，谨慎选择。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: We are the sum of all decisions that we make, and that are made for us.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我们是自己所作出的决策的总和，而这些选择是因为我们而存在的。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: This space grows far more interesting when you occupy a small amount of it.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 当你占据其中的一部分时，这片空间会变得更有趣。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: How you evaluate decisions is of limitless interest to me.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你如何评估这些决策，让我十分感兴趣。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: The burden of the passing time shall force a choice from you.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 时间流逝带来的压力会迫使你进行选择。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Is there not pleasure in determining an outcome, Son of Hades?

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 冥王之子啊，决定结果不是件让人开心的事吗？

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: My mark be with you, Son of Hades. You need merely choose its shape.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我赋予你我的印记，冥王之子，你只需要选择形态就好。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Though the waters of the Styx may wash away my mark, I can restore it.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 尽管冥河的水能洗去我的印记，但我可以将其恢复。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: The rhythm of your visits here over the course of time is pleasant, Son of Hades.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 随着时间的推移，你的来访让人很是愉快，冥王之子。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You are already back, and you are always welcome, Son of Hades.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你回来了，这里永远欢迎你，冥王之子。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Please visit me as frequently as you would like or dare.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 不管是有心还是有胆，请务必随时来访。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I find myself anticipating your arrivals, Son of Hades.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我已经预知了你的到来，冥王之子。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I require no exchange of words with you. Merely a choice.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我大可不必与你对话，只是我选择这样罢了。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Once more you have returned to my domain.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你又一次回到了我的领地。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I have a proposition, Son of Hades.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我有个提议，冥王之子。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I bid you welcome here within my space.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我在我的领地向你表示欢迎。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: How fares the solitary Son of Hades?

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 孤独的冥王之子现在怎么样了？

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: What shall we do for one another, Son of Hades?

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 冥王之子，我们该为彼此做些什么呢？

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You are within my presence, Son of Hades.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 来我面前，冥王之子。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: What brings you here to me this time around?

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 什么风把你吹到我这儿来了？

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Your such visits are agreeable with me.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你的拜访让我很高兴。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: How may the force of Chaos alter you?

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 来自混沌的力量会给你带来怎样的改变？

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You have arrived before me once again.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你又比我早到了。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I see that you are here, and so am I.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我看到你在这儿，我也在这儿。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You stand before me, Son of Hades.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你来到我面前，冥王之子。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: How shall we alter the intentions of the Fates?

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: How might I mend the fabric of existence for you, Son of Hades?

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我们将如何挣脱命运之神的束缚？

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我怎样才能改变你的现状呢，冥王之子？

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: There need not be a reason for your visit.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你随时都可以来找我。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: How may I shape reality for you?

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我该如何改变你的命运呢？

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You are always welcome here within this space.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 这里的大门始终为你敞开。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: What occupies your mind at this occasion?

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 此时此刻，你在想什么？

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Let us consider certain possibilities.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 让我们考虑一下某些可能性。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Among infinite outcomes, I propose these three.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 在众多的结果中，我提出了这三种结果。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Choose how to circumvent the Fates' design.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 选择如何打破命运之神的束缚。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Hail, Son of Hades.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 万岁，冥王之子。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I am amused to see you once again.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 很高兴再次见到你。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You have descended to my space once more.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你又一次来到我的领地。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You have returned to me.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你又回到了我的身边。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You are most welcome here.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 欢迎你。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Your presence is appreciated, Son of Hades, but please leave us here, for now.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 感谢你的来访，冥王之子，不过现在请离开吧。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Forgive us, Son of Hades, as we are amid exchanging memories.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 不好意思，冥王之子，我们正在交换记忆。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Son of Hades, I am pleased the goddess Nyx returned to me.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 冥王之子，我很高兴，女神倪克斯又回到我身边了。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Forgive me, Son of Hades, but I must continue this discussion with the goddess Nyx.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 不好意思，冥王之子，但是我得与女神倪克斯继续讨论了。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I had not seen the goddess Nyx in quite some time.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我已经有段时间没见过女神倪克斯了。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I am quite unaccustomed to having all this company of late.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我还不太习惯突然有人陪在我身边。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: My daughter was just in the midst of telling me the latest occurrences about your House.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我的女儿正在和我说你们圣殿的情况呢。

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: As you are able to observe, the goddess Nyx and I are in the midst of conversation now.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 如你所见，倪克斯女神正在和我谈话。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Master Chaos? Everyone makes offerings to my relatives upon Olympus. I wish to make an offering to you. Thank you for... everything.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: How droll of you to make attempts to tempt me with material things. Here, then, please in turn allow me this attempt at reciprocity.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 卡俄斯君主？每个人都向我在奥林匹斯山上的亲人贡献礼物。我想送您一个礼物。谢谢您所做的一切。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你真可笑，竟然想用物质的东西来诱惑我。那么，请允许我也俗套一下。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: This is for you, Master Chaos. Everyone beneath the heavens and earth enjoys this stuff.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You honor me in making such an offering, though please; it is not necessary to endear yourself using material means, for it is the thought alone which counts.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 卡俄斯君主，这是给您的礼物。凡界和冥界的每个人都享受它的口味。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 虽然你通过礼物表达对我的尊敬，但我还是很高兴；其实你没有必要用物质的方式表达对我的亲近，因为只有思想上的尊敬才是最重要的。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Master Chaos, forebear of the gods, it is an honor to have met you. Please, accept this gift.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Seldom do mortals or immortals think of making offerings to me. As I do not expect such token gestures, I am very much amused, and I accept.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 卡俄斯君主，众神之祖，很荣幸认识您。请收下这个礼物。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 凡人或神仙很少想到送我礼物。由于我没想到过这种象征性的表示，我觉得很有趣，我接受了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Master Chaos, I pledge never to forget you or your good graces. May your wisdom and your whim forever guide me.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Is this an offering of fealty or friendship, Son of Hades? I do not wish to know from you the answer, so that I might dwell on it and all the possibilities.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 卡俄斯君主，我发誓永远不会忘记您和您的恩宠。愿您的智慧和新奇想法永远指引我。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 这是表达忠诚的礼物还是表达友谊的礼物，冥王之子？我不想从你那里得到答案，这样我就可以仔细考虑它和所有的可能性。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm ever-grateful that my journeys through the Underworld mean that we can get to know each other, Master Chaos.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: Your repeated generosity with me is starting to become a bit predictable, and yet... somehow, I nonetheless appreciate it, still. How very odd.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我穿越冥界的旅程让我们可以互相了解，这种经历我会永远铭记，卡俄斯君主。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你对我一直这么慷慨，我已经有点习惯了，然而……不管怎样，我还是很感激。这真是奇怪。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Master Chaos, it's little wonder all existence sprang from you, because I see the noble qualities in so many I've met embodied in you. Please, accept this gift.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: If it is unclear yet, Son of Hades, I shall not be giving more to you in exchange for your repeated offerings. You give them to me knowing it shall serve no purpose and achieve no end. I know that there are some among both mortals and your kind for whom this is quite unacceptable.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 卡俄斯君主，一切生命都起源于您，这一点毫无疑问，因为我在您身上看到了我所认识的人所具有的全部优点。请收下这份礼物吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 我再澄清一次，冥王之子，对于你反复的进贡，我不会再给你任何回礼了。如果你执意如此，你得明白这些礼物毫无意义，也不会为你带来任何回报。我知道，这对一部分凡人和神明而言是完全无法接受的。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: This is the greatest delicacy of Olympus, Master Chaos. It's for you. I think normally it would be difficult for the Olympians to get it to you here.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: You make an even greater offering to me, knowing it shall produce no material result. You are aware that I am not persuadable? Yours is a squandering of resources and time. Although, of course, we do have each of these in great supply. Now then, respond.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...I just think the act of giving isn't quite the same as an exchange. I know I won't be getting any sort of other talisman or something in return. But, through these offerings, I can express my thanks. That's worth it by itself.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: ...I see. So then, the action is akin to theft. For you are getting something in return that I did not intend to give. I still have much to learn from my creations, Son of Hades. So let us say that we have made an even trade. My learning for your worth.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这是给您的礼物，卡俄斯君主，是来自奥林匹斯最为精贵的物品。通常来说，想把它从奥林匹斯山运到您这里来，还是很困难的。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 你明知这不会带来任何物质回报，却依然送给了我这件更加珍贵的东西。你应该明白，我没那么容易被说服的吧？你是在浪费时间和资源，尽管这两种东西我们有的是。好了，请答复吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: ……我觉得给予跟交换是两码事。我知道不会再得到护身符之类的东西。但是通过这种给予，我可以表达自己的谢意，这样就足够了。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: ……我明白了，那么这种行为就类似于盗窃了，因为你得到了我并没有打算给予你的东西。看来，从我自己的造物身上，我要学习的还有不少呢，冥王之子。那么今天这次就算是一笔公平交易了。我学到了，你也满足了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: If you'll forgive me, Master Chaos, this Ambrosia is intended to be given to those whom I care about, and I can think of few recipients I'd like to have it more. Please.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: I shall accept this, as a final offering, O Son of Hades. For I have given it additional consideration, and decided that my previous analysis of your intentions was too narrow, too inaccurate. And, I regret comparing what you have been doing to an act of theft. Respond?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Don't even mention it, please, Master Chaos. All of this is new for me, as well. I try never to overanalyze... my father does enough of that for all of us. I just know, when I encounter the primordial creator, I am going to give thanks. For everything.

en.speaker: Chaos
en.text: ...I see. Then, your response is quite acceptable. And, since the act of giving is not an exchange, let us say that you already had my gratitude.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 抱歉打扰，卡俄斯君主。这瓶仙馔密酒是送给我所关心的人的礼物，而我想不到有谁能比您更配得上它了。请吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: 冥王之子啊，我欣然接受这最后的进贡。另外我重新考虑了一下对你的看法，我觉得我之前的想法太过狭隘，有失偏颇。我不能把你的行为称为盗窃。请回答？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没什么大不了的，卡俄斯君主。这一切对我来说也是全新的。我试着不去过度解读大家……父亲对我们的过度解读已经太多太多。我只知道，如果我遇到了原初的造物主，我一定要对其表示感谢，感谢这所有一切。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡俄斯
zh-CN.text: ……我明白了，你的回复可以接受。既然给予不代表交换，那样的话我就对你表示感谢了。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Stupid boy. I told you nobody gets out of here, whether alive or dead. Though, how was your wanton ransacking of my domain?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Greetings, Father. My ransacking was a delight, thank you for asking. So, I'll just be on my way, again.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Be on your way, indeed. What do I care? You shall never reach the surface. Go, see for yourself.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 傻孩子。我说过了不管是死人还是活人，没人能离开这里。不过，这次在我的领地搞破坏感觉怎么样啊？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 您好，父亲。这次搞破坏非常开心，谢谢您的关心。没什么事，我就继续前进了。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 那你就去吧。我才不在乎。你永远不可能去到地面。不信你就去试试吧。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: What is it, now? I've a mountain of infernal parchmentwork.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 又怎么了？我这里有一大堆的文件要处理。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Out of my sight, now, go.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 别烦我了，快点走吧。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: To what do I owe the pleasure, boy? For I'm unaccustomed to being approached by you here in my House.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, you know. Just thought I'd check in, see what you were up to. Parchmentwork going all right, I'm sure?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Oh yes, the parchmentwork is going splendidly. Would you care for some? There is no shortage of it, you see.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 太阳打西边出来啦，小子？在这大殿里，我可真不习惯你主动来找我。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃。我就是感觉我应该来看看你在忙些什么。契约文书之类的一切都还好吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，是啊，文书工作正在有条不紊地进行。你打算做一部分吗？如你所见，这里的文书工作多得做不完。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Father, what happened to the lounge? The only place for anyone to have a little fun around here, and you seal it shut.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Oh, I had little choice about that, boy. You see, after you fled the first time, Cerberus, why he was very much upset. Utterly tore the place to shreds. It's now under repair. All thanks to you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're really blaming me for not minding the dog while I was out, and while you all were here?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I lay the blame entirely upon you, yes. Who else? It's fortunate that Cerberus has calmed himself since then! Come to his senses, I should say. May you yet come to yours.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲，休息室那边怎么回事？那是这里唯一能让大家娱乐放松的地方，您怎么给封起来了？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，这事可不能怨我，孩子。听我说，你第一次溜出去之后，刻耳柏洛斯非常伤心。然后就把那地方全毁了。现在正在修整当中。拜你所赐啊。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 您的意思是，我出门之后还得管着家里的狗是吧，您坐在这里干嘛呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 没错，责任全部在你身上，还能有谁？幸亏刻耳柏洛斯此后平静下来了！它找回了它的理智，我希望你哪天也能找回你的理智。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Who's that sniveling shade to your immediate left, there, Father? Already found someone new to do the busywork. And here I thought I was utterly indispensable.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: That shade, boy, is my newly designated contractor; one whose responsibility is to work on this House. Though, who shall pay for everything my subjects here demand, I do not know.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're trying to guilt me into funding the exorbitant furnishings you desire.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Perhaps once we are finished with repairs for all the carnage you have sown throughout my realm, then we might finally have time for all the needed renovations that have piled up.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你左边那位哭哭啼啼的幽灵是谁，父亲？看来你已经找到其他人来做这些无聊工作了。我还以为我是无可替代的呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 他是我新找的承包商，小子，专门负责圣殿内的事务。不过说到底，究竟是谁应该为所有这些东西买单呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你想道德绑架我让我为你这些贵得要死的家具出钱？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你在我的领地大开杀戒，留下满目疮痍，或许打扫完这一片狼藉之后，我们才能腾出时间来处理堆积如山的修整工作。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You have been keeping our contractor rather busy, I must say. Commissioning these frivolous projects around the House with the wealth you wrest from my domain. What are you hoping to achieve?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, you know, just giving back to the community. Figure if I'm to keep getting dragged back here it might as well be somewhat livable.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Livable! When last I checked, making the Underworld livable was not among our top priorities. Just remember, in your brazenness, whose House this is.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你可让我们的承包商有的忙了。你从我的领地上掠夺财富、然后来做这些华而不实的东西，你到底想怎么样？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，我只是知恩图报罢了。如果我不断被强行送回这里，这地方说不定真的就适合住人了。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 适合住人！据我所知，让这冥界变得宜居根本不在考虑范围内。在你嚣张的时候你还要记得，这里归谁管。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You have been keeping our contractor rather busy, I must say. Commissioning these frivolous projects around the House with the wealth you wrest from my domain. What are you hoping to achieve?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, you know, just giving back to the community. Figure if I'm to keep getting dragged back here it might as well be somewhat livable.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你可让我们的承包商有的忙了。你从我的领地上掠夺财富、然后来做这些华而不实的东西，你到底想怎么样？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，我只是知恩图报罢了。如果我不断被强行送回这里，这地方说不定真的就适合住人了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: There's quite a lot of renovating to be done, isn't there, Father. Your House Contractor there has shown a wide variety of pending jobs.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I've ordered Nyx to supervise that list. Entirely her problem, boy. And likely yours. How does it feel, knowing that your rampages create the need for so much maintenance?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Feels pretty good, now that you mention it. Keeps everybody occupied, no?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲，我们还有很多修整工作要做，对吗？你的圣殿承包商列出了一张长长的工作清单。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我已经下令让倪克斯来监工。完全是她的问题，孩子。也有可能是你的。知道自己的莽撞行为需要这么多的修缮工作，你有什么想法吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 既然您问，那我告诉您，我感觉挺好的。让每个人都有事情做，不是吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know, Father! I must say ransacking your domain beats having to toil endlessly in the administrative chamber. Far less painful, really.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Hah! Is that your way of asking me for your old job back, boy? You were a scourge upon every administrative duty to which you were assigned.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Yes, please, Father, give me back my old, wretched job, won't you?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Privileges are earned not begged for, boy. Unless you plan to reimburse this House for all the income that we lost because of you, then you shall not so much as set foot in the administrative chamber, again.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: How much is the reimbursement fee, anyway?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Whichever exorbitant amount the House Contractor has on record, now leave me be!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我不得不说，父亲大人！洗劫你的领地远远胜过待在行政办公室里无休止地工作。爽太多了，真的。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 哈！你就是这么和我说话，好让我答应你重操旧业吗，孩子？你简直是个祸害，让你干的行政工作你全都搞砸了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，拜托你了，父亲。让我回去干以前那份糟心的活吧，好不好？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 特权是赢来的，不是求人求来的，孩子。拜你所赐，这座圣殿损失了不少收入。除非你打算赔偿你造成的损失，否则你别想再踏进管理大厅一步了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那我到底要赔多少钱呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你去找圣殿承包商，看看他那里记了多少吧，别再来烦我了！

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: So help me, boy, I cannot fathom why you would have bought back the authority to enter the administrative chamber once again.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I knew you thought I'd never do it under any circumstances, Father. That seemed reason enough. Though, fear not, I've no plans to reapply for a position there.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: That does alleviate a deeply rooted fear of mine, in fact. The scene you caused in your brief time there yet remains a widely talked-about event among the shades who toil for me still.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 回答我，小子，我完全不能理解你为何要重新申请进入行政大厅的权限。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我就知道你肯定以为我一辈子都不会那么做，父亲大人，而那就是我的理由。但是你别担心，我可不会申请什么职位。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 其实那令我意外地放心。许多为我劳碌的幽灵还对上次你短暂的工作所造成的混乱历历在目。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Always wanted to ask you something, Father. Whose skull is that there on your shoulder? If it's not too personal.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I did not chronicle all Typhon's wretched offspring, boy. No one did. Some of them sit upon our shoulders now, lest we forget that things could easily have turned out rather differently, and much, much worse.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So these are just the remains of the spawn of the most hideous monstrosity of all time, which you and your brothers slew, got it. I guess putting the dead in their place is all part of the job. I can hardly imagine what it was like before you and the Olympians took charge.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 有一件事我想问很久了，父亲。如果你不介意的话，能不能告诉我你肩膀上的头骨是谁的？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我不记得巨人提丰的所有子嗣，孩子。没人能记得。他们之中的某些现在就在我们的肩膀上，以免我们忘记，一切原本会与现在完全不同，甚至要更加、更加可怕。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 所以你和你的兄弟们杀了史上最凶恶残暴的怪物，而这些就是他后代的遗骨咯？我猜你们想让他们死得其所。我简直无法想象在你和奥林匹斯众神掌管天地以前，世界是什么样的。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Be certain that you take appropriate precautions with the Sigil of the Dead that you now bear. Should some misfortune come to it through negligence, it cannot be replaced.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I can't imagine what I'd do without your blessing, Father! But, thank you again. I don't often inherit Fate-appointed honors, and will take good care of it. Though... what if the Olympians catch on? Wouldn't do for everybody knowing that you're aiding me even a little, right?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Correct. It would not do, at all. Fortunately, the power of the Unseen can remain well-hidden as it pleases. What is it your instructor always says?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...Fear is for the weak?

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你已经把死者印记带在身上了，一定要确保你采取了恰当的防范措施。如果由于你的疏忽导致它出了什么意外，我这里可没有备用的了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 真不敢想象没了你的庇佑我能做些什么，父亲！好吧，我仍要谢谢你。继承命中注定的荣誉并不常见，我会珍惜它的。但……要是被奥林匹斯众神知道了怎么办？是不是不能让所有人都知道你帮了我一点小忙？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 对。你很走运，无形者的力量可以随时隐藏自身；还记得你的老师总是怎么教导你的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: ……恐惧是弱者的专利？

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Those Chthonic Companion things you have from Nyx, or whoever they ended up with... I know they have been benefiting you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Yeah, well... I'm to attempt to escape this place by any means necessary, right? I figure if I can call on Olympus for aid, maybe some of my friends can help me in a pinch, as well.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Not what I mean. Some of your friends have been reluctant to engage against me during our scuffles on the surface. Know that I have authorized them to proceed, if necessary.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, really? You're saying it's OK for your own loyal subjects to side against you up there? You won't take it out on them?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I consider it an expansion of their responsibilities. Now, go.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你从倪克斯那里得到的神秘伴偶……或者不管是从谁那里拿的……我知道它们在协助你。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是的，这么说吧……我打算采取一切手段逃出这个地方，是吧？我觉得如果我呼唤奥林匹斯众神寻求援助的话，或许我的一部分朋友可以在危难时刻助我一臂之力。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我不是那个意思。我是说，我们俩在地表战斗时，你的某些朋友显然不太情愿违抗我。现在我准许他们在必要时这样做了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等等，真的吗？你刚刚说即使你那些忠实下属在那里与你为敌也没关系？你真的不会追究他们的责任？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我将把那视为他们的义务之一。去吧。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So tell me, Father. Just how much did it hurt your soul knowing my face is up there on the Featured Houseservant Board, for all in the lounge to see?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Has it occurred to you that I, alone, have final say about whose countenance is shown up there? Although, others who shall not be named did put in a good word for you, repeatedly.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Blood and darkness... all my life I thought that board was a joke. But seeing my face up there... it felt good. Thanks, Father. Maybe it won't be the last time.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲，我想问问：你看，我当上了优秀圣殿仆从，整个休息室都看着我的大头照，这事你难不难受？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你以为哪个人的照片会挂在那里，全都是我一个人能拍板决定的吗？不过，确实有些不愿透露姓名的人说过你的好话，说了好几次。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 鲜血与黑暗啊……我一直以为那个展板不过是个笑话罢了。可看到我自己的照片挂在上面……感觉还挺不错的。谢了，父亲，或许我还会再上榜呢。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Indulge me for a moment, boy. Why bother to construct a sundial, there? Knowing full well it was my wish to have one installed. To demonstrate your awe-inspiring authority? Or to deny me the small pleasure of doing it myself?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Maybe a little of each? Or maybe you ought not second-guess my every motive and decision, constantly, searching for some sinister agenda that has yet to cross my mind?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Pah! I would have chosen an entirely different marble texture for it, anyway.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 打扰一下，孩子，你干嘛要在那个地方安装个日晷呢？你明知道我一直都想安装个日晷。你这么做，是想展现一下你令人敬畏的权威吗？还是不想让我体验自己动手的乐趣？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 或许两者都有吧？或许，你不应该总是在揣测我做每件事的动机，妄想着那些我根本就没想过的邪恶念头，你说呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 哈！反正要是让我来的话，我是不会选这种大理石材质的。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Guess what, Father? The lounge is all tidied up. Your House Contractor there is quite efficient once you muster up the necessary funds. You should try it sometime!

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Are you expecting words of thanks because you paid the contractor to fix a bit of devastation that you caused? I fear it shall take rather more than that.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What if I replaced every furnishing in this blasted place, would you treat me any better then?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I suppose, boy, that there's only one way to find out. Though I suggest you save yourself the trouble.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你猜怎么着，父亲？休息室整理好了。只要钱到位了，你那位承包商办起事来效率过人。有时间你也试试吧！

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你花钱修好你一手造成的破坏，难道还要我夸你不成？我觉得你想要的不止夸奖而已。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果我把这破地方的家具全部换新，您能不能对我态度好点？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我认为，你可以试试，孩子。不过我还是建议你省点力气比较好。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I see you've decided to come home. Changed your mind yet, or looking for more pain and suffering?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: More pain and suffering, for sure. After all, you taught me to appreciate the finer things.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You keep telling yourself that, boy. But, mark you my words, sooner or later, this life that you have chosen for yourself shall teach you I was right.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你回来了啊。改变主意了吗，还是打算接着挨打受苦？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那当然是接着挨打受苦了。毕竟是您教的我要学会追求更好的东西。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 随你怎么说，孩子。不过，给我记住了，总有一天，你自己选择的路会告诉你，我是对的。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Well that was quick. What news, boy, ready to give up, or no?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You'd like that, wouldn't you? Lucky I've got other family who believe in me.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Be careful whom you give your trust. My brothers frolic on Olympus while we work. While I work! You're just like them. No wonder they like you.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 这么快就回来了？怎么样，孩子，要放弃吗，嗯？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你是想那样的吧？所幸我有另一家人信任我。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 不要随随便便轻信他人。我的兄弟们在奥林匹斯娱乐嬉戏，而我却在努力工作！你跟他们一样，难怪他们喜欢你。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: So, how did it go? How did you die ignobly this time, pray tell? Cerberus and I can't wait to hear the tale.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: In that case, I'll spare you the details.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Fine. Your failure is quite easily imagined. How often it recurs! Almost as though my realm is built to keep you here. You, and every single soul that's ever lived. But, by all means, continue struggling.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 进展如何？不吝赐教，这次你是怎么个死法？我和刻耳柏洛斯都等不及想听听了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这样的话，那我就不说了。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 好。你的失败真是显而易见，次数太多了！仿佛我的领地存在就是为了困住你一样。困住你，还有每一位曾经活着的灵魂。当然了，你可以继续挣扎。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Welcome home, boy. You're late for dinner... or, breakfast, or whatever blasted meal's next.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That's all right, Father. I'm not feeling very hungry at the moment.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: ...I've asked repeatedly for the construction of a sundial, but every time, they tell me no, can you believe it? Your impertinence with me inspires all.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 欢迎回家，孩子。你错过了晚饭……还是早饭，或者其他什么乱七八糟的饭。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没事，父亲。我现在还不饿。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: ……我问了好几次，每次我让他们建一座日晷的时候，他们都不干，真是难以置信。你对我的无礼都让他们给学去了。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Welcome home, boy. You're late for dinner... or, breakfast, or whatever blasted meal's next.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That's all right, Father. I'm not feeling very hungry at the moment.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: ...I've asked repeatedly for the construction of a sundial, but every time, they tell me no, can you believe it?

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 欢迎回家，孩子。你错过了晚饭……还是早饭，或者其他什么乱七八糟的饭。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没事，父亲。我现在还不饿。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: ……我要求了无数次让他们造一台日晷，但每次他们都说不行，真是难以置信。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Blood and darkness, but this place is falling apart... nobody works an honest day down here.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Father, everybody's dead. Give them a break.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: What would you even know of honest work? At least the wretched dead yet honor me as Lord. I cannot say the same for you.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 血与黑暗啊，真是可恶，这地方正分崩离析……根本没人在踏实工作。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲，大家都是死人了。您就饶了他们吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道什么叫踏实工作吗？最起码那些可怜的死人还知道尊称我为大人。那你可就不一样了。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Have you yet satisfied your foolish urges? Perhaps a lashing from the Furies' whips would set you straight.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I had it out with them already, thanks.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Such nonsense. First you defy me openly, and now you lie. On my next meeting with the Furies, we'll have a word about all this, you rest assured.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 满足自己愚蠢的冲动了吗？也许复仇三女神的皮鞭能让你清醒过来。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我跟她们交过手了，谢谢。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 一派胡言。你先是公然蔑视我，现在又撒谎。你放心，我下次跟复仇女神见面的时候，我们会讨论一下这个问题的。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Why, I can scarce believe my eyes, is that you, boy?! Cerberus, look who it is, he's back!

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Cerberus looks mournfully toward the Prince.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No need to drag the dog into this, Father.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Anything you say to me, you say in front of Cerberus! You might even learn a thing or two from him of listening, and of obedience!

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 哈，我是老眼昏花了吗，是你吗，小子？！刻耳柏洛斯，看看是谁回来了！

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯悲哀地看向王子。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 别把狗也扯进来，父亲。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你对我说的话，刻耳柏洛斯也能听到！你或许还能从他身上学点什么，学会听话，学会服从！

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: He's back already, Cerberus! Just as I indicated.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm standing right here, Father.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I'm sorry he disturbed your rest again, Cerberus, you've done a good job. The realm is well defended still, to the high standard that you set.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 他回来了，刻耳柏洛斯！就和我想得一样。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我回来了，父亲。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 不好意思他又打扰你休息了，刻耳柏洛斯，但你做得很好。这地方依然守备森严，符合你定下的高标准。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: What did I tell you, boy? Ever wasteful of your time, and mine. How fares my Underworld, hm?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I don't know how you can stand it.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Well, at least some things are running smoothly still. Next you go to die again, do give the tortured souls out there my warm regards.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我是怎么告诉你的，孩子？你总是在浪费你自己的时间，还有我的时间。我的冥界怎么样，嗯？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我都不知道您是怎么熬过来的。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 起码有些事情依然在稳定地运转。下次你死的时候，记得给那些受折磨的灵魂带去我温暖的慰问。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Ah, for shame, boy. I thought perhaps you'd finally made it out.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Really...? I mean, oh, wait, you're not serious. That famous sense of humor shining through.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I jest, of course, you'll never make it out; as I keep telling you to no avail. But you've gone farther than expected. So, who knows....

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，真丢人啊，孩子。我还以为这次你应该能成功了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 真的吗…？我是说，等下，原来你开玩笑呢。这强大的幽默感真是让我猝不及防。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我当然是在开玩笑呢，就像我一直说的那那样，你永远不可能成功。不过你到的地方比我想得更远，所以，谁知道呢……

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: ...You've been gone a while...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm going to find Mother. No matter how long it takes me.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: For the last time, you're not to speak about that woman in my House. You want to know of her so much, you go find her, indeed.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: ……你离开有段时间了……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我要去找母亲。不管要花多久。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 最后再说一次，你不准再在我的圣殿里提这个女人。你要想了解她，你就自己去找她。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I know that Nyx has been abetting you. You wish to take advantage of her pity? I care not. Her powers have their limits, anyway.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: How can you... Nyx is the Night Itself, and can do as she pleases, isn't that correct, Father? You think I asked she get involved in all this business?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You, boy, have already dragged this entire household, not to mention my fool relatives, into this mess, which you've created. Which you dare call business.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 是倪克斯在煽动你吧。你想利用她的怜悯？我无所谓。无论如何，她的力量是有极限的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你怎么能……倪克斯是夜的化身，她想做什么都行，是这样的吧，父亲？你觉得是我把她扯进这些事情里的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 小子，我们这一家人，更别提还有那些愚蠢的亲戚，全都卷进了你制造的这场混乱当中。你还敢管这叫事情？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So, tell me something, Father, if you please. Since we're more candid lately in regard to matters of my birthright here, and all... did you and Mother... how to put this? Any brothers or sisters I should know about?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I thought I told you never to invoke her here! Be thankful that you have no blasted kin. You've such weak blood, and such a temperament... why, then, would you think I'd risk another, such as you?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sure, that's fair enough, it's just not all such things occur as planned, as I am told. From tales of your brothers and so forth.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Oh, blast my brothers, and blast you, as well! All those who know me know I have no heir. You could not rise to the occasion if you tried! And, there is no one else. You've only me. And I have only you.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那么，我们就开诚布公地说一说吧，父亲大人。既然我们最近能够更坦率地讨论我的继承权问题，那么……你和我的母亲……怎么说好呢，我是不是还有其他的兄弟姐妹？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我记得我跟你说过，别在我面前提她！庆幸你是独生子吧。你这么没用，而且又是这种性情……我何必冒这个险，再生一个像你这样的儿子或女儿呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 当然，你的想法很有道理，但有时候总是事与愿违。至少从你那些兄弟们的传闻里我是这么觉得的。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，我那些兄弟和你都不是什么好东西！认识我的人都知道我没有继承人。如果你曾有心尝试，就不可能走到今天这般境况！而且，现在我们家再也没有其他人了。只有你，和我。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You call my chambers a mess, look at your desk, Father! Whatever happened to your court musician, huh, where's his sentencing parchmentwork? Stuck in Tartarus, all because he stopped singing for you on command?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: My desk is far more organized than you, boy! And if you're so concerned about our court musician, why don't you commute his sentence, yourself? Seeing as I haven't gotten around to it yet.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sure, happy to oblige. I'll just ask the House Contractor since you're too busy.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你说我的房间像个猪圈，那你看看你自己的桌子吧，父亲！你知不知道你的宫廷乐师遇到了什么事情，嗯？他的判决书在什么地方？他被困在了塔耳塔罗斯，这都是因为他不愿听令为你唱歌，你知道吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我的办公桌比你的可有条理多了，小子！如果你真的那么关心我们的宫廷乐师，那么你何不亲自替他受刑？我一直没时间着手处理这件事。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 何乐而不为呢。既然你这么忙，我会先问问大殿里的承包商。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I understand you have attempted to persuade our court musician to resume his craft. That is among the relatively useful tasks to which you have applied yourself of late.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I can't be completely sure but, what you said just now I think contained some of the component pieces of a compliment?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I'm certain that your boasts and twists of words shall soon inspire him to greater acts of compositional superiority, one of these days or nights.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道，你之前试图说服我们的乐师重新施展他的才华。这是你最近做过的比较有用的事情。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我虽然不敢肯定，但你刚才说的话里是不是带有一点赞美的意思？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我确定你的油嘴滑舌肯定能给他带来非常多的创作灵感。

en.speaker: Hades
