en.text: I had a feeling that our court musician would eventually come back to his senses and his talents, boy. Here, yet again, my intuitions were correct. Though, you appear a bit perturbed. Don't like the song? It's about you!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It says I'm really the bastard son of Zeus, but also indelibly connected to the god of wine, and how your parents tore me to pieces, giving rise to mortals, but that I'm always going to be stuck here.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You fill Orpheus' mind with nonsense, he produces nonsense. Nonsense I presume shall spread from this place far and wide, so everyone might know that I have nothing to do with you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm not worried. Orpheus plays for a very small audience.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我有预感我们的乐师最后一定能重拾他的天赋和技艺，孩子。我的直觉又准了一次。你看起来似乎有点烦恼。不喜欢这首歌吗？主题可是你哦！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 歌里说我其实是宙斯的私生子，跟酒神也有不可分割的联系，还被泰坦们大卸八块，最后复活成为凡人，但我将永远被困在这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯这家伙一天到晚胡言乱语都是和你学的。真希望这通胡言乱语传遍大江南北，好让大家都知道我跟你一点关系都没有。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我觉得不大可能。因为俄耳甫斯的听众并不多。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Father, I met an oak nymph called Eurydice. You know her name, I think. Is it really true what happened between her and Orpheus? They say you almost let her out, so why not me?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Pah! Orpheus is a talented musician, and a fool. I knew he would never get his beloved wife out of here. There's no escape for her, or anyone, including you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So you tricked him. Or maybe offered him a deal in bad faith. No matter. What's it going to take to waive the separation order between them?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: That's non-negotiable, boy. Waiving a separation order! That's a veritable fortune in dues alone. Off the table. Now, go mind your own affairs, and leave the waiving and the ordering to me.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲，我遇到了一位叫欧律狄克的橡树仙女。你应该知道她。她跟俄耳甫斯之间的事是真的吗？他们说你差点让她离开了这里，那你为什么不让我离开？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 呸！俄耳甫斯是个才华横溢的音乐家，也同时是个蠢货。我一开始就知道他不可能把他的妻子带出去。她，或任何人，包括你，都不可能逃出去。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你把他耍了。或者说跟他进行了一次不公平交易。无所谓。要怎样才能撤销他们之间的分居令？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 这事没得谈，小子。撤销分居令！这可要花好大一笔钱。这件事没得商量。你还是忙自己的事去吧，这种事就不劳你费心了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Father, have you ever considered that Orpheus might be much better as a court musician if you permitted him to see his muse again?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I have considered many possibilities, boy. And I trust Orpheus considered many possibilities before he signed away his rights to see his so-called muse when once he invaded my realm!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So you're forcing him to stay here for eternity just because he signed a contract with you?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Contracts with me are binding! Until such time as they dig themselves out of the archives and tear themselves up! And I don't see that happening anytime soon.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲大人，你有没有想过，如果俄耳甫斯能见到他的灵感女神，他或许能够将他的音乐才能发挥得更好？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我考虑过很多可能性，小子。 我相信俄耳甫斯在入侵我的领地时、在他自愿放弃见他所谓的灵感女神之前，也已经考虑了许多可能性！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 所以，就因为他和你签了合同，你就可以强迫他在这里待一辈子？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 和我签的合同是有约束力的！除非他们从档案卷宗里把它找出来，然后亲手撕毁！不过在近期，这是不可能发生的。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Father, let's say, hypothetically, that I could pay the dues to waive the separation order between Orpheus and Eurydice. Would you honor the new terms, or spitefully cheat me out of a fair deal?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I honor the terms of my commitments, boy. The rules we put in place are all that keep this Underworld in any semblance of a shape! But, what you ask is utterly absurd. The costs of processing a separation order are well beyond your means.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲大人，假设我愿意付出代价，撤销俄耳甫斯和欧律狄克之间的分居令。您可以接受新的条款吗，还是会故意骗我答应你的无理要求？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 小子，我只接受自己承诺过的条款。这些规定是维持冥界表面和平的基石！但你的要求简直太荒谬了。撤销分居令的代价你根本无法承担。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You voided the contract with our court musician. Used your own authority against me.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So what if I did? Just gives him a bit of break from time to time. He's still your court musician, isn't he?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: He is. And he knows better than to undermine me, I think. Out with you, then! I'll deal with your insubordination some other time.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 是你让宫廷乐师签的合同失效。是你利用手上的权力忤逆我。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是我又怎么样？我只是想让他有一些休息的时间。他还是你的宫廷乐师，不是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 他确实是。而且我认为他非常清楚不该冒犯我的权威。现在你给我出去！我另找时间来处理你的桀骜不驯。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You voided the contract with our court musician. Used your own authority against me.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So what if I did? Just gives him a bit of break from time to time. He's still your court musician, isn't he?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: He is. And he knows better than to undermine me, I think. Though, I suppose the Queen would take your side that he has paid his dues in full, by now...?

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 是你让宫廷乐师签的合同失效。是你利用手上的权力忤逆我。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是我又怎么样？我只是想让他有一些休息的时间。他还是你的宫廷乐师，不是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 他确实是。而且我认为他非常清楚不该冒犯我的权威。不过，我觉得冥后可能会和你一样，觉得他已经还清了所欠……？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Father, let me ask you something work-related, here. I know the shade called Sisyphus once wronged both you and Thanatos, and has since paid a heavy price. But don't the Fury Sisters now have better things to do than torture him?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You come to me to question how I allocate my resources? Preposterous. I care nothing for that wretched shade. That he is tortured for eternity is but a technicality resulting from his arrogance. The terms of his incarceration are long lost!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So then if I could somehow find those terms, then theoretically, I could grant him a pardon...

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: If you could somehow do your job, and enact miracles, then yes! You could do anything, then, I suppose. Including waste your time on those of his undeserving ilk.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲，我可以问一些和工作有关的问题吗？我知道这个叫西西弗斯的幽灵过去对你和塔纳托斯做了过分的事，他也因此付出了惨重的代价。但除了折磨他，复仇女神们现在没其他事可做了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你过来就是为了质疑我对人力的分配吗？真可笑。我才不会在乎那个该死的幽灵。他饱受折磨也是咎由自取，谁让他如此傲慢自大。他的关押判决书早就丢了！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 所以，如果我可以找到判决书，从理论上来说，我就可以赦免他？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 如果你可以做好自己的工作，并且引发奇迹的话，那么确实如此！到时候，你想干什么都可以，包括在这些不值一提的家伙身上浪费时间。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You altered one of my own pacts, without so much as seeking my consent... undoing terms that were agreed upon. Do you intend to undermine everything in this House, boy? Or only me?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Only you, Father. Good thing I've inherited some of your Fate-given authority, being your son and all. Otherwise some of your most loyal subjects would be bound by exploitive terms for eternity.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Terms that they chose, themselves! Terms to the benefit of this House. What if Achilles were to leave his post for the green pastures of Elysium, what then?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You could find a replacement? But it's a pointless question anyway, because he's here! He isn't leaving. He might even do better at his job, now that he has increased ability to step away from it.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: A naive hope, at best. The more you step away from your responsibilities, the less you shall want anything to do with them.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你篡改了我亲自订下的契约，却没有征得我的同意……你撤销了那些早就成为共识的条款。孩子，你是打算破坏这座圣殿里的一切吗？还是说，你只是想推翻我？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是你的错觉而已，父亲。事实上，我能成为你的儿子，拥有这一切，这就是命运赐予我的权利。如果我不这么做的话，你那些最忠诚的仆人们永远都会受到那些剥削条款的束缚。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 那些条款都是他们自己签的！是他们自己！那些条款会为圣殿带来好处，否则如果阿喀琉斯打算擅离职守、前往至福乐土，该怎么办？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 找个人替代他不就完了？而且这个问题毫无意义，他人明明就在这里！他是不会走的。如今他的力量变强了，足以挣脱束缚了，说不定他干活会干得更好呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 说好听点，你是太天真了。人越是能够逃避责任，就越不想再和责任扯上关系。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Megaera tells me that you surpassed her while out there. How utterly embarrassing for her, to say the least.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I suppose you're going to punish her in some cruel fashion, then?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Oh, I've already seen to that, of course. You think she volunteered to deal with you? Nobody did. That's how ignoble a task it is.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 墨纪拉跟我说你打败她了。可以说这件事让她感觉很难堪。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那你是不是想变着法儿地惩罚她？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，这个我早就安排好了。你以为她是自愿去处理你的吗？根本没有人自愿。这件事就是这样见不得人。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Tell me something, boy, did you enjoy the searing heat of Asphodel? You must have thought that you'd be more resilient to it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm open to a change of climate. Even if it gets a bit uncomfortable.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You know nothing of discomfort, yet. Making it out of Tartarus is nothing in comparison to what lies ahead for you.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 跟我说说，孩子，你喜欢水仙花平原的炎热气温吗？你是不是觉得自己能适应那里。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 气候变化而已。就算有点让人不舒服也无所谓。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 那你还没见识过真正的不舒服。闯出塔耳塔罗斯跟你即将面对的东西相比根本不值一提。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I understand that you created quite a stir within Elysium. An all-out brawl within eternal paradise!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You call that paradise? It's just a bunch of shades bored out of their former skulls, itching for a chance to feel alive again.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: What would you know of it! The greatest mortals have their every need fulfilled within that place. I dread to hear what they shall say of all of this.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 听说你在至福乐土引起了不小的轰动。永恒仙境里的激烈战斗！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你管那叫仙境？不过是一群好战的幽灵，通过战斗来让自己有活着的感觉。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你又知道些什么！那个地方能够满足最伟大的凡人灵魂们的一切需求。我真担忧他们会对这一切颇有微词。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Tell me something, boy, because my own set of ideas on the subject is beginning to run dry: What, exactly, is it going to take for you to understand that you're not leaving here?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Perhaps you ought to have me bound next to Prometheus, and have the dreaded Eagle peck my liver for eternity?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You would have me resort to such barbarity? Blast you, boy. Punishment is not the path to rehabilitation; it is for its own sake. I'd have expected all your trips through Tartarus to have taught you as much.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 回答我吧，孩子，这个问题我绞尽脑汁也无法想通：到底要怎样才能让你明白，你根本没法离开这里？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 把我跟普罗米修斯栓一块儿，再派一只大鸟不停地啄食我的内脏就行了。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我怎么可能会用这种残忍手段？气死我了你这孩子。惩罚不是用来解决问题的；惩罚本身就是目的。我还以为经过塔耳塔罗斯的你已经明白这个道理了。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I'm truly sorry that he's troubled you again, Cerberus. I know how much you value resting here, and yet, I have no better means to bar the entry to our realm than you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I thought you'd figured out by now that guilting me into abandoning my quest won't work. You're the one who should feel guilty, forcing Cerberus to block my path.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: What would you know of it? Cerberus cannot be forced to do anything. He simply understands he has responsibilities.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 不好意思他又来骚扰你了，刻耳柏洛斯。我知道你喜欢在这里趴着休息，但是除了你，我找不到其他更能看守冥界入口的家伙了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你应该知道，光靠让我内疚是不可能让我放弃行动的。你才是那个应该内疚的人，你命令刻耳柏洛斯去阻止我前进。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你又知道些什么？没人能命令得了刻耳柏洛斯。他只是清楚知道这是他的责任。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Ah, verify something for me, here, boy. According to the latest reports... you attempted unsuccessfully to shoplift from Charon, himself? And were consequently slain? Utterly ignoble end, even for you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, I was borrowing, OK? Not shoplifting. Why didn't anybody ever tell me Charon was such a monster? I thought the boating mercantile thing made for a peaceful life.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You incur the wrath of ancient chthonic gods, and then are surprised to be destroyed by them? Have you learned nothing, after all this time?

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，过来证实一下，臭小子。根据最新提交上来的报告……你试图从卡戎，从他眼皮底下偷东西？而且最后还被杀了？哪怕是你，这也极度不光彩。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，我当时是借用，不是扒窃，好吧？为什么从来没人跟我说过卡戎原来是这么个狠角色？我还以为天天摇船的人脾气肯定很好呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你惹怒了古老的冥界之神，他杀了你，你却还觉得意外？你活了这么久，难道就什么都没学到吗？

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: How are you finding my old trusty spear, then, hm? Or perhaps you have a preference for my brothers' and my sisters' former arms. Kept under lock and key, and yet, they're now in your possession, it would seem.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: The weapons in the courtyard. Of course you know about them, by now. I stole them. Why not just take them from me? I'd be stuck.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: The thought has long since crossed my mind. However, I'm not fool enough to tamper with those cursed things. They go where they please. They cannot be contained. Like you. Now, why don't you go entertain each other more?

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 找到我以前使的那柄趁手长矛了吗？还是说你用上了我兄弟姐妹们用过的武器？这些东西保管得很严，不过现在似乎到你手上了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那些武器就在院子里，你现在当然知道它们了。我偷走了它们。你为什么不直接从我这把它们收回去？这样我就无处可逃了。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 这件事情我想好久了。不过，我还没有傻到去驯服这些被诅咒的东西。这些东西捉摸不定，根本管不住。像你一样。现在，你和你的武器干嘛不接着取悦彼此呢？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Megaera and her sisters ganged up on me that time. I didn't think anyone could talk her into working with Alecto and Tisiphone again. Or even be in the same chamber.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I can be quite persuasive under certain circumstances, boy. Though my advice to you, not that you'll take it, is not to discuss the matter openly. Megaera is a professional; but she has made her feelings on the matter clear.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 墨纪拉和她的姐妹联合起来对付我了。我是真没想到还有谁能说服她跟阿勒克图以及提西福涅合作。甚至说把她们三个放到一个房间。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我的说服力你无法想象，孩子。我给你提个建议吧，你也不用非得接受，我建议你不要公开讨论这个事情。墨纪拉是很专业的；但她在这件事情上的态度已经非常明确。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: It is woefully infrequent that I've cause for this, but I do have to thank you, boy. You've culled the Satyrs and the vermin bringing ruin to our Temple, there! Blasted creatures multiply at an alarming rate.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: They're not doing your bidding, yet they're every bit as bothersome as all your wretched servants I've met. I'm surprised you aren't getting along.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: They are a plague upon this realm, although we have them well contained, for now. And once they are rightly dead, they tend to swear to me their fealty.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 很不幸，我极少能找到这样做的理由，但我还得谢谢你，孩子。你解决了那些萨提尔之后，鼠兽就把我们的神庙弄得一团糟！这些崽种们的增殖速度非常快。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 它们根本不听你指挥，并且跟你手下那些难缠的仆人一样让人恼火。看来你们相处的不大好啊。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 它们在冥界中就像是一场瘟疫，不过目前情况还在掌控之中。一旦它们真正死亡之后，就会全部归于我麾下了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Father, you always said the Olympians wanted nothing to do with our kind. But doesn't Charon work directly with Hermes? Maybe it's you who wants nothing to do with them.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I want nothing to do with them, correct. My hasty nephew assists Charon out of necessity, alone. Not even Thanatos is able to keep up with the rate at which mortals expire and must then cross our borders.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Want me to pitch in? Just give me your blessing and I'll head straight for the surface.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Hahaha, no. I think not, boy. You are born of this realm. The surface is a wind-swept waste. You don't know how good you have it here.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲，你总说奥林匹斯那帮人不想跟我们有任何瓜葛。但是卡戎不就跟赫尔墨斯共事吗？所以这只是你自己单方面不想和他们有瓜葛吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我确实是不想跟他们有瓜葛。我那焦躁的外甥是出于必要才帮助卡戎。凡人的死亡速度和越境需求让塔纳托斯都有点吃不消了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 要我帮忙吗？给我你的庇佑，然后我立刻就直冲凡界。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 哈哈哈，不。我觉得不行，孩子。你生来属于冥界。凡间不过是转瞬即逝、无物长驻的废墟。你只是身在福中不知福。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: She is gone, boy. She is gone. You are never going to locate her. I thought you would have come to that conclusion for yourself, by now. But apparently it must be said.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You mean Mother. How would you even know? You said reaching the surface was impossible as well, and I'm in striking distance.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: This is my final warning to you, boy... to cease this mindless quest. Or else, the consequences shall be worse than what you have experienced thus far.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 她走了，孩子。不回来了。你找不到她的。我还以为你自己早就明白这点。但还是得我来告诉你。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你在说母亲。你怎么知道呢？你还说我不可能到达凡界，但我现在近在咫尺。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 这是我最后一次警告你了，孩子…… 马上停止你鲁莽的行为。不然可能会导致你迄今为止都没有经历过的严重后果。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Whatever you did to my blasted seat is of no consequence to me. From my vantage-point, I can't even see it! A foolish prank and waste of valuable resources, nothing more.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's more for everybody else than you, Father. Think of it as a tribute to Cerberus! Besides, you really should think about changing up the look of this place from time to time. Keep things fresh!

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: The limitless work keeps things fresh enough as it is. Though if making aimless changes in this House is how you choose to spend your limitless time, I'll have no part of it.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 不论你对我的座椅做了什么，都与我无关。从我这个绝佳位置甚至看不见它！完全是愚蠢的胡闹，浪费宝贵的资源。再无其他。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那不是为你准备的，父亲，而是为其他人准备的。你就把它当做是对刻耳柏洛斯的致意吧！另外，你真的应该考虑时不时地换一下这里的装饰，让大家保持新鲜感！

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 没完没了的工作已经足以让大家保持新鲜感了。不过，如果你打算把你无穷无尽的时间浪费在毫无意义的装修上面，那我也无话可说。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Father, of all the skeletons and such in your direct employ... you wouldn't happen to have any here around the House, would you? Out in my courtyard, for example?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Skeletons! I'm sure they'll welcome you when next you visit Asphodel. You may not realize it, boy, but we have a certain standard of decency we uphold around here!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲大人，有很多骷髅都是直接听命于你的……在这些骷髅里面，不会刚好有哪个就在这座圣殿里工作吧？比如说，在我的院子里面？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 骷髅！等你下次去水仙花平原的时候，它们肯定会好好欢迎你的。或许你没注意到，孩子，但这座圣殿还是很讲究礼仪的！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You ever think of giving Thanatos a break, Father? He seems to have more than his fair share of work of late.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Blame the blasted mortals for perishing so easily, or blame Lord Ares, prior to accusing me. With their surface wars, not only do they kill each other readily, but also often subsequently perish from the consequences of it all!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What wars, what's going on up there? Why don't the other Olympians do something?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Pah! How should I know? The mortals are equipped to settle their petty differences by any number of means. We have to make room for them all sooner or later, regardless.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你有没有想过让塔纳托斯休息一下，父亲？他最近的工作似乎已经超出他该干的量了。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 比起控诉我，不如去责备那些该死的凡人竟那样脆弱，或者去责备阿瑞斯。凡人们在地上发动战争，他们不仅彼此厮杀，还会死于战争带来的种种后果！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么战争？上面到底发生了什么事情？其他的奥林匹斯众神为什么不做点什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 啧！我哪知道啊？那些凡人有的是办法来解决他们之间微不足道的纠纷。不管怎样，我们迟早都得想办法给他们腾出更多地方。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: So, you had a run-in with the Minotaur out in Elysium, did you? Perhaps the only soul within this realm more bull-headed than you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: How long have you been waiting to use that line, Father? Wouldn't put it past you to have sent the Bull of Minos to Elysium entirely so we could have this conversation now.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You give me too much credit, boy. The Minotaur resides where he resides because of an entirely different arrangement.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: He's working for you, isn't he? You think he can stop me.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Most in Elysium jump at the opportunity to do my bidding. Not that you know what that is like. Now go, see how you fare against the bull.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你好像在至福乐土跟弥诺陶交过手了吧。他应该是整个地府唯一比你还牛脾气的了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你想说这句话很久了吧，父亲？我怀疑你把米诺斯的公牛送到至福乐土就是为了有朝一日能对我说这句话。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你太抬举我了，孩子。弥诺陶目前这样的情况完全是因为其他原因。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 他为你做事对吧？你以为他能拦得住我。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我提出的任务，对至福乐土里大部分的人来说，那都是求之不得。那样子，你想也想象不到。去吧，看看你要怎样斗这头牛。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: How goes your heated rivalry against the greatest king of Athens lately, boy? Your battles with him and the Minotaur must be the talk of the Underworld of late.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Admit it, Father. Theseus was the only hero you were able to recruit to stand against me. All the while he gets to boast about being the champion. What, was Heracles too busy for the task?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Speak not to me of Heracles. You know these heroes by their deeds, not by their character. Heracles is fortunate he's in my brother's favor. Else he would be in Tartarus where he belongs. The mortal concept of what constitutes a hero is absurd.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 与雅典最伟大的国王打得怎么样，孩子？你与他和弥诺陶的那些战斗最近可是冥界的热门话题。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 少来了，父亲。我看你是除了忒修斯之外，根本找不到其他愿意阻止我的英雄吧。这人张口闭口就吹自己是最强战士。我寻思，赫拉克勒斯是太忙没时间噢？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 别跟我提赫拉克勒斯。你只了解这些英雄的作为，而他们的人格你一概不知。赫拉克勒斯很幸运，有我兄弟的庇佑，不然他现在还在塔耳塔罗斯呆着。凡人们对英雄这个词的理解简直是荒谬。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I know what you did. Stay out of Nyx's affairs next time, boy. She is needed here! Not wallowing in the primordial dark.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're just angry because some of us still want to have anything to do with their parents.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Parents, pah! You know nothing of what parents are capable of. Conspire all you like against my wishes, I care not. Get out.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道你干的“好事”。下次不要插手倪克斯的事情了，小子。这里需要她！她不应该沉湎于原始的黑暗中。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你不过是因为我们之中还有人会为自己的父母着想而发怒。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 父母，哼！你完全不知道父母能做什么。我不管你有什么盘算，现在离开这里。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: So you were able to dispatch my Hydra, boy. Right down to the last hateful head. It's an accomplishment I felt was certainly beyond your talent set. Though, here you are again, nevertheless.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You cheated me. There wasn't anywhere that I could go! I could have gone much farther. All the way to Mother!

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You shall do no such thing. Besides, if you were any help to me, you'd know vast portions of my realm are presently still under renovation. You won't be getting farther than you have.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I can wait. You can't just keep this place on lockdown for eternity. The mortals up there wouldn't stand for it.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: They have no patience, yes. The same as you. Then wait, with all the rest of them. It matters not to me. For I have other work to do.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 看来你打败我的九头蛇了，孩子。脑袋一个没留。这对你来说是一个巨大的进步。不过，最后你还是回来了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你耍我。根本没有路可走！我本该继续前进！去找母亲！

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你应该放弃。另外，如果你真想做点好事，你应该知道现在整个冥界都在修整当中。目前你没法继续前进了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我可以等。你不可能让整个地方永远封闭下去。上面的凡人可受不了这样。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 他们确实没有耐心。跟你一样。那就等吧，跟其他人一起等。与我无关。我有其他要紧事要做。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Now you begone from here, get yourself killed some more for all I care.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 现在你可以走了，至于你是去寻死还是干什么其他的我都不想管。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Well, boy. Word has reached me that you were able to dethrone the Champion of Elysium as well as his bull-headed companion. Tell me, how did you accomplish such a thing?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: First, you tell me when I can get out of there. The path guarded by Theseus was sealed! Is there even a surface? Is the outside world all a lie?!

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Ah, now you are asking the big questions! Comforting to see such growth of character. Well if there is an outside world, you shall not be seeing it for quite some time. You know why, don't you?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Ongoing Underworld renovations?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Ongoing Underworld renovations. Now go and let King Theseus drive that sharp spear of his into yourself some more, until such time. The mortals soon shall force me to reopen, and then what?

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 孩子。我听说你把至福乐土最强战士和他的牛头人伙伴一起给拉下了神坛。跟我说说，你怎么做到的？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 首先，你得告诉我什么时候才能离开冥界。忒修斯看守的通道是条死路！真的存在凡界这种地方吗？外部世界什么的都是骗人的？！

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，这个问题问得挺好！你能成长到这个地步真是令人欣慰。就算外部世界真的存在，你在短时间内也是没法见到的。你知道原因，对吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 冥界仍在修整当中？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 冥界仍在修整当中。现在你可以回去继续让忒修斯国王拿他的矛扎你了，消磨消磨时间。到时候凡人会闹着要我重新开张，然后呢？

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Now you begone from here, get yourself killed some more for all I care.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 现在你可以走了，至于你是去寻死还是干什么其他的我都不想管。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You are late, boy! Have you any idea what time it is?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No. Wait, what? I just vanquished you in single combat, and that's all you have to say to me?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Vanquished me? Hah, hahaha, nonsense. Don't you think I would recall such an event?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You can't be serious. You're going to pretend as though it never happened?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Everything is as it always was. And so shall it be, until the Fates determine otherwise. Or until our ongoing Underworld renovations are finally complete. Whichever comes first.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你回来迟了，孩子！你知不知道现在几点了？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等下，就这？我刚刚打败你了吧，你就没什么其他可说的？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 打败我？哈，哈哈哈，一派胡言。这种事情我可以直接撤回。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你认真的？你就装作无事发生一样？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 一切照旧。除非命运之神有其他安排。又或者，等到我们的冥界修整结束之后。就看哪个快了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So you're really not going to answer my question about Mother from the other time, until the Underworld renovations are complete?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I know not what you're going on about, there, boy. Although, my focus is entirely upon our renovations, yes. Perhaps someday or night when this place is in proper working order, I shall have more time for your insipid questions.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 所以你就非得等冥界修整结束之后，再回答我之前问的有关母亲的问题吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我不知道你到底想干什么，孩子。但是我现在精力确实都集中在修整这件事情上。也许有一天整个冥界都运转正常之后，我就有时间去回答你那些个问题了。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You are late, boy! Have you any idea what time it is?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No. Wait, what? I vanquished you in single combat and finally found Mother, and that's all you have to say to me?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Hah, haha! Nonsense. Don't you think I would recall such an event?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You can't be serious. You're going to pretend as though it never happened? She wants answers, same as I do. She demands you let me pass! Let me go to her again.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Silence! This discussion is over. I hardly think this is the time or place to indulge your overwrought imagination.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你回来迟了，孩子！你知不知道现在几点了？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不。等等，什么？我刚刚单打独斗打赢了你，而且终于找到了母亲，你现在就只对我说这些？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 哈，哈哈！一派胡言。你以为我会记得有这回事？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 开玩笑。你要假装根本没这回事？她想要你的答案，我也是。她要让你放我走，让我回到她身边！

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 住口！此事不必再提。这次我不想再纵容你那些神经质的妄想了。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I told you, boy. I told you! There's no escape from here. Learned that the hard way, then?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You could have told me more important things. Mother left because she never even knew I was alive. Thanks to you! She's got a lot of questions, herself, as you can probably imagine. I'm headed back to her. You going to cooperate?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Hahaha, nonsense! Listen to me: If you have any sense remaining in that head of yours, I caution you not to discuss this here and now.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Let me go. Let me find her. She demands it!

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我告诉过你了，小子。我早告诉过你！此处永无出路。非要吃点苦头吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你本可以告诉我更重要的事。母亲之所以离开是因为她不知道我还活着，这都是因为你！你完全可以想象她心中有多少疑问。现在我要去往她身边，你或许乐意放我一马？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 哈哈哈，一派胡言！给我听好，如果你那榆木脑袋里还剩下哪怕一点理智，我警告你，此时此刻，不许再提这个话题。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 让我走。让我找到她。这也是她所希望的！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Quite a mess you've created, I must say, Father... after being of no help whatsoever when it comes to disentangling it all. Though, this isn't the place to talk, right?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: No! It most certainly is not. Though, I take it it shall not be long before another of our private meetings, then.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不得不说，你真是惹出了相当大的麻烦啊，父亲，而且你在解决问题这方面完全没起到任何作用。不过，这里不是咱们闲聊的地方，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 不是！当然不是。不过我觉得，用不了多久，咱们就能再私下会面了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Something the matter, there, Father? You seem a little quieter than usual. Dare I say even a little somber and remorseful, for some reason?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Silence, boy! And better yet, why don't you get out of my sight? I've more important things to do now than indulge your boastfulness. We'll have to catch up at some other place and time.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 怎么回事，父亲？您今天好像不怎么爱说话。甚至看上去好像有点忧郁，又有点懊恼。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 住口，孩子，如果你现在就给我离开那最好不过了。我有更要紧的事要做，没空听你在这里吹牛。此时此刻还不是我们聊天的时候。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know, Father, while I'm sure you don't appreciate all the distractions as of late, your ceaseless toil has had some noticeable effect. Is it my imagination, or are the ongoing Underworld renovations almost complete?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: There you go, getting ahead of yourself, again. The final stages of renovation are some of the most vital! Second only to the initial planning. There's a great deal of important work ahead!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I wasn't saying it wasn't important, I was just saying maybe there's finally an end to it in sight. What are you going to do with all your spare time, then?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 老实说，父亲。最近发生了很多让你分心的事情，我知道你肯定不喜欢，但你不停的鞭策确实带来了明显的效果。是我的错觉吗？还是说，冥界的翻修工作马上就要完成了？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你又开始不切实际了，翻修工作的最后阶段是很重要的，重要程度仅次于最初的计划部分。还有很多重要的工作要干呢！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我倒不是说它不重要，我只是说，活终于算是要干完了。等你干完活，有空闲的时间的话，你打算干什么？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What's the giant pact posted out in the courtyard, Father? You offering me a job?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Perish the thought. It's so that all your toiling can be more painful, nothing more.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Why would I want my toiling to be more painful than it already is?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Who knows, boy, or better yet, who cares? To make the mortals up there worship you for all your labors? Go on, then, go get yourself dispatched some more, so I can make well certain that my realm can properly contain you.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 院子里那张巨大的契约是什么东西，父亲？提供给我的工作岗位？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 别瞎想了。那个就是为了让你受更多的苦而已，就这样。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我干嘛要让自己受更多的苦？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 谁知道呢，孩子，或者说，谁在乎呢？为了让上头的凡人因为你的事迹膜拜你吗？去吧，继续受苦，这样我就知道我的冥界还是可以管住你的。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: My records indicate that you've collected earnings based on some of your accomplishments, there, boy. I suppose you need an income of your own, having decided to cut ties and all.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, you mean the bounties that you've offered up to anybody capable of beating Meg and all your other guardians out there? Don't you think that puts a lot of undue pressure on them, knowing that you've turned them into targets?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: They must do better than they have, else they shall be replaced. If they're to grow in their respective roles, they have to know their weaknesses. And so do I. That you collect the bounties for it matters not.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What about the bounties for vanquishing you? Who's your replacement going to be?

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我的记录显示你的收入都来自你的战绩，对吗，小子。断绝一切关系后，我猜你需要有自己的收入来源。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么，你是指那些恩赐吗，那些不就是用来奖励能够打败墨纪和你的所有其他守护者的人吗？你不觉得你把他们都当成目标会给他们带来不必要的压力吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 他们必须超越原来的自己，否则就会被替换掉。如果想在各自的岗位上成长，他们就得认清自己的弱点。我也不例外。你能不能得到这些恩赐并不重要。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果是打败你的恩赐呢？谁会取代你呢？

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: My records indicate that you've collected earnings based on some of your accomplishments, there, boy. I suppose you need an income of your own, having decided to cut ties and all.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, you mean the bounties that you've offered up to anybody capable of beating Meg and all your other guardians out there? Don't you think that puts a lot of undue pressure on them, knowing that you've turned them into targets?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: They must do better than they have, else they shall be replaced. If they're to grow in their respective roles, they have to know their weaknesses. And so do I. That you collect the bounties for it matters not.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Be sure to add those to the list of words you'll eat someday.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我的记录显示你的收入都来自你的战绩，对吗，小子。断绝一切关系后，我猜你需要有自己的收入来源。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么，你是指那些恩赐吗，那些不就是用来奖励能够打败墨纪和你的所有其他守护者的人吗？你不觉得你把他们都当成目标会给他们带来不必要的压力吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 他们必须超越原来的自己，否则就会被替换掉。如果想在各自的岗位上成长，他们就得认清自己的弱点。我也不例外。你能不能得到这些恩赐并不重要。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 总有一天，你会为你说的这些话后悔。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Saw your new Pact of Punishment out in the courtyard, Father. Impressed that you could find a parchment large enough to fit all the unpleasant stipulations. So you're taking even harsher measures to contain me?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Whether you consent to the terms of the Pact is entirely up to you, boy. But, in all your comings and goings, it is important that we have full knowledge of which property is being carried from the premises.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 看到您在院子里的新的惩罚契约了，父亲。真不愧是您啊，能找到那么大的羊皮纸来写那么多的害人条款。所以您现在为了管住我，要开始动用更严格的手段了嘛？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你同不同意那个契约你自己决定，孩子。不过，在你来来往往的时候，有很重要的一点，就是我们要充分了解哪些东西会被取走。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You've taken more advantage of the Pact of Punishment than I would have expected, boy. I almost wish to commend you for doing such a thing.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Almost? I've been rampaging through the worst your realm has to offer. Causing you untold inconvenience and likely a fortune in repair costs. I thought you'd be upset.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Upset? Heavens, no. Through your repeated bumbling, you have revealed a number of shortcomings in our operations, which my underlings are busy working to address.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know you sound especially despicable when you say underlings, don't you?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Don't let me keep you any longer, boy, go forth! Try to escape again. You're helping make the Underworld a better place.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我好像低估了你对惩罚契约的接受能力了，孩子。我几乎想夸你几句了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 夸我？我可是在您地盘里迄今为止最恶劣的环境中杀了个死去活来。给您带来各种麻烦，还有一大笔修整费用。我还以为您会难过呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 难过？我有什么好难过的，你这样一通乱来，让我们发现了很多自己的不足之处，现在我的下人们正积极解决这些缺陷呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你说下人们这个词的时候听起来真的很卑鄙，知道吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 别让我再耽搁你了，孩子，继续前进吧！继续尝试离开这里。你在帮助这冥界变得更完善呢。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Explain to me something: How did you do it? I mean the Pact. For all of the conditions it imposed... you still surpassed me. How?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Plenty of practice, regular exercise, a positive attitude, the blessings of assorted family members you don't like, and your discarded Titan-slaying weapons I suppose. Nothing special. Why do you ask?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: To think that you would squander such a talent on frivolous pursuit. You do not even realize what you have achieved, do you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, wait wait wait wait, care to repeat that first part that you said back there? The talent part?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Would that you had a talent for listening. Begone for now.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 给我一个解释：你是怎么做到的？就是那个惩罚契约。尽管它强加了诸多限制……你依然胜过了我。怎么回事？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我想就是勤加练习、日常锻炼、积极的态度，你看不上眼的各种家人的祝福，还有被你弃之如敝屣的能杀死泰坦的武器。也没什么特别的。为什么这么问？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我在想，你竟然会把这样的才华浪费在这些无聊的追求上。你根本没意识到你做到了什么，对吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等一下，等一下，可以重复一下你的前半句话吗？关于才华的部分？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 但愿你有倾听他人意见的才华。现在，你可以滚开了。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Back to your senses, then, boy? The Pact of Punishment is not something one ought to trifle with unknowingly, in case you've yet to notice.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Father... the Pact... you were so blasted strong. I had no idea! All those other times we fought... I can't believe that you were holding back. You were desperate to stop me, you could have!

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: We are bound by the Fates to this realm. It is ours, and we belong to it, in turn. And... I did not hold back against you. Rather... I had forgotten my old strength. Some of it since returned to me.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Must have been all our vicious battles to the death? Or maybe it's from Mother being back in your life?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Pointless to even ask. What motivates us is a complicated thing. But if you long to face me with the power I once held during my own youth... you have available to you the means.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 清醒点了吗，孩子？假如你还没注意到，我得提醒你惩罚契约并不是可以轻率对待的东西。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲……关于惩罚契约……你实在是强得不像话，我之前一点都不知道。我们交手过那么多次……我真不敢相信你一直都在放水。你真的是很想阻止我，你根本就可以！

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我们都被命运女神困在这个世界。这里是我们的世界，我们也属于这里。另外……我并没有退缩或是手下留情；相反……我忘记了我曾经拥有的力量。现在我又重新取回了一部分。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是因为我们之间的惨烈战斗吗？还是因为母亲回到了你身边？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 这还需要问吗。驱使我们行动的动机是很复杂的，但是如果你渴望拥有我年轻时的力量，并且希望用那种力量来面对我……那你有的是办法实现。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Urgh... come, get your gloating well out of the way, so I can get back to this parchmentwork. It piled up, in my prolonged absence!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Not here to gloat, Father. Well fought back there. I can't believe I got you.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: ...Nor I. Next time, the Fates may not decide to favor you like that. If there shall be a next time.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 呃啊……走吧，把你那幸灾乐祸的表情收起来，我要回去处理那些文书工作了。我离开了太长时间，羊皮纸都堆成山了！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我不是来幸灾乐祸的，父亲大人。那真是一场精彩的战斗，难以置信我竟然打倒你了。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: ……我也没想到。下次命运女神可能就不会这般青睐你了。如果还有下次的话。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Father... look, Lord Uncle Zeus, I've been in contact with him, and he wishes to make peace. He asked for me to tell you. To tell you he forgives you for... whatever happened.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: My brother Zeus... forgives me? Zeus forgives me?! How dare that blasted little brat! His beard may be luxurious but he's as much a child as are you. Forgives me, bah!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What did you do...? What happened between you?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: None of your business! Go on now and frolic with that Lord Uncle of yours, the both of them! And don't you ever speak of him to me again, you hear me?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲，宙斯叔叔他……我跟他联系过了，他希望可以和解。他让我这样告诉你。告诉你，他原谅你……之前的作为。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我兄弟宙斯要……原谅我？就他还原谅我？！他竟然说这种混账话？他胡子确实挺长，但是他的见识跟你一样短。原谅我？呸！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你做了什么……？你们之间到底发生过什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 与你无关！继续回去跟你的好叔叔玩耍去吧，跟你两个叔叔一起！以后不准再跟我提他，听到没有？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Question for you, Father. The name Kore happen to mean anything to you, by any chance?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: What, where did you...?! Ahh, the cold witch brought it up, did she? Never repeat that name again, not here, nor anywhere, you hear me, boy? Know only this: The one called by that name despised it even more than I.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So let's see. Demeter's daughter went missing. She wound up down here. I... happened. Mother left. Demeter, and everyone else on Olympus apparently, has no idea. That about right? Tell me what happened.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I'll tell you nothing! Keep meddling in matters that you cannot understand, and you'll incur the wrath of Olympus on all that you hold dear. And, know that it is not for my sake that I'm warning you.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 给您的问题，父亲大人：有没有可能……科瑞这个名字是不是对您有什么特别的意义？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 什么，你是从哪里……？！啊，我知道了，是那个冷血的女巫告诉你的，对不对？不要再提起这个名字，不管在哪里都不行，你听到了吗，小子？你只要记住：拥有这个名字的人，比我更厌恶这个名字。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 让我想想。得墨忒尔的女儿失踪了。她后来出现在冥界这里。我……诞生了。母亲走了。得墨忒尔，和奥林匹斯山上的众神，都似乎对这件事毫无头绪。差不多吧？告诉我，究竟发生了什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我什么都不会说！如果你继续执着于这些你无法理解的事情，奥林匹斯山的众神之怒将会降临到你所爱的人的头上。而且我之所以警告你也不是为了我自己。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: What is it now? I see that sneering look upon your countenance, which must mean you have yet another one of your insipid questions, haven't you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, this one's not insipid in the slightest. Let me get this straight. My mother's Persephone. Her mother's Demeter, but her father... evidently was some farm-boy? My red blood comes from him? And my propensity to die I guess.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You blame your ancestors for your own weakness? You should be thankful you were born with immortality! Though, your meddlesome curiosity and constant need for affirmation must certainly be from your mortal side.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Then, Mother, did... she grow older with age? Is she just going to expire as the mortals do? With demigods I hear it can go either way.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I said never to speak of her, blast you! You said, yourself, she is the daughter of the goddess of seasons! Use your fool head, for once.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 又怎么了？我从你脸上看到了轻蔑的表情，你肯定又想问无聊的问题了，是不是？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，这个问题一点也不无聊。我来理理清楚。我的母亲是珀尔塞福涅。她的母亲叫得墨忒尔，但她的父亲……显然是某个农家男孩？我的身上流着他的红色血液？而且我猜我也会死。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你要把自己的弱点归咎到长辈身上？你应该为身为神仙而感恩！不过，你那爱管闲事的好奇心和不时需要他人肯定的毛病无疑都是遗传自凡人。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那，母亲她……难道衰老了？她会像凡人那样死去吗？听说半神都有可能……

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你这狗崽子，我说过永远不要提起她！ 你亲口说过她是四季女神的女儿！ 用一用你那笨脑子吧。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Greetings, Father. Ran into Lady Demeter out there, on my last outing. Or should I say, my grandmother? What's she to you, then, ex-mother-in-law? Source of abject terror? Hard keeping track. Our family's rather complicated.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Do not invoke her name inside my House, you hear me, boy? You do not know at all what she is like. Though I can see why you two hit it off. She hated her father. Though understandably, as he was worse even than mine. Even than yours.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你好，父亲大人。刚刚出去的时候我碰到得墨忒尔女士，或是说，我的外婆 ？她对你来说算是什么？前岳母？或是包袱？我们家族真复杂。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 别在我的大殿里提起这个名字，明白了吗，崽子? 你完全不了解她。但是我能理解你们为何能合得来。她恨她的父亲，但这情有可原，毕竟她的父亲比我的还差，比你的更不用说。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Greetings, Father. So! I can just... head on out there again whenever I want? Don't need to stick to any rigid schedule?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Your unpredictability is one of your assets. Our defenses must always be on guard. So, yes: Go about your business as you best see fit!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: And the Olympians are going to keep helping me, thinking I'm trying to get away from you, to them. We can't keep this up with them forever, you know.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你好啊，父亲，所以说！我可以……什么时候想出去就出去？不用遵守什么作息时间表吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你说来就来说走就走，这也是你的特点。我们的安保系统必须时刻保持警惕。所以，没错，你什么时候打算干活都行！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 而奥林匹斯众神依然会帮助我，他们以为我打算从你手上逃脱，逃到他们那里。你也知道，我们不可能把他们永远蒙在鼓里。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Tell me something, boy... Zagreus... why did you do all this? Return the Queen. Go to such lengths. At a certain point... you must have learned the way I felt about her. Yet still you persisted. If I were you... I'd not have done me any favors.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I didn't often stop to give it much thought. I just knew I needed to find her... and then as soon as I did, I knew I needed her in my life. In other words, doing you any favors was never a priority, Father. Just ended up that way, I guess.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: ...I see. I appreciate your candor. Nevertheless... I thank you. I do not know how you accomplished what you did, but know that I am grateful for the outcome. Even if I fail to act like it, much of the time.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 和我说说吧，孩子……扎格列欧斯……你为什么要这么做？为了回到冥后那里，不辞辛苦。在某个时候……你肯定已经明白了我对她的感情，可你依然坚持去找她。如果我是你的话……我是绝不会帮我的忙的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我当时并没考虑过这么多事情，我只知道我必须找到她……而且，当我一见到她的时候，我就知道我的生命中需要她。换句话说，帮不帮你的忙，并不是我需要着重考虑的事情，父亲。我猜，只是结果刚好帮到了你而已。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: ……我明白了，我很赞赏你的坦率。不管怎么样……我很感谢你。我不清楚这一切你是怎么做到的，但我很感谢你带来了这样的结果。我很多时候都没能采取这样的行动。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Say, Father... back when you drew lots with your brothers, and wound up with the Underworld, rather than the heavens or the seas... which would you have claimed, if the choice was yours?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I do not deal in hypotheticals, boy. Each realm has its host of unenviable problems. You have never experienced the cold and sopping sea, or the blinding heights of Olympus. I have. And I assure you, you're not missing much.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Didn't you try to leave the Underworld, yourself, at some point? You once gave me that impression. I always thought it was because you hated it here.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I hate not having any choice. Enjoy the freedoms that you have. As you grow long in years, you gain more burdens and responsibilities, until they bind you.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我想问一下，父亲……当时你和你兄弟们抽签的时候，你抽到了这里，成了冥王，而没能成为掌管天空或海洋的神……如果你能自己选的话，你想要当哪个神？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我不喜欢假设，孩子，每个王国都有各种各样让人眼花缭乱的问题。你从来没体会过海底刺骨的严寒，或是奥林匹斯山那令人眼晕的高峰，但我都体验过。而且我可以保证，你是不会喜欢的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这么长时间以来，你自己就没试过逃出冥界吗？你之前暗示过我你也试过。我一直以为你想逃出这个地方，是因为你讨厌这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我讨厌的是没有选择。好好享受你现在的自由吧，等你慢慢长大了，你肩上的重担与责任也会越来越多，最后会把你束缚住。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Father, all these shades... aren't they going to let on that Mother's back? What if word spreads... and the Olympians find out?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You are so well-accustomed to defying me that you forget there are no others, either living or dead, who would so dare. None in this House shall speak of this until we are prepared to make any announcements, on our own terms.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲，这些幽灵……他们会不会泄露母亲回来的消息？要是流言传出……奥林匹斯众神知道了该怎么办？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 只有你对公然反抗我习以为常，你甚至忘了没有人胆敢违抗我，无论是死是活。在这座大殿里，没有人会谈论此事，除非我们以自己的名义发布关于此事的声明。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Regarding your responsibilities: Our Resources Director is available to you. In my private quarters. Normally, it would be I, alone, transferring excess resources back into our realm.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: The fabled Resources Director! So, now I get to give away the hard-earned resources I've painstakingly gathered over time?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You get to do precisely that. It is not necessary that you do. But if you wish to rise above your current station, you shall do it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What's the point in rising above my current station? I thought our work was to be done in secrecy.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: It is. There is no point but pride. And pride is dangerous. Do what you will. I care not, as long as everything gets adequately done.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 关于你的责任，你已经可以去找我们的资源总监了，他就在我的私人房间里。通常来说，一直都是我一个人把多余的资源运回我们的王国。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 就是那个传说中的资源总监吗！所以，我那么长时间辛辛苦苦赚来的、来之不易的资源，我得把它们捐出去了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 一点都没错。这件事并不强求你做，不过，如果你打算提高现在的职级，就必须这么做才行。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 提高我的职级到底有什么意义？我还以为咱们的工作得私下里来做呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 确实毫无意义，只会让人感到骄傲，而骄兵必败。做你该做的事情吧，把所有的事情都做好就行了，别的事情我不关心。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Regarding your responsibilities: Our Resources Director is available to you. In the administrative chamber. Normally, it would be I, alone, transferring excess resources back into our realm.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: The fabled Resources Director! So, now I get to give away the hard-earned resources I've painstakingly gathered over time?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You get to do precisely that. It is not necessary that you do. But if you wish to rise above your current station, you shall do it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What's the point in rising above my current station? I thought our work was to be done in secrecy.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: It is. There is no point but pride. And pride is dangerous. Do what you will. I care not, as long as everything gets adequately done.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 关于你的责任，你已经可以去找我们的资源总监了，他就在行政办公室里。通常来说，一直都是我一个人把多余的资源运回我们的王国。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 就是那个传说中的资源总监吗！所以，我那么长时间辛辛苦苦赚来的、来之不易的资源，我得把它们捐出去了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 一点都没错。这件事并不强求你做，不过，如果你打算提高现在的职级，就必须这么做才行。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 提高我的职级到底有什么意义？我还以为咱们的工作得私下里来做呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 确实毫无意义，只会让人感到骄傲，而骄兵必败。做你该做的事情吧，把所有的事情都做好就行了，别的事情我不关心。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Briefly, now, boy: Our Resources Director informs me you've advanced in rank. Commendable. That's all.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 简单地说一句吧， 孩子，我们的资源总监告诉我说你的等级提升了。值得表扬。就这样。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You are advancing through the ranks of your position, and returning to our realm the vast resources you have claimed. As well you ought. Carry on.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 从你的职位等级可以看出你正在进步，你还为我们的领地带回了大量的资源。做得不错。再接再厉。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: We cannot speak of this, except... Unseen One... the highest ranking that we can bestow. I never once imagined that you could achieve that rank, yourself. Or any rank of note.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You always thought too little of me, Father. Though, thank you for taking note of that. I figured I ought to give back to the realm that made me what I am.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Yes. For this is the only world we know.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我们不能直接谈起这个，除非……无形者……那是我们能给予的最高等级。我从未想象过你能到达那个等级，或者别的什么值得一提的等级。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你一直都太不把我当回事了，父亲。不过，谢谢你注意到了这点。我觉得我应该报答这个生我养我的王国才对。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 是的。这毕竟是我们唯一了解的世界。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Father... all this stuff with the Olympians... will you just tell me what's going on, for once? How did Mother come to join you here? What's your problem with Uncle Zeus?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I thought she already told you...! Urgh. Come with me. Now.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: ...Swear to me that you shall never repeat what you are about to hear. Swear it!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: All right, all right, I swear. I swear, in your own name, I'll keep what you're about to say between us.... So?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: So... you had it mostly right, before. After I inherited the Underworld... your Uncle Zeus felt sympathy for me, he says. Your mother, he knew she was unhappy on Olympus. And... he knew I was drawn to her. So what did he do? He brought her here. Gave her to me as a gift!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You weren't expecting a gift like that. But she didn't want to return to Olympus, and you liked her, so you didn't send her away. And you're angry with Zeus for putting you in that position? Cut ties with him?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Yes!! The blasted fool, with all his flights of fancy! He does whatever he wants! He could have achieved a similar outcome in a limitless number of reasonable ways... rather than resort to what was tantamount to kidnapping! Even if she wanted to leave!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: And now if Demeter and the others found all this out, you and Mother... even Zeus would be in a bad spot, wouldn't he? He must have a temper on him to match yours.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You know nothing of tempers if mine is your frame of reference, Zagreus. Now, enough of this! You know the rest. Remember your oath.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲……和奥林匹斯众神的那些事情……你就不能告诉我发生了什么事情吗，哪怕一次也好？母亲怎么会和你来了这里？你和宙斯叔叔之间有什么过节？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我还以为她已经告诉过你了……！呃啊，跟我来吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: ……你要向我发誓，我告诉你的事情你绝对不会说出去。向我发誓！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好了，好了，我发誓，我发誓就是了。以你本人之名，你说的事情我绝不外传……好了，所以呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 所以……和你之前猜得八九不离十。我成为了冥王之后……你的宙斯叔叔说他很同情我。他知道你母亲在奥林匹斯山上呆得很不开心，而且……他知道我很喜欢她。所以你猜他怎么着？他把你母亲带了过来，把她像件礼物一样送给了我！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你当时没想到会收到这样的礼物。不过她确实不想再回奥林匹斯山，你也很喜欢她，于是你并没有把她赶走。你是在怨恨宙斯把你置于这样的境地？于是就和他一刀两断了？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 没错！！那个蠢货就是喜欢心血来潮！他简直是为所欲为！他本来有无数种合情合理的办法来促成类似的结果……可他却偏要靠绑架！虽然她确实想离开奥林匹斯山！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 要是得墨忒尔和其他众神发现了真相，你和母亲……就连宙斯都会摊上麻烦，没错吧？他的脾气肯定和你的脾气差不多。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 如果你是拿我做参考的话，那你对脾气这件事情简直一无所知，扎格列欧斯。好了，到此为止！剩下的事情你已经知道了，别忘了你发过的誓。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: One thing, before you depart again, boy. Until the Queen's intentions with Olympus come to pass... not a word to anyone about her presence, here. Do you understand?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I do. But she won't have to hide forever.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 在你走之前还有件事，孩子。除非是冥后本人打算和奥林匹斯众神见面……否则关于她在这里的事情，不要和任何人说，明白吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我明白，但她也没必要一直这么躲着。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So, now that the festivities are over with, it's back to work like this, the same as ever?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Do you have any idea what happens when you announce the Underworld has a Queen, boy? Urgh, damn it! Zagreus, I mean. You become inundated with well-wishes from every blasted shade that wants something.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're responding to well-wishes? Aw. Don't you think some of your subjects are sincerely happy for you?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 所以说，既然现在庆典已经结束，是不是要像平时那样继续工作了？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道当我们宣布冥界迎回了冥后时发生了什么事吗，小子？呃，该死！扎格列欧斯，我是说。你会被一群可恶的幽灵团团围住，淹没在别有用心的祝福里。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你在应付那些祝福？哦…你难道不觉得你的一些属下其实是真心为你高兴吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I never stopped to think about why pomegranates grew here in the Underworld. Mother's doing from before, then? And all that stuff she told the Olympians, about how they bind you to this place... it's all nonsense?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You know full well that the pomegranates in my realm hold a certain power beyond the tartness of their taste, boy. The Queen... she has a way with plants, you see. A bit of her own mother's gift, applied more sensibly.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You kept them growing all this time... flourishing, even, because of her.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我从一直都在想，为什么石榴可以在冥界生长，这是母亲的成果吗？还有，她和奥林匹斯众神说的那些事情，说他们把你束缚在这个地方……都是胡说八道吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你很清楚，冥界的石榴不仅仅美味可口，还拥有某种特别的力量，孩子。冥后……你也看到了，她对付植物很有一套。这算是来自她母亲的力量吧，而她运用得更加明智。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你一直种植着这些石榴……甚至让它们蓬勃生长，都是因为她。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So, what happened, when Mother first arrived, if I may ask? Some of your residents seem to remember the Queen from before. Yet the Olympians just never found out?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: They had no jurisdiction here. No knowledge of our goings-on. Well, Hermes did, perhaps, but in a very limited capacity. As far as anybody knew beyond this realm... our Queen was Nyx. Ask nothing more of this.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我斗胆问一下，母亲第一次来冥界时发生了什么事？这里的一些居民好像记得冥后的往事。奥林匹斯众神莫非从来没弄清楚过？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 他们管不到这儿，也无从知晓这里发生的事。呃，赫尔墨斯倒是可以，不过也很有限。在冥界以外的任何人看来…我们的冥后是倪克斯。切勿追根究底。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Father... how are you doing without Mother around? Will she be all right, on Olympus?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Clearly she is more than capable of handling herself. And we here have been well accustomed to not having her about.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So everything's back to normal, then? That sounds lovely.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Nothing is normal, anymore. Besides! She shall return. Knowing that she shall return, is that not sufficient for you? Be patient, for once.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲……母亲不在身边的日子，你过得怎么样？她在奥林匹斯山上能照顾好自己吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 很显然，她相当擅长照顾好自己，而且我们已经习惯了她不在身边的日子。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 所以说，一切又恢复原样了，是吗？听起来可真不错。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 一切都已经不一样了。而且！她还会回来的。知道她还会回来，对你来说这还不够吗？这一次你耐心点吧。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's good to see Mother's back. Not that I was too concerned, but... I was definitely a little concerned.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I shared in that particular concern, and yes... it is good the Queen has once again returned. And she shall have to depart again before we know it, so cherish your time with her, boy!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 很高兴看到母亲回来了。倒不是因为我很担心她，不过……我确实有点担心。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我也明白你这种担心，是啊……皇后又回来了，真是太好了。在我们反应过来之前，她就不得不再次离开了。所以，好好珍惜和她在一起的时光吧，孩子！

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Tell me, in brief, boy. Our own upon Olympus... are they continuing to aid you as expected?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Still showing up and lending their support. I think some of them are a little disappointed I'm not planning to come join them, though... I think they understand now that they owe the Underworld a debt. We all have to do our part, looking after the mortals. Whether alive or dead.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Indeed. I half-expected they would disappoint. Abandon you to toil on your own. At least thus far they've honored their commitment, then.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 简单地和我说说吧，孩子。咱们在奥林匹斯山的家人们……还是在继续帮助你吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 一如既往。他们之中的一些神略显失望因为我并不打算加入他们，不过……我觉得他们应该已经明白他们欠冥界一个人情。在照料凡人的过程中——无论在他们生前还是死后，我们都有各自的职责。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，我之前还以为他们会感到失望，把你一个人丢在这里呢。至少到目前为止，他们一直恪守着承诺。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So, are you maintaining better contact now with Uncle Zeus, Uncle Poseidon, and the rest? Oh, and... is it all right for me to speak about them here?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Urgh... I'm certain the superficial messages we have exchanged shall taper off, with time. We have always been apart, irrespective of the distance separating us. I know Zeus is content with your mother's version of events. Thus we are at peace, for now.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, what do you mean, for now?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I mean only that our family is prone to causing problems for itself. Never content to leave things well enough alone. But if we have little to do with them... their quarrels, all their nonsense on Olympus... it should be of no consequence.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 所以，现在你和宙斯叔叔、波塞冬叔叔，还有其他人往来得更频繁了吗？哦，我是说……我可以在这里谈论他们的事情吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 呃……我敢肯定，随着时间的推移，我们之间那些肤浅的往来会渐渐变少。这和我们彼此相隔很远没什么关系，而是我们始终都合不来。我知道，宙斯对你母亲策划的活动感到很满意，所以我们暂时处于和平状态。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等等，你说的暂时是什么意思？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我只是想说，我们的家人很喜欢自己制造麻烦，他们永远都不会满足于已经很好的结果。不过，只要别和他们扯上关系……别被卷入他们的争端，别被卷入奥林匹斯山上的破事里……那应该就没什么。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: The latest reports indicate that mortals are fully twice as fearful of ending up in Tartarus as in our last evaluation period, thanks to the destruction you have caused. You are an unseen power in the Underworld. Commendable.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Commendable, me? An unseen power, huh. Surprised you're giving me the credit, Father.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I give credit where it's due. But the mortals? They know nothing of what transpires here. Only rumblings we permit to escape our realm... rumblings that reinforce their deepest fears about what shall transpire after their demise.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So the more havoc I wreak in the Underworld, the more mortals hear about all the unpleasantness, and... it makes them fearful of this place? If more of them lead upstanding lives, it'll keep Tartarus from overflowing, I guess.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 最新的报告显示，由于你造成的破坏，凡人对塔耳塔罗斯的恐惧程度是上一次评估的两倍。你正是这冥界之中看不见的力量，这很值得表扬。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 值得表扬，我吗？看不见的力量，嗯。你居然会表扬我，这真让我意外，父亲。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 该表扬的人我向来会表扬。至于那些凡人呢？他们对这里的一切一无所知。他们只会听到传言，说我们允许有人逃出冥界……这些传言会进一步加深他们最深切的恐惧，让他们担心起死后的日子。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 所以说，我在冥界造成的破坏越多，凡人们就会听到越多的不满，然后……他们就会越害怕这个地方？如果能让更多人过上正直的生活的话，说不定塔耳塔罗斯就不会人满为患了。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Whatever you may wish to say, I do not wish to hear it.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 不管你想说什么，我都不会听。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You're interrupting me during my time at work.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你打扰到我工作了。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I think I've heard more than enough from you lately.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你的事我最近已经听得够多了。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You're willfully wasting my time, aren't you.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你就是明摆着想浪费我时间是吧。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Go, get out. Don't let me stop you.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 出去出去。我不拦你。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Shouldn't you be getting skewered by the dead?

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你怎么还不回去接着让那些死人捅你？

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Go to your room, or anywhere but here.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 回你自己房间去，只要别在这就行。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Blood and darkness, what is it with you?

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 鲜血与黑暗啊，你想干什么？

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Have you come up with more impertinence to spout at me?

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 没有什么无礼的话要对我说的吗？

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I'll not be bothered with your disrespect.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你这种不敬的行为对我没有影响。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Has it occurred to you that I'm preoccupied?

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你知不知道我现在很忙？

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I am uninterested in conversing with you, boy.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我现在没兴趣跟你说话，孩子。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Your presence is no longer welcome here.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 这里不欢迎你。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: How possibly could I have given the impression that I wished to talk?

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我看上去像是想跟你讲话的样子吗？

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You realize just how much property of mine you have defaced?

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你知不知道你搞坏了我多少东西？

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Fail all you like, you're never getting out of here.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 尽管死吧，你永远离不开这里。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You'll learn your place, the hard way, evidently.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你还是得通过受苦才能了解自己的身份。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: To suffer such indignity, from my own kin.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我竟被自己的血脉如此侮辱。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Such foolishness as yours I scarce can comprehend.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我真的想不明白你为何如此愚蠢。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: We've nothing left now to discuss between us.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我们之间已经没什么好说的了。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Whatever you may wish to say, I do not wish to hear it.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 不管你想说什么，我都不会听。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Have I mentioned that you're never getting out of here?

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我说过你永远不可能离开这里的吧？

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You're here to stay, boy. All of us are.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你哪儿也去不了，孩子。我们都一样。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I'm busy now, as you can plainly see.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 正如你所见，我现在很忙。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Blasted parchmentwork, it never goes away.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 该死的文书工作，从来没个断绝的时候。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Your recent efforts have proved useful to this place.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你最近的努力卓有成效。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Go instill some fear in those wretches out there, would you?

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 去给外面那些暗灵们散播点恐惧，好吗？

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: He's back again, Cerberus! I'll try not to keep him for as long, next time.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯，他又回来了！下次我会尽量让他别留在这儿这么长时间。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Doubtless I shall get you for that one next time.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 毫无疑问，下次我一定会报那一箭之仇。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Another satyr outbreak to look out for next you venture there...

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 又有一个萨提尔等着你去收拾他的入侵了…

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Be certain to give your regards to your mother as well!

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 确保也向你的母亲问好！

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Repairs for all the carnage that you sowed are already underway.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我们已经在修缮你造成的一切狼藉了。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: What else can we do to contain you, I wonder...

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我有时真想知道，我们还能做些什么才容得下你……

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I have some catching up to do, as you can see.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 显然我现在要叙叙旧。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Ah, we ought to reconvene the court now, I suppose.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，我认为我们现在应该开庭了。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: As you can see, I must attend to all this parchmentwork.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你看见了，我必须得处理这一大堆文书工作。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I must say, you made a hollow mockery of Theseus that time.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 不得不说，你上次让忒修斯丢尽了脸面。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Our security efforts in Asphodel are evidently lacking.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 很显然，我们在水仙花平原的安保措施不足。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Go rest yourself if need be. Though the Underworld is ready when you are.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 想休息就休息去吧，不过整个冥界都已经准备好了。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Against my better judgment, I went easier on you that time.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 那次是我自己犯蠢，对你手下留情了。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Thus starts and ends our brief exchange of pleasantries.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 就这样，我们短暂的寒暄开始了，结束了。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Continue to perform your duties as you have.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 和以前一样，继续履行你的职责吧。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Cerberus there was anticipating your return.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯在等着你回来呢。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Your mother expected this most recent result of yours.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你最近一次的成果，你的母亲早就预料到了。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Do I appear as though I've time for conversation, boy?

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我看起来像是有话要和你说的样子吗，孩子？

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Let us discuss your work performance at some other time.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 咱们下次再讨论讨论你的工作表现吧。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Your infamy throughout Elysium has only grown.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你在至福乐土的恶名甚嚣尘上。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I must admit... that was a job well done back there.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我得承认……你上次确实做得不错。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, uh, Father. I thought, maybe, you know, here.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Where did you get this...? You think you can butter me up with such trifles? Give me that, and then get out of here.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，父亲。我觉得，也许，这个，给。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你从哪儿拿到的…？你觉得用这种小东西就能讨好我吗？东西给我，你有多远走多远。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, uh, Father. I thought, maybe, you know, here.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You owe me nothing, certainly not this. And I've nothing to give you in exchange. But fine, I'll honor our custom. Give it here.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，父亲。我觉得，也许，这个，给。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你什么都不欠我的，至少不欠我这个，而且我也没什么回礼给你。不过好吧，我就尊重一下传统吧，这个给你。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, Father... I know we can't exactly change the past, but we can try to move forward. Look, I know I'm not even supposed to have this stuff, but everyone likes it, won't you try it, at least? Here, take it, either way.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Hrm. I... can dispose of this properly. Speaking of disposal... I've no further need for this, here, so... rid me of it, why don't you? On your way out.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，父亲……我知道过去的事情无法改变，但我们可以试着向前看。我想说，这东西我是不该有的，不过所有人都很喜欢，你要不要也试着尝尝？反正我先给你了。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，我……可以把它妥善处理掉。说到处理……我已经不需要这件东西了，给你吧。所以……你何不替我把它处理掉？不过是你出去时顺手的事。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: More Nectar for the old disposal service, Father, if you don't mind. Come on, you must have tried the stuff, at least in the days before you were here! Didn't you ever enjoy yourself, at any point?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I don't require beverages in order to enjoy myself, boy. Unlike so many of your kin upon their mountain. Yet this blasted substance somehow finds its way to my domain. Then, fine! You wish for the customs here to be more akin to Olympus, why not?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲，如果你不介意的话，帮忙把这些蜜露也处理掉吧。来嘛，你肯定已经尝过这种蜜酒了，至少在你来这里之前肯定尝过！在那段时间里，你一次都没好好享受过美酒吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我和你在奥林匹斯山上的亲戚们不一样，孩子。我不需要什么美酒，但这该死的东西还是来到了我的王国里。不过，好吧！如果你希望这里的习俗能更像奥林匹斯山的话，那有何不可呢？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Have another bottle, why don't you, Father? Not like it's going to change anything between us, right? All the Nectar in the Underworld can't change what's already happened. Or change yourself.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Hrm. You're probably correct. You must think it is my age that makes me obstinate. Unable to change my nature. But I have always been inflexible. You think I'm proud of it? You call me 'Father' like it's an insult. I deserve the title only as a technicality, I know.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You could start being a better father at any point. There's no one stopping you but you.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Yes, well... unfortunately, I am a significant impediment. You should be well aware of that. You were able to stop me. I have thus far been unable to do so...

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不如再来一瓶吧，父亲？我倒不是想说，再来一瓶就能改变我们之间的事情了，是吧？就算把整个冥界的蜜露都喝光，也改变不了曾经发生过的事情，也改变不了你这个人。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，或许你说得没错。你肯定是觉得，我是上了年纪才会变得这么顽固。我改变不了我的本性，我也一直都这么不知变通。你觉得我为此很自豪吗？你叫我“父亲”，就像是在侮辱我一样。我明白，我其实没干过什么像父亲的事。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你随时都可以开始当个更出色的父亲。没人会阻止你的，除了你自己之外。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，呃……遗憾的是，我自己正是个相当大的阻碍，你应该很了解这一点才对。是你改变了我，我自己一直都做不到这一点……

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Enough of this, boy! Even mortals know better. I don't want your Nectar, or Ambrosia, or whichever offerings. You owe me no such thing, and I shall not accept it any longer. In fact, here... you shall take all of it back!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Why? It's just Nectar, Father, lighten up. I get that you're surly about everything, but please at least try toward decency with me! If not for me, then for Mother.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: How dare you lecture me? I mean... urgh... look. As you told me yourself... there's no changing what already transpired. And our memories are warnings. When you have lived as long as I have... you come to understand your weaknesses.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What are you getting at? You're just going to give up, stick with what's comfortable for you instead of making any real effort at making peace with your son?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Rngh. Listen to me. My attempts at making peace are going to be rather subtle for your tastes. I cannot change the past. And there is only so much I can do about the future. I tell you this because... I shall not lie to you again. That much, I swear.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 够了，孩子！就连凡人都知道，我不需要你的什么蜜露、仙馔密酒，还是别的什么东西。你根本不欠我这些，我也不打算再收下你的礼物了。事实上，你看……这些东西你应该都拿回去！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 怎么了？不过是蜜露而已，父亲，看开点。我知道你对什么事情都没耐心，但你至少应该试着对我和善一些！就算不是为了我，也是为了母亲。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你竟敢教训起我来了？我是说……呃……你看，就像你之前亲口说的……发生过的事情是无法改变的。我们的记忆都是警告，当你像我一样活了这么久之后……你就会明白你自己的弱点。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你想说什么？你不打算努力缓和与儿子的关系，而是打算就这么放弃，只呆在你觉得舒适的地方就好了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 呃啊，听我说。我打算缓和与你的关系，但我的努力不一定对你的胃口。我确实无法改变过去，而对于未来，我能做的事情也很有限。我和你说这些是因为……我不希望再对你撒谎了，至少这一点我可以向你保证。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Well? What is the latest explanation for your tardiness? Lost track of time admiring the courtyard view? Perhaps you were recuperating from your martial training. Achilles is not prone to holding back.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I... I'm sorry, Father, I just overslept. I must have overslept. How am I even supposed to know exactly when to be here, I mean, every moment every day and night, here, it's all the same!

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: It's not at all the same! The hue of Ixion's green light takes on an obviously lighter hue when it is time! You're an embarrassment not just to me, here, boy, but to this entire operation. Now get back to work!

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Hades_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 那么，你这次的迟到理由是什么呢？欣赏庭院的美景而忘了时间？或许你还没从战斗训练中恢复吧。阿喀琉斯是不会手下留情的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 对……对不起，父亲，我只是睡过头了。我肯定是睡过头了。我甚至不知道什么时候该来这儿，我的意思是，这里的白天和晚上，每时每刻都没有任何差别！

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Hades_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 完全不是一直一样！ 时间一到，伊克西翁的绿光会明显亮一个明度！小子，你不仅使我蒙羞，还使这儿的一切蒙羞。现在给我滚回去工作！

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Not only were you late, again... but then you also failed to perform even the simplest tasks that I had asked, repeatedly, that you complete. How many chances do you need at this? I am too lenient with you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Too lenient? Instead of lambasting me nonstop, have you considered, maybe, training me some more to do this fascinating work to your satisfaction? You'll forgive me if I didn't memorize every laborious detail the last time you performed your monologue about how all this works.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Excuse me?! If I am not mistaken, you're deflecting your incompetence toward me? As though the Goddess of Wisdom herself has come to aid you in your time of need! I could replace you here and now with any number of simple shades, hungry to work here!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Then why don't you?! I don't want any of this. I'm not the one who drew the short lot with your brothers and got stuck here forever!! Why am I having to do this senseless parchment-pushing for you?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Why are you stuck? You're not. You're fired! I was wrong to think you were prepared to take on any responsibility at all. And, don't you ever invoke your uncles here again. Or I'll have you cast into the lowest pits of Tartarus. Now, get out of my administration, and my sight!

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Hades_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 你不仅又迟到了……而且还一而再、再而三地搞砸我交给你的任务，连最简单的也做不好。你究竟还需要多少次机会？我对你实在是太仁慈了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 仁慈？！你有没有想过，与其不断地责骂我，你不如多训练一下我做你这些“令人着迷”工作直到你满意？你应该原谅我我没记住所有繁琐的细节，因为你上次在说这些怎么操作的时候根本是在单口相声。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Hades_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 什么意思？！如果我没理解错的话，你是在把你的无能怪罪于我？说得好像智慧女神亲自给你启智了一样！我完全可以当场把你替换掉，争着来这工作的鬼魂多得很！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那你还犹豫什么？！这些都不是我想要的。我不像某人，和兄弟几个抽签输了，然后被永远困在这里！！我为什么必须要为你做这些无意义的文书工作？

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Hades_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 被困？你没有。你被炒鱿鱼了！我以为你可以承担起一些责任，但我想错了。还有，不许在这里再提起你的那些叔叔。否则我会把你丢到塔耳塔罗斯的最深层地狱。现在，给我滚，不要再让我看到你！

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Infernal watch-dog Cerberus regards the Underworld Prince with mixed emotions, from purest joy to deepest melancholy.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You watch over things for me, won't you, boy? You know I'd take you if I could.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 地狱看门犬刻耳柏洛斯用复杂的表情看着冥界王子，从最纯粹的喜悦到最深沉的忧郁。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 有好好看守吗，乖狗狗？如果可以的话我也想把你带上。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: How you holding up, boy, eating well lately? All three mouths full and happy?

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Each terrifying maw of the infernal watch-dog Cerberus responds affirmatively, one after the next, as if to reassure the ever-doubting Prince.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 怎么样，乖乖，有好好吃饭吗？三张嘴都吃饱喝足了吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 地狱看门犬刻耳柏洛斯的三张血盆大口依次作出了肯定的回应,生怕王子不相信似的.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Take it easy, boy. I'll probably be back here in no time.

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The watch-dog Cerberus merely sulks upon his supple bedroll.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没事没事，乖狗狗。我应该马上就能回来。

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 看门犬刻耳柏洛斯仅仅是窝在他舒适的床铺上生闷气。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You keep an eye on Father for me, boy. Don't let him sour up everyone's mood.

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Cerberus promises to do exactly that, in his own way.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 帮我看好父亲噢，乖乖。可别让他坏了大家的情绪。

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯以他自己的方式表示答应。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: How's everything been going lately, boy? What's the good word?

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The Underworld Prince's casual inquiry serves but to frustrate the infernal hound, as none of his three heads possess the gift and curse of speech.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 最近怎么样，乖狗狗？有什么好消息吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 冥界王子的随口发问让这头地狱猎犬感到难过，因为它的三个头里没有一个头有说话的天赋或者诅咒。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, boy, just me again. Here to report it's pretty dangerous out there even without you on guard duty all the time.

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The venerable hound of hell barely acknowledges the softly-spoken Prince's platitude, knowing full well the Underworld is not as vigilantly guarded as in ages past.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 乖乖，我又来了。就算外头没有你，也还是危险四伏啊。

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 庄严的地狱猎犬不太认同王子温柔说出的这番话，它知道冥界早已不如以前那般戒备森严了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Guess what, boy? Made it all the way to Asphodel last time! I fully understand how come you never liked it there. Now to trek on back, I guess. Take care!

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Despite the Underworld Prince's optimism, his old companion Cerberus, the multi-headed hound, maintains a somewhat sulky attitude for now.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你猜怎么着，乖狗狗？我终于到达水仙花平原了！我算是明白你为什么不喜欢那里了。现在我要走了，多保重！

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 尽管冥界王子如此乐观，他的老伙计三头猎犬刻耳柏洛斯，仍旧保持着一种生气的情绪。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey good to see you back here, boy. I'm glad you're back on guard duty! Even if it means having to find a way past you. I know you're just doing your job.

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The fear-inducing hellhound eyes the Underworld Prince uneasily, his six ferocious eyes each glistening within the dim light of the House.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 能回来见到你真好，乖乖。真高兴你又能继续看守了！尽管这说明我得想办法通过你的看守。我知道你只是在做自己的工作而已。

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 可怕的地狱猎犬不安地盯着冥界王子，六只眼睛在屋内昏暗的光线下闪闪发光。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I hope I haven't been inconveniencing you too much with all the visits to the Temple lately, boy. Say, how do you get back? Charon giving you a lift?

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Thus asks the Prince his question of the guardian of the gates of hell, knowing full well the multi-headed monster keeps a wide berth of the river-boatman, as do all with any sense.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我最近总是往圣殿这边跑，希望没给你带来太多麻烦，乖狗狗。你最近还好吗？卡戎有没有载你一程？

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 王子向地狱之门的守护者如是问道。不过他早已心知肚明，这只长着好几个脑袋的猛犬肯定会对冥河的摆渡人敬而远之，就像冥界其他脑子正常的人那样。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Enjoying staring at that ball I got you, boy? No fun if it doesn't fight back, huh...

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The hell-forged multi-headed monster feels no urgency to waste his precious time on simple play-things, much preferring to conserve his vast energy reserves in case any trespassers need to be eaten suddenly.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你喜欢我给你的那个球吗，乖狗狗？不过它不会还手，这恐怕就没劲了吧……

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 这只来自地狱的多头怪兽并不急着把自己的宝贵时间浪费在简单的玩物上，它宁愿将自己需要的能量储备起来，以备万一需要的时候能够一口吃掉闯入者。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You really ripped the lounge to pieces, boy? I hope you didn't get yourself in too much trouble. I'm sorry to have worried you like that.

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The guilt-wracked monster Cerberus admits to committing the crime, expressing some remorse for having implicated the incendiary Prince.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你是真的把休息室搞得一团乱是吗，乖乖？希望你没让自己惹上其他麻烦。真抱歉让你这样担心我。

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯满怀愧疚地承认了自己犯过的罪行，并表达了自己将王子也牵连进来的懊悔。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, did you see, boy? The old lounge is good as new again, you ought to check it out! Just, don't annihilate it like you did last time.

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Each savage countenance of Cerberus lights up to hear the news, doubtless beginning to assemble stratagems for ravaging the lounging area once more.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨，看到没有，乖乖？老休息室又重焕新光了，来看看吧！别再跟上次一样搞坏东西就行了。

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 听到这个消息后，刻耳柏洛斯的每一张脸都冒了光，一定是在盘算着把休息室再弄坏一次。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, boy. I hope all the construction and renovation around here hasn't been too inconvenient for you, lately. But hey, the lounge is just about ready for you to utterly destroy again!

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Prince Zagreus implants in the impressionable, vicious watchdog of the Underworld a new appetite for more destruction, to be sated in another age.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，乖狗狗，最近这里到处是翻修工作和施工，希望这没给你带来太多麻烦。不过，你看，休息室马上就要完工了，到时候你就可以再大肆破坏一通了！

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 于是，扎格列欧斯王子怂恿着这只脾气暴躁、性格凶狠的冥府守门犬，想让它搞出更多破坏。这种对破坏的渴望，恐怕要再过上几百年才能平息了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know, after dying in some wretched manner, giving pets to my good boy sure helps me get back on my feet. Thanks for being here for me.

en.speaker: Cerberus
