en.text: The burning embers in the eyes of monstrous Cerberus, notorious hound of hell, reveal that he, too, is amenable to the pets of which the Underworld Prince speaks, and in fact is deeply grateful for the quantity of them.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 说真的，以某种凄惨的方式丧命之后，好好拍拍我的好狗狗确实有助于让我重新振作起来。谢谢你在这里陪着我。

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 声名狼藉的的地狱犬刻耳柏洛斯眼中的烈焰熊熊燃烧，表明它也很喜欢冥界王子殿下所说的“拍拍”。它很是感激王子总是会拍它。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I found her, boy! My mother! Persephone, you remember her, don't you? She was pleased to hear about you. But I couldn't stay for long, and I have to find her again, so... guess I'll see you at the Temple, then?

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The ghoulish features of the much-reviled hound of hell all soften instantly upon the mention of a certain name; briefly, then, the monster is at peace.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我找到她了，乖狗狗！我的母亲！珀尔塞福涅，你还记得她，是吧？她很高兴听到你的消息。不过我在上面待不了太久，所以我打算再去找她一次。所以我猜……到时候神殿里见吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 一听到某个名字，这只恐怖的地狱恶犬散发出的凶狠气场立刻消失不见。之后，这只怪物进入了短暂的平静状态。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, look at you, boy! Never seen you quite so perky, relatively speaking of course, big tough guy like yourself. You must have missed Mother just as much as she missed you. Well, you've got plenty of time for catching up on things, now!

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The monstrous triple-headed beast of Hades would perhaps be overcome with pure emotion by the joyous circumstances, were he only capable of this.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哎哟，看看你，乖狗狗！我从来没有见过你这么活泼。当然，对你这样的硬汉来说，只是相对活泼一些。你一定很想念母亲吧？她也一样很想念你。好了，你们现在有足够的时间可以叙叙旧了！

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 在欢庆的场合中，哈迪斯豢养的这头三首地狱恶犬心里或许会充满纯粹的快乐，如果它做得到的话。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Bet you're happy to see Mother home again, huh, boy? Only wish you could have told me about her before.

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The hell-born monster Cerberus contentedly ignores the Prince's callous, inconsiderate remark.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜你再次见到母亲，一定很开心吧，乖狗狗？要是你以前能告诉我和她有关的事情就好了。

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 来自地狱的怪物刻耳柏洛斯开心地无视了王子冷酷无情、不合时宜的发言。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oof, you showed me back there, boy. With Father on the surface? I know you were just playing, but... go easier on me, next time, will you?

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The unrepentant monster Cerberus is thoroughly incapable of showing neither restraint nor remorse.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哎呀，你可让我尝到厉害了，乖狗狗。你和父亲在地面上的时候，记得吗？我知道你是在闹，不过……下次对我下手轻点，好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 不长记性的刻耳柏洛斯既没有表现出任何克制，也没有表现出任何懊恼。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: We're all very proud of you, boy! You were so well-behaved at the feast. I was worried sick one uncle or the other was going to set you off at some point, but you were Patience Incarnate. Thanks for helping show our extended family a good time!

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: How infernal Cerberus, the hound of hell, managed to maintain civilized behavior throughout the duration of the recent feast remains a mystery to all who attended.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我们都为你感到自豪，乖狗狗！你在宴会上的表现真不错。我本来很担心某个脾气古怪的叔叔可能会惹你大发雷霆，但你简直就是耐心的化身。谢谢你让我们新的大家庭度过了一段美好的时光！

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 在最近举办的这场盛宴中，地狱猎犬刻耳柏洛斯究竟是如何始终保持温文尔雅的举止，这对所有宾客而言都是个未解之谜。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Cerberus looks mournfully toward the Prince.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯悲哀地看向王子。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The Prince and Cerberus exchange a look.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 王子和刻耳柏洛斯交换了一下眼神。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The watch-dog Cerberus observes the Prince.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 看门犬刻耳柏洛斯打量着王子。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Cerberus cannot be bothered at this time.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 现在还不能打扰刻耳柏洛斯。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Cerberus is comfortably at rest, observing all.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯正在休息，打量着周遭的一切。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Cerberus lies as ever at the foot of his Lord Master's throne.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯像往常一样趴在主人的王座脚边。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Cerberus makes no attempt to move.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯一点也不想动。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Cerberus is busily considering upon what else to gnaw.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯此刻正在考虑要咬点什么东西。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Cerberus goes about his business: gnawing, in this case.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 此时此刻，刻耳柏洛斯开始办他的事了：咬东西。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Cerberus is preoccupied with scratching and biting at himself.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯开始挠自己，咬自己。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Cerberus is uninterested in conversing at this time.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯现在不想谈话。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The hound of hell rests peacefully upon his favored spot.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 地狱猎犬在他的地盘上安静地休息。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: All three of Cerberus the watch-dog's terrifying countenances greet the Prince.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 看门犬刻耳柏洛斯骇人的三个头对王子表示欢迎。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The vicious three-faced guard-hound of the gates of death barks out a brief hello.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 凶狠的死亡之门看门三头犬嚎叫着打了声招呼。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The ever-faithful Cerberus remains resting steadfastly in his spot.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 忠诚的刻耳柏洛斯继续趴在自己的窝里休息。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Notoriously vicious Cerberus is watching quietly his Master's court.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 以凶狠闻名的刻耳柏洛斯安静地看着主人工作。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: One of the frightful maws of Cerberus busily grooms the other two.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯的其中一个头正在给另外两个梳理毛发。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The triple-headed monster Cerberus is dutifully sitting there as ever.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 三头怪物刻耳柏洛斯像往常一样坐在那里。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The many-headed Cerberus is busy thinking of his next savory meal.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 三头的刻耳柏洛斯正想着自己下一餐吃什么。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Cerberus acknowledges the Prince with an affection tempered well with time.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯以一种时间打造的、温和的感情欢迎王子。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The hellish watch-dog snarls at the listless Shades crowding about the court.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 地狱看门犬对着庭院里拥挤在一起的无精打采的暗灵们咆哮起来。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The much-feared Cerberus licks endlessly at something on the floor.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 骇人的刻耳柏洛斯对着地上的某种东西舔个没完。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The hound of hell barely regards the Prince, having been sated for the time.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 这只地狱猎犬已经安静了一段时间，几乎没怎么搭理王子。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The vicious triple-headed Cerberus shows some restraint, for now.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 这只凶恶的三首猎犬刻耳柏洛斯表现出了一定的克制，至少暂时如此。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Cerberus is too busy living in the lap of luxury to pay much heed.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯忙着享受安逸的生活，没时间搭理别人。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The monster Cerberus sits vigilant atop his bedroll.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯机警地坐在他的坐垫上。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Each savage maw of Cerberus salivates in anticipation of the next time to feed.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 知道吃东西的时候到了，刻耳柏洛斯每张饥渴的巨口都流下了口水。

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Terrifying Cerberus is busy gathering his strength for when next he shall bar the Prince's path.

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 恐怖的刻耳柏洛斯正在忙着积蓄力量，为下次阻止王子前进做好准备。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Look what I got for you, boy...!

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: As one of Cerberus' heads receives the Prince's gift, another muzzles something back into his hand.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 看看我给你带了什么，乖乖…！

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯的其中一个头接受了王子的礼物，另一个头把什么东西塞进了王子的手里。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: There's a good boy... thought you'd like that!

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Cerberus is overjoyed to have received such a delicious treat.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 乖狗狗…我就知道你喜欢！

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯收到这美味的礼物显得非常开心。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Only the very best treats for my best friend, right, boy?

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Cerberus yawlps in merriment upon receiving such a generous offering.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 最好的东西只给最好的朋友，对吧，乖乖？

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯收到这件礼物后开心得直打哈欠。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It is my humble duty to oblige my favorite boy with all the treats as I am able to procure.

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Knowing the watch-dog's never-ending appetite for treats, the Prince obliges him.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 尽我所能让我最好的伙伴尝够美食是我的责任。

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 知道看门犬经不住美食的诱惑，王子也就成全他了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You like this stuff, don't you, boy? Well, good, because I like sneaking it over to you!

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The delectable taste of Nectar is enough to briefly sate even the ferocious appetite of the hound of hell.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你很喜欢这东西，是吧，我的好狗狗？那就好，因为这是特意给你偷偷拿过来的！

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 蜜露甜美的味道，甚至足以让脾气暴躁的地狱犬安静下来。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: This Nectar not fancy enough for you, boy, is that it? You've developed quite the delicate palate at your distinguished age!

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: Though having little appetite remaining for the lightness of Nectar's flavor, the multi-headed monster of the Underworld nevertheless accepts.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你觉得这瓶蜜露的味道不够劲儿，是吧，我的好狗狗？你活了这么久，口味也变得很不错了嘛！

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 尽管蜜露的味道实在是太清淡了，这只冥府多头犬对此并没什么兴趣，但它还是勉强接受了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That's right, boy... Ambrosia, just for you. You're going to love it. Pretty much every creature, living or dead, does!

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The six eyes of the hideous hound of hell go wide at once from having received the exquisite gift of rare Olympian Ambrosia. The creature is rather beside himself.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没错，我的好狗狗……这仙馔密酒是特地给你的，你肯定会喜欢。几乎所有人都喜欢仙馔密酒，无论是活人还是死人！

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 看到了来自奥林匹斯山的仙馔密酒之后，这只丑陋的地狱犬立刻瞪大了它的六只眼睛。这份罕见的贵重礼物让它欣喜若狂。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hits the spot, doesn't it, boy? I know you're caught up in the middle of all this and having to weigh your loyalties more than you'd like. I'm sorry we're putting you through this.

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The Underworld Prince's next attempt to bribe the monstrous triple-headed hellhound into further liking him proves once again successful, as the kingly gift of heavenly Ambrosia is beyond compare.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你很喜欢吧，我的乖狗狗？我知道，你并不情愿被卷入这件事情之中，总是不得不衡量自己到底应该听谁的吩咐。把你置于这样的窘境之中，我很抱歉。

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 冥界王子打算进一步收买这头可怕的三首猎犬，拉近与它的关系。事实证明，他的计划再次奏效了，因为仙馔密酒的美味真的是无与伦比。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Cerberus, not to get all sentimental on you, but... oh, who am I kidding, look... you've been with me my entire life! I know you're here at home partly because of me, aren't you?

en.speaker: Cerberus
en.text: The bond between a hound and its master is as hard as adamant. Cerberus, the fearsome monster born of hell, and guardian of its gates, answers firstly to the Prince's father. But it turns out, the Prince may be the next best thing.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're the best boy in the whole world. Even if heads Beta and Gamma don't much care for pets, do they? I've got more than enough lined up for you, though. Count on it.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯，我倒不是想多愁善感，不过……哦，我这是在说什么傻话呢。你看，你一直都和我在一起生活！我知道，你会待在家里，或多或少是因为我的关系，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 刻耳柏洛斯
zh-CN.text: 这只地狱犬和它主人之间的感情，就像精金一样牢不可摧。恐怖的地狱巨怪刻耳柏洛斯负责看守者地狱的大门，必须首先听从王子父亲的命令。但事实证明，在那之后，能让它忠心不二的人，便是王子本人了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你真是整个世界最乖的乖狗狗，不过你的第二个头和第三个头不怎么喜欢被摸，是吧？不过，我给你准备了相当丰富的礼物，拭目以待吧。

en.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
en.text: The multi-headed Cerberus stands vigilant before the Underworld's entryway; the tales of what happens to those foolish enough to attempt to pass are far too graphic to describe.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So it's really come to this, boy? After everything we've been through. Well then, if this is how it has to be, there's nothing left to say. Except for: On your guard!!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hahaha, no, but seriously, boy. I know why you're here. There has to be a way to make you look the other way. What if I help you with the Satyr problem, would you let me go? Please. I have to find Persephone... my mother. You know what this means to me.

en.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
en.text: After a moment's hesitation and deliberation, the voracious hound of hell barks once, affirmatively, toward the Prince, who sets off in search of something that can sate the monster's appetites.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 三头犬刻耳柏洛斯机警地站在冥界入口前，而传说中那些想越过这道门的蠢货下场都过于凄惨，这里不便描述。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这一天真的来了，乖乖。经过了这么多。好吧，如果非得这样的话，也没什么好说的了。除了：准备战斗！！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哈哈哈，不，但是老实说，乖乖。我知道你为什么在这里。肯定有什么办法能让你放弃这样做。如果我帮你解决萨提尔的问题，你能放我走吗？求你了。我一定要找到珀尔塞福涅。你知道这对我意味着什么。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 经过了片刻的犹豫和思考之后，贪吃的地狱猎犬，对王子发出肯定的叫声，王子开始寻找可以满足这怪兽胃口的东西。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: All right, boy, I got your favorite treat. But you have to promise to let me pass if I hand it over, OK?

en.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
en.text: Terrifying Cerberus accepts the fetid sack, and scans the darkened hall for where best to consume the stomach-turning contents.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好了乖乖，这是你最喜欢的。给你可以，但是你得保证下次让我通过，怎么样？

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 骇人的刻耳柏洛斯收下了这散发着恶臭的袋子，开始在昏暗的大厅找一个角落，享用这令人反胃的美食。

en.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
en.text: Cerberus again accepts the sack.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯再次收下了袋子。

en.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
en.text: Cerberus again accepts the sack.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯再次收下了袋子。

en.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
en.text: Gigantic Cerberus accepts the Prince's foul offering.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 高大的刻耳柏洛斯收下了王子肮脏的贡品。

en.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
en.text: Gigantic Cerberus accepts the Prince's foul offering.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 高大的刻耳柏洛斯收下了王子肮脏的贡品。

en.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
en.text: The fearsome Cerberus accepts the Satyr sack.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 可怕的刻耳柏洛斯收下了萨提尔的袋子。

en.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
en.text: The Prince persuades the Underworld's ferocious guardian to move aside.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 王子说服这冥界的凶恶守卫站向一边。

en.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
en.text: The Prince compels the multi-headed hound to let him pass.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 王子强迫这三头猎犬让自己通过。

en.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
en.text: Thus has the Prince again persuaded fearsome Cerberus to get out of his way.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 王子再一次说服了凶恶的刻耳柏洛斯为自己让出一条路。

en.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
en.text: Joyfully the hound of hell accepts another Satyr sack.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 开心的地狱猎犬愉快地接受了另一个萨提尔麻袋。

en.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
en.text: The monster's solitary weakness, Satyr sacks, prove terribly effective, once again.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 再次证明，这只怪物唯一的弱点，即萨提尔麻袋，极为有效。

en.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
en.text: Fang-bearing Cerberus directs all three of his attentions toward the Satyr sack.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯露着尖牙，三只脑袋的注意力都被萨提尔麻袋吸引了。

en.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
en.text: The guardian of hell itself decides the time has come for a short break and snack.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 这只地狱的守护者打算打个盹，吃点零食。

en.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
en.text: Prince Zagreus once more offers to Cerberus one of his favored sacks.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯王子再次给刻耳柏洛斯带来了他最喜欢的麻袋。

en.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
en.text: Cerberus moves for no one, but for Satyr sacks, he can make an exception.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 无论是谁来，刻耳柏洛斯都不会让路。不过如果是为了萨提尔麻袋的话，他可以破个例。

en.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
en.text: Vigilant Cerberus decides to look the other way, this once.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 机警的刻耳柏洛斯打算睁一只眼闭一只眼，仅限这次而已。

en.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
en.text: Each violent countenance of Cerberus agrees the Satyr sack must be destroyed.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 刻耳柏洛斯每张凶狠的脸都认为必须摧毁萨提尔麻袋。

en.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
en.text: After deliberating briefly, Cerberus concludes that, yes, he shall accept the sack.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Cerberus_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 仔细考虑了一阵子之后，刻耳柏洛斯得出了结论：他愿意收下这个麻袋。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Good to see you, lad, despite the circumstances. Remember your training out there. The pain of death is but another obstacle.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: And fear is for the weak. Take care, Achilles.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 不管怎样，还是很高兴见到你，小伙子。记住你的训练。死亡的痛苦只不过是另一种阻碍。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 只有弱者才会感到恐惧。保重，阿喀琉斯。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Good to see you, lad. You've been awful busy as of late, there, haven't you? Let me know if there's something I can do, though from what I can tell, you've had a pretty good handle on it.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 见到你很高兴，小伙子。你最近真的是忙坏了，是吧？如果有什么能帮到你的地方，尽管告诉我。不过在我看来，你已经把这些事情处理得很好了。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: You'll get the hang of it out there, lad. For all our sparring practice, there's no teacher like the real thing. Now then, I have something for you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, wait, you're giving me your Codex? I can't accept something like this!

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Please, I insist. I want your love of history to grow, not just your love of warfare. Besides, maybe you can finish out the rest of it.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 你会掌握诀窍的，小伙子。训练得再多，也不如实战来的有用。来，我有东西要给你。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等下，你要把你的手稿给我？这我真的受不起！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 不用客气，拿着吧。我希望你不仅善武，文化这块儿也要抓一抓。也许你可以把它填满。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, is it really true that Cerberus ripped the lounge up right after I left? He must have gotten in a lot of trouble.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I only wish you could have seen it, lad. The place looked like a vineyard after a typhoon! Your lord father was livid. But he never gets so angry with the dog. Poor Dusa, though, she's picking the place up.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, no... I wondered what became of Dusa. She's always worried Father's going to fire her, even without something like this.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯，刻耳柏洛斯他真的在我离开后把休息室毁了吗？他一定给自己惹了不少麻烦吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我只希望你可以亲眼看到，小伙子。那地方简直就像台风肆虐过的葡萄园一样！你的父亲大人脸都气歪了。他可是从来都没对狗这么生气过。可怜的杜莎，她现在就在收拾那个地方。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不会吧……她现在怎么样了？就算没发生这种事，她也一直在担心父亲会不会解雇她。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I have to say, lad! This place is livelier than usual, of late. Some of the old fixtures of the House getting patched up, new furnishings... it's rather nice, really. We've you to thank, don't we.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, that? It's nothing. Though I'm glad it's made a difference for the better. Our contractor's been doing all the work, I'm just putting in the orders.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: And the funds. Your father runs the Underworld a certain way. This old House is lavish, I suppose, but he has long since ceased trying to make it livable, at all. So the changes are appreciated.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 不得不说，小伙子！这地方比起以前要更生机勃勃一点了。圣殿里的一些老旧设施装修过了，新添的家具…说真心话也都很棒。这我们可得好好感谢你呢，呵呵。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，就这？没什么的。能有好的改变，我也很高兴。都是承包商的功劳，我只不过下几个订单而已。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 当然还付了钱。你父亲用他自己的方式来运营整个冥界。因为你父亲的原因，过去这地方表面上看上去非常奢华，但实际上并不适合居住。所以说，你做出的改变很好。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Keep at it, lad. I've known great men throughout my life, and I can always tell when someone's better than their circumstances. Fight like I'd fight out there.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'll give them hell as you once did, Achilles. Though, doubtless many of the shades who stand against me first arrived in Tartarus because of you.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 不要放弃，小伙子。我一生中遇到过很多了不起的人，所以我一眼就能知道，谁能超越自己目前的处境。像我一样去外面战斗吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我会像你一样让他们好看的，阿喀琉斯。毫无疑问，很多那些在塔耳塔罗斯对抗我的暗灵们都是因为你才在那里的。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Happen to know whom I should thank for the weapons just outside my chambers, Achilles?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I'm sure I wouldn't, lad. Though if I happen to run into them, I'll let them know.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我房间外面的那些武器是你放的吗，阿喀琉斯？我得谢谢你。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 肯定不是我，小伙子。如果我碰巧遇见那人的话，我会道谢的。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Your enemy is not the wretched dead, and not your father, lad. It is the Underworld, itself. It has been fashioned to prevent escape. You must have seen, by now, how all the chambers seem to rearrange themselves.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: The Underworld itself, my enemy... I'll do my best anticipating its surprises, sir.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 你的敌人不是那些可怜的死人，也不是你的父亲，小伙子。是冥界本身。防止逃跑就是它的特性。这么长时间，你也应该了解了这些房间似乎一直在变换出口。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我的敌人，就是冥界本身…我会好好接受它带来的惊喜的，老师。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: The sealed weapons by your chambers; your father won't observe their absence, I don't think. They remind him of a time he stood together with his brothers and sisters. He wants nothing more to do with any of that. I think it's fitting you've inherited their power.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: A power that once sealed away the Titans... maybe it's a power that can break me out of here. Thank you for helping me, Achilles.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 你房间里那些被封锁的武器，我想你的父亲也注意到了。它们让他想起以前与自己的兄弟姐妹并肩作战的时光。他现在最不想要的就是这些东西。我觉得你继承了他们的力量。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 曾经驱逐了泰坦的力量…或许这力量能让我逃离这里。谢谢你的帮助，阿喀琉斯。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: The sealed weapons by your chambers; your father won't observe their absence, I don't think. They remind him of a time he stood together with his brothers and sisters. He wants nothing more to do with any of that. I think it's fitting you've inherited their power.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: A power that once sealed away the Titans... maybe it's a power that can break me out of here. Thank you for helping me, Achilles.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 你房间里那些被封锁的武器，我想你的父亲也注意到了。它们让他想起以前与自己的兄弟姐妹并肩作战的时光。他现在最不想要的就是这些东西。我觉得你继承了他们的力量。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 曾经驱逐了泰坦的力量…或许这力量能让我逃离这里。谢谢你的帮助，阿喀琉斯。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I got acquainted with the Twin Fists of Malphon recently, sir. Fills me with a kind of battle-hunger I'd not felt before. To think the empty hand could have as much destructive force as any weapon.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: The empty hand has more destructive force than any weapon, lad. It is the only weapon that can wield all others. And without it, all others are nearly powerless. The Twin Fists are a testament to that. Use them with care. Don't lose your head out there.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 老师，我最近结识了双子之拳玛尔封。 它使我充满了以前从未有过的战斗渴望。 没想到空手竟然可能具有与任何武器一样大的破坏力。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 赤手空拳比任何武器都强大，小伙子。唯一一样身为武器、还能掌控其他武器的就是双手，没有它们，其余兵器的力量都无从谈起。双子之拳彰显了这种强大。小心使用它们吧，别被冲昏了头脑。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I found another weapon waiting for me in the courtyard, Achilles. Exagryph. I never entirely believed it was real.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Between us, lad... I wish it wasn't. Were such a thing available to my enemies during my fighting days, I surely would have come here even sooner. But I trust you have the training to use it well. May it serve you as it served the fire goddess Hestia... she hasn't needed it in a while.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我在院子里看到了新的武器，阿喀琉斯。伊格瑞菲。我还以为这东西根本不存在呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 私下和你说吧，小伙子……我也希望它不存在。我活着的时候，要是我的敌人手里有这样的东西，那我肯定更早就来这里报到了。不过，我相信你接受过良好的训练，可以把它用好。希望它能像侍奉火之女神赫斯提亚一样侍奉你……她已经有段时间没用过这把武器了。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I have to say, lad? Authorizing transfer of the Fated List from the old archives, straight into your chambers... bold of you! And right beneath your father's nose, at that.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, that? Just another job from the House Contractor near as I'm concerned, sir. Not like anything on the list was getting done while it was stuck in the archives, besides!

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Well, that's the spirit, I suppose. If there's one thing I know, it's that the Three Fates always get their way; but if you wish to help them go about it, then perhaps they'll pay you back in kind.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 小伙子，我必须要夸你！竟敢动用职权把命运清单直接从旧档案馆转移到你的卧室里……你可真是有胆啊！还是在你爹的眼皮底下做的这件事。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，你说那个？对我来说只是圣殿承包商的另一项任务而已，先生。再说了，如果一直放在档案馆里，清单上的事情一件也做不成！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，就是要的这种精神。如果有一件事我可以确定，那就是命运三女神总是随心所欲做自己的事情。不过如果你愿意帮她们处理清单上的事项，也许她们也会善意的回报你。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Thought I'd put in a House Contractor order to keep that Codex of yours sorted, lad. Now that you know so many on Olympus, figured it must be a lot keeping track of all their blessings and such.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Yes, that should definitely come in handy, sir! I'm still getting a handle on everything I can do, with all the Olympians' powers fused with mine.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我之前让圣殿承包商把你的手稿整理好了，小伙子。既然你认识这么多奥林匹斯山上的众神，我猜记录他们的祝福之类的，肯定很费心费力吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好啊先生，那样肯定会非常便利！如今奥林匹斯众神的力量与我的力量融为一体，我还在试着驾驭我的能力。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, sir? I got a relic of some sort out there... a globule of ancient blood, which formed after I fought with Megaera. Is this really the Titans' blood I found?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: As far as I know, yes, lad. That it is. Though whose, exactly, I'm not so sure. You'd best hang onto it, and keep it safe. Your weapons... they shall thirst for it and drink it up. Not yet, perhaps, but soon.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯先生？我在外面捡到一样东西……一滴远古之血，我打败墨纪拉之后出现的。我找到的这个真是泰坦之血吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 据我所知，是的，小伙子，那就是泰坦之血。不过我并不确定这些来自于哪位泰坦。你最好紧紧看着它，把它保管好。你的那些武器……它们很快就会感到饥渴，把它一饮而尽。也许不是现在，不过快了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, look at what I got out there, Achilles sir! A vintage bottle of Ambrosia, plucked straight from Elysium! I hear this stuff is very good, but... can't even open it. I've no idea what to do with it, right now.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: The drink of the gods! I hear it's good, all right. But only for recipients with whom you're close. Perhaps hang onto it until it's ripe for use? Somebody would be grateful I am sure. Or it could fetch you something from the Wretched Broker over there.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，看我拿到了什么，阿喀琉斯先生！一瓶陈酿仙馔密酒，从至福乐土弄到手的！听说这是好东西，但我……怎么也打不开。我现在也不知道该拿它怎么办。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 众神之饮！我听说过它的美味，名副其实。但是记得只能把它送给那些你最亲近的人。也许你可以先带着它，等待时机成熟值得送出的那一刻？我敢肯定那个人一定会非常感激你的。又或者它能帮你从那个贪心的残魂商人那里换点其他好东西？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, sir, I have a very important question... why do you detest onions so much? Have they wronged you, somehow?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: As soon as you slice into one of those things... it makes you cry. Don't you find that a bit unsettling, lad? I won't shed tears over a cut-up vegetable.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, apparently they're pretty tasty if you don't eat them raw.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯先生。我有个非常重要的问题要问……你为什么这么讨厌洋葱呢？它们是怎么惹你了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 只要你一切这东西……你就会泪流不止。你不觉得这有点不太像话吗，小伙子？我可不想为被切碎的蔬菜流泪。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，只要不生吃的话，它们还是很美味的。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Your extended family, the Olympians... they wish to help you from this place, don't they? I just hope that their intentions are as pure as they appear. They don't get on well with your father.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Neither do I, last time I checked. I'll take all the help I can get trying to break out of here.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I'm pleased to hear you say that. I have known too many far too proud to accept help, even when it was sorely needed. You just be careful, lad.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 奥林匹斯诸神，都是你的家人……他们都想帮助你脱离这里，是吗？希望他们没有什么其他隐藏的企图。他们跟你父亲关系不太好。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 其实我跟我父亲关系也不好。如果能让我脱离这个地方，我得到的帮助越多越好。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 很高兴听到你这么说。我已经见识过很多因为自傲不接受帮助的人了，就算是非常关键的帮助，也被拒绝。注意安全，小伙子。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Talk later. Best not keep your father waiting.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 一会再说吧，还是别让你父亲等得太久了。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Hold just a moment, lad. That look... I think I know it all too well. Things getting complicated for you lately, then?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, you know, just... the usual struggles of battling toward the surface, generally to some ignoble death, though... wait, you mean between myself and Megaera, don't you.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I think she likes you more than she lets on. You have a certain way, besides. I know you two got off to a rough start. And circumstances lately haven't helped. But, if you love her... follow your heart.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: And, what if I don't...? I hesitate to even use the word.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: If you don't... then cease with giving her such lavish gifts, I ought to think! No need to send the wrong impression, and there is nothing to be gained from such an empty gesture, anyhow.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 等一下，小伙子。你那副神情……我实在是太熟悉了。对你来说，最近的事情越来越复杂了，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，就那些，只是……往地表上逃跑的常见挣扎，通常是遇到一些愚蠢的死法，尽管……等等，你是说我和墨纪拉之间，不是吗。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我觉得她比起她表现出来的要更喜欢你。更别提你自己还有一种独特的魅力。我知道你们俩有一个比较坎坷的开端，而最近的这些情况对事情并没有转机。但是，如果你爱她... 就追逐本心吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果我不是呢……？！我都不知道该不该用这个字眼。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 如果你不是那种喜欢... 那就停止再送她这么多奢华的礼品，对吧！没有必要给别人留下错误的印象，而且你或她也应该不会从如此空虚的举动中获得什么。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Hold just a moment, lad. That look... I think I know it all too well. Things getting complicated for you lately, then?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, you know, just... the usual struggles of battling toward the surface, generally to some ignoble death, though... wait, you mean between myself and Thanatos, don't you.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I think he cares for you more deeply than you know. You have a certain way, besides. It has been difficult between you two. And circumstances lately haven't helped. But, if you love him... follow your heart.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Whoa, just a moment, there, I mean... I've never said something like that, have I?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: You haven't, no. And it is not my business to presume too much. Nevertheless, if your friendship with Thanatos is bounded... then, I would suggest you cease with giving him more lavish gifts. No need to send the wrong impression, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 等一下，小伙子。你那副神情……我实在是太熟悉了。对你来说，最近的事情越来越复杂了，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，就那些，只是……往地表上逃跑的常见挣扎，通常是遇到一些愚蠢的死法，尽管……等等，您是说我和塔纳托斯之间，不是吗。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我觉得他比起他表现出来的要更喜欢你。更别提你自己还有一种独特的魅力。我知道你们俩有一个比较坎坷的开端，而最近的这些情况对事情并没有转机。但是，如果你爱他... 就追逐本心吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哇，等、等一下，我的意思是……我从没说过那样的话，对吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 你的确没有。而且我推测这么多的确是我的失礼。不管怎样，如果你和塔纳托斯只是朋友关系……那么我会建议你停止再赠送他更多这些奢华的礼物。没有必要给他人留下错误的印象，对吧？

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Hold just a moment, lad. That look... I think I know it all too well. Things getting complicated for you lately, then?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, you know, just... the usual struggles of battling toward the surface, generally to some ignoble death, though... wait, you mean between me, Meg, and Thanatos, don't you.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: If I may presume a bit, I gather that they share by now the feelings that you have for each of them; each in their respective way, of course. If you love them... one, the other, perhaps both? I mean, you're gods...! Follow your heart.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Whoa, just a moment, there, I mean... ugh, I suppose you're not presuming much at all. Follow my heart, though? Where?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Wherever it should lead; that's how it works. Yours to decide when you've gone as far as you ought, and cease with the lavish gifts. No need to send the wrong impression, and there's nothing to be gained from such an empty gesture, anyhow, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 等一下，小伙子。你那副神情……我实在是太熟悉了。对你来说，最近的事情越来越复杂了，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，就那些，只是……逃往地表时经常在缠斗中挣扎，主要是那些愚蠢的死法，尽管……等等，您是在说我、墨纪拉和塔纳托斯之间的事，不是吗。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 如果允许我略加推想，我觉得他们现在也应当清楚你对他们的心意了，当然两人会有轻微的不同。如果你爱他们... 其中一位，另外一位，也许两人你都爱？别犹豫，你是一位神祗啊！追随你的本心吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哇噢，你等一下，我是说……呃，我觉得你的推想毫无道理。追随本心？要追到哪里去？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 不论它飞向何处，就这么一回事。由你来决定应当继续发展关系，亦或是停止赠送那些奢华的礼物。没有必要给他们留下错误的印象，而空虚的举动也无法为你带来什么，我说的对吗？

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I think I see that look again, if I am not mistaken in it, lad. What's on your mind? If you would like to share, I'm listening.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, it's just... sometimes, I find my thoughts, they wander between those I care about, it's... not just one. You mortals, typically you had a single suitor, did you not...?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: So we often told each other, yes. But... you're not like us mortals, or us shades. Nor are most of the others here. You gods... I cannot think of even one who had a single mate. Although, your father... maybe he is one.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, you're saying Father, he was never with somebody else besides... my mother?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Well, I of course don't know so very much about him, lad. But that's the way of it, from what I've learned. You needn't follow in his footsteps, though; I think you know that well enough by now.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我觉得我又看见了你那副神情了，如果我没搞错的话。小伙子你又有什么心事？如果你愿意分享的话，我在这里听着呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，这只是…… 有时，我发现我的思念，在我关心的事物之间徘徊... 而不仅仅是一个。 凡人们，通常只有一个求婚者，不是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我们经常告诉彼此，是这样的。不过……你可不是我们这些凡人，又或是阴魂，甚至不像这里的绝大多数人。你们这些神明……我甚至想不到任何一位神是只有一个伴侣的。话说回来，你的父亲……也许他是一位这样的神。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等一下，你是说我的父亲，他从来没有追求过别人，除了……我的母亲？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 这个嘛，我当然也并不是特别清楚他的事，小伙子。不过据我所知他是这样的。但是你没有必要走他的路，对于这个你现在应该已经理解的很深刻了。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Meant to tell you. Recently, I noticed Megaera, and... I believe I saw the faintest smile play across her lips. That anything to do with you, perhaps? Not asking for specifics, mind.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You really think that has to do with me...? I mean, I hope you're right, and I suppose it's possible, it's just... how can you tell?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Perhaps with time, I've grown keen to more than just the weaknesses of my enemies on the battlefield. Especially since I don't have those anymore. I'm happy for you, lad. The two of you.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 本来想告诉你。最近，我观察了墨纪拉……我觉得我在她的嘴角看到了一丝微笑。可能和你有关？我不会问你细节的，不要介意。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你真的觉得这和我有关……？我的意思是，我希望你是对的，确实存在这种可能性，但是……你是怎么看出来的？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 可能是因为我在战场上的时候越来越注意敌人弱点以外的事情吧。特别是在我克服这些弱点之后。真为你感到高兴，小伙子。你们俩。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I have to tell you something, lad. When Thanatos returned to seek you out, I was very concerned. Not just for you, either. But you've since patched things up...?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I think so. I hope so. It was complicated for a while there, but... I think things are clearer for us, now. Not just in the moment, but in retrospect. Ugh, I'm not making any sense.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Oh, on the contrary. I think I know exactly what you mean. I don't know Thanatos particularly well. Wasn't he who brought me here, you see. And he was always very busy, like your father. But, he always struck me as a decent sort.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我必须得和你说点事儿，小伙子。当塔纳托斯回来找你的时候，我非常担心。不只是为了你。但你已经做了补救……？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我想是吧。但愿如此。情况有点复杂，但是……我觉得现在情况已经比较明朗了。不管对于现在，还是过去。啊，我还是说不清楚。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，恰恰相反。我觉得，我很清楚你的意思。我和塔纳托斯不是特别熟。你也看到了，不是他把我带到这里的。而且他总是特别忙，和你的父亲一样。但我真没想到他是如此正派。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, I ran into Meg's sisters out there. We didn't really hit it off. Meg said they're not permitted in the House. Not that I'm complaining, but... what's that about?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: They have not earned the right, lad. Nor expressed any desire to exist here with the rest of us. Your father has assigned them to specific roles that suit their dispositions. They're... not as sensible as Megaera, in my experience.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That's what I was afraid of. Although, fear is for the weak.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯，我遇到墨纪的姐妹了。我们似乎不太合得来。墨纪说她们不允许进入到这里来。不是我抱怨，但……这是为什么呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 她们还没有得到这个权利，小伙子。她们也没有表示出任何想与我们在一起的诉求。你的父亲就让她们担任了最适合自己的特殊角色。依我看来，她们…没有墨纪拉那样理智。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我担心的就是这个。不过，只有弱者才会感到恐惧。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: You saw that Thanatos is back, didn't you, lad? He's been over there brooding, when he's around, at least.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I saw, Achilles. I think he's angry with me because of my decision to leave the House. Not that it's any of his business.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Oh, don't say that. It isn't everyday or night when one discovers that his closest friend has had it with his temperamental father, and decided to leave home. I think he's struggling with what to make of it. Be gentle with him, will you?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 你看到塔纳托斯回来了吧，小伙子。他只要在，就总是一副焦虑不安的样子。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我看到了，阿喀琉斯。我觉得因为我打算离开这里，所以他在生我的气。但这根本跟他没关系啊。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 你可别这么说。当一个人发现他要好的朋友和他暴脾气的父亲吵架并打算离家出走，这可不是一件小事。我觉得他在这件事情上不知如何是好。对他友善一点，可以吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Achilles, I... uncovered a late passage in the Codex, with regard to Thanatos and me. It says, you say, you think that I'm the god of blood? I'm not the god of anything, I think...

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Oh, nonsense, lad! If you're a god, then you're the god of something, I'm sure. It's just an observation, and I genuinely hope it's no offense. But, see... your father, and your mother, and your bloodstones, and your disposition...

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，阿喀琉斯，我……刚发现手稿中有这么一段，和塔纳托斯还有我有关……它说，应说你写的，你觉得那啥……我是鲜血之神？要我说，我觉得，我……应该什么神也不是……

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 别这样，小伙子。如果你是一位神祇，我很肯定，那你一定会是掌管某一领域的神。书上说的只是我的观察，而且我诚挚的希望这些话对你没有冒犯？不过，仔细想一想，你的父亲，你的母亲，你的血石，以及你的处事方式……

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, I've been meaning to ask you about the odd skeleton usually standing around in the courtyard. Old acquaintance of yours? A hireling, perhaps?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: That one, Skelly, was it? We only met when all this business of escape began. If I have a connection to him, I am unaware. Does he claim to know me? Perhaps I slew him when we were alive.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I don't know that that's it. So neither of us has any idea where he's from or how he got there, huh. Can you think of any leads? Nyx doesn't seem to know him, either.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Perhaps the gods of Olympus sent him to your aid? Their methods can be odd. And, there are many who support you. Regardless, he does not appear to be your father's spy, if that is your concern.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯，我一直想问你，院子里那个奇怪骷髅的事。是你的熟人吗？大概是雇来的吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 那个，骨头，是吧？你的逃跑计划开始的时候我们才见到他。如果我跟他有关系，那就奇怪了。他有说他认识我吗？也许他活着的时候就是我杀了他。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我也是一头雾水。看来我俩都搞不清楚他从哪来，怎么来的。你有头绪吗？倪克斯好像也不认识他。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 也许是奥林匹斯众神派他来协助你的？这也符合他们的风格。而且，帮助你的人也确实不少。不管怎样，他都不可能是你父亲派来的间谍，你不用担心。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Remember that Skelly character out in the courtyard, sir? Turns out he's been working with Charon all this time. Working for him more like! I had so much help in this, from all of you.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Charon! Of course. He has a stake in all that goes on in the Underworld. And he probably thinks highly of you. This Skelly character, though... he must have been somebody if Charon's confided in him.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: He won't tell me. He was either a venerable sea captain, or a petty thief. Maybe both?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 先生，您记得在庭院里的那位骨头吗？原来他一直以来都是卡戎的同事！卡戎的手下，才对。您们给了我的帮助真是多呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 卡戎！当然。冥界里的一切都与他有关。也许他对你有高度评价。但，这骨头……如果卡戎这么信任他，那他应该曾经是个伟大人士。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 他不肯告诉我。他一就是个伟大的船长，不然就是个小偷。或许两者都对？

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: In my recent audience with Nyx, lad, she let on that you have mentioned Chaos as of late. Is it true you've met her parent, yourself?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I have. Chaos is... not like anyone I've ever met. At first I was a little worried, meeting this vast primordial entity apparently responsible for all creation, but... they seem all right. Chaos and Nyx haven't been talking for a while, though. You don't know what happened there, do you?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I know a little bit, I think. Nyx, she and Chaos, they just... slowly drifted apart. No animosity, not anymore, at least. It happens between parents and children. And once such ties are severed, they cannot always be restored. Especially among primordial gods as old as time, I suppose.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 小伙子，在我上一次与倪克斯的交谈中，她说你最近提到过卡俄斯。 你亲眼见过倪克斯的孕育者，是真的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是真的。 卡俄斯……不像我见过的任何人或神。 起初，我有点担心，遇到这个庞大的，据说创造了整个世界的原始实体，但是……祂似乎还不错。 不过，卡俄斯和倪克斯似乎很久没有这样聊了。 您知道他们之间发生了什么吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我认为，我是知道一点。 倪克斯，她和卡俄斯只是……慢慢地分开了。 没有仇恨……至少现在没有了。 这种事时常发生在父母和孩子之间。 一旦切断这种联系，就很难恢复它。 我猜想，尤其是在和时间一样古老的原始神当中，这种事多少会时常发生。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wanted to ask you more about Nyx and Chaos, sir. So they just drifted apart, I mean... why not just keep in touch? I don't understand. How hard is it just to say hello from time to time?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: It can be harder than you know. For someone like Nyx... she was responsible for no small part of creation, herself. As her relationship with Chaos grew more strained, she gave birth to Strife, Misery, Doom... sons and daughters you don't hear about too much.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, really? I've never heard Hypnos or Thanatos mention any of them, let alone Nyx. They sound like a handful. Where are they, what happened?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I don't know, lad. On the surface, I suppose? My point is, Nyx had her own problems to contend with. Dealing with her brood, governing the Underworld all on her own before your father arrived. Her relationship with Chaos suffered for it.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我想向你打听关于倪克斯和卡俄斯的更多消息，先生。所以他们就这么分开了，我是说……为什么他们不保持联系？我不懂。时不时问声好会有多难？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 可能比你想象的难得多。就拿倪克斯来说……她本人承担着创世的很大一部分责任。随着与卡俄斯的关系越来越紧张，她还生下了冲突、痛苦和死亡……一堆你可能很少听说的子女。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 真、真的吗? 我从未听修普诺斯或塔纳托斯提到过其中任何一个，更不用说倪克斯了。 他们听起来很麻烦。 他们在哪里，发生了什么事？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我不知道，小伙子。或许在阳间？我的重点是，倪克斯要处理她自己的问题。管理她的一大群子女，一个人统治着冥界，直到你的父亲接班。她和卡俄斯的关系因此受到了不小的影响。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Lad, I heard from Nyx! She said that she was able recently to reestablish contact with Chaos, thanks to you? You're just full of surprises, reforging old bonds between primordial gods like it was nothing.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, just took a bit of tampering with the Sigil in the admin chamber. Whole bunch of Darkness, too. But I could tell that Nyx and Chaos, they... seemed to really miss each other, to the extent they are able to miss anybody.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I think they're plenty capable of missing their loved ones, lad. The amount of time that either of us have existed... it's nothing compared to either of them. Imagine, being apart from someone you care about, for that long...

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 小伙子，我听倪克斯说了！她最近和卡俄斯重新取得了联系，多亏了你？你总是能带来各种惊喜，例如轻而易举地恢复了原始之神之间疏远多年的关系。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，只是改动了一下行政办公室内的印记。还用到了一大堆的黑暗宝石。不过我看得出来，倪克斯和卡俄斯，她们……好像都思念着对方，只要她们还能够思念什么人的话。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 小伙子，我想她们有足够的时间想着挚爱之人。从我们还没有出生的时候算起……对她们来说只是弹指一挥间。试想一下，和你在乎的人分别这么长时间……

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, sir? You happen to know whether Father authorized the transfer of a Macedonian Tau-Lambda chariot to Elysium in recent memory? I ran into the former hero Theseus, all joyriding about in one of those.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I know the chariot you mean. It's not just any Macedonian. It's modified, apparently by Daedalus, himself. No earthly weapons can do what it does. Though, please don't tell me Theseus put on that mask...?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, you mean the golden matching mask? I saw him wearing it, all right. Looked like a proper fool, I thought. What of it, though?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Hahah, well! I think that Daedalus would certainly agree. Heard that he fashioned that mask and outfit as a little joke. For someone deeply prideful, and well unaware. It must have suited Theseus quite well, then, yes?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯先生，你有没有印象我的父亲最近授权把马其顿塔乌-拉姆达战车转移到至福乐土？我遇到一位昔日的英雄忒修斯，他当时正驾着其中一辆在兜风。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道你说的那辆战车。那可不是普通的马其顿族产物，它显然是经过了狄德勒斯的亲手改造。俗世的武器根本与之无法匹敌。但... 别告诉我忒修斯戴上了那张面具?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么，你是说他的黄金面具吗？我看他当时是戴着的。我当时还想呢，真是够傻的。那面具有什么不一般的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 哈哈哈，还真是这样！我觉得狄德勒斯也会同意你的看法。我听说他在制作那张面具和战衣的时候，故意做得很滑稽，就是想让那些狂妄自大的人在浑然不知的情况下出丑。这套装备一定很适合忒修斯，不是吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, wanted to ask you more about the weapons I've been using. They can change shape! So, they've molded themselves to suit me, and remember their past wielders, something like that?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Something like that. They seem alive, don't they? Taking everything in. I think they long predate even your father's time. Some have seen many different owners. Chances are, you shall not be the last.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯，我想问问你更多有关我在用的这把武器的问题。它们可以变形！所以，它们会为了适应我而改变形态，同时还记得自己的前任主人，这样的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 差不多吧。它们看上去就像有生命一样，对不对？仔细一想的话，我认为它们的存在甚至比你的父亲还要久远。某些武器形态已经见过了许多不同的持有者，你也应该不会是最后一位。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: As you may know, lad, I've a connection to the weapons that you use, having once wielded one of them myself. Of course not knowing its significance back then, but I digress. Sometimes, it... well, it keeps in touch. And I've a vision from it to impart.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, you mean a vision from Varatha the Eternal Spear? That's... out of the ordinary, and also a bit concerning. So, what did you see?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Well... I saw a great, bearded warrior. Bigger than me, pitch-black hair. Bearing an aspect of Varatha unlike any with which I'm familiar. Then he was gone. But, what still lingered were these words: I see you through the eyes of the crimson phoenix.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I see you through the eyes of the crimson phoenix... I don't understand. What's that supposed to mean?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: There's one more thing. This was not my first such vision. Long ago... I saw one of Varatha's other bearers. It was you. Your Infernal Arms... they must be weapons of the Fates' design. They know already who shall brandish them. Now they ask a favor. Seek Varatha. Speak the words. Go.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 小伙子，你可能也知道，我和你使用的武器还有点关系，曾经一度也有一把。当然，我当时不知道它的厉害，好像有点离题了。它有时候……还保持着和我的关系。我就看到过一些幻象。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么，您是说永恒之矛瓦拉塔？ 这……异乎寻常，而且有点令人担忧。 那么，您看到了什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 是这样……我看到了一个伟大的，有胡子的战士。 比我高大，一头黑发。他的瓦拉塔的姿态与我所熟悉的任何姿态都有所不同。然后他走了。但是，这些词仍然挥之不去：我透过绯红凤凰的眼睛看着你。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我透过绯红凤凰的眼睛看着你…… 我不明白。 那会是什么意思？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 还有，这也不是我第一次看到这些幻象。很久以前……我还看到过瓦拉塔的另一位主人，那就是你。你的冥府兵器……肯定出自命运女神之手，它们早就知道挥舞自己的主人是谁。现在，它们要请你帮个忙。找到瓦拉塔，说出唤醒它的咒语，去吧。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles...! Something awakened in Varatha when I spoke the words. It revealed to me a form I'd never seen. Wielded by the warrior called Guan Yu. Handsomely dressed! And just as you described. That's no Greek name, is it...

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: No, I don't think so, lad. I don't know who this Guan Yu is, or where he's from. Or even when he's from. But the Fates must have a plan for him, and you. Anyway... I think my part in this is ended. Varatha's served you well, no? I trusted it in life; I trust it now. Fear is for the weak.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯……！当我对着瓦拉塔说出那些话的时候，我感觉有什么东西觉醒了。那种形态是我从来没有见过的。一个名叫关羽的勇士挥舞着它。穿着华丽的衣服！就像你说的那样。这不像希腊人的名字，难道是……

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 不，小伙子，我不这么认为。 我不知道这个关羽是谁，或者他来自哪里。 甚至是他来自什么时代。 但是命运必然为他，还有你，制定过一个计划。 无论如何……我认为我在这方面的工作已经结束。 瓦拉塔为你做的很好，不是吗？ 我在活着时信任过它； 我现在还是一样信任它。 恐惧是弱者的专利。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, sir! I've uncovered the hidden aspect for Stygius! Nyx gave me the words this time, and a vision of a noble leader among mortals. An entire armored legion of them! Arthur was his name. Will be his name, I guess.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: A future leader among men, wielding that blade? The mysteries of the Infernal Arms run deep, don't they. Although it seems that you and Stygius formed quite a bond.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯先生，我发现了斯第格思的隐藏形态！倪克斯这次向我透露了那些话，还有一位高贵的凡人领袖的幻象。那是一整支壮盛的装甲军团！他的名字叫做亚瑟。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 一位出类拔萃的凡人，挥舞着那把利剑？地狱武器奥秘深深，不是吗？不过你和斯第格思似乎形成了不错的关系。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, I've revealed the hidden aspect of the Heart-Seeker. Lady Artemis herself told me the words, and... it seems Coronacht belonged to, maybe will belong to somebody called Rama. Peerless with the bow. Even among gods...

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Many lay claim to peerlessness with bows in my experience, there, lad, although... I'm not to judge a vision from an ancient weapon such as that. I hope this Rama shall use his weapon wisely when the time comes; same as you.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯，我发现了索心弓的秘密，是阿尔忒弥斯女士亲口告诉我的。而且……看起来科罗纳赫特曾属于，或者说以后会属于一个叫罗摩的人。这把弓就算是在众神之中，也是举世无双……

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 孩子，以我的经验来看，很多人都声称自己的弓举世无双。不过……至于这把古老的武器以后会怎么样，我不打算妄下评判。希望时机到来的时候，这个叫罗摩的家伙也能明智地使用这把弓，就像你一样。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, sir, I've revealed the hidden aspect of the Shield of Chaos... thanks to Chaos, themself. Apparently someday it'll protect an armored warrior known as Beowulf from all sorts of dangers... even a dragon! Mortals don't stand much of a chance against those, do they?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Depends upon the dragon, I suppose. I've heard they differ all across the world. Though, that's a fascinating find, there, lad. This Beowulf... sounds like he'll find a way to make good use of all that protective gear. Always preferred mobility, myself, but then, to each his own.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯先生，我发现了混沌之盾的秘密……这多亏了卡俄斯本人的指点。以后会有个叫贝奥武夫的战士身披重铠，而它将会保护他免受各种各样的危险……甚至抵挡巨龙的攻击！凡人恐怕不会是龙的对手，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我觉得，这得取决于是什么样的龙，我听说世界各地的龙都不太一样。不过，这个发现确实很有意思，孩子。这个叫贝奥武夫的人……听起来他很清楚要如何使用防御性的装备。虽然我更在乎灵活性，不过各人都有各人的喜好。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: The Bull of Minos led me to another hidden aspect, Achilles! A beastly form of the Twin Fists, belonging to an ancient god-king known as Gilgamesh. You ever hear that name? He had a half-beast friend, apparently. Like how Asterius is friend to Theseus.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Gilgamesh, you said...? That name isn't familiar to me, but... with these hidden aspects, there's bound to be a connection to the future, or the past. Say, why is the Bull of Minos aiding you? I thought he was one of your rivals barring passage from Elysium.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, he is. He's loyal through and through to Theseus, and never holds back when we fight. But he seems to be the respect-for-his-opponent type. Unlike his companion.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 米诺斯的公牛为我解开了一个隐藏的武器形态，阿喀琉斯！是双子之拳的野兽形态，曾属于某位叫吉尔伽美什的远古神王。你听过这个名字吗？他有位半人半兽的朋友，就好像忒修斯与阿斯忒里俄斯一样……

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 你说的是吉尔伽美什吗……？这个名字我没听过，不过……这些隐藏形态一定会与未来或过去有关。我想知道，米诺斯的公牛为什么会帮助你呢？我还以为他是你的敌人，负责在至福乐土拦住你呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，他是敌人，对忒修斯忠心耿耿，在战斗中也从不手下留情。不过和他那位搭档不一样，他似乎懂得尊重对手。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, I discovered the hidden aspect of the Adamant Rail, after Lord Zeus himself told me the waking-phrase. It's from a winged fellow by the name of Lucifer... apparently had a bit of a falling out with his lord father. Wonder how that worked out for him.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Huh! Perhaps it's from a time even before the Olympians rebelled against the Titans. But I've never heard of any Lucifer, with or without wings. Suggests to me, perhaps that falling out of his did not work out so well.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯先生，我发现了狮鹫弩炮的秘密，是宙斯大人亲口告诉我的。这个弩炮以前的主人，是个长着翅膀的家伙，叫路西法……看起来，他和他的天主父亲也闹了矛盾，不知道他后来怎么样了。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 呵！恐怕他们闹矛盾的年代，要比奥林匹斯众神反抗泰坦的统治要更加古老吧。不过，无论有没有翅膀，我听说过的人里都没有叫路西法的。要我猜的话，他和他父亲吵了一架之后，结果恐怕不怎么样。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, something I've been wondering... now that I've discovered all the hidden aspects of my weapons... as far as I know, anyway... I can't see any pattern there, at all. Guan Yu, Gilgamesh, Rama, and so on... any idea why them?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: To know for certain, I suppose you'd have to ask the Fates, themselves... and get an answer from them, too. I ask myself how come you found an aspect of mine, among them all. What made me so special, do you suppose?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You were a great warrior! Famous, in your time! It's no surprise to me at all the Fates chose you to have a stint with one of their world-altering weapons.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Well, that's just it! I was quite famous, yes. Infamous, perhaps, but no matter. Perhaps it's just that these weapons demand to make themselves known, above all. To leave a lasting impression in the hands of their wielders.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You think the Infernal Arms just want to be popular? Have exciting stories told about them and whatnot?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯，有的时候我不禁在想……如今我已经解锁了所有武器的隐藏形态……据我所知，这些人之间好像根本就没有任何关联，关羽、吉尔伽美什、罗摩、还有其他人……你知道为什么会是他们吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 如果想弄清楚原因，我猜你只能问命运女神本人……从她们那里听到答案了。我自己也思考过，在所有人里你为什么会偏偏找到属于我的形态呢？你觉得，我有什么特别的呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 因为你是位伟大的战士啊！在你的时代赫赫有名！命运女神会把你的形态加入到这不断变换的武器之中，我一点都不觉得奇怪。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，或许就是这样！我生前赫赫有名，或者说，恶名昭著，这都不重要。或许只是因为这些武器也希望自己能威名远扬，希望能在它们主人的手中，给人留下过目不忘的印象。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你觉得这些冥府兵器只是希望能为人所知？希望人们能讲起关于它们的传奇故事，类似这样的吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I've had the opportunity to use your aspect of Varatha, sir. So, you once wielded it yourself? It... fills me with a hunger for battle even more so than usual. A bit of your fighting spirit, perhaps.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Be very wary of that spirit, lad. It was what brought me here before my time. Although that spear indeed once served me well. A parting gift from my old master Chiron. He cautioned me as I am cautioning you. Though, may you be a better listener.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我终于有机会能使用你的瓦拉塔了，先生。所以，这把武器是你以前用过的吗？它……让我心里充满了对战斗的渴望，比平时要更加强烈。我猜，这大概就是你的斗志吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 一定要当心这种斗志，小伙子。虽然这把长矛我确实用得很顺手，但也正是因为它，我才会英年早逝，来到这个地方。这是我曾经的师父喀戎送给我的临别赠礼，他当时也是这么谆谆教导我的。希望你能比我更听得进劝告。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, I meant to ask, did you know that Coronacht the Heart-Seeker once belonged to the centaur, Chiron? Because one of its aspects is his own. He didn't have it back when you trained with him, did he...?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Master Chiron, truly...? Ah, of course. He granted me a spear, I think you know. If he possessed one such weapon, why not more? I remember his bow shined like the sun. It was splendid, and never missed its mark... though I attributed that to Chiron's extraordinary skill.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯，有件事想问一下。你知道索心弓科罗纳赫特曾是半人马喀戎的东西吗？因为其中一个形态是属于他的。你和他一起训练的时候，这把弓就已经不在他手里了，是吗……？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 喀戎大师，真的吗……？啊，当然是真的了。你也知道，他当时给了我一把长矛。如果这把弓以前是他的武器，那他是怎么弄丢的？我还记得他的弓像太阳一样光芒夺目。那真的是把好弓，而且总是能命中目标……不过，我当时还以为是喀戎的箭术很厉害呢。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I have to thank you for the mirror back there, lad. Lets me get a better look at things out in the great hall every now and then.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Of course, sir, don't mention it. You're really stuck having to guard this corridor most of the time, huh?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Oh certainly, it's an important corridor! Think of it, if just any shade could pass through either of those doors back there. Your father's barely keeping it together, as it is.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 小伙子，我必须感谢你摆的镜子。它让我能时不时地更好观察大厅里的事物。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 当然了，先生，不用谢我。您真的大部分时间都不得不守卫这个走廊，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，它当然是非常重要的走廊！想想看，如果有幽灵可以穿过那边的任何一扇门。你的父亲就很难像现在这样牢牢控制住局面。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Quite a statue you commissioned over there. I suppose I can think of worse subjects than mighty Heracles for me to have to stand about and stare at.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: They say he was the strongest demigod who ever lived. Though, I bet you could take him, sir. Big guy like that, you'd be too quick, I'm sure. You ever meet him?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Only in passing. He once died a mortal's death... worse than mine. Had a brief stint down here, but... he's favored by Olympus. Got a special arrangement of some sort, I heard. Haven't seen him since.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 你在那边安置的雕像还真不错。万一那不是强大的赫拉克勒斯，而是什么更糟糕的东西，我也不得不一直站在这里盯着看。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 大家都说他是最强大的半神。不过，我猜你能打得过他，因为对他那样的大块头来说，你的动作太敏捷了。你见过他吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 只在这里见过。他像个凡人一样死去……死得比我还惨。他在这里消沉了一段时间，不过……他毕竟受到奥林匹斯众神的青睐，我听说他们给他安排了某种特殊待遇。在那之后，我就没再见过他了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, looks like I could buy back my right to go in the administrative chamber, there. I never want to go in there again, but... can you think of any reason whatsoever that I should?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Hah, well. Perhaps we all want what we cannot have. Other than that, I suppose certain documents or records in there could be of some benefit under the circumstances, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯，看来我已经可以赎回自己的权利，可以再次进入管理大厅了。我真的一点都不想去那个地方，不过……在你看来，我有没有什么非去不可的理由？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 哈，这么说吧，或许我们都渴望得到自己没有的东西。除此之外，我觉得其中某些文件或记录，在这种情况下说不定能给你带来好处，你觉得呢？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That Chthonic Companion you gave me, sir... have to say it's been amazing to see you and Patroclus in action. I thought you said your fighting days were over?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Yes, well... that was before I was reunited with Patroclus, and had the opportunity to help you in a pinch, with him at my side. I trust we were of some small service, then?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 关于你送给我的冥府伴偶，先生……我不得不说，看到你和普特洛克勒斯作战的英姿，真是太美妙了。你不是说过，你早就不想再打仗了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，我是说过……可现在我和普特洛克勒斯重聚了。有了他在我身边，我们就可以在你陷入危机的时候帮你的忙了。我猜我们还是能派点用场的，是吧？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, I... sometimes I fear that Father, if he learns that you've been aiding me, that he will... not be generous with you.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Don't worry about me, lad. Your father's still getting caught up with work that I created for him in my mortal days. Besides... there's nothing he can take from me. We have a mutual arrangement, he and I.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯，我…有时候我有点怕，怕我父亲万一知道你一直在帮助我，他会…找你麻烦。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 不用担心我，小伙子。我生前给他带来的问题他到现在还没处理完呢。再说……他无法再从我这里夺走什么了。这是我和他之间的共同协定。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, I'm concerned that Father's growing angrier with you. He thinks you've taken sides against him in all this. I don't want anything to happen.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: He's right, lad. I have taken sides. But, as for you not wanting anything to happen... while I know what you meant, I don't want you to say such things again. Do you understand? You're doing this because something here needs to happen. Hold back your fear.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯，我担心父亲会生你的气。他觉得你面对这一切时没有跟他站一边。我不想你有什么事。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 他没错，小伙子。我确实站边了。不过，至于你说的不想发生什么事…我知道你的意思，我不想听到你再说这样的话。明白了吗？你这样做，是因为有些事情，它必须要发生。收起你的恐惧。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wanted to say, the Lady Aphrodite asked that I relay a message to you, sir. She said that she admires you. Mentioned a certain war.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Admires me, does she? Sometimes, lad, I think that Aphrodite is the mightiest of all the gods. Her power is what spurs us all to action. Whether to love, or war. Or sometimes both the two. I'm grateful for the message.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 老师，阿弗洛狄忒女士请我帮她给你带个话。她说她很欣赏你，她还提到了一场战争。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 她欣赏我，真的吗？小伙子，有时候啊，我就觉得阿弗洛狄忒是众神当中最强大的。她的力量能督促我们行动。不管是爱，还是战争。又或者两者皆有。很高兴听到你带的话。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Achilles! I heard from Lady Artemis out there. It seems you have a bit of a fan in her. She wanted me to tell you you're the best! She's not mistaken, by the way.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: The goddess of the hunt herself said that? That's very flattering to hear. Good thing she doesn't know I'm all washed up, by now. Her memory is of my glory days.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯，阿尔忒弥斯女士跟我说了。她似乎有点中意你。她想让我告诉你，你是最棒的！她真的没弄错。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 狩猎女神本人这么说的吗？我真是太高兴了。还好她不知道我现在已经完全不行了。她记忆中的我还处在巅峰时期。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, have you ever run across the shade of Daedalus in all your time? I've found some of his legendary hammers out there, but no sign of him.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I've never met him, no. Your father keeps him fully occupied with building out his Underworld, and renovating constantly. No wonder some of his old crafting-tools are strewn about. I take it you've been able to make use of them?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯，你遇到过狄德勒斯的暗灵吗？我找到了他的传奇战锤，但没看到他的人。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我从没见过他。你父亲总是派给他很多冥界的建设工作，还要不断翻修。难怪他的建造工具散落了一地。我还以为你能好好利用它们呢？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, did you ever use to pray to the gods? Make offerings to them and such, back when you were alive?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Prayed mostly to my mother, lad. I always had my doubts the gods were listening. That they could even hear. Though, I suppose that if you make an offering, they might be so inclined, just for the moment, anyway. They helping much?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯，你还活着的时候，向众神祈祷过吗？比如给他们献上祭品什么的？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我通常都向我的母亲祈祷，小伙子。我很怀疑众神会不会听我的祈祷，甚至怀疑他们能不能听到。不过我猜，如果你献上祭品的话，他们至少在一段时间之内还是会很青睐你的。他们帮上什么大忙了吗？

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: You have a worried look about you, lad. Spare me your thoughts?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, it's just... I met the goddess Demeter out there. The blessings that she offered, they... just drained the heat and life from everything. I thought she saw to fruits and grains and vegetables and such? Not that I'm complaining.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: All gods and goddesses are to be feared. Demeter, she has the power to give life, or take it. Seems she's more interested in the latter, though. She's the eldest on Olympus, and your father seems to harbor a particular dislike for her. I don't know why. Be careful.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 你看上去心事重重啊，小伙子。愿意说来听听吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，只是……我在外面遇到了得墨忒尔女神。 她提供的祝福，它们……吸取并消耗一切热量和生命。 我以为她的领域是养育水果，谷物和蔬菜等？ 我不是在抱怨。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 所有的神灵都值得敬畏。得墨忒尔，她有能力赋予生命或夺取生命。 似乎她对后者更感兴趣。她是奥林匹斯山年龄最大的神，而你的父亲似乎对她特别讨厌。我不知道为什么。小心为妙。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, what happened between Nyx and Dusa? Dusa's really gone?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Nyx cut her off, lad. I'm sorry. I know you cared about her. I was as surprised as you when I found out. I knew that Nyx had her concerns about Dusa's propensity to overwork herself, but... this wasn't the step I was expecting.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Propensity to overwork herself... you really think that's what this was about? I can't shake the feeling it's my fault. Nyx didn't want her talking to me, as though she's beneath me or something! Ugh, what am I going to do.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Look... I don't have all the information on this one, and neither do you from the sound of things. Nyx loves you and respects you. I trust she would want to know how this affects you.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯，倪克斯和杜莎之间到底发生了什么？杜莎真的走了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯把杜莎撵走了，小伙子。我很遗憾，我知道你很在乎她。我听说这件事情的时候，我也很震惊。我知道杜莎干活实在是过于卖力了，倪克斯对此也感到很担心，不过……我没想到她会这么做。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 干活实在是过于卖力了……你真的觉得她是因为这个才被撵走的吗？我一直觉得这都是我的错。倪克斯不希望她和我说话，就好像她和我相比是个下等人一样！啊，我到底该怎么办？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 听着……我不太清楚这件事情的来龙去脉，听起来你也不怎么了解。倪克斯很爱你，很尊重你。我相信，她也想弄清楚这么做会对你造成怎样的影响。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, what happened between Nyx and Dusa? Dusa's really gone?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Nyx cut her off, lad. I'm sorry. I know you cared about her. I was as surprised as you when I found out. I knew that Nyx had her concerns about Dusa's propensity to overwork herself, but... this wasn't the step I was expecting.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Propensity to overwork herself... you really think that's what this was about? I can't shake the feeling it's my fault. Nyx didn't want her talking to me, as though she's beneath me or something! Ugh, what am I going to do.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Look... I don't have all the information on this one, and neither do you from the sound of things. Nyx loves you and respects you. I trust she would want to know how this affects you.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯，倪克斯和杜莎之间到底发生了什么？杜莎真的走了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯把杜莎撵走了，小伙子。我很遗憾，我知道你很在乎她。我听说这件事情的时候，我也很震惊。我知道杜莎干活实在是过于卖力了，倪克斯对此也感到很担心，不过……我没想到她会这么做。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 干活实在是过于卖力了……你真的觉得她是因为这个才被撵走的吗？我一直觉得这都是我的错。倪克斯不希望她和我说话，就好像她和我相比是个下等人一样！啊，我到底该怎么办？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 听着……我不太清楚这件事情的来龙去脉，听起来你也不怎么了解。倪克斯很爱你，很尊重你。我相信，她也想弄清楚这么做会对你造成怎样的影响。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Did you see, sir? Dusa's returned! Nyx must have reconsidered her decision.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: She must have, indeed, lad. I was pleased to see Dusa return. And you know what...? I daresay she seemed rather well-rested, for a change. It might not have been the best of circumstances, though my hope is that some good has come of it.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你看到了吗，先生？杜莎回来了！倪克斯肯定是重新考虑过了。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 肯定是这样，小伙子。杜莎回来了，我也很高兴。而且你知道吗……？我觉得她变了，她看起来气色不错。虽然说这未必是最好的局面，但我希望会带来不错的结果。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I understand you've made it all the way to Asphodel of late, haven't you, lad?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I guess word travels faster than I do. Why do you ask, Achilles?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: ...No reason in particular. Just that it brings me joy to hear of your progress.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我最近听说，你一路杀到了水仙花平原，对不对，小伙子？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 看来我的事迹跑地比我本人快得多。问这个干嘛，阿喀琉斯？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: …也没什么。只是为你的进展而感到高兴。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I haven't seen you in a while, lad. You made it to Elysium last time, didn't you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I did, Achilles. It's crawling with great warriors still looking for a fight. It's not exactly what I was expecting.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Your father's marshalled the most willing ones to deal with you. Doubtless there's much at stake in it for them, if but the pride of having done the task. Although I think that pride will always be their weakness.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 有段时间没见到你了，小伙子。上一次你到了至福乐土，对吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没错，阿喀琉斯。那里满是渴望战斗的伟大战士。跟我期待的不太一样。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 你父亲让大家自愿去对付你。毫无疑问，除了完成任务的荣耀感以外，肯定还有很多其他的原因。不过我认为他们应该觉得荣耀感比什么都重要。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I couldn't help but notice, lad, that Cerberus has been away for quite some time. Turns out your father's put him back to work above. I truly hope you shall not have to come to blows.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Don't worry, sir. I've run into Cerberus up top, all right. Even if he's technically Father's pet, he'd never bare his fangs at me. No matter how much Father might wish otherwise.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我注意到了啊，小伙子，刻耳柏洛斯已经出去好久了。看来是你父亲把它派到上面去工作了。希望你俩不会大打出手。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没事，老师。我已经在上面跟他见过面了。尽管他是父亲的宠物，但他也从没对我凶过。不管父亲有多想他这么做。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I don't wish to presume, lad, but you seem more glum than usual. What's weighing on you, there, if you don't mind?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, it's just... I've never slain a living creature, sir. Until my recent journey to the Temple up above. I know they're just Satyrs and vermin, but... it's not the same as sending wretches to the depths.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Look. All mortal life is fragile; it simply is a struggle to survive. Sooner or later it fails to succeed, and then, it ends up here. And we have room enough for everyone, even the Satyrs and the vermin of the world.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Now that you mention it, I have to say I'm glad we can accommodate all former-living things. And at least mortals get to rest assured knowing what happens once they die! Must really ease the mind.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 可能是我多虑了，小伙子，你好像比平时要忧郁啊。如果可以的话，告诉我你有什么烦恼。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，就是…我从来没杀死过一个活着的生物，老师。直到我去到了上面的神殿。我知道它们只是些萨提尔和鼠兽，但是…这跟把死人送去深渊不一样。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 听我说。所有凡躯都很脆弱；他们都尽可能挣扎求存。总有那么一天，他们会失败，然后，他们就来到了这里。而这里接受任何人，就算是萨提尔和世界的鼠兽也一样。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 既然你都提到了，我得说，我很高兴我们能接纳所有活过的东西。至少凡人可以放心，知道他们死后会去什么地方！这样能稳定他们的情绪。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I saw your father storm out of the House in his regalia. So he must have confronted you himself, at last. I... see that must have not gone well. You were so close.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, at least I know who will be waiting for me the next time I climb all the way to the Temple of Styx and manage my way out.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Don't lose heart, lad. I did not train your father, only you. He is a god; but he is just a god. If you'll forgive my bit of treason there.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我看到你父亲穿着战衣气冲冲地走了。他肯定是亲自与你对战了吧，到最后。我…看得出来结果不太好。你差一点就成功了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧，至少我知道下次我一路爬到冥河神庙并设法出去时，谁会等着我。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 别泄气，小伙子。我训练的不是你父亲，而是你。他是个神没错；但也只是个神。如果你能原谅我这小小的背叛。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I found her, sir! My mother, she's... alive and well, and... ugh, but I just couldn't stay up there, for very long. I have to get back to her!

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: You really made it all the way? You must have... gotten past your father, that's amazing, lad. But, wait, what was she like, what happened to you there?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: She was... she was great! Nothing like Father, more like... you, a little bit, I guess! Though, being on the surface, it just seemed to suck the life right out of me. Even without the wretches of the Underworld trying to do me in.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: But then, you had a little time at least! Sounds like you have unfinished business with her, there. You got to her this once... surely you're able to again, isn't that right?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我找到她了，先生！我的母亲，她……还活着，都很好，不过……呃，我没办法在地上的世界呆得太久，我得再回去找她！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 你真的逃出去了吗？你肯定已经……击败了你的父亲，这真是太了不起了，小伙子。不过，等等，她是个怎样的人？你遇到了什么事情？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 她……她太棒了！和父亲一点都不一样，更像是……你，我猜有点像吧！不过呆在地上世界的时候，明明没有冥界的暗灵在阻挠我，但感觉就像是我的生命要被吸干了一样。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 不过，你还是能有一点时间的！听起来你还有其它事情想要和她说。既然你能见到她一次……那你肯定能再找到她，没错吧？

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: How did it go, lad? You've been gone a while. For good reason, I hope?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I found her, again, sir, and... we were able to talk some more. But, I have so many questions left for her, and Father's certainly not been of any help...

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Well, first of all, good work. I knew you had it in you. Secondly... you know what you have to do. Go find her, for as many chances as it takes. It's not just her you've sought... it's the answers to those questions that you have.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 怎么样了，小伙子？我已经有段时间没见到你了，希望是好事吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我又见到她了，先生……我们谈了一些其它的事情，可我还是有很多问题要问她，毕竟我父亲肯定是不会回答的……

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 首先我得说，干得漂亮，我就知道你很有本事。其次……你很清楚你该做什么。找到她，无论要找上多少次。你要找的不仅仅是她……还是你那些问题的答案。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: So, you can tell me in due time if you decide to, lad. But I do have a question, same as you did, going into this. Why did she leave? Why did she leave you, in particular?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's that she didn't even know I was alive. Sounds as though Nyx revived me sometime after I was born, but by that point... Mother had already left, and... they let her be. For reasons I am trying to find out.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Ah, that's... quite a bit to take in, there. And it explains more than a bit, I think. Look, I'm not one to speculate too much. I trust you'll find the answers that you seek as you proceed.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 如果你下定决心的话，随时可以告诉我，小伙子。不过我和你一样也有个问题：她为什么要离开？更确切地说，她为什么要离开你？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 她当时不知道我还活着。听起来像是我出生的一段时间之后，倪克斯复活了我，但那个时候……母亲已经离开了，而且……他们没人去找她。至于原因，我还在想办法弄清楚。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，这可……真曲折啊，而且我觉得很多事情就说得通了。你看，我不是那种擅长思考的人，我相信你一定会慢慢地找到答案。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: What news this time, lad? Did you find your mother, once again?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No, I failed, sir. No thanks to Father! Urgh, what am I going to do?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Just take it easy, now. You got there once, there isn't any question in my mind that you can do it once again. Your father's acting as though nothing's changed, besides. So, don't lose hope. You're capable of this.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 这次又有什么消息了，小伙子？你又找到你的母亲了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没，我失败了，都怪父亲阻挠！呃，我现在该怎么办？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 放松些就好了，既然你去过那里一次，那我觉得你毫无疑问可以再去一次。另外，你父亲的行为也都没什么变化。所以，不要放弃希望，你一定能做得到。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, tell me something, sir. Any rumors swirling about the House regarding the outcome of a certain interaction I had with my father recently? Involving a great deal of violence? Because I'd like for everyone to know: I won.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I wouldn't know of what you mean, there, lad. For there are certain subjects so forbidden here right now that not even rumors can take hold. But, just between us for the time: Congratulations. Truly.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Thank you, sir. I didn't know whether I had it in me. As for the other bit, I'll keep it quiet, then, for now. I probably shouldn't be tying my sense of self-worth to praise from friends, acquaintances, and strangers, anyway.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 跟我讲讲，老师。关于我最近一次跟我父亲交流会面的情况，大家有没有在讨论啊，有没有什么传闻之类的？非常暴力的那种？因为我想让大家都知道：我赢啦。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我不知道你想表达什么，小伙子。因为有些事情目前处于禁评状态，传闻流言都不能有。不过，要我说的话：恭喜你。真心的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 谢谢你，老师。我都不知道我自己能成。至于其他部分，我现在就暂时不说了。无论怎样，我可能不应该把我的自我价值感跟朋友、老熟人或者陌生人对我的称赞联系起来。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: The Queen is back! You did it, lad. You must have lots of catching up to do. Or patching up. And, I'm to understand that your escape attempts, they are officially approved, isn't that so?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That's so, indeed, sir. Especially for now, at least, I'm going to keep on fighting to the surface. Helps me to vent a bit, and, like Hypnos says, it makes the Underworld a better place! Though indirectly, I suppose.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Well, then, I look forward to working with you in a more formal capacity. And, it is my sincerest hope that you, your mother, and your father learn to get on better with each other, now.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 冥后回来了！你成功了，小伙子，你们肯定有很多事情要聊，要弥补过去的时光。而且据我所知，你今后的逃脱行为已经得到了官方批准，是这样的吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 确实如此，先生。至少现在，我打算继续一次次逃到地面世界。这样可以让我缓解压力。而且就像修普诺斯说的那样，这可以让冥界变得更加美好！虽然过程比较间接。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 那就好，我希望能以更正式的身份与你合作。而且我衷心希望你、你的母亲和你的父亲能渐渐学会如何更融洽地相处。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey sir, meant to say I hope I didn't get you into too much trouble after letting me in Father's bedchambers.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Think nothing of it, lad. It was a risk I was willing to take, and for his part, your father looked the other way on that one. Though I did not expect you'd get free rein to go there as you please.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，先生，你允许我进入父亲的卧室，希望这没给你带来太多麻烦。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 不用担心，小伙子，是我自己愿意冒这个险的，而且你父亲也对此睁一支眼闭一只眼。不过，我没想到你真的能可以随意管理那里。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: So, lad, tell me, then. How went the family feast, was everything all right?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, I confess I was perhaps a little nervous for practically the entire thing, but... all in all, I had a good time, and I'm very, very glad it all turned out the way it did. How about yourself?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I quite enjoyed it, too. Last time I was invited to a feast, I was still busy warring on the surface, that's how long it's been. I must say, your mother is quite good with words! Had everybody chatting, laughing...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: She really pulled it off! But... for all her confidence, I don't think she knew she had it in her. Because if she did... if she reached out to Olympus sooner... a lot of things could have been different.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Don't dwell on that. I spoke a bit with Nyx. Your mother had her reasons. No one gets to act on perfect information, right? All we have is what we think we know, and what our conscience tells us. Your mother got to where all this was possible... all thanks to you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: All thanks to me, sir? I had ample help along the way. For instance, I could not have done it without you. Would have been using an old chair leg as a weapon, I suppose.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: And what a fearsome chair leg it would be! In any case... you heading out there, soon? Olympus should be more than happy to assist in your security review. If that's what we're calling it now.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Yeah, I should go. I'll see you not too long from now.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 来吧，小伙子。和我说说，你们的家族盛宴怎么样，一切都还好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，我得承认我整场筵席可能都有点紧张，但……总体来说，我玩得很开心。而且一切能以现在的样子收场，我真的、真的非常高兴。你呢，你怎么样？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我也很开心。上一次参加筵席的时候，那时我还在忙着在阳间打仗，想想看这都多了多久了。不得不说，你的母亲真的很擅长辞令。她和所有的人都能聊到一起去，哈哈大笑……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 她真的很了不起！不过……虽然她很有信心，但我不觉得她有稳操胜券的把握。因为如果她……如果她能早一些去找奥林匹斯众神的话……很多事情可能就会完全不一样了。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 不必纠结这个。我之前和倪克斯谈了谈，你母亲有她的理由，而且没人可以在知晓一切的情况下采取行动，不是吗？我们所拥有的，只有我们所知道的事情，以及我们的良心指引我们去做的。你的母亲已经做到了最好……这都多亏了你。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 都多亏了我吗？我这一路上都一直有人帮我。比如说，如果没有你的话，我根本不可能做得到，说不定我还在拿条破椅子腿当武器用呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 就算真是这样，那也会是把名震四方的椅子腿！总之……你马上要出发了，是吧？奥林匹斯众神应该会很愿意帮助你进行安保审查工作，不知道是不是这么称呼的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，我得走了，我很快就会回来见你。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I'm so impressed with what you've managed to accomplish, lad. When I was closer to your age... or, the age you appear to be... all I wanted was glory. To be remembered forever. Look where that got me! I'm glad you know better than I did.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So in pursuing glory... you think you lost it? Forgive me, here, but I just disagree. I settled a family squabble. You single-handedly turned an entire war!

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: A foolish war. Glory comes to those driven to excel in worthwhile pursuits. A happy side effect, not a goal unto itself. Though, you don't need for me to tell you that.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: If not for all your training and advice, I wouldn't have come this far. You prepared me for this. Wasn't that a worthwhile pursuit? Must mean you got some glory after all, then, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 你做到的一切给我留下了深刻的印象，小伙子。我像你这么大……或者说，像你看起来这么大的时候……我想要的只有荣耀，只想永远被人铭记。看看我落得了什么下场！我很高兴你明白不该像我这样。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 所以你觉得，你在追寻荣耀的过程中……失去了它吗？抱歉，但我不同意。我解决的不过是家人之间的小争端，而你却凭一己之力扭转了整个战局！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 那是场愚蠢的战争，只有尽全力去做值得做的事情，才能得到荣耀。荣耀是令人愉悦的副产品，而不该是目标本身。不过，你并不需要这些忠告。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 要不是有了你的训练与忠告，我根本走不到这一步。是你让我为这一切做好了准备，这还不算是值得做的事情吗？我猜到头来，一部分荣耀还是属于你的，是吧？

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: You're getting somewhere with that Codex, lad. I'm pleased to see it. My duties to the House have meant that, lately, I can't travel quite as much as once I did.

en.speaker: Zagreus
