en.text: I'll try to travel for the both of us, Achilles. I've seen so little other than these walls.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 这手稿没白给你，小伙子。我很高兴能读到这些。我对圣殿的责任让我明白，我不能一出门就长时间不回来了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我会试着连你的份也一起，阿喀琉斯。除了这些墙壁，我几乎都没见过其他的东西。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Well, look at you, lad, with that Codex brimming with our history! I knew I could rely on you to fill it out. Back when I was alive, why, no one would have ever believed what goes on down here.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Mortals must have had their stories, though. About what happens to them once they die, and once they end up in this place.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: They have their stories, definitely so. They fear your father, understandably. They also fear your dog. But most of them know precious little else. Even their fears, I think, are born of ignorance. As most fears tend to be.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 小伙子，读了这些饱含着我们历史的手稿后，你真的变了！我就知道你有能力继续书写这手稿。我还活着的时候，根本没人愿意相信下面世界发生的事情。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 凡人们一定也有自己的故事版本吧。关于自己死后会怎样，来了这里会怎样之类的。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 你说的没错。他们惧怕你的父亲，这可以理解。他们也怕你的狗。但是他们中的大部分人，对其他方面就几乎没有了解了。我认为就连他们的恐惧，也是出于无知。就像大部分的恐惧原因一样。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, sir... within the Codex, you'd written something, about someone with whom you shared your life... when you were flesh and blood?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: ...Ah. That is a private matter for me, lad. From a time I had convinced myself the Codex would be for my own eyes, alone. My past is not really worth mentioning. And, I am presently on duty, so... begging your pardon, please.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯，老师…手稿里，你写的一些内容，里头说你在自己有血有肉还活着的时候…跟另一个人共享了自己的生命？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: …啊。那个就是我的私事啦，小伙子。很久以前我就决定我的手稿只给我自己看。我的过去其实也没什么好提的…而且，我现在正执勤呢，不好意思了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, Achilles sir, there's something I've been wondering, about your Codex. The words are yours, and yet it's through my actions that I'm able to absorb them. Is that how mortal scriptures always work?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Ah. You have to understand, lad, I've been here in your father's realm for quite some time. My documented learnings became bound to me, much like this spear, you see? You can undo those bindings over time. Thus my knowledge can be yours. Whatever it amounts to.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，阿喀琉斯老师，关于你的手稿，我有些问题想问一下。这些都是你写的，但是我要通过自己的行动才可以理解其中的意思。凡人的手稿也是这样的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 啊。小伙子，你要知道，我在你父亲的国度里已经呆了很久了。我所记录的知识，已经与我紧密相连，就像这根矛一样，看到了吗？久而久之，你就可以解开这种联系。如此一来，我的知识就为你所有了。不管多少。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I had the strangest feeling, lad, you mind if... can I see that Codex, there?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Of course, sir! I've been keeping busy with it, you could say. It's almost complete!

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: It is complete! That's amazing... a chronicle of this place... everything I've ever learned and felt.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Still always more to learn and feel, though, isn't there?

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我有种非常古怪的感觉，小伙子。你不介意……我看看那卷手稿吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 当然不介意，我一直在努力完善它的内容，已经基本完成了！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 已经完成了！真是太了不起了……冥界的百科全书……我学到的、感受到的一切，都在这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不过，总会有更多可以学习、可以感受的东西，是吧？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Achilles? My father's hall back there. I don't suppose you'll let me have myself a look? Lots for me to rummage through, I'm sure.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: You know I'd do just about anything to aid you, lad. But my ability to do so hinges on me sticking to my post. Though if I do catch wind of anything back there requiring attention, you shall know.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨，阿喀琉斯。我父亲的大厅，你应该不会让我进去的吧？我想在里头找一些东西。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道我会尽我所能去帮助你的，小伙子。只要我能够坚守在自己的岗位上就行了。如果有什么不对劲，我马上就会通知你的。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I'd ask you join me for a drink, lad, but I know you've a task ahead of you, and liquor dulls the senses. Fortunately so, under most circumstances except yours. Leave me to it, will you, and I'll have one for the both of us.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Some other time, Achilles. Just checking in on you, but I'll be on my way again shortly.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我真的想请你喝一杯，小伙子，但我知道你有要务在身，酒精会让人变得迟钝。幸运的是，大部分情况下是这样，但你除外。没事你走吧，我一个人把咱俩的都喝了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 下次吧，阿喀琉斯。就是来看看你，我马上就要走了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, would you... tell me something more of Patroclus? You mentioned you were very close.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: We could have been no closer. The ashes of our bodies yet mingle together somewhere on the surface there. What can I tell you, lad? I loved him with all my heart. And he left me too soon.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Then, surely he must be in the Underworld, somewhere... have you not tried to seek him out? Or asked my father?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Hah, haha. I tried, lad, I have tried. On both accounts. What you propose is not that simple, it turns out. You've seen what it is like out there... it's difficult to find one's way. But I shall tell you what. If you see Patroclus among the countless shades, you tell him I said hi.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯，你能不能…告诉我有关普特洛克勒斯的事情？你提到过你们关系不错。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我们的关系再好不过了。我跟他的骨灰现在还在凡界上的某处混在一起呢。要怎么说呢，小伙子。我全心全意地爱着他。但他却早早离开了我。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那他肯定在冥界的什么地方…你没试过去找他吗？或者问问我父亲？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 哈，哈哈。我试过，小伙子，我当然试过。都试过。事实证明，事情没有你说的那样简单。你也知道外头是什么样，你很难找到路。我要告诉你。如果你在茫茫暗灵之中见到了普特洛克勒斯，请给他带去我的问候。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles, would you... tell me something more of Patroclus? You mentioned you were very close.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: We could have been no closer. The ashes of our bodies yet mingle together somewhere on the surface there. What can I tell you, lad? I loved him with all my heart. And he left me too soon.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: But now you're both here, in the Underworld! Can't you go seek him out? Or alter your arrangement with my father?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Ha, hah. I tried, lad, I have tried. On both accounts. What you propose is not that simple, it turns out. But I shall tell you what. When next you see Patroclus on your journeys, you keep speaking to him for me, won't you?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯，你能不能…告诉我有关普特洛克勒斯的事情？你提到过你们关系不错。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我们的关系再好不过了。我跟他的骨灰现在还在凡界上的某处混在一起呢。要怎么说呢，小伙子。我全心全意地爱着他。但他却早早离开了我。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 但你们现在都在冥界了啊！你不能去找他吗？或者跟我父亲修改一下你们的协定？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 哈，哈。我试过，小伙子，我当然试过。都试过。事实证明，事情没有你说的那样简单。以后我再跟你细说吧。下次你在路上见到普特洛克勒斯的时候，替我多陪他聊聊天，可以吗？

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: How fare your labors, lad? You have a certain look about you. Everything all right?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's just... within Elysium, I happened on a shade, who said he knew you. Said he misses you. Do you know a Patroclus, sir?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: What... I... yes. I knew Patroclus, did he... is he all right?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: He... I don't know. He seems like he's known better times than these. Is... there something I should say to him, if I run into him again?

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: ...Please send him my regards. And... all my love. I think of him always. But I cannot see him any longer. And you mustn't ask me why, do you understand? Now, leave me be, please, lad. I need some time.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 进展得如何，小伙子？看你的表情。是有什么事吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 就是…我在至福乐土，遇到了一个暗灵，他说他认识你。说他想你。你认识普特洛克勒斯吗，老师？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 什么…我…认识。我认识普特洛克勒斯，他有没…他怎么样？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 他…我不知道。他好像经历过比这更好的时光。如果下次我再遇到他，有什么要我跟他说的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: …替我带去我的问候。还有…我全部的爱。我无时无刻不在想他。但我没法再见到他。但你不准问我为什么，了解了吗？让我一人静一静吧，小伙子。给我点时间。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: How fare your labors, lad? You have a certain look about you. Everything all right?

en.speaker: Zagreus

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 噢…！那你，就，替我带去我的问候吧。还有…我全部的爱。我无时无刻不在想他。但我没法再见到他。但你不准问我为什么，了解了吗？让我一人静一静吧，小伙子。给我点时间。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Hey, listen a moment, lad. I require your discretion with regards to whom we spoke about last time. The shade you met within Elysium.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I understand. What can I do about this, sir? There must be something. But, you have to let me know what's going on.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Simply put, he is the reason that I'm here. Patroclus lost his life before I did. Because of me. I shortly followed, in a rage. When I arrived here, I received a hero's welcome. Your father himself ushered me to Elysium. But that's not what I wanted.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You wanted to see Patroclus. But, he's in Elysium, while you... oh, no.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I signed a pact, lad. Felt that the terms were good enough. He could live there, while I'd live here, at least for now. Such deals are most uncommon, and their confidentiality must be upheld. But, let's speak no more of this for now, all right? Some other time.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨，听我说，小伙子。关于我们上次提到的那个人，你得谨慎一点。就是你在至福乐土遇到的那个暗灵。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我明白。我能做点什么，老师？一定有什么事。但是，你得让我知道到底怎么回事。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 简单来说，就是因为他我才在这里。普特洛克勒斯比我先死。就是因为我。没多久，我也死了，盛怒之下。我来这里的时候，受到了英雄级别的款待。你父亲亲自带我去了至福乐土。但我要的不是那些。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你想要见到普特洛克勒斯。但是他在至福乐土，而你…噢不。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我签订了契约，小伙子。我感觉那些条款还可以接受。他在那头，而我在这头，起码现在是这样。这种交易不常见，必须严格保密。现在我们就别再谈这个了吧。以后再说。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Hey, listen a moment, lad. I require your discretion with regards to whom we spoke about last time. The shade you met within Elysium.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I understand. What can I do about this, sir? There must be something. But, you have to let me know what's going on.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Simply put, he is the reason that I'm here. Patroclus lost his life before I did. Because of me. I shortly followed, in a rage. When I arrived here, I received a hero's welcome. Your father himself ushered me to Elysium. But that's not what I wanted.
