en.text: Your father was different with Persephone, to some extent. He has always been as you know him, yet... her lightness... it affected even him, I think. And he knows... that he was better with her, than without.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sounds like a lot of pressure on Mother to fix all his failings... but, it sounds as though she cared for him, as well. And you, and Cerberus. She said she misses you.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲很爱她，是吗？我是说，爱我的母亲。他怀着强烈的信念……固执地思念着她，是吧？至于母亲到底看上了父亲的哪点，我就不清楚了。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 从某种程度上来说，你父亲对珀尔塞福涅的态度完全不同。他一直都是你所熟知的样子，可我觉得……她的快乐……甚至都能感染你的父亲。而且你父亲也明白……有她在身边，比没有她要好。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 听起来像是母亲为了改正他的缺点承受了巨大的压力……不过，听起来她也很在乎他。她也很在乎你，还有刻耳柏洛斯。她说她很想你。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx, why is it the mortals come here knowing all about Olympus, while knowing so little about what goes on in our realm? Is there something more we could be doing to help spread the word?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: This realm remains enshrouded and obscure by my design and by your father's will, my child. Tell me, what would be the benefit of the attention you would seek?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, I... I don't know, it's just, for all the famous gods and monsters and the like, it seems to me that someone such as you, who does so much, why... you should be at least as known as any one of them!

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Obscurity is not a weakness, child. Are we understood? Seek to be valuable, not to be known. If you are valuable, then fame or notoriety can be a consequence. Should they become a burden... I can help.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯，为什么来这里的凡人对奥林匹斯山上的事情了如指掌，可对我们这里知之甚少？有没有什么办法能让大家更了解我们？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 这个王国之所以不为人知，都是出于我的设计与你父亲的意志，我的孩子。告诉我，你所寻求的关注会带来什么好处？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，我……我也不知道，只是大家对那些著名的神灵和怪物都很了解。我觉得，像你这样付出了这么多的人……你至少也应该和他们一样有名才对！

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 不为人知并不是弱点，孩子，你明白吗？我们寻求的是获得价值，而并非为人所知。如果你是个有价值的人，那无论威名还是恶名，都是由此而来的结果。如果你为名声所累……我可以帮你。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You have encountered setbacks within Asphodel, have you not, child? The Bloodless shades residing there are eager to bring death to any form of life. Beware of their infernal power.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你在水仙花平原受了不少苦了吧，孩子？那里的无血僵尸暗灵寻找着一切活着的生命并带给他们死亡。当心他们可怕的力量。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You have confronted the Exalted Shades within Elysium, my child. Your father offers them a handsome bounty should they bring your journey to an end. Although, I think the pride of vanquishing you would more than suffice in getting them to take up arms again.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你曾在至福乐土与英灵抗衡，我的孩子。你的父亲以丰厚的赏赐引诱它们，让它们中断你的旅程。但我觉得打败你的荣誉感和满足感足以让它们再次拿起武器。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You nearly gained the surface, child. Considerable progress. Though, the setbacks that you faced within the Temple... if it is of any consolation, the foes you faced there have been quite a burden to your father, too.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, Father can't control the pest problem? Never thought I'd be of any help rampaging through the upper levels of his domain.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你差点就逃离了冥界，孩子。除了在神庙遇到的挫折，你取得了了不起的成绩……如果有什么值得安慰的话，你在那边面对的敌人对你的父亲来说也是一种负担。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么，连父亲也没办法解决这些害虫问题？在他的领地的上层横冲直撞，我从来没想过还能帮上什么忙。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I saw you took possession of the List of Minor Prophecies, of the Three Fates. As ever, I should never have doubted my daughters' expectations. I was uncertain you had necessary guidance to select it from among the House Contractor's many opportunities.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You offer something called the Fated List of Minor Prophecies to me, chances are I'm going to pick it up. Though, you make it sound like there's more I should know about it. Should I be concerned?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You know exactly what is necessary, and no more. I know better than anyone never to tamper with the Fates' design. Though, if they had cruelty in store for you through their List... I think that I would warn you, anyway.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我看到你拿着三位命运女神的那张小预言清单。我也应该和过去一样，从不怀疑我的女儿们的期望。我只是不确定你是否得到了必要的指点，在圣殿承包商提供的那么多机会中会选择它。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你送我那张所谓的命运小预言清单，我就会把它收下。不过你好像还想和我说些什么，有什么是我应该注意的？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 该知道的你都知道了。我比如何人都更明白，不能篡改命运的安排。如果在这张清单上写着你命中注定要经历可怕的事情……我想我还是会提醒你。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You have fulfilled already many prophecies envisioned by my daughters, child. Although perhaps inevitable, I find it impressive, nonetheless.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Thank you, Nyx. Though, they're just minor prophecies, right? The kind that won't necessarily come to pass unless spelled out and coupled with a decent reward to make it worth my while. Not even the Fates are above greasing the wheels of progress, then?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: The Fates have perfect knowledge of exactly what is necessary for the future they have woven to someday come to pass. We each are instrumental to their ultimate design. Some more than others, it would seem, of course.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我的女儿们所做的预言，很多都已经在你身上应验了。虽然它们可能是必不可免的，但还是让我印象深刻。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 谢谢你，倪克斯。但它们只是一些小预言，对吧？那些都不一定会实现，除非你把它说出来，然后给我奖励，让我不觉得是在浪费时间。甚至连命运女神也没有在其中推波逐浪？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 命运女神完全知道要做些什么，以使她们所编织的未来成真。对于她们的最终安排，我们只是工具而已。当然，有些人可能更加重要。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I sense all of the minor prophecies described within the Fated List have been fulfilled...? I do not understand how that is possible.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, it certainly took some doing, and several of those really were rather difficult, and took some time, but... what's so special about getting through them all? It's a list, right?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: The Fates are always at their weaving. To have caught up with their designs... well, I should think that they shall have to learn to weave a little faster, perhaps.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Any new prophecies need fulfilling, they know where to find me.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我感觉到，命运清单上所有的小预言都已经实现了，是吗……？我不明白这到底是怎么做到的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，这确实要花上一些工夫。而且其中一部分事情相当困难，也花了不少时间，不过……完成其中所有的内容，到底有什么特别之处呢？这只是份清单，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 命运女神总是在编织命运。若是想弄清楚她们的安排的话……这么说吧，我觉得她们或许应该学着织得快一些才是。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果有什么需要实现的新预言，他们知道该去哪里找我。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I sense all of the minor prophecies described within the Fated List have been fulfilled...? I do not understand how that is possible.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, it certainly took some doing, and several of those really were rather difficult, and took some time, but... what's so special about getting through them all? It's a list, right?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: The Fates are always at their weaving. To have caught up with their designs... well, I should think that they shall have to learn to weave a little faster, perhaps.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Any new prophecies need fulfilling, they know where to find me.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我感觉到，命运清单上所有的小预言都已经实现了，是吗……？我不明白这到底是怎么做到的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，这确实要花上一些工夫。而且其中一部分事情相当困难，也花了不少时间，不过……完成其中所有的内容，到底有什么特别之处呢？这只是份清单，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 命运女神总是在编织命运。若是想弄清楚她们的安排的话……这么说吧，我觉得她们或许应该学着织得快一些才是。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果有什么需要实现的新预言，他们知道该去哪里找我。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: What is it, child? Is something amiss?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No, it's just... the latest renovations from the Contractor... Father told me you've been supervising all of that. Look, just between us, and I'll not speak of it again, but... thanks. So much.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Ah. Yes, no need to speak of it again. Though, I am pleased to oblige.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 怎么了，孩子？有什么问题吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯，关于承包商最近的整修工作……父亲和我说，由你负责总体监工。我是说，这是我们两个人之间的秘密，我也不会再次提起这件事，但是……我要谢谢你，真的非常感谢。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 啊……是的，不用再提这件事了。不过，我很乐意帮忙。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: This House is not a place of cheer, child. A certain severity always struck me as appropriate, if not necessary, given our role.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Is this about all the House Contractor decorations? Look, it's one thing if Father objects, but if you do as well... just tell me, and I can have it taken down.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You misunderstand. I am grateful. These changes... I would not have commissioned them, myself. But, seeing them now... I appreciate their presence. You have a discerning eye.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 这座圣殿可不是适合庆祝的地方，孩子。考虑到我们的角色，我觉得保持一定程度的严肃才合适，甚至说是必要。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这一切都是和圣殿承包商的装饰品有关吗？听我说，父亲反对我一点都不在乎，但如果你也不喜欢的话……告诉我就好，我会撤下来的。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你误会了，我很感激。这些变化……我自己是不会去委托这些事情的。可亲眼看到这些变化之后……我很感激这一切，你的眼光真的很不错。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx, if, hypothetically, I felt that some injustice had been dealt to someone who deserved a better lot... say, that they were subjected to too harsh a punishment for all eternity... don't I have some of my father's authority to do something about it?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Now that you have regained your access privileges to the administrative chamber, child, yes; that is a level of authority you hypothetically possess, again.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: But how can I possibly find anything in there? The place is wall-to-wall pacts and parchments. I've no idea where to look.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You can be made aware. Though, use discretion, if and when you need to exercise this power. And make certain that the time is right. Now, are we understood?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯，假设说，我感觉某些人遭到了不公平对待，他们应该有更美好的命运……例如，他们被判定要承受过于苛刻的永世惩罚……难道我就不能动用我的父亲的哪怕一点点权限来做点什么吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 现在的你已经重新获得了进入行政厅的权限，孩子。你又重新获得自己梦寐以求的权力了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 但我又怎么可能在那里找到些什么？那地方堆满了契约和羊皮纸。我根本不知道该如何下手。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你会摸清门路的，不过，在运用你的权限时要小心谨慎，并且把握正确的时机。明白了吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Never thought that the administrative chamber would have been so invaluable, Nyx. Though, I have you to thank for all of it.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Nonsense, child. Our records must be kept up-to-date. You merely observed that several were long past due. Not even your father can argue with that.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我从来没想过管理大厅居然是这么重要的地方，倪克斯。不过，这一切都得感谢你才是。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 用不着这样，孩子。我们的记录必须每天更新，而你看到的只是几份老早之前就该更新的记录，这一点就连你父亲也没法否认。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx... I encountered Demeter. She mentioned her daughter... Persephone. You never said she was my grandmother. Didn't you think... under the circumstances... that was something I should know?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: ...Listen to me, child. What you know, or do not know, is for your protection. Your protection, and your birthmother's, as well. Your suspicion and your curiosity are warranted. But I can do no more about them, now, except to caution you. Are we understood?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯……我碰到了得墨忒尔。她跟我提起她的女儿……珀尔塞福涅。你从来没说过她是我的外婆。你不觉得……在这种情况下……你应该和我说些什么吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: ……听我说，孩子。你知道什么，不知道什么，都是为了你的安全考虑。你的安全，还有你生母的安全。你可以怀揣着疑心和好奇心。但我目前对此无能为力，除了提醒你要小心。你能理解吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx, I've come to know the god of swiftness, Hermes, though... it seems to me he doesn't work directly with the others on Olympus. Do you know him well?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Lord Hermes is a point of contact, yes. Among Olympians he works the closest with our operations here, and aids with shepherding the souls of the departed to our gates. Accept his help; for he is faithful to our cause.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯，我认识了迅捷之神赫尔墨斯，不过……我看他和奥林匹斯山上的其他诸神没多少来往。你和他熟吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 赫尔墨斯先生是我们的信使，我认识他。在所有奥林匹斯山众神中，他与我们这边关系最密切，还会帮助护送死者的灵魂穿过我们的大门。接受他的帮助吧；因为他也忠于我们的事业。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Someday I'd like to meet more of your children, Nyx. Eris, Nemesis... Thanatos told me of several others. Have they ever visited the House?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: No. They are required elsewhere. It is for the best. Some of my children are not on speaking terms with one another, or with me. As a mother... one has her victories, and her defeats.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 希望以后能与你其他的孩子们见面，倪克斯，像厄里斯、涅墨西斯……塔纳托斯和我提起过的其中几位，他们来过这座圣殿吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 不，他们的职责在别的地方，这才是最好的安排。我的一部分子女和另一部分相处并不融洽，和我的关系也不太好。身为人母……会有很多成功之处，也会有很多失败之处。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx, I was just busy doing some administrative chamber record-keeping recently, and, wouldn't you know, it somehow slipped my mind where I could find the sentencing parchmentwork for the knave-king Sisyphus, forced to toil out in Tartarus? I ran it by Megaera...

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: He has offered you aid, repeatedly. At first I saw it for a brazen act of bribery, but... try as I might, there was no deeper underpinning to his actions that I could detect. That is to say... the records you seek may be found in section sigma-phi-alpha, lower gamma folder.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯，我最近都在行政办公室忙于做记录，你知道吗，有时候我在想，在哪里可以找到西西弗斯的判决书呢，就是那位被迫在塔耳塔罗斯做苦力的无赖之王？然后我跟墨纪拉说起这件事……

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 他一直在帮助你。起初我以为他在厚颜无耻地讨好你，但是……我试过了，确实找不到他的行为背后有什么不可告人的目的。话说回来……你要找的记录应该在西格玛-斐-阿尔法区的小写伽马文件夹。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I waived the punishment-sentence for Sisyphus the knave-king, Nyx, except... he chose to stay! He chose to stay, in Tartarus, I think in part because he likes getting to speak with me, from time to time! Also his boulder friend.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: That sounds to be an agreeable outcome for him. Though, his liberty is not the end of his rehabilitation. As his friend... please make certain he does not run afoul again of your father, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我撤销了对无赖之王西西弗斯的惩罚，倪克斯，除非……他自己选择留下来！他选择留在塔耳塔罗斯，可能想和我不时地说说话是其中的部分原因！当然还有他的巨石朋友。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 听起来对他来说是不错的决定。不过他的自由并非其赎罪的终点。作为他的朋友……请确保他不会再冒犯你的父亲，孩子。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, Nyx, you ever have a burning urge to find the case files for the circumstances under which our court-musician bound himself to eternal servitude here in this House, and forever lost his opportunity to be with his beloved muse? I was wondering if you had a remedy for that.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Our court musician brings a certain peace to this abode, my child. But, you may discover, once you find his case files in section zeta-pi-omega, upper beta folder, that the consequences that he suffers may be quite in excess of his trespasses...

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，倪克斯，你是否曾经有迫切地想要找出案件卷宗，看看我们的宫廷乐师出于什么原因要在这座圣殿里永远被奴役，而且和他心爱的缪斯分隔两地？我在想你有没有办法补救。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我们的宫廷乐师给这个地方带来了安宁，我的孩子。不过，当你在泽塔-派-欧米伽区大写贝塔文件夹找到他的案件卷宗，你会发现他所受的惩罚相对于其犯下的错误来说过于严酷……

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You don't know how pleased I was to see Orpheus visiting with his muse Eurydice over in Asphodel. Best of all... I don't think he's left for good. He'll just have some time to visit her now and again! Thank you, Nyx, on their behalf, and mine.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You need not thank me, child. Your actions made this outcome possible. I merely did what anyone in my position would have done.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你没法想象，在看到俄耳甫斯和他的缪斯欧律狄克在水仙花平原相逢时，我有多么高兴。最棒的是……我认为他们不会永远分离。他会时不时地抽空去看欧律狄克！我要代表他们还有我自己谢谢你，倪克斯。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你不需要感谢我，孩子。这都是你的功劳。我只是做了自己该做的事情而已。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I, ah, happened to be looking into our security situation here, just running background checks, that sort of thing, and... I was wondering if you could help me locate an old pact signed by... signed by Achilles, Nyx. It would mean a lot... not just to him, but me.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Achilles... We would struggle to put someone comparable in his role. Though, be that as it may... epsilon-iota-theta. Rho folder, middle, I believe. You are certain about this, child?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我，呃，碰巧在检查这里的安保情况，背景调查啊之类的，然后……我想问一下，你能不能帮我找一份古老的契约……是阿喀琉斯签署过的契约，倪克斯？这份契约至关重要……不仅仅是对他，对我来说也同样如此。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯啊……我们之中很难有谁能比得上他。不过，随它去吧……应该是埃普西隆——约塔——西塔，在㖻文件夹里，中间那层。你真的要这么做吗，孩子？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I saw Achilles with Patroclus in Elysium, Nyx. They're free to be together, now, thanks to you. If only you could have seen them.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Oh, I can see them, my child, and I have. And it pleases me Achilles has earned some degree of respite from his servitude, for all his loyalty to our House. For what you have done for him, thank you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Father isn't going to be thrilled I've let him out of a binding pact.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Your father is committed to his rules, and you released Achilles from his pact according to those rules. There is not much that even he can do about it save to have Achilles sign again.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我在至福乐土看到阿喀琉斯和普特洛克勒斯在一起，倪克斯。他们现在自由了，在一起了，谢谢你。真希望你也可以去见见他们。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，我现在就能看到他们，我的孩子，我已经见过他们了。阿喀琉斯对我们的圣殿忠心耿耿，能看到他从这奴役之中得到些许喘息，我真的很高兴。谢谢你为他所做的一切。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 撕毁一个契约，应该不至于让父亲大发雷霆吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你的父亲是个恪守规矩的人，而你根据他定下的规矩，解除了阿喀琉斯的契约。就算是他，也没办法让阿喀琉斯再次签下契约了。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Persephone, the Queen... she has returned! I scarce believe it, child. You have brought her back, to all of us.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I scarce believe it, too. What happens now? Pick up the pieces and begin again?

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 珀尔塞福涅，冥后……她回来了！我真不敢相信，孩子。你把她带回来了，带到了我们身边。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我也不敢相信。现在该怎么办呢？收拾残局，重新开始吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: How has it been for you of late, Nyx? Having Mother here again, for old time's sake?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Though reminiscent of an older time, it is now very different, child. For one thing... you are present, now. Unlike before.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, right. So, are you getting on OK, is everything all right?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Everything is all right. Your birthmother... Persephone... her presence has been welcome here, I think.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 最近怎么样，倪克斯？母亲又回来了，你们可以好好叙叙旧？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 尽管让人想起了曾经的时光，但现在却大不相同了，孩子。比如说……你也在了，这和以前不同。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，好吧。所以，你们相处得还好吗？一切都还好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 一切都很好。你的生母……珀耳塞福涅……我认为她在这里很受欢迎。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Congratulations on your new responsibilities, my child. So, you have reason to rise from here to the surface, still.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's more of a formality, I think. My responsibilities, such as they are, remain quite similar to those that got me to this point. But thank you, Nyx. It's strange... to think that I can serve the House, by trying to break from it, time after time.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: There can be no escape. Your father wishes that this reputation spread. So that the mortals and the shades never attempt what you were able to achieve.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, it does beat standing around in my chambers aimlessly. And... I daresay it feels rather good not to feel utterly incompetent, for a change.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: It is an honor to be working with you, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 恭喜你有了新的职责，孩子。所以，你依然有理由逃出这里，前往地上世界。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我觉得，这变得更加正规了。我的责任正是如此，和我以前一直在做的事情没什么差别。不过我要谢谢你，倪克斯。这种感觉很奇怪……想想看，我居然能靠一次次从这里逃出去来为这座圣殿提供服务。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 没人能逃出这个地方，你父亲希望这样的声誉能在所有人那里传开，这样凡人和幽灵们才永远都不会尝试你曾实现过的事情。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧，这总比呆在房间里无所事事要好。而且……我觉得，能感觉到自己有能力接受变化，这种感觉还挺好的。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 能与你共事是我的荣幸，孩子。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx, meant to ask... Charon was there to take Mother and me home the one time. So is he... has he been working for you? All part of some elaborate plan, or something?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Charon serves only this realm, child. And, he is very trustworthy. I suppose that it is also possible he has some affection for the Queen, if not for you.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯，我想问的是……之前是卡戎把我和母亲送回来的。所以他……他一直都在侍奉你吗？这一切都是某个精心设计的计划的一部分吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 卡戎只侍奉冥界，孩子，而且他非常可靠。我猜，说不定他对冥后怀着某种特别的感情吧，对你也是如此。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You are still in a difficult predicament, my child. And I, with you, in turn. Those on Olympus think you seek them, even now. That you are my own son by birth. Our deception, well intentioned as it was, has multiplied in size.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're right. We have to do something. We can't just keep pretending with them.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: But if you reveal to them the truth of everything... I fear the wrath they shall unleash. Perhaps not all of them, but some, at least, shall not take such deceptions well.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I couldn't agree more. Fortunately, Mother has a plan! Asked me to get in touch with everybody on Olympus, one by one.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Your birthmother is resourceful, certainly. Though can you say as yet, which sort of plan?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Would you believe it if I told you she wants to have all of them over for Ambrosia?

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你仍然处于困境之中，我的孩子，我会与你共同面对困难。即便是现在，奥林匹斯众神也认为你在寻找他们，认为你是我的儿子。虽然我们的谎言出于好意，但撒下的谎却越来越多了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你说得没错。我们不能一直把他们蒙在鼓里，必须做点什么才行。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 可如果你把所有的真相都说出来的话……我很担心他们的怒火。或许不是每个人都会发火，但至少其中一部分人并不喜欢谎言。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我完全同意，不过幸好母亲有个计划！她要我一个接一个，和奥林匹斯山上的每位神明都取得联系。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你的生母足智多谋，这一点毫无异议。不过，你可以告诉我是什么样的计划吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果我说，她打算请每个人都喝些仙馔密酒的话，你能相信吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx, this feast Mother has planned... would it be all right with you if I were to invite Chaos?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I... hardly think that Chaos would attend any festivity of ours. I am uncertain that they even could. Even more doubtful that they would want this. However... if you truly wish to ask, proceed.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯，关于母亲策划的这场盛宴……如果我把卡俄斯也邀请来，你觉得可以吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我……很难想象卡俄斯会参与我们的庆典。我不确定他能不能参加我们的庆典，更不确定他到底愿不愿意这么做。不过……如果你真的打算问他的话，就去问吧。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: It was a privilege to meet your relatives at last, child. Athena, Ares, and the rest. Confronted face-to-face, they were much more agreeable than I expected. A night we shall remember, was it not?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: A memorable night it was, indeed, Nyx! For most of us, at least. Dionysus, he won't remember any of it, I don't think. But, it was really good to see everyone having a good time. Getting along as though they didn't hold a grudge! So, then, we're clear, I think?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Persephone told them everything they needed to hear. Sometimes that is the only way, with family. Though, the Olympians... they are prone to their misunderstandings, are they not? This state of kinship may not last eternally.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, let's enjoy it while it does, I guess.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 终于有幸见到你那些亲人了，孩子。雅典娜、阿瑞斯，还有其他人，他们比我想象得要和蔼可亲得多。真是个值得铭记的夜晚啊，不是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 确实是个难忘的夜晚，倪克斯！至少对大部分人来说是这样的，不过我估计迪奥尼索司肯定什么都记不住吧。不过很高兴看到大家欢聚一堂，都相处得很好，就好像没什么过节一样！所以说，我们已经没问题了，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 珀尔塞福涅对他们说了他们需要听到的一切，有时候我们对家人只能这么做。不过，奥林匹斯众神……他们很容易误解别人，不是吗？像这样的亲族关系，可能没办法永远持续下去。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那我猜，就趁它还在的时候，享受当下吧。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Pride has been the failing of so many mortals, child, and has brought low members of your family, as well. And yet... I am so very proud of you, for what you have achieved. I wanted you to be aware of that.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That means a lot to me, Nyx. Though I never could have done any of this without your help. Even after I lashed out at you after I learned the truth about Mother, you never stopped caring for me... and you put yourself directly in harm's way, defying Father's will. Why do all that, for me?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I am eternally committed to this House. Long before your father came to rule, I was already here. When he arrived... I needed to do everything I could to keep order, and establish with Lord Hades an agreeable relationship. But, there is one more reason, besides that...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: To get on better terms with the Olympians. They always used to frown on the Underworld, but... now that they know us, they seem much more willing to get involved and help with things.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: A reasonable guess, and not without some truth to it, but no, my child. My reason for helping you is simpler than that. It is because I love you. You may not be born of me, but I raised you like one of my own. And I have cared for you as I am capable.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx... I love you, too. Thank you for everything.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 骄傲曾让无数凡人身败名裂，孩子，也曾让你许多家人名声扫地。可即便如此……你所成就的一切，让我感到无比骄傲，我希望你能明白这点。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 对我来说，这些话意义重大，倪克斯。可是没有你的帮助，我根本做不到这些事情。即便我得知了母亲的真相之后大发雷霆，你也从未停止对我的关心……你还违背了父亲的意愿，把自己推到了风口浪尖。为什么要为我付出这一切呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我永远效忠于这座圣殿。很久以前，你父亲还没成为冥王的时候，我就已经在这里了。他来这里的时候……我尽我所能地保证秩序，想办法与冥王哈迪斯建立友好的关系。不过除此之外，还有另一个原因……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你希望能和奥林匹斯众神处好关系。他们以前总是对冥界不屑一顾，不过……如今他们已经和我们熟悉了，似乎也更愿意帮我们处理这里的事务了。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 这个猜测很合理，而且也基于事实，但并不是这样，我的孩子。我帮助你的原因，比这要简单得多：因为我爱你。或许你并不是我的亲生儿子，但我待你视如己出，我尽我所能地把你养大成人。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯……我也爱你，谢谢你为我做的一切。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: She has departed once again. Your birthmother the Queen. Although, it was not as difficult to see her off, this time. Knowing she shall return.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It must be difficult for her... returning to Olympus. She had no love for it at all. I hope she'll be all right.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Do not despair. We have ways of watching over her. Not that I expect anything untoward to happen, but... well, with your family, one learns to take precautions, as you know.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...I'll miss her.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: So shall I. But it shall not be long, I think.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你的生母冥后又离开这里了。不过，这次再想见她就没那么困难了。放心吧，她会回来的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这对她来说肯定很难受……回到奥林匹斯山。她一点都不喜欢那里，我希望她一切都好。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 不要感到绝望，我们有办法观察她的动向。倒不是说我觉得她可能会碰上什么意外，不过……这么说吧，你那些家人还在，我们总得提前做好措施，你明白的吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: ……我会想念她的。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我也会，不过我觉得她应该很快就回来了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I was pleased to see even Chaos was able to attend our little feast there with the Olympians, in spirit, anyway! Were you able to chat at all?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Only a little bit. The first communication we have had in quite some time. It went better than expected. Perhaps they and I can continue the conversation at some point. Thank you for your initiative, child.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, let's enjoy it while it does, I guess.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 就连卡俄斯都以它的灵魂形态，参加我们与奥林匹斯众神的小小盛典了，我感到很开心！你们有没有聊上几句？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 只聊了一点点吧，这是我们这么长时间以来的第一次沟通，比预期得要好。或许在某些情况下，我可以和他继续进行对话。感谢你这么主动，孩子。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那我猜，就趁它还在的时候，享受当下吧。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Alas, you have seen much of Hypnos lately, child. I hope you find his disposition somewhat tolerable? Please tell me plain if this is not the case.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, he's not so bad, Nyx. Be proud of your sleepy, cheerful son! Who else among us is able to muster that kind of enthusiasm?

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 唉，你最近跟修普诺斯交流的不少啊，孩子。希望你可以接受他的性格。不过这应该不是问题所在吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，他没什么不好啦，倪克斯。为你昏昏欲睡、无忧无虑的儿子感到骄傲吧！我们之中还有谁能有这种热情呢？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I don't often see you interact with Hypnos, Nyx, so I just wanted to make sure... is everything all right?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Hypnos still is learning independence, child. Thus, I have decided it is best to keep my distance from him temporarily, else he shall continue to rely upon me, even for completing the most rudimentary requests. We have agreed he shall not call upon me for the time being.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: For the time being? How long are we talking? Can't remember the last time I saw you speaking with him, now that you mention it.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Based on his rate of progress, I suspect his education shall have been complete well before the dawning of the next age.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我很少看到你和修普诺斯联系，倪克斯，所以想要问问……你们之间还好吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 修普诺斯还在学习如何自立。因此我决定最好暂时和他保持距离，否则他会继续依赖我，连最基本的事情都做不了。我和他说好了，暂时不要来找我。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 暂时？那是多久呢？既然你提起来，我都不记得上次你们说话是什么时候了。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 按照他的进步速度，我猜他的学习差不多会在下一个纪元开始前结束。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx, have you seen Charon lately? Everything all right with him? I can never tell how he's doing.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Charon and I have not lately taken opportunities to correspond. But he has always been among the least dependent of my children, other than perhaps only the Fates. This much I know and can assure to you: He always is content to steer his boat.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I suppose you are the one to thank for his assistance, when it comes to selling me his wares and such.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: No. He is the one to thank. Do not mistake his lack of speech for lack of cleverness. He serves this House as I do. But he does not answer to me.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯，你最近见过卡戎吗？他还好不？我都不知道他现在怎么样。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我和卡戎最近也断了联系。在我的孩子当中，他一直是最独立自主的那个，或许除了命运女神以外。我知道的就这些，但我可以向你保证：他肯定很满足于能够掌舵。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 他之所以会帮助我，我想我应该感谢你，比如他会把自己的商品卖给我。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 不。你要感谢的人是他。他的沉默寡言并不代表他缺乏智慧。我们一样都在为圣殿做事。但他不用向我汇报工作。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, Nyx? You don't suppose Charon would hold it against me if... we had a little fight? To the death, I mean.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: None of Charon's brothers ever dared fight with him whilst growing up. Why would you fathom such a ruinous idea, child?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It... kind of already happened. And, I can confirm he's rather strong. Something I can do to make it up to him?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Probably not. For it is unnecessary. Likely he appreciates having an adversary, in his own way. Few would so much as dare.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，倪克斯？你觉得卡戎会不会记恨我，假设……我们小小地打了一架？我是说，打到至死方休的那种。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 卡戎长大成人的这段日子里，他没有哪个兄弟敢和他打架。你怎么会想出这种自取灭亡的主意，孩子？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我们……算是已经打过了吧，而且我觉得他很强壮。我应该怎么弥补和他之间的关系？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 或许你不用做什么，因为这没必要。说不定他很喜欢能有位势均力敌的对手，毕竟没几个人有胆量挑战他。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You must have vanquished Megaera, my child, for she has been sulking in the lounge for quite some time. You are safe here from her whip, but not her words.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'd better talk to her. Thank you for the heads-up, Nyx. See you later, I'm sure.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你打败了墨纪拉，孩子，她现在正在休息室里生闷气呢。在这里你不用担心她的鞭子，但她的话就不一定了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我最好跟她谈谈。多谢你的提醒，倪克斯。我们回头见。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You must have vanquished Megaera, my child. For she has been sulking in the corner there for quite some time. You are safe here from her whip, but not her words.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'd better talk to her. Thank you for the heads-up, Nyx. See you later, I'm sure.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你肯定打败了墨纪拉，我的孩子。因为她一直躲在那个角落里生闷气。你在这里很安全，她的鞭子抽不到你，但她的话依然很伤人。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我最好跟她谈谈。多谢你的提醒，倪克斯。我们回头见。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx, do you know anything about a softly-spoken gentlebeing under the guise of Chaos? They approached me recently, and offered me a Boon, of sorts.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Primordial Chaos... indeed, I know them well. They must have taken interest in your quest. I would advise that you beware their offerings, though know that Chaos, whilst a trickster, is not a deceiver.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯，你认识一位轻声细语说话，名为卡俄斯的吗？最近祂开始接近我，给了我个另类的祝福。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 原始者卡俄斯……没错，我的确认识，祂一定对你的事产生了兴趣。至于他的祝福，我建议你谨慎对待为妙。不过你得了解，卡俄斯或许很狡猾，但祂不会欺骗你。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Can you tell me something more of Chaos, Nyx? I... have a lot of questions.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: My place is not to speak too openly of Chaos, child. It is their own prerogative to tell you of themselves. I can say they are the eldest force within this world. Before them, there was nothing.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 能告诉我更多有关卡俄斯的事吗，倪克斯？我…有许多疑问。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我的身份不允许我公开谈论卡俄斯，孩子。只能由祂自己来告诉你这些。我能说祂是这世界里最古老的一支力量。在祂之前，什么都没有。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Chaos seems to have taken somewhat of a liking to me, Nyx. They mentioned you.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: They mentioned me, did they... I thought, perhaps, that they had long forgotten. You should know they are my mother and my father, child. We have not spoken since the dawn of time.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 卡俄斯似乎有点喜欢我了，倪克斯。祂提到了你。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 祂提到我了，那祂有没有……我还以为祂早就把我忘了。你应该知道，祂既是我的母亲，也是我的父亲，孩子。自从黎明到来之后，我们就再也没说过话。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx, I hate to be a bother, but I wanted to ask you about Chaos once again. Won't you at least try to reach out to them?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: It is for Chaos to reach out to me if they wish to reacquaint themselves with me. Child, it would please me if we spoke no more of this for now.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯，我这样可能有点烦，但是我还是想再问一下有关卡俄斯的事。你最起码应该尝试一下与祂接触吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 如果想要重新认识彼此，那卡俄斯就应该自己来找我。孩子，如果可以不再谈论此事，我会感到很欣慰。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Child, I... know not exactly what you did, but... I detected faintly an attempt by Chaos to reach out to me. A message, merely at the edges of my consciousness, yet I felt certain it was there. But I could not discern it, otherwise. What does Chaos want from me?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I... think Chaos wishes to reestablish contact with you, Nyx. The two of you drifted apart from one another, so, I think I can imagine. I lost touch with Thanatos awhile! But that was nothing in comparison to this. Isn't there someway you can reconnect?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Now that the House is strong, and this realm orderly, I do not know. But I shall think upon it, child. Leave me, please.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 孩子，我……不知道你做了什么，但是……我微弱地感觉到卡俄斯试图和我取得联系。有一条讯息，就在我快失去意识的时候，但我肯定有这么一条讯息，却怎么也无法分辨。卡俄斯想从我这里得到什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜……卡俄斯是想和你重新取得联系吧，倪克斯。你们两人渐渐疏远了，我可以想象出来。我也曾一度和塔纳托斯互不联络！但和你们比起来根本不算什么。你们没办法再沟通一下吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 想到现在圣殿如此强势，这片领地也井然有序，我不知道。但我会考虑的，孩子。请让我再好好想想。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I know what must be done, regarding Chaos and myself, my child. It is not often that I ask for your assistance, but I need for you to do something for me, if you would hear me out.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Of course, Nyx. Anything. What can I do?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: In the administrative chamber, you perhaps recall the Eldest Sigil there. Through it we have access directly to the darkest reaches of the realm. But not to Chaos, anymore. Not currently. Though, this is solvable, I think.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, the Sigil? But I'm not authorized to use it. It's never worked for me, and I have even less authority around here now.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: That you were stripped of your authority is what makes this possible at all. It shall require a significant expenditure of Darkness. Then... the bridge to Chaos may be restored. So that I might travel again to visit them. Will you bring Darkness to the Sigil for me, please? When possible.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'll do everything I can. Hey maybe you can put in a request with the House Contractor for me? Make it official, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 关于卡俄斯和我的事，我知道要做什么。我一般不会要求你的帮助，但是如果你愿意听我的请求，我希望你能够帮我做一些事。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 当然了，倪克斯。任何事都行。我能做什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 去管理大厅的话，或许你会想起最古老的印记。我们可以通过它直接抵达冥界最黑暗的地方，而不再是卡俄斯的所在之处。虽然我们现在还做不到这一点，不过，我觉得这个问题可以解决。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等一下，印记？但我没有权限使用它呀。它从来没有对我起过作用，更何况我现在的权限已大不如前。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 就是因为你的权限被削弱了，才使这一切变得可能。它需要大量黑暗宝石。这样……通向卡俄斯所在之处的桥梁才有可能被修复。我也可以再去拜访他们了。你可以为我把黑暗宝石带到印记这里吗？如果可能的话。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我会尽量想办法的。对了，或许你可以为我向圣殿承包商提出请求？正式的请求？

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: At last. The bridge to Chaos is restored. Thank you so very much, my child. I shall be going, then. And I shall presently return. Please, have no fear. And now, farewell. I shall bring Chaos your kindest regards.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 终于。通向混沌世界的桥梁被修复了。非常感谢，我的孩子。那我先走了，但不久就会回来。请不要担心。那我们先就此别过。我会替你向卡俄斯问好的。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx, you're back! So, how did things with Chaos go? Please tell me it went well?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: It did. It did go well, my child, I... appreciated having had a chance to reconnect with my great ancestor. Thanks to your generosity, to both of us. We had to make up for a great deal of lost time.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So what happens now? You're back on speaking terms, then... does it mean Chaos will stop by for a visit soon, something like that?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Chaos is comfortable in their realm. I may, however, visit every now and then. Keep them apprised of what unfolds up here. Beyond that... Chaos knows better than to exert too much influence upon this realm. Beyond having already formulated it, and everything.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯，你回来了！卡俄斯怎么样了，一切都还好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 是的，一切都好，我的孩子，我……很感激有机会和我的伟大的祖先重新建立联系。多亏了你对我们两人的慷慨。我们必须弥补过去那段被浪费的时间。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那现在怎么样了？话说你也回来了，这是不是意味着……卡俄斯很快就会过来，或是怎样？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 卡俄斯在祂的领地过得逍遥自在。我也会经常去看祂，告诉祂这里都发生了什么。除此以外……卡俄斯也知道不要对这片领地施加太大的影响力。虽然是祂创造了这里，还有一切。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: How are you and Chaos getting on, lately, Nyx? Sounds like they expected an awful lot from you before. That you should shine as bright as day, something like that? I can't imagine.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: To shine was never quite my strongest suit. During the dawn of creation, there was much to do. This place... all that you see around you... it was more my leaning. Chaos understands that better, now. As for me, the work helped me to know which limits I have.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What limits are those? You seem capable of anything. Probably even shining bright.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Come, child. We each have our limits.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你最近和卡俄斯相处得怎么样，倪克斯？听起来祂之前很想听到你的消息。祂说你就应该想白昼一样熠熠生辉之类的？我实在想象不出来。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 熠熠生辉从来都不是我的强项。早在创世之初，就有很多事情要做。这个地方……你周围所见的一切……才是我的偏好。如今，卡俄斯更好地理解到了这一点。对我来说，这项工作也让我体会到了我能力的极限。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你还有什么极限呢？你看起来什么事情都做得到，说不定在夜晚熠熠生辉也做得到。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你说笑了，孩子，我们每个人都有各自的极限。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: The Fury Megaera is under orders to prevent your passage out of Tartarus, my child. Conflict between the two of you is unavoidable. It brings me pain to have to see you fight.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Don't say that, Nyx. Besides! Conflict between Megaera and me has always put the spark in our relationship. We're going to be fine.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 复仇女神墨纪拉受命阻止你通过塔耳塔罗斯，孩子。你俩的冲突在所难免。看到你们剑刃相向让我很难过。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 别这样说，倪克斯。再说了！我跟墨纪拉起冲突的时候还是可以培养感情的。我们没事的。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx, you've known Megaera practically forever. Well, before my time at least, so could you... tell me more about what she was like, back then?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Ah-hahah. I am pleased to see the two of you on better terms of late. Megaera always was as she appears. Dutiful and quite particular. Thoughtful and dependable. Respectful.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯，你跟墨纪拉那么熟，至少肯定比我更熟。那你能不能告诉我……以前的她是什么样的？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 啊哈哈……看到你们最近关系改善，我很开心。墨纪拉就是那样一个人。忠实尽职，但不失个性。体贴周到，彬彬有礼，非常可靠。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: It pleases me that you and Megaera have come to deeply understand each other, child. I must admit to you, it was my hope that you and she were capable of this result.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're pleased we're together, Nyx? I thought you'd be concerned that such relationships distract from work responsibilities and such. Although, I'm grateful to have your approval.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I have no fear that Megaera shall be distracted, child. Besides; such matters are more likely to inspire, and to spur greater accomplishment. Although, the greater sense of contentment tends to be a sufficient end unto itself.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 很高兴看到你和墨纪拉能够深入了解彼此。而且，我也一直希望你和她能够相处的如此融洽。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我们在一起，你很开心吧，倪克斯？我还以为你会担心这种关系会影响工作什么的呢。不过，能得到你的认可我很高兴。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我不担心墨纪拉会因此受影响，孩子。而且，这种事情往往能带来更多启发，激励她取得更大的成就。不过，主要是这本身也会让人产生更强烈的满足感。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: It pleases me that you and Megaera have come to deeply understand each other, child. I must admit to you, it was my hope that you and she were capable of this result.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're happy Meg and I are friends now, Nyx? I appreciate it, certainly, though... I worry it might get in the way of Meg's ability to do her job.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I have no such fear for either one of you. You both are dedicated to your tasks. I trust your friendship can withstand your confrontations every now and then. For that is why the friendship blossomed, is it not?

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 很高兴看到你和墨纪拉能够深入了解彼此。而且，我也一直希望你和她能够相处的如此融洽。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我跟墨纪成为朋友，你很开心吧，倪克斯？当然我也很开心，不过……我担心这样会影响墨纪的工作。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我对你们两个都没有这种担忧。你们都会专注于自己的事业。我相信，偶尔发生的摩擦不会影响你们的友谊。毕竟你们也算是不打不相识吧，不是吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx... I ran into Thanatos out there. He aided me, although I think he's rather upset. That I took off like this.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Thanatos is worried for you, child. I hope you understand whatever anger you may sense from him is not the feeling at the source. Please forgive his rudeness.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯……我在外面碰到塔纳托斯了。他帮助了我，但是我觉得他好像有点不开心。然后我就走了。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 塔纳托斯在为你担心，孩子。希望你能理解，不管你感觉他有多恼火，那都不是真正他想表达的。还请原谅他的无礼。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Thanatos has finally come home. Have you not seen him, child? He has been very much preoccupied of late. It must have gladdened him to see you once again.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 塔纳托斯终于回来了。你没看到他吗，孩子？他最近有点忙。再见到你一定让他感到高兴。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You and my son... it pleases me to see the two of you have grown so close of late. Thanatos has always led a solitary life. He never would complain of it, and yet... I know he yearned for closeness, in his way.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Thank you, Nyx. I think we each have harbored feelings for each other for some time. We've finally been true about them.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Then, in this you each achieved what you desired. I ask that you take care of my dear son. I often fear that he shall work himself too hard.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, he's all right. Though, I'll be sure to keep an eye on him.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你和我的儿子……我很高兴看到最近你们俩的关系变得如此亲密。塔纳托斯这孩子向来喜欢独处，而且他也不愿意向别人倾诉自己的寂寞，不过……我知道，他肯定也会通过自己的方式和别人亲近。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 谢谢你，倪克斯。我觉得我和他一直以来都对彼此有感觉，如今我们终于正视了这份感情。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 这样一来，你们都得到了自己想要的了。还请你帮我关照一下我亲爱的儿子。我一直都怕他工作太卖力，累到自己。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，他过得挺好的。不过我会帮你照看他的。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You and my son... it pleases me to see the two of you have grown so close of late. Thanatos has always led a solitary life. He never would complain of it, and yet... I know he yearned for closeness, in his way.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's difficult to find a friend down here. Though, I have always had a trusted one in Thanatos, and he in me. I think we have a better understanding of that now.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Then, may the bonds of your friendship last for as long as this House shall reign beneath the earth, here in the dark. Take care of my dear son.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你和我的儿子……我很高兴看到最近你们俩的关系变得如此亲密。塔纳托斯这孩子向来喜欢独处，而且他也不愿意向别人倾诉自己的寂寞，不过……我知道，他肯定也会通过自己的方式和别人亲近。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 在这种地方能交到朋友真的不容易。不过，我一直以来都很信任塔纳托斯，他对我也一样。我觉得我们现在更加了解彼此了。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 那么，只要圣殿依然统治着冥界，这片黑暗领地，我希望你们的友谊永远不会改变。照顾好我最心爱的儿子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: What is it, child? I sense that your concern is of a different nature than it usually is. Yet, it is veiled to me, somehow.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, it's just.... Please don't take this the wrong way, Nyx, but I was worried you were being rather harsh to Dusa. You asked her not to speak to me, at all?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I asked she mind her own responsibilities. I fear she forgets herself, in this House. Though you have an informal air... you are the Prince! The only son of the Lord Hades, Fate-appointed master of this realm. You shall have the company of gods. Not severed gorgon heads.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Pff! If I'm so important, shouldn't I be the one to choose whom I get to interact with around here?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You do not fully know your place, my child. The gorgon-head most certainly does not know hers. Please focus on your task at hand, and leave her be.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 怎么了，孩子？我感觉到你关心的东西和平时的不大一样。但我还不确定。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，那只是……请您别误解，倪克斯，我只是担忧您对杜莎太苛刻了。您甚至让她别和我说话，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我让她注意自己的职责。我担心她忘记自己在这座圣殿里的身份。虽然你很随和……但再怎么说你也是王子！冥王哈迪斯的独子，命定的这片领地的主宰。你应该多与诸神作伴，而不是和不成器的蛇发女妖。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 切！如果我真的这么重要，连要和谁做朋友都没办法自己做主吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你还没弄清楚自己的身份，我的孩子。蛇发女妖显然也没有认清她的身份。请专心于手上的工作，由她去吧。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You are consorting with the severed gorgon head, my child. Despite my wishes that you maintain respectful distances between yourselves.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: She's my friend, Nyx. Look... I love you very much, you know I do, except... you cannot choose my friends for me! I can't allow that. I know you don't trust her. Don't you trust me?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: ...I do. Then, very well. But understand that your relationship with her does not preclude the need for her continual improvement with respect to her responsibilities.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你又和蛇发女妖厮混了，我的孩子。我希望你和她保持礼貌的距离，你却把我的劝告抛到脑后。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 她是我的朋友，倪克斯。听着……我很爱你，你是知道的，但……你不能为我选择该和谁交朋友！我没办法接受。我知道你不相信她。难道你还信不过我吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: ……我相信你。那好吧。但你要理解，即使你们之间的关系密切，她还是要不断地鞭策自己，善尽自己的职责。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What happened with Dusa, Nyx? You really fired her because she talked to me? She was my friend!

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: She was removed for insubordination, and repeated overextension and lack of proper judgment, child. Your affinity for her is the reason her removal was as amicable as it was.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Insubordination, and repeated lack of what? She worked harder than anyone here to keep the House neat and orderly! I'd thought you would have valued that!

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Her eagerness to please was to a fault. Perhaps your Olympian relatives require sacrifices, child, but this House requires efficiency, and nothing more.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Efficiency... you know who you sound like right now, don't you, Nyx? I can't believe this.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: If you are bent on undermining my authority, go do so someplace else.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 杜莎出了什么事，倪克斯？你真的把她开除了，就因为她和我说话？她是我的朋友！

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 她被开除的理由是，不服从上级、三番五次僭越职权，而且缺乏正确的判断能力，我的孩子。就因为你们之间的关系密切，我们在开除她时并没有为难她。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不服从上级，三番五次还有缺乏什么？为了保持圣殿整洁有序，她比任何人都拼命地工作！我以为你会看到这些！

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 她过于努力地讨好就是错误。也许你在奥林匹斯山的亲戚们需要牺牲供奉，孩子，但这座圣殿只要效率，其他的都不重要。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 效率……你现在的口吻像极了一个人，你知道吗，倪克斯？我简直无法相信。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 如果你执意要削弱我的威信，就不要当着我的面。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx... I'm sorry that I raised my voice with you before, it's just... I cared about Dusa, and I know just how much she cared about working here, with you, and all of us... isn't there some way you would reconsider letting her go?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I appreciate that you have calmed yourself, my child. As for the gorgon head, this House needs steady-tempered vigilance, not unthinking devotion. Despite repeated feedback, she refused to approach any aspect of her duties with restraint.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, you're saying you fired Dusa for working too hard? Did you give her any warning?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: She did not understand how to work properly. Despite all that she did, she ultimately was a burden to this House. There was no warning necessary on my part.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Please give her another chance, Nyx. She can learn, she just needs to know what she did wrong. She gave this work everything. She just pushed too hard. Shouldn't something like that be forgivable?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: ...It seems you have more patience than I, child. And, I did not realize you cared. But do not ask again for me to rescind my decision. Are we understood?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯……我很抱歉之前对着你大呼小叫，只是……我很在乎杜莎，我知道她多想留在这里，和你，和我们在一起……你就不能考虑一下别赶她走吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你能够冷静下来，让我感觉很欣慰，我的孩子。至于蛇发女妖，这座圣殿需要稳重而警觉的性格，而不是盲目的奉献。我曾经多次规劝，但她拒绝以克制的态度履行她的义务。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等一下，你说你是因为她工作太努力而开除她的？你之前有警告过她吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 她不理解如何正确地工作。虽然她做了很多，但最终还是成了这座圣殿的累赘。对于我来说，我没有警告她的义务。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 请再给她一次机会吧，倪克斯。她愿意学习，她只是需要知道自己做错了什么。为了这份工作，她付出了全部。或许是操之过急。这样的她难道不应该被原谅吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: ……你似乎比我有耐心得多了，孩子。而且我不知道你还会在乎别人。但请不要再求我收回已经做出的决定。明白了吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You really asked Dusa to come back. Thank you, Nyx! I'm very grateful. And Megaera. Probably everybody here! I'm sure she won't let you down.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I know you care for her, child. And I admit I retain several concerns. Not only about the appropriateness of her conduct, but of her reckless inexperience. I do, however, see the possibility that she can work through these issues. Perhaps with your support.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你真的让杜莎回来了。谢谢你，倪克斯！我真的很感激，墨纪拉也是，说不定这里的所有人都很感激！我敢肯定她不会让你失望的。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道你很在乎她，孩子。我也得承认，我依然有些担忧，不仅仅担忧她的举止是否得当，还担忧她是否经验不足，行事莽撞。不过，我确实认为她能解决这些问题，或许她需要你的支持吧。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: At first, I was deeply concerned that you were spending so much time with Dusa, child. It seemed unbecoming for the both of you, and threatened to disrupt our custodian's routine. Except... it pleases me to say that, in this case, I was mistaken about you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Thank you for saying so, Nyx. Though, you mean you were mistaken about me, or about Dusa?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I was mistaken about both of you. That you would influence her in a harmful way, yet here, in point of fact, she has performed her duties with increasing skill. That she would fail to perform her role, or to learn well from her mistakes. Please do continue to look out for her.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 起初，我特别担心你花太多时间和杜莎厮混，孩子。这对你们两人来说都不得体，而且可能干扰我们管家的日常工作。不过……我很高兴可以这么说，我误会你们了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 感谢你这么说，倪克斯。你是指误会我了，还是误会杜莎了？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我错怪你们两个人了。以为你会给她造成不好的影响，但事实上她做好了自己该做的事，而且越来越熟练。我还以为她会把工作搞砸，但她会从自己的错误中吸取教训。请你一定要继续留意着她。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Hold, child. I have a message for you from my daughters, themselves. Concerning the Blade of the Underworld in your possession.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, you mean the Fates? And Stygius? I'm honored that they would have taken any notice of me. What is it that they want for me to know?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: They wish for me to impart to you these words, so that your blade, in turn, may hear them uttered from your lips: I see your kingly pardon from a prison of stone. Repeat them, and remember.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I see your kingly pardon from a prison of stone... this must be for one of the weapon's hidden forms. Please tell your daughters I am very grateful, Nyx.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I shall, child. Although, I'm certain they already know. Though, whether they are aiding you or this is simply what must come to pass, I cannot say.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 等一下，孩子。我的几个女儿亲自捎人给我送来一条消息。关于你手上的冥界之刃。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等等，你是说命运女神？还有斯第格思？很荣幸她们会注意到我。她们想和我说什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 她们让我告诉你这句话，然后由你亲自对着冥界之刃说出来：汝在石之监狱得到赦免。重复一遍，然后牢牢记住。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 汝在石之监狱得到赦免……它肯定和武器的隐藏形态有关。请代我感谢你的几个女儿，倪克斯。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我会的，孩子。不过我肯定她们已经知道了。她们是否在帮助你，或者说有些事情注定会发生，我也说不清楚。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx, the words you told me... when I spoke them to Stygius, the blade revealed to me the form of a great leader among men, taking counsel with his loyal retinue about a circular table. But if his reign is inevitable, why would the Fates need me?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: That I cannot say, child. It is peculiar having daughters who know every outcome that shall come to pass. It puts a strain on our relationship, and... I have learned never to ask they tell me more than they are willing to impart.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯，你教我的那句话……当我对斯第格思说出来时，冥界之刃向我显现出万人拥戴的领袖形态，他正坐在圆桌边听取他的忠诚的随扈的建议。如果他的统治是不可避免的，为什么命运女神还需要我呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我也不大清楚，孩子。有女儿能准确预知未来，这种感觉很奇怪。也让我们之间的关系变得紧张，而且……我也学会了不要问太多问题，除非她们自己愿意告诉我。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You... you're... Nyx, you're not my mother. All this time, you and my father, you... you lied to me?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Oh, my dear child! So now you know...? So now you know. But, only half the truth. I can explain the rest, so, please.... It never was my wish to hurt you.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你…你……倪克斯，你不是我母亲。这么长时间以来，你和我父亲，你们…在骗我？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，我亲爱的孩子！你知道了…？看来你知道了。但这只是真相的一部分，我可以给你解释剩下的部分…我并不想伤害你。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey Nyx, I would have you know, I'm now proud owner of my very own Chthonic Companion! You really built them to last. Just... not very many of them, apparently. I'd all but given up on ever finding one.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I sensed this outcome, and it pleases me. Though, you never would have simply discovered such a thing. They each are unique artifacts that must be given willingly if they are to retain their shape, and power.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I have to say, and I do mean this as a compliment: It's hard for me to imagine Night Incarnate herself fashioning these little keepsakes to be given between friends.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Do not mistake them for their unassuming look. Within them is the strength of an unbreaking bond between two souls conjoined.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，倪克斯，我想告诉你，我现在为能够拥有冥界伴偶而感到自豪！它们是你的杰作，而且很靠得住。但……显然数量太少了。我费尽工夫还想再找到一个。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我感觉到了，也让我感到特别欣慰。不过，要找到它们从来就不是一件容易的事。它们每一个都是独一无二的，而且必须经由自愿赠予才能保持它们的形态，和力量。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我不得不说，而且这是一句赞美：真的很难想象黑夜之神会亲自制作这些在朋友之间送来送去的小信物。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 它们虽然其貌不扬，但不要低估它们。它们是两个灵魂之间牢不可破的纽带，蕴含着强大的力量。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx, did you really give Dusa quite possibly the sole surviving epsilon edition Chthonic Companion in the entire Underworld? She's very grateful for it, so much so that she entrusted Fidi to my care. They grow in power that way, right?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: The severed gorgon head is not without redeeming attributes, my child. Though, I expected this companion would soon find its way to you, the way the two of you have grown attached. Thus, in one action, both of you have found encouragement.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯，你真的把据说是整个冥界仅存的艾普西隆级冥界伴偶送给杜莎了吗？她对此感激涕零，甚至把菲迪交给我托管。这样它们的力量就会不断增加，对吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 蛇发女妖也有自己的优点，我的孩子。不过，我希望这个伴偶很快归你所有，毕竟你们两个人走得这么近。这样，你们都会受到鼓舞。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: ...You are not to aid him in these matters, Nyx; his foolishness is to be scorned and reprimanded, not indulged. Do we have an understanding?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: We have an understanding, Hades, yes. He is your own son, after all, and therefore your responsibility. I, in turn, have my commitments to this realm, and to this House. You have aided me in them, so I remain, as ever, in your debt.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: It is not necessary to remind me. Surely all those who once defied my brothers and myself would much prefer a post within my House over eternity within the lowest depths of Tartarus. Not that the darkness there would trouble you.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: …你不应该在这种事上帮助他，倪克斯。你应该对他的愚蠢表示谴责，而不是纵容包庇。我们难道没达成共识？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我们之间确实存在共识，哈迪斯。毕竟他是你的儿子，你也有责任。同样地，我要信守对这片领地，还有这座圣殿所做的承诺。你帮助过我，我还欠着你的人情。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 这个不用你提醒。那些曾经蔑视我和我兄弟们的人，一定愿意呆在这圣殿内，而不是塔耳塔罗斯的深渊里吧。并不是说那里的黑暗会影响你。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: ...It is plain to me that you are helping him; in spite of my insistence you do not. What do you expect that I should do about this, Nyx? What would you do, in my position? Deception, in my very house and home...! Answer me.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Hades, my relationship with him remains unchanged. It is the very same relationship from when you first requested I take care of him. He has my full support, and always shall. You must know this. He wishes now to leave. I shall make no attempt to stop him.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Tsch. What good is any one of you? He's not even your son; and yet you coddle him. You know as well as I that he cannot succeed. You fill his mind with harmful delusions. If that is what you want for him, then, please! Proceed at pace.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: …很明显，你在帮助他。尽管我一再表示不许这样做。你觉得我现在应该怎么做，倪克斯？如果你是我，你会怎么做？在我的圣殿里，欺骗我！回答。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我和他的关系并没有改变，哈迪斯。 我与他的关系，从您第一次要求我照顾他那一刻，保持着一成不变。我给他我的全力支持，永远都会。 您已经知道这一点。 他现在希望离开。 我不会试图阻止他。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 啧，这对你又有什么好处呢？他根本不是你的儿子，而你却如此溺爱他。你和我都很清楚，他不可能做得到。你给他灌输了有害的幻想。如果你就希望他变成这个样子，那请便吧！随便你吧。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Olympus knows of him?! Bestowing on him all their worthless blessings, here, within my realm! Our realm! Explain to me how, exactly, this is possible, Nyx. Either your limitless power has considerably waned, or you are up to something.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Do not question my power, Hades. Your son was bound to be discovered the closer he came to the surface. The Olympians are pleased to know they have a distant relative, and bid him welcome to their mountain. That is all. Their influence is very limited.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Blood and darkness! Do not speak to me about their influence! I've seen their influence firsthand. You've made a foolish mistake.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You would speak to me of foolish mistakes? You cannot change the course that has been set. Try all you like.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 奥林匹斯众神知道了他的存在？！把他们那些没用的祝福赐给了他，这可是我的王国！我们的王国！你得和我说清楚这到底是怎么回事，倪克斯。要么是你无穷无尽的力量弱了很多，要么就是你在打什么主意。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 不要质疑我的能力，哈迪斯。当你的儿子接近地面世界的时候，他就注定会被他们发现。奥林匹斯众神知道有这样一个远亲，他们很高兴，也欢迎他去奥林匹斯山做客，仅此而已。他们的影响力非常有限。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 鲜血与黑暗啊！别和我说什么他们的影响力了！我亲眼见识过他们的影响力，你真是犯了个愚蠢的错误。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你居然说我犯了愚蠢的错误？路线已经设定好了，你是改变不了的。随便你怎么尝试吧。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: What now, Nyx? Do you realize the danger you have put her in? You claim to care for her, but now you threaten to expose her, to them!

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Hades. When have I even once been unaware of precisely what I mean to do? I shall bring no harm to the Queen, and neither shall your son.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Harm to the Queen, wait... what are you talking about?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Child! Zagreus. Do you intend to betray the presence of your birthmother to the Olympians?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No! Of course not. She... seems content to be all on her own.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You take his word for it? How can you trust him not to ruin everything?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Precisely how I trusted him to get us to this point.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 又怎么回事，倪克斯？你意识到你把她置于什么样的危险之中吗？你口口声声说要照顾她，可你现在却要暴露她的行踪，让他们知道！

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 哈迪斯，我有哪次不清楚自己该做什么吗？我是不会让冥后受到任何伤害的，你的儿子也绝不会这么做。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 让冥后受到伤害？等等……你在说什么呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 孩子！扎格列欧斯，你打算出卖你的生母，把她的消息告诉奥林匹斯众神吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不！当然不是了。她……看起来一个人自得其乐。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你居然听他的怂恿？你怎么知道他不会把一切都毁了？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我相信他，因为他就是这样引导我们走到这一步的。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: ...What I attempt to tell you, Nyx, is I am grateful. For our long-standing collaboration, here. My rule was thrust upon you and your kin. By all rights, you ought have undermined my every move. I often thought you would. Yet once Olympus and I severed ties... you stood by me still.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I am the Night Itself, as you well know, Hades. As I declared to you when first we met: I shall stand by your side, so long as you remain the fate-appointed ruler of this realm.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I shall require no additional reminders. Know, in turn, that I shall always oversee this realm to the full extent of my ability.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: ……我想对你说的是，我很感激，倪克斯。我很感激我们之间的长期合作。我之前把规矩强加在了你和你亲戚们的身上。按照你的权利，你应该会尽可能地阻挠我的一举一动，我以前也总以为你会这么做。可当奥林匹斯众神切断了与我的联系时……你依然与我站在同一阵线。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 如你所知，我就是黑夜的化身，哈迪斯。就像我们初次见面的时候，我答应过你的那样：只要命运依然让你担任冥界的统治者，我就永远都会是你的盟友。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你以后不用再提醒我这一点了。我也要告诉你，我将始终尽我所能来管理冥界。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: ...I've done the best I could, preparing him. Though, I am fearful it was not enough. No one ever has escaped this place.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Your expertise has readied him, Achilles. Yet I sense it is your confidence in him which spurs him on. Do not lose faith in yourself now, lest soon he do the same.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: …我已经尽我所能，让他做好准备了。而我怕这还远远不够。从来没有人能逃离这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你的学识让他做好了准备，阿喀琉斯。我感觉到是你对他的信任让他继续前进。不要对自己失去信心，不然他也会跟你一样。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: ...You raised him well, O Night. You know that, I hope? Though, I can't imagine even you could have expected this outcome. Thank you... for making all this possible. For all of us.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You are to thank for this outcome as much as I. Perhaps more so. For I have little choice but to serve this House. I was created in this realm, and it is everything to me. But you? Your loyalty could not have been assumed.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Oh, I don't know. I felt I had no choice, either, except to serve this House. At least at first. But in training the Prince... preparing him... I felt like I was living for something again. As strange as that may sound.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Nevertheless, given the circumstances of your life and servitude, you need not have given so much of yourself. The greatness of your mortal days followed you into death.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: ……你把他养育得很好，黑夜之母，希望你能明白这一点。不过，我觉得，可能连你都没有预料到这样的结果。谢谢你……让这一切变得可能，我代表所有人感谢你。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 这一切也有赖于你，或许你才更值得感谢。因为我没什么别的选择，只能效力于这座圣殿。我是在这里诞生的，这里对我来说就是我的一切。而你呢？你的忠诚无以复加。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，我说不好。我感觉我也没什么别的选择，只能效力于这座圣殿，至少一开始我是这么想的。但在训练王子殿下的过程中……教导他的过程中……我感觉生命似乎又有了意义，这听起来可能很奇怪吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 即便如此，考虑到你的生活环境的繁重的苦役，你也本没必要付出这么多。即便是死后，你也依然保持着生前的伟名。

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: ...I cannot ever repay you for what you have done, O Night. Know only that it is my honor to continue to serve at your pleasure, here.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I am certain I know nothing of what you mean, Achilles. Though, your continued service here is more than welcome. The honor is mine.

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: ……我真不知道该如何报答您的恩情，黑夜女神。能继续在这里侍奉您，这是我的荣耀。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我不太明白你指的是什么，阿喀琉斯。不过你能继续在这里效力，这真是再好不过了。这是我的荣幸。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: ...Persephone, my Queen... it has been far too long. Although, the passing of the time was very kind. It is an honor to see you again.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Oh, please, Nyx! No formalities between us, right? It's wonderful to see you, too, my friend. The days there on the surface, they were very different, but the nights... I was reminded of our times together, here.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Good times, I trust.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Good times, most certainly! I try not to remember the others!

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: We are pleased to have you back. Although, it shall be a difficult adjustment for you once again, I fear. For all of us.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Well, having built a little house all by myself up there, I think I'm up for anything! You know what it's like.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: ……珀尔塞福涅，我的冥后……我们实在是太久没见面了，不过，漫长的岁月似乎对你很是仁慈。能再次见到你，我很荣幸。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 哦，拜托了，倪克斯！咱们就没必要这么客套了，是吧？见到你我也很高兴，我的朋友。在地上世界的那段日子里，白天和这里截然不同，可到了晚上……我总是会想起我们在这里，一起度过的时光。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我相信那是美好的时光。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 都是美好的时光，大部分都是！至于剩下的，我尽量不去回忆！

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 很高兴你能回来。不过我担心，对你而言，这恐怕又会是一次难以接受的变化，对我们所有人而言都是如此。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，我靠自己的力量盖起了一栋小房子，我觉得我什么事情都做得到！你知道这是种什么感觉。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Darkness guide you, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 愿黑暗引导你，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I am preoccupied, so please excuse me, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我有别的事，所以请忍耐一下，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Take care of yourself, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 注意安全，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I shall be watching over you, and our House alike.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我会守护你的，就像我守护这个圣殿一样。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Do not concern yourself about your father. I shall be watching him.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 不用担心你的父亲。我来照看他。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Fear not for Cerberus. He is well taken care of in your absence, and well-fed.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 不用担心刻耳柏洛斯。你不在的时候，有人照顾他，他也不会饿着。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Go, fulfill your purpose, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 去吧，完成自己的目标，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Your fate lies somewhere past these walls, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你的命运就在外面这些墙壁的后面，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You are always welcome in my company, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我永远欢迎你，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Do not despair, and hold to your resolve, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 不要绝望，孩子，坚持下去。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Remember there are those who love you, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 记住那些爱你的人，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Do not let circumstances rattle your resolve, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 别让困境消磨了你的意志，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Thank you for visiting me, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 谢谢你来看我，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Such brief exchanges gladden me, my child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 简短的会面也让我感到高兴，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Your father is the same as ever, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你父亲还和以前一样，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Someday, you shall achieve your heart's desire, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 总有一天，你会做到你心中所想的事，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: The life the Fates apportioned to you lies ahead, my child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 命运之神为你编织的命运就在前方，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: May you discover what you seek, my child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 愿你发现自己所寻找的事物，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I shall keep you safe during your stay here, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你在这里的时候，我会保护你的安全，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I am well, though thank you for your remembering me, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我很好，感谢你还记得我，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I am filled with joy to see you whole, my child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 能见到你真高兴，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Always am I grateful for your company, my child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 有你陪伴很开心，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You are most generous to visit with me, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你能来看我真是太好了，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You look rather well on this occasion, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你看上去状态不错，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: It pleases me having these brief exchanges, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 与你见面让我感到欣慰，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: My faith in you has never faltered, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我永远相信你，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I sense your worry for me, child, yet would seek to disabuse you of the sentiment.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我感觉到你在担心我，孩子，看来我得设法让你打消这个念头。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Though your journeys take you elsewhere, still it pleases me to see you, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 尽管你的旅程将你带到别处，我还是很高兴见到你，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: My focus is on other matters at this time.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我的意志正集中在别的事上。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Please leave me to my current task at hand.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 请让我完成我手上的工作。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Let us communicate again some other time.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 下次再聊吧。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I shall support you however I can, my child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我会尽我所能帮助你，我的孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Through any setback, you are always welcome here with me, dear child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 无论你遇到什么挫折，我这里都永远欢迎你，亲爱的孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: The nature of this realm, my child, is not fully known or understood, not by anyone within it or above.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我的孩子，冥界的本质并不为人所知，也不为人所理解，无论是冥界的人还是冥界以外的人都是如此。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: There is no setback which you cannot overcome.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 这世上没有你无法克服的困难。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: All here is well at present, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 目前一切都很好，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: The House stands strong from all your labors, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你的努力让这座圣殿屹立不倒，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You bring me pride through your accomplishments.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你的成就让我感到无比自豪。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Go, and serve this House.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 去吧，侍奉这座圣殿吧。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: May Thanatos assist you should you cross his path.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 如果遇到塔纳托斯的话，希望他能助你一臂之力。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Remain unseen, my child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 避人耳目，我的孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: The Queen Persephone must be so proud of you.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 珀尔塞福涅皇后肯定为你感到无比骄傲。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Go, in honor of your birthmother, the Queen.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 去吧，以你的生母，冥界皇后的名义。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: This House is stronger with the Queen returned.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 冥后回来之后，这座圣殿变得更加强大了。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Honor the Queen, my child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 荣耀属于冥后，我的孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Your father's spirits have been better as of late.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 最近你父亲也变得更有精神了。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Your birthmother awaits. Go find her, child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你的生母还在等你呢，去找她吧，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Seek out your birthmother again, my child.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 再去寻找你的生母吧，我的孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Persephone awaits above.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 珀尔塞福涅还在上面等着呢。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I know for certain your birthmother waits for you.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我很清楚，你的生母正在等着你。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Go. You know precisely where to find her now.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 去吧，你知道该去哪里找她。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I am afraid I cannot help you now.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 恐怕我现在帮不了你。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You shall discover what you seek when it is time.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 时机合适的时候，你会找到你所找之物。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, Nyx? You've done so much for me, I.. thought you might like this.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You know your father does not like it when Nectar is doled out on the premises, dear child. However, I am not he... and I wished, regardless, to provide to you a token of my affection.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，倪克斯？你为我做了这么多，我……希望这个你能喜欢。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道，你的父亲不喜欢这座圣殿里有人送蜜露当礼物，亲爱的孩子。不过，我可不是他……无论如何，我都希望能把我的爱意送给你。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: How can I possibly accept such generosity, my child? Surely others whom you know are more deserving of such offerings.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nonsense, Nyx. I want you to have it. You've always cared for me. I can't ever repay you for that.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我怎么能接受这样贵重的东西，孩子？一定有其他人配得上你给我的这些。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 胡说，倪克斯。这就是给你的。你一直都很关心我。这我永远报答不完。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Your kindness toward me is unnecessary, child. You know I have no expectation of such gifts, from you or anyone.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I think of you always, Nyx. You raised me as your own, and I am grateful for it.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你这样完全没有必要，孩子。我从没期望你或者任何人能送我这样的礼物。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我永远记得你，倪克斯。你将我当作自己的孩子养大，我很感激。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You honor me, my child; although I dread that I am not deserving of such generosity. There is no need to flatter me like this.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Be that as it may, Nyx! I would still like for you to have it, with my compliments.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我很欣慰，孩子。但我想我还是不能接受这样的礼物。没有必要这样讨好我。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 请不要推脱了，倪克斯！我希望你可以收下这饱含我敬意的礼物。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: No gift which you could bring me can exceed the value of our kinship, child. Though, it moves me to receive this offering.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's nothing, Nyx, really. I know you've always believed in me, and it's not something I ever take for granted.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 任何礼物都比不上你我之间的亲情，孩子。尽管如此，能收到礼物我还是非常感动。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 别介意，倪克斯，真的。我知道你一直相信我，我可不打算把你的信任当做理所当然。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Among my many children, both those born to me and surrogate to me, you are one of the most thoughtful and most generous of all.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You have always cared for me and protected me. And given me someone to look up to. This is nothing, Nyx.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 在我所有的孩子中，无论是我生孕的还是代养的孩子，你都是他们中最体贴和最慷慨的之一。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 您一直关心我，并保护我。给了我一位值得仰望的神。我给您的不算什么，倪克斯。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx, if you'll forgive me this transgression for a moment, I would like for you to have this vintage bottle of Ambrosia, please. You can hand it off to Megaera as contraband, but... just in case, I wanted you to have it, first.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Ah. A crystal bottle come all the way from the highest peaks of Mount Olympus to these depths within the earth. Your father always said he hated it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Though, Father does have questionable taste.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Ah, hahahaha. I accept this gift, with gratitude. This is a delicacy I have not experienced myself. Perhaps I may yet save it for appropriate occasions still to come. Thank you, my child.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯，如果您能暂时原谅我的这种犯罪行为，请容许我献给您这瓶陈年仙馔密酒。您可以将它作为违禁品移交给墨纪拉，但是……这一次，我希望您先拥有它。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 啊。从奥林匹斯山的最高峰一直运到地内深层的冥界，装在水晶瓶里的一瓶仙馔密酒。你父亲总是说他讨厌那味道。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 虽然，父亲大人的品味确实有些可疑。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，哈哈哈哈。那我只好充满感激地接受这份礼物，毕竟这是我没有品尝过的美味。也许我可能会珍存它，以备不时之需。谢谢你，我的孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: By the way, I meant to tell you, child. The Ambrosia that you gave me? Rather than hold onto it indefinitely, I decided recently to sample it. Your father's claims about its flavor are quite false. I have never tasted anything like it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So glad you liked it, Nyx! And, good timing, too, because... I have for you another bottle, here. They say each one is different in its own respect! And besides, the pleasures of Olympus should be shared. Please, take it, won't you?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You are persuasive like your mother, and determined like your father, child. But if you so insist, then I shall not deny myself the simple pleasures of this drink. Though rare is the occasion for it here.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 顺便说一句，孩子，我想告诉你…… 你给我的仙馔密酒？ 与其一直保留着它，我最近决定品尝它一下。 你父亲说它的味道有点不对。 我从来没有尝过这样的东西，挺好的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 您喜欢就好，倪克斯！并且，时刻也不错，因为……我这里又有一瓶给您的。据说每一瓶味道都不一样！此外，奥林匹斯山的美味也应该与大家分享。 拜托，收下，好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你像你母亲一样有说服力，而像你父亲一样坚定，孩子。但是，如果你如此坚持，那么我不会拒绝这种饮料和它带来的简单的快乐。尽管在这里这种享受难得一见。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx, along with giving you this bottle of Ambrosia here, there's something I have meant to say to you. The Three Fates have been very kind to me. Because, in denying me my birthmother... they gave me you. Without your steady presence here, I... can't imagine what it would be like.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Oh. Then, the Three Fates are whimsical, indeed. When you were born, and I was filled with fear for what it meant for you to be alive, to be responsible for you... I must admit I did not guess that, one evening, you would provide for me both such a gift, and such a sentiment.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, I mean every word. I love you, Nyx.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 除了在这里给您这瓶仙馔密酒之外，我还想对您说些话。三位命运女神对我很照顾。因为，让我失去我的生母的同时……她们给我了您。没有您的稳重的母爱在这里，我……无法想象会是什么样。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 哦。那么，三位命运真是性情不定。当你出生时，我充满了恐惧，恐惧你活着的意味，恐惧要对你负责的意义……我必须承认，我没想到会有一天晚上，你会为我献上这样的礼物 ，以及这样的感情。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是么，可我每个词语都是诚意的。 我爱您，倪克斯。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: My greetings to you, child. How unusual that we should come in contact here. Chaos and I had quite a bit of catching up to do. Please go about your business, and I shall see you back inside the House in time. Provided you return there, of course. And, thank you for this, once again.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Nyx_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 你好啊，孩子。很难得我们居然在这里相见。我和卡俄斯还想好好叙叙旧。你先去忙你的事情吧，我们晚点回圣殿再聊。当然，如果你还回去的话。另外，我还想再次感谢你。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Chaos and I have much catching up to do.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Nyx_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 卡俄斯和我许久不见，有很多话。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: How interesting to see you here, my child.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Nyx_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 没想到会在这里见到你，我的孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Please go ahead and do not mind me, child.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Nyx_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 请不要在乎我，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Thank you for keeping Chaos company.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Nyx_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 谢谢你陪伴卡俄斯。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Go forth, bearing the mark of Chaos.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Nyx_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 带着卡俄斯的印记，前进吧。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Chaos and I have so much left to discuss.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Nyx_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 我和卡俄斯还有很多要讨论的事情呢。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: It is comforting to be here again, in such darkness.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Nyx_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 能再次回到这黑暗之中，感觉真舒服。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I shall see you back at the House soon, child.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Nyx_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 到时候咱们在圣殿里见吧，孩子。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: It is odd to have returned to where I was born.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Nyx_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 回到了我诞生的地方，这种感觉真奇怪。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: We are pleased to see you here, however briefly.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Nyx_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 哪怕很短暂，我们也很希望你能来。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: As Chaos cannot visit us as easily, now I can visit them.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Nyx_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 卡俄斯想见我并不容易，但我现在可以来见祂了。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Welcome to the House of Hades, where... wait, I know you! Guess that means you died out there, huh? Well don't be sad, though, pretty much everybody dies sometime!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 欢迎来到冥王圣殿，在这里…等下我认识你！这说明你在外面死过，对吧？不要伤心啦，每个人都会死的！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh! Hi. I'd ask you how it went, but since you're here again, I guess I know already, huh! Oh well, just come on in!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢！你好。本想问问你情况如何，不过既然你又回来了，那我也没什么好问了！噢，来吧来吧进来吧！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Ah, good, you're back already, huh? A few of us, we had a bet, about how long you'd last out there, and I just knew you'd be back in no time!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，很好，你已经回来了嘛？我们有几个人打了个赌，赌你能在外头撑多久。不过我早就知道，你用不了多久就会回来！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, hi! Um, welcome home! Again! Go right ahead! I think your dad's mad about something or other, though.

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨！唔，欢迎回来！又一次！快去前面吧，不过我认为你父亲正在为某些事情抓狂。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Wow, you've died at least five times so far, I think? Dying's good for the whole ecosystem down here, so, uh, thanks! You're helping make the Underworld a better place!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Great! Just keep dying over and over and everything will be fine.

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哇哦，你应该已经死了有五次了吧？死亡对整个生态系统来说是一件好事呢，所以，谢谢你！你在帮助这冥界变得更完善呢！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
