zh-CN.text: 好！你只管死就好啦，事情会越来越好的。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: It's fun watching the Pool of Styx, you know? The ripples in the blood, and everything, and sometimes, somebody pops out of there, like you! House staff and guests of honor, no one else. I sign them in, and help make sure they have a pleasant stay!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 观察冥池还是很有意思的，你知道吗？血和所有一切事物产生的波纹，有时候，会有人跟你一样，从里面浮出来！圣殿内的员工和贵宾，没其他的了。我帮他们入住，然后确定他们享受这个地方！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Ooh, why you made it all the way to Asphodel that time, that's pretty neat! Still died and everything but not as quickly as you used to, so, that's progress, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，你竟然一路通向了水仙花平原，太厉害了！尽管你还是跟以前一样死了又死，不过没那么快了，这也算是种进步吧。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Hey, wow, you did it! According to my list it says here you've died, what, fifty times at least! That's more than anybody's died around here, I think!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，哇哦，你做到了！根据我的记录显示，你已经死了，呃，至少五十次了！你死的次数已经比所有人都多了，我觉得！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Hey, let me be the first to say: Congratulations! You have died a hundred times since I've been keeping score. Since I've been keeping track. No prize for it or anything, but the journey is its own reward, or something, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哎，我要第一个对你说：恭喜！从我开始计数以来，你已经死了一百次啦！我可是一直有在数的噢。虽然我没有奖励给你，不过这旅程本身就是一种奖励，对吧？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: You're not going to believe this, here, you ready? Three.. hundred... times!! That's right! Three hundred times, you've died! That's like... more than an entire village from an earthquake, all on your own!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 我要说的事情恐怕会让你大吃一惊，你准备好了吗？三百……次！！没错！你已经死过三百次了！这就像是……比地震对村子造成的伤亡还多，都是你一个人努力赴死的结果！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, I just can't believe it, although I know my list here never lies! And it says that you have died all of five hundred times! Five hundred!! I can't even think of a number higher than that!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，虽然我明白我的清单绝不会撒谎，可我还是不敢相信！你已经死了五百次了！五百次啊！！我简直想不出来比这更大的数字了！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: It's usually pretty quiet, keeping watch over the Pool of Styx back there. But it's sure been busy lately! Why, somebody else came through just earlier! You should have seen the look on my face when it wasn't you!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 平时在这里看着冥池的时候，通常都很安静。但是很明显最近开始忙起来了！为什么呢，前阵子有人来了！当我发现那不是你的时候，你真得看看我的表情。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Hey, you keep dying! You happen to run into my brother anywhere out there, by any chance? Haven't seen him in ages, what's with the long assignment?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Something about a war. Father sent Thanatos to take stock, but you're right, it's been a while now that you mention it. I guess a lot's occurred down here since then.

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: I'll say! The lounge re-opened, let's see, what else... Anyway! You see my brother out there you tell him we've got everything here under control!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你死了这么多次！在外面的时候有没有碰巧遇到过我的兄弟啊？我已经好多年没有见过他了，真是搞不明白。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是关于一场战争的。父亲派塔纳托斯去查看情况，不过你说得对，确实过了很长时间。我想从那以后应该发生了很多事情。

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊！休息室重新开放，我看看，还有什么…不管怎样！你在外面看到他的话，告诉他，这里的一切都相安无事！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Hey, did you see? My brother, he's come back! He's here! Somewhere, I think! Good old Thanatos. He's so busy all the time, he... never talks to me! Kind of like your dad with you, I guess!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，看到了吗？我的兄弟，他回来了！他来了！老塔纳托斯，他就在这里的某个地方！他一直忙着工作，从来不跟我说话！感觉就像你跟你父亲一样！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Whaa! Oh, hah, you just startled me there, is all, I was just... um... I...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, uh, everything all right, there, Hypnos?

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, absolutely! Everything definitely is. It's just... it's Thanatos. He said some stuff, and... now I'm not so sure I'm doing the best job I can, you know?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm sure he wasn't trying to hurt your feelings. Wait, what am I saying, he's always been harsh with you, hasn't he?

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Hey, what if he doesn't like me anymore? He's got other brothers!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哇啊！哦，哈，你吓了我一大跳。我刚刚只是在……呃……就是……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，呃，一切都还好吧，修普诺斯？

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，当然了！一切都好极了。只是……只是塔纳托斯，他和我说了些话，我……我现在不太确定自己做得到底好不好了，你明白的吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我敢肯定，他不是有意想让你难过的。等等，我在瞎说什么呢，他一直都对你很严苛，不是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，如果他不喜欢我了怎么办？他可还有别的兄弟呢！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh hey! Um, this might be a little weird, but I, uh... thanks! I mean, you talked to Thanatos about me, right? At first I thought he was acting funny. But he has definitely been a lot nicer to me, lately!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Come on, Hypnos, I didn't have anything to do with that. You seem like you've been working extra hard, and taking some of the feedback you've been getting to heart. I think Thanatos really appreciates that sort of thing. Who doesn't?

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: I don't know! But I really appreciate that you went out of your way, I mean... I just stand here and greet and register the dead! But you? You're a real friend!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，嘿！呃，这可能有点奇怪，不过我，呃……谢谢。我是说，你和塔纳托斯聊过我的事情，是吗？一开始我还以为他是在逗我玩呢，不过最近，他对我的态度确实好了不少！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你说笑了，修普诺斯，这件事情和我一点关系都没有。你似乎工作得特别卖力，也因此得到了你想要的答复。我觉得塔纳托斯真的很吃这一套，又有谁不吃呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 我也说不好！但我真的很感谢你费心来帮忙，我是说……我只不过是站在这里，给来这里的死人做做登记罢了！可你呢？你是我真正的朋友！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Hey, there you are! So is it true?! You know, about you and Thanatos? Because he told me, and I just said, whooooaaa, but then, everything made sense?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm sure whatever it is he said is completely true, yes, Hypnos.

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你来啦！所以说，那是真的吗？！我是说，你和塔纳托斯之间的事情？因为他告诉我的时候，我只说了句：哇啊啊啊啊。后来呢？一切都还说得通吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 虽然不知道他是怎么说的，但我敢说都是真的。没错，修普诺斯。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Hey, did you see? Somebody got me this incredible new sleeper-seat right here! Though, I would never lie down while on the job! I'm perfectly all right sleeping while standing up!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨，看见了吗？谁给我在这摆了一把新的、上好的睡椅！但是，我不会上班时躺下嘀！我能稳稳地站着睡！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Hypnos? What would it take for you to let me through the locked door down the hall?

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, hahaha, that's a good one, you know I can't let you enter your dad's private chambers anymore, since you betrayed his trust and tried to run away from home! Sorry, Master's orders!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨，修普诺斯？要怎样才能让我进去大厅那头被锁上的门？

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，哈哈哈，问得好。你也知道，我不能再让你进入你老爸的私人房间了，因为你辜负了他对你的信任，还想着离家出走！很抱歉，这都是大人的命令！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Hey, did you see?! The Queen's come back! Though, did she ever take her sweet time!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey watch it, Hypnos, that's my mother you're talking about!

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: What, really? Huh! So then your mom doesn't spend any time with you, either! We've got something in common!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你看到了吗？！冥后回来了！不过，不知道她到底喜不喜欢这个地方！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，注意点，修普诺斯，你说的那个人可是我的母亲！

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 什么，真的吗？哈！看来，你的母亲也从来没陪过你！咱们这一点上还是挺像的！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Wait, wait, wait, so what's all this about you working here? I thought they fired you, and that was why you left!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hypnos... you think all these times I've died, it's because I was upset I was let go from a miserable job?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 等等，等等，等等，所以说你其实是在这里工作的吗？我还以为他们把你开除了，所以你一气之下才跑了呢！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 修普诺斯……你觉得我死了那么多次是因为我很沮丧，是因为我失去了一份令人讨厌的工作，是吗？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: I heard the feast you had here, it was really something else! All the gods, together in one place, eating, drinking, not killing one another! That must have been a sight.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You should have been there, Hypnos! Not that I noticed your absence, though, what happened? Other pressing business?

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Slept through the whole thing!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 我听说你们在这里举办的盛宴了，那可真是绝了！所有的神都聚在一起，尽情享受美酒美食，不必互相厮杀！那肯定是相当奇妙的一幕吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你当时也应该去才对，修普诺斯！虽然我并没注意到你缺席了，不过发生什么事情了？有更重要的事情要做吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 我一直在呼呼大睡！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Hypnos? This is for all the well-meaning advice you've given me. A little something from a certain double-bladed-axe-wielding, bull-headed, oversized monster of a man who you admire?

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: What's this, it's kind of hard to read the hand-writing, it says, no way... To Hypnos, my biggest fan. Stay vigilant. Asterius. There's... even a little picture of a bull. You... I... wow... wow!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨，修普诺斯？感谢你一直以来给我的好建议。是从你的偶像，一位高大威猛挥舞着双头斧的牛头怪物那里拿到的。

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 这是什么，这手写的字有点不好辨认。上面写着，我的天啊……致我的铁粉修普诺斯，保持警惕，阿斯忒里俄斯。 这上面……竟然还画了头牛。你真是……我……哇哦……哇哦！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Hoh, says here one of the Wretched Thugs got you, too bad! They're slow but they hit pretty hard I guess. Have you tried moving out of the way?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 嚯，看样子你是被暴徒给打败了，不太好！他们应该速度很慢，但是力气很大。你试过躲开攻击吗？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: According to my list here, why, you must've just got clobbered all the way back home by one of those Wretched Thugs again! The old moving-out-the-way trick didn't work, huh...?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 从我这个表单上来看，你应该是又被那些暴徒残魂给揍回来了！看来躲开攻击没什么用，嗯…？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Looks like one of the Wretched Witches shot you dead last time, sorry to hear that, huh? Have you tried shooting them first?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 似乎你是被一个女巫给射死了，真是惨啊。要不要试试先发制人？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: You must have had a run-in with a Spreader, huh! They're much more talented than the low-grade witches down in Tartarus, so your dad lets them stay warm up in Asphodel, I guess!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 你一定遇到了地狱传道者了吧？他们可比塔耳塔罗斯的低级女巫要厉害得多，难怪你老爸让他们留在水仙花平原热身呢！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oof, a Splitter zapped you, didn't she! There's lots of witches in your dad's place, huh? Witchcraft must be pretty dangerous for all those mortals up there. Pretty dangerous for you, too!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢哟，这次是禁忌使者把你干掉了，你老爸地盘上的女巫还真不少呢。上面的凡人肯定扛不住这么危险的巫术，你也一样扛不住！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Aw, looks like you died from one of those nasty booby traps left by a Wretched Pest, little guys who look like urns? Have you tried avoiding them maybe?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，看来你是被害虫的那些令人恶心的陷阱给干掉了吧，那些像罐子似的家伙？也许你要试着避开。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Ooh wow, so Megaera herself got you last time, that must have been intense! She's fast, and strong, and beautiful, and... um... anyway, I hope the Fates are nicer to you next time!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢哇哦，这次是墨纪拉本人把你给打倒了，一定是激烈的战斗吧！她又快又强，又美丽，又…呃，不管怎样，希望命运之神下次能对你好点！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Hah! Megaera the Fury got you again! She is unstoppable, isn't she? One time, I tried to stop her on the way to have a chat with your dad, and she didn't even turn her head! <Sigh...>

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哈！复仇女神墨纪拉又把你打倒啦！她可真是强啊，对不对？有一次，她准备去和你老爸说话，我本打算制止她，可她都没正眼看我！<叹气……>

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: You got whipped by Megaera the Fury! Eh?! I always wanted to say that. Whipped, you know? Referring both to how badly you lost, and to that glowy purple whip she's always threatening me with whenever I try to talk to her?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 你又被复仇女神墨纪拉的鞭子抽倒啦！呃？！我一直想说那个词。鞭子抽，你知道吗？既能形容出你输掉时的惨状，也描绘了她那根经常拿来威胁我、不让我跟她说话的发亮的紫色鞭子。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: So you got skewered by a Spike Trap out there, huh? Well, that's too bad! Have you tried not standing there, like, when the spikes come out?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 看来你让尖刺陷阱给扎穿了？太惨了！下次尖刺出来的时候，你就不要站在上面了，怎么样？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Ooh looks like one of those Dart Traps killed you last time, bet that must have hurt! Have you tried getting behind something?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢看样子这次是中了飞镖陷阱，一定很疼吧！有没有试过躲在什么东西后面？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Ow looks like you got blasted to bits by an explosive urn last time! We keep some really nasty shades all bottled up in those, but... you so much as touch them, BOOM! Hah!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，看来你是被一个爆炸罐子给炸没了！我们会把一些非常凶残的暗灵封印在里面，你如果非要去招惹它们，它们就会砰的一声挣脱出来！哈哈。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Whoaaa, you just got killed by one of those Bloodless Inferno Bomber skeleton type guys, nice! I always wondered what would happen if you just kind of stood around while all their bombs went off!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哇噢噢，你被那些炼狱火药僵尸给干掉了，真好！我一直想知道如果他们的炸弹快爆炸了，你还不跑会发生什么！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Owie, looks like the Bone Hydra of Asphodel just stomped you that time, huh? I hear each of its heads has its own nasty tricks. That must be tough!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噫，看样子是水仙花平原的骸骨九头蛇把你跺没了，是吧？听说它的每一个头都有自己的特点。一定很艰难吧！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Bone Hydra got you again, huh? Real sorry about that. Though, you know what? I want you to get back out there, you know, all through Tartarus, and Asphodel, again, and knock some sense into it for me, OK? OK!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 骸骨九头蛇又把你打败了？真是令人难过呀。不过，你知道吗？我要你原路返回，从塔耳塔罗斯，到水仙花平原那里，把它给我打飞，知道吗？没问题！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Wait let me guess, don't tell me... you got slaughtered by the Bone Hydra, again! How many times was that? But you will get 'em next time, I just know it! Maybe the time after that. Eventually, no doubt about it!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 等等，让我猜一下，别告诉我……你又败给了骸骨九头蛇！这都是第几次了？下回你一定能干掉它们，我相信你！也许下下次。最后，总能行的！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Daw, one of those Wretched Louts just killed you dead that time, those mean old slappy guys? Maybe try killing them beforehand, I don't know!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，那些可怜的呆子残魂把你给打回来啦，那些肥头大耳的家伙？我想你下次应该先把他们给解决了！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Ooh, says here a Wretched Lout slapped you to death again, that's a tough break! Have you tried talking it out, or something, I... I don't know?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，又被呆子给扇死了你，真艰辛啊！有试过和它们说一说……道理吗？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Hey you got turned to ashes by those floating Brimstone crystally type things! Next time one's turning you to charcoal with those beams of theirs, how about you step on over to the side?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你被那些漂浮的硫磺水晶样的东西给整死了吧！下次它们用光线要把你烧成炭的时候，你靠边站一站怎么样？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Ooh, ow, so you got burned down to a crisp out there, standing in magma, right? I know you've got your burning feet and all, but standing in magma, why, I'm not so sure that's a good idea!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，哎哟，你是不是站在岩浆里被烧死了？我知道你可能脚下会生火，但那可是岩浆哎，你要不要好好考虑一下！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Huh, so you walked straight into a burning magma spout, is that what got you this time? Bet if you waited long enough it'd cool off, instead of killing you!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，看样子这次你是直接走到了岩浆喷射口上了，是这样对吧？希望你能等到它冷却，而不是直接走上去送死！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Hooh, looks like one of those little Numbskulls took a big old bite right out of you back there, I guess they got you, huh? Maybe if you weren't quite so tasty, they'd leave you alone! And so would I!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，看来你是被一个小骷髅头给一口咬死了，我猜的没错吧？如果你不是这么好吃的话，它们应该就会放过你了！我也是！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Did you just get chomped by one of those little Numbskulls, again?! Oh, that is definitely rough. I guess you must have done something to make the Fates real mad!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 你又被那些小骷髅头给啃死了？！真是太惨了。我觉得你应该是做了什么事得罪了命运之神！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, hohoh, you got blown up by a Slam-Dancer, I can see it on your face! It also says it on my list! Got everybody's cause of death, right here. Some real morbid stuff from time to time! So anyway, take care!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，嚯嚯，从你脸上就能看出来，你肯定让烟火爆舞僵尸给干掉了！我的表单上就是这么写的，这上面记录了每个人的死因。有时候也能看到一些很奇葩的东西！无论如何，保重！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Why you look like someone who just got beaten silly by a dirty skeleton! Beaten well beyond the brink of death, I ought to say! And, sure enough, according to my list, you did! Those Bloodless sure are tough!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 你看上去像是刚被一个脏骷髅给打傻了一样！感觉已经不是仅仅被打死那么简单了，不得不说！不管怎样，从我的表单上看，你确实死了！这些无血僵尸可真厉害！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: My list here says that you got petrified to death that time by some sort of nasty floating gorgon head? No offense to Dusa! Sounds like a pretty painful way to go, though hey! At least you got to be a statue for a little while! I like statues.

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 根据表单所示，你当时应该是被某个漂浮的蛇发女妖的头给石化了，我不是说杜莎！听起来是个很痛苦的死法！不过，起码你变成了一座雕像呢！我最喜欢雕像了。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Pff, can I just say ouch? Because according to the list here, you got flattened like a pancake by a Skull-Crusher, out in Asphodel somewhere! Keep that up and you're going to get even shorter, haha!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哎哟，我只能说挺疼的吧？因为根据表单来看，你是在水仙花平原被碎骨坦克给碾成了一摊烂泥！继续努力，这样你就可以变得更矮了，哈哈！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Mmm, you look like someone who just got turned to stone then crushed to a bloody pulp by the Megagorgon of Asphodel, am I right? Well, look, I'm sorry to hear that, and before you ask, I won't tell Dusa, don't you worry about that!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，你好像是在水仙花平原先被巨型蛇发女妖石化，然后被碾成一摊血泥了，对不对？很抱歉你死得这么惨，不过没事，我不会告诉杜莎的，这点你不用担心！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, I recognize that look! That is the look of someone who just got here after having met a most unfortunate demise, courtesy of the notorious Bloodless Wave-Makers!! How do they make those waves, and why do they hurt so, so much? Plenty of time to think it over, now!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，我认得这张脸！这张脸的主人表示自己刚刚惨遭可恶的暗波投手僵尸的杀害。他们是怎么制造那些诡异波浪的，为什么会这么，这么疼？有时间可以去想想这个问题！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Looks like you really took the heat from one of those Bloodless Burn-Flingers back there, didn't you? I know how tempting it can be to try and catch those fiery explosive bombs they throw, but... if I might offer you a bit of personal advice? You really shouldn't do that.

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 看来你让烈焰投手僵尸烧得够呛啊，是不是？我知道你非常想接住他们扔的那些热得发烫的炸弹，但是……我想在这里给你提个建议。不要去接。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, wow, Alecto's got it out for you...? Normally she doesn't kill anyone, she likes keeping them alive... for quite a while, really. Hurts them still, but doesn't kill them off! I guess she really doesn't like you, huh!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，哇哦，阿勒克图把你杀了…？一般来说她不会去杀人，她只是…喜欢让他们活一段时间。慢慢折磨他们！而不是直接杀死。看来她是真的一点都不想见到你！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: If you got killed by Tisiphone the Fury, why, then it must mean you've been accused of murder! A most heinous crime, as I'm to understand! Well, I hope you clear your name. Or whatever those mortals do about that stuff!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 如果你被复仇女神提西福涅杀死了，这肯定说明你生前是个杀人犯！以我来看，这是最令人发指的罪行！嗯，希望你能证明自己的清白。反正跟凡人一样做就行了！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: So, you lost a duel to the death with an Exalted Brightsword, did you? They're pretty much the best of the best, so don't feel bad! It had to happen! But if it's any consolation, it'll probably happen again!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 看来你跟高级光明剑士的决斗是落败了，对吗？你不用难过，他们确实非常厉害。这事没法避免！如果说有什么能安慰你的话，那就是这事肯定会再发生的！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Says here that you got stuck like a piece of meat on a spit by an Exalted Longspear, wow, I'll bet that really hurt! Too bad you don't have a thick, leathery hide or something that could help protect you in that type of situation. Oh well!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 如果你像一块叉子上的肉一样被高级长矛手顶在半空，哇噢，我只能说，那应该非常疼吧！真可惜你没有厚皮革之类的可以保护你不被捅穿的东西。噢！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Looks like you just got pounded down by an Exalted Greatshield, huh? Did you try attacking while their guard was down? Or, did they just not let down their guard at any point... Oh...

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 看来你被高级护盾兵给揍了一顿。你可以趁他们放松警惕的时候去攻击他们。还是说，他们从来不会放松警惕？...噢…

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Let me guess, you got caught out by one of those Exalted Strongbows, did you there? Next time, if you don't stand around like you're doing here right now, maybe you won't make such an easy target!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜猜，你被那些高级强弓手给逮着了，对吧？下次，如果你能别跟现在这样站着不动，也许他们就很难射中你了！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: My understanding is you had a little run-in with a Nemean Chariot, just kind of plowed right into you, there, didn't it? You got to watch where you're going crossing the streets of Elysium next time!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 我的理解是，你一定遇到了一辆尼米亚战车，像犁地一样从你身上碾过去了，对不对？下次在至福乐土过马路的时候千万要注意安全！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Those Archer Statues in Elysium have got to be a real sight, no doubt about it. But, you can't just stand there and admire them, or else they'll shoot you dead like they did just now!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 至福乐土那些弓箭手雕像射得还挺准的，没得说。如果你不像个傻子似的在那里站着不动，也许他们就没有机会把你射成筛子了！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Sounds to me like you got stuck in more ways than one gawking at a Phalanx Statue in Elysium back there! I got to hand it to your dad. He made sure those look just as good as they stab any intruders like yourself!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 我听说，你好像被至福乐土的那些阵雕像收拾得挺惨的啊！这件事我向你老爸汇报过了。他说这些东西对付入侵者很管用，收拾你也一样很管用！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Says here that you got flash-fried to a crisp within a Phoenix Urn's destructive blast back there, I mean, you really ought to stay away from those, if you ask me!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 这里说你被一个凤凰罐的毁灭冲击波给烧成了焦炭，要我说，你怎么就不会躲开这些东西呢！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Woow, I can't believe you took on the Minotaur, no way! No wonder you're back here! Everyone knows that he's unstoppable. Especially me! Hey, next you run into him, could you... get his autograph, for me?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哇噢，真不敢相信你跟弥诺陶干上了！难怪你回来了！谁都知道没人能打得过他，我知道得最清楚了！哎，下次你……再见到他的时候，能不能帮我弄一份他的签名？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: The Minotaur killed you again, that must have been exciting, huh? So, any chance you got that autograph for me, before you got destroyed?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 你又被弥诺陶杀了，一定很刺激对不对？在你被杀死之前，能有机会帮我弄一份签名吗？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Slain by the Minotaur once more, now he's a real beast, there, isn't he! But, tell me something, any progress on that autograph request of mine?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 又被弥诺陶杀了一次，他可真是太猛了啊！不过，话说回来，签名那件事情，有进展吗？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, I just knew that you'd be back, soon as I heard you faced the Champion of Elysium, himself! You know, I've heard that, among mortals, it's an honor to be killed by somebody like Theseus! Keep it up, and maybe you'll be famous, too!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，我刚想着你会回来呢，我听说你跟至福乐土的最强战士对上了！我从凡人那里听说的，说被忒修斯那样的人杀死是一种荣誉！继续吧，总有一天你也会出名的！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Look, I have to say, I just don't think you have a real chance against both Theseus and the Minotaur, together! But, you might just have a chance to get the Minotaur's autograph for me, if maybe you ask nice or something?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 听我说，我真的不认为你可以同时战胜忒修斯和弥诺陶！不过，如果你好好跟弥诺陶说的话，说不定能有机会帮我弄到他的签名呢。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Good, you're back! So, prior to when Theseus killed you again back there, did you, by any chance, happen to ask his big bull buddy for an autograph for me, this time?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 太好了，你回来了！这次被忒修斯杀死之前，有没有帮我问一下他那位牛头朋友签名的事啊？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Looks like somebody just found out that some types of butterflies are incredibly dangerous! Especially the ones that come swarming out of those Soul Catchers! If only you could just... not have a soul, or something? Then they'd bother somebody else!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 看来有人终于弄明白有些种类的蝴蝶真的非常危险呢！特别是那些倾巢而出的捉魂魔法球！如果你…一点灵魂都没有的话。它们应该就不会缠着你啦！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: So, one of those Flame Wheels drove right into you, and burst into a fiery explosion, killing both of you, is that what happened there? Well if it makes you feel any better, technically, I think this means you got your revenge!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 所以，一个火焰战车撞上你然后发生爆炸，把你俩双双炸上了天，我说的没错吧？其实吧，你这样也算是报了仇了，这样想的话你应该会好受点！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: You had a run-in with those nasty Satyrs all the way up in the Temple of Styx, huh. I can't even imagine the sheer agony, having their lethal poison coursing through my body!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 看来你在冥河神庙里遇到了那些丑恶的萨提尔了。中了它们的致命毒液后，那种极致的痛苦我是真的不敢想象！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: You know, I've only heard the tales of the gigantic, vicious, flesh-eating vermin up there near the surface. Now I guess we both know that those tales are definitely true!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 那些出没于凡界附近凶恶吃人的巨大鼠兽，我只在传说故事里听过。现在我们都知道了，这些东西都是真实存在的！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Eugh, it says here you got chewed up by an angry swarm of Crawlers somewhere just a stone's throw from the exit to your dad's domain? Talk about adding insult to injury, huh?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哎哟哟，这上面说你才刚走出你老爸的地盘没多远，就被一群愤怒的爬虫给活吞了。这可真是又痛苦，又丢人啊！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, I heard the pests of Tartarus had bigger, meaner counterparts up near the surface, but... I guess you just found out the hard way, huh? When you tripped one of their explosive things?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，我听说塔耳塔罗斯的鼠兽在接近凡界的地方有更大更凶残的品种，不过……你应该已经知道了吧！在你被那些爆炸物绊到的时候？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: I know that look, why, that's the look of someone just incinerated by a Snakestone, am I right? They spit a whole bunch of those white-hot, flesh-burning beams right at the same time, there, don't they?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 你这副表情一看就知道是被蛇石给烧死了，对不对？它们会同时朝你射出那种炙热的光线，对不对？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Hey, you're back! Wait, wait, what happened? My list says you got killed by a Redacted, what's that even mean? I've never seen anything like this!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨，你回来啦！等下，等下，发生了什么？表单上说你被莱德艾克杀死了，那是什么东西噢？我连听都没听过！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Redacteds got you again, huh. Here's the thing, I keep asking around about them and no one seems to know what I'm talking about! Could you maybe describe them for me, please?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 你又被莱德艾克干掉了。是这样的，我四处打听了一下这些东西的消息，看来没人知道我在说什么！你能给我形容一下吗？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Huh, that's funny. Nothing on my list at all this time, except... I could have sworn I saw you walk right out of the Pool back there. I'll have to have this thing looked at.

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，有意思。这回我表单上什么都没有，但是…我敢发誓我看到你从那个池子里走出来了。我得好好研究一下。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: The list is telling me you caught one of those gigantic Temple saw blades square in the chest, huh? Eugh... At least you're back in one piece!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 表单上说你撞到了神庙上的巨大锯片，然后死了。呃…起码你没缺胳膊少腿！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: What's the matter, there, you got a splitting headache from those giant falling axes in the Temple of Styx? Well I have just the cure, which is: Don't get hit by them!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 怎么了？冥河神庙里那些巨大的落斧让你头疼欲裂了吗？我这正好有解药：躲开这些东西！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Well somebody just walked into a cloud of noxious gas, there, huh! Must have lost all your vital functions pretty quickly after that! Next time, you'll know it's seriously deadly stuff, because it killed you! And because it's green!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 看样子有人走进了一团毒气当中！你一定没多久就当场毙命了吧！下次你就知道了，这玩意能杀人！因为它是绿色的！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: So, you just plain ran out of time and died, all according to the Pact of Punishment, there, huh? Now that is what I call a deadline, hahahaha!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 所以，按照《惩罚契约》的说法，你用尽了时间然后死了，是这样吗？这就是我所说的死亡期限，哈哈哈哈！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Why, says here you just blew yourself right up that time, with that weird infernal shooty thing you stole? Remember, next time, shoot the other guys!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 什么？这上面说你刚刚把你自己炸了，用你偷到的那个奇怪的地狱发射器什么的？记住啦，下一次要对着其他人发射！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Whoa, wait wait wait, this just can't be right, it says, it says... hahahahah, you got beaten by a tiny little rodent? Oh, haha, sorry I just, I, you have my sympathies.

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哇噢……等等……等等，这不对吧，这上面说……哈哈哈哈，你让一只小老鼠给打败啦？噢，哈哈，不好意思……我……对此深表同情。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Wait, what, you're back already? Hey, my list says that you barely made it out of here before you died! Were you even trying? Because if you were, why, maybe you need to try a whole lot harder than that next time!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 等等，什么？这么快你就回来了？清单上说，你死前差点就逃出去了！你有认真对待吗？如果有的话，那你下回可得多多努力才行哦！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, you got throttled by a Wringer, must have grabbed and crushed you like a grape! You know what grapes are, right? They're like big, squishy pomegranate seeds.

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哎哟，你被碾碎者给弄死了，它肯定是像碾葡萄一样把你碾碎了吧！你知道葡萄是什么吧？葡萄就像是又大又多汁的石榴籽一样。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Ah, looks like you ran smack into the Doomstone out in Tartarus, thing gives me the creeps! Next time, try standing perfectly still. That way, it'll all be over that much faster!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哎哟，看起来你像是被塔耳塔罗斯的末日巨岩给撞扁了啊，那东西真的让我不寒而栗！下次的时候你还是站着别动好了，这样至少会死得痛快不少！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Hey, you're the latest victim of a Wretched Sneak, that's something, right? They like to get you when you least expect it, so next time, why not keep spinning around and around? Then you'll catch them trying to sneak up!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你也成了邪恶伏击者的刀下之鬼了。那家伙真的挺厉害的，是吧？他们会趁你大意的时候突然袭击。所以下次的话，不如一直原地转圈吧？这样你就能发现他们了！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: So, let me guess, one minute you were minding your own business out in Asphodel, and then the next, one of those Dracons pops up right in front of you and pfeh! Just kills you dead with noxious acid breath. Ah, well! It happens, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜猜看吧。前一秒钟，你还在水仙花平原上忙自己的事情，下一秒钟，毒蛇突然窜到了你脸上，然后，噗！它们剧毒的酸雾一下就把你毒死了。啊，这种事情难免发生，是吧？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Going toe-to-toe with one of those Bloodless Bone-Rakers didn't go so well, huh? Next time they're ripping you to shreds, remember: That's your signal to be someplace else, instead!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 你打算和那些无血僵尸们硬碰硬，结果不太顺利，没错吧？记住：如果你下次再被它们撕成碎片，这说明你应该去别的地方晃荡了。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Wow, you just barged into the Witches Circle out in Asphodel, and they just filled you full of all those stinging purple orbs and killed you, huh? You can't just show up expecting to join their club! You have to study witchcraft for years!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哎哟，你是不是撞上了水仙花平原的女巫们了？她们拿那种紫色的刺球让你吃不了兜着走，于是你就这么死了，是吧？你可不能就这么大大咧咧地过去，加入她们的行列！你得先花上很多年的时间学习巫术才行！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Hey, my brother Charon killed you, am I seeing this right? He's never been particularly nice to me! Whacked me with his oar a couple times, but it never got that bad. Must be some misunderstanding, have you talked to him?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，我的兄弟卡戎把你杀了，我没看错吧？他对我也一直都不怎么好！他也拿桨揍过我好几次，但当时的情况可没那么惨烈。你们肯定是出了什么误会吧？你和他谈过了吗？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: You had it out with Charon again, huh? And turned out like it did before! The thing you have to understand is he's got lots of upper body strength. You seen the definition in his arms? Maybe try some rowing for yourself!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 你又跟卡戎打起来了，对不对？结果和上次一模一样，是吧！有件事你得弄清楚，他的胳膊可相当有劲儿。你看到他胳膊上的腱子肉了吧？或许你也应该划划船，练练肌肉才对！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: So you met a violent end aboard the infamous Barge of Death sailing the river of flame! Surrounded by skeletons bleeding you dry, Voidstones making all of them invincible...! Have you thought about taking a different barge?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 你登上了火焰之河那艘臭名昭著的死亡之舟，结果却不幸横死舟上！你被骷髅团团包围，虚无宝石的力量让它们刀枪不入，你力竭而死……！你就没想过上另外一艘船试试吗？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Whoa, what happened to you, you just... died? You just plain died, like... nothing stabbed you, bludgeoned you, poisoned you, burned you, crushed you, blew you to bits, turned you to stone, but... you're back here! Must have been those Natural Causes mortals talk about!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哇啊，怎么回事，你刚刚是……死了吗？你就那么死了？我是说……没人用刀捅你，用拳头砸你，用药毒你，用火烧你，把你碾碎，把你炸成碎片，把你变成石头，可……你却回来了！这肯定就是凡人们常说的寿终正寝了吧！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Natural Causes got you again, huh? That's a real shame, I mean, imagine one day you're just going about your business, and then ack!! You're dead! Although I guess you don't have to imagine it like I do!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 你又寿终正寝了吗？这可真让人感到遗憾啊，我是说，想象一下，你正准备去忙自己的事情，结果哎哟！你就死了！不过我猜，这种事情只有我才需要想象，你是不需要的！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Darned Natural Causes got you once again, there, didn't they? Well, you show them next time! Would you do that for me, huh?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 该死的寿终正寝又把你害死了，是吧？好吧，你下次一定要让它尝尝厉害！可以替我教训它一顿吗，嗯？

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: ...You're late with your report, Hypnos. Again. Again! The dead of course can wait, but I'm less patient. Now, explain yourself to me.

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh! Well, let's see, I woke up, I don't know what time it was, and I made sure that every shade had been accounted for, just like I always do, except I couldn't find my list at first, can you believe it? I thought maybe my brother played a little prank, and so...

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Get to the blasted point already, I don't have all day! Or night. Urgh! Your report, where is it?

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Sure I was just getting to it, Master! My list, I found it over by the lounge, it was inside, but I am not the one who put it there, no sir! So I've been making positively sure it's not been tampered with, that it has everybody's name, cause of death, place of birth, former body weight, any previous allergies or medications...

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Enough!! Blood and darkness, that's enough from you, just... see to it the ledger of the dead is accurate, and get back to your post. Ugh, would that you could be more like your brother.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: …你报告迟了，修普诺斯。又迟了。又迟了！死人可以等，但是我没那么有耐心。现在解释一下吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢！嗯，你看啊，我醒的时候，不知道是几点，不过我可以肯定跟往常一样，每个暗灵我都记录在案了。只是找不到我的表单了，你敢信吗？我还以为是我兄弟在整我，所以我就…

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 给我说重点，我没空听你的流水账！说重点。啊！你的报告呢，哪儿去了？

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 马上就到重点，大人！我在休息室看到了我的表单，在里头，但绝对不是我放进去的，不可能！然后我就要保证表单没有被人乱涂乱画，那上面记着每个人的名字，死亡原因，出生地，生前体重，有无任何过敏史或者用药…

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 别说了！！血与黑暗啊，你不准再说了，你…确保你的死亡表单没有问题你就回自己的岗位去吧。啊，真希望你能像你兄弟一样。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: ...Your reports have been much more punctual of late, Hypnos. That is to be expected. However... the illustrated edges... a clever detail. Ensures certain reports are easily procured from a stack of parchment.

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, thanks, Master, glad you like those! Ever since Thanatos made pretty clear to me I was about to lose my job, I started keeping a list of my own tasks, which I sort through each day, deciding on priority, estimating time to completion, cost-benefit analysis...

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Yes, well. Certainly, then, you have a number of such tasks requiring your attention. Continue working diligently, then.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: ……你的报告最近变得准时多了，修普诺斯，这一点很值得期待。不过……画着插图的页缘……这个细节很巧妙，可以确保某些报告从一大叠羊皮纸中一眼就能找得到。

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，谢谢你，主人，很高兴你喜欢！自从塔纳托斯信誓旦旦地说我马上就要被炒掉之后，我就开始按我自己的任务列表做事情了。我每天都会对这些任务进行排序，确定优先级，估算完成时间，进行成本效益分析……

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，没错，当然了。你还有很多诸如此类的任务需要留意呢，那就继续努力工作吧。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Master, I just can't thank you enough for putting my picture on the board there in the lounge! I heard it's a good picture! I haven't had time to see it yet, but I am going to, it's on the list!

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Hypnos... that shall be all. Lest I rescind your commendation and cast you out of here.

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: ....Um, could you say all that again with smaller words, Master, because I thought it maybe sounded kind of bad?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 主人，你把我的画像摆在了休息室里，我真不知道该怎么感谢你才好！我听说那张画像画得很棒！我还没亲眼见过呢，不过我真打算去看看，这件事已经列在清单里了！

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 修普诺斯……别再说了，省得我取消对你的嘉奖，把你从这里赶出去。

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: ……呃，你可以用小一点的字体把这句话再说一次吗，主人？因为这听起来像是在 生气。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: ...I just get sleepy, sometimes, Mom, I mean, I've been working so much, lately, just over there? You've probably seen me, greeting shades, making my list, creating a welcoming environment...

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Remember what we previously spoke of, Hypnos. Do not address me thus whilst we are here. Conduct yourself as befitting a servant of the House of Hades... and, continue practicing your independence, please.

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: ……有时候我觉得很困，妈妈。我是说，我最近一直都工作得很努力，是吧？或许你已经见过我接待幽灵、整理清单、营造快乐氛围的样子了……

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 要记得我和你之前说过的话，修普诺斯。在这里的时候，不要叫我妈妈，要把自己当做冥王圣殿的仆人，举止要得体……而且，你得努力变得独当一面才行，拜托了。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You have demonstrated sustained competence in your duties, Hypnos. It gladdens me to see measurable progress. Your efforts are to be commended.

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Aw, wow, thanks! Commended by whom, exactly? Megaera? Thanatos? Dusa, maybe! Not the Master himself?!

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Commended by me. I cannot always look after all of my children, as you know. It falls upon them to take care of themselves, as well as their obligations to our domain. As your mother... it is reassuring to see that you are capable.

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Capable? Me? Aw, Mom... I mean, um, Mother Nyx! Nobody's ever called me that before!

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You are my son. It is to be expected. However... I know it is not effortless, to be of use. Continue to do well. I shall be watching.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你在工作中表现出了长久稳定的才能，修普诺斯。看到你有了这么大的进步，我真的很高兴。你的努力值得表扬。

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，哇哦，谢谢！是谁要表扬我？墨纪拉吗？塔纳托斯吗？说不定是杜莎！该不会是冥王大人本人吧？！

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 是我要表扬你。你也知道，我没办法总有经历照顾好我所有的孩子，他们必须照顾好自己，做好他们应尽的义务。身为你的母亲……看到你这么能干，我真的很欣慰。

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 能干？是我吗？啊，妈妈……我是说，倪克斯！以前从来没有人夸过我能干！

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你是我的孩子，你肯定是个能干的人。不过……我知道这绝非易事。继续努力吧，我会看着你的。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: ...And if you ever need anything at all, Your Royalness, you can always find me wide awake, right over there! Though I really shouldn't leave my post like this! Not even for you!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: ……如果您需要什么的话，冥后殿下，可以随时来这里找我，我随时愿意效力！不过，我确实不应该像这样擅离职守！就算是为了您，也不应该！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Welcome to the House of Hades! Glory in Death!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 欢迎来到冥王圣殿！死得其所！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Welcome to the House of Hades, where death is our life!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 欢迎来到冥王圣殿，死亡即生活！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Welcome to the House of Hades, where death is our business!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 欢迎来到冥王圣殿，死亡即事业！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Welcome to the House of Hades, and thanks for dying!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 欢迎来到冥王圣殿，感谢您的死亡！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Just keeping watch over the Pool of Styx, there, same as always!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 我就像往常一样，看着冥池！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: They won't catch me sleeping on the job again!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 我不会再让他们抓到我上班睡觉了！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, hey, I didn't see you come in, um... welcome back!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，嗨，我没看到你回来了。呃……欢迎回家！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Whoa, I guess you must have died out there again, huh.

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哇噢，你应该是又在外头死了一次吧。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, whoa, you're back already, that's too bad!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，这么快就回来了，真可惜！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, hi, um, you're welcome! Just, go right ahead, I guess!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，你好，呃，欢迎你！直接往前走就好了！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Um, I was just resting my eyes... you won't tell anybody, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，我只是闭目养神一下…你不会告诉其他人吧？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Well, you know what they say: There is no escape!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道他们怎么说的：没人逃得出去！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Hey, you look like you could use some sleep!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 你看上去急需睡上一觉！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, it's you, just, come on in, you're on the list!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，是你，进来吧，你在表单上呢！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: You're back, huh? That was pretty soon I guess!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 你回来了啊？这有点快了！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: You must be pretty used to dying like this, huh?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 你一定习惯死亡了吧？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: The Fates are pretty mean to keep on doing this to you!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 命运之神真的对你有点不太好呢。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Thanks for dying, nice to see you here again!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 感谢你的死亡，真高兴又在这里见到你！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Go right ahead, I'll get you all signed in!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 请往前走，我会帮你们登记的！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Good thing you're basically immortal, huh?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 好在你基本上是死不了的，是吧？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Guess you're here to stay, hah-ha!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 看来你得留下来了，哈哈！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: There's always next time, isn't there?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 总有下一次的，对吧？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: How's my best friend doing, huh?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 最近还好吗，我最好的朋友？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: You'll get them next time, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 你下次一定能行的，是吧？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Don't let me keep you, huh?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 我就不耽误你了，好吧？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Signed you in, you're good to go!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 我已经登记过了，你可以走了！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: I like having a best friend!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 我喜欢有好朋友的感觉！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Glad you died so I could talk to you!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 幸好你死了，这样我就能和你聊聊天了。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Nice to have a heart-to-heart like this, you know?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 能这样推心置腹地聊聊真的很好，你说呢？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: See you next time you die, OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 等你下次死的时候再见吧？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Hope you enjoy your stay!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 希望你在这里住得开心！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: I've got a survey here if you'd like to fill it out?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 我有个问卷，愿不愿意填一下？

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Welcome to the House of Hades! Just come on in!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 欢迎来到冥王圣殿！快进来吧！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Welcome to the House of... oh, you know!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 欢迎来到冥王……哦，你知道我要说什么！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Welcome back to our most frequent guest!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 欢迎我们最常光临此地的客人！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: I want you to go out there, and die some other way!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 我希望你能从这里出去，试试新的死法！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: There's no escape, in case you hadn't heard!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 没人能逃出这里，我多说一遍，怕你没听清楚！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: You can do this! Whatever it is you're doing!

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 你一定能做得到！无论你在做什么！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Surprise, Hypnos! I got you this.

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Whoa whoa whoa you can't bring that in here! Hah, just kidding, thanks! But wait, I'll trade you, look!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 惊喜，修普诺斯！我给你带了这个。

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哇哇哇噢这个东西可不行！哈，我开玩笑呢，谢谢你啦！等等，我也有东西给你，看！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh! Wow! Thanks! This is real nice of you, hah! I sure am glad you died out there just now!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm glad I died, as well, Hypnos! I'm glad I died, as well.

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢！哇噢！谢谢！你真的太好了，哈！真高兴你又死在外头了！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我也很高兴我死了，修普诺斯！我也很高兴我死了。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Ah, neat! Huh, thanks!! It's not so bad that you keep coming back like this, is it? At least for me it isn't!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm getting used to it. Though I don't think I'd feel particularly welcome anymore if not for you, Hypnos.

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，真好，呃，谢谢啦！你如果一直这样回来，倒也不错……对我来说是这样！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我已经习惯了。不过如果不是你的话，我也不会觉得自己受到了欢迎，修普诺斯。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Whoaaa you must've really gotten pretty far out there if you could get me one of these, so, wow! And thanks for stopping by!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You lighten up my numerous untimely deaths, Hypnos.

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哇噢噢，你一定走了很远的路才能给我弄到这个，哇噢，谢谢你来跟我说话！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 在这么多次无奈的死亡中，是你让我有了一丝慰藉，修普诺斯。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Hah, well this is like a dream come true! I mean, how come you're always being so darn nice to me? But anyway, um, thanks!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sure thing, Hypnos! Knock yourself out.

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哈，这真的就像美梦成真一样，我是说，为什么你总是对我这么好呢？不过还是得说，呃，谢谢你！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没事，修普诺斯！别客气。

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh you are just the best, I bet you died on purpose just to get this back to me, didn't you! Didn't you?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I have a secret, Hypnos. I've died on purpose every single time, just to see you.

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 你真是太棒了，你该不会是为了把这个给我专门去送死的吧！是不是啊？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我有个秘密，修普诺斯。我每次送死都是为了来见你。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hypnos, wanted to say you have really helped the thought of my coming back here time after time, painful death by death, not be inherently abhorrent. Your greetings really help! So I wanted you to have this.

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: But, but, but, wait, this, it's Ambrosia! You are not supposed to have this here! We could both get in a lot of trouble, and I mean a lot, if they catch us in the middle of this totally forbidden exchange!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I notice that you haven't yet returned the bottle to me, which I'm going to take as an indication that you're going to hang onto it.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 修普诺斯，我只想说，我一次一次痛苦地死亡，一次一次回到这里。虽然我不一定讨厌这种安排，但你帮了我不少忙，你的问候真的起了不少作用！所以，我希望你能收下这个。

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 可是，可是，可是，等等，这不是仙馔密酒嘛！这东西怎么会在冥界！如果他们发现我们搞这样的私下交易的话，我们两个肯定会有大麻烦的，我是说，天大的麻烦！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 话虽这么说，我发现你并没有把那瓶酒还给我，那我就当你打算收下它了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: One more forbidden exchange, Hypnos. Sometimes when I'm out there and about to die, I catch myself thinking... well, at least Hypnos will share one of his deep insights about why it is I utterly failed. So here! For all your generous advice.

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Aww, I... feel like I am going to cry, I mean, all my advice is free! You really didn't have to do this. But I sure am glad you did! Even if it is highly illegal! I... I... I...!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You what, Hypnos? You what?

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: ...I think you could be my best friend! Have you... tried being my best friend?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 又到私下交易的时间了，修普诺斯。有的时候，当我奄奄一息的时候， 我不禁会想……至少修普诺斯会告诉我失败的原因。所以，收下这份礼物吧！感谢你慷慨的建议。

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 啊哦哦，我……我简直要哭了。我是说，我那些建议都是免费的，你真没必要这么破费！不过收到你的礼物，我真的很开心！哪怕这是严重违规的行为也好！我……我……我……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你怎么了，修普诺斯？你想说什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: ……我觉得你可以成为我最好的朋友！你有没有想过要……成为我最好的朋友？

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Go about your business, Zag. What if Lord Hades saw us chatting like this, now...? I risked everything by helping you out there, and still you failed.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Turns out there's quite a lot of dead to fight down in the Underworld. Though I probably got farther than I would have, thanks to you.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Always happy to oblige. Especially when it causes me to risk my station. To risk everything I've worked for.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 去做你自己的事，扎格。如果哈迪斯大人看见我们这样聊天怎么办……？我冒着失去一切的风险帮你，但你仍失败了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 即使是在冥界我也有无数的亡灵要战。不过多亏了你，我比原先走得更远了。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我永远乐意为你效劳。尤其是我还得冒着失去地位的风险。甚至失去我所拥有的一切。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: What are you doing back here, Zagreus? I risked everything by helping you out there. So that was all for nothing, then?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Far from it, Than. I got where I needed to go, and if not for your help, maybe I wouldn't have. As for why I'm back... as Father would say, I have some business to attend to, here.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Well! Don't let me stop you, then. Always happy to risk my station for your sake. To risk everything I've worked for.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你在这里干什么呢，扎格列欧斯？我冒着巨大的风险帮你从这里逃出去，看来我是白忙活了，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 才不是呢，塔纳。该去的地方我都去了，而且如果没有你的帮助，或许我根本到不了那些地方。至于我为什么会回来……就像父亲说的那样，我来这里有点事要办。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 好啦！那我就不浪费你的时间了。如果是为了你的话，我愿意冒险，愿意赌上我为之奋斗的一切。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Be on your way, Zagreus. I have an audience with Lord Hades in a moment. An inquiry into my recent absences.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What are you worried about, Than? You've never given him a reason not to trust you.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Recently, I'm not so sure. Whatever you're doing, it had better be worth it.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 做你的事去吧，扎格列欧斯。我待会该去见冥王哈迪斯了。他想知道我最近为何没有出现。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你在担心什么呢，塔纳？你永远都值得他去信任你。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 不过最近，我不确定了。不管你在做什么，这最好值得。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I still cannot entirely believe you really think there's any way you're getting out of here.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Why? You've been out. It's thanks to you the mortals end up down here maybe half the time.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: That's different, that's my job. I can't stay there, and frankly I can barely stand it. Do you have any idea how bright it gets, up there?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No. But I look forward to finding out for myself.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Tsch, well. We'll see what the Fates have to say about that. Maybe the shade of Daedalus can make you some protective eyewear or something.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我还是不能相信你真的认为有办法可以逃离这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 为什么？你出去过。多亏了你，那些凡人才有一半的时间都呆在这个地方。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 这不一样，这是我的工作。我不能待在那里，而且我自己也受不了那个地方。你知道那外头有多亮吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不知道。但是我想自己去寻找答案。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 啧，行吧，看看命运女神有没有什么安排吧。或许狄德勒斯的暗灵可以帮你做一副保护眼罩什么的。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Thanatos, the world outside... didn't you say that it would make you sick, being out there for very long at all? I understand now what you meant by that. Beautiful place and all, but... it's good to be back.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: See what I mean, now, Zag? Nice place to visit on occasion, sure. But I definitely wouldn't want to live there.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 塔纳托斯，外面的世界……你之前不是说过，如果在那里呆得太久，就会感到浑身不舒服吗？我现在终于明白你说的是什么意思了。那里确实很美，一切都很好，但是……能回来真是太好了。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 现在你明白我的意思了吧，扎格？那边偶尔去看看确实不错，但我真的不想住在那里。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I met her, you know. Persephone, I mean. You look more like your father, but... you have her eyes. One of them, anyway.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You never spoke of her to me. You must have known... you kept the truth from me, the same as Nyx?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: It's not like that. I didn't know any more than you. Besides, Lord Hades ordered all of us to never speak of her again. I thought it just a bad relationship. I didn't realize she left her son.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Something tells me Father wouldn't let her take me even if she wanted.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Maybe so. But even still, she did abandon you. Your family's here, if you ask me. But I can understand that... you need answers.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道吗，我见过她，珀尔塞福涅。你看上去更像你的父亲，不过……你继承了她的眼睛。其中一只。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你从没跟我提起过她。你一定早就知道…你也不告诉我真相，就跟倪克斯一样？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 不是这样的。我知道的也不比你多。另外，冥王哈迪斯也命令我们不准再提到她。我以为只是他们的感情不太顺利，我不知道她还留下了自己的儿子。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我感觉，就算她想，父亲也不会让她带我走的。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 也许吧。但事实如此，她抛弃了你。要我说的话，这里才是你的家。但是我可以理解…你想知道答案。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I met her, you know. Persephone, I mean. You look more like your father, but, you have her eyes. One of them, anyway.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You never spoke of her to me. You must have known... you kept the truth from me, the same as Nyx?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: It's not like that. I didn't know any more than you. Besides, Lord Hades ordered all of us to never speak of her again. I thought it just a bad relationship. I didn't realize she left her son.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Something tells me Father wouldn't let her take me even if she wanted.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道吗，我见过她，珀尔塞福涅。你看上去更像你的父亲，不过……你继承了她的眼睛。其中一只。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你从没跟我提起过她。你一定早就知道…你也不告诉我真相，就跟倪克斯一样？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 不是这样的。我知道的也不比你多。另外，冥王哈迪斯也命令我们不准再提到她。我以为只是他们的感情不太顺利，我不知道她还留下了自己的儿子。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我感觉，就算她想，父亲也不会让她带我走的。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Than. Come join me in the lounge for old time's sake. The coast is clear. The work can wait.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You're really asking me to join you for a drink...? I mean... you know what, sure. The work can wait.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...I somehow knew, you know. I always knew you weren't going to stay. You were... so restless here. You just needed a reason to leave! And I hoped you wouldn't find one this quickly. Eugh. What am I saying? You have no idea.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No, I know exactly what you're saying, Than. I'm sorry that I'm putting you through all of this, it's just... it's something that I have to do. But, I'm glad we know the truth about me, now. Maybe we can move on from there.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Tsk... I've always lacked your optimism, Zag. Anyway... the work has waited long enough, I need to get back to it. Thanks for the drink.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...Watch yourself out there, Zagreus. I have to go.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨，塔纳。看在咱俩交情的份上，来休息室陪我一下吧。不会有事的。工作待会再做。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你真的是邀我跟你喝一杯…？我是说…当然没问题了。工作待会再做。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……说真的，不知为何我很清楚，我很清楚你不会留在这里。你……在这里一直都烦躁不安，你只需要个离开的理由，而我之前一直希望你别这么快就找到理由离开！呃，你肯定不明白我在说什么吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不，我知道你想说什么，塔纳。我很抱歉让你卷入到这事里头来，就是……这是我必须要做的。但是，我很高兴现在我们都知道我身世的真相了。或许咱们可以从现在开始，更进一步了。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 哧…我永远都不能像你这样乐观，扎格。好了…工作应该等我等得不耐烦了，我得回去了。谢谢你陪我喝酒。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: …外头当心点，扎格列欧斯。我得走了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Thanatos, I've meant to ask... is it really the case that many mortals have a crippling fear of death?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: It is, I'm quite feared, up there. Most of them cannot distinguish between me, and, say, Lord Ares, or your father, even. We fill them with despair. No helping it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Why not? I mean, isn't it kind of a big problem that they have such negative associations, here? Can't we... I don't know, do something to educate them all?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: We've all the time to educate them, here. Their ignorance of death is solved almost as soon as they experience their first. Though I suppose they might be better off knowing before the fact.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 塔纳托斯，其实我是想问一下……是不是很多凡人都非常怕死？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 是的，凡间的人怕我怕得要死。他们中的大多数人都分不清我和战神阿瑞斯，甚至连你父亲也认不清。我们让他们充满绝望，不过这也没办法。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 为什么？我是说，他们的这种负面联想难道不是一个大问题吗？我们就不能……想办法纠正他们的想法吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 等他们来这里之后，我们有的是时间纠正他们。等他们死过之后，基本上就都不再会对死亡一无所知了。不过我觉得，提前认识死亡或许对他们更有好处。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Than? I had another question about death. So... why is it mortals grieve so much about the thing, I mean... it definitely hurts there for a little while, but... it's not that bad.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: They see it as their one and only chance. Imagine if, after you perished, that was it. Back to the infinite Chaos. Everything about you. Returned to how it was before you were even there.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: But that's absurd. One life? Though... eugh. That's horrible, even to think about.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I know, right? Some of them know that isn't how it is, and try to tell their kind about what it is we do here, but... it's slow going, getting the information out. Either way! I get to be the bearer of good news.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 塔纳？我又想问个关于死亡的问题了。那就是……为什么这件事会让凡人如此悲伤？我知道……它确实会暂时造成一些痛苦，但是……也没那么糟糕吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 因为他们以为生命只有一次。想象一下，假设你死了之后，你就会再次回到卡俄斯无尽的身体之中。关于你的一切世事纷扰，都会尘归尘，土归土。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 但这也太荒谬了，生命只有一次吗？但是……呃。光是想一想，就觉得好可怕。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我说的没错吧？他们当中有些人知道事实并非如此，他们也试着跟其他人解释我们这边的情况，但是……进展很慢，真实的情况很难传播开来。不管怎样！我要成为好消息的传递者。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey Than? Something's been troubling me still, with what you said, about how mortals look at death. If most of them believe their life is all they have... how do they live? I mean, I can't even imagine what that's like. I'd be a lot more careful, at the very least!

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: They live with all their hearts, or at least try. I think there's something to it, truthfully. Though, some of them, they fall apart. They get here without me. On their own, gripped with despair. If only they knew what your father always says about all this.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, you mean that 'there is no escape'? From what? The mortals are up there, not here. Not while they're technically alive in their sense, anyway.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I mean, you can't escape your problems, Zagreus. You can run from your family, but you can't run from everything. You have no choice but to confront it, and work through it, sooner or later, one way or another. You, and all of us.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...I'm starting to notice that, yes. Though, to a mortal who has yet to die... don't they think of death as some sort of release? You come to end their misery, something like that?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I can release them from their decaying bodies. Sometimes, the Fates demand I bring them in sooner. That's about as much as I can do. Some of them get it early on, how to live. It's quite impressive, really, that they learn so quick.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，塔纳？有些事一直困扰着我，就是你说的关于凡人如何看待死亡的问题。如果大多数人都坚信他们只有一次生命……他们是怎么生活的？我的意思是，我根本无法想象。起码，我会更加小心翼翼！

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 他们会竭尽全力地热爱生活，或者至少要试着这么做。不过，老实说，我觉得这是有原因的。不过还有一些人，他们死的时候没有留下全尸。他们在没有我陪伴的情况下来到这里。独自前来，被绝望所侵蚀。关于这一点，真希望他们知道你的父亲总是说起的那些话。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么，你是说“根本没有逃脱的可能”？从哪里逃脱？凡人应该在阳间，不是这里。至少，在他们所理解的活着的时候。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我的意思是，你无法逃避面对自己的问题，扎格列欧斯。你可以离家出走，但你无法逃避所有问题。你迟早要以这样或那样的方式面对和解决这些问题，别无他法。你，我，我们任何人都一样。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: ……我开始注意到，是的。虽然每个凡人都难逃一死……但他们不也是把死亡当成一种解脱吗？由你来结束他们的不幸，之类的？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我可以将他们从其腐朽的肉体中解放出来。有时候，命运之神会要求我把他们提前带进来。这就是我要做的。有些人更早地明白了如何去生活。真的很厉害，他们学得很快。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, just how far are you able to shift, anyway, Than? I never could go more than a blade's length in front of me, while you're out there skipping across the entire world probably.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Most of it, yes. Don't beat yourself up, though, Zagreus. It's a practiced skill but I've apparently been able to do it since birth. Mother Nyx says I was a real handful.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你能瞬间移动多远呢，塔纳？我最多只能瞬移差不多一把刀那么远的距离，而你却能在整个世界之中到处穿梭。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 差不多是这样的，不过也别太灰心，扎格列欧斯。这种技巧要好好练习才能掌握，可我一生出来就能自由运用，连母亲倪克斯都说像我这样的人凤毛麟角。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, what is it you're always staring at out there, anyway, Than? I don't see anything.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: The River Styx is right in front of you, and you don't see anything, Zag? I can watch it endlessly. Studying the competition, you might say. Most mortals expect to get here by river, with Charon. Not with me.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So you're locked in ruthless battle with a river, searching it for any signs of weakness, that sort of thing? That sounds stressful.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I find it rather soothing as a matter of fact. A break from having to deal constantly with mortal souls. Speaking of which... I have to pick somebody up right now.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你一直在盯着什么看呢，塔纳？我什么都没看到。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 整条冥河就在你眼前，而你却什么都没看到吗，扎格？我可以盯着它看到地老天荒。也可以说，我是在研究我的竞争对手吧。绝大部分人都觉得会在这里见到卡戎，而不是见到我。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 所以说，你是和这条河杠上了吗？打算寻找它的弱点之类的吗？这听起来太让人有压力了。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 老实说，我觉得这挺减压的。这样我就可以休息一下，不用再和凡人的灵魂没完没了地打交道了。说到这个……我得去接个人了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Than, my blade, the one I'm borrowing from Father anyway, it... revealed to me an older aspect of itself, of Nemesis. Nyx never mentions her. Have you two ever met?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: In case you haven't noticed, most of us who sprang from Nyx, we're not exactly close. Nemesis is fully occupied meting out justice on the surface. Our paths are not designed to cross. And based on everything I know, that's fine with me.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 塔纳，我那把刀，就是我从父亲那里借来的那把，它……它向我展示了它更古老的形态，是涅墨西斯的形态。倪克斯从来没提起过她，你见过她吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 或许你还没注意到，虽然我们都是倪克斯的子嗣，但我们之间的关系并不亲近。涅墨西斯全神贯注于地面上的世界，忙着伸张正义，我们本就没机会打交道。而且据我所知，这样也挺好的。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: How's that Rail of Adamant been working out for you lately? Always figured the direct approach was more your style. Though, I happened to have a look at your permanent record lately, and turns out you're doing a lot of work with that thing.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Why, Thanatos, you're learning to pry in others' business! The Rail's been working out just fine, thanks. Though, now that you mention it, how well do you know Eris, one of Nyx's daughters, right? Seems she wielded the Rail before me.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: The mortals call her Strife. She and her children... it's thanks partly to their dedicated efforts I'm so busy all the time. Though, it is best we didn't speak of her, I think.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你那把狮鹫坚炮用得还顺手吗？我一直觉得你比较适合肉搏。不过我最近看了看你的记录，发现你用那把炮还真是做了不少事情。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 怎么，塔纳托斯，你也开始打探别人的事情了嘛！那把炮我一直用得很顺手，多谢了。不过既然你提起来的话，你和厄里斯熟吗？她也是倪克斯的女儿，是吧？看起来，她是那把坚炮之前的主人。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 凡人们称她为“不和女神”。她和她的孩子们……多亏了他们的不懈努力，我才能一直忙个不停。不过我觉得，我们最好别说和她有关的事情。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Thanatos, I ought have asked by now, but... what's it like? Up there I mean, outside. You never talk about it, I... almost forget that's where you go, for work.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: What can I say? It's... different. I never stay up there for very long, don't think I could, starts making me feel ill. Too many sensations all at once. And when the chariot of Helios is in the sky, it gets so bright that I can barely see.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That sounds awful. If it's that bad, why would all the Olympians chat it up so much?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: There's no accounting for their taste, I guess. But, I'm discounting certain aspects that are not so bad. You know what? I'll not spoil the surprise. I have a feeling you're going to see for yourself soon enough.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 塔纳托斯，我早该问你了，但……那是一种怎样的感受？我是说阳间的生活。你从没提起，我……差点忘了你在那边做事。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 该怎么说呢？……很不一样。我没办法在那边待太久，我自己很明白，会让我感到不舒服。一时间你可能要面临太多的情感冲击。当赫利俄斯驾着战车出现在空中，它亮得刺眼，我几乎睁不开眼睛。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 听起来很糟糕。如果真的这么糟糕，为什么奥林匹斯山上的众神都把那说的天花乱坠呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 谁知道他们的品味出了什么问题。不过，如果不考虑其中某些方面，其实也还好。你知道吗？你还是自己去发现那种惊奇的感受吧。我有种预感，你很快就能亲身体验到这些。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Thanatos, I ought have asked by now, but... what's it like? Up there I mean, outside. You never talk about it, I... almost forget that's where you go, for work.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: What can I say? It's... different. I never stay up there for very long, don't think I could, starts making me feel ill. Too many sensations all at once. And when the chariot of Helios is in the sky, it gets so bright that I can barely see.

en.text: That sounds awful. If it's that bad, why would all the Olympians chat it up so much?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: There's no accounting for their taste, I guess.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 塔纳托斯，我早该问你了，但……那是一种怎样的感受？我是说阳间的生活。你从没提起，我……差点忘了你在那边做事。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 听起来很糟糕。如果真的这么糟糕，为什么奥林匹斯山上的众神都把那说的天花乱坠呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 谁知道他们的品味出了什么问题。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What's going on with Charon, by the way, if you can tell me, Than? He's... never been particularly talkative, but he really seems to know the inner workings of this place.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I correspond with Charon all the time, but even I don't know the full extent of his responsibilities. He's an independent contractor of sorts, been here forever. Your father gives him plenty of space to work.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: He must be compensated pretty well for having done this for so long. Tending the influx of new souls and all of that.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I doubt he's in it for the compensation, Zagreus. There is no Underworld without Charon. I think he knows that, and your father knows it, too.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那卡戎呢，他怎么样，塔纳，能和我说说吗？他……从来不多说一句话，但他好像很清楚这个地方的很多潜规则。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我和卡戎一直保持着来往，但连他具体是干什么的我都不知道。他有点类似于独立的承包商，永远都待在这里。你的父亲给了他很大的工作空间。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这么长时间以来，他肯定拿了不少报酬。照顾新来的亡灵之类的。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜他不是为了报酬，扎格列欧斯。没有卡戎，整个冥界将不复存在。我觉得他心里很清楚这点，你的父亲也是。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, were you ever close with Charon, Than? Seems like no matter how much I try, I can't quite get through to him.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Wouldn't be surprised if you were closer to him than I am. Not all of Nyx's sons and daughters keep in steady touch. Though at least we're not always at each others' throats, like the other side of your family.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你之前和卡戎融洽相处过吗，塔纳？好像不管我怎么努力，都没办法和他搞好关系。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 如果你和他比我和他走得更近，我一点都不会意。倪克斯的子女们并非总是保持着紧密联系，不过，至少我们也不会像你父亲那边的亲戚们那样，总是刀剑相向。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Than, you're not going to believe this, but... Charon's been helping me. All on his own, apparently! I was so sure that Nyx or someone put him up to it. That Skelly character I mentioned, Charon hired him!

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: What are you talking about, Zagreus? Just because Charon's selling you things doesn't mean he's helping you. Wait, are you sure?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm sure! His helper, Skelly, he's a lot more talkative, and finally let on. Although, he couldn't tell me how come Charon did a thing like this, I mean... we weren't ever close...

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Hmm. All I can think of is... Charon's very dedicated to this House. Like some of us. Maybe he thought... he could help settle things, between you and your father. One way or another.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 塔纳，或许我这么说你不会信，但……卡戎一直都在帮我。很显然，全是靠他自己的力量！我很确定他是奉倪克斯或某人之命这么做的。我之前说的那个叫骨头的家伙，就是在替卡戎工作！

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你在说什么呢，扎格列欧斯？卡戎卖给你东西，但这可不意味着他在帮你。等等，你确定吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我很确定！他的帮手骨头是个大嘴巴，他终于说漏嘴了。不过，他还是没告诉我卡戎为什么要做这种事情。我是说……我们两个之前都不熟……

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，我能想到的是……卡戎和我们中的一部分人一样，对这座圣殿尽心尽力。或许他觉得……他可以以某种方式，帮忙解决你和你父亲之间的事情。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Than, now hypothetically, if I were to have vanquished Charon in single combat after having, I don't know, say, helped myself to one of his wares at no charge, how long would you say he'd hold it over me?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Everything is an exchange with Charon, Zag. If there was something you refused to pay for, then I'm going to assume that's why you're back here, now. The debt is paid in obols, or in blood. Or their closest counterparts, I guess.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，塔纳，假设说，我拿了卡戎的东西却没给他钱，之后又在一对一的战斗中把他打败了，你觉得这件事情他会记恨多久？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 对卡戎来说，所有的一切都是交换，扎格。如果你之前确实有什么东西没付过钱的话，那你之所以会来我这里，恐怕也是因为这个吧。债务要么用金币来偿，要么用血来偿，要么用最接近的东西来偿，我猜。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Than, level with me on this. You didn't happen to hire a shifty character called Skelly to assist me here and there, did you?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Who, what? No. Why would you even ask?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 塔纳，实话告诉我吧。你该不会刚好雇了个叫“骨头”的狡猾帮手，来帮我忙这忙那吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 是谁？你说什么？没有啊，怎么问起这个来了？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Do you remember anything else about my mother, Than? Just, anything. You weren't close, I guess?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: We weren't. She kept to herself as I recall, and I would do the same. Unlike my present company, I do not ask too many questions. It was quite clear to me she wasn't from this place.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Father isn't from this place, either. How was she any different?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Sometimes I have to be reminded that Lord Hades wasn't born here, like the rest of us. But Persephone, she... she had a radiance about her, I suppose. Reminded me of the outside, but... I don't mean that in a negative respect.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 关于我的母亲，你还记得什么别的事情吗，塔纳？什么事情都行。你们之前不太亲近，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 确实如此。在我印象中，她一直都喜欢独处，我也一样。和我现在的伙伴不一样，我不怎么喜欢问问题。不过当时我就很清楚，她并不是在这个地方诞生的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲也不是在这个地方诞生的，她又有什么不一样的呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 有时候必须有人提醒我，冥王哈迪斯并不是在冥界诞生的，就像我们其他人一样。至于珀尔塞福涅，她……她给我一种光芒四射的感觉，会让我想起外面的世界……我指的是好的那一方面。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Than, you don't hold a grudge against old Sisyphus, do you? He seems rather apprehensive about you. I understand you met not on the best of terms.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: He is a brazen one, I have to give him that. I hadn't realized that you were close. Despite some questionable choices on your part, I don't think you're the poorest judge of character, and so... maybe I have him wrong.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I only have a faint impression of the man he used to be, although it seems he's changed a lot, since then. Thank you for understanding, anyway.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 塔纳，你对老西西弗斯没有心怀怨恨吧？他好像对你充满怀疑。我知道你们合不来。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我不得不说，他是一个恬不知耻的家伙，我没想到你们两个关系这么好。虽然你的有些选择很值得商榷，但我也不认为你是一个识人不明的人，所以……也许是我看错他了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我对他的模糊印象都停留在过去，虽然他后来变了很多。不管怎样，还是要谢谢你的理解。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I heard you stayed the knave-king's sentence. I should be angry with you. Sisyphus must be the only mortal ever to have humiliated me. But Mother Nyx, she... must have backed you, didn't she...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: We did what needed to be done. As much as Father likes making examples out of wretched shades, an eternal sentence felt a little excessive in this case. Besides... Sisyphus isn't leaving, anyway. Seems to have found his niche.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Oh? Well, he's an odd one through and through, I guess. As long as I don't have to deal with him again.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我听说你暂缓了对无赖之王的判决。我本该对你发火才对，西西弗斯是唯一一个胆敢羞辱过我的凡人。不过我的母亲倪克斯，她……她肯定给了你支持，是吧……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我们只是做了很久以前就该做的事情。虽然父亲喜欢拿卑鄙的幽灵杀鸡儆猴，但永生永世的惩罚未免过分了点。另外……西西弗斯是不会离开这里的，他似乎已经找到了他该干的事情。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 哦？好吧，反正他是个彻头彻尾的怪家伙，只要我不用再和他打交道就好。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You and Achilles ever get to talk much, Than?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I have my orders, he has his. What do you think? Even back when he was still alive, there was no real chance I was going to be the one to take him here, given his line of work.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Because he was a warrior. When mortals die a violent death, they're no longer your case, are they?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: No. I tend to those in less of a hurry to come here.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你和阿喀琉斯聊过什么吗，塔纳？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我有我要做的事情，他也有他要做的事情，你觉得呢？就算他还活着，考虑到他在这里的工作，我也不可能真的有机会去和他聊聊。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 因为他生前是个战士，在战斗中丧命的凡人不归你管，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，我负责管那些不怎么急于求死的凡人。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Your trainer's been absent from his post, more so than usual. You voided his pact with Lord Hades, didn't you? I don't know how you did it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know he's more than my trainer, Than. As for how I did it, turns out being the first and only son of Hades has its privileges. Now Achilles gets to be with someone he loves. Who loves him back.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Love is common among mortals. Is theirs really so special as to be worth the trouble? Not just on your part, but theirs?

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你的教练没在站岗，他缺勤的时间比平时更久。是你撕毁了他和冥王哈迪斯之间的契约，是吧？我真不知道你是怎么做到的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你也知道，他可不仅仅是我的教练。至于我是怎么做到的，身为冥王的长子，也是他唯一的儿子，我还是有些特权的。现在，阿喀琉斯应该和他相爱的人在一起了。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 凡人之间的爱很常见，他们的爱真的那么特别，值得这么大费周章吗？而且不仅仅是你愿意帮忙，他们自己也愿意折腾吗？

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You've seen a lot of Megaera lately, haven't you, Zag?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's not like that, Than. She's there to slow me down. Get in my way.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: If you insist. Although I think it's much more complicated than you say.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Yeah... her sisters are back. They're... hard to deal with. I don't think Meg is on good terms with either one.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: That's not what I meant. But fine, you've told me all I need to know, for now.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你最近经常去见墨纪拉吧，扎格？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 事情不是那样的，塔纳。她是为了拖慢我的脚步。阻止我的前进。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 如果你硬要这样说的话。不过我觉得事情比你说得要复杂。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊……她的姐妹们回来了。她们…很难对付。我觉得墨纪跟她们的关系不是很好。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我不是这个意思。也罢，你已经告诉我我想知道的了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You and Meg go back a long way, don't you? I forget sometimes you two are pretty close.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Our responsibilities must have us cross paths often, yes. But I didn't really get to know her until after the whole humiliating affair with Sisyphus.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, right. He got stuck in Tartarus after that, under Meg's personal supervision. So you bonded over your shared disdain for Sisyphus?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: We each had to blow off some steam, yes. That was some of the hardest I ever worked, back then, and her, too, I think. When you go through something like that with someone, it brings you closer, I suppose.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你和墨纪以前就很熟悉，是吧？有时候，我都忘了你们之前走得很近了。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，因为职责的缘故，我和她时常见面。不过，直到我被西西弗斯羞辱的那件事发生之后，我才开始慢慢了解她。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，没错，是墨纪亲自下令要把西西弗斯困在塔耳塔罗斯的。所以，你们是因为都很讨厌西西弗斯，才熟悉起来的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 没错，我们也得释放一下压力。那差不多是我对付过的最棘手的家伙了，我猜对她来说也是如此。我想，一起经历过这样的事情之后，两个人的距离应该是会拉近的吧。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Than, there's something that I meant to tell you. Ask you, rather. You're close with Megaera, so, what I mean is... you know about us, right?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Yes, of course. Why do you ask?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, it's just... I figured since you deal with mortals all the time, I know that some of them, they choose a single suitor. It's a valid custom, if it's yours...!

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: The mortals have their customs, yes, indeed. Quite a variety, in point of fact. However, none as yet have stuck with me, I think. So don't concern yourself with things like that.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're saying you're not angry with me? Or Meg, for that matter?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Not any more than usual. Tell her that I said hello when next you meet.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 塔纳，我想和你说一件事。或者说问你一个问题。你和墨纪拉的关系亲密，所以，我想知道……你对我们都很了解，对吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 当然。你为什么要这么问？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 说起来有点……我在想，既然你一直和凡人打交道，我知道他们当中的一些人会选择一个追求者。这是非常合理的习惯，如果是你的……！

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 确实，凡人有自己的习惯。实际上，有很多这样的习惯。不过，没有一个是我想不通的。所以，不要让自己卷入其中。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你是说，你不生我的气？或者生墨纪的气？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 现在不了。下次见到她时，替我向她问好。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Than, you don't take issue with me being close with Dusa, do you? She brings such warmth to this place... I really appreciate having her here.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You don't need to ask me such things, Zagreus. They're your feelings.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 塔纳，我和杜莎走得很近，你对此不介意吧？她让这里充满了温暖……我很庆幸这里能有她在。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 这种事情不用问我，扎格列欧斯，那是你自己的感觉。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Than, what's your relationship with Ares on Olympus? I know he deals in death himself, but... his approach seems rather different from your own.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I do not care for his approach at all. But he has been professionally courteous with me. More than I can say for most of your Olympian relatives, I suppose.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You mean the rest of the Olympians don't treat you well?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Discounting Hermes, I should say, the rest of them have nothing much to do with me at all. I can imagine why, I know it's complicated with your father here. But as for Ares... I think he's all right.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 塔纳，你和奥林匹斯山上的阿瑞斯是什么关系？我知道他也在和亡灵打交道，但……他的方式好像和你差别很大。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我完全不关心他用什么方式。但他对我保持着职业上的礼貌。甚至可以说，超过你在奥林匹斯山上的大多数亲戚。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你是说奥林匹斯山上的其他神对你不好？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 除了赫尔墨斯，我应该说，其他人跟我一点关系都没有。我能想到原因，我知道你父亲的处境有点复杂。至于阿瑞斯……我觉得他还不错。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Than? I thought you ought to know that Ares, he... I think he's taken quite an interest in Nyx. Keeps asking me to talk to her on his behalf.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Finally. It's about time Olympus took notice of Mother and all her accomplishments.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Finally? You don't think Ares has untoward intentions or anything like that?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: He'd be a hollow fool if he did. Why do you think they fear us on Olympus, Zagreus? Because of Hypnos? I don't think Mother Nyx requires your concern. Though, by all means, talk to her about it, if you like.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 塔纳？你应该和阿瑞斯很熟吧，他……我觉得他对倪克斯很感兴趣，他总想让我替他给倪克斯带话。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 终于啊，奥林匹斯的众神也注意到了暗夜之母，注意到了她的成就。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 终于啊？你不觉得阿瑞斯有什么不良企图之类的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 他如果敢打什么主意，那他就是个白痴了。你觉得奥林匹斯山的那些家伙为什么惧怕我们，扎格列欧斯？难道是因为修普诺斯？我觉得暗夜之母倪克斯并不需要你的担心。不过，如果你想聊聊她的话，可以尽管聊。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Mother Nyx told me you restored the Eldest Sigil, Zagreus. I couldn't believe that was your doing. What you did... it meant a lot to her.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It was my pleasure. Say, did Nyx ever let on to you of her relationship with Chaos, at any point?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: No, not everyone is quite as sharing as you are, Zag. Nor as inclined to pry. But still... in this case, sounds like it worked out. So, thank you. If she hasn't said as much.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯告诉我，你修复了远古印记，扎格列欧斯。我真不敢相信那是你做的，你做的这一切……对她意义重大。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我很荣幸。和我说说吧，倪克斯有没有和你透露过她和卡俄斯之间的关系？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 没有，不是所有人都能像你这样消息灵通，扎格。我也没打算去打探，不过……听起来他们发展得还挺顺利。虽然她本人并没说过什么，不过，还是很谢谢你。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I can tell when Mother Nyx is upset, Zagreus. And I know better than to ask her, so I'm going to ask you. What happened?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Probably because Nyx took issue with me chatting with Dusa from time to time. Is that really so unbecoming of me? Not even Father seems to care.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Well, Mother cares! And I, for one, know better than to question it. None of us would be here were it not for her. If she has a request for you, you honor it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're telling me I should just start ignoring Dusa from now on, like you do?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You're a god. I'm telling you to learn to act like one.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 看得出来，倪克斯很不开心，而我不打算这种时候问她。所以我想问你，发生了什么事情？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 可能是因为我时不时与杜莎聊天，倪克斯觉得不太妥当吧？这么做真的很不合适吗？父亲好像根本都不在乎。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 可母亲会在乎呀！我很清楚我们不该质疑母亲的想法，如果不是因为她，我们根本就不会诞生。所以，如果她想让你做什么，你应该按她说的做。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你是想我从今以后不理杜莎吗，就像你一样？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你是个神。我的意思是，你该有神的样子。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm sorry I raised my voice with you last time, Than. I know Nyx puts so much into this place, and has nurtured so many of us here.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: It's not me you should be apologizing to, Zag. Although, with Mother Nyx, sometimes it's best to leave her be. As for Dusa... I didn't mean to suggest you should abandon your friend.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 很抱歉上次和你发脾气了，塔纳。我知道倪克斯很在乎这个地方，我们很多人也都是由她抚养成人的。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你应该道歉的人不是我，扎格。不过，至于倪克斯，有的时候最好不要去惹她就是了。至于杜莎嘛……我并没有建议你抛弃你的朋友。

en.speaker: Zagreus
