en.text: Nyx let her go, Than. Dusa, I mean, she's gone. What do I do?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: If I were you, I would start getting over it as soon as possible. But, I don't see you doing that. Just remember... maybe this isn't about you. Dusa's job may have been far too much for her. Mother Nyx is strict, but she is fair.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Then she should give Dusa another chance. Has Meg heard? She'll be furious.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Megaera will be no such thing. Some of us don't default to questioning every decision from our superiors.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯把她撵走了，塔纳。我是说，杜莎她走了，我该怎么办？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 如果换做是我，我会想办法尽快接受这个事实，但我看你并没有这个打算。记住……或许这件事并不是因你而起，有可能是因为杜莎实在是干不完活了。倪克斯确实很严厉，但她也很公正。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那她应该再给杜莎一个机会才对。墨纪听说这件事情了吗？她一定会火冒三丈的。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 墨纪拉才不会呢，不是所有人都喜欢质疑上级的每个决定。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I saw that Dusa's back. You must have worked your ways on Mother Nyx. Don't know how you do it. Can't remember the last time I saw her budge on anything.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx genuinely cares about this House and all of us. She had to come around on something like this. Dusa's one of the hardest workers here. Even if she has room to improve.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Incessant hard work can lead to trouble, Zagreus. I think maybe that's why Mother was concerned. We all know how your father can get. She doesn't need someone like Dusa taking after him.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我看到杜莎回来了，你肯定是和倪克斯谈好了吧？真不知道你是怎么做到的，我已经不记得上次见到她让步是什么时候了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯真的很在乎这座圣殿，在乎我们，她不得不处理这样的事情。杜莎差不多算是我们之中工作最勤奋的人了，但即便如此，她也有进步空间。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 一刻不停的努力可能会带来麻烦，扎格列欧斯。我想，这也正是母亲大人如此在意的原因吧。咱们都知道你父亲是个什么样的人，她不需要像杜莎这样的人来照顾他。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Than, you know, Hypnos, he adores you. Besides just driving you to madness, now and then.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I'm rather used to the relationship, thanks, Zagreus. Seems like you got to know him pretty well.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, dying repeatedly can end up bringing people closer, I suppose.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I don't know what's worse, dying repeatedly or Hypnos. Although, I guess I'm grateful for your patience with him, Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 塔纳，你知道吗，修普诺斯，他可喜欢你了。虽然他可能时不时让你觉得崩溃。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我已经习惯这样了，谢谢你，扎格列欧斯。看样子你很了解他嘛。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，看样子重复死亡可以让大家的关系更加亲密。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我不知道哪个更糟，是重复死亡还是修普诺斯。不过，我应该感谢你能够耐心对待他，扎格。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Got to tell you something, Than. You can be pretty mean to Hypnos! And that's coming from someone who's mean to Hypnos a lot. Believe me, I completely understand, but... still.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: He's utterly incompetent, Zag. He wouldn't even be here if Mother Nyx wasn't trying to whip him into some sort of shape.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Yeah, but... pretty much none of this would be here, were it not for Nyx, right? Anyway my point is not that you should go easy on him, but... there must be some way not to get as frustrated. You'll both be better off.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I know, it's just...! You're right. I catch myself feeling particularly horrid after talking to him. He can be very frustrating, and self-absorbed... though, I know he means well. Probably.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 有些话我想和你说，塔纳。对修普诺斯来说，你是个很重要的人，可有时候你对他太刻薄了！说实话，我能明白你的感受，可……就是太过了。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 他是个彻头彻尾的废物，扎格。要不是母亲倪克斯总是在鞭策他，让他多少有点人样，他连今天这个位置都走不到。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，可是……如果不是倪克斯的缘故，这里的一切都不会是这个样子，不是吗？总之，我不是想说你应该对他宽厚点，我只想说……肯定有办法可以不闹得这么僵，你们两个可以相处得更和睦。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我明白，只是……！你说得没错。我每次和他聊完之后，脾气都会变得特别差。他是个自恋的家伙，而且会让人气不打一处来……不过，我猜他的话都是出于好意，大概吧。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I can hardly believe it. Hypnos finally came out on top, huh? Even Father seemed pleased with him. That's more than I get.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I can hardly believe it either, Zagreus. But then again, he's one of Mother Nyx's offspring, so we shouldn't be so surprised. Though, I have to thank you for talking to me about him a while back...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, that? I noticed you two getting along better recently. So what's your secret?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: He loves lists. Doesn't do well with subtlety, so much, but spell things out for him, and he will get right on it. Long as he's awake, at least. He's still working on that part.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我简直不敢相信，修普诺斯终于打起精神了吗？就连父亲大人似乎都对他很满意，我可真没想过会这样。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我也不敢相信，扎格列欧斯。但话说回来，他毕竟是倪克斯的儿子，所以我们也不该太惊讶才是。不过，我得感谢你才是，多亏你前一阵子和我说了他的事情……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，是吗？我发现你们两个的关系最近好了不少，你有什么秘诀吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 他喜欢工作清单。虽然暗示之类的事情他听不明白，但只要说明白让他去干什么，他就立刻会去做。至少他醒着的时候是这样的，他现在还在努力不打瞌睡。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I saw you voided the old pact between Orpheus and your father. So now he gets to see his wife from time to time?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: He does, and I did, Than. I think we can stand to see a little less of him if it means he can be happier for the remainder of eternity.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You really need to learn to stop meddling in others' affairs. Did either of them even ask your help? I can't imagine Orpheus did, and I'm guessing his wife's feelings were complicated, too, from what I know of the circumstances of their final meeting.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What? Orpheus is my mate, Than. And I came to know his muse, Eurydice, as well. They still had feelings for each other, but with no way to communicate.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: So you decided to step in. Tsch. I think my instincts on the subject are just not the same as yours. I know your intentions were in the right place, but... you know what, forget it.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我发现你撕毁了俄耳甫斯和你父亲之间的契约，所以，他现在可以时不时地去见他的妻子了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，而且确实是我干的，塔纳。如果他在余下的永生之中能更开心的话，就算少见他几面，我觉得也是可以忍受的。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你真的应该学学少管别人的闲事，他们让你帮忙了吗？我听说过他们最后一面的情形。在我看来，我很难想象俄耳甫斯求你帮这个忙，他的妻子当时肯定也百感交集。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你在说什么呢？俄耳甫斯是我的伙伴，塔纳，我和他的缪斯女神欧律狄刻也很熟。他们依然彼此相爱，只是没办法交流而已。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 所以你决定插手这件事，唉。我觉得我对事情的考虑方式和你不太一样。我明白你的意图是好的，不过……算了吧，当我没说。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I saw the Fated List of Minor Prophecies was requisitioned through the House Contractor, Zagreus. Didn't take you for an agent of the Fates.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Turns out I'm full of surprises, Thanatos. Though, the Three Fates are your sisters, aren't they? Surprised you didn't requisition the List yourself.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Guess it just wasn't meant to be. Though, I don't know them at all. Keep only to themselves, somewhere. Sometimes I wonder whether everything really is preordained, or whether they're making all this up as they go.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我注意到命运小预言清单被包给了圣殿承包商。没想到你还是命运女神的信使呢，扎格列欧斯。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我就是这样总能给人带来惊喜，塔纳托斯。不过命运三女神不是你的姐妹吗？我很惊讶你居然没自己申请命运清单。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜命运不该如此吧，而且她们三个我完全不认识，她们一直独居在某个地方。有的时候我不禁在想：一切真的是早就注定的吗？还是说，这一切都是他们编出来的？

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You took Lord Hades down... you really did. I've never seen him quite like this before. I could scarce believe it when he came up through the Pool of Styx, himself...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Seemed only fair in the grand scheme of things. He slew his own parents at some point, right? I think the Fates enjoy this sort of thing.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Come on, Zag, take some credit where it's due. Though... you'll forgive me if I keep my distance for a little while, as I think you have some issues to resolve. You watch yourself.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你打败了冥王哈迪斯……你真的做到了。我以前从未见过他如此。他从冥河池爬上来时来时我简直不敢相信，那是他本尊……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 总体来说似乎还算公平。他在某个时候杀死了自己的父母，对吗？我觉得命运喜欢这种相应的发展。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 哎呀，扎格。该出手时就出手。不过……我觉得你有些事情要处理，我就先不打扰了，希望你能见谅，你自己多保重。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...You're really staying, Zagreus? I mean... between the generally ill-conceived attempts to reach the surface every so often.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I am. I figured it's the only way I could continue interrupting you while you try to do your job. You work too hard, Than, live a little, right?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Heh. Well then, I'll see what I can do about that. You'll have to show me what you mean by 'live a little', though.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……你真的要留在这里吗，扎格列欧斯？我是说……你之前总是一次次徒劳无功地想要跑到地面上去。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，我发现只有这样，我才能趁你工作的时候打扰你。你工作实在是太卖力了，塔纳。享受一下生活，好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 呵，好吧，我尽量试试看吧。不过，你得让我看看你说的“享受一下生活”是什么意思。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Have to tell you something, Than. My birthmother... she didn't abandon me. Or at least... she didn't think she did.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: She didn't think she did? What are you talking about, Zag? She left when you were born. Was never seen or spoken of again, until all this with you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, it turns out... she never knew I was alive, at all. Complications when I was born. She had been struggling already here, and it was all too much, I guess. By the time Nyx brought me back... my mother was long gone.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: What? But, Mother Nyx, and your father, they... could have sent for her, let her know... they must have known where she went!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx knew. But, Father must have convinced her that my mother... that it would be for the best if she never found out. About me. So she could live in peace. Away from all of this. And away from Olympus.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: That's... a lot to take in.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 有件事情得告诉你，塔纳。我的生母……她并没有抛弃我，至少……她并没打算那么做。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 她并没打算那么做？你在说什么呢，扎格？你一生下来她就走了，在那之后再也没人见过她，听说过她的消息，直到你做了这一切为止。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧……她根本不知道我还活着。我出生的时候出了很多状况，她一直都处于煎熬之中，我猜她已经承受不了了。等到倪克斯把我救活的时候……我的母亲早就走了。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 什么？可倪克斯和你的父亲，他们……他们本可以去找她的，让她知道……他们肯定知道她去了哪里！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯知道。但我父亲肯定说服了她……他们认为我母亲不知情是最好的，那样她就可以过平静的生活，远离这一切。远离奥林匹斯。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 这可真是……复杂啊。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...Answer me something, Zagreus. What am I to you, exactly, as of late? Because, sometimes, with you, I...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm sometimes at a loss myself, Thanatos. Though one thing I know is it's always really good running into you out there, it's... well, exciting. Sparring with you and all that! And then, I know it means that I might get to see you here.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Well, here I am. But you didn't answer my question. Though, you know something? Forget I asked. I've got to go.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……回答我一个问题吧，扎格列欧斯？对你而言，我究竟是什么样的人呢？因为有的时候，我和你在一起，我……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 有的时候我自己也不清楚，塔纳托斯。不过有件事情我很清楚，能见到你我总是很高兴。这么说吧……呃，和你讨论各种事情很有意思！而且我知道，只要来这里就能见到你了。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，我就在这里。虽然你还没回答我的问题。不过，怎么说好呢？就当我没问过吧，我得走了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Than, tell me something, and forgive the awkward question here, but... are we good? I mean... between us. Any infuriating habits I should know about, that sort of thing?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You know I don't have time to list all your infuriating habits, Zagreus. Though... if any of them were outside my usual tolerance threshold, I promise to let you know, all right?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So then, we're good. Because I think we're good, but I just wanted to make sure.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: We're good. See you, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，塔纳，抱歉问你这样一个蠢问题，不过和我说说吧……我们还是朋友吧？我是说……我们两个之间。我有没有什么让你讨厌的习惯，或者类似的东西？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 说真的，你那些让我讨厌的习惯，我恐怕根本列举不过来，扎格列欧斯。不过……如果有什么事情让我觉得受不了的话，我会告诉你的，好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好了，那我们就还是朋友。我知道我们一直是朋友，但我只是想确认一下。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我们是朋友，下次再见，好吗？

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...It just struck me how much you've changed, Zag. I still remember when you kept trying to singe Cerberus' tail with your feet. Haven't seen you do that in a while.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, I definitely learned my lesson there. But, thanks, I guess. You've opened up a lot, yourself, by the way. Talking to you lately, it's a world apart from the first time. You looked like you were going to slice my head off.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: It sure must have taken a lot of courage for you to come right up and tell me you thought I looked better before I cut my hair. I still ask myself how come I didn't keep ignoring you after that. Or slice your head off.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, the option is always available, I guess. Hey, you ever think of growing it out again?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: No. It kept getting in my way. Sliced it right off and never looked back. So... plenty of personal growth all around, then?

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……你的变化真是让我刮目相看，扎格。我还记得你打算把刻耳柏洛斯的尾巴缠在脚上时的样子呢，已经好久没见过你这么做了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，当然了，我已经尝到教训了。不过，谢谢你这么说。顺便一提，你和以前相比也开朗了不少。你现在的样子，和我第一次见你的时候简直判若两人。那个时候，你简直像是要把我脑袋砍下来一样。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 那你跑过来告诉我，说我剪了头发就变难看了，肯定下了很大决心吧。我现在还在想，我当时怎么就不能无视你呢？怎么就没把你脑袋砍下来呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哎，我猜你现在也随时可以这么做吧。嘿，你有没有想过再把头发留起来？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 没有，头发长了总是碍事，剪了就没去在乎了。就……我们都长大了，对吧？

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: How's everything been going with your mother, Zagreus? You've been pretty quiet about the whole thing, is everything all right? You can tell me.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Thank you for asking, Than. I don't know how much more I can say right now, given everything. I'm still figuring it out myself. I'm thankful you've been there to help me get to see her from time to time.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Well, if there's something more that I can do to support you in this, let me know, all right? Sounds like you're making progress, at least.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你和你母亲一切都还好吗，扎格列欧斯？这件事情你都没怎么提过了，没出什么问题吧？有什么事情都可以告诉我。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 谢谢你的询问，塔纳。发生了这么多事情，我也不知道该说什么好了，我还在想该怎么办才好。我很感谢你时不时地帮我去见她一面。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，如果有什么其它事情可以帮你的话，和我说一声，好吗？看起来，你至少不算是毫无进展。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: So, between us... all your attempting to break out of here, over and over... you're now authorized to keep that up? Exposing weaknesses in Underworld security, huh.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Something like that. I guess I've gotten pretty decent about escaping from a place that's known for being inescapable. Lets me keep in touch with the other side of the family. Work with you from time to time.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I have to say I never thought I'd hear you talking about looking forward to working, Zag. You feeling all right? Spending too much time on the surface, maybe?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh I'm feeling fine. I never thought I was much good at anything, but... if my fated purpose is to be a master of frustrating Father's efforts to make everything strictly perfect, I think I'm OK with that.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Well, then, I'll be looking forward to working with you in a more official capacity. Even if we're still supposed to keep it all under wraps, for sake of appearances. See you out there.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 想私下和你聊聊……你打算一遍一遍地逃出这个地方。你的行为已经得到正式批准了吗？寻找冥界安保系统的弱点，嗯。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 差不多就是这样吧。这个地方宣称绝对逃不出去，但我已经是逃出这个地方的行家了。我打算和另一边的家人保持联系，时不时地和你一起共事。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 不得不说，我从来没想到会听你说出想工作这种话，扎格。你还好吧？你是不是在地上世界待了太久了？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，我挺好的。我一直以为自己没什么长处，不过……如果我命中注定要和我父亲过不去，成为这方面的行家，好让一切尽善尽美的话，那我觉得我是能接受的。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 很好，我很期待能以更正式的身份与你合作。不过出于面子问题，所有的事情还是必须得保密。那就下次见吧。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Have to tell you, Zag. It's different, with your mother around here. Don't mean to be so obvious, but... it's something about your father, I suppose.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I think they have a lot of work ahead of them. As long as they're trying... he's trying... I think I'm good with that, for now. Though, I am glad she's here.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I'm beginning to think we all are. And, please don't take this the wrong way, but... I think you and your father have a lot of work ahead of you, as well.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 有件事情我得和你说，扎格。你的母亲来了之后，这里一切都不一样了。我不想把话说得这么直，不过……我猜是你的父亲变了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜他们还有很多事情要做呢，只要他们还愿意努力……他还愿意努力……我觉得现在挺好的，我很高兴她能在这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我觉得所有人都很高兴有她在。另外，希望你别误会了我的意思，不过……我觉得你和你父亲之间也有很多要做的事情。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Your mother's very clever, Zagreus. I always thought you got that from your father, now I'm not so sure. So all is well with the Olympians, again?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: For now, I think it is. But, you know how they are. How we all are, I guess.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Hah! Yes, indeed. Well, then! I guess enjoy it while it lasts, as mortals sometimes say. I'll see you out there.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你的母亲非常聪明，扎格列欧斯。我一直以为你的聪明劲儿是从你父亲这里来的，但我现在没那么肯定了。所以，和奥林匹斯众神又重归于好了，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我觉得目前是这样。不过，我猜你也知道他们是什么脾气，我们所有人是什么脾气。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 哈！是啊，没错！我猜，就像凡人们说的那样，及时行乐吧。下次见了。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Such tardiness is oft to be expected from your brother, but from you, Thanatos? You're practically the god of punctuality.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: My lord, I apologize sincerely for the lapse in my performance as of late. I think my duties following the recent war above took more of a toll from me than I expected.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Thanatos, even we gods require rest from time to time. Someday we might get it around here, once this accursed House is well in order, finally. Until then, I appreciate your diligence. Do not overextend yourself.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Thank you, my lord. I am at your service. I'll be getting back to my assignment now.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你兄弟可能经常会迟到，但是你不一样，塔纳托斯。你可以说是守时之神。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 大人，对于我犯下的迟到错误，我深表歉意。我认为我最近跟进观察的凡间战争，其中的消耗远超我的预期。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 塔纳托斯，就算是神也需要时不时休息一下。总有一天我们会让事情正常运转起来，只要等这该死的圣殿修整好。在那之前，我需要你继续努力。但不要累着自己了。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 谢谢您，大人。随时为您效劳。我现在回去工作了。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: ...You have been rather slow about your duties, lately, Thanatos. And I'm receiving incident reports from Tartarus involving you. Remember your responsibilities. And, remember, I am watching you. Now, get out of my sight.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: ……你最近工作很不上心啊，塔纳托斯。我还收到了塔耳塔罗斯的事件报告，里头有你。记住自己该干什么。记住，我一直在关注你。现在，退下吧。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You've been abetting him, Thanatos. Behind my back! Betrayal. I would ask you why. Well?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: My lord, he and I... please. Go lock me up in Tartarus, or deal whichever justice you see fit, but... my loyalty is not subject to change. And I cannot stand by and watch you fight. The matter between you and Zagreus... there has to be some resolution, here.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You dare to lecture me? Tsch. My loyal subjects are too few of late, I think. This is your realm, not mine; I'll not cast you into that wretched pit. It's not like I have someone to replace you here, besides. Now then, begone.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I'm deeply sorry, lord...

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 塔纳托斯，我知道你一直在教唆他。背着我！这是背叛。我想知道为什么。好吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 大人，他和我……拜托。把我关在塔耳塔罗斯吧，或者给我安上你觉得合适的罪名，可……我的忠诚永远不会变。在你们战斗的时候袖手旁观，我做不到。你和扎格列欧斯之间的事情……总要找到解决的方法才是。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你竟敢教训起我来了？啧。对我忠诚的属下怕是越来越少了。这是你的地盘，不是我的；我不会把你丢进那可怕的深渊。再说，没有任何人可以取代你。你退下吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 非常抱歉，大人……

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You wished to see me once again, my lord? It's been... a while since I had an audience with you.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: It has. The last time, what was it you said? That there must be some resolution to the matter, as you called it, with my son? Well it is settled, now. Isn't it, boy?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I mean, you're still trying just as hard as ever to prevent me from escaping past the threshold of your realm, so, I don't know if I'd exactly call the matter settled. But... it does feel different, now.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: And so you see... I would continue in our mutual good graces, if you please. This House can only function if the upper management is in accord. What do you say?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I say, you honor me, my lord. I appreciate you telling me, yourself. And I concur that, for the good of all the Underworld, it is imperative that each of us continue to perform at our full strength.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Then, as you were. Dismissed.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 您又想见我一面了吗，大人？从上次见您到现在，已经……过了很久了。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，我们上次见面的时候你说什么来着？你说，关于我儿子的事情，肯定能找到解决方法，是吧？现在看来，问题已经解决了。是吧，孩子？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我是想说，你依然和以前一样，尽你所能地阻止我逃出你的王国。所以，我也不知道这能不能算是事情都解决了，不过……现在的感觉确实和以前不一样了。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 如你所见……如果你愿意的话，我将继续维持我们共同的利益。这座圣殿只有在高层管理人员达成一致的情况下才能正常运作，你说呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 您的话让我不胜荣幸，大人。我很感谢您能亲口告诉我这些话。我也同意您的看法，为了整个冥界的利益，我们每个人都必须继续全力以赴。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 很好，你一向如此，你可以退下了。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Hypnos, really, that is the worst idea I think I've ever heard. Do you understand how little sense that makes?

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: I'm just saying, maybe if you just, I don't know, had all the mortals die at the same time, it'd save you a bunch of trips, and then we'd have more time to spend together, huh?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I don't know why I bother with you, honestly. Get back to work, and let me do the same.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 修普诺斯，真的，这是我听过最蠢的主意。你知不知道这有多不靠谱？

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 我就是说说，如果你可以，我是说，让所有凡人全部一起死了，那你可不就省不少力气，然后我们就有更多时间在一起了，对不对？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我真不知道我怎么会跟你谈这个。我们都回去工作去吧。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You cannot keep falling asleep on the job like this, Hypnos. This is completely unacceptable.

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh I just nodded off a little while, Thanatos! I rest easy knowing that you're here! But if I goofed, why, I guess you could kill me dead, or something, huh?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Don't give me any ideas. Pull yourself together, and quit slacking off. The House needs help, and you've got a job to do. Now get to it!

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你真的不能在工作的时候像这样打瞌睡了，修普诺斯。你这样真的不行。

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 我只是稍微打个盹儿而已，塔纳托斯！因为你在这里我才这么容易睡着！如果我真的犯蠢了，我想你应该可以直接把我给杀了之类的，对吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你可别帮我出主意。打起精神来，别偷懒了。这圣殿需要帮忙，你也有工作要做，开始做事吧！

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...Hypnos, this list has a bunch of tasks from I don't know how long ago, I mean... I took several of these last year! And you've already submitted this week's registrations, why isn't that marked complete?

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Don't you know it, I was just about to get to that! Then you showed up, and I got so distracted, it just kind of slipped my mind! It happens, right?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You need to focus, Brother. Or it'll be Lord Hades reprimanding you again, and that is not something you want.

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, I don't know about that, last time I talked to Master he made pretty clear he never wanted to speak to me again!

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ………修普诺斯，这份清单上有很多任务我都不知道是多久以前的了，我是说……上面有几件事已经是我去年干过的了！而且你已经做好了这个星期的登记工作，为什么不把它划掉呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，我刚准备把它划掉！然后你就来了，我就分心了，然后我就把这件事给忘了！这种事情也是难免的，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你得专心点才行，兄弟，否则冥王哈迪斯就又要骂你了。我相信你可不想挨骂。

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，这我可说不准。因为我上次去见冥王大人的时候，他已经说得很清楚了，他说他再也不想和我说话了！

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Hypnos, you're not irreplaceable, you understand? If you don't shape up, quickly, someone else is going to have your job.

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh I hear you loud and clear, Thanatos! And, let me tell you, they will have the greatest job in all the Underworld!

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I feel like I'm not getting through to you, Brother. Well, after the inevitable happens, don't come telling me I didn't try.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 修普诺斯，你并不是必不可少的人物，你是明白的吧？如果你不赶紧打起精神来，你的工作就要被别人抢走了。

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，我听得很清楚，塔纳托斯！我告诉你吧，要是真的有人来替我了，他就可以干整个冥界最有意思的工作了！

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我觉得我的话你一点都没听进去，兄弟。好吧，等到时候麻烦来了的话，可别怪我没警告过你。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...Well, how often do you consult these lists you make? If you're spending too much time just making lists, you're not leaving time to get anything done.

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, I love making my lists... I always illustrate the edges, each one is unique! That way anyone who gets to review the work, it's a whole experience, you know? But... I guess it does take up a lot of time.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You'll have to work around the constraints of your responsibilities. You do take breaks, don't you? Before and after each break, maybe that's a time to make sure your own list of priorities is up-to-date.

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Wait, my own list of priorities...? But, you're saying I can just go and make a list... for me? Huh. Whoa. Whoa....

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……我想问，你花在检查清单上面的时间有多少？如果你总是花很多时间来看清单的话，那你根本没时间去做事情。

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，我就是喜欢列清单……我总会阐述这些事项，每个事项都是独一无二的！这样别人在检查成果的时候，就会明白每件事的来龙去脉了，是吧？不过……我猜这确实耽误了不少时间。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 您必须得想办法做好你分内的事情。你时不时会休息一下，是吧？或许在每次休息前后，你应该确保你自己做事的优先列表都有好好更新过。

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 等等，我自己的优先事项列表吗……？你指的是，我可以列一个……我自己的列表吗？呃，哇啊，哇哦……

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I've heard that your reports have been immaculate of late, Hypnos. I have to know, who's helping you with them? It can't be Zagreus.

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, haha, no, he doesn't help. It's just I took to listing only the important stuff up top, and spending just a bit more time on the priority reports, and... guess it's working out!

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Look, whatever the case... the work's improved. It's been observed. You ought to keep it up.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我听说你最近的工作汇报非常出色，修普诺斯。你必须告诉我，到底是谁在帮你？肯定不是扎格列欧斯吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，哈哈，不是，他可没帮忙。我只是列了个列表，把重要的事情排在了前面，花更多时间在优先度比较高的报告上，结果……你看，就做得很好！

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 听着，虽然我不知道是怎么回事……但你工作成效提高了，大家也都看在眼里。你得坚持下去。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...Though, what I mean to say is, that... I'm sorry, Hypnos. You're my brother, but I haven't always treated you that way. Would you be willing to forgive me?

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Aww, come on, Thanatos, are you kidding me, right here? We're like two skeletons in a crypt! You're the best, and you're always looking out for me. Even when you're not around for what can seem like aeons at a time!

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Well let's not get ahead of ourselves, here. We each have got important jobs to do. Isn't that right, Brother?

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……不过，我想说的是……我很抱歉，修普诺斯。你是我的兄弟，但我一直以来都没把你当成过兄弟，你可以原谅我吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哎哟，别这样，塔纳托斯，你是在和我开玩笑吧？我们简直是穿一条裤子的好兄弟！你是我最出色的兄弟，也一直都在好好照顾我。就算你已经不知多长时间没来找过我了，我也这么觉得！

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，咱们还是先别说得太远了吧。咱们都有重要的事情要做，是这样吧，兄弟？

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...Congratulations, Brother! I saw you finally made the board. You made us proud.

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Sure did! That's something, huh? Though, sorry Thanatos, can't really chat right now, the shades are stacking up, there's greetings to be done, and sign-ins... lots of work to do, you know?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I definitely know the feeling. Well then, let's keep it up, the both of us, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……恭喜你，兄弟！我注意到你终于改头换面了，我们都为你感到骄傲。

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 没错！我还真厉害，是吧？不过抱歉，塔纳托斯，我现在没时间聊天。幽灵们一直在涌过来，我得一个一个接待他们，帮他们登记……有很多工作要做，你明白的吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我很明白这种感觉。好吧，那我们两个都保持住这种劲头，好吗？

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Mother, is there something I can do to help, with all of this? I spend too much time away from the House. Please, let me know.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You are already doing what you can to help, my son. Continue doing so. Matters are at stake here concerning you and all of us. Your support and choices in this shape the outcome that shall come to pass.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I understand, and I will do my best. Thank you for taking care of everything. I've every faith in you, Mother. And in this House. Farewell.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 母亲，发生了这些事情，我能帮上什么忙吗？我离开圣殿太久了，还请您示下。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你已经帮了不少忙了，我的孩子。继续这样做就好了。目前正是紧要关头，你的支持和选择将会影响事情的结果。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 明白了，我会全力以赴的。谢谢您对所有事情的关照。母亲，我相信您，相信这座圣殿。再见了。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Am I imagining it, Mother, or has this House been running relatively smoothly as of late? Although I know I must be tempting the Three Fates by putting it like this.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: It is through a concerted effort that the House thus thrives, for now. Though, it shall do so only through continued diligence on your behalf, and that of many others here. It is a good occasion to take brief reprieve. But we need you working to the best of your ability, here, Thanatos.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Well... know that I am ever-grateful, Mother. And I love you very much. Where would we be right now if not for you? I don't take what you've done for us for granted, nor does anybody here. You rest assured.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 是我的错觉吗，母亲？还是说，这座圣殿里的气氛确实变得缓和了？虽然我明白，我这么说会让命运三女神情不自禁地想插手。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 是所有人的共同努力，才让这座圣殿欣欣向荣的，至少目前如此。不过，只有你和这里的很多其他人持之以恒地努力工作，才能让这个势头维持下去。这种时候很适合稍微休息一番，但我们这里依然需要你尽最大的努力才行，塔纳托斯。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我明白……希望你知道，我永远感激你，母亲，我也非常爱你。要不是你，我们现在会在什么地方呢？你为我们所做的一切，我都不会当做理所当然，这里的其他人也不会这么想。请你放心吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...But that was then and this is now, and we have work to do.... Uh, anyway, Than, I think we'd best continue this discussion at some other time.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You're interrupting private conversation, Zagreus. Leave us.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: No, let him stay, if that's what he wants. What does it matter? He's technically allowed within these halls, but he must know he isn't welcome anymore.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……但此一时彼一时，我们还有事情要做……啊，好了，塔纳，我们最好再找时间讨论这个话题。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你打断了私人谈话，扎格列欧斯。走开。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 不，如果他想留下的话，就让他留下。有什么不妥吗？他本来就可以在这里自由出入，但是他要知道，他早已经不受欢迎了。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Queen Persephone. All of us, we are most pleased you're back. If there is anything that I can do to ease your acclimation to this House, you need but ask.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Why, thank you, Thanatos! I'll take you up on that if I can think of anything anytime soon. But my, you've grown! I understand you've been looking after my son, in the meantime?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Your son, he... is very capable of looking after himself, it turns out. Although I try to be there, just in case. Though, I must beg your pardon, Queen. Someone awaits me on the surface now.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 珀尔塞福涅冥后，我们所有人都很高兴您能回来。如果有什么可以帮助您适应这座神殿的话，您尽管开口。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 哦，谢谢你，塔纳托斯！如果有什么事情需要你帮忙的话，我会向你开口的。不过，天啊，你都长这么大了！我猜，这段时间里，你肯定一直都在照顾我的儿子吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 您的儿子，他……看起来很擅长照顾自己。不过我也会在他身边，以防万一。不过请允许我先行告退，冥后，地面上还有一些事情在等着我处理。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...I thank you for your blessings, Queen Persephone. Your son and I... we always were quite close, but through all this ordeal, we've become rather inseparable, I think.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Well, I can see that he has better taste than I do, Thanatos! I have a sense of how industrious you are. You just take care of yourself, please. And take care of each other, too, all right?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: As you will, Queen. I mean, all right.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……谢谢您的祝福，珀尔塞福涅冥后。您的儿子和我……我们的关系一直都很亲密。不过一起经历了这些磨难之后，我觉得，我们的感情已经变得密不可分了。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 是吗，看得出来，他比我挑人的品味可好多了，塔纳托斯！我感觉得到你是多么勤奋的人。希望你能照顾好自己，也希望你们两个都能照顾好对方，好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 如您所愿，冥后。我是说，没问题。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Sorry, Zagreus, I have to go. Lots of assignments as of late. Too bad I can't be everywhere at once.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 不好意思，扎格列欧斯，我得走了。最近工作特别忙。我是真的分身乏术啊。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: No use in making idle chat, right, Zagreus?

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 闲聊是最没用的，对吧，扎格列欧斯？

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I have a job to do, and you've no interest in remaining here. See you around out there.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我有工作要做，没兴趣跟你说话。我们外头见。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Don't bother, Zagreus. I was just leaving.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 没事，扎格列欧斯。我正要离开。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I hope you've thought through all of this. For both our sakes.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 看在我俩的份上，我希望你已经想明白这些事情了。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I can't keep bailing you out each time you get in over your head.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我不可能每次都帮你摆脱困境。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I have to say it's quite a mess you've gotten yourself into, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我得说，你确实让自己陷入了不小的麻烦，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You better know what you're doing.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你最好知道你在做什么。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You're wasting your time. Just go.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你在浪费时间。走吧。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Shouldn't you be back out there by now, getting yourself killed?

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你不是应该去外面，让自己死上几次吗？

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You know how much trouble I am getting myself into here?

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道我现在有多少麻烦要处理吗？

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: There's nothing left for us to talk about.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我们现在没什么好说的。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Don't talk to me. Just go.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 别说话。走。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Excuse me, I've got work to do.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 不好意思，我有事。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Not now, I have to go.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 现在不行，我得走了。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I don't know what you want from me.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我不知道你想要我干什么。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I have to get back to my responsibilities.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我得继续工作了。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You are in so much trouble.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你真是麻烦不断啊。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You watch yourself out there.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你在外头注意安全。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Take care of yourself.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你自己保重。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I'll see you out there, I guess.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我想，我们外头再见吧。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I hope all this is worth it.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我希望这一切都值得。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: We'll meet again out there.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我们会在外头再见的。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I hope you know what you're doing.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我希望你知道自己在做什么。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Can't talk right now, I have to get to work.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 现在不行，我要工作。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I need to get to work. I'll see you later.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我得工作了，回头见。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Your father's going to have my hide.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你父亲会找我麻烦的。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I am in so much trouble, you have no idea...

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你是真不知道我有多少麻烦要处理…

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: What have I gotten myself into, Zag...

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我到底让自己怎么了，扎格…

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Much as I would like to stay and chat, I'd better go.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 尽管我很想留下来聊聊天，但我还是走吧。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Zag, I've got so many mortals on my plate right now...

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 扎格，现在我手头上有好多凡人……

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: See you out there soon enough, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我们外面见，好吗？

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: If you stay out too long, I'm going to track you down.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 如果你在外面太长时间，我就去把你抓回来。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Sounds like we've both been keeping plenty busy as of late.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 听起来我们最近都很忙。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Now that you're here, I can finally head out.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 既然你来了，我终于可以出去了。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: We'll have to catch up more some other time.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我们改天再找时间好好聊吧。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Sorry Zag, I'm due to get a bunch of mortals now.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 对不起，扎格。我现在要去多抓些凡人了。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Excuse me, Zag, just got word that I'm needed back up top.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 不好意思，扎格，刚刚得到消息，上面需要我。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Hope your father's going to be all right with all of this.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 希望你的父亲可以好好处理这些事。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: We showed those wretches last time, didn't we.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我们上次不是教训过那些暗灵吗？

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Good running into you out there, and glad you made it out.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 很高兴能在外面遇到你，很高兴你成功了。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Impressive that you went the distance once again.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你可以再次走得这么远，太让我钦佩了。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Was good having an opportunity to back you up out there.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 能有机会在外面为你提供支援，我很高兴。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I heard you did good work out there last time.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我听说你上次在外面干得不错。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: The shades are murmuring about your latest exploits, Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 暗灵都在私下流传着你最近的功绩，扎格。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Don't have a lot of time for catching up right now, here, Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我现在没时间和你在这里叙旧，扎格。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You're not in too much of a hurry, are you, Zag?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Well then... some mortal up there's lived a good, long life.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你不赶时间吧，扎格？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 那么……上面有些凡人活得很好，寿命很长。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Mind if I practice my ability to shift short distances with someone else?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Well... I'd say that test was a success, wouldn't you?

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 介意我展现一下和其他人一起瞬移的本事吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯…我自己觉得这次试验很成功，你说呢？

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I have to shift away from here, though if you'd care to join me...

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Too bad I can't just shift you to the top, though this wasn't so bad.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我要瞬移离开这里，你想和我一起吗……

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 糟糕，我没办法把你瞬移到上面去，其实也没那么糟糕。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Hey let's get out of here for just a bit, all right?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Whew. Thanks for the break, now back to it, I guess.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，我们离开这里一会儿，好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 呼。谢谢你给我这个休息的机会，现在继续吧。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Was just about to go on break, if you would care to join me.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Good catching up. Take care of yourself, Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我正要休息，如果你愿意和我一起的话。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 很高兴和你叙叙旧。你自己保重，扎格。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I think you'd better head back to your quarters, Zagreus.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Mm. I'd best get back to my responsibilities for now.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我觉得你最好还是回自己住处，扎格列欧斯。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 唔。我现在最好重新肩负起自己的责任。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: This is a private chat, if you'll excuse us, Zag.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: We'll see you later out there, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 这是私人谈话，你可以回避一下吗，扎格？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我们外面见，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Just catching up on things with Megaera here, Zag.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: We were just talking about you, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 刚刚和墨纪拉在这里叙旧呢，扎格。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我们还谈到你了，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Well if it isn't our mutual friend.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Enjoy the peace and quiet with us, Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 谁让她是我们俩共同的好朋友呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 和我们一起享受祥和宁静吧，扎格。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Just catching up with Thanatos, if you don't mind.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Discussing work-related matters, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 如果你不介意的话，我刚才和塔纳托斯聊了一会儿。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我们在讨论和工作有关的事情，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Look who it is, Than. Zagreus.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: We've been comparing notes about our latest tasks.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 看看那是谁，塔纳。扎格列欧斯。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我们就最近的任务交换了一些想法。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: We're in the middle of a conversation, Zag.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Catch up with you some other time, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我们正在说话呢，扎格。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 改天再和你说，可以吗？

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...Looks like you have everything under control. Nice work, Hypnos.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……看起来你已经把一切都办好了。干得漂亮，修普诺斯。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...Plenty of time for sleeping once your shift is over, right, Brother?

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……等你把事情忙完之后，就有很多时间可以睡觉了。是吧，兄弟？

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...Heard your latest reports were looking good, Hypnos. You keep it up.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……我听说你最近的表现很不错，修普诺斯，再接再厉。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...Anyway, good catching up, Hypnos.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……总之，你很有进步，修普诺斯。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...That's the last of the new registrations, but I should have more soon.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……新来的就是这些了，不过我很快会带另一批人来。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...All right, I'd better get going. Take care, Brother.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……好了，我得出发了。多保重，兄弟。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...Looks like you have everything under control. Nice work, Hypnos.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……看起来你已经把一切都办好了。干得漂亮，修普诺斯。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...Looks like you have everything under control. Nice work, Hypnos.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……看起来你已经把一切都办好了。干得漂亮，修普诺斯。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: ...We have another task for you.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: As you will, Mother. It will be done immediately, then.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: ……我们有另一个任务要交给你。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 如您所愿，母亲，我会立刻把这件事情办好。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...Understood, Mother. Commencing the assignment now.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……我明白了，母亲，我马上着手去办。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: ...Your expertise is needed once again.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Then, very well, Mother. I'll begin right away, and be back soon.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: ……我们又需要你的专业技术了。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 好的，了解了，母亲。我马上动身，很快就能回来。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...I hear you, Mother, and obey. I will return when the task is complete.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……我愿按照您的意思行事，母亲。等事情做好了，我就回来。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Thank you for thinking of me for this task. I'll make it happen shortly.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 谢谢您考虑我来做这件事情，我会尽快把事情办好。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...The task is clear to me, Mother. I go. Your will be done.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……我清楚了，母亲。我要走了，您吩咐的事情会做好的。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...It shall be as you say, my lord. I will report back soon.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……如您所愿，大人，我很快就会向您禀报。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...Yes, my lord. I will begin, and not return until the deed is done.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……没问题，大人。我立刻去办，事情办好之前是不会回来的。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...If that is all, my lord, then I will make way for the surface now.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……如果就是这样，大人，那我立刻前往地上世界。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...I understand, my lord. I know where they are and soon shall bring them here.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……我明白了，大人。我知道他们在哪，马上就把他们带回来。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...I do appreciate your faith in me, my lord. Begging your pardon, please.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……很感谢您的信任，大人，请容我告退。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...This matter will be dealt with promptly, lord. I expect to return shortly.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……这件事情我会妥善处理的，大人，我马上就回来。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It isn't much, Than, but I got you something.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You want me to take that off your hands, fine. But you are taking this from me, and if anybody asks, we're even. Or, scratch that, don't tell anyone about this, understand?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 虽然不是很多，塔纳，但是我有东西要给你。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你想让我从你手上拿走吗，行。但是你得从我这里接受这个，这样别人问的时候就知道，我俩都不欠谁的。或者，别这样，谁也别告诉，知道吗？

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: What, really...? Come on, what is this, Zagreus. You think handing this to me makes up for everything you've put us through?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's just something I found out there that I thought you might like, Than. Don't think anything of it.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 什么，真的…？不是吧，这是什么，扎格列欧斯。你觉得把这个给我就能弥补你一直以来给我们找的麻烦吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 只不过是我在外面找到的东西，我想你可能会喜欢的，塔纳。可别想多了。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Why bother with such empty gestures, Zag. You've said you're getting out of here; best focus on that and leave me be.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's not an empty gesture, Than. Besides, if I wasn't trying to stay focused, I'd be drinking it myself.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 为何要做这种没有意义的事情，扎格。你既然说你要离开这里，那就好好去做，别管我。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这可不是没意义，塔纳。另外，如果我不是好好做我自己的事，我早就把它喝了。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You shouldn't be doing this, Zag. You picked sides, and things are not the same. A momentary stab at thoughtfulness can't fix something like that.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: We've been through a lot, Than, and I think we'll be going through a lot more yet. Consider it a token of our kinship.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你真的不用这样做，扎格。既然你站了边，事情就不一样了。解决那样的问题一定费了你不少心思。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我们经历了很多，塔纳，我觉得以后还要经历更多事。就把他当作是我们亲情的象征吧。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Don't know what you're expecting, giving this to me. If there's a catch here, I don't want to know.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: We've been through a lot, Than, and I think we'll be going through a lot more yet. Consider it a token of our kinship.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我不知道你在想什么，才把这个东西给我。如果你在打什么主意的话，我可不想知道。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我们经历了很多，塔纳，我觉得以后还要经历更多事。就把他当作是我们亲情的象征吧。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: What is it with the generosity lately...? Look I'll just stash this with the rest if you really don't have a better thing to do with it than dump it off on me.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, that's an idea. One of these days or nights, we'll have enough of this stuff to throw a feast to make all of Olympus jealous.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 最近怎么这么大方了…？如果你除了把这东西给我以外，没其他可做的，那我就只好把这些东西都存起来了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这主意不错。总有一天，我们会有足够多的这些东西，全拿出来摆宴席，羡煞奥林匹斯众神。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You can't be serious. You're serious...? Eh, you know what, fine. I'll take this and we'll go about our business. Though I don't see why you bother.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Why I bother? Why, how else can I show you how I feel except by handing you these bottles from time to time?

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你没开玩笑吧…你认真的…？呃还是算了，我收下这个，然后我们就各干各事去吧。但我还是不明白你为何这样。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 为何？除了时不时给你带来这些东西之外，我还能怎样表达自己的心情呢？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey Than. For all the times you've bailed me out, and just, all the times you've been around for me... I thought I'd get you this. The real thing.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Ambrosia...! Zagreus, where did you even... don't you think this is a bit excessive?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You say that like it's a bad thing. Little bit of excess from time to time never hurt anyone I'm sure.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Oh, you would be surprised. Though if you're going to embarrass me, you know what, I am going to reciprocate. Behold!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，塔纳。每次都是你救我出来，每次你总是守护在我身边……我只能给你这个。货真价实的好东西。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 是仙馔密酒……！扎格列欧斯，你是从哪里……你不觉得这有点太奢侈了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你的口气就好像它不是什么好东西一样。偶尔奢侈一下是不会有什么坏处的，我向你保证。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，我会让你大吃一惊的。虽然让你这么破费，不过我也会给你一份回礼，好好看着吧！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: For you, Thanatos. The Olympians might be accustomed to this stuff but I think we should have our share of it down here. At least you should.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You know... the Olympians do have good taste in certain things. The last bottle you gave me... it was... better than expected. Though, I almost decided not to try it at all.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: But try it you did! And now, you'll get to try this one for comparison's sake. Each one's supposed to be different you know.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Different, huh. Well, then, I guess I'll have to see what you mean by that. Thank you, Zag. You didn't have to do this.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这是给你的，塔纳托斯。奥林匹斯的众神可能已经喝惯了这种东西，不过我觉得，我们也应该尝尝才对，至少你应该尝尝。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 不得不说……奥林匹斯的众神在这方面很有眼光。你之前给的我那瓶蜜酒……味道比我想象得还要好。不过，我已经差不多下定决心要戒酒了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 再喝一口嘛！再尝一口，就当是比较一下味道吧。你知道吧，每一瓶蜜酒的味道都不一样。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 不一样吗，哈，好吧，那我就试试你说的“不一样”是什么意思吧。谢谢你，扎格，你真不用这么破费。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I hope you're ready for some more of the real thing, there, Than, because I got you some, and I won't be taking 'Tsch, what is this, Zag' for an answer.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Ugh, what is this? Come on, already, Zagreus, are you just messing with me, now? How did you even manage to get more of this, much less decide to hand it off to me?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: In order: no, I'm not; by ransacking my father's realm repeatedly; and it's because I like you, Thanatos. In case you still have some misgivings about that.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: You like me, Zagreus...? I never thought, I... don't know why that sounds so strange, coming from you. Given everything that's happened as of late.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Yeah. Look, if you don't feel the same way about me at this point, I would rather know. Cease all these coy gift exchanges, and all that.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I never said anything like that! You know what, there's... a bunch of mortals I have to go fetch. Good-bye.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我希望你能够找到货真价实的东西，塔纳，因为我可以给你一些，而且我保证你在看到以后不会做出“啧，这是什么，扎格”这样的反应。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，这是什么？拜托，扎格列欧斯，你是在和我捣乱吗？如果你刚刚得到什么好东西，怎么可能就这么草率地决定送给我？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 为了……哦，不，这是我在不停洗劫我的父亲的地盘时找到的，而且因为我喜欢你，塔纳托斯。如果还有疑虑，那真的是大可不必。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 你喜欢我，扎格列欧斯……？我从来没想过这种事情，我……不知道为什么，这句话从你嘴里说出来很奇怪，尤其是考虑到最近发生的事情。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是吗。现在的情况是，如果你对我并没有相同的感觉，就让我知道你的真实想法。不要再这样扭扭捏捏地交换什么礼物了。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我从来没说过这样的话！你知道吗，还有很多凡人……等着我去抓。再见。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Thanatos, I wanted to apologize for the last time I approached you with a bottle of the real thing, and give the whole exchange another shot. Would that be all right?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Hmph! You're asking my consent to give me yet another lavish gift? Sure! Permission granted. Though, what makes you think that your approach this time is going to be any more successful than the last?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I don't know that it will. I never really know exactly where I stand with you. But I know how I feel. And I'd rather be up front with you, even if it means risking our relationship, such as it is.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: Our relationship? It wasn't long ago you were prepared to throw it all away while making for the surface, if you don't recall. But now you're saying that you care for me, and... what, exactly, Zagreus?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Yes, that's what I'm saying, Than. I should not have left the way I did, without letting you know. But when you found me, I... think that's when... that's when I knew. Or started to realize, you know?

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I... yes. I know, I think, because... when I heard you took off, the anger that I felt, it was... it wasn't something I expected. So... ungh. What do we do now?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Maybe we ought to take our time? Unlike the real thing there, that's a commodity we have in good supply. Just know that, if you feel the way I do... you know where to find me. And if not... I'm grateful, anyway.

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: ...I see. Well, then. The best that I can say for now is that... I'm grateful, too, for this. Take care of yourself, Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 塔纳托斯，我想为上次给你的那瓶所谓的货真价实的东西道歉，要不我们再交换一次礼物吧。可以吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 唔！你在征求我的同意，要给我一件很好的礼物吗？行！我答应你了。不过，是什么让你这么有信心这次会比上次更加成功呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我也没把握。我根本不知道自己在你心中的位置。但我很清楚自己的感受，所以我宁愿和你直说，即使冒着和你的关系破裂的风险，就像现在这样。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我们的关系？如果你不记得了，让我来提醒你。不久前为了回到阳间，你还把它抛在脑后。而现在，你竟然说你在乎我，你……究竟要干什么，扎格列欧斯？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是的，我真的在乎你，塔纳。我不应该不辞而别。但就在你找到我的时候，我……就是那个时候……那个时候我才明白，或者开始意识到，你懂我的意思吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我……知道。我知道，因为……当时听说你走了，我心里非常气恼……自己都控制不了。所以……呃。那我们现在怎么办？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 也许我们应该慢慢来？不像那个所谓货真价实的东西，它只不过是件随处可见的商品罢了。别忘了……如果你和我有同样的感受……你就会知道在哪里可以找到我。如果没有……我还是很感激。

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: ……我知道了。好吧……我现在可以说的，也只有感激而已。你自己保重，扎格。

en.speaker: Thanatos
en.text: I have to hand it to you, Zag, you're really putting in the work to get me to forgive you after all you've done. I'm honestly surprised.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Don't be. That feast of ours is really going to be something, Than.

zh-CN.speaker: 塔纳托斯
zh-CN.text: 我一定要把这个给你，扎格，你为了让我能原谅你做过的事，可真是下了番工夫啊。说真的，我很吃惊。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不用不用。你说的那宴席，一定能成，塔纳。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: ...Thought you could just get away from me, did you?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Thanatos. I figured it was only a matter of time before Father sent you after me to do his dirty work.

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Zagreus. Is that really why you think I'm here? Let's see how many of these exalted champions you can send back to their dooms, unless you'd rather I would send you back to yours.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: ……你难不成就想这样摆脱我了？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 塔纳托斯。我早知道，父亲派你来阻止我，恐怕只是时间问题。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，你真的以为我是因为这个才来的吗？我们来看看你能对付多少位英灵战士吧，除非你更希望我送你上路。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Barely caught up with you, here, Zag. You must have had a little help from Hermes, I suppose.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 在这里很少听到你的消息呀，扎格。我猜肯定是赫尔墨斯在帮助你。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: You have the butterfly I gave to you. Stay back, then, and it'll make you stronger once I'm finished here.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 你还带着我送给你的蝴蝶呢。好吧，离远点，等我这边的事情忙完之后，它就会让你变得更加强大了。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Got little Mort with you, there, huh. Well, there's no need to summon me this time.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 你已经有那个小莫特了，呵。好吧，看来你这次不用再召唤我了。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: You're back. I thought you made it out. No matter.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 你回来了。我还以为你逃出去了呢，不过不要紧。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Good to be working with you in a more official capacity, Zag. Shall we get started?

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 很高兴能以更正式的身份和你合作，扎格。那咱们可以开始了吗？

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Thought I might find you all the way out here. Although, quite frankly, I'm surprised you're still alive.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I can hold my own in case you haven't noticed, Than.

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: I haven't, Zag! Now, stand back, and let me show you how it's done.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我就知道能在外头看到你。不过，看到你还活着我也蛮惊讶的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 也许你不知道，我还是有两把刷子的，塔纳。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我确实不知道，扎格！往后站，让专业的来。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Still at it, I see. You're stubborn. And you are going to get me in a heap of trouble before all is said and done.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 仍需努力。你太固执了。只要你还在，就能给我惹一大堆麻烦。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: How about another of our little contests, Zagreus?

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我们再来一场小比赛好不好，扎格列欧斯？

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: We'll have to catch up at some other time. Though good to see you anyway.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我们得另找时间叙旧了。不过还是很高兴见到你。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: I have a feeling this is not going to take much time at all.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我有预感，这场战斗很快就会结束。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: I only have a little time until my next assignment, but this shouldn't take too long.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 在下个工作前，我只有一点点时间，不过这场战斗应该很快就会结束。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Thought I might stop by and check up on this corner of the Underworld, Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我觉得我该顺便来看看这个角落的情况，扎格。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: You've come this far, now let's make sure you go the distance, Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 你走了这么远的路，千万可别功亏一篑，扎格。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: I heard there was a matter that required my attention here.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我听说这边有件事需要我的注意。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Had a feeling I would find you all alone out here.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我就知道会碰到你一个人在这里。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Want to stand back and watch me work, here, Zag?

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 想傻站着观战吗，扎格？

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: This one is off the record, Zagreus. Come on!

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 这场战斗不会被我写到工作记录里，扎格列欧斯。来吧！

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Looks like we've got an urgent work-related matter to attend to.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我们好像有一件和工作有关的事亟需处理。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Your father's forces making trouble for you, Zag?

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 你父亲的手下给你带来麻烦了吗，扎格？

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Not a word of this to anyone back home, you hear me, Zagreus?

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 这里的事回去对谁都不能说，知道吗，扎格列欧斯？

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: I heard you got yourself into another mess that needed cleaning up.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我听说你又给自己惹了其他麻烦。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: We'll catch up later, now let's deal with these wretches and be done.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 以后再说，现在该对付这些可怜的暗灵了。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Hope you don't mind if I cut in, here, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 希望你不介意我也参与进来，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: What say we go take care of business here just like we used to, Zag?

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我们就像以前一样在这里把事情搞定怎么样，扎格？

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: I can't stay long, so how about we get this business over with.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我不能待太久，所以我们就快点吧。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Figured you'd be up to have another of our little contests. Now let's go.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我想你应该会再来一次我俩之间的小比赛吧。来吧。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: What do you say we deal some death together, Zagreus?

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我们联手对付这些亡灵怎么样，扎格列欧斯？

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Don't have much time, but let me see if I can pitch in.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我时间不多，不过我应该可以帮忙。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Remember, not a word of this, to anyone. Let's go.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 记住，这里的事情对谁都不能说。上吧。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: You look like you could use a hand.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 你看上去需要帮助啊。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Let's see who's better at this, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我们来一较高下吧，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: I got the feeling you could use some backup here.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我感觉你需要支援。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Let's get this done.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 好了，把这件事做好吧。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Good, I'm not too late. Got here as quickly as I could.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 还好，我没有迟到太久。我可是快马加鞭才赶过来的。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: I got the message that you need assistance, Zagreus?

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我收到消息说你需要帮忙啊，扎格列欧斯？

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: You left, without so much as telling me good-bye. I suppose you knew I'd catch up with you sooner or later, is that it? No escaping death, and all?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I left when it was necessary, Than. I thought of you and hoped you'd understand. I have to do this.

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: That's more motivation than I've ever heard from you. Well, if you won't say it, I'll say it. Good-bye, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 你就这样一声不吭地走了。大概你早就知道我早晚会追上你，是不是？你不是在逃避死亡，对吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我是因为有必要才离开的，塔纳。我的确想到了你，但我希望你能理解。我必须这样做。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 这是我从你那里听到的最动人的话了。既然你不想说，那就我来说吧。再见，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: I've got to hand it to you, Zag. You're easy to track down. The shades of Tartarus are beginning to fear you even more than your Lord Father.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh they won't fear me once they get to know me.

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: I'm not so sure about that. Even I'm beginning to fear you, I think. Seems I don't know you as well as I thought.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我真是要表扬你一下，扎格。你实在是太容易找了。比起你的父亲大人，塔耳塔罗斯的暗灵现在要更怕你了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，如果他们了解我的话，就不会怕我了。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 这我可不敢肯定。我发现就连我也开始怕你了。看样子我是不够了解你喽？

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: What's with the look? You had your hands full, now you don't thanks to me... Tsch, seems I'm left to thanking myself, since you're too proud to do it.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 你这是什么表情？你正忙得不可开交呢，不用谢谢我…哧，看来我得谢谢我自己了，因为你好像不屑于这样做。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: You seemed a little winded, there, no? Not even close to the surface, yet, either.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Thanks for the vote of confidence there, Than.

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: You're very welcome. Now, I'd better get back, before Lord Hades catches on to this.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 你好像有点喘啊，是不是？咱们离凡界还远着呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 谢谢你的鼓励，塔纳。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 不客气。我现在该回去了，在冥王哈迪斯发现之前。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I told you I don't need your help here, Thanatos.

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: It wasn't being offered. Just happened to be in the area is all. Carry on, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我说了我真的不需要你帮我，塔纳托斯。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我也不是有意要帮你。我只是恰好路过这里而已。继续吧，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Still running from yourself, I see. How's that been working out for you thus far?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm searching for my mother. You still live at home with yours. You don't know what it's like.

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Mother Nyx was like a mother to you, too. And this is how you repay her. You should be ashamed of yourself, and learn your place.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 真是个嘴硬的人。最近事情进展的怎么样了？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 在寻找我的母亲。你跟自己的母亲住在一块。你不会理解的。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我母亲倪克斯，对你来说也同样是母亲啊。你就这样报答她吗？你应该为自己感到羞耻，注意你的身份。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Listen to me. I don't know how else to put this, but, I want you to come home. Voluntarily. It's not just you swept up in all this nonsense now. And, I know you didn't ask for me to get involved, but, what did you expect?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...Than. Home is never going to be the same for me. There's no use trying to pretend. I have to go.

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: You don't have to do anything of the sort. You have no idea how good you've had it here. Maybe someday you'll come to understand.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 听我说。我不知道该怎么说，但是，我希望你可以回家。自愿回来。现在不光是你卷入了这些事情中了。我知道你没有让我也参与进来，但是，我还能怎么办呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: …塔纳。这个家再不能回到从前了。再怎么掩饰都没用。我得走了。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 你不必做这种事的。你真的不知道你在这里有多自在。也许有一天你可以理解。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Outdid me once again, there, huh. Tsch. I have to admit, you're not as bad at all of this as I expected. First I found you, I was certain that you had no chance at all.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I seem to have this whole easy-to-underestimate thing about me, based on a decent sum of my relationships. In any case, I always welcome your appearances out here. I know it's not been easy for you, Than.

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: That's fair as an assessment, I would say. But then again, it's never been an easy time for me. I know I have to do my job. But I don't have to keep on helping you, like this.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...What, you're telling me this is it? You're just going to leave me to my own devices, then, I've proved myself to you, something like that?

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: No, you deadbeat, I am telling you the opposite! Why do you think I keep on showing up? You may not really need me, Zagreus, but I will take these opportunities to help. I take it that's all right.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 你又赢了，呵。唉，我不得不承认，你并没有我想象得那么差劲。刚见到你的时候，我很确定你根本不是我的对手。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 根据以往的人际经验，我好像很容易被低估。不管怎样，欢迎你随时来这里。我知道这对你来说不容易，塔纳。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 可以说，这是非常公正的评价。但对我来说，并不是什么轻松的事情。我知道，有些事我必须去做。但我没有义务一直帮你，像现在这样。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: ……什么？你是说就这样了吗？我不是已经向你证明自己了吗，你怎么还是要离我而去，你什么意思？

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 当然不是，你这赖皮狗，跟你说的恰恰相反！你以为我一次次出现是为了什么？你也许并不需要我的帮助，扎格列欧斯。但是，只要有机会我还是会帮你的。这肯定是没的说。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Good to see you taking little Mort there on one of your strolls. Means I can better keep an eye on you out there.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: He's been great to have around, for sure. Still can't believe you found him after all this time! You used to always carry him around, I was so sad for you when he got lost.

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: And I cannot believe you still remember that. Regardless, he will not be getting lost again under your supervision, accurate?

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 很高兴看到你带着小莫特出去散心。这样我就可以更好地留意你的一举一动。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 毫无疑问，他的确是个不错的同伴。很难想象在经历这么多事情之后，你竟然能够找到他！以前你总是把他带在身边，当时听说你把他弄丢了，我也很难过。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我简直无法相信你竟然还记得这些。不管怎样，在你的照看下，他不会再把他弄丢了，我说得对吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: About when we last spoke. I care about you, Thanatos. A lot. Though, you asked what you are to me... how am I supposed to even answer that?

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Ugh, I don't know. Sometimes I miss not feeling anything. Can't always trust what feelings say. I get to thinking, are we only friends, or... look, this is embarrassing.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: To think discussing feelings would be even harder than annihilating Father's forces. But... I've been asking myself the same thing, Than. If it's any reassurance.

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Well, if you come up with any answers, I guess let me know. Good running into you.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 关于我们之前聊过的事情，我很在乎你，塔纳托斯，非常在乎。不过你问我，对我来说，你究竟是什么呢……我该怎么回答你这个问题呢？

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 呃，我也不清楚。有的时候，我怀念什么感情都没有的那段日子，毕竟感觉不是总能靠得住的。我有时候会想，我们仅仅是朋友而已吗，还是说……哎，这真是太让人尴尬了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 想想看把，讨论感情问题比对抗我父亲的力量还要困难。不过……我也一直在问自己同样的问题，塔纳，不知这么说能不能让你宽慰点。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 好吧，如果你想到了答案的话，就告诉我一声吧。能遇到你，我很高兴。

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Hey. I didn't mean to lay the guilt on you for what you did for Orpheus, Zag. I just worry when we get involved... we can make matters worse.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You haven't ever made anything worse, Than. But as for me, I realized what you meant. I was so eager to do something for Orpheus when I first met Eurydice, I... never asked them if it was OK.

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: At least things turned out well for them. But that was fortunate. Family troubles, personal relations, and the like... it's sensitive business. Though, who am I to talk. You didn't ask me to show up, like this.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你对俄耳甫斯做的那件事情，我倒不是想把锅甩到你头上，扎格。只是我们插手的时候，我会很担心……我们可能会把事情搞砸了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你从来都没搞砸过什么事情，塔纳。可至于我嘛，我明白你是什么意思了。第一次见到欧律狄刻的时候，我实在是太想为俄耳甫斯做些什么了，我……我都没问过他们想不想让我这么做。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 幸好最后的结果很好，但那不过是我们运气好罢了。家族矛盾、人际关系……像这样的事情往往都是清官难断的。不过我又哪有资格说你呢，我也是自顾自地就这么跑出来了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Than, are you OK? I mean, with everything, lately?

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: I am. Though, thanks for asking, Zag. The risk of being close with anyone is sometimes things get complicated, fast. Admittedly it's not a risk I often take, but... in your case, it's been worth it, all in all. We're good, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，塔纳，你最近还好吗？一切都好？

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 一切都好，谢谢你的关心，扎格。如果与人亲近，事情就有可能会在短时间内变得很麻烦。老实说，我并不喜欢承受这种风险，不过……如果是你的话，我觉得一切都是值得的。我们是朋友，没错吧？

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: What are you doing back here, Zag? You made it out.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I did... but I had to come back. And, not exactly voluntarily. I'll be visiting up there from time to time, though... it looks like I'll be staying here.

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: Visiting from time to time...? I don't understand.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's my mother. She's alive and well! It's just that I can't stay with her up there for very long! So we'll have to catch up... one visit at a time.

en.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
en.text: I see. Well then... that's good. That's good, because... it means that I won't have to track you down up top. Because, between us, I can only take so much of it up there.

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 你怎么跑回来了，扎格？你不是逃出去了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我是逃出去了……但我还是得回来，而且不是自愿的那种。我会时不时地去地上世界看看的，不过……看起来我以后也只能呆在这里了。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 时不时地看看……？我不太明白。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是我的母亲，她还活着，一切都好！只不过我没办法陪她呆得太久。所以我……每出去一次，才能和她见一次面。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Thanatos_Field_01
zh-CN.text: 我明白了。好吧，这……这很好，这很好，因为……这意味着我不用一路追着你跑到凡间了。因为，私下和你说，我实在是受不了上面的世界。

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh! The Prince himself, you, want to talk to me...? Me?! Oh, wow, oh wow!!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I, uh, just wanted to say, the lounge looks wonderful, as good as new. Better! Hope it's not been too much trouble patching up.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I, I, I, aah, I have to clean the rafters, I...!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢！王子本尊，您，是在跟我说话吗…？我？！噢，哇，哇！！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我，呃，我只想说，休息室很好看，跟新的一样。更好了！希望修补的时候能别出什么差错。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我，我，我啊啊，我还得打扫房梁呢，我……！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh! The Prince himself, you, want to talk to me...? Me?! Oh, wow, oh wow!!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I, uh, just wanted to say, don't bother picking up my room today. I'm headed out for a while.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I, I, I, aah, I have to clean the rafters, I...!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢！王子本尊，您，是在跟我说话吗…？我？！噢，哇，哇！！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我，呃，我想说，今天不用替我收拾屋子了。我要出去一段时间。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我，我，我啊啊，我还得打扫房梁呢，我……！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I, ah, hope you're having a nice stay! Even though you don't want to live here anymore, Your Highness!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我，啊，希望您在这里过得愉快！尽管您并不想继续在这里生活了，殿下！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, Dusa? Turns out that I may be stopping back from time to time, like this. But, please don't bother picking up my room. I won't be staying long.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, hahaha, sure! But I'll just keep an eye on things in there, from time to time, in case you change your mind, um, so, good-bye!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，杜莎？我有可能确实会像这样，时不时地回来一趟。不过，我的房间就不用费心收拾了，反正我也待不了太久。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哦，哈哈哈，没问题！不过我会时不时地照看您的房间，说不定您会改主意呢。呃，所以，再见了！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Um, Prince? Your father, I, I think he's pretty steamed right now, about something, so, maybe you could stay away from him? Or... I could tell him you're not here?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That's quite all right, Dusa. I'm not afraid of him, and neither should you be. You're the best help he's ever found.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Just, ah, just doing my job, here, Prince...!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 呃，王子？您父亲，我，我觉得他现在因为一些事情，特别生气，所以，您最好跟他保持距离噢。要不然……我就跟他说您不在好了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没事，杜莎。我不怕他，你也不用怕他。你是他能找到的最得力的助手了。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我，啊，我就在这里干活，王子…！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, um, so, hi Prince! So, is there anything I can get you, or maybe tidy up some more, or... I just thought maybe you'd like something to drink? Sometime?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh! A drink sometime sounds wonderful, Dusa, maybe tomorrow assuming I'm not getting out of here by then...?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Whaa, I mean, it's no big deal, I mean, forget I asked, or anything, I'm sorry, bye!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢，呃，您好，王子！那个，我能帮您拿点什么东西，还是整理点什么东西？还是……您要不要喝点饮料什么的？现在不要吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢！现在不用啦，杜莎。不过如果我明天不出门的话也许可以…？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哇啊啊，我是说，没什么的，那个，就当我，没有问吧，对不起，再见！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Uh, um, I just, wanted to apologize, because, I think maybe I didn't act very appropriately last time you spoke to me? But I just really, really like this job, and promise I will always do my very best, so, I just hope I'll have another chance?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dusa, please, there's no need to apologize! You've been doing a wonderful job, really!

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I... what? You really mean it, Prince, I... thank you, thanks so much!!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 呃，啊啊，我，我想道个歉。因为，上次您跟我说话的时候我表现得不太好。但是我真的真的很喜欢这个工作，我保证以后绝对全力以赴，那个，能再给我一次机会吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 杜莎，说什么傻话呢！你的工作做得非常好，真的！

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我……什么？您说真的吗，王子，我……谢谢，非常感谢您！！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, um, hi, Your Highness? I, just wanted you to know, that if you do get out, I, we are going to miss you. Around here. OK? So, bye...!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢，嗯，您好，殿下。我，我就是想说，如果您真的离开了，我会，我们会想你的。大家都会。好吗？那个，再见…！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, Ms. Dusa, I wanted to, uh, cordially invite you to an outing in the lounge? Remember when you asked me about a drink?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Aaah! Oh, oh, oh, really, what you mean, right now, you're... I... I guess I'm overdue to take a break...

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: ...And, well, since I don't exactly fit the mold of your traditional gorgon, I mean, I have no body for example, I had trouble finding work! That is until Lord Hades took me in, and then, I met you, and, well, I just love this job!!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh! I can definitely relate at least to some of that.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: <Sigh> I, I, I, thanks, Your Highness. Prince. Prince Zagreus!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，杜莎小姐，我想，呃，我诚邀你与我一起去休息室转一转可以吗？还记得之前你问的饮料的事吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 啊啊！噢，噢，噢，真的吗，您是说，现在，您…我…我觉得我是该休息一下了…

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: …那个，嗯，我这副身体跟你们传统的蛇发女妖有点不太一样，我是说，我连身体都没有，这样的我很难找到工作！直到后来冥王哈迪斯把我领了进来，然后，我就遇见您了，然后，嗯，我爱死这个工作了！！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦！我确实能理解你的感受。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: <叹气>我，我，我，谢谢您，殿下。王子。扎格列欧斯王子！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Um, P-Prince, the way you look so sad sometimes, when you come back in here, out of the Pool of Styx? Is everything OK? Because if there was something I could do...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, it's nothing for you to be concerned about, Dusa. I'm just having a harder time fighting my blasted way out of this place than I anticipated. If you'll excuse my language.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, I... this is silly, but, I'd no idea anybody could beat you, I mean, the Prince? Greater than the mighty Achilles, more cunning than his father, faster than Hermes! But... you're just struggling, like me?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I am. And that stuff you heard about me isn't true.

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 呃，王——王子殿下，当你从冥河血池爬出来，回到这里的时候，你有时候看起来很难过。一切都还好吗？如果有什么我能帮忙的地方……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，你不用担心什么事情，杜莎。我想从这该死的破地方逃出去，可这一路上的考验比我想象得还艰苦。抱歉，我说脏话了。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哦，我……我知道这很傻，但我想不出有谁能打败你，王子殿下。我是说，你比伟大的阿喀琉斯还强大，比你的父亲还足智多谋，比赫尔墨斯还要更快！可……可你也会遇到困难，就像我一样吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，而且你说的那些关于我的事情，都太夸大了。

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: ...sorted the cutlery, wiped the counters, replaced the candles, did the dishes, swept the floor, inspected the barrels, let's see what else, oh!! The Prince, it's you!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's me! Dusa, I'm impressed you're able to manage this whole lounge all by yourself. How do you do it, what's your secret?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Hahaha, secret? I'm two weeks behind schedule with this place, at least! Fortunately, no one here seems very good at keeping time, so, no one's gotten on my case just yet, but... oh, you aren't going to tell, are you?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Of course not. What's behind schedule, though? This place doesn't seem any worse for wear than usual.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Well, that's just it! Miss Nyx, she tasked me with a pretty big project a while back, to make this place worthy of the name, which means... there's so much left to do, I need to get everything ready, please, excuse me, Prince!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: ……餐具都摆好了，桌子也擦干净了，蜡烛换了新的，盘子洗净了，地也扫了，桶也看过了，我想想还有什么其他的，噢！！王子殿下，您来啦！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没错，是我！杜莎，你能独自管理整个休息室真的是很厉害呀。你是怎么做到的，有什么秘诀吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哈哈哈，秘诀？这里的工作进度起码落后了两个星期！不过很幸运，这里好像没什么人在意时间，所以呢，目前还没人找我麻烦，但是……噢，您不会把这事说出去吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 当然不会了。不过到底什么工作拖慢了进度？这地方看上去也不比平时差啊。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 这就是问题所在了！倪克斯小姐前段时间交给了我一项大工程，她要我把这个地方变得恰如其名，就是说……这里还有很多工作要做，我要把方方面面都料理妥当，我先失陪了，王子殿下！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: ...patch up the seating, update the menu, clean the stove, stock the honor bar, sweep the rug, dust the rafters, mop the flooring, pay the broker, oh!! Um, sorry, Prince, way behind on my assignment, so if you'll excuse me, please...?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dusa, wait, before you fly away... there must be something I can do, to help pitch in with everything? Doesn't matter how good you are at your job, what you're describing, that's more than one individual can handle!

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Your Highness, please! I know you mean well, but I have this! Wish everybody wouldn't doubt me all the time, like that House Contractor, just gets to stand around, waiting for work orders! Unless they come from me, then nooo.

en.speaker: Zagreus
