en.text: The House Contractor isn't cooperating with you, huh. No wonder so many lounge renovations are clogged up in the works. Though maybe I can grease the wheels a bit?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: AAH, I completely forgot!! I need to get more cooking grease for the Head Chef! I have to go!!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: ……修补座位，更新菜单，清理火炉，给荣誉吧上货，打扫地毯，清理房檐，擦洗地板，给商人结账，噢！！不好意思，王子殿下，还有很多工作等着我呢，我就先失陪啦……？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 杜莎，等等，在你飞走之前……这里一定有我能帮上忙的工作吧？就算你再怎么出色，就像你刚才说的，这可不是一个人能做完的工作！

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 王子殿下！您的好意我心领了，我一个人能行！希望大家不要总是怀疑我的能力，跟那个圣殿承包商一样，就在那傻站着，等人给他下达工作单！我要不下单，他什么都不干。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 圣殿承包商不配合你的工作啊。难怪这么多休息室翻新工作都滞后了。也许我可以稍微让进度快一点。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哎呀，我都忘记啦！！我还要给主厨送点做饭用的油呢！我必须得走啦！！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: ...patch up the seating, update the menu, clean the stove, stock the honor bar, sweep the rug, dust the rafters, mop the flooring, pay the broker, oh!! Um, sorry, Prince, way behind on my assignment, so if you'd excuse me, please...?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dusa, wait, before you fly away... there must be something I can do, to help pitch in with everything? Doesn't matter how good you are at your job, what you're describing, that's more than one individual can handle!

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Your Highness, please! I know you mean well, but I have this! Wish everybody wouldn't doubt me all the time, like that House Contractor, just gets to stand around, waiting for work orders! Unless they come from me, then nooo.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Ooh, that might be my fault. I've been giving the Contractor lots of work. Some of those lounge orders must be coming from you, right? This place is really shaping up!

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Wha-wha, wait, then you're the one who's been authorizing all these improvements?! Oh my, oh my, aaaah!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: ……修补座位，更新菜单，清理火炉，给荣誉吧上货，打扫地毯，清理房檐，擦洗地板，给商人结账，噢！！不好意思，王子殿下，还有很多工作等着我呢，我就先失陪啦……？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 杜莎，等等，在你飞走之前……这里一定有我能帮上忙的工作吧？就算你再怎么出色，就像你刚才说的，这可不是一个人能做完的工作！

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 王子殿下！您的好意我心领了，我一个人能行！希望大家不要总是怀疑我的能力，跟那个圣殿承包商一样，就在那傻站着，等人给他下达工作单！我要不下单，他什么都不干。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，这可能是我的问题。我让承包商做的工作太多了。其中一些休息室的工作单应该是你下的吧？这地方真是越来越好了啊！

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哇……哇……等一下，您就是批准这些修缮措施的人吗？！哎呀，啊啊！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: The lounge is really starting to look nice lately, Dusa! All your hard work is really paying off!

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Hah! Why, thank you, Prince, it's just that, lately, the House Contractor's been slightly more agreeable I guess, working a little faster, maybe, but there's still a lot we have to do, so, you just wait!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 休息室看起来真是越来越好了，杜莎！这都是你的功劳！

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哈！谢谢您，王子殿下，只不过，最近圣殿承包商态度好像好了很多，做事也麻利点了，但是要做的事还是很多，还请您稍安勿躁啊！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Um, Prince Zagreus...? I just wanted to say something, if you have a little time? I know you're really busy... I can come back.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, no, now's fine, of course, what is it, Dusa? I'm not so busy, by the way, and always happy to check in. Wait, is something wrong?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: No, nononono, it is just the opposite, I... can't believe you helped me, with the lounge. I don't think anyone has ever helped me out like you did, cleaning up after Cerberus, and the new rug, and the kitchen, and, just, all of this!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It was my pleasure, really. All of us use the lounge, don't we? This House can really be a lot, but in the lounge here, things are easier a bit, I think. I'm so glad we have you watching over it.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Y, you really mean that, Prince...? But you don't know what this means to me. I'm finally caught up on work! W, what am I going to do? I, I don't know what I'm going to do with all this extra time! I have to go, and plan everything out!!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 呃，扎格列欧斯王子……？您有时间吗，我想跟您说件事。我知道您很忙……要不，下次再说吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不用，不用，现在就可以说。说吧，杜莎。其实我也不是很忙，来这里看看，我还是很高兴的。等下，有什么问题吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 不，不不不不，完全相反，我……我真的不敢相信，休息室的工作能够得到您的帮助。除了您，没有别人这样帮助过我，跟在刻耳柏洛斯后边打扫，新地毯，还有厨房等等，您帮我做了这么多工作！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我很荣幸，真的。我们每个人都会用到休息室，不是吗？这座圣殿确实包罗万象，但是到休息室这里，我觉得事情就变得简单起来了。感谢有你来照看这个地方。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 你，你是说真的吗，王子殿下……？但你不知道这对我来说意味着什么。我终于有了一份可以投注心力的工作！我要怎么做……我，我不知道要如何打发这些多出来的时间！我必须回去好好地计划一番！！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Um, Zagreus? I wanted to talk some more, if you're available? I mean, if you're free. I mean! If you have time to right now. Is that OK?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Of course, Dusa! Where should we chat? The lounge, or maybe somewhere more private...?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Somewhere more private, please, if that's OK? Thank you.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: ...Um, Zagreus... so, ever since you told me you had feelings for me, it's been, like... my whole mind is on fire. I haven't been able to think straight, or get anything done. It's all been so much!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm sorry, Dusa, I... put a lot on you, and... maybe I shouldn't have, since I'm the Prince and everything, as you point out, and... sometimes, I forget myself. I'd never pressure you, it's just... I thought you had these feelings for me, too.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I do have feelings for you, silly! That's what I've been trying to tell you, it's just... it's just...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's just what...? Whatever it is, it's OK. You can be yourself with me, Dusa, I promise.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I'm glad you put it that way. I... I'm not looking for an intimate relationship. You're the kindest soul in this whole House. And I have learned so much from you! But, when I really think about my feelings... I'm just, not attracted to you, in that way. I'm sorry. You're a really nice guy!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, hahaha, look, there's nothing to apologize for, not at all. In fact... all this is a relief. I've learned a lot from you, too, and I cherish our friendship for what it is. Do you... do you think that we could still be friends? Or, is it better that you didn't see me anymore...?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Don't say that! Though, I was going to ask you the same thing. I'd really like it if you'd be my friend! Though, my career comes first, so... I don't want you doing any special favors, promise me? I need to see how far I can get on my own.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I respect that so much, and yes, I promise, Dusa. So, well, then... friends? For all eternity?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Yes. Friends. For all eternity. Now... I had better go. See you, OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 呃，扎格列欧斯？我想和你详细谈谈，如果你没事的话？我是指，如果你闲着的话。不对！如果你现在有时间的话。可以吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 当然了，杜莎！我们去哪儿谈呢？休息室，还是其他更私密的地方……？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 去人少的地方说，好吗？谢谢。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: ……呃……是这样的，自从你说你对我有感觉以后，我的脑子……像是炸开了锅。我没办法冷静地思考问题，或者做任何事。这对我来说太意外了！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 很抱歉，杜莎，我……给你太大的负担……或许我不该和你说这些，就像你说的那样，我是王子，我的身份摆在那里……但有时候，我会忘记这些。我从来没想过给你压力，只是……我以为你对我也有相同的感觉。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我当然对你有感觉，傻瓜！我一直想告诉你，只是……只是……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 只是什么……？你尽管说，没有关系。你可以对我敞开心扉，杜莎，真的。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我很高兴你能这么说。我……我想要的不是亲密的关系。你拥有这座圣殿里最善良的灵魂。我从你的身上学到很多！但是，当我静下心来审视自己……我对你的感觉不是那方面的。对不起。你真的是个好人！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，哈哈哈，听着，完全没必要为此道歉。实际上，这对我来说是一种解脱。我也从你的身上学到很多，我珍惜我们之间的友谊。你觉得……你觉得我们还可以做朋友吗？或者，你希望我离你远一点……？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 别这么说！虽然我也想要问你相同的问题。我真的很珍惜你这个朋友！不过，我要把工作放在第一位，所以……我希望你不要对我有特别的关照，可以答应我吗？我想看看自己能做到什么样的程度。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我尊重你的想法，我答应你，杜莎。那么，还是……朋友？永远的朋友？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 是的，朋友，永远的朋友。现在……我得走了，我们回头再见？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Hey, Zagreus, I... wanted to talk to you again, I... what I mean is, I just, hope I didn't hurt your feelings, because, if I did, you'd let me know, wouldn't you?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dusa, please! Remember friends for all eternity? That's a long time, so, there's no need for second guessing. I'm glad we had a chance to talk.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, well, good! That's a relief to hear, but... one last thing, so I can clear my conscience of it, I... I've saved all the Ambrosia that you gave me, and I figured since... I didn't realize, you know, the way you felt? I can be a little dense! I have it here. And I would like to give it back. Is that OK?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Dusa_ChoiceText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I... look, if you don't want the Ambrosia anymore, and receiving it made you feel uncomfortable in any way, I'll take it back. It was my gift to you, to do with as you please. Are you sure you don't want it?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Yes, I'm sure, and thank you for your understanding, Prince. It really was quite sweet of you, but it's important that I learn to stock the lounge myself. So, here you go, and I will see you soon, OK?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, now, there's no need to do anything rash like that! That Ambrosia was my gift to you, and it was unconditional. Just try the stuff and see! They say the purer the act of giving, the better it is. Won't you keep it? If not for yourself, then for the lounge?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Ah, all right, I... had to ask, so, thanks again. Just wanted to make sure! I hope we can enjoy it at the lounge sometime!! I'd better go put it away. Not drink it! Store it for safe keeping, now, OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 嘿，扎格列欧斯，我……还想和你谈谈，我……我想说的是，我只是，希望我没有伤害到你，如果有的话，你会跟我说的，对吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 拜托，杜莎！忘了我们是永远的朋友了吗？时间还长着呢，所以不要胡思乱想。不过我还是很高兴有机会和你聊天。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢，那就好！我终于可以松口气，但是……还有一件事，它一直让我感到不安，我……我把你送给我的仙馔密酒都保存得好好的，而且我想……因为当时我不知道你的意思，我承认自己有点愚钝！我都带过来了。你可以把它们收回去吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: Dusa_ChoiceText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我……听着，如果你不想要这些仙馔密酒，而且收下它们让你觉得内心不安，那我可以收回。这是我送给你的礼物，你可以随便处理。你确定不想要了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 是的，我确定，谢谢你能理解我，王子殿下。你真的很贴心，也幸亏我学会了把东西都存在休息室。这些你都拿着，我们回头再聊？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，现在没必要这么草率行事！这些仙馔密酒是我无条件送给你的礼物。你尝一口试试看！据说，赠予的动机越纯洁，它们的味道越醇美。你不留着吗？就算自己不喝，放在休息室里也可以？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 好吧……但我不得不问，还是要谢谢你。我只想确定一下！希望下次有机会和你一起在休息室喝！！我现在最好把它们收起来。暂时不喝！先保存着。

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Hey, um, Zagreus? I wanted to say, that was very sweet of you, letting me hang onto all that Ambrosia you gave me before? It's in safe keeping now! Except one bottle... that kind of slipped, and broke. Though that did mean I got to try the stuff!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, you got to try it, after all? What did you think, all it's cracked up to be?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: It was amazing. I've never had anything like it! It's so good to have a forked tongue, meant I could taste it twice at the same time! So, um... if one of the other bottles slipped and broke... you wouldn't mind, would you?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 嘿，呃，扎格列欧斯？我想说，你真是太贴心啦。还记得你之前送给我的仙馔密酒吗？我把所有的酒都好好地保管起来了！只有一瓶……那瓶酒滑了一下，打碎了，所以我不得不把它喝掉啦！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，到最后，你终于喝了吗？你觉得它味道怎么样，名副其实吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 真的是太美妙了，我从来没尝过这样的东西！能有条分叉的舌头真是太幸运了，这样我就可以同时用两条舌头来品尝了！所以，呃……如果其中一瓶酒不小心滑了，打碎了的话……你应该不会介意吧？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dusa, I can't shake this feeling, so I wanted to apologize to you, because... I think when we first met, I just... I don't think I took it the right way. I never had a fan before! I wanted to live up to your idea of me.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, Prince, Zagreus, don't worry about that! Even I didn't know what I was going through. When I first started working here, I was just so impressed with you, I mean... you were the only one who would stand up to your father! I thought about you all the time!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: But you didn't even know me, yet. We didn't get to talking for what seemed like ages. You can be difficult to find! Since I can't fly up to the rafters like you can.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Well I'm so glad you kept trying to talk to me! If you hadn't... I'd probably be up in the rafters still, building up this idea of you that's not even as good as the real thing!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 杜莎，这种感觉让我挥之不去，我想向你道个歉，因为……我觉得，我们第一次见面的时候，我……我觉得我的做法不太对。以前从来没人崇拜过我！我当时就想成为你心目中的那个样子。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哦，王子殿下，扎格列欧斯，别在意那件事了！当时就连我自己都不知道该怎么办。我刚在这里工作的时候，你实在是让我太着迷了，我是说……只有你能和你的父亲相媲美！我的脑子里一直全都是你的事情！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 但那个时候你和我并不熟，我们可能有很多年都没说过话。我没办法像你那样飞上屋顶，有时候根本都找不到你！

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 您一直想要找机会和我说话，我很高兴！如果你没有这么做的话……说不定我现在还躲在屋顶上，思考着你实际上有没有我想象得那么好！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey Dusa, something I was wondering, and it's just curiosity, mind you, but... is there somebody else...? I mean, somebody special, whom you're close with, or would like to be. Romantically, I mean. If it's all right to ask.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, you can ask me anything! But, um, somebody else romantically, not really, no? It's not really my thing? It doesn't mean I don't have feelings for you, though! You know that, right? I wouldn't drop what I'm doing and throw myself at danger for just anyone, you know!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I definitely know. There's seven kinds of love, or so, isn't that right? It isn't something that's taught extensively down here, though, so... there's still a lot for me to learn, I guess.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Wow, I never thought of it as love until you said it there just now, Prince, but you're right! I love you, Zagreus! Hah, haha, that feels good to come right out and say, you know? OK, well, bye!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨……杜莎，我在想，我就是有些好奇，我想问你……还有没有什么人……？就是，比较特别的人，和你很亲近的，或者想亲近的人。充满浪漫气息那种。这么问你不会介意吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢，您问什么都可以！浪漫暧昧的其他人嘛，应该，没有吧？这方面，我不太擅长？不过这不代表我对您没有感情噢！您知道的吧！我可不会随随便便就放下手里的活去为谁赴汤蹈火的！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这个我当然知道。世界上有七种爱，是这样吧？在这种地方可没人会教大家爱是什么。看来我还有很多东西要学习啊。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哇，王子殿下，您的话真是让人茅塞顿开，您说得没错！我爱你，扎格列欧斯！哈……哈哈，能说出来，感觉太棒了，你知道吗！好吧，回头见吧！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I hope it's not been too much, having to care for Cerberus, is it, Dusa? He isn't quite as fearsome as he seems. At least, that goes for two heads out of three!

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, Cerberus is a good boy, he's fine! One of the highlights of the job, for sure. We really hit it off after he finally realized I'm not a ball! So, I've been feeding him, grooming him, changing his water dish...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...Cleaning up after him...?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Most definitely, yes. If you'll excuse me, by the way? He's got to go. I mean! I've got to go! I mean!! You know what I mean, bye!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我希望照顾刻耳柏洛斯没有给你带来太大困扰，杜莎。他其实没有看起来那么可怕。至少，三个头和两个头差不了多少。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 啊，刻耳柏洛斯还好吧，它很乖！在我所有的工作里，还算有趣的啦。它发现我并不是一个球之后，我们就很合得来了！现在，我要喂它，给它梳毛，换水盆……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: ……清理它的……？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 当然啦。不好意思，王子。它要去了。我是说，我要去了！我意思是！！您应该明白我的意思，再见！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Ungh, Dusa... it's a little much out there sometimes, I have to say. Different stresses than in here, but still.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh don't you lose hope now, Prince Zagreus! There isn't anything you couldn't handle, I just know! You're every bit as tough as your father, except, you're nice! And you never back down from anything. You can do this!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...I don't know that anyone can do this. No escape from the Underworld and all that. Though, thanks for cheering me up.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I'm not just saying it, I mean it, Prince! Look at how far you've come! Practically everybody in this House believes in you! Even the Wretched Broker and the Head Chef! Oh, I've asked them! Everybody thinks you're going to succeed!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，杜莎……不得不说，有时候我觉得压力有点太大了。虽然和这里的压力不太一样，不过还是会有压力。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哦，不要失去信心，扎格列欧斯！没有什么问题是你解决不了的，我很清楚！你和你的父亲一样强大，而且你比他还和善！而且，无论发生什么事情，你都从不退缩，你一定能做得到！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: ……据我所知，这种事情还没人做到过，还没人能从冥界逃出去。不过，谢谢你给我打气。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我可不是随便说说的，王子殿下，我是认真的！你已经做出这么多了不起的事情了！圣殿里几乎所有人都对你充满信心！就连残魂商人和大厨都是！是啊，我问过他们了！每个人都觉得你一定能成功！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Can I ask you a couple of purely figurative questions here, Dusa? First, what have I gotten myself into...? And second, what am I going to do...?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Believe me, I know the feeling, being in over my head! Though, if I can find my way out of my messes, then I know, I know, you definitely can! I don't know what you ought to do, but I am always here to listen.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我可以问你几个完全是假设性的问题吗，杜莎？第一个问题，我给自己惹上了什么麻烦……？第二个问题，我应该怎么做才好……？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 说真的，我也明白这种压力太大的感觉！不过，既然连我都能想出办法解决问题，那我很清楚，我很清楚你也一定做得到！我不知道你应该做什么，不过如果你想说什么的话，我会始终听着的。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know Achilles reasonably well, don't you, Dusa? Seems like he's always stuck there in that hall. At least you get to fly around. Sometimes I think he wishes he was someplace else.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: There has to be a way to help him, Prince! He's been so loyal to this House, and he has to be your truest friend of everybody here. But he's the pity-party type. He needs someone to get him out of this!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你和阿喀琉斯很熟悉，是吗，杜莎？至少你还能到处乱飞，但他却似乎一直被困在那座大厅里。有时候我觉得，他想去的是别的地方。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 肯定有办法能帮到他，王子殿下！他一直都对这座圣殿忠心耿耿，在所有的人里面，他也一定是你最真挚的朋友。但他是那种不怎么会解决问题的人，必须得有个人帮他走出困境。

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, Prince, I heard the news about Master Achilles, that's so great! I'm going to miss him being here as often as he used to, but I'm just so happy for him, and for you!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Me too, Dusa. The happy-for-him part, at any rate! He's a good friend, and he deserved much better than to be stuck here.

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哦，王子殿下，我听说阿喀琉斯大人的事情了，这真是太好了！他没办法像以前那样总待在这里，我一定会想他的。不过，我为他感到开心，也为你感到开心！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我也是，杜莎，他的幸福值得这一切麻烦！他是个善良的朋友，不应该一辈子都被困在这个地方。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, Ms. Dusa, I ran into hostile gorgons that resembled you out there in Asphodel. Resembled only in the vaguest sense, I mean, they lacked your charm or social graces, anyway. I just, hope you are not related, since I sort of... you know.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, hahaha, those old things? They're relatives just in the loosest sense, like... say you had some nasty, almost mindless siblings born entirely from your own blood, something like that? Do you have any idea how hard it was to get a steady job because of them?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So I have your permission to continue hacking down such gorgons with impunity?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，杜莎小姐，我在水仙花平原遇到过和你长得很像的蛇发女妖，但她们充满敌意。我是说，有点像，她们没有你的魅力或者说完全不懂社交礼仪。我只是希望，你们之间没有关系，因为……你也知道。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哦，哈哈哈，那些老东西？她们勉强算是我的亲戚，就好像……你可能也有一些讨厌，甚至愚蠢的兄弟姐妹，身上流着和你一样的血？你知道就因为她们，让我在找工作的过程中遭遇多少艰辛吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 所以，你同意我可以继续消灭这些蛇发女妖，而不会责怪我吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I had another question about your relationship to other gorgons, Dusa. So... I notice you're not much for hissing, snakelike noises when you speak, and so on? Is that some sort of special gorgon language or something?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: No, um, not exactly, Prince! It's what it sounds like, hrrrsssss!! Just, scary hissing, really, takes some practice not to sound like that with a forked tongue! I really wanted to fit in. Hey, how about you? Always wondered how come you have a surface accent. Weren't you born here?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, wait, me? I never gave it any thought. I... guess it's from my father. He insisted that he teach me how to speak, himself. Maybe it's in the blood.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 杜莎，关于你和其他蛇发女妖的关系，我还有一个问题。就是……我注意到你在说话的时候很少会发出哧哧的声音，像蛇那样的？那是蛇发女妖之间相互交流的一种方式吗，还是什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 不，不完全是，王子殿下！应该是嘶嘶声！！听起来很可怕，为了改掉只有分岔舌头才有的这个坏毛病，我可下了不小的功夫！我真的想融入这个世界。那你呢？我还一直疑惑你为什么有地表的口音。你不是在这里出生的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，等一下，你说我吗？我从来没想过这个问题。我猜……应该是因为我父亲的原因吧。他坚持要亲自教我说话。又或者是血液里遗传的？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Dusa, this is kind of personal, and you don't have to answer, but I have to know. So... did you... use to have a body, and all that? Because, I've heard of gorgons, well... that you had wings, and such?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Um, Prince, so, look. That's something very private that you're asking, and... I know you don't mean any harm, but it just isn't something I discuss with anyone, OK? I'm who I am. Besides! As you can see, I don't need wings to fly!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，杜莎，这个问题有点私密，你可以选择不回答，但我必须弄清楚。就是……你之前……也有身体吗，还有其他的？因为，我听说，蛇发女妖，怎么说好呢……你以前还长着翅膀，之类的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 呃，王子殿下，是这样的。你问的问题确实过于私密，而且……我知道你没有恶意，但我不想和任何人讨论这个话题，明白吗？我就是我。再说了！就像你看到的那样，我也不需要翅膀！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Ms. Dusa, I, erm, wanted to apologize for when I pried about your past. I just wanted to get to know you better, but... I was insensitive, and I'm sorry.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, Your Highness, Zagreus, come on! Don't even worry about it! I'd already forgotten, really no big deal. It's just, the past me, it's as though... it wasn't even me. This is me, now! I'm glad I'm here.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 杜莎小姐，我，呃，想向你道歉，我不该打听你的过去。我只是想更了解你。但我太迟钝了，对不起。请你原谅我。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢，扎格列欧斯殿下，不要这样！根本不需要为此感到困扰！我都已经把这茬给忘了，真的没什么。只是，过去的我，好像……和我没有关系。现在的我才重要！我对于现状特别满意。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know, it must be pretty handy, being able to turn somebody into stone. Is that something you can just do whenever you please, like... I don't know, sticking out your tongue or something?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Not quite as easy as all that, but not so hard! You have to get yourself pretty worked up, and picture what you're seeing like a... well, um, like a picture, really, and then, fwoop! Stone statue. It's funny, I used to think everybody could do it!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 能动不动就把其他人变成石头，肯定很有趣吧。你随时都可以这么做吗，就像……怎么形容呢，就像把你的舌头伸出来那样轻而易举？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 也没有那么简单，但也不难！首先你必须让自己变得很激动，然后想象你看到的是……呃，一幅画，就这样。呼的一下！就变成了石头雕像了。确实挺有意思的，我过去以为每个人都可以这样做呢！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Hey, Prince, I saw that Orpheus, he got some time away, did you do that? He's visiting his muse, that's what he said! That's so exciting, I mean, they've been separated the whole time they've been dead!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: They have a lot of catching up to do, for sure. Though I think they're going to be all right.

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 嘿，王子殿下，我遇到俄耳甫斯了，他前段时间不在，是因为你的原因吗？他和我说，他去找他的缪斯了！这也太让人激动了吧，我的意思是，他们从死后开始，一直没有见过面！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 他们肯定要好好叙叙旧，不过我觉得他们应该能谈得很好。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Do you have to work with Hypnos pretty closely as part of your job, Dusa? Feels like I've been running into him a lot lately.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Mister Hypnos, I have trouble getting through to him, I think? He gives me plenty of advice, it's just, it isn't really why I talk to him. I... only talk to him when I don't have a lot of other choice, I guess.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 和修普诺斯合作，也是你工作的一部分吗，杜莎？我感觉最近总能碰到他。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我感觉我说的话，修普诺斯大人基本都没听进去，是吧？他给了我很多建议，不过，我去找他倒不是因为这个。我……我猜，我只有别无选择的时候才会去找他吧。

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Hey, Prince, is-is it really true? About Miss Meg and you, I mean, that you're, you know, um, I? You know!! Because, if so, then I want you to know, I'm just so happy for the two of you! That's wonderful, you two!! I'm so glad!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, thank you, Dusa, I know you and Miss Meg are close, so, I am grateful that we have your blessings. Though, we're kind of... not out in the open with it, necessarily, so if you please, just... keep it quiet for us, would you?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, you better believe it, I will tell nobody whatsoever, no! I'll just be very, very happy to myself! All right, then! Bye!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 嘿，王子殿下，这-这是真的吗？关于你和墨纪小姐，我是说，你们，你知道吗，呃，我？我要和你说！！因为，如果是真的，我希望你能够知道，我为你们俩感到高兴！太好了，你们俩！！噢，我真的很高兴！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，谢谢你，杜莎，我知道你和墨纪小姐的关系很好，所以，我很高兴能够得到你的祝福。不过，我们俩……还没有公开，所以，在必要的时候，你可以……为我们保守秘密吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢，相信我，我不会告诉任何人，绝对不会！我就自己高兴高兴！没事了，再见！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Hey, I saw you and Thanatos recently, Prince! You two, if you don't mind me saying, you are quite the pair, I mean, you ought to see yourselves! You're, whew...! Makes me a little woozy just remembering it now! Well, up I go, then, bye!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 嘿，我最近看到你和塔纳托斯了，王子殿下！你们俩，如果你不介意的话，你们俩真的是“天生一对”，你真该自己亲眼看看！你们，唉哟……！现在想起来我都有点眩晕！好了，我要走了，再见！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dusa, I don't mean to upset you but, I'm worried you're going to burn yourself out if you keep pushing yourself past your limits... are you sure you don't need a break?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I, I'm sure, Prince. This is my chance! I'm custodian of the House of Hades! I need to keep doing my best right now. Thanks so much for the Nectar! Bye!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 杜莎，我也不想烦你，但如果你一直这么逼着自己突破极限，我担心你最后会把自己累坏了……你确定不休息一下吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我，我确定，王子殿下。这对我来说是一次机会！我是冥王圣殿的管家！我现在需要拼命地工作。谢谢你送我蜜露！再见！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh hey, you brought some fish, could smell it all the way from down the hall, that's great!! The Head Chef can take it off your hands, should be right in the back of the lounge like always! Thanks for helping us out, Prince!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢，嘿，你带着鱼呢，整个大厅都能闻到，真的太棒了！！主厨会过来拿走的，现在他应该和往常一样在休息室的后面！谢谢你帮助我们，王子殿下！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Say, Dusa, in your work around the House, you wouldn't happen to have run into a Skelly character, out in the courtyard, there, have you?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh! Not really, um, because, my work is in the House itself, and, well, the courtyard, technically, it's kind of right outside, so, I'm supposed to stay inside the walls. But, I think I know who you mean! I've seen him, standing there just past your chamber doors. Why, is he OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 说吧，杜莎，你平时在圣殿里工作，不可能会到庭院并且正好碰到骨头吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢！不大可能，呃，因为，我的工作范围仅限于圣殿本身，而庭院，从技术上说，属于圣殿以外的地方，所以，我要待在圣殿里头。但我知道你指的是谁！我见过他，就站在你的房间门的那边。怎么了，他还好吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Have to tell you, Dusa, your job seems really stressful, here. It's a big House! You have to tend to the entire thing?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh! Well, most of it isn't so bad at all, but... ever since Cerberus tore up the lounge, I... guess it's been a little hectic, getting everything back to normal like before!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm not sure it was ever normal around here, but... I'm sorry I created work for you. Cerberus tore the place apart because of me. Though, maybe I can help you patch things up?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Don't say that, Prince! Cerberus knows better, and besides, you have your job to do, don't you? And I have mine! And I will do my very best at it, just wait and see!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 杜莎，不得不说，你的工作看起来是在太辛苦了。偌大的圣殿！你必须方方面面照看到位！

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢！大部分时候并没有这么辛苦，但……自从刻耳柏洛斯把休息室弄得一团糟，我……我觉得是有点手忙脚乱的，如果要让一切都回归原来的样子的话！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我不确定这里也曾正常过吗？不过……很抱歉给你添了麻烦。刻耳柏洛斯因为我才变得那么狂躁。或许，我能帮上什么忙？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 不要这么说，王子殿下！刻耳柏洛斯应该更清楚，再者，你也有自己的工作不是吗？这是我的工作！而且我会尽最大努力，你就等着看吧！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dusa, there is something you should know about me. Me and Nyx, that is. She's not my real mother...! My real mother's called Persephone. She's out there, somewhere. On the surface. That's why I left. Wait, just a moment, are you laughing?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Haha, oh, uh, no, it's just, uhh... I'm really, really, really sorry, I can't help it, I, um, didn't want to interrupt, because, I kind of knew all that, already? Um, meaning, I had heard about it, everybody talks, you know, from time to time? But I just... really hope you find her soon!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 杜莎，有些和我有关的事情，我觉得你应该知道。我和倪克斯。其实，她不是我的亲生母亲……！我的亲生母亲是珀尔塞福涅。她现在下落不明，但肯定在阳间。这是我要离开的原因。等一下，你是在笑吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哈哈。噢，不，只是，实在是，呃……非常、非常、非常抱歉，我忍不住，我，呃，不想打断你，因为这些，我早就知道。呃，其实，我都听说了，你知道吗，每个人都在议论？不过，我真心希望你早日找到她！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dusa, there is something you should know about me. Me and Nyx, that is. She's not my real mother...! My real mother's called Persephone. She's out there, somewhere. On the surface. That's why I left. Wait, just a moment, are you laughing?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Haha, oh, uh, no, it's just, uhh... I'm really, really, really sorry, I can't help it, I, um, didn't want to interrupt, because, I kind of knew all that, already? Um, meaning, I had heard about it, everybody talks, you know, from time to time? But I just... really hope you find her soon!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I trust you not to mention this to everybody in the House, but... I have. Found her, that is! I'm... trying to figure out what happens next. Can't really talk about it yet, so... bear with me?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Whooa, that is exciting, what's she really like? Is she tall? Does she have your eyes? Where does she live? What does she do? Does she have a job? What color is her hair? Is she, you know, is she with anybody?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 杜莎，有些和我有关的事情，我觉得你应该知道。我和倪克斯。其实，她不是我的亲生母亲……！我的亲生母亲是珀尔塞福涅。她现在下落不明，但肯定在阳间。这是我要离开的原因。等一下，你是在笑吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哈哈。噢，不，只是，实在是，呃……非常、非常、非常抱歉，我忍不住，我，呃，不想打断你，因为这些，我早就知道。呃，其实，我都听说了，你知道吗，每个人都在议论？不过，我真心希望你早日找到她！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我相信你不会对这里的其他人提起这件事，但……我做到了。也就是说我已经找到她了！我……正在弄明白下一步该干什么。我暂时不能透露太多，但……你不介意吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哇啊啊，这真是太让人激动了！她本人是什么样子？高吗？她的眼睛和你的一样吗？她住在哪里？在做什么？她有工作吗？她的头发是什么颜色的？她，呃，我是说，她和别人交往了吗？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Whoa, why, Prince, you're... wait, you're back? I mean, I thought...! I heard that...! How come you're still here?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, hah, yes! I made it pretty far! On that account you heard correctly, Dusa, but... turns out I have unfinished business here, so... I should be turning up like this from time to time.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh wow, well, that's great!! I mean, I hope it's great? I mean, if you agree it's great, I also think it's great! If that's OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哇啊，怎么，王子殿下，您……等等，您怎么回来了？我是说，我听说……！我听说您……！您怎么还在这里呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，哈哈，没错！我确实走了很远，这点你没听错，杜莎。不过……我在这里还有点其他事要忙，所以……我时不时都会来这里待一阵子。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哦，哇哦，太棒了！！我是说，确实很棒吧？我是说，如果您觉得很棒的话，我也觉得很棒！这么说可以吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dusa, in my father's chambers, he... he has a bedside portrait of somebody. Is... is she someone with whom you are familiar?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, Prince, I'm not permitted in your father's chambers, are you kidding me? I'd ask you what it's like in there, but... I don't think I'm supposed to know!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 杜莎，我父亲的房间里……挂着一张某个人的肖像画。这个人……这个人你熟悉吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哦，王子殿下，您是在开玩笑吧？我是无权进入您父亲的房间的。我还想问问您里面是什么样子呢，不过……我恐怕不应该知道这些事情！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dusa, wherever did you get that Fidi Companion you gave me? You know how much that thing is worth? To me at least, I don't know who collects those anymore, but I sure do!

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh! I'm so glad you like her, Prince! I could think of no one better to take care of her, and best of all... she'll remind you of me! But as for where I got her, you're not going to believe it... can you guess?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, wait, you don't mean... no, not from Nyx, herself? Did you, wait, Dusa... you didn't, how to put this, borrow her from Nyx, did you?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Haha, no! Happen to value my job, here, among other aspects of my well-being, but... after the lounge assignment, Nyx herself commended me, and gave me Fidi as a nice reward! Although, she probably knew I'd just end up giving her to you!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 杜莎，你给我的菲迪伴偶是从哪里弄来的？你知道那东西有多高价值吗？至少对我来说是这样，我不知道还有没有人收集这些东西，但我肯定是其中的一个！

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哦！很高兴你喜欢它，王子殿下！我实在想不出还有谁能把它照顾得更好，而且最重要的是……它会让你想起我！但至于我是从哪里得到它的，我说出来你也不会相信……你要不要猜猜看？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么，等等，你不会是说……不，不可能是倪克斯，她本人？你是，等一下，杜莎……你不会，该怎么说合适呢，向倪克斯借的吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哈哈，不是！我可是很珍惜我的工作，还有其他的种种好处，那是……在一次休息室工作完成以后，倪克斯亲自表扬了我，而且把菲迪送给我作为奖励！不过，她可能早就知道我会把它送给你！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: How's your relationship with Nyx been lately, Dusa? She strikes me as a pretty intense supervisor. You getting on OK?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, Miss Nyx? I'll do whatever she says! Why, did she say something about me? She did, oh, why would you be asking otherwise, oh no. Am I losing my job?!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, no, no no, it's not like that, it's just... a feeling that I've had from glimpses of the interactions that I've seen between you two. I haven't always got along with Nyx, but I know she cares deeply about this House and everyone in it. Including you.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Hahaha, well, that's nice to know! She cares about my work performance, that's for very sure, and I am doing everything I can to live up to and exceed her expectations, tell her that!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你和倪克斯的关系最近怎么样了，杜莎？她给我的感觉像是一位非常严厉的上司。你们还处得来吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢，倪克斯小姐？我对她言听计从！你干嘛这么问，她跟你提起我了吗？肯定是，噢，不然你干嘛要这么问呢，噢，不。我要丢掉这份工作了吗？！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，没有没有，不是这样子的，只是……上次无意中看到你们俩之间的互动，给我一种感觉。我也不是总能和倪克斯合得来，但我知道她很在乎这座圣殿和里面的每个人。包括你在内。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哈哈哈，那太好了！她在乎我的工作表现，这一点是肯定的，而且我也尽量满足甚至超过她的要求，你这么告诉她！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Aah! The Prince! Miss Nyx, she, I, I'm not supposed to talk to you! I have to go!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 啊！王子殿下！倪克斯小姐……她……我……我不该告诉您的！我得走了！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dusa, hey, hey what's the matter, you seem... something's wrong, what happened? Tell me, please.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: No, Your Highness, you... you're not supposed to talk to me, I mean, I'm not supposed to talk to you, you see, Miss Nyx, she... oh, I will be in so much trouble, now!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, Dusa, slow down, what is the matter? Nyx really has forbidden you from even speaking with me? Do you know on what grounds?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I've no idea, Prince, I, look... I really want to keep my job here, so, I can't, I can't be seen with you right now, like this, please understand, I have to go, OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 杜莎，喂，怎么回事，你好像……怪怪的，有什么问题吗？还是告诉我吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 不，王子殿下，您……您不该和我说话的，我是说，我不能跟您说的，倪克斯小姐她……啊，我又要惹麻烦了！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 慢点，杜莎，慢点说，怎么回事？倪克斯真的让你连话都不准跟我说吗？到底怎么回事？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我也不知道，王子殿下，我……我真的很在乎自己的工作，所以我不能，不能被人看到像这样跟你站在一起，请您理解，好吗？我要走了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dusa, I... think that Nyx has some concerns... maybe with me, because it's like you said, she doesn't want us talking here like this. Is she... not satisfied with the work you've been doing, or something?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Ah, Prince, no, it isn't you, it's definitely me! There's all these things she said I need to work on, calmness, not making so many lists, putting things into perspective, not working myself too hard, not taking blame for things that aren't my fault...!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Those sound like reasonable goals, though I just wish that Nyx could find a way to tell you that wasn't so upsetting. Won't you take care of yourself, Dusa, please?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: ...And plus, she said I'm not supposed to talk to you, she said that too, oh, I am going to be in so much trouble, aah!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 杜莎，我……我觉得倪克斯可能有些想法……关于我的想法。因为就像你说得那样，她不希望我们像这样聊天。她……她对你最近的工作不满意了吗？还是怎么样了？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 啊，王子殿下。不，这和你无关，都是我的问题！她说我要做的事情就是保持镇定，不要规划太多工作，要学会全面考虑问题，不要把自己逼得太紧，如果不是自己的错就别主动去揽锅……！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这些建议听起来都合情合理，不过我觉得，倪克斯只是在用她的方式告诉你，她并没有生你的气。你可以好好照顾照顾自己吗，杜莎？拜托了。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: ……另外，她说我不应该和你攀谈。啊啊，这句话她也说过了，我要有大麻烦了，啊啊！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I, um, Prince, I... wanted to say good-bye, because... it's my last day. Or night? Um, anyway, it's really been a pleasure, knowing you, and working here, and so...!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, wait, wait, what exactly happened, your last day or night, what is all this? You're really leaving? Why?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I lost my job! Miss Nyx, she... it's her final word, and so... I need to go, before I make things any worse. Farewell, Highness! Farewell...!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我，呃，王子殿下，我……是来说再见的，因为……这是我最后一天，或者说最后一晚在这里工作了。嗯，不管怎样，这段时间我一直很开心，能在这里工作，认识您，这里的一切都是这么美好……！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等下……等下……等下，到底怎么回事，什么最后一天一晚的，你到底在说什么？你真要走了吗？为什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我的工作丢了！倪克斯小姐她……她是这样说的，所以……我不能再闯祸了，我得走了。再见了，王子殿下！再见了……！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Prince, I... hi, again, I guess... I guess I'm back? At work, here, once again?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Imagine my relief. I'm glad that Nyx has come around. I... understand she was concerned, but... I hope she never looks past all your good qualities like that again.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I hope so, too. I'm glad to have my job back. It's hard work, and I know there's more to life, such as it is, than this, but... it matters a lot to me, you know? I have to do this, so... I'm glad that all of you are letting me.

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 王子殿下，我……您好呀！我应该说……我又回来啦？又可以在这里工作啦？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 总算松了一口气。真高兴倪克斯能改变主意。我明白她是有点担心，不过……我希望她不要再忽视你的所有优点了。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我也希望这样。很高兴能回来工作。工作不容易，但生活总会有这样那样的不如意……不过，这对我很重要，您知道吗？我需要这份工作……很高兴您给我这样的机会。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So, what even happened when you lost your job, Dusa? Did you have someplace else to stay? Was everything all right?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: You know, it's funny, after I was fired... at first, I just couldn't believe it, I... felt lost! But, after a few days or nights, it's like, it opened up my eyes, you know? Suddenly, I had all this time to myself, and... what I realized was, I was... so, so tired. I think I really needed the break.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm surprised you wanted to come back to work after something like that. Wouldn't you be totally fed up? Burned out on the whole thing?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I love this work too much to get burned out, Prince. But that's me. I know there's more to being alive or being dead than just your work, but... my work happens to be important to me. And besides... if I don't push myself from time to time, how can I ever know my limits, right?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: But if you go too far beyond your limits, things can get bad. Believe me. I mean, you almost lost the job you care so much about.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: You're right, I... need to be more careful, not to push myself too hard, too often. Hey, could I ask a favor? Would you tell me if I go too far with work again?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那么，丢掉工作之后发生了什么，杜莎？你住在哪里？没发生什么不好的事吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我被解雇之后，很有意思……一开始，我一直不敢相信，我觉得……很失落！后来，过了几天，或者说几个晚上，我突然就明白了，您知道吗？我一下子就有了大把的时间……还有，我感觉……非常非常累，我觉得自己要好好休息一下才行。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 发生了这样的事情，之后你还愿意回来工作也挺让我吃惊的。你不觉得烦吗？这些事情没有把你搞得筋疲力尽吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我太爱这工作了，王子殿下，永远也不会觉得累。我是这样想的。我知道，按理说生死比工作要重要，不过……我非常在乎自己的工作。另外……如果我不去鞭策自己，怎么会知道自己的极限呢，对吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你太勉强自己也不好。相信我。你看，你差点丢掉自己心爱的工作。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 您说得对，我……我是要多注意了，不会再这么逞强了。对了，我问一下，如果发现我工作太过卖力，您能提醒下我吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: How's work lately, Dusa? You seem to have a handle on your new responsibilities, or so I hear from Nyx.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh yes, it's going pretty well, so far, I think! I have some new accounting duties, though I've parceled everything, and got a budget for a little extra help. It's funny, I-I should be busier than ever, but... I have more time to spare, lately, and things are good, I guess?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 最近工作怎么样，杜莎？你似乎对自己的新工作很有信心啊，起码倪克斯是这样说的。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢，没错，我觉得，现在一切进展都很顺利！我在办公室里又多了些会计工作，不过我已经把事情都处理好了，还有一些余力来做其他事情。真有意思，我……我应该比以前更忙才对，但是……现在好像时间反而更充裕了，这是好事，对吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dusa, hey, I wanted to congratulate you! Saw you were chosen as the featured servant of the House, getting your portrait there, right in the lounge for all to see! That's quite an honor!

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, haha, it's really nothing, Prince, something that anybody could have done really, as long as they were fired up to do their very, very best, all the time, with a positive attitude, and without worrying too much about the overwhelming amount of work that still needs to be done!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨杜莎，我要祝贺你啊！我看到你被选为圣殿里最受欢迎的仆从了，你的画像挂在休息室供大家瞻仰呢！真是莫大的荣誉啊！

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哦，哈哈，这其实算不上什么，王子殿下。这些事情其实每个人都能做得到，只要他们能带着积极的态度，非常非常努力地工作，不要去想还有那么多成堆成堆的工作还在等着，这样就行了！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, Prince! Persephone, your mother, wow, she's, woww...! It's no wonder you wanted to try to find her. She's something else! Although, I guess you didn't know that till you met her, huh? But, still!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's definitely an adjustment, with my mother here. Especially for her! I'm glad the two of you are getting on all right. I guess things will be different, now, but... hopefully, it's for the better, isn't it?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Are you kidding?! Ah, didn't mean to be so rude, it's just, I think it's definitely better, now! We're like a complete team!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哦，王子殿下！珀尔塞福涅，你的母亲，哇哦，她可真是，哇哦……！怪不得你这么想找到她。她可真是不同凡响！我猜你见到她之前也不知道吧？不过她真了不起！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我的母亲已经来了，这确确实实就是改变，尤其是对她而言！我很高兴你们两个相处得很好。我觉得现在一切会和以前不太一样，不过……希望能往好的方面变化，好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 你是在逗我吗？！啊，我没打算这么无礼，我觉得一切确实变得好多了！我们就像亲密无间的队友一样！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Um, Prince, so, is it... really true, then, that you're staying, and... that you'll be working here, officially, I guess?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I... well, when you put it that way, yes, I guess it is! We're going to try and make it work like this, for now.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Well you know what this means, don't you? We're official co-workers now!! Isn't that so exciting? We can share our latest learnings, compare notes about the challenges we're up against, run into one another in the hall...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dusa... we've been doing everything you said this entire time.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: But it is not the same! The entire feel of it's completely different, now! You'll see! So, OK!! Bye!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 呃，王子殿下，所以说……你真的打算留在这里，而且……会正式留在这里工作，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我……嗯，如果你这么说的话，是啊，我想是的！我们暂时可以一起工作，一起打理这座圣殿了。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哇啊，你明白这意味着什么吧？咱们已经是正式的同事了！！这可真是太让人激动了，是吧？咱们可以聊聊最近发生的事情，谈谈彼此遇到的难题，在大殿里见个面打个招呼什么的……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 杜莎……你说的那些事情，咱们一直都在做。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 可这并不一样！现在这一切感觉都不一样了！你会明白的！所以，好啦！！下次见啦！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...I think I finally know a little more about how you must feel, Dusa. Working for Father, I mean. I was so intent on running away from here, but... here I am.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Look, Prince, um... your father's always been a pretty scary god. And, this is something between you and him. Though, if you can forgive him, I guess... it means you'd stay? And I would like that, so... that's where I stand! I know it's really complicated, though.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: ……我觉得，我终于能稍微理解一些你的感受了，杜莎。我是说，替我父亲工作的感受。我之前一直打算逃出这个地方，可现在……成了这个样子。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 你看，王子殿下，呃……你的父亲一直是个很吓人的神明，而且你们之间还有些过节。不过，如果你能原谅他的话，我猜……你就会留在这里了吧？我很希望你能留下，所以……这就是我的看法！不过我也知道，这件事情非常负责。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dusa, this whole place, it looks immaculate! That's even after all Olympus came here for that giant feast? How did you get everything clean so fast?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, ha-hah! Well! I guess I have my ways, Prince. Sometimes you get one of those jobs and you just want to give it everything you've got, you know? I get a lot of jobs like that! Feeding Cerberus, cleaning the rafters! But this one? I just knew it was the perfect job for me!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 杜莎，这个地方看起来完美无瑕！奥林匹斯众神这才刚刚来这里，参加了一场隆重的盛宴啊！你是怎么这么快就把这里清扫干净的？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哦，哈哈！这么说吧！我有我自己的办法，王子殿下。有时当你负责某件工作的时候，你就想尽心尽力把它做好，你懂的吧？我有很多想做好的工作！像给刻耳柏洛斯喂食，清理房梁之类的！至于给盛宴收拾残局，这简直是我梦寐以求的工作！

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, uh, hey there, Dusa! How's your endless toil treating you?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Um, Mister Hypnos, do you... maybe think that you could, you know, uh, keep an eye on the procession line before Lord Hades? Like you were supposed to...?

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh! Um, that's no problem, I can definitely do that, I'll just add it to the list!

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Um, good, then! Glad we had a chance to chat. Now, maybe get some sleep or something. You look pretty beat...?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，你好，杜莎！忙的怎么样了？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 呃，修普诺斯先生，您……您应该可以，呃，那个，好好看着冥王哈迪斯面前的这条长队吗队伍，这是您应该做的事情，是吧……？

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢！呃，好的好的，没问题的，我马上就把这个写到表单上！

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 嗯，好的！那么，很高兴能跟你说上话。你也应该要睡一觉了吧，你看起来有点不太精神……？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Mister Hypnos, I, uh, wanted to check in with you again, regarding the procession line that's... right in front of you, right over there, it's... moving pretty slow.

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: I know! Those shades, they just go on and on, and on and on, forever, blathering about this or that! I mean, Lord Hades, it's a wonder he can stand it, listening to them every day or night!

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Um, well, it's just, I think you were supposed to keep things moving, so, if they're taking too long, I guess that maybe you could say something, or... any bright ideas?

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: It's a toughie, Dusa, because I think it's important that the shades who wait their turn, why, that they get a chance to say their piece! But it's a real tricky situation you bring up, so, let me tell you what I'm going to do: I am going to sleep on it! And then, get back to you!

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: OK, well... if you don't, though, I'll check in with you again, later, I guess? Because, I'm under orders, so... um... bye...

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 修普诺斯大人，我，呃呃，想和你聊聊，关于……关于你面前的那条长队，就在那边，它……它几乎都没怎么动过。

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道！这些幽灵真是没完没了，总是在抱怨这个抱怨那个，没完没了！我是说，冥王哈迪斯天天听他们抱怨这些事情，居然还能受得了，这简直是不可思议！

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 呃，我是觉得，你应该负责让他们动起来。如果他们一直都待在那里的话，我觉得，或许你应该对他们说些什么，或者……你有什么好主意吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 这是件棘手的事情，杜莎。因为我认为，让这些幽灵学会排队等待非常重要，等轮到他们，他们才能说自己的事情！不过你说的这个问题也很棘手，所以，我打算这么做：我打算美美地睡上一觉！然后，再答复你！

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 好吧……如果你没来的话，我过一阵子再来问你吧？因为我有命令在身，所以……呃……再见……

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Heya Dusa, let me guess! You're here regarding the procession of these shades, who have been standing here for quite some time, clogging the hall a bit... they've barely moved at all!

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Y, you guessed it, Mister Hypnos, so... have you, um, given any thought to maybe focusing the traffic flow through here a little bit, to keep the hallway clearer, and, oh, I don't know, put some sort of time limit in place?

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: You know, can't say I have! I've got my registration list, and I have had to keep a careful eye on it, with all the shades that have been pouring in? It's really gotten slow around here!

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: It definitely has, I... have to go, um, hope you get yourself some rest, OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，杜莎，让我猜猜！你又是因为那些幽灵的事情来的吧？他们已经在这里等了相当长一段时间了，这个大厅已经有点挤了……而且他们几乎一点都没动过！

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 你，你猜得一点都没错，修普诺斯大人。所以……你，呃呃，你有没有考虑过怎么才能让他们动起来，好让这个大厅没那么拥挤？或者说，呃，打个比方，加个时间限制之类的？

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 老实说，我没怎么考虑过！这么多幽灵涌进来，光是这份注册清单就够我忙的了，我得确保这个过程万无一失，是吧？这边的进度真的很慢！

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 确实如此，我……呃，我得走了，希望你能有时间好好休息休息，好吗？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I can't believe it, Mister Hypnos, how... how did you do it? All the shades that have been lining up, they... they've been moving right along!

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: You know, you're right, they have! They definitely have. It's pretty hard to notice, since they're slow, but I have a keen eye. And so do you! You noticed before I did in this case. What did you say your question was back there?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I asked you how you did it, got the traffic flow moving a little faster, and... it's the sarcophagus things, isn't it? Right down the hall! The shades, they're scared to stand around! That's brilliant, Mister Hypnos, I'm impressed!

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, hahaha, that, well, really, it was nothing, Dusa! Though, I'll tell you something! It is good to know that you're impressed with me!

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I, haha, don't know if I'd go that far, um, anyway! I'll mark this as resolved!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我真不敢相信，修普诺斯大人。你……你到底是怎么做到的？所有的幽灵都排好队了，他们……他们已经动起来了！

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，你说得没错，他们动起来了！确实动起来了。虽然他们走得太慢了，不仔细看根本看不出来，但我的眼力可是很厉害的，你也一样！我还没注意到呢，你就先注意到了。哦，你刚刚问我什么来着？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我问你是怎么做到的，是怎么让他们稍微动得快那么一点点的，而且……那是个石棺，是吧？就摆在大厅里面！那些幽灵被吓坏了，只好老老实实地呆着！真是个好主意，修普诺斯大人，你真是太了不起了！

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，哈哈哈，是啊，没错，嗯，只是举手之劳而已，杜莎！不过我得说实话，你觉得我了不起，我很高兴！

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我，啊哈哈，我不知道我是不是说的太夸张了！啊，总之！我就当这件事已经解决好了！

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: ...And after that, Dusa, you are to clean the rafters once again, and prune the gardens thoroughly. By then it should be time to tend the kitchens, and sweep the lounging area a second time...

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Y, yes, right away!

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: …然后呢，杜莎，你要把房檐再清洁一次，接着把花园彻底修剪一番。做完这些的时候就应该去厨房了，然后把休息室再打扫一次。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 是，是的，马上就去！

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: ...Lastly, Dusa, you are not permitted to address the Prince, unless first spoken to. You are invisible to him. Now, are we understood?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Yes, Miss Nyx, we're understood, I mean... I understand. I, I'll be going, then.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: …最后，杜莎，你不准主动跟王子说话，除非他先开口。你对他来说就像不存在一样。现在明白了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 知道，倪克斯女士，明白了…我明白。那，那我就先走了。

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Miss Nyx, you're...? Do I want my job again, I... wha, I, more than anything! This job, it, it means everything to me, I mean, working with you? You are the Night Itself! This place, and all of you, all of it, it's so amazing to me, and I just... I, just I want to help! Just, give me one more chance!

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Your one more chance has certain stipulations, Dusa. If you think it is necessary to exceed the allotted time for your responsibilities, I expect you to ask. You are not the sole bearer of this House's fate. Your temperament toward your work is as important as the end result. Now then... I would ask that you return to your post.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: What, I, Miss Nyx, you mean... like, start right now? Now now? I mean, I, I don't have a lot of pressing obligations, so, I'll do it, yes!! I accept! I'm so excited to be back! Where do I even start, I can survey the lounge, sweep the cobwebs, walk Cerberus, check the pantry, ah, OK, I'm off!!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯女士，您这是……？我想不想重新工作，我……我当然想了呀！这份工作，对我来说比什么都重要，我是说，与您共事吗？您可是夜的化身啊！这个地方，这里的人，所有的一切，都让我感到无比快乐，而我……我只是想帮忙！请……请再给我一次机会吧！

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你的这次机会要签署特殊的契约，杜莎。如果你觉得自己没法在规定的时间里完成自己的工作，你可以请求帮助。在这座圣殿工作的人并不只有你一个。你对待工作的态度和工作的结果也很重要。那么……你现在可以回去工作了。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 什么、我、倪克斯女士，您是说……现在就开始？现在立刻？我是说，我现在没有什么要紧事，所以我会去做的，没错！我愿意！能回来我真是太激动了！我该从哪里开始啊，我可以巡视休息室、清扫蜘蛛网、遛刻耳柏洛斯、检查储藏室……啊！太好了！

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: ...and, therefore, for your diligence and service, and for having demonstrated such improvement... by my authority as Night Itself, I hereby name you Chief Custodian of the House of Hades, and appoint to you the privileges implied. Bear the responsibility with honor, Dusa.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Miss Nyx, I am truly honored, and, I'm very grateful for this opportunity, and for the trust you've placed in me, in this expanded role. I promise you, I will not let you down. Not you, or anybody here! Thank you so much!!

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You are most welcome. The orderliness of this House is a reflection of the realm as a whole. You have internalized this, and understood that a disciplined approach toward work is far more valuable than mere exertion of effort. Although, you understand the need for exertion, as well.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: ……因为，你一直以来的辛勤奉献，也因你获得如此进步……在此，我以夜的名义，任命你为哈迪斯圣殿的首席管家，同时给予你额外的特权。望你能珍惜这份荣耀，担起重任，杜莎。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯小姐，我感到非常荣幸，能有这次机会，获得您的信任，可以负责更多工作，我非常感激。我保证不会让您失望，也不会让这里的任何人失望！非常感谢您！！

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 不必如此客气。秩序井然的圣殿能从整体上反映这一领地的面貌。你深知这一点，你明白严谨有序的工作态度比埋头苦干更重要。而且，你也明白后者的重要性。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...And then, all seven of those wretches tried cutting to the front of the procession line, can you believe the nerve? As though they'd get an audience that way.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Ha, hahah, what a bunch of dummies! What were they even thinking, cutting the line, I mean, in front of you?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Let's just say, if they still have any complaints for our Lord Hades, they'll be waiting for a long, long time before they get the chance to bring them up.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: …然后，全部七个暗灵都想插到队伍前头去，真不知道是哪儿来的勇气。好像这样就能吸引大家注意似的。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哈，哈哈，真是一群白痴！他们到底在想什么呢，还想插队，在你面前插队？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，如果他们还是有怨言要对冥王哈迪斯禀告的话，那也得等很久很久才能呈上来了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...I swear you're right that one is such an idiot...! Though anyway, I'd best get back to work. Next round's on me, Dusa, and you take care.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: You take care, too, Miss Meg, thanks for the drink! Bye now...!

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: …我发誓你是对的，那家伙真是个大白痴…！好了，我要回去工作了。下一回我请，杜莎，你保重。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 您也保重，墨纪小姐，谢谢您！再见…！

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...Follow your heart? That's odd advice, especially from you. Though, no offense intended.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I just mean, if you don't believe in the work you're doing, why keep on doing it, just out of obligation? You have to take care of yourself.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I don't think there's any rush for that. We won't just shrivel up and die in forty years like mortals do. But, I know what you're saying. I'll think about it, Dusa. Thanks.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……跟随自己的内心？这话从你嘴里讲出来，还真是有些奇怪。不过，我也没有冒犯你的意思。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我的意思是，如果你自己都不在乎自己的工作，那何必还要干这份工作呢，只是为了完成任务吗？你要好好为自己想想了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我不觉得有什么可着急的。我们不会像凡人一样活个四十来年就匆匆衰老而死。不过，我懂你的意思。我会好好想一想的，杜莎。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...We got off on the wrong foot from the start. Just what happens when you're born of Titan blood, I guess. It's for the best we haven't crossed paths much since.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: But they're your sisters, I mean... they're family! You must have something in common, some way of, I don't know, seeing eye to eye?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You're more my sister than they are to me, Dusa. I don't always agree with Lord Hades but I am thankful that they're not permitted in this House.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……我们一开始就不是一路人。我想可能是因为你有着泰坦血统的关系吧。我想，我们还是尽量少见面吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 但是你们是姐妹啊，我是说……你们是一家人呀！你们肯定还是有共同点的，比如说，对事情有一致的看法？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 其实，你比她们更像我的姐妹，杜莎。虽然，有时我并不赞同哈迪斯大人的看法，但对于禁止她们几个出现在圣殿里这个决定，我深感欣慰。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...You sure that you're all right, with everything? I just... I wouldn't want you to be caught up in the middle of all this. If you so much as said to call it off...

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: No, nononono, no, Meg, no! No, Meg! Come on, now, are you kidding me? I mean, I couldn't be happier about it, really! You deserve this! As long as you're happy, yourself, right?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Well, thank you, Dusa. You've always been so kind. I don't quite know what to say.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Hey, now, that's my line! Look, though, I better get going, but, I just want to say this is great news, all right? Thank you for telling me!

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……说了这么多，没有影响到你吧？我是说……我可不想让你卷入这些事情里来。如果你不想再说这些事情……

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 没有，没有，没有……没有，真的没有，墨纪！不存在的！哎呀，你开什么玩笑嘛！我高兴还来不及呢！这样就对了！只要你开心就好，不是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 谢谢你，杜莎。你对我太好了。我都不知道说什么好了。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 喂，那可是我的台词！我现在得走啦，不过，这可真是个好消息，对不对？谢谢你能告诉我这些！

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: ...Would that all my subjects exhibited such promptness. Your report, then, if you please, Dusa?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Sir! The office currently is running smoothly, sir! Lounge attendance is up by twenty-eight percent, with customer satisfaction ratings in the eightieth percentile. No issues to report at this time.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: See that we achieve thirty percent before the turn of the aeon, Chief Custodian. Other than that... a satisfactory report. Now, carry on.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: ……要是我所有的仆从都能像你这么勤快就好了。可以请你开始汇报了吗，杜莎？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 陛下！办公室目前运转正常，陛下！休息室的上座率提高百分之二十八，顾客的满意度在百分之八十以上，目前没有任何问题需要汇报。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 看来我们已经赶在下个时代到来前，完成了百分之三十的目标，总管。除此之外……你的报告很让人满意，继续努力吧。

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Um, it's my great pleasure to make your acquaintance. Call me Dusa, please! I, I'm your House custodian? And I am at your service! Anything you need, just call, OK?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Dusa! Wonderful to know you! This House is immaculate! Night-and-day difference from before. Now I know exactly whom to compliment.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Thanks so much! I will not let you down!!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 呃，能见到您真是我的荣幸。请叫我杜莎就好！我，我算是您的圣殿管家？我时刻愿意为您效劳！如果需要什么，告诉我就好，好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 杜莎，能认识你真的很高兴！这座圣殿真是太棒了！和以前完全不一样，我现在知道这都是谁的功劳了。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 谢谢您！我不会让您失望的！！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I, I, I, oh no, I, just forgot something, I, I have to go!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我，我，我，噢不，我，我忘记什么东西了，我得走了！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, um, Your Highness, I was just, making the rounds again!!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢，殿下，我刚才，也还是就随便到处走走呢！！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Um, everything is spick and span like always, Your Highness!!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 嗯，所有东西都跟平时一样光洁如新，殿下！！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Y-you'd tell me if I did anything wrong, wouldn't you, Prince?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 您，如果我哪里做得不对，您会告诉我的吧，王子？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: ...dusted the halls, dusted the library, dusted the sconces, dusted the doorknobs, dusted the chairs...

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: …打扫大厅，打扫图书馆，打扫烛台，打扫门把手，打扫椅子…

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: ...let's see, I cleaned the mantle, cleaned the rafters, cleaned the skulls, cleaned the bar-room...

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: …我想想，斗篷，房檐，骨头，酒吧间都打扫过了…

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, um, hi! Hello, Your Highness, nice to see you! Thanks!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢，嗯，您好！您好，殿下，见到您很高兴！谢谢！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Working hard, Your Highness! Always working!

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I'll make sure everything is taken care of!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 努力工作，殿下！一直都在工作！

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我保证照顾到所有东西！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, hahaha, thanks for talking to me, Prince, I have to go!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢，哈哈哈，谢谢您跟我说话，王子，我得走了！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Hi Prince, I fed Cerberus already, all three heads!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 王子您好，我已经喂过刻耳柏洛斯了，三个头都喂了！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Wha, hah-haha, oh, you startled me, Your Highness...!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哇，哈哈哈，噢，您吓到我了，殿下……！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I'm just keeping busy busy busy here like always, Prince!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我就是在这里一直忙，一直忙……和平时一样，王子殿下！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I, I, I, I'm sorry that you died again out there, Your Highness...!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我，我，我，我很抱歉您又死了一次，殿下…！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, um, hi! Is... everything all right, there, Prince?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哦，呃，嗨！一切……都还好吗，王子殿下？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Nothing gets dirty around here while I am on the job, Your Highness...!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 只要有我在，这里绝对干干净净，殿下…！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Don't worry, Prince! I'll keep an eye on things!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 不用担心，王子！我会照看好一切的！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: You can count on me, Your Highness!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 您可以相信我，殿下！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Anything I can do for you right now, or, maybe later...?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 有什么事情可以帮到您吗，还是，现在不需要…？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: ...let's see, I did the dishes, fed the heads, cleaned the cupboards, cleared the pool...

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: ……我想想，我盘子洗了，狗也喂了，柜子和水池也都清理了……

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, Prince, um, I'm supposed to be at work, so, I can't talk, OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢，王子殿下，呃，我要工作了，不能陪您聊天了，好吗？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Excuse me, sorry, I just have to file this report, it's very late!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 不好意思，对不起，我得把这份报告归档下！已经很晚了！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I, I, I have everything here well under control, Highness!!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 现……现在一切都在我的掌控之中，殿下！！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: What, is something wrong, Prince? I'll look into it, right now, up there!!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 什么？有什么问题吗，王子殿下？我马上就去调查清楚！！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Am I in trouble for something again, or, no...?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我又惹麻烦了吗，还是说……？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I'm always at 110%, hah, hahah!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我可是一直都铆足了劲呢，哈哈哈！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Um, I, I, I, I'm sorry, I, I better get back to my cleaning...!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 呃，我，我，我，不好意思，我，我要回去做清洁了…！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, wow! I'm so sorry, Prince, I'm just behind already on my daily chores!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哦，哇哦！我很抱歉，王子殿下，我的工作进度已经慢了！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Ah! Haha, got me again, Prince, sneaking up on me like that!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 啊！哈哈，你又偷偷摸摸从我身后冒出来，把我吓了一跳，王子殿下！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: You'll get them next time, Prince, I'm sure of it! I think?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 你下次一定能战胜他们，王子殿下，我敢肯定！我能肯定吧？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Just making sure the lounge is squeaky clean!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我要确保休息室一尘不染！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: This is going to be the best lounge in all the Underworld!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 这里一定会成为整个冥界最舒服的休息室！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: You let me know if you see any dust around here, won't you, Prince?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 如果看到有灰尘的话，记得告诉我好吗，王子殿下？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: You rest assured I'm not even remotely tired, Prince!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 放心吧，王子殿下，我一点都不累！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Please count on me for all your household needs!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 所有的家务事，就都包在我身上吧！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I'll make sure Cerberus has everything he needs while you're out!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 你出去的时候，我会好好照顾刻耳柏洛斯，他要什么就给他什么！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Don't tell me I'm in trouble, am I, Prince?!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我该不是有麻烦了吧，王子殿下？！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Just thought I'd mention, I, I really love this job!!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我只是想说一句，我——我真的很喜欢这份工作！！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: ...stocked the store room, checked the locks, cleaned the tiles, watered the trees...

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: ……储藏室整理过了，门锁检查过了，瓷砖清洗过了，树木也浇过水了……

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: ...checked the contracts, cleared the ledgers, set the tables, washed the windows...

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: ……契约检查过了，账本清理过了，桌子都摆好了，窗户也擦好了……

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: ...sorted the files, gathered the feedback, updated the schedule, sent the report...

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: ……文件整理好了，反馈收集好了，日程表更新了，报告也发出去了……

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: You please take care of yourself, OK, Prince?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 请务必照顾好自己，好吗，王子殿下？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I sometimes get so worried for you, Zagreus...!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 有时，我真的很担心你，扎格列欧斯……！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Don't worry, Prince, I have everything here well under control...!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 不用担心，王子殿下，一切都在我的掌控之中……！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I hope you have a great whatever time it is out there, Highness!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 希望您出门在外能一切顺利，殿下！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I will definitely keep an eye on things while you are out!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 您不在的时候，我会替您照看好这里！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Just in the middle of a wall-to-wall inspection right now, Prince!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我正在彻底检查这里，王子殿下！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Heard everything's been good lately between you and Miss Meg!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 听说，您和墨纪小姐最近关系不错！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Eternal friends forever, right, Prince Zagreus?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 愿我们的友谊天长地久，对吧，扎格列欧斯王子？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: So glad to see you back here, Your Highness!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 很高兴看到您回来，王子殿下！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Made sure the House was nice and tidy for you, Prince!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我为您将圣殿打扫得整洁如新了，王子殿下！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Your Highness, hi! All's well here, nothing to report!!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 您好，王子殿下！这里一切安好！！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Looks like we've both been keeping busy, huh, Your Highness?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 看来咱们都很忙啊，王子殿下。

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Whew, I have been so busy, lately, Prince! The same as you!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噗……我最近和您一样，也很忙呢，王子殿下！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Sorry, not much time to chat more right now, Prince!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 对不起，王子殿下，我现在没时间聊天呀！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: We'll have to catch up in the lounge sometime, huh, Prince?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 改天，我们到休息室再好好叙旧吧，王子殿下，好吗？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, haha, you startled me, there, Prince!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢，哈哈，您吓了我一跳，王子殿下！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Hold on, Prince! Think I saw some dust I missed up there!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 稍等，王子殿下！请让我打扫一下那边！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Sorry, got to file this report, now, Prince!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 对不起，请让我先填好这份报告，王子殿下！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Nice to see you, now I'm off to clean the rafters once again!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 很高兴见到您，我现在准备再去擦一遍房檐！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I'm on duty right now, but it's really nice to see you like this, Prince!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我正忙着呢，王子殿下，不过还是很高兴见到您！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I know your job gets frustrating sometimes, so please remember to take breaks, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我知道你的工作有时会很不顺，所以记得要休息休息，好吗？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I hope you're always finding joy in work like I do, Prince!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 希望你能像我一样，总是能在工作里找到快乐，王子殿下！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: From the reports I've seen it looks like you've been doing such great work out there!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 从我看过的报告来看，你最近的工作表现非常出色！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Um, I, I, I, I'm sorry, I, I better get back to my cleaning...!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 呃，我，我，我，不好意思，我，我要回去做清洁了…！

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Not now, Zag. Private meeting.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Don't work yourself too hard, OK, Highness?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 现在不行，扎格，我们有事情要谈。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 别把自己累坏了，好吗，殿下？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Please do remember to take breaks, OK?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: We'll have to chat some other time, here, Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 记得休息休息，好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 下次有机会再聊吧，扎格。

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: You get rest from time to time, for me, OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 你得时不时地休息休息，就当是为了我，好吗？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I hope you get to see Miss Meg out there next time!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 希望你下次能见到墨纪女士！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I hope you'll get to see Thanatos again soon!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 希望你很快就能再见到塔纳托斯！

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Can't you see we're in the middle of a conversation, Zagreus?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你没看到我们正在谈话吗，扎格列欧斯？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Excuse us, Zagreus, we're in the middle of a meeting here.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 抱歉，扎格列欧斯，我们正在谈话呢。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You know you can just let us talk without being interrupted, Zagreus?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: This particular discussion doesn't concern you, Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你可以先别打扰，让我们把事情聊完。你知道的吧，扎格列欧斯？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我们讨论的事情和你无关，扎格。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...Sometimes, though, Dusa, he's not the best at taking hints...

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……不过杜莎，有时候他就是没办法心领神会……

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Now, here you go, Cerbie! And, um, don't eat me, please?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 好了，开动吧，小刻！还有，呃，别把我吃了，好吗？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Um, here you go, boy! Triple order, just the way you like it!

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 呃， 好了，乖狗狗！三份饭都做好了，按你喜欢的样子来的！

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: ...Just, please be careful where you go after you eat all this, this time, OK, Cerbie?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: ……只是等你吃完之后，活动筋骨的时候要当心点，好吗，小刻？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, come on, Cerbie, hurry up and eat! This stuff can't be that bad! I mean... can it?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哦，拜托，小刻，快来吃嘛！我做的东西不可能那么难吃吧！我是说……是吧？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, Ms. Dusa? I wanted you to have this. It's nothing really, just... for your hard work.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: P-P-Prince, I'm really grateful for this, really, and I thought, I, kind of got something for you...?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，杜莎小姐？我想给你这个，不是什么值钱的东西，就当……是你辛勤工作的奖励吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 王，王子殿下，我真的非常感激。不过我也……我也有东西要给你……

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Wh-whaaaa, b-but, there must be some mistake, I, Prince, you're giving this to me...?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I want you to know we all appreciate you, Dusa. Don't work yourself too hard on my account, OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 呜哇啊啊，但，但是，这一定有什么误会，我，王子，你要把这个给我…？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我想让你知道，我们都很感谢你，杜莎。不要因为我你就不要命的工作，好吗？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Ohh, oh, oh, oh my, Your Highness, are you... are you really sure you want me to have this?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I really am, Dusa. I hope you enjoy it.

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢，噢，噢，天啊，殿下，你真的…真的要把这个给我吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没错，杜莎。我希望你会喜欢。

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: B-b-but, Prince, I, don't know what to say, I... are you joking around with me, maybe...?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, I am deadly serious, Dusa, honest. It's for you.

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 但，但是，王子，我，我不知道该说什么了，我…您是不是在跟我开玩笑呀…？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，我现在可是非常认真的，杜莎，真的。是给你的。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dusa, you must work harder than anyone in this House, keeping everything so neat and orderly. I don't think it should be thankless work, so, thank you! And I'd like for you to have this.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, Prince, wow, thank you! Thanks so much!! You've been so generous, I... I think I'm speechless! No, can't think of anything to say right now!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, you said it all! Don't mean to put you on the spot or anything. I'm just glad we've had a chance to get to know each other.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I... I'm glad we've had a chance to know each other, too. Thanks for the Nectar! I can tell it's really, really good! Um, OK, bye!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 杜莎，你一定是这里工作最认真，最努力的人，这样才能把这里整理得如此整洁整齐。我要好好谢谢你，真的十分感谢！还有，这个是送给你的。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢，王子殿下，哇，谢谢！太感谢您了！！您太慷慨了，我……我都不知道说什么好了！此情此景，真的不知道该说什么好了！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，什么都别说啦！我真的不是故意要让你如此紧张的。只是很高兴我们能彼此认识。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我……我也很高兴能有机会能够认识您。谢谢您的蜜露！一定非常好喝！嗯，好吧，后会有期！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey Dusa? Here's some more of this really, really good Nectar for you! Please keep up the wonderful work, and more importantly, keep being your wonderful self.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I, I, I, I'm really very flattered, Prince, but, I've just been so busy, lately, that I haven't even had a chance to try the last bottle you gave me, so... you want this back, maybe for someone else?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Please, it's yours! Besides, you must have some time off coming up when you can enjoy it, don't you?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh! I mean, maybe I do? I think maybe I do, except, nobody's told me anything about that, and besides, there's so much work to do around the House still, I just can't leave everything like this!!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨，杜莎？我这还有一些非常不错的蜜露要给你！还希望你能再接再厉，更重要的是，要坚持做优秀的自己。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我……我……我，我太感动了，王子殿下。不过我最近太忙了，上回您送的蜜露我还没来得及尝一口呢，所以……要不您就把这些蜜露送给别人吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这就是给你的！再说了，你肯定能抽出时间好好尝一尝的，不是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢！也许会有吧？应该会有的。还没人告诉过我这些话呢。现在，圣殿还有很多工作要做呢，我没办法坐视不理！！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Dusa? Congratulations on completing your assignment with the lounge. Look at this place! It's better than ever. All thanks to your effort and dedication. Here, this is for you. Something special for the occasion.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Whoa, I, this, this is Ambrosia, Prince! But, this is for gods...! This isn't for... someone like me? But, wait, wait wait, no, here, I'm going to do it, I am going to do it, here, take this!! I got it, just for you, so, take it, please! Farewell!!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨，杜莎！恭喜你完成了休息室的工作。快看看这里！比以前好多了。感谢你，这全是你的功劳！来，这是给你的，很特别的东西。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 哇，我，这，这是仙馔密酒啊，王子殿下！不过，这是只有神才能……！这可不是……我能享用的吧？不过，等下……等下……等下，我要送给您，我要送给您，这个！！专门给您弄来的，请收下吧！回头见了！！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Ambrosia isn't only for the gods, you know, Dusa. It's for anyone we really care about. So, here. Please, enjoy this, or... just add it to the lounge's stash. Whatever suits you.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, I, but, you... really mean that, huh...? But, you're the Prince himself, and I'm just... look, we both know I am just a floating monster head. And a custodian. I just don't understand. Why keep on being nice to me, like this? I thought you'd never even talk to me...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're so much more than what you said. I wish you could see that. If only everybody in this House had your spirit.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Ah. If only everybody in this House had yours, Prince Zagreus. You've been so kind to me, and I'm glad we've had a chance to get to know each other more. It's really nice, sometimes... knowing somebody really cares about me here?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It should be more than sometimes that you feel that way, as far as I'm concerned. I just... I've never met anybody like you before. My father always told me not to smile quite as much, but... you're like me.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: What, because I smile, haha? Smiling's just a little something that I like to do to deal with the day! Though, oh, that's what you meant, I... oh, I see. I, look, this is kind of a lot, I, I had better go...! I'll cherish the Ambrosia, though, OK?!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 仙馔密酒可不是神专享的，杜莎。它可以用来送给我们真正在乎的人。所以说，请收下吧。不然……直接放到休息室的储柜里也行。看你怎样方便了。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢，我……但是您……真的吗？但是您可是王子呀，而我只是……我们都知道，我只是个飘在空中的怪物头，一个管家而已。我真的不理解，您为什么一直对我这么好呢？我之前甚至还以为您连话都懒得跟我说……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你可比自己说的好多了。我希望你要知道这一点。如果圣殿里的人都能有你这样的精神就好了。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 啊，要是这座圣殿里的其他人也能像您一样就好了，扎格列欧斯王子。您一直对我很友善，我也很高兴能有机会和您更加了解彼此。有时候……知道有人真的在关心自己，这种感觉很棒，不是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我可不是有时候才会去关心你啊。我只是……从没遇到过像你一样的人。我父亲总教我做一个不苟言笑的人。不过……你跟我很像。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 什么，因为我喜欢笑吗，哈哈？笑是我一天当中做的最多的事情了！不过，噢，您是那个意思啊，我……噢……我懂了。这可有点难说了，我，我先走了……！我一定会好好珍惜您给的仙馔密酒！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I got you more Ambrosia, Dusa, and I hope this is OK. I figure maybe you could use this for the lounge? Special events, guests, that sort of thing?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: ...I'm sorry that I flew away last time you brought me something like this, Prince... I mean, Zagreus. It's really strange for me to call you that, I... when I started here, they told me not to even speak with you, and now, uh... here we are...!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, look, if I listened to everything I was told, my life would be a lot different and a lot worse off, I think! So... who cares what anybody says? I enjoy your company.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: And I enjoy yours, too! Wasn't long ago that I was just a lonely gorgon head, all by myself in the big Underworld, looking for steady work. And then, I heard about the opening here, in your father's House? Well I got it! It seemed too good to be real. And then, there was you...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I remember when we first met. You were carrying three bowls for Cerberus and bumped right into me. It all went flying, but you cleaned up half of it before it hit the ground. Then flew away before I got your name. I thought I'd never see you again.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I was so embarrassed! Worse... I thought I was done for, here. But, I got another chance! That was your doing, wasn't it? You've been looking out for me, all this time! That's so sweet of you, I... I don't know how to thank you, I... I, I better put this Ambrosia away, for safe keeping, OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我又给你送仙馔密酒来啦，杜莎，希望你能收下。也许你能在休息室里用到这些，比如说特殊的场合、款待客人之类的。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: ……不好意思，上次您送我这些蜜酒时，我扭头就跑了，王子殿下……我是说，扎格列欧斯。直呼您的名字真的感觉很奇怪……我刚来的时候，他们甚至不让我跟您说话，现在，呃……我们竟然还可以在这里……！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯……你知道吗，如果别人让我干什么，我就干什么，那我的人生可能会完全不一样，变得更糟糕了！所以说……不要太在乎别人的想法。有你陪我，我很高兴。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我也是呀！不久前，我还只是一个形单影只的蛇发女妖的头，只身一人在这偌大的冥界寻求一份稳定工作。后来，我听说了这里，您父亲的圣殿开始招募工作人员。然后我就得到了这份工作！当时我简直不敢相信这是真的。后来，就认识了您……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 第一次和你见面的情形依然历历在目。当时，你端着刻耳柏洛斯的三个碗跟我撞了个满怀。东西全都撞飞了，但是你在东西落地之前就清理了一半。然后，我还没来得及问你名字，你就一溜烟地跑开了。我还以为再也见不到你了。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 当时真的太尴尬了！更糟的是……当时，我还以为要因此丢掉饭碗了。不过，我又得到了一次机会！肯定是因为您吧？您一直以来都在关照我！您真的很贴心。我……我都不知道该如何感谢您了，我……我最好把这瓶仙馔密酒收好，保存起来，好吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Dusa, I was thinking that this batch of Ambrosia ought to hold the lounge over for quite a while! Keep things livelier for everyone. And, please take a bottle for yourself, won't you? As a token of my affection.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh! Y-you said your affection, huh, I... wow! I... really like you, also, Zagreus. I liked you from the start! You were so different from your father, and Miss Nyx, I could just tell, but... wait, what am I saying, I am such a dummy! You're just being friendly with me, right...?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I would be more than that, if it pleased you. You're very wonderful, and... you light up this House. But I would never risk our friendship, so, if this is where we draw the boundary, please, just let me know.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Um... wait, wait. Wait, wait. Did you just say I'm... wonderful?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I did, indeed. And I am glad to get it off my chest, if you must know! Though... what about you? How do you feel?

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: I, wow, I, I never thought you'd... have those kinds of feelings, for somebody like me. It's really nice to hear! It makes me feel complete. But, um, Zagreus, I don't know if I can be what you need, I mean? Wait. You weren't, you weren't just being nice to me for all this time, because...?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What? No, no, Dusa, of course not, I... ungh, why is it so damn difficult to share one's feelings with somebody else? I don't want to ruin what we have. If only you could see what's in my heart.

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh, hahaha, I was just checking, don't feel bad, OK? You don't seem capable of hiding what's in your heart. And I mean that in the best possible way. I'm so happy, it's just... all this is a lot, and, I'm on duty right now, but... see you soon...?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 杜莎，我觉得这批仙馔密酒应该够休息室用一阵子的了！让大家都有个好心情。你自己也来一杯吧，怎么样？就当是我的一点心意了。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢！您说您的心意，呃……我……哇！我……我也喜欢您，扎格列欧斯。从一开始，我就喜欢您了！您跟哈迪斯大人，倪克斯小姐都不一样，我也说不上来，但是……等下，我在说什么呀！我好傻！您只是把我当朋友的吧……？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果你愿意，不只做朋友也可以的。你真的很美妙，而且……你让这整座圣殿蓬荜生辉。但我不能拿我们的友谊来冒这个险，如果你觉得我们应该保持界限，请一定要让我知道。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 呃……等等，等等。等等，等等，你刚刚是说，我……很美妙……？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，我就是这么说的。而且说真的，我很高兴能把这些心里话说出来。你呢？你是怎么想的呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 我……哇……我想都没有想过……您对我这样的人，还有这种感觉。我很高兴！我感觉自己变得充实了。但是，呃，扎格列欧斯，我不知道自己有没有你说的这么好，我是说？等等。你一直以来对我都这么好，该不会是因为……？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么？没有没有，杜莎，当然不是的……啊，向人诉述衷肠怎么就这么难！我不想让我们之间这份美好的感觉付之一炬。你能明白我的心，我就别无他求了。

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
