zh-CN.text: 噢，哈哈哈，我只是问问，不用这么紧张。您好像不擅长隐藏自己的内心想法。我觉得这是件好事。我很高兴！只是……所有这些情况对我太过……我现在要工作啦！但是……我们回头再说吧……？

en.speaker: Dusa
en.text: Oh no, no no no, Your Highness, are you, really giving this to me?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Yes, yes I am, Ms. Dusa, and I hope you enjoy it. Be seeing you, OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 杜莎
zh-CN.text: 噢噢，不会吧，殿下，您，真的要给我这个吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是的，没错，杜莎小姐，我希望你会喜欢。回头见，好吗？

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Gguhhhhhh....

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Why good to see you, Charon mate! Just minding my own business, taking in the sights, and, hey what's that you got, some sort of wares for sale? Then, I'll just have a look around.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 咕啊啊啊…

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 见到你真好，卡戎老伙计！我正做我自己的事呢，也看看风景什么的，那么，你这里有什么，看看你有什么好货。我就四处转转。

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Gguhhhhhh....

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Why good to see you, Charon mate! Just minding my own business, taking in the sights, and, sure is awfully convenient to be running into you like this! I'd all this coin I wanted to get rid of.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 咕啊啊啊…

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 见到你真好，卡戎老伙计！我正做我自己的事呢，也看看风景什么的，就这样碰见你可真是太好了啊！我正想把身上这些钱币给花了呢。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Charon mate, now hypothetically, if I provided you with, say, a thousand coins, would you be willing to give me a ride in your beautiful boat? Upriver, I should say, specifically.

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Nrrnnhhh, hnnnn, hrrnn, hrrrrrnnn....

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 卡戎老兄，现在我们假设一下，如果我给你，嗯，一千个硬币，你能用你那漂亮的船送我一程吗？咱们往上游走，如果可以的话。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 呃嗯嗯，哈嗯嗯，赫嗯嗯，呃嗯嗯嗯嗯……

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, Charon, mate...? I don't suppose you've given any further thought to my proposal to, just, you know... ferry me up to the surface? Seeing as it's not out of your way.

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Rhhuuaaauuggghhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，卡戎，伙计…？你好像没有考虑过我的建议啊，就是，你直接…载我到凡界行不？果然还是不行吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 呃呃呃啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊……

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Got to say, you are a sight for sore eyes, there, Charon! So, uh... looks like you're selling, is that it? You come to help me out?

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Uunngggghhhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 说真的，你是真的让人着迷呢，卡戎！那么，呃…你要卖东西了吗？你也要来帮助我了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 咕啊啊啊…

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey good to see you out here, mate! And looks as though you've got some fine wares up for sale, don't you?

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Urrrnngghhhhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 很高兴看见你，伙计！看起来你好像又有些好货可以卖了！

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 呃嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯…

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Haaahhhhhhhhh....

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Fine day to you as well, there, mate! Now let's have a look at your supply, shall we?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 也祝你愉快，伙计！现在让我们看看你有什么好货吧！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You must have a lot of stops around these parts, don't you, Charon mate. Most of the dead are here in Asphodel, correct?

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Nnnnrrrrrhhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你一定停靠了很多次吧，卡戎老伙计。很多死人都在水仙花平原了，对不对？

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 呐啊啊…

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Charon, I'm in Asphodel now, aren't I? I'd always heard this was some flower-covered meadow type place, not such a... terrifying hellscape.

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hhhhaaaaaaahhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨，卡戎，我是在水仙花平原吧？我印象里，这里应该是那种遍地鲜花的草场才对，不是这种……可怕的地狱景象。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 哈哈——

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Charon. If there happens to be something really horrible awaiting me beyond that door there, then... give me a sign, won't you?

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hhhaaaaaaahhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 喂，卡戎。如果那扇门后面有什么非常恐怖的东西等着我，你…你给我点提示好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 哈啊啊啊啊啊啊啊……

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Care to provide me any insight as to just what sort of hideous monstrosity awaits me over on the next infernal island, Charon mate?

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hheeehhhhhhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 能告诉我下一个可怕的岛上有什么恐怖的怪物在等着我吗，卡戎老伙计？

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 嘿嘿——

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, look at you, Charon mate, you're looking well! Something's different about you, can't quite put my finger on it. Have you done something with your hair?

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Urrraaauuhggghh...

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哎呀，这不是我的好伙计卡戎吗，你看起来很不错！你好像有哪里不太一样了，但我又看不出来是哪里不一样了。你是换过发型了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 呃呃呃啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊……

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Charon mate, wanted to thank you once again for the fine hourglass you gave to me before! It's been very handy with those Wells of yours.

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hheeehhhhhhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 喂，卡戎老伙计，我想再次感谢你，谢谢你之前给了我这个不错的沙漏！这在你们那些井里发挥了不小的作用呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 嘿嘿——

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey Charon, you're not angry with me after we had it out last time, are you, I mean... I figured since you gave me one of your Loyalty Cards, must mean everything's fine, but... I'm... just making sure.

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Krrr, krraauuuggghhhh...!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，卡戎，我们上次谈过之后，你已经不生我的气了吧？我是说……既然你已经把你的忠诚卡牌给我了，那我们肯定和好了。不过……我……只是想确认一下，没问题吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 呜啊啊，哇啊啊啊啊啊啊啊……！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No hard feelings about that whole battle-to-the-death thing last time, right, Charon? Especially since you absolutely demolished me. I was just messing with you, you know that, right?

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Nrraaauuuggghhh...!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我们上次恶战一场，那件事你别太往心里去了，好吗，卡戎？再说了，你已经把我狠狠地收拾了一顿。我当时只是在跟你开玩笑而已，你明白的吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 呃啊啊啊啊啊啊啊……！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hi Charon! I finally met Hermes, god of swiftness, travel, bringing souls of the departed to your boat. Calls you his professional associate. You and he, you've been working together for a while, haven't you?

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hrrrrrrnnnnghhhhhhhh...

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨卡戎！我终于遇到赫尔墨斯了，迅捷、旅行之神，将死者的灵魂带到你的船上。你真是请到了专业人士的帮忙呢。你跟他，你们合作有一段时间了吧，对吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 赫呃呃呃呃…

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Charon, I always thought Olympians never consorted with chthonic gods such as yourself. But it sounds like Hermes is a close colleague of yours. You wouldn't... happen to know why he's helping me, would you?

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Grrrhhhoooaaaaaahhhh...!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 卡戎，我总以为奥林匹斯众神从来不跟像你这种冥界的神打交道呢。不过，赫尔墨斯跟你好像是关系很好的同事一样。你该不会…碰巧知道他为什么要帮助我吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 噢噢噢啊啊啊…！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Charon, Hermes told me that the other Olympians are unaware he's lending his support to me. I'm curious to know what's going on. Thinking of asking Nyx. Figured I'd check with you first.

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Mmnnnrraaauuugggghhh!!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 卡戎，赫尔墨斯说他是瞒着奥林匹斯众神在帮助我。我有点好奇到底是怎么一回事。我想问问倪克斯了。不过我得先问问你。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 呃呃呃啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Charon mate, I know you meet an awful lot of dead, and it probably gets very difficult to remember them all, but... I don't suppose the name Skelly means anything to you, does it?

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: ...Ssss... kkkhhh... rrrrnngghhh... raauuuggghhh!!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 卡戎，我的好伙计，我知道你见过太多太多死人了，估计你很难记住他们所有人的名字，不过……不知道你有没有听说过“骨头”这个名字？有吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: ……呼呼……呃呃呃……哇啊啊啊啊啊……喝啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Charon mate? As a longtime customer, I just wanted to take a moment to thank you again for your invaluable service as a part of my repeated attempts at getting out of here. What would I have done without your wares all these many times? Besides dying a lot faster.

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hrrnngghh, grhhh, grhaaaaaaaahhhh...

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 卡戎，我的好伙计？我一次又一次地想要逃出这个地方，作为你的忠实客户，我只想稍微花点时间感谢你出色的服务。在这么多次冒险之中，要是没了你的宝物，我会落得什么下场呢？恐怕只会死得更快吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 呃呃呃呃呃，呜呃呃呃，哈啊啊啊啊啊啊……

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Charon, mate? Wanted to thank you very, very much for bringing Mother and me home. Your boat's quite comfortable, you know! Though, I suppose you won't be making a habit of giving me a ride, will you?

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hrrrhhhaaaaauuugghhh...!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 卡戎老伙计？真的非常非常感谢你把我和母亲带回家。说真的，你的船坐起来真舒服！不过我猜，你不会允许我养成搭便车的习惯，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 噢噢噢啊啊啊…！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Charon, as I know you serve the realm, I just wanted to say I look forward to continuing to work with you in a somewhat more official capacity. I'll still be breaking out of here like always, but... well, you've probably heard.

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Nnnrrraaaauggghhhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 卡戎，据我所知，您效忠于这个王国。我只是想说，我期待能以某种更加正式的身份继续与你合作。我还是会像以前一样逃出这个地方，不过……嗯，你可能已经听说过了。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 呃呃呃啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hope you enjoyed the feast with the Olympians, Charon! We didn't have much of a chance to chat, though it looked like you and Hermes were having a good time.

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Krrhh, hrraaaahhh...!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 希望你还喜欢和奥林匹斯众神的盛宴，卡戎！咱们聊的机会不太多，不过看起来，你当时和赫尔墨斯好像聊得很开心。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 呜啊啊，哇啊啊啊啊啊啊啊……！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Charon? Unrelated to anything whatsoever, I just wanted to say... I'm very grateful to have your support. You've always done your own thing... I never get to see you at the House. But I know you care! An awful lot. So, cheers.

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: ...Khhrraaa hhaaaaahhhh...

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是卡戎吗？我没什么事情，我只是想说……我很感激你能支持我。你总是在忙你自己的事情……我从来没在圣殿里见过你。但我知道你关心我！你非常在乎我。所以，谢谢你。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: ……呜啊啊啊……哈啊啊啊啊啊啊……

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Haaahhhhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 哈啊啊啊啊啊啊……

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Mmmrrrrnnn....

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯……

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hrrnmmmm....

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 嗯呃呃呃…

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Khhhrrrrr....

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 呃啊啊啊啊……

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Heeehhhhhhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 嘿嘿——

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hhrrrrnneehhhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 哼呃呃呃…

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Urrrrrrgggghhh...

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 呃呃啊啊…

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hrrrnnnhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 哼哼——

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Nnnnrrrrrhhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 呐啊啊…

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hnnnggghhhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 喝啊啊啊啊啊啊啊……

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hrreehhh hohhhhhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 哼呃呃 嚯嚯……

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Khhrraaa hhaaaaahhhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: ……呜啊啊啊……哈啊啊啊啊啊啊……

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Nrrrrggghhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 嗯呃……

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hrrnnaaauugghhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 呵嗷……

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Grrruuuooaahhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 嗝嗷……

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Mmmrrnnngghh....

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 唔嗯……

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Rrraaauuuggghhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 啊嗷……

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hhrrrnn, haahhhhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 呵，哈啊啊啊啊啊啊……

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Urrrnngggghhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 呃嗯……

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Khhrrrnnnnnnggghh....

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 咯嗯……

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Gggrrrnnngggghhhh....

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Heeehhh, hohhhhh....

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 嗝嗯……

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Charon, you've been such a reassuring sight, I thought I'd offer you a token of my gratitude.

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hrrrhhrooooh, hnnnn....

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, you don't have to give me something in return, it was a gift! Though, you're insisting, aren't you.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 卡戎，你真是个可靠的人啊，我想我应该表达一下谢意了。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 呼呃呃啊啊啊啊啊啊啊，嗯嗯嗯……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等下，你不用送我东西回礼的，这是给你的礼物！既然你坚持要给我的话。

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hohhhh....

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Glad you like it, mate. Thank you for helping me out with your supply. Even if you fleece me with those prices!

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 嚯嚯…

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你喜欢就好，伙计。谢谢你和你的好货，帮了我大忙。就算你的价格是那样离谱。

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hrrrnnnn...?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You enjoy that, mate! And, when it comes time to reconsider your price structure, hope you think of me!

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 哼嗯嗯…？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你喜欢就好，伙计！还有，如果你考虑重新定价的时候，希望你可以想到我！

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hrrrn, hhmmm hmmmm....

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Enjoy it, Charon mate! Don't go thinking I'm just being kind to get you to lower your prices for me, that would be unconscionable!

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 哼，嗯嗯 嗯嗯嗯…

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 尽情享受吧，卡戎老伙计！不过，别以为我是为了让你降价才对你这么好，我可不会干这种没良心的事！

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hrrooooohhh....

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know, I thought you'd say that, Charon mate, but I insist you take it and enjoy, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 噢噢哦……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我就料到你会这样说，卡戎老伙计，但是还请你务必收下这件东西，好吗？

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hhhrrrrhh... hhhrrrnnnn... hrrrrrhhh...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm pleased to have you as a friend as well, Charon. The pleasure's mine.

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 喝啊啊啊啊啊……呼啊啊啊啊啊……哈啊啊啊啊啊……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 能跟你做朋友我也很开心，卡戎。我很高兴。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Charon, I realize you have a very busy schedule and certainly needn't keep going out of your way for me like this, so here. Just a small token of my appreciation for you. If you ever want to talk, know that I'm here.

en.speaker: Charon
en.text: Hrrrnnnnnnnnn...! Thhhrrrrrrrrnnnnnn... kkrrrrrrrrhhh...!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 卡戎，我知道你一直都很忙，也知道你本不需要像这样为了我的事情分心。所以，请收下这个吧，是我送给你的一点点心意。如果你想找人聊聊的话，我随时愿意奉陪。

zh-CN.speaker: 卡戎
zh-CN.text: 嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯……！呃嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯……呃啊啊啊啊啊……！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, hello, Zagreus. I understand you liberated me from my eternal punishment. And so I have returned to serve your father here. Thanks.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Orpheus, you're back! Look, don't get on Father's bad side like that and you're going to be fine. Besides... right now I think he's angrier with me.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I grieve for you, my friend. But if you've come to ask me for a song, why, I'm afraid I must stand firm about my answer.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，你好，扎格列欧斯。你知道是你把我从永世的惩罚当中解救出来。所以我回来为你的父亲服务。谢谢你。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯，你回来了！听着，只要别惹父亲发火，你就不会有事的。而且……现在更让他生气的人是我。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 真是替你难过，我的朋友。但是就算是你来要求我歌唱一首，我的答案还是不会变的。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, hello, Zagreus. I understand you liberated me from my eternal punishment. And so I have returned to serve your father here. Thanks.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Orpheus, you're back! Look, don't get on Father's bad side like that, and you're going to be fine. I've fought with him enough for all our sakes.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I grieve for you, my friend. But if you've come to ask me for a song, why, I'm afraid I must stand firm about my answer.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，你好，扎格列欧斯。你知道是你把我从永世的惩罚当中解救出来。所以我回来为你的父亲服务。谢谢你。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯，你回来了！听着，只要别惹父亲发火，你就不会有事的。为了我们的利益，我已经和他做过不少斗争了。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 真是替你难过，我的朋友。但是就算是你来要求我歌唱一首，我的答案还是不会变的。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, hello Zagreus. I was just wondering if you had ever heard of any other court musicians who had lost the will to sing? Your father's asked me to explain myself and honestly it has been rather difficult.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: If it's any consolation, mate, I'm certain every single undead court musician serving in the throne room of the god of the dead has been through everything you're going through.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 噢你好啊，扎格列欧斯。我想问问你，你有没有见过哪个宫廷乐师一点也不想奏乐歌唱的？你父亲让我解释一下情况，但是真的很难开口。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果能安慰你的话，伙计，我敢肯定，每一个侍奉死亡之神的活着的宫廷乐师都会经历你现在的处境。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: It's awfully quiet here, you know, when you're out and about? Makes me a bit self-conscious, truth be told, seeing as ostensibly I'm the musician of this court.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Look, if you decide to start strumming on that lyre again, I'm sure nobody here is going to mind. Though you take care, OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 这里太安静了，你知道吗，就在你离开的时候。这让我有点难为情，说实话，我这样的乐师只能是个摆设。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 听我说，如果你打算再次奏响里拉琴的话，我敢肯定这里没人会介意的。不过你要多保重，好吗？

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, hello Zagreus. You look a little down. And so I was just wondering, would you perchance fancy a song right now?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Orpheus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: How about The Lament? You used to play that one a lot!

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, fancy that one do you? Alas, I've not the heart to sing it anymore. I'm glad you like it, though.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: How about In the Blood? That's one of your old hits, right?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: How about Argonauts, didn't you sail with them?

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，你好，扎格列欧斯。你看上去有点沮丧啊，我在想，你现在想不想听我唱首歌？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: Orpheus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不如就《哀婉之歌》吧？你以前总喜欢唱这首！

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，你喜欢那首，是吗？可惜我已经无心再唱那首了，不过你喜欢，我还是很开心。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不如就唱《鲜血之中》吧，这可是你以前最热门的曲子，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不如就《阿尔戈船英雄》吧？你不是和他们一起出海了吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Orpheus, forgive my bluntness here, but I have to ask. Why won't you sing? You were a legend, mate! Our court musician!

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Why, it's that I have lost my muse, my friend. It isn't harder to explain than that. Have you not had such moments in your life, where you had lost the will to chase your passions?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I, I suppose I have, yeah. But recently I found my drive again, and that's why I have to get out of here.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: And I am truly happy for you, friend. Alas, I've had no luck in my own search, not that I'm searching any longer, so, I'll just be over here, OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯，可能我有点太直白了，但我要问问你。你为什么不想唱歌？你可是个传奇人物啊，伙计！你是我们的宫廷乐师！

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 为什么呢，因为我失去了自己的缪斯女神，我的朋友。这很难说清楚。你有没有经历过一些事情，然后失去了逐梦的热情？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我，我应该有吧。但是最近我又找回来了，这就是为什么我要离开这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我真心为你感到高兴，朋友。唉，但是我就没你这么好运了，所以我也不会再去寻找了，我就在这里，好吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Anything I can do to help you find your muse, mate?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I fear my muse is long since lost to me, my friend, though truly thanks for asking. I suppose she must be out there somewhere still, since I once traveled 'cross this land in search of her, and found her then. But that was quite a while back.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, you found her? What happened?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Well, this was back when I was still alive, you understand. Your father, why, he doesn't care for anyone to leave this realm, and, basically now I'm stuck here as well! Not seen her since, and, I'm not much for travel anymore.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That's... I'm sorry to hear that. Thank you for letting me know. I hope you get to see her again someday.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I appreciate the sentiment, my friend, though please don't worry about her or me. I mean, we're dead! We're fine.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 有什么我能帮忙的吗，帮你找到自己的缪斯？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 恐怕我的缪斯早就离我而去了，我的朋友，但还是谢谢你的好意。我想她应该还在这个地方，因为有一次我去寻找她的时候，我找到了。但那是很久以前了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等等，你找到她了？然后呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，这是我还活着的时候的事了，你明白吗。你父亲，他不准任何人离开这个地方，所以我也困在这里了！从此我再也没见过她，我也就不怎么旅行了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那可真是……听到这些，我很难过。谢谢你能向我倾诉这些。希望你能早日与她再相见。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 感谢你的好意，我的朋友，但是请不要为我或者她担心。我是说，我们都是死人了！不会有事的。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Mate, if you don't mind, I'd love it if you told me more about your muse.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: My muse... never has somebody been as splendorous as my Eurydice...! She was so gentle, yet so stout of heart that it would make yours ache, just thinking on it. She inspired innumerable songs of mine.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That's quite a few. She sounds like she was a real catch all right. I'm sorry for your loss. Thank you for sharing your memory of her with me.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Thank you for listening, my friend. Eurydice, she likewise used to listen to me all the time....

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 朋友，如果你不介意的话，我想听你说说更多你的缪斯的事。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我的缪斯女神……我从来没见过像我的欧律狄刻那样了不起的人……！想想看吧，她是如此温柔，却又如此坚强，甚至会让你的心感到疼痛。是她启发了我，让我创作出了无数歌曲。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那还蛮多的。听上去她确实是一个不错的人。很抱歉你失去了她。感谢你告诉我你与她的事。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 感谢你的倾听，我的朋友。欧律狄克，她总是在听我歌唱…

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Mate, if you don't mind, I'd love it if you told me more about your muse.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: My muse... never has somebody been as splendorous as my Eurydice...! She was so gentle, yet so stout of heart that it would make yours ache, just thinking on it. She inspired innumerable songs of mine.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Eurydice...? I know a... anyway, she must have been a real catch! I'm sorry for your loss. I have to go look into something here.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Thank you for listening, my friend. Eurydice, she likewise used to listen to me all the time....

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 朋友，如果你不介意的话，我想听你说说更多你的缪斯的事。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我的缪斯女神……我从来没见过像我的欧律狄刻那样了不起的人……！想想看吧，她是如此温柔，却又如此坚强，甚至会让你的心感到疼痛。是她启发了我，让我创作出了无数歌曲。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 欧律狄克……？我知道……无论如何，她肯定是一个不错的人！很抱歉你失去了她。我必须好好调查一番。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 感谢你的倾听，我的朋友。欧律狄克，她总是在听我歌唱…

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I understand you've journeyed well beyond the pits of Tartarus, my friend? Another most heroic feat of yours, and truth be told I find it quite inspiring.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Inspiring enough to... make you want to sing, again?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, that's a rather bold insinuation, Zagreus. I don't know that I've the will for that, I... just, I need some time to think, is that all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我听说你已经通过了塔耳塔罗斯的深渊，我的朋友。又是一项英雄般的壮举，老实说这给了我一点灵感。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这点灵感足够……让你再展歌喉吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，这真的有点难说，扎格列欧斯。我不知道自己到底想不想，我…我需要时间来考虑一下，好吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It sounds like Father's very cross with you, Orpheus. Won't you consider singing once again? You know his threat of further punishment is not a bluff.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Your father can be.... most persuasive, yes, my friend. However, this time, I am... putting my foot down! I have no plans to sing for him again.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well then how about for me? Or for your other friends among the court?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I... no. Please. My muse is gone to me. I can do no such thing.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好像父亲对你很不满，俄耳甫斯。没想过再展歌喉吗？你知道他威胁要让你吃更大的苦头可不是说说而已。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 你父亲总有办法……让人俯首帖耳，我的朋友。但这一次，我决定……不再妥协！我不打算再为他歌唱。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那如果是为了我呢？或者为了你在宫廷里的其他朋友呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我……不要这样，拜托。我的缪斯已经离我远去。我再也做不到了。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: You seem quite agitated, as of late, my friend. Is anything amiss with you, perhaps?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh! No, I'm all right, Orpheus. Just a lot on my mind is all, sorting out what's next. Stuff I need to work through on my own.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Ah, well, I truly understand. I was reluctant to discuss my long-lost muse, really for quite some time. Well, if you do require some emotional support, know that I likely shall be standing over here...

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 你最近看起来有点躁动不安，我的朋友，有什么事情让你觉得烦恼吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦！没有，我很好，俄耳甫斯。只是我最近想了很多事情，我得考虑接下来该怎么做，我有些私事得想办法解决。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，是啊，我完全能明白。我之前也不打算谈论我失去的缪斯女神，那种状态保持了好长一段时间。这么说吧，如果你需要情感方面的支持，我随时愿意听你开口……

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, Orpheus? I heard from Hermes, messenger and god of travel, and all that? It's odd I'm giving you his message in this case, but he says hey! Admires your musical ability, as well.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, that was kind of him, my friend! When I first ventured deep into this realm, whilst searching for the soul of my lost muse... after I failed utterly, it was Lord Hermes who whisked her away. It happened so fast. He did an excellent job!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，俄耳甫斯？我从赫尔墨斯，信使之神、旅行之神、还有别的什么神那里听到了消息。由我来给他传话确实很奇怪，不过他让我替他向你致意！他也很欣赏你的音乐才华。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，他可真是个好人，我的朋友！当我第一次踏入冥界，寻找我失落缪斯的灵魂的时候……当我彻底失败之后，是赫尔墨斯大人把她带走了。当时一切发生得太快了，他做得真是太棒了！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I always meant to ask you, Orpheus. Where did you learn to sing like that? Was it really Apollo himself who taught you?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, why, I learned from many different sources, Zagreus. That is before all of my inspiration started coming from a single source. I credit my accomplishments to her, and to Apollo, and the gods. And to considerable time spent practicing!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯，有件事我一直想问你：你是从哪儿学的唱歌？是阿波罗本人教你的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，怎么了，我到处都有学，扎格列欧斯。那是在我所有的灵感都来源于同一事物之前。感谢她，感谢阿波罗和众神，我才有这样的成就。当然还有无时无刻的练习！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Orpheus? I know Father appreciates your songs, to the extent he's capable of appreciating anything. Though, has Nyx ever responded to them? She's always right nearby yet you two don't seem to talk...

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Almighty Nyx appears to tolerate my presence, Zagreus. For she could cast me into everlasting darkness if my song failed to be pleasing to her. She is a most-discerning listener!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯？我知道父亲很喜欢你的歌声，喜欢到了无以复加的程度。不过，倪克斯给过你什么评价吗？她就在你身边，可你们两个似乎都没怎么说过话……

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 全能的倪克斯女神似乎已经允许了我的存在，扎格列欧斯。因为如果她对我的歌声不满意的话，我恐怕就要被她丢进无尽的黑暗之中了。她可是个相当能慧眼识珠的听众！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Are you the one whom I should thank for this most wondrous music stand, my friend? Why, it is positively splendid, isn't it?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Our renowned court musician ought to have the finest means available, I think. I'm pleased you like it, Orpheus. Though, tell me something, how can it play your music when you're not even here?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Who can explain the secret art of Daedalus, my friend? Know only that, whenever it produces music for your listening enjoyment, that the sound you hear is coming from my soul!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 这个乐谱架太棒了，你就是我要感谢的那个人吗，我的朋友？因为这真的太棒了，对不对？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我们著名的宫廷乐师配得上这最好。你能喜欢就好，俄耳甫斯。不过，告诉我，为什么你不在的时候，也能听到你的音乐？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 这是狄德勒斯本人才知道的秘密，我的朋友。这么说吧，当它奏出美妙音乐的时候，你们听见的声音都来自于我的灵魂！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: So, I am quite confused, I must admit, my friend. The Queen Persephone, she is your mother, then? How is it that she came to reside, here?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, erm... it all started when my father saw her on Olympus, and... they fell madly in love. He swept her off her feet, and brought her here. The Olympians, they got pretty worried when they saw she was gone. But now it's OK! Everything's out in the open.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: But, surely the Queen's mother on Olympus, the great goddess Demeter... surely she would quite like it if she saw her daughter still, from time to time?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, that! Thing is, Mother ate some... pomegranate seeds when she was here. And we have rules about that stuff, you know! It means she cannot leave this place for very long at all. I'm sure Demeter will understand. And unfreeze everything when her daughter's around.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Ah, yes, pomegranate seeds, of course, of course! Though, there is one more subject I don't understand, which is... how you fit into all of this. Were you not trying to escape from here?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Forget about me, Orpheus! This isn't about me, it's about Mother. What's important is she's here, where she belongs.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I see! I understand. Well, thank you, then, for clearing all that up. It is a splendid tale, I must say, and every part of it makes sense to me, at last.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 不得不承认，朋友，我还是一头雾水。珀尔塞福涅皇后是你的母亲，是吗？那她怎么会住在这里呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，呃……一切的起因，都是我父亲当年在奥林匹斯山上见到了她……他们坠入了爱河。她无法抗拒他的魅力，跟着他来到了冥界。奥林匹斯众神发现她走了之后非常担心，但现在一切都没问题了！

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 不过，奥林匹斯山上还有冥后的母亲，伟大的得墨忒尔女神……如果能时不时地见到自己的女儿的话，她一定会很开心吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，这个啊！问题是，母亲在这里的时候……吃了一些石榴籽，咱们都知道这意味着什么，是吧！这意味着她根本无法长时间离开冥界。 我相信得墨忒尔会理解这一点的。等她女儿在她身边的时候，她就会让地上世界解冻。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，是啊，石榴籽。确实如此，确实如此！不过我还有一件事情不太理解……你怎么也留在这里了呢？你之前不是打算逃出这个地方吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不用在乎我的事情了，俄耳甫斯！重点不是我，而是我的母亲。她在这里，她属于冥界，这才是最重要的。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我明白了！我懂了，谢谢你把所有事情都说清楚。不得不说，这真是个了不起的传说故事，至少每个环节在我听来都合情合理。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I've decided I should give this singing thing another shot for now, my friend. I hope you like it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: This is amazing, mate. So does this mean you found your muse?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh no, I never found my muse, my friend. It's just... seeing you carrying on like this time after time, I was reminded I ought to get on with my life, too, such as it is right now.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我决定要试着再来一次，我的朋友。希望你能喜欢。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 太棒了，伙计。这是不是说明你找到了自己的缪斯？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 当然不，我从来没有找到过，我的朋友。只是…看到你这样一次又一次的坚持，我想我也应该活出点样子了，就像现在这样。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I've decided I should give this singing thing another shot for now, my friend. I hope you like it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: This is amazing, mate. You sing quite beautifully, with or without your muse.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: How kind of you. It's just... seeing you carry on like this, time after time, I was reminded that I might as well get on with my existence, too. Such as it is right now.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我决定要试着再来一次，我的朋友。希望你能喜欢。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 太棒了，伙计。不管有没有缪斯，你的歌声都是如此动听。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 太抬举我了。只是……看到你这样一次又一次的坚持，我想我也应该活出点样子了，就像现在这样。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I've decided I should give this singing thing another shot for now, my friend. I hope you like it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's beautiful, mate. If only Eurydice could hear you right now.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: How kind of you, my friend. It's just... seeing you carry on like this, time after time, I was reminded I ought to get on with my existence, too. Such as it is right now.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我决定要试着再来一次，我的朋友。希望你能喜欢。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 真是太美妙了，朋友。如果欧律狄克能听到你的歌声就好了。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 太抬举我了。只是…看到你这样一次又一次的坚持，我想我也应该活出点样子了。就像现在这样。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I became so enthralled with song once more, my friend, that I have been inspired to compose another one. For old time's sake, perhaps.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: This is amazing, mate. You sing quite beautifully, with or without your muse.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: How kind of you, although... my voice is nothing but the crunch of gravel underfoot compared to hers, which soars as though on wings.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我的朋友，我再次被歌声吸引，于是我创作了一首新的歌曲。或许是为了纪念过去的岁月吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 太棒了，伙计。不管有没有缪斯，你的歌声都是如此动听。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 你真是太抬举我了……与她的歌声相比，我的歌声不过是喑哑之语罢了。她的歌声仿佛长着翅膀，直入云霄。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Say, Orpheus? I ever tell you I once single-handedly slew a multi-headed bone hydra within the magma fields of Asphodel without so much as breaking a sweat?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: My, that is wonderful to hear, my friend! Another in a litany of such heroic deeds, more noble than the heroes of our verse, and even great Achilles over there!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm glad you think so, mate! These tales of my valorous accomplishments do seem to cheer you up, so, I will keep reporting back once I rack up some more.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 喂，俄耳甫斯，我有没有告诉过你，有一次我在水仙花平原的岩浆原野中只身一人杀死了一只骸骨九头蛇，气都不带喘的。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 天啊，这可真是太厉害了，我的朋友！又是一项英雄壮举，比史诗中的英雄更加高尚，就连那边的阿喀琉斯都被比下去了！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你能这样想，我很高兴，我的朋友！我的这些英勇事迹看样子能让你开心起来，这样的话，我以后有什么新进展就回来给你说说。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey Orpheus? You know about the time I vanquished seven legions of Bloodless warriors with both hands tied behind my back while hopping on one foot? Lord Poseidon dared me to do it, you know.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Why, that is a spectacularly vivid tale, Zagreus, and most deserving to be chronicled in song! Would that there were a poet here still willing to commit such deeds to verse.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨俄耳甫斯？你知不知道，有一回我双手反绑，单脚跳着击败了七个军团的无血僵尸战士？波塞冬大人让我这样做的，你知道吗。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 如此生动的故事，扎格列欧斯，值得用我的歌去记录！这里还有一位诗人愿意把这样的事情写入诗歌。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Orpheus? I take it you know all about the time I burned my father's hands to a crisp the moment I was born? He grasped me by the feet, and they caught fire! And that's why he still wears those fancy rings: to cover up the hideous scar tissue.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: But that is such a splendid tale, Zagreus, deserving to be sung both far and wide, until it turns into the stuff of myth, as deathless as the gods themselves! I'll gladly tell that one about!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿俄耳甫斯？你知不知道我出生的时候把我父亲的手都烧糊了？他抓住了我的脚，然后我的脚也着火了！这就是为什么他现在还戴着那些漂亮的戒指环，是为了遮住伤疤呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，这个故事真的棒极了，值得广为传唱，直到它变成神话传说，像众神那样永远流传下去！我很高兴能告诉你这些故事！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey Orpheus, you've noticed the resemblance between me and Dionysus, haven't you, mate? I'll tell you a little secret but you have to promise not to tell... We're really the same god. I love a good feast, don't I?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: But, Zagreus, that is a striking revelation, the connection you describe. I see it! I can see it now! To think the god of wine and you are intricately linked, it isn't obvious, is it?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, there's more to it! A bit grim, really, as I'm a little older than I look. You see, the Titans, they once tore me limb from limb, but then my heart was saved, and that's where Dionysus comes from! That is the connection between us, you understand me, mate?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Your tale stirs my soul, it truly does, my friend. It is a marvel to me that such heroism isn't widely known, and I'm committed to the spread of all such truths.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯，你应该已经注意到我和迪奥尼索司的相似之处了吧？我会告诉你一个小秘密，但是你要保证不要告诉别人…其实我们是同一个神。谁不喜欢丰盛宴席呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 但是，扎格列欧斯，这可是个惊人的发现，你所说的联系。我看到！我全看到了！光是你和酒神的错综复杂的联系，这还不够很明显吗。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，还有呢！有点糟糕，其实，我比看起来要老很多。你看，泰坦，他们曾经把我大卸八块，不过我的心脏被救了下来，那就是迪奥尼索司的来历！这就是我们之间的联系，你懂了吗，朋友？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 你的故事震撼了我的心灵，真的，我的朋友。这样的英雄故事没有广为流传，对我来说是个好机会，我保证会让这些事实为众人所知。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey Orpheus, you know I've just been messing with you, with those Dionysus tales, and all that? Just trying to liven things up for us, mate.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, Zagreus! There isn't need for such humility, not when one's deeds of heroism are as great and numerous as yours! It is an honor to have heard such deeds first-hand!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿俄耳甫斯，其实我一直在逗你玩呢，迪奥尼索司那些事情。我只是为了让咱们开心开心。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，扎格列欧斯！不用这样谦虚，特别是你拥有如此伟大的英雄壮举的时候！能够听你亲口告诉我这些事情是我的荣幸！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know, mate, sometimes I worry that you're taking my tall tales rather seriously. You're not really going about and telling everyone this stuff, are you?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Come now, my friend! I know this is a test of faith! Of course I am committed to the spread of such heroic deeds as yours. And I do so enjoy getting to hear them first!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道吗，朋友，我真的担心你把我说的故事全都当真了。你不会到处跟人说这些事吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 别这样，我的朋哟！你肯定是在测试我！我当然要让你的英雄事迹流传出去。我真的很高兴可以获得第一手资料！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Orpheus? I figure that you've heard by now about how I bested the Minotaur Asterius, alongside Theseus, the Champion of Elysium, himself? I don't think I even broke a sweat.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I scarce can possibly imagine such a spectacle, my friend! But certainly I shall attempt to try!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，俄耳甫斯？你应该听说了我同时打败了弥诺陶阿斯忒里俄斯和极乐世界的最强战士忒修斯了吧？我觉得我应该是出了汗的。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 真是我无法想象的场面啊，我的朋友！不过我打算试试！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Orpheus, you have to hear this straight from me. I vanquished my own father, on the outskirts of the Temple of Styx. At the surface! I know how this looks, since I'm back here, and so is he. You believe me, don't you?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Of course I do, my friend! Though, you must know, your father has requested his relationship to you be kept quite clandestine. You'll understand if I not sing your praises in this case, won't you?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯，你得好好听我说。我在冥河神庙的外围，击败了我的父亲。在凡界！我知道这是什么样，因为我回来了，他也回来了。你相信我说的话，对吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我当然相信你，我的朋友！不过,你要知道，你父亲要求你和他之间的事情要保密。如果我不再唱你的赞歌你就会明白了对吧？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Orpheus, sorry to interrupt, it's just... I couldn't help but notice that new ballad that you're playing, there.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Technically, one ought consider it a hymn, my friend! In honor of your numerous travails, prior to your current set of circumstances, which must pale in comparison to all the rigors you've endured to date!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, the thing is... none of the information in your hymn is accurate. It's nonsense. I was just kidding with you, mate! I tried to make that clear. You get so lively when I tell you my tall tales, you know? You're not angry with me, are you...?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Heavens, no, my friend! Your humility is matched only by your perseverance in the face of adversity! May your great deeds live on forever, much like you!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯，抱歉打断一下，就是……我注意到你正在演奏的那首新曲子。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 准确来说，这个叫赞歌，我的朋友！这是为了纪念你无数次的艰苦前行，是发生在之前的故事，与你迄今为止经历过的艰难险阻相比，都不算什么！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，问题是…你这些赞歌里的内容，没有一个是对的。都是胡说。那些都是我跟你开玩笑的，朋友！我告诉过你了。因为我跟你讲起那些夸张故事的时候，你就显得很活跃。你不会生我的气了吧…？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 天啊，不会吧，我的朋友！也就只有你在逆境中的坚持不懈才配得上你此刻的谦逊卑微！愿你的事迹像你一样永存于世！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Say, Orpheus. You wouldn't happen to know the nymph Eurydice, would you? Tall, woodsy type? I get the impression maybe you know each other.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: What? Why... yes. I know Eurydice. Or, I once knew her, I should say. Whyever would you ask me such a thing, my friend?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I saw her, mate. In Asphodel. She's doing fine up there! All on her own. The two of you, you used to know each other, then?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: We more than knew each other, Zagreus. We were husband and wife. She was my muse. To think that we are doomed to be apart during our afterlives. Ah, well!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Ah, well? Don't you have a message I could bring to her, if we should meet again? Something like that?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I do not wish to trouble her again, my friend. Speak not to her of me, all right? I have my memory of her; it is enough.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯。你不会碰巧认识一个叫欧律狄克的仙女吧？高高的，像树一样？从我的经历来看，你们两个可能互相认识。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 什么？为什么…是的。我认识欧律狄克。或者说，我曾经认识她。你为何要这样问，我的朋友？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我见到她了，伙计。在水仙花平原。她过得还不错！只身一人。你们两个应该都认识彼此吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 不仅仅是认识，扎格列欧斯。我们可是夫妻呢。她就是我的缪斯女神。一想到来生我们注定要分离。啊，好吧！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧？如果我再遇到她，你就没有什么话想跟她说的吗？没什么想说的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我不想再打扰她了，我的朋友。你也不要再跟她提到我了好吗？我记得她，这就足够了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Say, Orpheus. You're not going to believe this. I happened on a certain nymph during my journeys recently. It was Eurydice. Tall, woodsy type?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: What? Why... truly. I knew Eurydice resided in your father's realm, but... I had not anticipated you would cross her path. You're certain of this, then?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I saw her, mate. In Asphodel. She's doing fine up there! All on her own. You said the two of you were very close, isn't that right?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: We were much more than that, Zagreus. We were husband and wife. She was my muse. To think that we are doomed to be apart during our afterlives. Ah, well!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Ah, well? Don't you have a message I could bring to her, if we should meet again? Something like that?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I do not wish to trouble her again, my friend. Speak not to her of me, all right? I have my memory of her; it is enough.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯。你不会相信的。我最近外出的时候，遇到了一位仙女。它叫欧律狄克。高高的，像树一样？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 什么？什么…真的。我早就知道欧律狄克住在你父亲的地盘里，但是…我没料到你会遇见她。你真的确定吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我见到她了，伙计。在水仙花平原。她过得还不错！只身一人。你说过你们两个人很亲近，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我们可不只是认识，扎格列欧斯。我们可是夫妻呢。她就是我的缪斯女神。一想到来生我们注定要分离。啊，好吧！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧？如果我再遇到她，你就没有什么话想跟她说的吗？没什么想说的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我不想再打扰她了，我的朋友。你也不要再跟她提到我了好吗？我记得她，这就足够了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Orpheus, I saw Eurydice again. I... couldn't bring myself to do exactly as you asked, I... sort of mentioned you.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: You what?! Or, what I meant to say was: Oh. Did you perchance get the impression she yet harbors toward me feelings of resentment, and the like?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You seemed to be a bit of a sore subject, yes. What happened to the two of you, if I may ask?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, it's just... I almost saved her soul from this domain, back when I lived and breathed. But in the final moments of my rescue, my faith faltered. She is lost to me forever, now. Though, I'm pleased to hear she isn't lost to you!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯，我又看到欧律狄克了。我…我没能完全按你的要求来，我…提到你了。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 什么？！我的意思是：噢。你觉得她是不是对我还有点怨恨之类的感情？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，说到你的时候，气氛有点冷。你俩之间到底怎么了，我想问问。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，就是……我差点就可以把她的灵魂从这个地方拯救出去，那是我活着时候的事了。但是在最后的那一刻，我动摇了。然后就永远失去她了。不过，很高兴她并没有失去你！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Orpheus, I saw Eurydice again. I... couldn't bring myself to do exactly as you asked, I... sort of mentioned you.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: You what?! Or, what I meant to say was: Oh. Did you perchance get the impression she yet harbors toward me feelings of resentment, and the like?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You seemed to be a bit of a sore subject, yes. You really almost freed her from the Underworld, huh?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Almost, my friend, almost. But in the final moments of my rescue, my faith faltered. She is lost to me forever, now. Though, I'm pleased to hear she isn't lost to you!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯，我又看到欧律狄克了。我…我没能完全按你的要求来，我…提到你了。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 什么？！我的意思是：噢。你觉得她是不是对我还有点怨恨之类的感情？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，说到你的时候，气氛有点冷。你真的差点就把她带离冥界了，对吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 差点，我的朋友，就差一点。但是在最后的那一刻，我动摇了。然后就永远失去她了。不过，很高兴她并没有失去你！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Pray tell me something, Zagreus. How is she lately, hm? Eurydice, I mean. Her hair, fall colors, or full bloom? Her poise, as proud and supple as the oak?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: She's all right, Orpheus. Seems comfortable within her little place in Asphodel. The only thing that seems to bother her at all is... when I mention you. Is there nothing you can do to patch things up?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Alas, I cannot change the past, my friend. So, no. As you can plainly see by now, I'm dead to her. Rightfully so, at that.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: But that's just a technicality! I mean, you're here, she's there! So what if you're not breathing anymore, you have all eternity ahead of you. Don't you want to see her again?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Don't I want to see my Eurydice again...? Why, yes. That, more than anything, my friend. Provided she wanted to see me. I tried once to disturb her everlasting rest, as you well know. And that did not pan out as I had hoped....

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 告诉我吧，扎格列欧斯。她最近怎么样？我是说，欧律狄克。她绽放的秋色秀发。她如橡树那样高傲挺拔。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 她还好啦，俄耳甫斯。看上去她在水仙花平原自己的一小块地方过得挺好的。唯一让她感到烦恼的…就是我提到你的时候。你就不能做点什么来弥补一下吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 唉，我不能改变过去，我的朋友。所以，不能。正如你看到的，对她来说我早就死了。理应如此的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 但是只是理论上是这样！我是说，你在这头，她在那头！既然你是一个死人了，你就有大把大把的时间了。你就不想再见她一面吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我就不想再见到我的欧律狄克吗…？我当然想。我做梦都想，我的朋友。只要她想见我。我有一次打扰了她永久的安息，正如你所知的。结果并不如我想的那样好…

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: What news of late about Eurydice, my friend? She is as delicate as I described, no doubt? Ah, but... I am dwelling on her once again, it seems.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I knew she was a talented musician, mate, but you never let on that she is an amazing chef, as well. She's been hospitable to me each time we've met. Though you still seem to be a bit of a sore subject.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: How very understandable, indeed. Were I to have been failed to be rescued from the depths of hell, mere moments from escape, I too would be quite cross with my attempted rescuer. And for quite some time.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 欧律狄刻最近怎么样了，我的朋友？她还是与我形容的一样美丽动人吧？啊，我又在想着她了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道她曾是一个才华横溢的乐师，伙计，但是你从没提过她惊人的料理手艺。每次见面她都对我很热情。不过一提到你气氛就凝重起来。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 这个我可以理解。如果我在最后的一刹那没能从地狱深渊逃离出来，我也会对救助自己的人心生怨恨的。会恨他很长时间。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Orpheus, I don't suppose you know how come I keep running into Eurydice in particular out there? For all the shades resting eternally in Asphodel, it seems beyond coincidence I always find the one that's dear to you.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I have no knowledge of the weavings of the Fates, my friend. Perhaps they trample on what used to be my heart for leisure or for sport, do you suppose?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯，你大概不知道为什么我总在外面碰到欧律狄克吧？水仙花平原里那么多的暗灵，我总能找到你爱的那一个，这可不是什么巧合。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我对命运这种事情一窍不通，我的朋友。也许蹂躏我的心就是命运之神玩弄我的手段吧，你觉得呢？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Say, Orpheus, Eurydice told me your songs, some of them came from her? She seems quite brilliant. You choose your muses well!

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I owe my everything to my Eurydice. She authored many of my songs, indeed; and she inspired many, many more. Whilst living, we collaborated frequently, you see.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: But weren't you the famous one? I don't understand why she doesn't share your renown.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: It is but one of life's injustices, I fear. I always sang her praises every chance I had. And she asserted herself splendidly. Yet even still, our listeners believed our songs, they came from me... what else could I have done?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I don't exactly know the ways of mortals, mate. But I'm pleased to hear you always giving credit where it's due.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯，欧律狄克跟我讲过你的歌，有些歌是来自于她的？她似乎真的很厉害。你的缪斯女神真不赖！

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我欠欧律狄克太多太多了。她为我写了很多歌，没错。而且她也是我很多歌的灵感来源。还活着的时候，我们就经常合作。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 但是你不是出名的那个吗？我搞不懂为什么她好像并没有沾到你的光。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 恐怕这就是生活的不公吧。我总是一有机会就赞颂她。而她也表现得非常出色。但是，我们的听众却始终相信这些歌，都来自于我…我又能怎样呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我也搞不懂凡人是怎么想的，伙计。但是你把功劳归给应得的人，这就让我感到非常欣慰。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Orpheus, you said that it was one of life's injustices that Eurydice doesn't get her fair share of the credit for the songs she wrote. Isn't there something we can do?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Why, I don't know, my friend. Once people set their minds to certain things... it can be difficult to show them other possibilities exist. What's to be done?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I don't know... tell them they're wrong? Politely, perhaps not? Or... tell them what's right. Get the word out about what's right? Can't we do that?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Get the word out...? But I am court musician of this House. My songs no longer reach too many ears. Although... I do suppose all of these shades about... they are my audience, as well. I shall make certain that they know whose songs I sing.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯，你之前说欧律狄刻创作了那么多歌曲，可她却没得到应有的赞誉，这恐怕太不公平了。你不觉得我们可以做点什么吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 老实说，我也不清楚，朋友。人一旦变得固执己见……他们就很难再看到其它的可能性了。你打算做什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我也说不好……告诉他们是他们错了？用比较客气的语气，不行吗？或者……告诉他们什么是对的，让外面的人明白什么是对的？这一点我们做不到吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 让外面的人明白……？可我已经是这座圣殿的乐师了，我的歌声已经没办法再传到外面众人的耳中了。不过……我猜这些幽灵……也都是我的听众吧。我会让他们明白，我唱的歌都是谁创作出来的。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I must confess something to you, my friend. My mind still wanders to Eurydice quite often, and my memories of her. Despite my best attempts to move along with my existence here. I would call it a fatal flaw, except, I am already dead.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Don't torture yourself, mate. You've been through enough. As has she! You still care for one another just don't have a way to get the point across. But I have an idea.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I, too, once had ideas, Zagreus. Ideas, and inspirations. It was so very wonderful, to have a muse...

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我得像你坦白一些事情，我的朋友。我心里依旧时时想着欧律狄克，还有关于她的回忆。可我已经努力去适应我现在的生活。这真的是我最大的缺陷了，而且我已经是死人了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 别为难自己，伙计。你经历的够多了。她也是啊！你们依旧互相关心，只是心意没法传达给对方。我有个想法。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我曾经也有想法，扎格列欧斯。想法，灵感。拥有自己的缪斯，是非常美好的事…

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I got you something, Orpheus. It's a new song. From someone who still cares for you.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: My friend, you wrote a song, for me...? Oh, but this is not from you, it's from... Eurydice... I, no, I don't know what to say, I... I...

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 给你这个，俄耳甫斯。是一首新歌。从依然关心你的人那里得到的。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我的朋友，你为我，写了这歌…？噢，这不是你写的，这是…欧律狄克……我，我不知道该说点什么好了，我…我…

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You sing beautifully, mate. If only Eurydice could hear you singing this right now.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh. Thanks for the sentiment, my friend, it's just... when I sing this song of hers, why, I've this feeling where my heart once was that, well... perhaps she can.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你唱得真好听，朋友。如果欧律狄克能听到你的歌声就好了。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 噢。感谢你，我的朋友。每当我唱起她的这首歌时，为何，我就感觉自己的心曾经…也许她可以可以。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I've decided I should give this singing thing another shot for now, my friend. I hope you like it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You sing beautifully, mate. If only Eurydice could hear you singing this right now.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh. Thanks for the sentiment, my friend, it's just... when I sing this song of hers, why, I've this feeling where my heart once was that, well... perhaps she can.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我决定要试着再来一次，我的朋友。希望你能喜欢。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你唱得真好听，朋友。如果欧律狄克能听到你的歌声就好了。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 噢。感谢你，我的朋友。每当我唱起她的这首歌时，为何，我就感觉自己的心曾经…也许她可以可以。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Zagreus! The most amazing circumstances have occurred. The terms of my employment, they've been altered such that... I may visit Asphodel sometimes. May visit her.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That's great! Orpheus, what are you waiting for, mate? Go and find your muse out there! You two have lots to catch up on, I think.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I think you're right. I am so very anxious, I must say. But I must also thank you, for this opportunity, and... for speaking with me all this time. So, how might I repay you?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Why is it always talk of payment around here? You're my mate. And your songs have lifted many spirits here, including mine. Now go, and make the most of this, will you?

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯！这真是奇迹呀。我的工作条款，不一样了……我现在能时不时去一趟水仙花平原了。我也许能见到她了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 太好了，俄耳甫斯！你还愣着干什么，伙计？快去找你的缪斯啊！你俩可得好好叙叙旧啊。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 你说的没错。我现在也挺着急的。但是能有这样的机会，我还得谢谢你呀，还有……还要感谢你一直以来陪我聊天。我该怎样回报你呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 怎么老是动不动就回报回报的？咱俩谁跟谁啊，你的曲子可以抚慰我和其他人的心灵。去吧，好好抓住这次机会吧！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey Orpheus, you're back! How was your trip? I hope it was all right.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: It was more than all right, my friend. Why, it was positively inspirational. But I've returned as promised to this House. My love is there, whilst my responsibilities are here.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You sound despondent again, mate. You must wish you were there right now. I'm sorry you had to come all the way back.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, on the contrary, Zagreus. It dawned upon me that having some distance between my responsibilities and my domestic life, why... it is not so bad. Besides, Charon makes travel to and fro quite simple for me, really.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨，俄耳甫斯，你回来了！你的旅行怎么样了？希望还好？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 不只是还好，朋友。那，只能说是充满了灵感。但是我已经如约定回到了这冥殿。我的爱人在那里，而我的责任在这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你似乎又沮丧起来了，朋友。你一定希望自己能留在那里吧。很抱歉你得从那儿一路回到这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 恰恰相反，扎格列欧斯。我终于明白，在工作和家庭生活之间划清界限也不是件坏事。另外，有了卡戎，往返行程也变得快捷很多。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I have to ask you something, Orpheus. It seems like everything has been all right for you, except... you don't look very happy to me, mate. Is everything all right? Between you and Eurydice, I mean?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, haha, but your concern is much appreciated, friend. I feel I am in everlasting bliss. It simply does not show upon my countenance. Perhaps through song is how I best express myself.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我要问你一些事情，俄耳甫斯。现在似乎一切都合你心意了，除了……但我看你好像不怎么开心的样子。没什么事吧？你跟欧律狄刻之间还好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，哈哈，谢谢你的关心，朋友。可能从我脸上看不太出来，我感觉自己幸福极了。也许歌曲才是我最好的表达方式。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Orpheus. You know I'm very happy that things turned out well between you and Eurydice, but... looking back, I think I might have overstepped my bounds with you a bit, and wanted to say I'm sorry.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: You're sorry, Zagreus? Whatever for? If not for you, I fear I never would have seen my muse again.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, it's just... when I met her, and I found out the two of you were having problems, I... well, I just wanted to see you patch things up. But, it wasn't any of my business, and you never asked my help. Neither did she. I could have made things worse.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: But, you didn't make things worse, my friend. And... truth be told, I do not think I ever would have asked for help, at any point, because... I don't entirely know how. So I am grateful to you, and your generous instinct.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，俄耳甫斯。你和欧律狄刻破镜重圆了，我真高兴。不过……仔细想想的话，我觉得我可能太多管闲事了，我对此很抱歉。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 很抱歉，扎格列欧斯？有什么要道歉的呢？要不是因为你，我恐怕再也见不到我的缪斯女神了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧……我见到她，听说你们两个之间出了点问题的时候，我……我就想看看能不能想办法改变一下现状。不过这不是我该管的事情，你从来都没要我帮你这个忙，她也没有，我本可能会把事情搞砸也说不定。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 但你并没有把事情搞砸，我的朋友，而且……老实说，我觉得我恐怕永远都不会开口求你帮这个忙，因为……我自己也不太清楚为什么。总之，我很感谢你这么助人为乐。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Say, Orpheus! I heard what must have been a song of yours, it went something, something, in the blood, you know that one? It was amazing, mate.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, that one, yes, I know! I mean, it was a favorite, I was told, by those who listened to the music I created with my muse. It was a most productive time, back when we were alive!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Would you ever sing it again?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我说，俄耳甫斯！我之前听过的那首歌肯定是你写出来的，歌词是鲜血里的什么什么之类的，你知道那首歌吧？真是太好听了，朋友。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，那首啊，没错！我是说，那以前确实是首很流行的曲子，我的听众们都这么说。那首曲子是我和我的缪斯女神一起创作的，那个时候我们都还活着，也都很高产！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那首歌你愿意再唱一次吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Orpheus. The keepsake that you gave me... it's come in useful, thanks. I can't quite see what's in the container, though. I shouldn't open it, should I?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: No, Zagreus. Unless of course you wanted to set loose a cherished living memory of mine, and take from me that fleeting bit of joy?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，俄耳甫斯。你给我的纪念品……它确实很好用，谢谢你。虽然我看不到里面装的是什么。我不该打开它，对吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 不，扎格列欧斯。除非你非要勾起我珍藏在心里的那段回忆，然后夺走我最后一丝快乐？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Orpheus, the Distant Memory you gave me... it's a bit of your past with Eurydice in there, isn't it. I'm grateful, but... why give me such a precious gift as that?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I'm glad you like it, Zagreus. Some memories are cherished, yes, indeed. But there can come a point where they provide more benefit to others than ourselves. Don't you agree?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯，你给我的遥远记忆……是关于你和欧律狄克的过去，是吗？我很感激，但是……为什么要给我这么珍贵的礼物呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 你喜欢就好，扎格列欧斯。有些回忆需要被珍惜，确实是这样。但有时候，它可以给其他人带来更多好处。你不同意吗？

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Have you considered doing music-making as a recreational pursuit, my friend? You have such slender hands, why, I believe you'd do quite well at it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Not really been at the top of my list of late, mate, but who knows. It's something I've been meaning to try at some point, I suppose. Thanks for the words of encouragement!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我的朋友，你有没有想过，闲暇的时候，搞点音乐创作什么的？我看你双手纤巧，一定能有不错的表现。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我最近好像没有那么高的兴致，不过也说不准。有时候我也会想着试试看。谢谢你的鼓励！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey Orpheus! I got myself a lyre much like yours, except I'm absolutely miserable when I try to play! Got any advice?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, why, that's splendid, Zagreus. And I can certainly show you a thing or two. First, the proper posture is important, here...

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: ...now remember to practice the plucking technique which I taught you, and mind your off-hand constantly. And, above all, continue practicing! The joyfulness is in the practicing itself.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨，俄耳甫斯！我弄到一把里拉琴，跟你的很相似，只是当我试着演奏时根本不是那回事！有什么建议吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，那就太好了，扎格列欧斯。我绝对能教你几手。首先，要摆正姿势，这样……

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: ……别忘了练练我教你的拨弦技巧，要随时注意自己的另一只手。当然最重要的，还是要勤加练习！你可以在练习中体会到快乐。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Zagreus, I heard your recent lyre-playing from your bedchambers. Let no one lead you to believe it's not a reassuring start.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, come now, mate, I'm terrible and you know it. You pulling one over on me as payback?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I'm being serious, my friend. It is a challenging pursuit requiring a dedicated state of mind. The progress shall come. You shall discover what I mean.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，我听到你最近好像一直在房间里演奏竖琴。不要听别人乱说，这绝对是一个好的开始。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，得了吧，朋友。你明明知道我弹得很难听。你这是在故意损我吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我是认真的，朋友。这可是需要集中精力的功夫活，总有一天你会进步的。到时候你就明白我的话了。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Your music-playing has improved substantially. Perhaps in time you shall surpass my own abilities!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I highly doubt that, mate, though thanks for noticing. Creating music's quite rewarding once you get the hang of it!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 你的演奏水平明显提升了啊。也许有朝一日你能超过我，很有可能哦！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我对此表示怀疑，朋友，不过还是感谢你的关注。一但掌握了其中的诀窍，音乐创作还是很有成就感的！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I must commend you on the most splendid lyre-playing emanating from your bedchambers, my friend. It seems we have a second court musician, now.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Thank you for encouraging me to give it a shot, mate. And for the kind words.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 你在卧室里的竖琴演奏真是非常不错啊，我的朋友。看来我们已经有第二位宫廷乐师了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 感谢你的鼓励和美言，兄弟。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: ...You called upon your humble court musician, as I understand, Lord Hades sir? Referring to myself of course?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Well, Orpheus... if you're quite finished with your little stint within the depths of Tartarus, I'd like to ask again: Play us a song, already. Or else next time I'll not be quite so charitable with your punishment.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, that. I must apologize, again, Lord Hades sir. For I'm afraid that I've no wish to sing as yet. In spite of your persuasiveness even. And, that, um, is my final word upon the subject. At this time.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Is that so...? Why, then, I'll go ahead and wait. I've all the patience in the world.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: …是您在召唤卑微的宫廷乐师，对吗，哈迪斯大人？也就是我？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，俄耳甫斯…如果你在塔耳塔罗斯深渊待够了的话，我想再问你一次：为我们奏支音乐好吗？否则下次我就不会这样宽容地惩罚你了。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，这样啊。我得再次表示抱歉，哈迪斯大人。因为现在我实在是无意歌唱。尽管你很有说服力。然后，嗯，这就是我想说的全部了。我说完了。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 是这样吗…？既然这样，那我就只好继续等了。我可以永远等下去。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Help me to understand something here, Orpheus. Why do I bother keeping such a worthless shadow of a court musician in my House? You prattle ceaselessly, yet I can't get even a single note out of you?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: If I may be so bold, my lord? Perhaps the merest sight of me still stirs in you a memory of my performances of yore. It gladdens me you used to like my songs.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I used to tolerate your insolence. We're finished here. You find your voice. Immediately! You have one hundred years, and not a moment more.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你来帮我参谋参谋，俄耳甫斯。我为何要把这么个没用的宫廷乐师留在我的圣殿里？你话倒是不少，但是连一个音符都弹不出来。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 恕我冒昧，大人。也许您看到我，就会想起回忆里我以前的表现。您喜欢过我的歌，这使我倍感欣慰。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 而我也容忍过您的傲慢。没什么可说的了。你找回自己的声音。立刻！我给你一百年时间，没有再多。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Finally returned to your senses, haven't you, Orpheus. A court musician who refused to sing! Such nonsense. I trust there shall be no more insubordination from you, moving forward?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I'm gladdened that my songs yet stir your soul, my lord. But, I have to confess my choice to sing again was motivated largely by the Prince. And by my muse, of course.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Still going on about your so-called muse, I see. You had your chance with Eurydice. You squandered it. And now you're here; a deal is a deal. I expect you to comply with your end of our agreement.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你终于恢复理智了，俄耳甫斯。拒绝唱歌的宫廷乐师算什么宫廷乐师！一派胡言。我相信你从今往后不会再抗旨不遵，对吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 很荣幸我的歌声触动了您的灵魂，大人。但我必须说实话，我之所以愿意再次放声歌唱，主要是因为王子殿下。当然，还有我的缪斯。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 还在提你那可笑的缪斯。你本来有机会和欧律狄克一起。但你却白白浪费了这个机会。但既然你在这里，说话就不能反悔。我希望你遵守我们的协议。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: ...I'm pleased to know my new, more flexible arrangement remains to your satisfaction, still, my lord. I must admit I feared that my departure would result once more in a protracted stay within the pits of Tartarus.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Don't give me such ideas, Orpheus! Instead, you go about your business, there, and play your blasted songs when circumstances call for it.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I shall be happy to oblige, my lord. Eurydice and I are grateful for your magnanimity.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: ……我很高兴得知您对我新的、更有弹性的日程安排没有意见，大人。 我得承认，我之前担心过，我这样贸然离开可能会让我身陷塔耳塔罗斯的深渊之中。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 别说这种话来暗示我，俄耳甫斯！去忙你自己的事情吧，哪里需要，你就去哪里唱你那些破歌吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我很乐意效劳，大人，我和欧律狄刻都很感激您的宽宏大量。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: ...You're much too modest, Lord Achilles, for someone with such a number of heroic deeds and glorious decapitations to his name! You ought to be more like ever-boastful Zagreus, and talk it up some more!

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: Oh, fear not, Orpheus, I was quite boastful in my day. And would you look at where it got me? Besides, I've not the imagination to come up with tales as tall as those of our Prince Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯大人，作为一个有着无数英雄事迹和荣耀的人，您太谦虚了。您应当像扎格列欧斯那样，炫耀炫耀！

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，别吧，俄耳甫斯，以前的我已经够自大的了。你看看最后我的下场。再说啦，我也没有扎格列欧斯那样的想象力能编出那样惊险的故事呢。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: ...Do you miss it, yourself, Lord Achilles, sir? The freshness of the air. The need to have meals several times a day, and such.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I scarce remember it, my friend. Although your songs do stir up memories, sometimes. I'm used to things the way they are, I think. But you, not so much?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, on the contrary, sir, I am profoundly satisfied. We are most fortunate to have employment even after death. Imagine, merely resting for eternity, when you could work!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: ……您会怀念从前的日子吗，阿喀琉斯大人？清新的空气。一日三餐的需求，之类的。

zh-CN.speaker: 阿喀琉斯
zh-CN.text: 我都不太记得了，我的朋友。不过你的歌有时候确实能勾起回忆。我已经习惯现在的生活了。你呢，不习惯吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，当然不会，老师，我非常习惯了。在死后还能有工作，真是太幸运了。想象一下，永恒的安息，同时还能工作！

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: ...Ah, but to think that our esteemed musician of the court is none other than you, Orpheus! In matters of music, at least, Hades and I have similar tastes. Anyway, I don't mean to keep you!

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I shall be honored to perform my songs, Your Grace. And, might I add, Your Grace bears many of the striking features of your son? I understand now where he gets his charm.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: ……啊，想想看，我们尊贵的宫廷乐师正是你，俄耳甫斯本人！至少在音乐方面，我和哈迪斯的品位还是很相似的。总之，我可没打算一直把你扣在这里！

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 能为您演奏是我的荣幸，冥后殿下。另外，不知能否多言一句？您和您儿子有很多俊美的地方长得很像。我现在明白，他这么风度翩翩是像谁了。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I'm sorry I've no will for singing, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 不好意思我现在不想唱歌，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I feel a bit self-conscious seeing as I must refuse to sing...!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 现在有点难为情，所以我拒绝唱歌…！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I remain your humble court musician, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我依然是你卑微的宫廷乐师，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I'm truly pleased to see you, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我很高兴能见到你，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Would that I could aid you in some way, my friend.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 希望我能帮上你的忙，我的朋友。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: It's awfully quiet whilst you're not around. Still rather quiet now!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 你不在的时候这里安静得可怕。现在也挺安静的！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Nice speaking with you, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 很高兴与你谈话，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I'm afraid I haven't much to say on this occasion, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 恐怕现在我也没什么好说的，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I hope your day or night, I guess, is going nicely, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 希望你白天夜晚都过得安稳，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Please do be careful out there, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 在外头千万注意安全，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I wish I could direct you towards a much more lively court musician.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 希望我可以领你去找一个更活泼的宫廷乐师。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Normally I'd offer up a song for such occasions, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 一般这个时候我会歌唱一首，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Be strong out there, my friend, OK?

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 在外面要坚强，我的朋友。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I'm cheering for you all the way, my friend.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我一直在为你加油呢，我的朋友。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Good luck to you out in that deadly hellscape, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 祝你在外面的死亡地狱里好运，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Thank you for checking up on me, my friend, although I'm quite all right.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 谢谢你来看我，我的朋友，我现在非常好。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I'm still fresh out of songs or will to sing them, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我的歌都唱完了，现在也不想唱了，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I'd ask if you remember what it's like to feel inspired, my friend, but I don't want to know.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我想问，你还记得灵感迸发的时候是什么感觉吗，我的朋友？但是我不想知道。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, hello, Zagreus....

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，你好，扎格列欧斯…

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Wishing you a pleasant day or night as ever, my good friend...!

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I'm in the middle of a song my friend...!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 希望你也有个舒适的白天或者夜晚，我的好朋友…！

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我正在唱歌呢，我的朋友…！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: May you emerge from all of this unscathed, my friend.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 希望你能毫发无伤地摆脱这些，我的朋友。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I trust your neverending toil in the Underworld is proceeding well, my friend?

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 你在冥界里永无止尽的行动进展得还顺利吧，我的朋友？

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I have an optimistic feeling about your next attempt to run away, my friend!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 对于你下一次的逃离行动我有一种乐观的预感，我的朋友！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: May you yet find your muse somewhere out there, my friend.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 愿你也在外头找到属于自己的缪斯，我的朋友。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Each failure brings new opportunities for self-reflection, right, my friend?

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 每一次的失败都是审视自己的好机会，对吧，我的朋友？

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Please keep me well apprised of all of your incredible achievements, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 请务必第一时间让我了解你那些惊人的成就，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: It lifts my spirits when we briefly interact, my friend.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 跟你交流的时候我也会变得精神起来，我的朋友。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I pray the Fates not ruin all your dreams as they did mine!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我向命运之神祈祷不要像对我一样毁掉你的梦想！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I'd best get back to singing, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我得回去继续歌唱了，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Let's talk when I'm not singing, Zagreus?

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我不唱歌的时候再聊天好吗，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Hello, my friend, let's get back to my song?

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 你好，我的朋友，我要回去唱歌了。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I'm kind of singing at the moment, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我现在正唱歌呢，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Terribly sorry I can't speak with you right now.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 真的不好意思，但是我现在不能和你聊天。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I thought I'd lost even the gift of music, Zagreus. So, thanks again for helping find that one for me!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我还以为我丢失了音乐天赋呢，扎格列欧斯。再次感谢你帮助我找到了它！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I must say, it's nice having some music in my life again, and hopefully in yours!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 不得不说，再次拥有音乐之后的生活真好啊，希望你也一样！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: We all could use a little song from time to time, isn't that so?

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我们时不时都需要来一点音乐，对吧？

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: It's nice that I no longer have to live and breathe, and can be focused purely on my song...!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 死后的我可以全身心投入到歌曲创作当中了，真是太好了…！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: You rescued me from an eternity of not getting to sing, my friend.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 你把我从永远无法歌唱的危机中解救出来了，我的朋友。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I hope your day or night is just as splendid as my own, my friend.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 望你的日与夜也能过得精彩，我的朋友。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I pray the Fates fulfill your dreams as they did mine!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我向命运之神祈祷让你的梦想必会实现！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, Zagreus, how wonderful to see you once again!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，扎格列欧斯，很高兴能再会！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I was just thinking of you, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我刚刚正想你呢，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: My greetings to my very dearest friend.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 向我最亲密的朋友，致以最深切的问候。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I am in concert as perhaps you see, my friend!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我正在开音乐会呢，我的朋友！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Begging your pardon, Zagreus, but I'm amid performance at this time!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 不好意思，扎格列欧斯，我现在正在表演呢！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I'm quite preoccupied with singing all your praises, Zagreus!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我正忙着赞颂你呢，扎格列欧斯！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: This hymn is dedicated to your deeds, my friend!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 这首赞歌讲的是你的事迹噢，我的朋友！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I cannot talk right now, my friend, for I must sing!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我现在不能说话，朋友，我在唱歌！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I trust my music brings some lightness to our gloom-filled times, my friend?

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 相信我的音乐能在这忧郁的日子里给大家带来一丝欢快，我的朋友。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: The tale of your birth is so complex, my friend!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 你的出身故事太复杂了，我的朋友！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I ask you please hold your applause until the end!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 希望你可以把掌声留到最后！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: To think Lord Dionysus and yourself share such a bond!

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: May my performances spread wide your fame, my friend!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 迪奥尼索司大人和你竟如此这般的联系！

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 愿我的表演令你声名远扬，我的朋友！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Your parentage need not be secret any longer, Zagreus!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 不必再保密自己的出身了，扎格列欧斯！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I shall keep singing of your praises, far and wide!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我将继续歌唱你的事迹，让它广为流传！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: You've helped inspire me to song, my friend!

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 你给了我创作歌曲的灵感，我的朋友！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I must stay focused on my singing, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我要集中精神去唱歌，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I trust my hymn provides some solace to your days or nights?

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我相信我的歌不论在白天还是黑夜都能带给你快乐。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: My muse writes absolutely wondrous songs, don't you agree?

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我的缪斯女神写了非常棒的歌，不觉得吗？

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Ah, this reminds me so of my Eurydice...

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，这让我想起了我的欧律狄克…

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Would that I were together with her now...

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 想起了我们在一起的时光…

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: The songs of my Eurydice are without peer...

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我的欧律狄克，她的歌天下无双…

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: This is a favorite song of mine, and perhaps yours?

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 这是我最喜欢的一首歌，也许你也喜欢？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, mate, here. I got this for my favorite court musician.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, my, but you can't simply be this kind to me without retaliation on my part, my friend! And so, in turn, I have a gift for you!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，朋友，来。给我最喜欢的宫廷乐师。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，天啊，如果对你的慷慨没有回礼的话就太不像话了，我的朋友！好，作为回礼，我把这个给你！

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Why, this is absolutely splendid, Zagreus. Is this really for me? It's so very kind of you to think of me like this.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I want you to have it, Orpheus. You've brightened up our lives down here more than you know. I only wish that you could see that.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 哎呀，这简直是太棒了，扎格列欧斯。真的是给我的吗？你这样对我真是太好了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 希望你能收下，俄耳甫斯。你给我们的生活带来了光明，你自己都不知道。我只希望你可以看到。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, why! I'm very much obliged that you have thought of me again, for such a wonderfully thoughtful gift!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's nothing, Orpheus. Thank you for all the inspiration through your song. I love your work, mate.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，哎呀！又给我带来这么精致，这么思虑周全的礼物，我真的很高兴。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没什么，俄耳甫斯。谢谢你的歌给我的鼓舞。我很喜欢你的作品，伙计。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: You're always much too kind, you know, my friend? Now typically I would express my gratitude through song, except, you understand, don't you?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I understand completely, Orpheus. I think we'll both get through this rough patch in due time.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 你总是这样慷慨大方，我的朋友。一般这样的时候我会通过唱歌来表达感激，不过，你明白的，对吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我完全明白，俄耳甫斯。我想我们总会渡过艰难时期的。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: You always offer means to quench my thirst, my friend. A wonder that I have such feelings, even now.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Now that you've started singing once again, I figured it was thirst-inducing work! Your music stirs so many souls around here, mate.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 你总有办法满足我的需要，我的朋友。即使是现在，我也很奇怪自己竟然有这样的想法。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 因为你又开始歌唱了，所以我就觉得你应该会特别容易口渴！朋友，你的音乐打动了这儿的许多灵魂啊。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, mate! What do you say we share this over in the lounge?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, I, certainly, why, I don't see why not. I mean, it's not as though I've got something to do that isn't that.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: ...And, anyways, I oughtn't have looked back, I mean, the moral of the story is to not look back when you are told not to look back, you understand, don't you, my friend?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Don't look back, huh. I'll try not to. Though, you can't be blamed for doing it yourself, just the one time. What happened to you... it wasn't fair. If you ask me.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: ...I quite enjoyed our outing, Zagreus. So, I suppose I shall be seeing you around?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，朋友！把这个东西在休息室里跟大家一起分享怎么样？

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，我，当然了，为何，为何不呢？我是说，反正我现在也没什么事。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: …不管怎样，我不应该回头的，我是说，整个故事的寓意就是，不该回头的时候就不要回头，你懂我意思吧，我的朋友?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不要回头，是吗，我尽量别回头吧。不过，你也只不过是回了一次头而已，不应该这么责备自己。要我说的话……你碰上的那种事情根本不公平。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: ……这次小聚真让人高兴，扎格列欧斯。那么，我想是时候说再见了？

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I am indebted to you, Zagreus, both for your friendship and embarrassment of generosity.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: And I, in turn, am indebted to you, Orpheus, for your calm demeanor and ability to accept life's greatest challenges. You inspire me, and I wish you the best.

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，您给我的友谊和慷慨，我必会回报。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这就要谢谢你了，俄耳甫斯，你从容自若地接受了人生中最大的挑战。你激励了我。我祝你一切如愿！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Orpheus, mate! I have something good for you right here... Ambrosia! All the way from the surface. I want you to have it.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Ah, but this is splendid, Zagreus. And I must say, apart from my Eurydice, I've never felt as strong a bond of kinship as with you.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯，来！我给你看个宝贝……仙馔密酒！这东西可是从遥远的地表来的，送给你了。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，太好了，扎格列欧斯。而且，说真的，除了欧律狄刻以外，你是唯一让我有强烈亲近感的人。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey Orpheus, you know I once wrested this bottle of Ambrosia from the Champions of Elysium, defeating them two against one, just so I could bring it here to you personally?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Please, my friend! I feel I am undeserving of such a relentless show of kindness on your part. I shall accept, but you'll relent, won't you? As well as forgive me?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Mate, if that is your wish, then it will be my pleasure to oblige. Though, may this gift symbolize the strength of our friendship for an eternity to come. I've learned so much from you.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Thank you, my friend. Would that I had capacity to take some joy from this.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 喂，俄耳甫斯，你知不知道，这仙馔密酒是我从至福乐土最强的战士手里抢来的，当时我可是以一打二，想着一定要给你搞到这瓶好酒。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 我的朋友啊！我自知不配接受你这慷慨的礼物。我会收下的，但你也要这么激动嘛，好吗？原谅我吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 朋友，如果这就是你的愿望，那我马上就让你如愿。希望这份礼物成为我们亲密友情的象征。你教会了我很多东西。

zh-CN.speaker: 俄耳甫斯
zh-CN.text: 谢谢你，我的朋友。真希望我能从中获得一丝愉悦。

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Why, Zagreus, how wonderful to see you here. Eurydice and I, we have been catching up for all the time we've spent apart.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Yeah. So, if you would excuse us for a little while, hon? I'm not finished catching up with him just yet. But first, before you go!

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Orpheus_Story_01
