zh-CN.text: 哇哦，扎格列欧斯，真高兴能在这里见到你。欧律狄刻和我一直在这里互诉衷肠，了解彼此的近况呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 是啊。那么，如果你不介意的话，可以让我们单独谈谈吗，亲爱的？我和他还有些话要说。不过，我们聊完，你们就可以走了！

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Orpheus_Story_01
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I've never heard anything like this. As good as you two sound each on your own, you're positively wonderful together.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: A splendid compliment, my friend. Doubtless the Fates themselves conspired to ensure Eurydice and I would meet, and sing together. Fall in love. And then be cruelly separated for some time!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Now don't you start with that again, you get me, Orphy? Got our whole entire afterlives ahead of us! And lots of songs to catch up on.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Why, you're correct of course, my dear. If you'll excuse us, Zagreus? Our calling beckons.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我从来没听过这种的歌曲。你们两个本身都非常出色，现在合唱的这首歌简直是棒极了。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Orpheus_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 非常感谢你的赞美，我的朋友。毫无疑问，是命运女神让我和欧律狄刻相遇，共展歌喉，坠入爱河。而后，却又狠心将我们拆散！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 不要再提那件事了，听见没有，俄耳？未来的日子还长着呢，有无数的曲子等着我们。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Orpheus_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 哦，亲爱的，你说得没错。请见谅，扎格列欧斯，我们现在就要唱一曲了。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Orpheus_Story_01
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, you two, how's everything lately? On speaking terms again? Or singing terms?

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, things are going very wonderfully, my friend. I never thought I'd see Eurydice again, after I...

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Orphy still just can't shut up about that time, hon. But we're making progress. Thanks for having him stop by. I'm sure he needed plenty of encouragement.

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 喂，你们两个，最近怎么样？是说出来还是唱出来？

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Orpheus_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 噢，一切都挺好的，我的朋友。我从来没想过经过那种事情后，我还能再见到欧律狄刻……

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 俄耳还是一天到晚抱着以前的事说个不停，亲爱的。不过我们还是有进步的。感谢你让他来这里。他一定需要更多的鼓励。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Orpheus_Story_01
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, you're singing In the Blood after all, Orpheus! Thank you for taking my request!

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Oh, it is certainly my pleasure, Zagreus. This song of Eurydice's and mine, I've a connection to it, I suppose. Reminded me of some fond memories!

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你终于唱起《鲜血之中》这首歌了，俄耳甫斯！谢谢你接受我的请求！

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Orpheus_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 哦，这是我的荣幸，扎格列欧斯。这首歌是我和欧律狄刻创作的，我猜，它也算是我的一部分了吧。它让我想起了很多美妙的回忆！

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Orpheus_Story_01
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hey, nice of you to visit us, Your Royal Majesty! For you!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 嗨，谢谢您来看我们，我的陛下！给您！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Orphy and I, we're doing great here thanks to you. You take care, hon!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 我和俄耳在这里过得很好，谢谢你。保重，亲爱的！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hope you find yourself someone to sing with, too, hon.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 希望你也可以找到自己的知音，亲爱的。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Don't fret, Your Majesty, I'll have him back to work on time, you hear that, Orphy?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 别急，陛下。我会让他按时回去工作的，听到了吗，俄耳？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Orphy and me, we're like your typical old married couple, hon.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 我和俄耳，就是典型的老夫老妻啊，亲爱的。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: If you find happiness out there, hon, don't look back.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 找到欢乐就别回头噢，甜心。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Things aren't so bad here, hon. Hope you can say the same.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 这里不太烂，甜心。希望你那边也是。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: What can I say, hon? We like practicing our favorite tune!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 我能说什么呢，亲爱的。我们就是喜欢一起练习我们最爱的曲子！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Well if it isn't the Hades kid come to pay the both of us a visit!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 看，是哈迪斯的小子来探望我们！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: ...You must know, you sound as wonderful as ever, now, my dear!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Orpheus_Story_01
zh-CN.text: ……我一定要告诉你，你的声音和以前一样美妙，亲爱的！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Is she not truly wonderful, my friend?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Orpheus_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 她真是太美妙了，不是吗，我的朋友？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: We sing, and sing, and never once grow weary, Zagreus!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Orpheus_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 我们一直唱着，不知疲倦，扎格列欧斯！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I never thought I would see her again. You are to thank for this, my friend.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Orpheus_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 我从没想过可以再次与她相见，这一切都是你的功劳，我的朋友。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: When we thus sing together, Zagreus, I lose all track of time.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Orpheus_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 当我们一起歌唱的时候，我会完全忘记时间，扎格列欧斯。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Is the singing of Eurydice not the most splendid thing that you have ever heard?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Orpheus_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 欧律狄刻的歌声简直是天籁，不是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: Shall there ever be a voice as lovely as Eurydice's, my friend?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Orpheus_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 还有谁的声音能像欧律狄刻的歌声一样动人吗，我的朋友？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: It gladdens me that you could join us here, my friend.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Orpheus_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 你能来这里，我真是太高兴了，我的朋友。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Guess what we've been up to lately, hon? Now if you'll excuse us?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 猜猜我们最近做了什么事情，亲爱的？不介意我们告退吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: We just finished eating, here! Got plenty left over.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 我们刚刚吃完，还剩了不少呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: The one thing better than singing, hon, is singing with somebody you love.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 比唱歌更令人开心的事情，就是和你心爱的人一起唱歌。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Orphy here's just practicing for when he's got to sing next for Hades Senior!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 俄耳只是在练习他下一次要唱给哈迪斯大人的歌！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: What do you know, we were just in the middle of a song here, hon!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 你知道吗，我们刚刚还在唱歌呢，亲爱的！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Not much luck trying to teach Orphy to cook, but he can sing, all right!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 教俄耳做饭的计划不太成功，不过他会唱歌，这就够了！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Look, Orphy, we've got an audience! So sing your heart out!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 快看，俄耳，有听众来了！尽情地唱出来吧！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Don't mind Orphy, here, hon. Can't snap him out of it once he gets singing!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 来，亲爱的，别介意俄耳。他只要一唱起来，就停不下来。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: You know this tune, hon? It's one of our old hits!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 你听过这首歌吧，亲爱的？这可是我们以前最知名的曲目之一！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: We were just thinking about old times, Orphy and I!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 我和俄耳，我们刚刚在追忆以前的日子呢！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Thought we'd mix up our singing just a bit here, hon!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 我觉得我们应该一起高歌一会儿才对，亲爱的！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Got to tell you I've warmed up to this old song over the years!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 说真的，这些年里，我慢慢开始喜欢这首老歌了！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: I know that you enjoy this one, my friend!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Orpheus_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 我就知道你会喜欢这首的，我的朋友！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: This one reminds me of my days alive with my Eurydice...!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Orpheus_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 这首歌让我想起活着的时候，和欧律狄刻在一起的时光……！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Orpheus
en.text: This song had quite a bit of popularity, one time.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Orpheus_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 这首歌以前还挺流行的。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText03

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Tsch. The prodigal son returns.... Everyone's saying I went easy on you, Zag.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Don't worry, Meg. I eventually managed to get home the painful way after all.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Look, I've a reputation to uphold. You get past me again like that, you best go all the way. Now, leave me be, and don't think you're going to be so lucky next we meet out there.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 啧，顽逆的孩子回来了……大家都说我放水了，扎格。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没事，墨纪，反正后来我又惨死回家了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 声誉对我来说很重要。如果你再从我这里通过，你最好一路走到终点。你走吧，别以为下次我们相遇还能有这么好运了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Tsch. The prodigal son returns.... Everyone's saying I went easy on you, Zag.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Don't worry, Meg. I eventually managed to get home the painful way after all. Though... I managed to get much farther than you'd probably expect.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I expected you to not get past me, yes. Look, I've a reputation to uphold. Don't think you're going to be so lucky next we meet out there.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 啧，顽逆的孩子回来了……大家都说我放水了，扎格。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没事，墨纪，反正后来我又惨死回家了。不过……我去的地方，恐怕比你想象得要远多了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 是啊，我本希望能把你拦下来。听着，我还得维护我的名誉呢。等我们下次再见面的时候，你别以为你还会这么走运。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Tsch. The prodigal son returns.... Everyone's saying I went easy on you, Zag.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Don't worry, Meg. I eventually managed to get home the painful way after all.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Look, I've a reputation to uphold. You get past me again like that, you best go all the way. Now, leave me be, and don't think you're going to be so lucky next we meet out there.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 啧，顽逆的孩子回来了……大家都说我放水了，扎格。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没事，墨纪，反正后来我又惨死回家了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 声誉对我来说很重要。如果你再从我这里通过，你最好一路走到终点。你走吧，别以为下次我们相遇还能有这么好运了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Tsch. The prodigal son returns.... Everyone's saying I went easy on you, Zag.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Don't worry, Meg. I eventually managed to get home the painful way after all. Though... I managed to get much farther than you'd probably expect.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I expected you to not get past me, yes. Look, I've a reputation to uphold. Don't think you're going to be so lucky next we meet out there.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 啧，顽逆的孩子回来了……大家都说我放水了，扎格。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没事，墨纪，反正后来我又惨死回家了。不过……我去的地方，恐怕比你想象得要远多了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 是啊，我本希望能把你拦下来。听着，我还得维护我的名誉呢。等我们下次再见面的时候，你别以为你还会这么走运。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, uh, what's that you're drinking, Meg? Anything good?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Whatever it is, it's weak. Enough to be mistaken for your blood.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nice! Well, I'll just leave you to it, then.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，呃，你在喝什么呢，墨纪？好喝吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 随便什么东西，反正没什么劲，跟你的血一样。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好的！那么，我就不打扰你啦。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I'll tear you limb from limb out there next time, you mark my words.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 下次再遇到你，我要把你手脚都给扯了，你记住了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What are your sisters up to these days, Meg? I've not seen them around.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: We're stretched a little thin, as you can see. Some kind of war up there meant lots of business here. I'm left to hold the line. And deal with you.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你的姐妹们最近都在干什么呢，墨纪？都没看到她们。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 正如你所看到的，过得不太好。上面打起仗，下面事情就多。我在这里坐冷板凳。然后对付你。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What are your sisters up to these days, Meg? I've not seen them around.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: We're stretched a little thin, as you can see. Some kind of war up there meant lots of business here. I'm left to hold the line. And deal with you.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你的姐妹们最近都在干什么呢，墨纪？都没看到她们。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 正如你所看到的，过得不太好。上面打起仗，下面事情就多。我在这里坐冷板凳。然后对付你。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: What do you want from me, leave me alone. We've nothing to discuss here anymore.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I was just checking up on you, just... let me know if you wanted to talk, for any reason.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I am not interested in having company, especially from you. You stay the hell away while I'm off duty.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你到底想怎么样，离我远点好吗。我们在这里没什么好谈的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我就是来看看你，就是…如果你想找人说话的话，告诉我就行了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我不要有人来陪，特别是你。我现在没在工作，你最好滚远点。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I told you to back off.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我说了给我滚开。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: What do you want from me, leave me alone. We've nothing to discuss here anymore.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I was just checking up on you, just... let me know if you wanted to talk, for any reason.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I am not interested in having company, especially from you. You stay the hell away while I'm off duty.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你到底想怎么样，离我远点好吗。我们在这里没什么好谈的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我就是来看看你，就是…如果你想找人说话的话，告诉我就行了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我不要有人来陪，特别是你。我现在没在工作，你最好滚远点。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I told you to back off.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我说了给我滚开。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Excuse me, is there something I can do for you, Prince Zagreus?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's nothing, I just thought I'd say, that was well fought back there.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: There's no returning to the way things used to be, Zag. Now can I offer you some words of advice? Get over yourself. And get ready to die out there next time we meet.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 不好意思，有什么我能为你效劳的吗，扎格列欧斯王子？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没事，我就是想说，刚刚真是一场激烈的战斗呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 事情已经回不去原来的样子了，扎格。我现在能给你提个建议吗？给我打起精神来。下次我们见面的时候准备受死。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Zagreus. Good, I wanted to tell you something. Your victories against me? They don't count for anything.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sounds like you've been giving this a lot of thought, there, Meg. How do you figure?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Nyx's Mirror. You couldn't possibly beat me without its help, or hers.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm not competing with you, Meg. I'm trying to get past you, to the surface.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Call it what you want. You're doing what you have to do. I understand. But you are not stronger than me. You just have more help.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯。好，我想告诉你。你打赢我这件事。不能算数。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 听起来你好像对此有什么想法，墨纪。你想说什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯的镜子。没了这镜子或者倪克斯的帮助，你不可能赢我。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我又不是在跟你竞技，我是想从你这里通过而已，墨纪，然后去凡界。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 随便你怎么说。我知道你只是在做自己该做的。但你没有我强。你只是有人帮你。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Beaten. By you. Without the help of Nyx's mirror. You humiliated me. And now you've come to rub it in, I guess? Well, go on, then. Not like you can shame me any more.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Meg, what is it going to take for you to quit treating me like I'm incompetent? Have I not grown even a little since we met? You were supposed to teach me something; what does that make you?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Tsch... why don't you raise your voice a little louder so that all the House can hear. Is that what you want? For everyone to know that you're superior to me?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're not hearing me, Meg. I know it sounds a little disingenuous considering we keep fighting to the death and all, but... I never meant to hurt you.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You give yourself far too much credit, Zagreus. Leave me alone.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我……输了。在没有倪克斯的镜子的情况下。你羞辱了我。而现在又再伤口上撒盐？来吧，继续吧。你对我的羞辱还不够吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 墨纪，怎样才能让你不再把我当作没用的废物？从你认识我到现在，难道我就没有一点成长吗？你本来该教我一些东西；对此你有何想法？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 啧……你怎么不再大点声，好让圣殿的每个人都听见？让所有人都知道你比我强？你就是这么希望的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你好好听我说，墨纪。我们一直以来都是兵戎相见，我知道这听上去有点虚伪，但是说真的……我从没想过要伤害你。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你的自我感觉太良好了，扎格列欧斯。别烦我。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Beaten. By you. Without the help of Nyx's mirror. You humiliated me. And now you've come to rub it in, I guess? Well, go on, then. Not like you can shame me any more.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Meg, that isn't why I'm here, you know that isn't how I am. Why can't you see it? All I've ever wanted was to prove myself to you.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Tsch... you think that you can prove yourself to me by winning in a fight?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sometimes I think that I can never really win with you, Meg. If I held back, what would you have thought?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: If you think you know me so well, Zagreus, then you ought to know better than to keep this conversation going with me, now.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我……输了。在没有倪克斯的镜子的情况下。你羞辱了我。而现在又再伤口上撒盐？来吧，继续吧。你对我的羞辱还不够吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 墨纪，这不是我来的原因，你知道我不是这样的人。为什么你还是不明白？我想要做的，只是在你面前证明自己。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 哧……你以为赢得一场战斗就能在我面前证明自己吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 有时候，我都认为自己永远不能赢得你的欢心，墨纪拉。如果我退缩了，你又会怎么想？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 如果你觉得对我有足够了解，扎格列欧斯，就不应该说这些傻话。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I can't believe it, Zag. I thought for sure that Nyx's mirror was the only reason you could beat me. I knew you'd changed to some extent, but... not this much.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I had to see if I could do it, Meg. I've learned so much from you, I... thought maybe this was a way that I could prove myself to you. And to myself.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Prove yourself, to me...? You must not be as comfortable in your own skin as you let on. I can't decide if I like that about you. Now leave me alone while I give it some thought.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 真是不敢相信，扎格。我以为倪克斯的镜子是你能够打败我的唯一原因。我知道你进步了，但……没料到你进步这么大。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我必须要试试看，我能不能做到，墨纪。我从你身上学到那么多，我……觉得这可能是向你，也是向我证明自身价值的一种方式。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 向我证明你的价值……？按照你的说法，你那副故作轻松的样子肯定让自己挺不舒服的吧？我也不知道自己是不是喜欢这样的你。现在让我一个人好好想想。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: So, Zagreus. How's it going with that Pact of Punishment you signed? You've made some meaningful improvements to the Underworld.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'll fight my way out of this place, or earn it. The Pact is nothing to me other than a way to keep things lively.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You are delusional. I'll never understand you or your father. Anyway, if you're looking for more punishment, you know where to find me.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 那么，扎格列欧斯，你签订的那道惩罚契约怎么样了？你给这冥界带来了一些可观的改善呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我会从这个地方杀出去，努力争取。这契约对我来说只是保持活力的一种方式罢了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你真是妄想。我永远都理解不了你和你的父亲。不过，如果你想要惩罚的时候，欢迎来找我。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: So, Zagreus. How's it going with that Pact of Punishment you signed? You've made some meaningful improvements to the Underworld.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'll fight my way out of this place, or earn it. The Pact is nothing to me other than a way to keep things lively.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You are delusional. I'll never understand you or your father. Anyway, if you're looking for more punishment, you know where to find me.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 那么，扎格列欧斯，你签订的那道惩罚契约怎么样了？你给这冥界带来了一些可观的改善呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我会从这个地方杀出去，努力争取。这契约对我来说只是保持活力的一种方式罢了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你真是妄想。我永远都理解不了你和你的父亲。不过，如果你想要惩罚的时候，欢迎来找我。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Zagreus. I heard Lord Hades served you with a Pact of Punishment. You must be very proud.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, you mean the gigantic infernal contract reserved only for extraordinary circumstances? Yeah, I suppose I'm pleased that Father's gone to all that trouble just for me.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Well, when you're finished being smug about it? Know that all of us are bound by its terms. You can force a lot of things to change if you're not careful.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: A lot of things, such as how you refuse to reason with your positively charming sisters, Meg?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: The Extreme Measures condition... you wouldn't dare. Do you have any idea what you're talking about?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯。我听说冥王哈迪斯和你签了惩罚契约。你肯定很自豪吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你是说如此影响深远的地狱契约只适用于特殊情况？是啊，我应该为此感到高兴，父亲竟然为了我这样大费周章。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 好吧，在你洋洋得意的同时？你要知道我们所有人都要受到契约条款的约束。万一有什么闪失，很多情况就变了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 很多情况？例如，如何拒绝与你迷人的姐妹们讲道理吗，墨纪。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 极端措施条件……你竟敢。你知道自己在说什么吗？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Well, how was it up there, Zagreus? Within Elysium. You'll have to tell us all about it every time the greatest strike you down.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You've never been there, have you? It's... lush? Is that a word? It feels closer to the surface. Closer to the sky.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: How poetic. You could have visited as part of your responsibilities. Instead, you trespass. Incurring wrath of fallen champions in service of your father.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 嗯，上面怎么样，扎格列欧斯？至福乐土。每次你被强敌打倒，都要告诉我们。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你还从来没去过，对吧？那是…酒吗？这是个词吗？感觉凡界近在咫尺。天空触手可及。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 真有诗意。你本可以以工作名义来这里参观参观的。但你现在是入侵者。你父亲手下的陨落战士也对你刀剑相向。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Well, how was it up there, Zagreus? Within Elysium. You'll have to tell us all about it every time the greatest strike you down.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You've never been there, have you? It's... lush? Is that a word? It feels closer to the surface. Closer to the sky.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: How poetic. You could have visited as part of your responsibilities. Instead, you trespass. Incurring wrath of fallen champions in service of your father.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 嗯，上面怎么样，扎格列欧斯？至福乐土。每次你被强敌打倒，都要告诉我们。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你还从来没去过，对吧？那是…酒吗？这是个词吗？感觉凡界近在咫尺。天空触手可及。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 真有诗意。你本可以以工作名义来这里参观参观的。但你现在是入侵者。你父亲手下的陨落战士也对你刀剑相向。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: So you cleared out some of the Satyr infestation near the surface, then. How come the change of heart? Not like you to assist Lord Hades in such things.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I wasn't trying to do my father any favors, Meg. Those Satyrs seem to hate me just as much as him. My one way out involves a detour straight into their dens.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: An interesting coincidence. At any rate, that's one less problem for the rest of us to deal with. Until the Satyrs all come back, at least, which won't be long.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 所以你就清除了凡界附近的萨提尔害虫。是什么改变了你的心意？你不像是那种会帮助冥王哈迪斯做这种事的人呀。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我并不是在帮助我的父亲，墨纪。那些萨提尔对我和我的父亲都恨之入骨。我的出路正好经过他们的巢穴。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 有趣的巧合。无论如何，替我们其他人解决了一个问题。至少在萨提尔卷土重来之前是这样，他们很快就会回来。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You've been through hell more times than you can count by now, haven't you, Zag. You getting used to it? No wonder that you're friends with Sisyphus.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm getting used to it, all right. I'll keep going, for as many chances as it takes. I'll look forward to our next appointment out there.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Appointment. Indeed. Don't keep me waiting. For all your toil, I'm sure you're not even close.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你已经在地狱走过无数回了吧，是不是，扎格。你习惯了吗？难怪你跟西西弗斯交了朋友。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我已经习惯了。我会继续前进，次数越多越好。那我就先提前预约跟你的下一次会面了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 预约。没错。可别让我久等了。你如此艰辛前行，在我看来你离成功还远得很。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Zagreus, please tell me that the rumors are untrue. You really vanquished him? Have you completely lost your mind? You're going to destroy this blasted House!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Come on, Meg, Father had it coming for some time. What's your concern, besides? The House is safe.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: He's not going to take this lying down. He'll find some way to take it out on you. On all of us. You watch yourself, or all of us will pay.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，请告诉我传言都是假的。你真的打败他了？你是不是要疯？你会把这座该死的圣殿毁掉的！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好了，墨纪，父亲那件事已经过了很久了。你有什么好担心的呢？圣殿没事的。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 他是不会善罢甘休的。他会想办法给我们安个罪名。每个人都跑不了。你自己要小心点，否则我们所有人都要为此付出代价。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Zagreus, please tell me that the rumors are untrue. You really vanquished him? Have you completely lost your mind? You're going to destroy this blasted House!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Come on, Meg, Father had it coming for some time. What's your concern, besides? The House is safe.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: He's not going to take this lying down. He'll find some way to take it out on you. On all of us. You watch yourself, or all of us will pay.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，请告诉我传言都是假的。你真的打败他了？你是不是要疯？你会把这座该死的圣殿毁掉的！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好了，墨纪，父亲那件事已经过了很久了。你有什么好担心的呢？圣殿没事的。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 他是不会善罢甘休的。他会想办法给我们安个罪名。每个人都跑不了。你自己要小心点，否则我们所有人都要为此付出代价。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: What are you doing here? I heard you finally made it out. What, did you break out of here, only to die in some pathetic way on the surface?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Long story, but yeah. Boils down to what you said, more or less.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: So you're going back out there, again. Well, it's your business, not mine. For your sake... I hope it's worth it.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你在这里干什么呢？我听说你已经逃出这里了。你一次次地逃出这里，难道就是为了能在凡间惨死吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这是个复杂的故事，不过是啊，差不多就是你总结的这样。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 所以你又要逃出这里了。好吧，反正这是你的事情，不是我的。我希望对你来说……这一切都值得。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: What are you doing here? I heard you finally made it out. What, did you break out of here, only to die in some pathetic way on the surface?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Long story, but yeah. Boils down to what you said, more or less.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: So you're going back out there, again. Well, it's your business, not mine. For your sake... I hope it's worth it.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你在这里干什么呢？我听说你已经逃出这里了。你一次次地逃出这里，难道就是为了能在凡间惨死吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这是个复杂的故事，不过是啊，差不多就是你总结的这样。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 所以你又要逃出这里了。好吧，反正这是你的事情，不是我的。我希望对你来说……这一切都值得。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Meg, did you... did you ever meet the Queen...? Remember anything about her, at all?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: It was not my place to address her. I barely ever saw her. Then, at some point... I never saw her again. And, unlike you, I know better than to get involved in things that are none of my business.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: How is it that this place has this secret Queen for I don't know how long, then suddenly she just vanishes, and no one speaks a word of it?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 墨纪，你以前……你以前有没有见过冥后……？还记不记得关于她的事情？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我以前没资格跟她说话，也几乎没怎么见过她。后来某一天……我就再也没见过她了。而且我和你不一样，和我无关的事情，我知道自己不该乱掺和。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 先是有个避人耳目的冥后，不知道在这里呆了多久。之后她突然消失了，却根本没人提起过她。这地方到底是怎么回事？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: How is she doing, Zagreus? The Queen, I mean. She was... I had admired her.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Mother... she's doing well, I think. She's in good spirits every time we meet. Happy to let her know you're thinking of her, by the way!

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Don't, it's... it isn't necessary. She doesn't need you telling her about this place. Sounds to me like she is better off without.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 她还好吗，扎格列欧斯？我是说，冥后。她……我很钦佩她。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 母亲……她一切都好。每次见面的时候，她看起来都很有精神。另外，我很乐于告诉她，说你还在惦记着她！

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 别这样，这……这没必要。她不需要你告诉她这里的情况，我觉得她离开这里之后，好像活得更开心。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Just so I understand. Breaking through everything in your path, taking resources from your father's realm, trying to get through me... all officially part of the job description?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I guess that's right... but, before you ask, I'm not doing it for him.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I didn't think you'd have it in you. To leave this place for good. But I didn't think you'd take responsibility for anything, either. Anyway... we'll just have to kill each other more officially, I guess.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 以我的理解，你要破坏沿途的一切，在你父亲的王国里搜刮财宝，从我这里闯过去……这一切都正式包含在你的工作范围之内吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜你说的没错……但是，在你开口之前，我没打算为他做这件事情。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我真没想过你还有这股劲儿。我以为你只打算一走了之，从没想过你打算为任何事情负责。总之我猜……咱们要以更加正式的身份互相厮杀了吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I never thought I'd see the Queen again. I still can't quite believe she's back... and staying? Is that really your doing?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's her doing, not mine. So you know her? Because... you could have told me. About her. Who she was to me.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Don't know her all that well. But I do know Nyx, and I've been bound to secrecy as part of my oath to this House. I flay oathbreakers and liars, Zagreus. Wouldn't do for me to be no better than them, now, would it?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No, I suppose not. So what does this mean for Nyx, now that she's back? Or for you, for that matter?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: The Queen always gave Nyx her space. Your father, though... I don't know what it'll be like for him, if she decides to stick around this time.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 真没想到我还能再见到冥后大人，我还是不敢相信她真的回来了……而且还会留在这里？这真的都是你的功劳吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这是她的功劳，和我无关。所以说，你认识她吗？因为……你本可以告诉我关于她的事情，告诉我她是我的什么人。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我和她没那么熟悉，不过我和倪克斯很熟悉，而且我发誓要恪守这座圣殿的秘密。我专杀骗子和背信弃义之人，扎格列欧斯，我总不能变得和那些人一样吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，我想你说得没错。既然她已经回来了，这对倪克斯来说意味着什么呢？或者说，对你意味着什么呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 冥后总会给倪克斯足够的空间。不过，至于你的父亲……如果冥后这次打算留下的话，我不知道他会做何感想。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: So the Olympians are backing you officially now? Doing their part to help the family business, finally. Lord Hades probably never thought he'd see the day. Night? You know what I mean.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Seems only fair they should help in some capacity. They all work together on the surface, and, let's face it, they're responsible for a good number of shades pouring into this realm. Least they can do is help shore up the whole 'there is no escape' reputation we've got.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: By making you unfairly stronger by the time you try to get through me?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 所以说，奥林匹斯众神已经正式支援你了，是吗？他们终于也履行他们身为家人的责任了。说不定冥王哈迪斯从来都没想过能亲眼看到这么一天。或是这么一夜？你明白我的意思。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 他们应该在某种程度上提供帮助，这样才公平。所有的奥林匹斯神都在通力合作，而且老实说，之所以会有那么多幽灵涌入这个地方，都是因为他们的关系。所以，他们至少可以帮助我们，帮忙巩固这里“没人能逃得出去”的名声。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 所以他们做的事情，就是让你强到犯规，好从我这里闯过去吗？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Well, Zag? You like things nice and complicated, don't you. Apparently so do I.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: If you're asking if I have any regrets about what happened between us, the answer is no. Being with you... any complications there are worth it.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You don't need to tell me. Two rules, if you want to keep this up. First... we set the personal aside when we're out there. I better not hear a soul say I'm going soft on you. And second... keep up this slightly more mature thing you've had going for you recently.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wasn't planning on sliding back into the insensitive nonsense of youth, so I don't think the second thing will be a problem. But the first... can we really just keep killing each other out there like nothing happened?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 怎么了，扎格？你很喜欢把事情弄得复杂，是吧？很显然，我也喜欢。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果你想问我，我对咱们之间发生的事情后不后悔的话，我的答案是：不后悔。能和你在一起……无论是什么样的后果，都值得。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 这些话你不用对我说。如果你打算继续维持这种关系的话，我有两个要求。第一……我们在外面的时候，先把儿女私情放下。我可不想听到有人说我对你手下留情。第二……你最近变得更成熟一些了，继续保持这个势头。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我并不打算回到那没心没肺，麻木不仁的青葱岁月，所以我觉得第二个条件不成问题。但第一个条件……我们真的能继续互相杀戮，就好像什么都没发生过一样吗？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Tsk... Come off it, Zag. Are you really going to act all uncomfortable every time you see me now? More than usual I mean.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No, it's just... I felt terrible, turning you away. It's just... I've been so confused lately, and... I trust you. You're someone I can talk to. I guess I'm... afraid to lose that.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Don't be an idiot, and you won't. We've been through a lot together. Grown, maybe. This particular relationship... it can't die so easily, I think.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 啧……放松点，扎格。你真的打算每次见到我，都显得这么难受吗？我是说，你看起来比平时难受。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不，只是……拒绝你的感觉很糟糕。只是……我最近一直很困惑，而且……我相信你。你是我可以推心置腹的人，我猜……我只是害怕失去这些吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 别傻了，你才不会呢。咱们一起经历过这么多事情了，或者说，一起成长了。像这样特别的关系……我觉得是不会轻易泯灭的。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I feel like everybody knows about us, Meg. Even Aphrodite, herself, seemed to know we were involved. It's not like I've been going around boasting. You wanted to keep things quiet, didn't you?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Zagreus. Are you happy with how things are between us now? Or do you have a problem with it?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, I could do without the kill-or-be-killed stuff if we're being honest, that part is still a little weird, but otherwise... yes, I mean... I'm happy. You're you.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Then, that's enough. Let them say what they want. What does it matter? We're gods. The things they say about us... even other gods... you pay too much attention to it, it'll drive you out of your mind.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: But... I know how important your career is to you. This won't create a problem?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: We've already crossed that bridge, I think. Stop worrying.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我感觉好像所有人都知道咱们之间的事情一样，墨纪，就连阿弗洛狄忒本人似乎都知道了。这倒不是因为我到处宣扬咱们的事情。你希望这一切都不要声张，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，你对我们之间的关系满意吗？还是说，你觉得有什么问题？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不过，如果说实话的话，我觉得“要么杀人要么被杀”之类的可以去掉，这部分还是有点奇怪。不过除此之外……是啊，我是说……我很开心，你就是你。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 好了，这就足够了。别人愿意说什么就说吧，有什么关系呢？反正我们是神。他们对我们的评论……乃至对其他神明的评论……你实在是太在意了，这会把你逼疯的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 可是……我知道你的事业对你来说有多么重要。这不会造成问题吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我觉得我们已经跨过那条线了，别再担心了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Megaera... you ever been in love with somebody?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...Hm. Yes.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Who?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...Shut up.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 墨纪拉……你有没有恋爱过？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是和谁？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……闭嘴。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Never in my wildest fantasies did I imagine you'd ever end up on the Featured Houseservant Board, Zagreus. I still can't entirely believe it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Whoa, back up! Can you elaborate a bit about these wildest fantasies, Meg?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I'm serious. You should be proud. Not arrogantly proud to a fatal fault or anything, but a little bit is all right in a case like this.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 就算是在我最不切实际的幻想里，我也从来没想过你会成为这座圣殿最受欢迎的仆从，扎格列欧斯。我到现在也不敢相信。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哇啊，等一下！这怎么就成了你不切实际的幻想了，可以解释解释吗，墨纪？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我是认真的，你应该感到骄傲才对。倒不是那种盛气凌人、妄自尊大的骄傲，不过稍微自豪一下是完全没问题的。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Got to tell you something, Zagreus. I'm not getting any more used to losing to you like this. I mean... you don't even stop to rub it in. You know how humiliating that is?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, you're saying you would feel less ashamed about the outcomes of our fights if I were to gloat more about beating you? How does that make any sense?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You know what doesn't make any sense? That you keep beating me. I must be getting sloppy if I'm that predictable... too bad none of the other wretches I have to deal with put up much of a fight.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 有件事情我得和你说，扎格列欧斯。我已经不太适应像这样输给你了，我是说……你赢了之后，甚至都不肯停下来嘲弄我一番，你知道这有多让人难堪吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等等.……你是在说，如果我打败你之后能更加幸灾乐祸的话，你就觉得心里没那么惭愧了，是吗？这哪里说得通了？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你知道真说不通的是什么吗？就是你总是在打败我。如果我这么容易就被看穿的话，那我肯定是变得懈怠了……真遗憾，其它要处理的那些暗灵里，没一个能当我的对手。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You and your sisters really don't get along well, do you.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Alecto and Tisiphone and I each have a different outlook, I would say. We've learned mostly to stay out of one another's way.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That doesn't sound like a healthy basis for a relationship between siblings.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Are you lecturing me about healthy relationships with family, Zagreus? Your family, your father's family, is the most broken and corrupted in the history of the entire concept.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...Fair point. I... didn't mean to sound like I had any meaningful advice, there, Meg. We're stuck with our bloodlines and our relatives, aren't we.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Your family cut their Titan parents into pieces and then scattered them in Tartarus. Remember that when next you tell me about family.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你和你的姐妹确实处得不太好啊。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 阿勒克图，提西福涅和我都有不同的想法。我们都学着不去干扰彼此。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这听起来可不像是什么和谐的姐妹关系。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你还有脸给我说和谐的家庭关系，扎格列欧斯？你的家庭，你父亲的家庭，是有史以来最格格不入、最水火不容的家庭。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: …确实。我…并不是让自己听起来像是在说教，墨纪。我们都被自己的血统和亲人给困住了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你的家人把自己的泰坦父母切成碎片投入塔耳塔罗斯。下次你跟我谈论家庭的时候你最好记得这点。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know, while it was brutal squaring off against the three of you, I have to say, Meg... I was happy you were with your sisters. Nothing like a common cause for bringing bitter rivals together, right?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You have your Pact of Punishment to thank for our reunion, there. We have to answer to its terms. But my sisters and I, we got on better than I had expected, I will give you that.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So you've patched things up, then? Going to start spending more quality time together and all that?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Hm, let's not get carried away. A work assignment forcing our cooperation is not exactly a big step in the quality of our relationship.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你也知道，在和你们三姐妹残酷对峙的时候，我不得不说，墨纪……我为你和你的姐妹们站在一起而感到高兴。只有共同的理想才能把昔日的仇敌凝聚在一起，不是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 那还要感谢惩罚契约让我们重归于好。我们必须对其中的条款做出回应。但我和我的姐妹们之间的关系变得比我预料中的还好，我可以这么说。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 所以说，你们之间的关系和好如初了？然后开始共度美好时光？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 呃，别扯太远了。工作上的合作而已，对于关系的改善没有多大的作用。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Alecto's really something else. She must have been a real handful, huh?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: My youngest sister takes a lot of pleasure from her work. I've learned something of that from her. But that's as far as we relate, I think.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: She could learn a thing or two from you, I'm sure. About having a little common decency, perhaps.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: She won't be learning anything from me. The contempt you get from her is unconditional. I learned not to take it personally.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 阿勒克图确实与众不同。她一定很能干吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我最年轻的妹妹享受自己的工作。我也从中略微学习到了这点。但我们之间可能只有这样了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我肯定她也能从你身上学到点什么。比方说举止得体，礼貌待人之类的。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 她不会的。她对谁都是非常轻蔑的态度。我没往心里去。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, so, about Tisiphone, is... uh... everything all right with her? Talk of murder, all the time, and all.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Tisiphone is charged with punishing the worst that mortals have to offer. More than charged. Her work is everything to her.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No time for family or recreation, then, I take it? Pity what happens to those overly obsessed with work.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I get what you're insinuating, Zagreus. I'm nothing like her. Not even close. And don't you dare compare the two of us again.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，那么，关于提西福涅，她……呃……她没什么问题吧？她一直在说杀手杀手的，她没事吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 提西福涅负责惩罚人类能犯下的最恶劣的罪行。兢兢业业。她的工作就是她的全部。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没有家庭，没有娱乐，这样吗？工作狂真的很值得同情啊。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我知道你想表达什么，扎格列欧斯。我跟她不一样。没有一点像她。你也不准再拿我跟她对比。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: So you've been trying to give Tisiphone speech lessons between fights to the death. Are you bored, or just naive?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Come on, if her vocabulary consists of two different although admittedly almost identical words, there's got to be room for growth, there. Besides, I feel like... maybe she's lonely, or something. Has anyone ever tried to teach her anything?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Maybe, just maybe, you're projecting your own insecurities onto her a little bit? Tis can take care of herself. Always has. Talking's not her strong suit like it's yours. But if you, in all your wisdom, think you've got something to teach her, you go right ahead.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You've tried already, haven't you? She's pretty dead-set on the murder thing, then?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 所以你打算趁厮杀的间隙，教提西福涅说话。你是闲得无聊吗？还是太天真了？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 拜托，如果她会说的词语里包括两个虽然听起来几乎相同，但其实不一样的词语，那她肯定还可以继续进步。另外我感觉……她会不会是太孤独了之类的。有人试着教过她什么东西吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 或许吧，仅仅是或许而已。你是不是把你自己的不安投射到她的身上了？提西一直都能照顾好自己。说话是你的强项，而不是她的强项。不过如果以你的智慧，你觉得可以教会她什么东西的话，那你尽管去教吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你已经试过了，是吗？她就是一根筋地对谋杀什么的感兴趣，是吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You and Thanatos don't work together much anymore, do you, Meg?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: No. Though he still brings me my assignments every now and then.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oathbreakers, traitors, and the like? Sending them straight to Tartarus, huh. Must be quite an experience going from living and breathing, to... being dead, to being whisked off by Thanatos, straight to you and your whip.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: If that's not the experience mortals are looking for, they need only keep their oaths and not betray the ones they're closest to. It's not that hard.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你和塔纳托斯已经不再共事了，是吗，墨纪？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 不了，不过他还是会时不时地让我去帮忙做些事情。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 背信弃义之人，叛徒之类的，是吗？把他们直接送到塔耳塔罗斯，哈。我猜这些人从活蹦乱跳到……一命呜呼，到被塔纳托斯带走，再到送到你这里挨鞭子，这肯定是相当曲折的经历吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 如果凡人们不想要这种体验的话，他们只要恪守誓言，不要背叛他们最亲近的人就好了。其实也没那么难。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're not too broken up about how things ended between you and Hypnos, are you, Meg?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I'm still in a state of shock. I'll have to pick up the pieces somehow, and figure out how to get on with my existence.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你和修普诺斯之间的结果不太好，你并不太觉得难过，是吗，墨纪？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我依然没能从震惊之中恢复。我不得不想办法强打起精神，想想自己今后该怎么活下去才是。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You got that court musician to pipe up again. I know you can't shut up, but didn't know it was contagious.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, it was all Orpheus, not me. Can't sing like that without a lot of motivation, inner turmoil, who knows what else. Why, don't you like it? This lounge seems better with a little song.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: This lounge is fine. And the singing... not used to it yet.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你让那个乐师再次唱起了歌。我早就知道你是个不肯闭嘴的家伙，可我没想到这居然还能传染。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，这都归功于俄耳甫斯，和我无关。如果没有内在的动力、充足的情感，或是别的什么东西的话，是没办法唱出那样的歌的。怎么，你不喜欢吗？我觉得休息室里有歌声会更好一些。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 休息室倒是蛮好的，至于歌声……我还没习惯。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Not seen the court musician sulking over there quite as much lately. Your doing, I hear?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You'll just have to sulk for the both of you, I guess, then, Meg. But if you must know, on my authority I have released Orpheus from the terms of his old, rather unfair agreement with Father, so he can see his wife at least from time to time.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: And Lord Hades is OK with you just picking out old binding contracts and nullifying them? You're exploiting your status.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm doing no such thing. Father wanted me involved in all this business with his pacts, and presiding over the dead, then fine. But I'll do it my way.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 最近我没怎么再见过那个乐师生闷气了，我猜这是你干的好事吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜，以后你们两个人的闷气，只能由你一个人生了，墨纪。不过如果你真的想知道原委的话，其实是我授权解除了俄耳甫斯与父亲之间相当不公平的古老条款。这样一来，他至少可以时不时地和他的妻子见面了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 而冥王哈迪斯就放任你去废除他那些古老的契约，对此听之任之？你可真是在作死啊。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我这不是作死。父亲希望我能参与契约相关的工作，负责管理那些死人的事情。这没问题，不过我会按照我自己的方式去做。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What do you think of all the lounge decor, there, Meg? Looking a little better these days, wouldn't you say?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You know, it isn't bad. Though I have heard the strangest thing, that you're responsible, for all of this? I couldn't understand why you would even bother, honestly.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, it's a popular locale for off-duty Underworld officers to take a load off between shifts, and so I figure... least I can do is pitch in and make the place a little better than I left it, right?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: How very selfless of you, Zagreus. Soon doubtless it'll be your portrait hanging on that wall back there.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你对于休息室的装饰有什么看法吗，墨纪？看起来是比以前好一些，不是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 确实不错。不过我听说了一件特别奇怪的事情，说这些都是你负责的，是吗？说真的，我想不通你为什么要弄得这么麻烦。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 其实，冥界的差役们不当差时都喜欢来这里，在换班的空档稍微放松一下压力，所以，我觉得……至少我可以做点贡献，在我离开之后让这个地方变得更好，不是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你可真是大公无私啊，扎格列欧斯。不久后，你的肖像就会挂在休息室的墙上了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: The prism-sphere in the corner is maybe a little much. But the fireplace... the bat-cage... the aquarium... this lounge is practically comfortable. Lord Hades would strongly disapprove.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Good thing he never sets foot in here, then, huh? Wait, you don't miss when things were all sad and dreary in here, do you?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I'm still getting used to it. But, no.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 角落里的反光球可能有点太显眼了，不过壁炉……蝙蝠笼……水族馆……都很好。这个休息室相当舒适，冥王哈迪斯会强烈反对这样的情形。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 幸好他从来没来过这个地方，是吧？等等，你可不怀念这里凄风苦雨的日子，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我还在适应这里的氛围，不过，我不怀念。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: How's my little Battie doing, Zag? The one I gave you. Was just a little pup. I figured she'd be better off with you. Please tell me I was right.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Battie's doing great, Meg. Reminds me of you every time I think of her. Helps keep me company throughout my little jaunts outside. So you've a thing for bats, then?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: That's good. And yes, the bats around here, they and I have always shared an understanding, you could say. I usually care for the pups myself. But Battie? She seemed more your style.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我的小巴蒂怎么样了，扎格？就是我给你的那个。给你的时候才那么点儿大。我想，和你在一起，她应该过得很好吧。请告诉我，我没猜错。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 巴蒂很好，墨纪。每次想到她，我就会回忆起你的点点滴滴。这会让我的旅途不再那么孤单。所以，现在你开始喜欢蝙蝠了？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 真好。对啊，可以这么说，这里的蝙蝠，它们和我总是能够心有灵犀。我经常会亲自照顾它们的幼崽。但巴蒂呢？她似乎更像你一些。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Meg, what's going on with Nyx and Dusa, do you know? I think they've been butting heads a bit lately.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I can't imagine why. Nyx has her under strict orders, yet you keep on stopping by for your little chats. You think she doesn't notice?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What does she care? I talk to everybody around here at least a bit.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: It's not my business, Zag. Not even for Dusa. But you watch yourself.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 墨纪，倪克斯和杜莎发生什么事情了，你知道吗？我觉得她们两个最近发生了一些小冲突。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我想象不出来是怎么回事。倪克斯制定了严格的规矩，可你总是停下来找杜莎聊天，你以为倪克斯没注意到吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 可这关她什么事情？这里的所有人，我多多少少都聊过了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 这不关我的事情，扎格，也不关杜莎的事情。不过你得注意言行。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Damn you, Zagreus. She was my friend. And now she's gone.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Who, you mean Dusa? Like I had anything to do with that. It's Nyx you should be cross with, not me!

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I don't think so. Nyx warned you. Ungh, you know I can't go to her myself about this, so fix it!

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 都怪你，扎格列欧斯。她是我的朋友，如今她不在了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 谁？你说杜莎吗？这件事跟我哪有关系啊。你该找的人是倪克斯，不是我！

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我可不这么想，倪克斯警告过你。呃啊，你知道我不能和她说这件事情，所以得你来解决问题！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You saw Dusa's back, right, Meg? She's getting another chance. Nyx reconsidered!

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I saw. Nyx doesn't often change her mind when it comes to this House. But I won't second guess what happened or why.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You don't sound all that pleased...

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你看到杜莎回来了，是吧，墨纪？倪克斯重新考虑过了！又给了她一次机会！

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我看到了。只要是涉及到这座圣殿的事情，倪克斯很少会改变心意，不过我可不想去猜发生了什么事情。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你的语气听起来可没那么开心啊……

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm so proud of Dusa lately, Meg! Chief Custodian of the House, was it? That's quite an honor coming from Nyx.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I thought all the added responsibility would stress Dusa out worse than usual. But she's taking it in stride.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're always looking out for her. Thanks for that.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Not doing it for you. Though... thanks for looking out for her, yourself.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 最近我真的为杜莎感到骄傲，墨纪！她成了这座圣殿的首席管家，不是吗？能从倪克斯那里获得这种殊荣，可真了不起。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我还以为这些新的责任会把杜莎压垮呢，不过她做得非常好。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你总是很照顾她，谢谢你。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我可不是为了你才照顾她的。不过……谢谢你这么照顾她。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I did not appreciate you sending Dusa after me out there, Zag. You leave her out of this! Though... it was good to see her out of this damned House for a change.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: See, I, too, thought she could use the fresh air. Or... however you'd describe the quality of the air on the edge of Tartarus. You know she'd never mean you any harm, right? In her mind... I think she's trying to keep it friendly between us.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Eugh, she said the same thing to me. Look, you know what, fine. If that's the only way to get her to take a break from this place, I guess it's for the best.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我可不喜欢你派杜莎来对付我，扎格，你不准把她卷到这件事里！不过……能看到她离开那座该死的圣殿，转换转换心情，我还是挺高兴的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我也是，我觉得她应该出来呼吸呼吸新鲜空气，或者说……随便你怎么形容塔耳塔罗斯的空气质量吧。她根本没打算伤害你，你是明白的吧？在她心里……我觉得她只希望咱们能好好相处。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 呃，她也是这么跟我说的。行吧，那就这样吧。如果只有这样才能让她稍微休息一下的话，那我觉得这样倒也不错。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Meg, I understand you're under orders to kill me on sight out there, but... do you really have to go so hard on Sisyphus?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: That wretched shade isn't who you think he is. Do you have any idea of the magnitude of his crimes from when he led a mortal life?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: He cheated death. Tricked Thanatos and maybe Father, too.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Before that, he did worse. He was an awful man. I think that is the real reason that your father punished him.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What if he's changed? Or... is that impossible. No coming back from certain crimes.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: No coming back from certain crimes, indeed. Though you may have more mercy in your heart to spare than I in mine.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，墨纪，你收到的命令就是对我杀无赦，但是…你不用对西西弗斯也这样狠吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 那个可怜的暗灵不是你所想的那样。你知道他生前犯了多大的罪行吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 他避免了死亡。戏耍了塔纳托斯，也许还有父亲。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 在那之前，还有更恶劣的。他人品极差。我认为那才是你父亲惩罚他的原因。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果他改变了呢？噢…这有可能吗。本性难移。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 本性难移，是的。看来你心中的仁慈比我要多得多。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I have to ask you for a favor, Meg. And I'm willing to make it worth your while, if you'll hear me out.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: A proposition, Zagreus? Let's hear it, then. While I'm in a charitable mood.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's about Sisyphus. If I can get my father to alleviate his sentence, would you just... ease off of him, a little bit? You and your sisters. I think he's suffered quite enough under your whips.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I don't know what you see in him, I swear. But you don't need to ask such things of me. If you can overturn his sentence with Lord Hades, I'd like nothing better than to never see that miserable shade again.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我得请你帮个忙，墨纪。好好听我说，我保证你的时间不会白花。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 这算是一个提议吗，扎格列欧斯？那我倒要听听看。我现在想做点善事。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 就是那个西西弗斯。如果我让我的父亲为他减刑，你们能不能不要对他……这么苛刻？你和你的姐妹们。你的鞭子已经让他吃够苦头了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我真不知道你看上他哪一点。但你不用为这种事情求我。就算你能推翻冥王哈迪斯对他的判决，我也巴不得永远别再看到那个可怜的暗灵。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Megaera, I have to ask you something, please. We really need to talk.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...For once, I think you're right. Although, I'm curious, what is it that you think we have to talk about?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I still have feelings for you. At least... I think I do. Isn't there... isn't there someway for us to, you know... work through all of this?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: In spite of everything that's happened, and that's happening right now? What are the outcomes, Zagreus? Either you eventually succeed, and leave this place, or else, what, exactly?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...I haven't thought that far ahead. But I don't think it has to be this way. I don't hate you, Meg. I don't think I can ever hate you.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...Despite my best intentions. Unfortunately, I don't know that I can say the same. Look, I'm at a very difficult point in my career. I need to focus on that now. Do we understand each other?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 墨纪拉，我想问你一件事，可以吗？我们确实得谈谈。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……首先，我觉得你是对的。不过，我有点好奇，你觉得我们需要谈什么事？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我对你还有感情。至少……我这么觉得。难道……难道就没有其他办法，让我们一起……处理好这些事情吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你就不管过去，不管现在吗？这会有什么样的结果，扎格列欧斯？也许你可以成功逃离这个地方，但要是你失败了呢，你想过后果吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: ……我还没想到那么多。但我觉得这也不是唯一的结局吧。我不恨你，墨纪。对你，我怎么也恨不起来。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……除了对你的最美好的祝愿。抱歉，我没办法和你说同样的话。你看，我现在正处在职业生涯的艰难转折点。我现在需要把心思放在工作上。明白了吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Megaera, I have to ask you something, please. We really need to talk.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...For once, I think you're right. Although, I'm curious, what is it that you think we have to talk about?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I still have feelings for you. At least... I think I do. Isn't there... isn't there someway for us to, you know... work through all of this?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: In spite of everything that's happened, and that's happening right now? What are the outcomes, Zagreus? What, exactly?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...I haven't thought that far ahead. But I don't think it has to be this way. I don't hate you, Meg. I don't think I can ever hate you.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...Despite my best intentions. Unfortunately, I don't know that I can say the same. Look, I'm at a very difficult point in my career. I need to focus on that now. Do we understand each other?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 墨纪拉，我想问你一件事，可以吗？我们确实得谈谈。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……首先，我觉得你是对的。不过，我有点好奇，你觉得我们需要谈什么事？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我对你还有感情。至少……我这么觉得。难道……难道就没有其他办法，让我们一起……处理好这些事情吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你就不管过去，不管现在吗？你知道后果吗，扎格列欧斯？你知道具体后果会是什么吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: ……我还没想到那么多。但我觉得这也不是唯一的结局吧。我不恨你，墨纪。对你，我怎么也恨不起来。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……除了对你的最美好的祝愿。抱歉，我没办法和你说同样的话。你看，我现在正处在职业生涯的艰难转折点。我现在需要把心思放在工作上。明白了吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Meg, you know what's going on with Than and me, don't you? I just... want things to be out in the open, between us.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Oh I know everything about you, Zag. And Thanatos, maybe even better. Though I appreciate you telling me. It's fine.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's fine? I mean... upon Olympus, jealousy runs rampant, as I'm told. But here it's not even an issue, then?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: If you prefer the way they do things on Olympus, then I think you know the way. As for me... dealing with jealousy is what I do. Tell me, should I feel threatened by Thanatos?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No... he thinks so highly of you, he... he'd never wish to cause you any harm.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: And I feel much the same. He and I, we're not the same to you. I think we both see that, and understand. Now quit your second-guessing me, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 墨纪，你知道我和塔纳之间的事情吗？我只是…不希望对我们两人之间的关系遮遮掩掩。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 哦，我是知道你的，扎格。对于塔纳托斯，我可能了解的更多。不过，我还是要感谢你告诉我。没关系。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没关系吗？我听说……在奥林匹斯山上，嫉妒之风盛行。但这件事就完全没关系吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 如果你喜欢奥林匹斯山上的做事方式，那我相信你知道要怎么做。至于我……我的工作就是消灭嫉妒。告诉我，我应该感觉受到塔纳托斯的威胁吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不应该……他对你的评价很高，他……他从来没想过要伤害你。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我也是这样。他和我，我们对你来说完全不一样。我知道我们俩其实都清楚得很。现在别再胡乱揣测我的想法了，可以吗？

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: ...Make certain of it, Megaera. I am finding, lately, that the help within this House is much more lacking than it used to be. I trust that you shall set it back on course.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...If that is your will, Lord Hades, then it will be done. To the fullest limits of my capability.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: …把话说清楚，墨纪拉。我最近发现，在这圣殿里的协助已大不如从前了。我相信你们可以让它回到正轨上来。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: …如果这就是您想要的，哈迪斯大人，事情会如您所愿的。我会竭尽全力。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...Give me another chance, Lord Hades. I can do better. Don't... bring them here.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: It is already too late for that, Megaera. They have been notified and are en route to Tartarus even as we speak.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You know what they're like. They are best left to their specific tasks. Not this.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Megaera, trust me when I say I know the feeling all too well. However, surely, in your ingenuity, you may yet find a way to get your sisters to see eye to eye.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: …请再给我一次机会，哈迪斯大人。我会做得更好。不要…把她们牵扯进来。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 已经太迟了，墨纪拉。在我们谈话期间，她们已经受命前往塔耳塔罗斯了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 您知道她们是什么样的人。她们是处理这种事情的专家。不是这样。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 墨纪拉，相信我，我太了解这种感觉了。不过，可以肯定，以你的聪慧，应该可以让你的姐妹达成共识。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...I cannot work with them, Lord Hades. Please. They don't respect my words, or even listen.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Enough! Besides, Megaera, this is not your failing. It is mine. I must attend to these affairs more actively.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...I've often tried, but never to a satisfactory result. You're asking the impossible of me.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: I am not asking, Megaera.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: …我没法跟她们一起工作，哈迪斯大人。求你了。她们根本听不进我说的话。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 够了！另外，墨纪拉，这次失败不是你的错。是我的错。我必须更积极地处理这些事。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: …我试过很多次，都没有得到满意的结果。您在让我做不可能的事。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 我没有在求你，墨纪拉。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...But, I don't understand, Lord Hades. I have fallen to him countless times. How can this be...?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You and your sisters have protected Tartarus unerringly. The Prince has proven uncontainable. The fault is mine, not yours. Your duty to this realm must be commended.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You honor me... I have done nothing to deserve this. There must be something more that I can do?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: There is, and isn't, Megaera. I ask only that you remain committed to this realm. Bar passage in and out of Tartarus. And, if the Prince continues to show up... you give him hell.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Lord Hades, it will be my pleasure, sir.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……可我不明白，冥王哈迪斯。我已经死在他手上无数次了，这怎么可能……？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你和你的姐妹们兢兢业业地守护着塔耳塔罗斯。事实证明，没人能管得住王子，这是我的错，不是你们的错。你在这方面做出了很多贡献，理当得到嘉奖。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我受宠若惊……我做的都是不足挂齿的小事，不值得如此嘉奖。应该还有别的事情我能胜任吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 是，但又不是，墨纪拉。我只要求你继续认真负责手上的工作，禁止任何人进入或离开塔耳塔罗斯。另外，如果王子再露面的话……你要好好给他点颜色看看。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 这是我的荣幸，冥王哈迪斯大人。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: ...We each have our commitments to this House, Megaera. There is no shame in yours. And whilst your sisters are away, you bear their burden of responsibility, as well.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I understand, it's just... am I supposed to keep pretending nothing's changed? This House is cracking at the seams, and no one's going to admit it?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: The House shall stand eternally, although in what condition, it is ours to decide. Our obligation is to keep the House in order.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I know. You're right of course, you're right... I'll do my best. I'll do my best for both our sakes, Nyx.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: ……我们每个人都要对这圣殿负责，墨纪拉。不用自责。既然你的姐妹不在，你就要承担起她们的责任。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我明白，只是…我该继续装作事情一点都没有变化吗？圣殿的裂隙越来越大，可大家都装作不知道。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 圣殿会永远屹立，不管出现什么状况，这都取决于我们。我们的义务就是让圣殿里得的一切井井有条。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我知道。你说的没错，没错…我会尽我所能。我会为了我们两个，尽我所能，倪克斯。

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: ...and so, who else is there to be depended on...? You are a trusted overseer, Megaera. Your station is no accident and there is no one better fit for what you do. I urge you to look inwardly. How you approach your work is vital to the end result.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...Thank you for the advice, Nyx. I don't know what I'd do without you. Or what this House would be if not for you.

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: ……还有谁可以依靠……？你就是最佳人选，墨纪拉。没人可以取代你的位置。我希望你可以好好感受自己的内心。做好自己的工作对最后的结果非常重要。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: …感谢您提供的建议，倪克斯。我不知道没了您，我该怎么办。没了您，这圣殿该怎么办。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...But, how can you do this to me? Blast your Mirror. By taking sides with him, you're standing against me...!

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Neutrality ceases to be an option when a crisis rises to a certain point, Megaera. You, yourself, shall have to choose allegiances. I have steadfastly told you this throughout our shared ordeal.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I thought that both of our allegiances were to this House, Nyx. It seems I was mistaken. Do you have any idea what sort of pressure I am under here...?

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Use caution with the tone you take with me, Overseer. I am the mother of the Fates, themselves. I do not act by whim or by mistake. Mind your own station, and perform your role. All shall unfold eventually as it must. I like the intervening time no more than you.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……但是，您怎么可以这样对我？我不喜欢你那面圣镜。让圣境为他所用，那就是在和我作对啊……！

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 当危机严重到一定程度的时候，就不能再保持中立了，墨纪拉。你要选择到底站在哪边。在我们共同经历这些事情的时候，我一直在告诉你这一点。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我还以为我们都是站在圣殿这一边的，倪克斯。看来是我错了。您能想象我现在的压力有多大吗……？

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 跟我说话时的语气要谨慎一点，小监工。我是命运女神的母亲。我不会轻举妄动，但我的眼里也不揉沙子。做好你自己的工作，扮演好自己的角色。一切皆有定数。和你一样，我也不喜欢这中间的时间。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...Nyx, you'd tell me if I made a terrible mistake, or even just a bad one, wouldn't you? I need your guidance on this one, or maybe your approval.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: You shall always be the best determiner of what is right about such matters, Megaera. Though, if you seek my blessings or encouragement in this particular pursuit, please rest assured... you have them both. You know the way, from here.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I hope that you are right. You always have been, it's just that... I wish I had your confidence in this.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……倪克斯，如果我犯了错误，哪怕是一点小错，您都会告诉我的，对吧？这项任务，我需要您的指引，或者您的认可。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 在这些事情上，你永远都是最佳的决策者，墨纪拉。不过，如果你在当下寻求我的恩赐或鼓励，请放心……我都会给你的。你知道该怎么走。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我希望您是对的。您一直都是对的……我只是希望能在这项任务中得到您的信任。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...I think I understand, now, Nyx. You've been here longer than the rest of us combined. You've seen this House go through a lot. Even before Lord Hades took his place. I never should have doubted you.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: To doubt is an important instinct, Megaera. Without it, we could not conceive of better circumstances than the ones we know. Besides... I am the Night. Others shall always doubt me. You may doubt me again. I ask only that you heed well your intuitions, from now on.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I will. I promise, Nyx. And if there's anything you ever need that I can do, well... please, just ask of me.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……我想我现在明白了，倪克斯。你驻守在这里的时间比我们其他所有人的总和还要长，包括哈迪斯大人掌管这里之前的时光。你见证了这座宫殿经历的太多太多。我永远不该怀疑你。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 怀疑是种重要的本能，墨纪拉。没有它，我们永远无法设想出比我们所知的更好结果。此外……我是黑夜的化身，其他人总是会怀疑我，你也可能还会怀疑我。从现在开始，我只要求你好好听从自己的直觉。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我会的，我保证，倪克斯。而且，如果有什么我能为你做的，如果你需要……请你一定告诉我。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...They can't be reasoned with, Nyx. You know that. What use are they to us, trying to manage this? They'll make things worse.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: They are your sisters. They are part of your life, whether you like it or not. Your relationship with them is yours to mold.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I'm afraid there isn't much for me to work with. You have a lot more faith in them than I do.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I have a lot more faith in you, Megaera. There are many obstinate personalities with whom we regularly interact. Thus, we do what is possible.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……他们真的不可理喻，倪克斯。你知道的。即使做了这些，他们对我们有什么用？他们只会让事情变得更糟。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 无论你喜不喜欢，她们都是你的姐妹，是你生命中的一部分。至于你们之前的关系，要靠你来塑造。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 恐怕没什么我能做的，我对他们远没有像你那样的信心。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我对你的信心更是要多得多，墨纪拉。我们时常要与很多顽固的人打交道。因此，只要是有可能的事情，我们就要去做。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...Would you look at that, Hypnos. Care to repeat to me the unsolicited advice you just now offered, now that Zagreus is here?

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, hahaha, well, it is my custom to give pointers to our visitors, who come involuntarily, because, I do pick up a lot of bits and pieces, talking here to everyone! About, you know... dying?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Zagreus. He told me that I ought to evade more of your attacks next time. So you just watch your back out there, because I know your secrets thanks to Hypnos here.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: …你看，修普诺斯。既然扎格列欧斯来了，你就重复一下你刚才提出的建议吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 噢哈哈哈，嗯，我的工作就是给那些非自愿的来客一些提示，因为我确实有些零零散散的东西，要给这里的各位说一说！给各位，说一说…死亡？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯。他告诉过我，让我下次要更多次地躲避你的攻击。所以你下次最好注意点了，多亏了修普诺斯，我现在知道你的秘密了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...I think that I can find the lounge well on my own, Hypnos. Or... wait... what is this, did you just ask me out?

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Me? No, nonononono, no! I'd never even think to do that, Miss, I mean, you have your station, and I have mine. We're from two different worlds, you could say. Fated never to be seen together much.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Every time I talk to you, you somehow take it as a compliment, is that correct? Then, let me give you some advice, for once. Stop being an idiot.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: …我想我能自己找到休息室，修普诺斯。不然…等会，什么意思？你刚刚要约我出去吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 我？不，没有没有没有，没有！我连想都不敢想呢，小姐，我是说，我们两个身份不太相称。可以说，我们是来自两个不同的世界。命中注定无法长久。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 每次我跟你说话，你都以为我是在恭维你，我说的对吗？那好吧，我来给你提点建议，仅此一次。别再当傻瓜了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...You haven't greeted me as often lately, Hypnos. I wouldn't have noticed if it weren't half your job. If there's something you wish to say to me, why not just come right out.

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, um, well, I, see, the thing is, Megaera, Miss Megaera, mind if I call you that? As I was saying, I just, thought maybe, you know, we had a thing, a real connection, lately, since you keep on dying more and more, and I keep standing here? But then... I always thought you were invincible...

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I see. And so you're realizing now that your entire image of me came from your imagination, is that it?

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Well, it's just! I really thought with all my advice that you'd go back to killing Zagreus, rather than the other way around! I just don't think things are working out the way I hoped, you know?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: It almost sounds as though you've broken up with me, except... well, are you sure that you'll be all right?

en.speaker: Hypnos
en.text: Oh, yeah! Look, I'm just glad it's one of you two, sure beats having to greet shades nonstop! They never talk to me.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: All right, then... you greet me next I'm here.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……你最近都不怎么跟我打招呼了，修普诺斯。要不是因为这也是你工作的一部分，我可能都不会注意到。如果你有什么话要说的话，不如直接说出来吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，呃，我知道了。墨纪拉，墨纪拉小姐，你不介意我这么称呼你吧？我只是觉得，就，最近我们之间产生了某种……纽带，因为你死得越发频繁，而我总是站在那里，是吧？不过…我以前还以为你所向无敌呢…

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我明白了，而你现在意识到，你对我所有的认识都源于你的空想，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 啊呀，确实如此！我当时真的以为，我给你的那些建议能帮助你杀了扎格列欧斯，而不是被他杀了！我猜，事情并没有像我希望得那样发展，你明白的吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 听起来感觉你要跟我绝交了，除非……好吧，你真的确定你会振作起来吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 修普诺斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，没问题！你看，我很高兴能和你们两个聊聊，这比没完没了地接待死人要好多了！他们从来都不和我说话。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 好吧，那……下次我来的时候，你得和我打招呼啊。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...It was my duty to prevent him from getting farther. If I succeeded... he never would have found you. So this once, I'm glad I failed. I hope you know that, my Queen.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I hoped, but did not know for certain till I heard from you just now, Overseer Megaera! And, if I may? I understand you have achieved an awful lot since I took my, erm, leave of absence from this House. I see why Nyx and Hades put their trust in you!

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Thank you, my Queen. Then, if there's anything else that I can do to help you reacclimate yourself, I'm always at your service. You are most welcome, here.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Likewise, you be sure to let me know if my son there happens to make more trouble for you than you welcome in your life. All right?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……我的职责就是阻止他逃出去，如果我那时成功的话……他恐怕永远都见不到您了。所以只有这一次，我很庆幸我失职了。希望您能明白，冥后殿下。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我想过，但那时我并不确定，直到你刚刚告诉我，墨纪拉主管！可以这么称呼你吗？我明白，自从我，呃，离开了这座圣殿之后，你就做了相当多的工作。我能看得出来倪克斯和哈迪斯为什么这么信任你！

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 谢谢您，冥后殿下。如果有什么别的事情可以帮助您适应这里的话，请尽管开口，我随时愿意为您效劳。这里的一切都诚挚地欢迎您。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 你也一样，如果我儿子惹出来的麻烦已经超出了你能忍受的程度，你一定得告诉我，好吗？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Can't you see I'm busy now with more important things than you?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 没看见我现在忙着比你还重要的事吗？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: May I help you somehow, Zagreus? Because if not, why don't you leave me be.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我能帮你什么忙吗，扎格列欧斯？如果没有，那你为什么不快点走开。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: May I help you somehow, Zagreus, because if not, why don't you leave me be?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我能帮你什么忙吗，扎格列欧斯？如果没有，那你为什么不快点走开。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Do I look like I'm in the mood to chat?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我看上去像是要聊天的样子吗？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Do I look like I'm in the mood to chat?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我看上去像是要聊天的样子吗？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You've come to gloat, I guess? Too bad I can't just kill you where you stand, within this blasted House.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你是在幸灾乐祸吧？真可惜我在圣殿里不能亲手把你给杀了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Have I somehow created the impression that I wish to speak with you? Because if so, there's been a terrible mistake.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你什么时候产生了我想跟你说话的错觉？如果是这样，那你真的就错了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: There must be someone else whose time you could be wasting, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 这里一定有其他人的时间可以让你浪费，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: It's embarrassing enough having returned here, much less to be seen talking to you.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我回到这里已经够尴尬了，更不想让人看到我在跟你说话。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Sooner or later when we meet out there again, I'll kill you, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 总有一天我要在外头把你给杀了，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: If I have something I decide I wish to tell you, Zagreus, I'll make it clear. Leave me alone.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 如果我有什么想跟你说的，扎格列欧斯，我会说的。别烦我。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Your father's absolutely right about you, Zag. You are and always will be an insufferable brat.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你父亲对你的看法真没错，扎格。你就是一个真正的烦人的混蛋。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Don't test me any further, Zagreus. You know the rules, no violence in the House.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 别再试探我了，扎格列欧斯。你知道规矩，不能在圣殿里使用暴力。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Blood and darkness, leave me be, damn you. I've better things to do than occupy your time.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 血与黑暗啊，别烦我，滚啊。除了占用你的时间，我还有其他事情可做。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I have to hand it to you, Zag. You've gotten strong. Sending me all the way back here like this.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我不得不佩服你，扎格。你变强了。能把我送回来。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Nyx must be worried, seeing us like this. Lately always at each other's throats.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯看到我们这样一定会担心的。一天到晚吵个不停。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Oh don't worry, I'll be back in fighting shape in no time, Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 别担心，扎格，我很快就能恢复到战斗状态。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Your father's not been very pleased with my performance lately as you might have guessed.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你应该猜到了，你父亲对我最近的表现不是很满意。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Sometimes, Zagreus, I'm almost not detested by the sight and smell of you.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 有时候，扎格列欧斯，我也不是那么讨厌你的样子和气味。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I shouldn't be back here right now. No thanks to you, of course.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我竟然回来这里了。真是谢谢你了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I'm keeping careful track of all the times you've sent me home like this.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你就这样把我送回来，我都好好记着呢。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: At least the House seems well enough in order since I saw it last.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 起码圣殿看上去还是好好的。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: We keep on running into one another lately, don't we Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 最近我们总是会碰面啊，扎格。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You got me fair and square last time. Though I'm a little bitter anyway.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 上次你光明正大的把我给打败了。但我还是有点不爽。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You know we can't be seen together like this, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我们这样在一块儿被人看到不太好，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I should be whipping Sisyphus' lazy hide right now instead of standing here.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我应该拿鞭子抽西西弗斯而不是在这里站着。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Don't like having to come back here quite this often, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你没必要这么频繁地过来，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I'm not even remotely interested in chatting with you, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我一点都不想和你聊天，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Why don't you go get out of here if you despise this place so much?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 如果你不喜欢这里，为什么还要待在这里？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Don't you so much as dare talk to me.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你竟然还敢来和我说话。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Get out of my sight, Zagreus. And be thankful violence is prohibited in here.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 快从我的视线里消失，扎格列欧斯。这里不允许使用暴力，你应该为此感到庆幸。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Right now I wouldn't talk to me if I were you.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 如果我是你，我肯定不会在这时候来找我说话。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I think you'd best be on your way right now, you understand me, Zagreus?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我觉得你现在最好赶紧走，你听到了吗，扎格列欧斯？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I think you've wasted quite enough of both our time, don't you?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你不觉得你已经浪费我们彼此太多时间了吗？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Whatever's on your mind, believe me, it's the last thing that I want to hear right now.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 不管你心里在想什么，相信我，我现在绝对不想听你说出来。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I can't believe you got me like that, Zag. I'm going to get you back.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我无法相信你会这样对我，扎格。我会让你付出代价。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Just here licking my wounds until we meet again out there.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 现在在疗伤，你给我等着。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Heard you made it pretty far last time.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 听说你上一次走很远。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You almost got there last time, didn't you.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你上一次几乎快逃出去了，对吗？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Heard you made it all the way last time.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 听说你上一次一路杀了出去。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You're back. Got all the way to the surface back there, huh?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你回来了。一路杀到地面，是吗？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Keep letting down my guard against you, Zag.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你总是让我放松警惕，扎格。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Went all the way to the top last time, huh? Not bad at all.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你上次一路杀出去了，是吗？还不错嘛。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Ugh, I don't remember the last time I beat you, Zag...

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 呃，我都记不得上一次打败你是什么时候了，扎格……
