en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Break's just about over. See you out there?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 休息时间马上结束了，我们外面见吧？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Hypnos give you any good pointers lately?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 修普诺斯最近给没给你什么好建议？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Taking a break from putting up with Alecto out there...

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 休息一下吧，不用再忍受阿勒克图了……

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Got to say, I like what you and Dusa did with this place.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我得告诉你，我很喜欢你和杜莎为这里做的一切。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Didn't rough you up too bad last time, did I?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我上次应该没把你打得太惨吧？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You showed Alecto again. She must be so mad.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你又让阿勒克图尝到了教训，她肯定要气疯了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: About ready to go another round with me out there?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 准备好和我再比试一场了吗？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I have to speak with you in private, Zagreus. Urgently.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: It's fortunate that matter is resolved. I'll see you out there, then.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我必须和你私下谈谈，扎格列欧斯。马上。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 太好了，问题终于解决了。那我们回头再见。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Let's go someplace a little quieter than this. Where we can concentrate.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: A little peace and quiet's good from time to time, don't you agree?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我们去一个更安静的地方吧。一个可以让人全情投入的地方。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 偶尔享受片刻安静和祥和其实也不错，不是吗？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Don't even say a word, and follow me.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Well, Zagreus? Take care until we meet again, I guess.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 别说话，只管跟我走。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 嗯，扎格列欧斯？保重，我相信我们会再见面的。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Zagreus, did you forget about our private tutoring, again? Come on.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: There. I take it you'll remember what I've taught you, hm?

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，你是不是又忘了我私底下教过你？拜托。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 好了。我就当做你还记得我教过你什么吧。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Come with me, Zagreus. Your chambers are past due for a routine inspection.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Well! Seems everything's in order. Carry on.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 跟我来，扎格列欧斯。你的密室好久没有打扫了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 好吧！一切看起来还是那么井井有条。继续。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: If you're available right now, I have some parchmentwork that needs review.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Hmm. Less parchmentwork than I expected. Well, thank you for your time.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 如果你现在有空，我这边有些文件需要审阅。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 嗯。文件比我预料得少。好吧，感谢你愿意花这个时间。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, uh, Meg? Look, I know you're just doing your job out there, and, anyway, found this, thought of you and all that, so... here.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I... I'll see to it this contraband is put away at once. Now, take your finder's fee and go about your business.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨，呃，墨纪？我知道，你在外头只是做自己的工作而已，我找到了这个，觉得你会喜欢的，所以……给你了。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我…我立刻就把这违禁品给带走。好了，现在该干嘛干嘛去吧。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, Meg! I, uh, thought I'd better hand this over.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I'll confiscate that if you really want. Although, I'm warning you, I'm not susceptible to bribes. Many have tried.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey I'm just handing over contraband to the appropriate authorities, think nothing of it, Meg. Just doing our jobs, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，墨纪！我，呃，我觉得最好把它上交给你。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 如果你真有此意，我可以没收。不过我警告你噢，我是不接受贿赂的。很多人都试过。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨，我又来上交违禁品啦，别多想，墨纪。工作而已啦，对吧？

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Tsch. You're serious. You're really giving that to me. I mean, I'll take it off your hands if that is really what you want.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's really what I want. And, I sincerely hope we can move past our differences. Not that turning in this contraband has anything to do with that.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 哧。你认真的。你真的要把这个给我。我是说，如果你是这样想的，那我就拿走了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我真的是这样想的。并且，我真心希望我们能够解决彼此的分歧。不过这违禁品跟这个没有一点关系的。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Such gifts won't stay my whip when next we meet out there, you realize that, right?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I realize it. And I hope you never change, Meg.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 这种礼物在我们下次见面的时候可不会管用，你明白吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我明白。希望你不要改变自己，墨纪。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Flattery won't get you anywhere. We can't go back to how things used to be.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Flattery never got me anywhere with you to begin with, Meg. Doesn't mean I won't keep trying. I am ever stubborn, aren't I.

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 阿谀奉承是没有用的。我们已经没法再回到过去了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我的阿谀奉承虽然现在对你没有用，墨纪。但我不会放弃的。我就是这么固执。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Got you some more of that contraband you like. Don't suppose I could help you put it away or anything...?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Look at me, Zag.... You think that all these gifts will make things go back to the way they were? They won't. It isn't possible. We may be immortals but we're older now.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'd hope we're wiser, too.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我又带来了你喜欢的违禁品。我想我可以帮你把它给收起来…

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 看着我，扎格……你觉得这些礼物能让事情变回原来的样子吗？不会的，不可能。我们也许永生不老，但我们都不是小孩子了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 要是我们也能变得更有智慧就好了。

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Ambrosia... you know the penalty for attempting to sway an Overseer of the House of Hades with foreign contraband, don't you?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I can't entirely say I do, though if it involves lashings and whatnot, I already get more than my share of that, so... figured I would take the risk. So what do you say?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I say hand over the damn bottle. I'll see that it's disposed of properly. Now as for you... you wouldn't know who misplaced something like this, would you? On my authority as Overseer... hang onto it. Though if you tell so much as anyone...!

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 仙馔密酒……这可是外来的违禁品啊。你知道拿这种东西贿赂冥王圣殿的主管，会招致什么样的惩罚吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 老实说我不太清楚，不知道这么做会不会挨鞭子。我这里的仙馔密酒已经够多了，所以……我觉得我可以冒一下这个险，你觉得呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 我要求你把那个该死的瓶子交出来，我会妥善处理它的。至于你嘛……你并不知道是什么人不小心把这种东西带进来的，是吧？身为主管，我允许你……继续上交违禁品。不过，这件事情你要是告诉别人的话……

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I had this awful contraband I wanted to turn in as soon as possible, if you don't mind taking it from me, Meg.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Tsch... you still have no idea how to be up front with me, do you, Zag. Why don't you tell me why you're here, and what you want.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm... so the whole contraband thing, you aren't buying it, I guess? Although I see you took the bottle there, now, anyway... I wanted just to talk to you. And patch things up, maybe.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Patch things up. What is it, by your estimation, that could use repairs, between the two of us, hm?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I... I was naive. I tried not to get too close, but then I did, and said a lot of stupid things, and then... well, we've since tried to kill each other lots of times, there's that. Look, I am sorry, Meg.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You said a lot of stupid things, all right. And we Furies, we're not much for forgiveness or apologies. But... I can see you're making an attempt. Now, thank you for the contraband. Good-bye.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这件棘手的违禁品就在我手上，如果你不介意从我手上拿走的话，我想尽快上交，墨纪。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 哧……你还是不知道什么叫坦诚相见，对不对，扎格。为什么你不能直接告诉我你为什么在这里，还有你想要什么。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃……所以这件违禁品你是完全不买账咯？虽然我看到你从那里拿走了瓶子，但现在……我只是想和你谈谈。也许还可以修复我们的关系。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 修复关系。私下里问问你，你觉得我们之间有什么问题要修复呢，嗯？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我…我太天真了。我试着不要走得太近，但我没做到，而且说了很多傻话，然后……然后，我们还多次相恨相杀，就是这样。我真的很抱歉，墨纪。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你是说了很多傻话。作为复仇女神，我们不吃原谅或道歉这一套。但是…可以看出来，你在努力尝试。好了，谢谢你的违禁品。再见。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Here, Meg. Contraband. I wish I could do over how we started.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: I, too, wish for a lot of things. Unfortunately there's no unraveling the Fates' patterns. We can learn from our mistakes or keep repeating them. That's it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What if I've learned from my mistakes? Have I ever done anything to hurt you since we've been like this? Discounting the unavoidable and frequent fights to the death.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: There's nothing you can do to hurt me, Zag. It's just a question of whether you're worth my time.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well... am I worth your time, then, Meg?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You know... let me get back to you on that. I need a little time to think it through.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 在这里，墨纪。违禁品。我希望我们可以重新开始。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 对于很多事情，我也是这么希望的。但很遗憾，你我终究也无力反抗命运的安排。我们要么从错误中吸取教训，要么就是不断重蹈覆辙。就是这样。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果我从自己的错误中吸取到教训了呢？自从我们变成这样之后，我曾经做过什么伤害你的事情吗？除了很多次不可避免的生死相搏。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你伤不到我的，扎格列欧斯。问题是，你是否值得我在你身上投入这么多时间。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧，那我值得吗，墨纪？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 等等……我晚点再回答你这个问题。我需要点时间想想清楚。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey Meg, you're off duty, aren't you? Look, I was just... hoping you might want to split this with me, best stuff I could find out there, and I would give it all to you, it's just... maybe you wouldn't mind some company. From me.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: You sound a little tongue-tied, Zagreus. Just like you always used to around me.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're not exactly easy to approach, you know. So... how about it, then? Care for a drink with me?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Open it up, and we can go from there.

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: ...You should have seen the look on your face. You act a lot more confidently now. Though, I think, deep down, you are still that inexperienced little godling that you used to be.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: And I think, deep down, you are not the heartless harbinger of retribution that you want for everyone to think you are. But I can keep your secret if you're willing to keep mine, what do you say?

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Tsch... that sounds an awful lot like blackmail, Zagreus. You'd stoop to that, with me?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No, I... I was just, that's not what I meant at all...

en.speaker: Megaera
en.text: Hahaha, I just want to see you squirm. Thanks for the company and for the drink. Guess I'll be seeing you around.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，墨纪，你没有任务，对吗？我，我只是……觉得你可能会想和我把它分一分，这是我能找到的最棒的东西，我可以全部都给你，只是……你介意和别人结伴吗？比如我。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 你听起来有点结结巴巴的，扎格列欧斯。就像以前那样。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 其实，你这人不大好接近，知道吗？那么……可以和我一起喝一杯吗？怎么样？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 有话直说，不要拐弯抹角的。

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: ……你真该看看自己的表情。现在比以前自信多了。但我觉得，在内心深处，你还是过去那个少不经事的小小神。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你根本就不是一心想着复仇，冷酷无情的人，虽然你希望别人都这么看你。但如果你可以替我保守秘密的话，我也可以保守你的秘密，你觉得如何？

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 哧……这听起来像恐吓一样让人不舒服，扎格列欧斯。你会屈服于我吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不，我……我只是，我根本不是这个意思……

zh-CN.speaker: 墨纪拉
zh-CN.text: 哈哈哈，我只是想看你窘迫的样子。谢谢你请我喝东西聊天。我们在此别过。

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Hey, Prince Z. Must look like I'm slacking off with the old boulder, here, but... I was just getting back on my feet. The Fury Sisters don't often leave me be. Where'd they go, anyway? And... what are you doing here?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, you know, just out on a little stroll is all. Do me a favor, though, you see the Fury Sisters, let them know I was headed down the way I came from, will you...?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Oh I'll let them know, all right, I hear you loud and clear, Your Highness. I'll just go about my business now, and you take care.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，扎王子。我可没坐在石头上偷懒噢…我刚准备站起来呢。复仇女神三姐妹一般都不会这样不管我的。她们去哪儿了？还有…你在这里做什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，没什么，就是出来逛两圈。不过，请你帮个忙，如果你见到复仇女神三姐妹，告诉她们我打道回府了，好吗…？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，我会告诉她们的，我明白你的意思，殿下。那我就继续去忙我自己的事情了，你保重。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: You know, Prince Z., I'd not expected to run into you again, not after all this time. Something amiss down in the House, or what? Not had much company of late, is all.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, something's just about always amiss back home, sir. Figured it couldn't hurt to check up on things in Tartarus a bit more frequently.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Well I am grateful for it, I and the old boulder there, in turn. I'm used to going lengthy stretches on my own, but having visitors from time to time would do me well!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 扎格王子，没想到这么久之后还能见到你。圣殿发生什么事情了吗，还是？只是近来有点孤单而已。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，家里有些事情始终不太对劲，先生。我觉得多检查检查塔耳塔罗斯的情况，也不会有什么坏处。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我和我的巨石老友都特别感谢你。我习惯了自己一个人干着这永无止境的活计，但时不时有几个来访的客人也不错！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: If I may be so bold, Your Highness, I was wondering... what brings you back around this way again? Same story as last time?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Look, I have to level with you, Sisyphus. I'm leaving the House. I've had quite enough. You understand, I'm sure. I'm going to the surface.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Whew, that is quite an undertaking, Prince. If it wasn't you yourself proposing it, I'd like to call it madness, truth be told. Though you're just mad enough to pull it off! Well hey, I hope you make it. Good fortune out there!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 恕我冒昧，殿下……我想知道，是什么让你又回到这里来？跟上次一样吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我得跟你说实话，西西弗斯。我要离开圣殿。我受够了。你知道我是认真的，我要去凡间。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 哎哟，那可真是番大事业呢，王子。老实说，要不是从你口中说出来的，我还以为这人疯了呢。不过想要成功也可以说是疯了。那好嘞，希望你可以成功，祝好运！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Hey Prince how goes the old escape plan, any luck?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know it's been all right, all things considered. Dying now and then, and it's been hard, but hey, what can you do.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Ah, well, keep your chin up. Me, why I quit trying to get out of here a while back, but, if I was a fire-stepping youngster like yourself, perhaps I would have stuck to it.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，王子，逃脱计划怎么样了？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 还算可以吧，所有事情计划周全了。死来死去的话有点艰难，不过，也没有其他办法了。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 哎，别灰心。我呢，早就放弃逃出这里了，但如果我是跟你一样的脚下生火的小伙子，也许我会选择坚持下去。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Hey, Your Highness, anything the matter, or just passing through? Happy that we get to chat like this of late, of course.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sisyphus, don't take this the wrong way, but... why are you helping me? My father's stuck you here for an eternity of torment and even still, you greet me with a smile, time after time.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Hah! Come now, Prince Z., that's just the way I am! Besides, you're not your father, thank the gods! You always seemed a decent lad to me, and if you're saying you want out of here, why, I suppose I can relate, is all.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，殿下，有什么事吗，还是刚好路过？很高兴我们能这样聊天。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 西西弗斯，你不要会错意了啊，但是…你为什么要帮我？我父亲把你困在这里永远惩罚你，但你对我却依旧笑容满面。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 哈！听我说，扎格王子，我就是这样的人啊！再说，你又不是你父亲，感谢诸神！在我看来你是一个很正派的小伙子，如果你说自己要逃离这里，我还是会认同你的。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: You know, Prince, it's been good not having to see those Fury Sisters quite as much lately. The main one, what's her name, she's on your case now, isn't she.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You mean Megaera. She's on my case all right. Under strict orders not to let me out of Tartarus. I guess that means you've got yourself a break! About damn time they gave one to you, sir.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道吗，王子，最近一个复仇女神都没见到，这真是太好了。领头那个，叫什么来着，她现在心思全在你身上了，对吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你指墨纪拉。她在处理我的事呢。严令禁止我离开塔耳塔罗斯。这意味着你可以休息一下了！现在，也该是时候许你一个了，大人。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, quick question, Sisyphus, you seen the other Fury Sisters lately?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Not seen the other Fury Sisters in some time now that you mention it! Just Megaera, the kindly one, and she is quite a handful on her own. I'll keep an eye out for the other two!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，问你个问题，西西弗斯，最近有见过其他的复仇女神姐妹吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 有段时间没见过她们了！只有墨纪拉，脾气好的那位，她真的是很能干呢。我会留意另外两个的！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sisyphus, how can you stand it, being here like this? You always seem in such good spirits, though.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: You push old Bouldy here sufficient times, and you might get a different outlook on things, too. With the Furies all preoccupied and with my running into you from time to time, I'm positively doing great lately. I like to take what pleasures I can get!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 西西弗斯，你是怎么忍受的，受这种折磨？你看起来总是很精神。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 你要是推这块大石头推这么长时间，你也会产生不一样的想法。最近复仇三女神都很忙，我还能时不时跟你聊天，我最近可真是愉快啊。我喜欢享受我能得到的快乐！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Look here, Bouldy, Prince Z. himself has come to visit us!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Does Bouldy really keep you company? Personally I would resent a giant boulder that keeps tumbling back down a hill after I push it all the way up there.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Oh, Bouldy's not so bad, I mean, he's a good listener, a good shoulder to lean on, doesn't wield a whip... I rightly can't complain! Good having company down here.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 快来看看，石头，扎王子本人来看我们啦！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这石头真的一直陪着你吗？我把它从山脚推到山顶，然后它又滚下来，如此反复这样。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，石头也不算坏，我是说，它听你讲话，你也可以依靠着它，它也不会拿鞭子抽你…我还有什么好抱怨的！有人陪就是好啊。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know I was just thinking, sir... sometimes I am a little envious of you and Bouldy there. You seem to have things pretty figured out. I still grow frustrated with myself quite often and don't always know whom to turn to.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Oh, hah! Well, I just think you're in a tough spot lately, Prince. But you'll get through! As for old Bouldy, why, by all means do not hesitate to lay your troubles on him if you like! Dumped all of mine on him a while back.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So I can just... walk up and talk to him, and chat? That's all it takes?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: That's truly all it takes to make a friend sometimes, indeed, Highness. Now, here.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我一直在想，大人……有时候甚至有点羡慕你和那块巨石。你们好像都很清楚自己想要什么。但我还是不得志，我不知道应该向谁求助。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 哦。哈哈！好吧，我觉得你最近在低谷中，王子。但你会熬过来的！至于老石头，你可以随时向它诉苦！我过去就这么做。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我可以……直接走过去和它说话、聊天？就这么简单吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 有时候这样就可以交到朋友不是吗，殿下？好了。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I have to thank you, Sisyphus, not just for all the help you've given me time after time, but for encouraging me to have a chat with Bouldy there. I daresay I feel a little more at peace of late, and maybe it's thanks to him.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: He's a good one, all right, isn't he? Though if you've come to such an understanding with old Bouldy there, why, it must mean you've done some growing on your own as well, I think.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我要好好感谢你，西西弗斯，你不仅三番五次地帮助我，而且鼓励我和石头聊天。我觉得最近平静多了，这可能都是你的功劳。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 他是不错的聊天对象，不是吗？我敢说，如果你这么看待老石头，说明你肯定也成长了很多。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Hey, Your Highness, good, old Bouldy there had several things he wanted to tell you.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Thank you for listening to him! With all that said, I think I've got something for you right here.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，王子殿下，你来了。老石头有几句话想和你说。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 谢谢你愿意听他说话！说到这个，我觉得我有些东西要给你。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Hey Prince, ah, so... you do know Bouldy's just a plain old rock with a few lines chiseled into him, resembling a face, don't you? Chiseled into it, I mean. Just so you don't get the wrong idea...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Come now, sir, we both know full well Bouldy's much more than that. You really think I doubt the power of Bouldy after everything we've been through?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Hahahaha, no. Was just a jest, there, at Bouldy's expense. Look at him! He gets so annoyed when I call him a plain old rock like that. But then he calls me an old lazy lump, and then we're even for a while.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，王子殿下，啊，我是说……石头不过只是块石头而已，他只是表面被刻了几刀，看起来像个人脸一样，这件事你已经知道了吧？我是说，它只是被刻了几刀，我可不想误导你……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 别逗了，先生，我们都清楚石头可不仅仅只是块石头。我们一起经历了这么多事情，你真的以为我还会怀疑石头的力量吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 哈哈哈哈，没有，我刚刚只是拿石头开了个玩笑而已。你我说他只是块石头的时候，你看把他给气得！不过，他也会管我叫老懒骨头，这样我们就算是扯平了。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You ever meet Alecto, Sisyphus? The Fury Megaera's nastier sister. We recently became acquainted, she and I.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Ah, fortunately I've not seen too much of her, myself, Prince Z. And based on everything that I have seen and heard, I'd like to keep it that way for a while! I hope she doesn't cause you too much trouble there.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你有见到阿勒克图吗，西西弗斯？复仇女神墨纪拉的姐姐，比墨纪拉还难缠。我们最近刚刚认识。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，很不幸，扎王子，我最近都没怎么见到过她。而且，根据我的所见所闻，我觉得这样还挺好的！希望她没有给您添太多麻烦。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sisyphus, have you had run-ins with Tisiphone the Fury here before? She isn't much for conversation, I don't think.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Tisiphone. Why, yes, I have, in fact, Prince Z. She's visited on multiple occasions, truth be told. So she is back, is she?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: She is. Although, I think she's back to deal with me. I'll have to keep her plenty busy just in case.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Appreciate it, Prince. Of all the Fury Sisters, she's the one I would least care to see. But if she does stop by, you know, that's how it goes.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 西西弗斯，来到这里之前你见过复仇女神提西福涅没？她好像不怎么太爱说话的样子。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 提西福涅。哦，没错，扎王子，我见过她。说实话，她来过几次。她现在又回来了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没错。而且，我觉得她是专门回来找我的。我得让她好好忙一阵了。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 非常感谢，王子殿下。在所有复仇女神当中，我最不愿意看到的就是她了。不过要是她真来了我这儿，那也没办法。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Look, Prince, I don't hold grudges, you know that. Push this boulder long as I have, you move past the petty stuff. So, just want you to know, in case you make it out this time, it's been a real pleasure.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Feeling's mutual, sir. Someday you'll have to tell me all about how you tricked Father. I might learn a thing or two.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 听着，王子，我不记仇，你知道的。推这块石头时间越久，就越会忘记这些事。在你成功逃离之前，我想让你知道，这真的是一件快乐的事。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 深有同感，先生。有时间你一定要告诉我你是怎么骗到我父亲的。我得跟你学学。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Say, tell me something, Prince, if you don't mind. How come you're so intent on getting out of here? I mean, what happens when you do?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sisyphus, you ever lose somebody dear to you? There's someone out there whom I need to find. That's... all that I can say right now.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: I get it, Highness, and I didn't mean to pry, it's just... I can't remember what it's like to want something so bad, you know? Whoever's out there, I hope you find them soon.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 告诉我一些事吧，王子，如果你不介意的话。你为何要离开这里？我是说，离开后你要做什么呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 西西弗斯，你有失去过自己爱的人吗？外面有一个我要去寻找的人。目前…我只能说这么多。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我懂了，殿下，我不是在刺探，只是…我已经记不起这种想要得到某样东西的强烈欲望了。不管是什么人，我都希望你能尽快找到他们。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey sir, I've always wondered, what were you like back when you were alive? Were you always this wise?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Might surprise you, Highness, I've a bit of royalty in me, myself. Not on your level, mind, but I was very much a king. Though I'll be honest, I... I wasn't much of a good man.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Huh! I thought I sensed the royalty in you! Although, I can't imagine you as anything besides the gentleman I know you for, my friend.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Well that is awful kind of you to say. Though, I would like to think my punishment here wasn't without warrant. At least I've had a lot of time to think it through!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨先生，我一直想知道，你生前是一个怎样的人？一直都是这样有智慧吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 说出来可能吓你一跳，殿下，我也有皇室血统呢。虽然跟你的不能比，不过我也曾是个国王。不过老实说…我并不是什么正人君子。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 咳！我就知道你是有王室血统的人！但我还是不能想象你除了是我认识的那位绅士以外，还是什么样的人。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 听到你这样说真是太好了。但我认为我在这里接受惩罚不是毫无根据的。起码我花了很长时间来思考这个问题！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, Sisyphus, you mind my asking what you did to warrant this particular arrangement you've got here? Pushing a boulder till the end of time and all. Never heard it in your own words.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Well, it's a bit of a long story, Prince. My time had come, though I just wasn't ready, you might say. Your father thought he had me in his clutches, but then, shoom! I gave him the slip. Your father's henchman, Thanatos, he'll back me up on that.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Outsmarted Thanatos, that's amazing... what happened then?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Turns out your father doesn't like us mortals cheating death. Eventually they found me, so, now I'm stuck here with my boulder friend. I push old Bouldy up the hill to the beat of the Furies' whips, then he tumbles down, and then we go again.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So then, you're stuck forever, no reprieve. That's terrible... wish there was something I could do to help.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: You save those sympathies for someone else, Your Highness! I could be Prometheus, spending an eternity having my liver gobbled up, but instead I get to stay in shape, and have these chats with you. Now I'd better get back to it!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，西西弗斯，你是做了什么才会被弄到这里来？你永远都要推着这块大石头。我从来没听你亲口谈过这些。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 这可就说来话长了，王子。当时，我命悬一线，但我还不想死。你父亲认为他抓住我了，不过呢，我唰地一下就逃掉了！你父亲的侍从塔纳托斯会为我证明的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 智胜塔纳托斯，真厉害…后来呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 你父亲似乎不太高兴我们凡人逃离死亡。最后他找到我了，然后，我就在这里推石头了。我一边挨着复仇三女神的鞭子，一边把这老石头推向山顶，到顶之后它就滚下来，如此反复。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 所以，你就永远困在了这里，无法解脱。太可怕了…希望有什么我能帮到你的。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 把你的同情心留给别人吧，殿下！我的下场可能跟普罗米修斯一样，永远被恶鹰啄食内脏，但是我现在还在这里，跟你聊天。该回去干事了！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sisyphus, I've meant to ask, where are you getting all this stuff you give to me? You must be pretty well connected around here.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Oh, well, you know! I have acquaintances amongst the locals here, try to be neighborly with everyone is all. It's not just Bouldy and myself as you can see. Sometimes I come across things that'd be better off in other hands than mine.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 西西弗斯，我想问你，你给我的那些东西都是从哪儿来的？你在这边的人脉肯定很广吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，好吧，你也知道！我在当地有不少熟人，我会尝试和每个人处好关系。不仅仅只是我和石头而已。有时候我会遇到些东西，它们可能对其他人更有用。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I have to tell you, Sisyphus. Sometimes I wish I knew more about your past. You must have been a great king.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Well, ah-hah, the thing is that I wasn't, Highness. And that's not modesty from me, all right? All behind me, now. And I'd appreciate it if we left it at that.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I hear you, sir. Though, whatever you did in your mortal days... you've since more than paid for it, I'm sure.... Wait, is that why you're still here, in Tartarus? Because you think you deserve this?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: It's more like... this is where I belong. Where my path has taken me, you know? Here in the Underworld, you can't entirely escape your past... and yet, it's like you get another life to live. With all the wisdom that you picked up along the way.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这句话我一定得告诉你，西西弗斯。有的时候我在想，我要是对你的过去更了解一些就好了，你生前肯定是个了不起的国王。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 是嘛，啊哈，但实际上不是这么回事，王子殿下。我可不是在谦虚，你明白的吧？不过，这一切都已经过去了。如果这个话题能就此打住，我会很感激的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧，先生。虽然不知道你生前做过什么……但我敢肯定，你的罪行肯定早就还清了……等等，你就是因为这个才待在塔耳塔罗斯的吗？你觉得这是你应得的下场？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 更像是……这里是我该在的地方，是命运引导我来的地方，你明白吧？冥界的人是没办法彻底遗忘自己的过去的……但即便如此，还是像是保留着生前积累的所有智慧，重获新生了一样，

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: You know, Prince Z., you really have a look about you that you know exactly where you're going, as of late. I used to think you weren't near as comfortable in your own skin.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, you were right. I was never comfortable performing Father's routine Tartarus inspections. Though those responsibilities of mine didn't last long.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Nor did we have much opportunity to chat back then, but hey! You always struck me as a decent sort. Wasn't accustomed to your father's henchpeople greeting me with a smile.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 说真的，扎王子，你最近让我感觉到，你非常明白自己应该去什么地方。我以前总觉得，你的生活其实一点都不开心。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，你想得没错。父亲让我对塔耳塔罗斯进行例行检查，我从来都不喜欢做这种事情。不过，我也没做多久就是了。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 那个时候我们也没机会能这么聊聊。不过，嘿！我一直觉得你是个很正派的人，我可没想到你父亲的打手居然会笑着和我打招呼。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sisyphus, I know you tend to be in remarkably good spirits, all things considered, but there must be something I can do to help with your predicament, isn't there?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Oh, come now, Prince, do Bouldy and I look like we could use your charity? We're planning to stay put within this chamber for a while. It's hardly a predicament, I'd say.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: But, what of the Furies and their torments and all that? They might be back and make all this more difficult for you.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Ah, yes, the Fury Sisters, well. I wouldn't mind seeing them more infrequently now that you mention it, but either way! So don't you even worry about me. Now, here.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 西西弗斯，我知道因为种种原因，你总是可以处于精神饱满的状态，但我肯定能做点什么，帮助你摆脱现在的困境吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，拜托，王子，你觉得石头和我需要你对我们大发慈悲吗？我们还计划在这间密室里多待一阵子呢。要我说，这算不上什么困境。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 但复仇女神和她们对你的折磨呢？她们随时可能回来，让你更不好过。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，对，还有复仇女神。既然你提到这一点，我也希望少见她们为妙，但无论怎样！你真的不用担心我。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I have good news, sir! I located the contract binding you, and bought it out. It's null and void. You're free to go!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Oh! Indeed, then, does this mean, Prince, then... the Fury Sisters, they won't come around as often anymore?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Not just that, Sisyphus! You can make your way someplace else, where other decent shades reside! You know, somewhere with fewer chains and torture devices and such?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: You're much too kind to this old soul, Prince Z. The thing is, this is home. For me and Bouldy, it is what it is. Though, knowing that the Furies won't be visiting with quite their former regularity, that is a load off. Heavier than Bouldy, there.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You mean you're really going to stay? Even though you don't have to?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Is that so odd, Highness? Don't see myself lugging old Bouldy out of here, besides! And if I were to leave, why, we would not be having these exchanges now and then. I happen to enjoy them quite a bit! Now, here you go, and thank you, very much.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我有个好消息要告诉你，大人！我找到了制约你的契约，还把它给买下来了。现在它已经失去了效力。你自由了！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 噢！这样的话，王子，是不是意味着……复仇女神不会再经常过来了？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不仅如此，西西弗斯！你现在可以去别的地方，去其他体面的暗灵居住的地方！比如，那些没有镣铐和刑具的地方？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 你对我这样的老亡灵太好了，扎格王子。但重点是，这里是我们的家。对于我和石头来说，就是这样。不过，知道复仇女神不会像过去那样经常过来，减轻了我的负担，这种负担比巨石还重。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你是说你真的打算留下来？即使你没必要这样做？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 听起来很奇怪吗，殿下？我没办法想象自己拉着石头到处晃悠！而且，如果我离开这里，我们就不能自由自在地聊聊天了，不是吗？其实我很喜欢这样子！好了，不过还是非常感谢！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Must say, Prince Z., the free life sure does have its perks down here! This place really isn't as bad as it's cracked up to be.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Glad to hear it, sir. But you're still here... the same as ever. Is it really all that different from the way it always was?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Well, it used to be I'd have to start heaving Bouldy there at any point, if the Fury Sisters decided to show up. But now? I just get to relax, chat a bit with the other shades, and give you one of these when you're in the area!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 不得不说，扎王子，这里无忧无虑的生活还挺不错的！这地方其实并不像传说中的那么糟糕嘛。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这真是个好消息，先生。不过，你依然留在这里……和以前一样，这里的一切真的和以前不一样了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，如果是以前，复仇女神打算过来看看的话，我还得装模作样推推石头。可现在呢？我只要好好休息，和其他的幽灵们聊聊天，等你来的时候给你些好东西就好了！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Ah, there you are, Prince! I was just thinking about how grateful I am that you got me out of that contract with your father. It's been a real weight off my shoulders, truth be told.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You never seemed particularly concerned even before, sir. Must say you're very good at hiding your worries.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: And I could say the same to you! Look, I know you were concerned for my wellbeing. Now you don't have to be. And I'll still be around to help you out. Good feeling, isn't it?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，你来了，王子殿下！我刚刚还在想，你帮我解除了和你父亲的契约，我该怎么道谢才好，说真的，这真是从我肩膀上卸下了一块大石头。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我之前还以为你并不怎么在乎这件事情呢，先生。不得不说，你真的很善于隐藏自己的忧愁。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 你不也一样嘛！你看，我知道你一直很关心我的状况，不过你终于可以不用担心了，我也依然会留在这里帮你的忙。这种感觉可真不错，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: You must have seen everything there is to see here in your father's Underworld, haven't you, Prince? I figure that there isn't any place nicer than this!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh! Well, I suppose now that you're free, you could always see for yourself? It's pretty different as soon as you reach Asphodel. Don't you have someplace or somebody you'd like to see?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: I'll take what's coming to me right here, thank you very much. You're the wayfaring sort, but my wayfaring days are over. It's hard to explain, but... this is a much-needed fresh start for me.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 你父亲的地下世界所有的一切，你肯定都已经见识过了，是吧，王子殿下？我觉得没有哪个地方比这里更舒服了！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦！既然你已经自由了，我猜你也能亲眼看看这个世界了吧？等你到了水仙花平原之后，所有的风景都不一样了。你应该有想见的人，或是想去的地方吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 无论我在这里遇到什么事情，我都欣然接受，非常感谢。你是个喜欢旅行的人，可我的旅行已经结束了。虽然很难解释，但……对我来说，这是个必不可少的新的开始。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: I will have you know, Prince, that your visits here have become a very important part of my routine!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: And what routine is that, exactly, sir?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Why, the routine of looking forward, of course! I try to appreciate the moment as much as anybody, but you know? It's always nice having something to look forward to. So, see you next time, then?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 有件事得告诉你，王子殿下。你时常来这里看我，这已经是我日常生活重要的一部分了！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你说的日常生活，具体指的是什么，先生？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 当然是充满期待的日常生活啦！我在努力像其他人一样珍惜当下，不过说实话，有值得期待的事情总归是件好事。所以，我们下次见了，好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: I heard straight from the source the Fury Megaera's been giving you a time, there, hasn't she. Trust me I know the feeling, so, I'm grateful that you're here and that she's not. You give her hell for me next time, won't you?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh I'll get her for the both of us one of these days. Nights? Whenever.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我听说复仇女神墨纪拉给了你一点时间，对吧。相信我，我知道这感觉，很高兴在这里的是你而不是她。下次替我狠狠揍她一顿，好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不光是替你，我也要替我自己这样做，总有一天。晚上呢？都行。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Hey Prince, I heard you showed that Fury Sister the what-for, is that the truth? Might explain why I've been left here to my own devices for a change.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I don't think she'll be out of commission for very long. She'd best find you minding that boulder, though at least you managed to catch a break for now. Be seeing you, Sisyphus.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 嗨王子，听说你收拾了那个复仇女神，是不是啊？也许这就是我现在只身一人在这里的原因了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我觉得她应该很快就会回来的。她来的时候你最好在推石头，不过现在你可以稍微休息一下。回头见，西西弗斯。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Now you be careful out there, Highness. The kindly Megaera is out for blood. She kept on groaning 'bout the last exchange between the two of you. You must have showed her good!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I think I might have gotten lucky.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 在外头千万注意安全，殿下，温柔的墨纪拉正渴望鲜血呢。她不停地抱怨你俩的上一次战斗，你一定给她好看了！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我觉得只是运气好而已。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Hey, Prince Z., I heard the strangest rumor, here's the thing, I'll give it to you straight. I have heard you've been consorting both with Megaera the Fury and with that old stiff, Thanatos, can you believe it?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sisyphus, I don't know where you heard that, but... it's true. They're... they're just doing their jobs, and I... I know how it looks, but... you're my friend, as well, and I don't want you to forget that.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: I... look, I do appreciate the sentiment, Your Highness, I'm just surprised. I thought we shared a common foe in them, is all. What can I say, I hope that someday I can see them how you see them.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Thank you for understanding, sir. Besides... maybe I can get them to cut you some slack.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，扎王子，我听说了一件很奇怪的谣言，这样，听我跟你说。我听说你同时在跟墨纪拉和那个老笨蛋塔纳托斯周旋，这是真的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 西西弗斯，不知道你是从哪儿听来的，但…这是真的。他们…他们只是在做自己的工作，我……我知道的！但……你是我的朋友，我不想让你忘记这点。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我…听着，我非常感谢你的关心，殿下，我只是有点惊讶。我还以为咱们都把他们当敌人呢。我能说什么呢，真希望有一天我能像你一样看待他们。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 感谢你的理解，先生。另外…也许我能说服他们对你宽松些。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sisyphus, I have to be up front with you. The Fury Megaera and Thanatos... I know you're not exactly on the best of terms with either one of them. But they're both close to me. You won't hold it against me, sir, will you?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Look, Prince, it's not for me to judge you, or your friends. The Fury Sisters, Master Thanatos... we got off on the wrong foot, you could say. My fault, entirely. I'd sooner make sure that our correspondence here doesn't make those relationships more difficult.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Don't even say that, sir. I think Meg and Than know me better than that by now. Well, thanks for understanding, as always.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Certainly, Highness. And who knows? Perhaps as you spend more time together, some of your finer qualities will rub off on those two!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 西西弗斯，我必须和你实话实说。复仇女神墨纪拉和塔纳托斯……我知道你和他们都合不来。但他们对我来说很重要。你不会因此记恨我吧，大人？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 听着，王子，你或者你的朋友轮不到我来评判。复仇女神、塔纳托斯大人……我们一开始就相互不待见。都是我的错。我早就应该小心点，别让我们之间的来往激化矛盾。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 别这么说，大人。我相信以墨纪和塔纳现在对我的了解不至于出现这种情况。不过，还是要谢谢你这么善解人意。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 乐意为您效劳，殿下。谁知道呢？没准相处时间久了，你身上的优点还会感染到他们呢！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: How goes it with old Master Thanatos of late, Prince Z.? Is he at least less stern with you than with the poor mortals he's sent to take in here?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, Thanatos is doing all right. Much like my father, I think he feels he has some sort of fearsome reputation to uphold. Or maybe he's perpetually stressed over his work. But he's been well lately.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: That's good, I guess! Always appreciated that he ultimately took me in, rather than having to show up here through much more sudden, much more painful means. Didn't stop me from trying to avoid the trip, of course.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 你最近和塔纳托斯大人相处得怎么样，扎王子？他对你的态度有没有缓和一些？不像对待他手下的那些可怜虫那么严厉了吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，塔纳托斯一切都好。他和我父亲很像，我觉得，他认为他需要维持某种令人心生畏惧的气场，也可能是他只是工作压力太大罢了。不过他最近都很好。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜，那就好！我很感谢他当时平静地出现在我面前，带我来冥界，而不是用更加突然、更加痛苦的手段把我丢在这里。不过，当然了，我还是想靠耍花招来逃过一死。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Word is you've caused quite the hubbub in Elysium, Prince Z.! Making the champion up there really work for it, I hear?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You could say that, I guess! Apparently word gets around. That Theseus, though... he doesn't care for me one bit, let me tell you!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: I bet he'd like you better if you were a regular pushover! Ah, well, he'll learn, I'm sure.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我听说你在至福乐土引起了不小的骚动，扎王子！听说你让那里的最强战士吃了不少苦头，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜可以这么说吧！看来这个消息已经传遍了。不过那个忒修斯……就这么说吧，他一点都不在乎我！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜，如果你只是个一文不名的手下败将，他会更喜欢你的！啊，我敢肯定他会学到教训的。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Prince, you've been gone for quite a while, why... I heard-tell you made it all the way outside! And I believed it for a while there, yet here you are. What happened, might I ask?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I made it out of here, indeed, sir. I always said that I was leaving, but... turns out there was good reason for me to come back. Not the least of which is visiting my friends from time to time.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Well, I am certainly delighted to hear that! So long as you achieved what you set out to do. But, what brings you back again this way? More than a social visit I presume.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're right. I'm back because... I'm leaving once again. Something I have to do if I get up there, though I should be back before long either way, I guess.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Going to try and make it out of here again and again, is it? Well they say repetition is the key to mastery, Prince Z. Now here, I'll send you on your way.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 王子，已经有一阵子没见到你了啊……我听说你已经一路冲到外面了！我本来挺相信这个传言的，可你又出现在这里了。可以问一下，发生了什么事情吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我确实去了外面的世界，先生。我以前总是说我要离开这个地方，可是……现在我又有理由回到这里了。不过，这样至少可以时不时地见见我的朋友们了。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 哎呀，这可真是个好消息！只要你已经实现了要做的事情，就一切都好。不过，是什么原因，让你又像这样过来了呢？我相信，不仅仅只是为了见我一面吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你说得没错，我回来是因为……我要再次离开这里。我在地面世界还有必须要做的事情，不过不管怎样，我猜我很快就能回来了。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 所以说，你打算一次一次逃出这里，是吗？俗话说得好，熟能生巧，扎王子。好了，我该和你道别了。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: So, how do you like the surface, hey, Prince Z.? Now that you've finally had a chance to see it for yourself. Not too bad, I hope?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It takes some getting used to, that's for sure. I'm not sure I'll ever grow completely accustomed to it. Do you miss it, sir?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Oh, you know. I still have almost everything that matters, and the rest? It makes for precious memories I didn't have up there.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，扎王子，你还喜欢上面的世界吗？你现在终于有机会看看凡间是什么样子了，应该还不赖吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我得花些时间才能适应，这倒是真的，不过我不太确定到底能不能完全适应那边。你怀念凡间吗，先生？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，说真的，那些重要的东西，我在这里也几乎都有。至于剩下的吗？它们可以成为我在凡间没体会过的珍贵回忆。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: So, all this time, Prince, when you were battling up to the surface, and all that... you were searching for her, weren't you? The Queen?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I was. Although, between us, sir, it's important that you keep that one a secret, please. Did... you happen to meet her, ever?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Well, just the one time, briefly, when your father decided to put me here. And, you have my word, of course. About the... surface stuff.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 所以，王子，你一直以来都在不断地一路杀到凡间……是在找她，是吗？找冥后殿下？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊。不过先生，私下里和你说，这件事情请务必保密，拜托了。你以前有没有……刚好见过她？什么时候见的都好。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，我只见过一次，是你父亲打算把我囚禁在这里的时候见到的。至于……地面世界的事情，当然，我保证绝不和别人说。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Prince Z., my understanding is the Queen herself is back, is that correct? Moreover, I have heard a truly fascinating rumor about her...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That I'm her son...? It's true, sir. And she's back with us for now, indeed. I think we're all still getting used to it, but... it feels good, having her in my life.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: That's wonderful to hear. I'd always heard good things about that one. No wonder such a quality runs in the family.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 扎王子，我听说冥后殿下已经回来了，是真的吗？而且关于她，我听说了一件很有趣的传闻……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是说我是她的儿子吗……？是真的，先生，而且她确实回来了。我觉得所有人都还在适应这件事情，不过……能和她在一起，这种感觉很好。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 这真是个好消息，那位大人总是能带来好消息。毫无疑问，这是你们家族的优秀品质。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Just one thing I don't understand, Prince Z., if you'll indulge me for a moment, here. If everything is all right for you at the House, then... why is it you're fighting to the surface, still?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, you know. Wouldn't want Father to get too comfortable thinking this place is foolproof. It has a terrifyingly ominous reputation to uphold! There is no escape.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sure, that makes sense! Well, from a certain point of view. Escape over and over to prove it can't be done! I like that. Well, let's both of us keep at it, then!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 只有一件事情我不太明白，扎王子，可以和我说一说吗？如果你在圣殿里的生活一切都很好，那……你为什么还要再次冲出冥界呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，这么说吧，我可不希望父亲太安心，以为这个地方是铜墙铁壁。必须维护好这个地方的可怕声誉！没人能逃出这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，这就说得通了！从某种角度来说，一次一次逃出这里，来证明这个地方逃不出去！我还挺喜欢这样的，那咱们就都加油吧！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Not working yourself too hard of late, are you, Prince Z.? Remembering to take some breaks from time to time, and all?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I think I'm managing, thanks, sir. Though, back when you pushed Bouldy rather than talked to him... I suppose you didn't have much of a choice, did you?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Well, it was work, you know? Even your Father has to work. Of course, I've since retired! But it seems you and he like to keep yourselves occupied. Whatever makes you feel content.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 你最近工作没有过于努力吧，扎王子？记得时不时地休息休息，好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我觉得我作息安排得很好，多谢了，先生。不过，想想你以前总是在推石头，而不是和他聊天……我猜你那时别无选择，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 这是工作，是吧？就算你的父亲也得工作。当然，我已经退休了！不过看起来你们两个都喜欢有事可忙，只要你们自己觉得开心就好。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Say, that's my Shattered Shackle on your person, right, Prince Z.? I'd recognize that clunky thing from anywhere. It serving you all right?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey sir, certainly it's been most welcome having something from you with me at all times. Though has it always held this power? And... how did you remove it to begin with?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Bit of an odd story, that. Involved a well-timed accident with the old boulder there. Though, I'd best not get into it so that you're not accomplice to that little crime. Surely you understand?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 你拿着的那个破碎枷锁是我的东西，扎王子。这笨重的东西走到哪儿我都能认出来。这玩意儿戴起来还舒服吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，先生，我一直都非常荣幸能够继承您的“衣钵”。不过，它一直都有这种力量吗？还有……您究竟是怎么把它拿下来的呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 说来也怪。跟这个老石头发生过的一次时机恰到好处的事故有关。不过我最好还是不说了吧，不然您恐怕就要变成这小事故的帮凶了。您懂我的意思吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: My Shattered Shackle's practically like new, there, Prince! Minus the part where it's still broken, and all that. Nice work!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Thanks, sir. It's been of help through my repeated treks across this realm, all thanks to you. You sure you don't want it back?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Hahahahah! Absolutely not, though truly I appreciate the sentiment. I'd rather have a look at the old boulder there than a symbol of the time I first got stuck here, when I wasn't doing quite as well.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 王子殿下，除了它本来就破碎不堪的部分，我的枷锁看起来跟新的一样呢！保养的不错哟！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 谢谢夸奖。在这个领地一次又一次的历险中，它帮了我很大的忙，这都要感谢您呢。您确定不想收回它吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 哈哈哈哈！虽说有点感情在，但还是不要了。我宁愿看着那颗老石头，一看到这枷锁就会想起刚来这里的时候，那时的我过得非常不容易。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Word is that the most beautiful music's been heard up in Asphodel, lately, Prince! From the sound of it, why... I think that has got to be Eurydice and Orpheus!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You heard correctly, Sisyphus! Orpheus is reunited with his muse, at last. Or at least, he gets to visit on the regular, when he isn't busy at my father's house. So you've heard of them, have you?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Oh, I've more than heard of them! I'm sure you know how Orpheus once ventured all the way down here, after Eurydice passed on. I'll never forget his song! Even the Fury Sisters gave me a break, they were so captivated by it, then. Ah, good times. For me, at least!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我听说，最近有人在水仙花平原听到了这世上最美妙的音乐，王子殿下！就我听到的消息来看，唔……我觉得那肯定是欧律狄刻和俄耳甫斯演奏的！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你说得一点都没错，西西弗斯！俄耳甫斯和他的缪斯女神团聚了。或者说，他可以趁圣殿里的工作没那么忙的时候，时不时地去见见她了。原来你听说过他们，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，我对他们的了解可不仅仅只是听说过而已。你肯定知道欧律狄刻去世之后，俄耳甫斯是怎么一路来到冥界的吧？我永远都无法忘记他的歌声！就连复仇女神都被他的歌声吸引，让我好好休息了一阵子。啊，真是美好的时光啊，至少对我来说是这样！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Prince Z., it seems you've brought my little Shady back to visit me! How very kind. And I can tell he's in good care of late.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: He is, sir, and I'm grateful once again to have adopted him. You sure you don't want him back, though? Always seems like you could use a friend.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: All due respect, Highness, but I've the best friend anyone can ask for to my right just there. And as for little Shady, he was more inclined than I to see the farthest reaches of the Underworld. Safe travels to you both!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 扎格王子，你是不是带了小沙迪来看我？太好了。我看得出来他最近被照顾得不错。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是的，大人，我真的很高兴领养了他。你不会想把他要回去吧？你好像很需要朋友。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 恕我直言，殿下。我在这里也有好朋友，而且随叫随到。至于小沙迪，他喜欢到冥界的尽头开开眼界。祝你们俩一路顺风！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sisyphus, sir? Have you any idea how Shady works? I'm able to just whisk both you and Bouldy out of here, and to my aid? It must be awfully disorienting.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Well, Prince, I told you that we'd be with you in spirit, didn't I? It's not just Shady's power, I suppose, nor is it Bouldy's or my hidden strength. It's testament to our companionship, is all. You gods are capable of anything!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 西西弗斯大人，你知道沙迪是怎么回事吗？我可以把你和石头变到其他地方去来帮助我？你们明明留在这里，真让人费解。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 是这样的，王子，我不是和你说过我会在精神上支持你吗？这不仅仅只是沙迪的力量，也不是石头或者我的潜在力量。它是我们友谊的见证。你们这些神什么都做得出来！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: She's gone... You still in one piece, Sisyphus? Not hurt or anything?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Oh I'm just fine, thanks, Prince. That Fury Sister, she is quite a lass, I have to say, and very, very strong. Bet she could push old Bouldy here better than I!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 她走了……你还好吧，西西弗斯？有没有受伤？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我还好，谢谢你，王子。不得不说，那位复仇女神，确实不好惹。我敢打赌她可以把这块老石头推到这里来，比我推的还好！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You've really never gotten Bouldy to the top before?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Never got the boulder to the top, not even once. Always tumbles down right at the very end. Lost count after the nineteen thousandth time or so, but you know what? One of these days, I bet it's going to stick.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 您真的从没把巨石推到顶过吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我可从来没把石头推到顶过。总是快到终点的时候就又滚下来。在数了一万九千多次后，我就没数过了，不过您知道吗？总有一天我会成功的。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sisyphus, did I just hear correctly that Megaera has vowed to leave you be for now? Both you and Bouldy there?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Why, I believe you heard just that, Your Highness! Seems the Fates are giving me a break. Although, the Fury Sister did declare that she'll be back to haunting me after she's through with you...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, I bet I can keep her busy for a while yet. I'll take it as a bit of good news, sir.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 西西弗斯，我没听错吧？刚才墨纪拉发誓说暂时不管你了，也不管石头了？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我敢说您也听说过，王子殿下！似乎命运女神要让我歇一歇。不过，复仇女神明确表示在解决完你的问题后就会继续回来骚扰我了……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是这样嘛，那我猜我应该能让她忙上一段时间了。我就当这是个好消息吧，先生。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Oh, I'm doing very well, thanks, Prince. I'm not afraid of him, I mean, what have I got to lose? Now here, I wanted you to have this.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，我还可以，谢谢，王子。我可不怕他，我意思是，我已经没什么可失去的了。拿着吧，我想让您收下这个。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Can you believe the nerve of that one, Prince? He's nothing but a blowhard, so, I simply tell him what he wants to hear! He can't stop me from helping you, besides. I'm dead already, what's he going to do?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 他说的话您信吗，王子殿下？他盛气凌人、净说大话，所以我才说了他爱听的话！他才不能阻止我帮助您。再说了，我人都死了，他还能拿我怎么样？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Prince Z.! Just missed your stern-faced colleague, feel that stillness hanging in the air? Sounds like he won't be checking up on me again anytime soon.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Thanatos really isn't such a bad sort once you get to know him, sir. Though, I suppose you'll have to take my word for that.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Oh, I believe it, Highness. I should think that bringing death must be a lonely job. Perhaps he ought to try pushing a boulder sometime!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 扎王子！你刚好和你那位面瘫同事擦肩而过，感觉到空气里的死寂了吗？感觉他近期都不会来查我的岗了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果了解塔纳托斯的话，你会发现他并不是什么坏人，先生。你应该相信我的话。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，我相信这一点，殿下。我早应该想到死亡的领路人是一份寂寞的工作。也许他应该抽空试一下推一块巨石！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Good to see you in one piece, Prince Z.!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 真高兴看到你还活着，扎王子！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Life treating you all right, I take it, Prince?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 看来你过得还不错，王子。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Oh I'm hanging in there, thanks for asking, Prince!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 噢我扛得住，感谢关心，王子！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: You'll make it out of here, I've no doubt about it!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 你一定能逃出这里的，我敢肯定！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Nice of you to drop in for a bit!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 你能来真是太好了！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: You are a sight for sore eyes, Prince!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 你真是一道美丽的风景啊，王子！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Now you be careful out there, won't you, Prince?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 去外面要注意安全，王子。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: You give them hell for me, all right, Prince Z.?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 替我狠狠地揍他们，好吗，扎王子？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Go get them for me, Prince!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 替我好好收拾他们，王子！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Got just the thing for you here, Prince!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 这里正好有你要的，王子！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: It's always good to see you, Prince!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 很高兴见到你，王子！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: You keep your chin up, Prince!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 振作起来，王子！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Keep fighting the good fight, there, Prince!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 永远不要放弃，王子！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Hey you take care, you hear me, Prince?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 保重，知道吗，王子！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Let's both of us keep going, that a deal?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我们一起努力，一言为定。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: It's good of you to visit me like this!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 你能来看我真是太好了！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Hope everything's been well enough of late.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 希望最近一切都太平。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: You watch your step out there, all right, Prince Z.?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 在外面注意脚下，王子。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Hullo Highness, you're looking well enough!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 你好殿下，你看起来不错！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Hey, Your Highness, how goes it, how is everything?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，殿下，情况怎么样？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: I have to say it's good to see a friendly face!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 能见到友好的脸真是太好了！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Always a pleasure, Highness, you take care out there.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 很荣幸，殿下，路上小心。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Here's my best friend in all the Underworld, how goes it, Prince?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我在整个冥界里最好的朋友，最近如何，王子？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Glad you made it all this way, Prince Z.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 很高兴你能一路过来，扎王子。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Think I've got just the thing for you right here, Highness!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我觉得这里有你想要的东西，殿下！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: A brief hello from time to time does wonders, don't you think, Prince Z.?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 偶尔打个招呼总能给人意想不到的感觉，不是吗，扎格王子？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Much as I like the company of Bouldy there, you're always welcome, Prince!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 虽然我喜欢石头的陪伴，但也欢迎你过来，王子！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Stop by whenever you're around these parts, all right, Prince Z.?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 如果在附近，随时过来坐坐可以吗，扎格王子？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: I know it isn't much, Highness, but I do hope this helps!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道作用不大，殿下，但还是希望能帮上忙！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Here's something courtesy of me and Bouldy, Prince!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我和石头有些好东西要给你，王子！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: How about a little bit of help as you keep on your journey, Prince?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 在旅途中给你点帮助，怎么样，王子？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Let's see if we might make your going slightly easier, there, Prince!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 看我们是否可以帮你把事情变得简单些，王子！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Should have something that ought to come in handy for you, Prince!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 有些东西应该可以帮上点忙，王子！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: No need for these, so take one off my hands, won't you, Prince Z.?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 没必要这样，从我手里拿一件吧，扎格王子？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Bouldy and I have got the usual for you right here, Your Highness.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 和往常一样，石头和我给你准备了点东西，王子殿下。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Highness, please take one of these and go!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 殿下，请拿件兵器出发吧！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: All's well out here in Tartarus, Prince Z.! What will it be?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 塔耳塔罗斯的一切都好，扎格王子！会怎么样呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Bouldy and I got our usual selection here, Highness!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 石头和我跟平时一样为你准备了点东西，你可以随便选择，殿下！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Don't let me keep you, Prince, I know you've plenty of important business here.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我就不耽误你了，王子殿下。我知道你还有很多重要的事情要做呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Before you go, Prince Z., a little souvenir from your fine stay in Tartarus.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 扎王子，临走之前，我想给你点来自塔耳塔罗斯的纪念品。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Don't do anything I wouldn't do out there, you hear me, Prince?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 可不要做连我都不会做的事情，明白了吗，王子殿下？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: You're looking good and ready for whatever lies ahead up there, Prince Z.!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 你看起来很不错，已经做好了面对一切的准备，扎王子！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: You know approximately where to find me if you happen to be in the area again, Prince Z.!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 如果你刚好又来这里的话，你应该知道该来哪里找我，扎王子！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Everything's fine as ever here, Prince Z., so you go on ahead, and don't look back!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 这里的一切都很不错，一如既往。你就安心前进吧，不要回头！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: I have a feeling you are going to make it all the way topside this time, Highness!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我有种感觉，你这次肯定能一路顺利登顶，王子殿下！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Need a little pick-me-up perhaps?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 需要我搭把手吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Bouldy and I will always be here in your time of need, Prince Z.!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 在你需要帮助的时候，石头和我会一直在这里守候，扎格王子！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Bouldy says whatever we can do to help, we'll do it, Prince!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 石头说，只要帮得上忙，我们一定全力以赴，王子！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: In case words of encouragement are not enough, have one of these here, Prince!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 如果鼓励的话还不够，请从这里拿上一件东西吧，王子！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Let's get you on your way, Prince Z., and in good spirits, too!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 让我们帮助你精神饱满地上路吧，扎格王子！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Don't you worry, Highness, we have got you covered here!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 别担心，殿下，我们是你的坚强后盾！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Told old Bouldy here you'd probably be back if only to say hi!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 告诉老石头你很快就会回来，即使只是为了打声招呼！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Hey Prince, Bouldy and I will not be needing these, but maybe they can help!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，王子，石头和我都用不上这些东西，但可能对你有帮助！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Just do the best you can, if you don't mind me saying so, Prince Z.!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 如果你不介意我说泄气的话，我觉得只要尽力了就好，扎格王子！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Speaking for myself and Bouldy there, we're always at your service, Prince.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我和石头随时愿意为您效劳，王子殿下。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: You get all the way up to the top and do whatever it is needs getting done, Highness!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 希望你能一路走到上面，做你想做的事情，王子殿下！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: I know Bouldy believes in you every bit as much as I do, Prince!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我对你充满信心，我知道石头也和我一样，王子殿下！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: Sisyphus_OfferText01

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, sir, thought this might ease your burden for a while.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Now hold a moment, Highness, I cannot accept something like this... not without giving back a little something in return, that is!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，先生，我觉得这个可以让你暂时减轻负担。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 等一等，殿下，这我不能接受……除非我也有些小东西可以回礼！

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Oh, my, you're really giving that to me, there, Prince? But, I'm just, why would you...?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You better believe it, sir. Now you take care, be seeing you around.

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 噢天啊，你真的要把这个给我吗，王子？但是…我只是…为什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你最好相信，先生。保重，下次再见。

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Why, Prince, you being serious right now, is that for me?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You deserve better, Sisyphus! This really isn't much, but maybe it'll help you while away the days. Nights. Whatever time it is.

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 为什么，王子，你是认真的吗，给我的？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你配得上，西西弗斯！这真的没什么，但是应该可以帮你消磨时间。晚上也行。不论时间。

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Wow, Your Highness, you... you really shouldn't have. Thank you for not forgetting about me.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're always a sight for sore eyes out here, Sisyphus. Thank you for always believing in me.

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 哇，殿下，你……真的不必这样。谢谢你没有忘记我。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你永远是一道靓丽的风景线，西西弗斯。谢谢你一直相信我。

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: I'm really very flattered, Highness! You didn't have to get me anything, I mean, your company's more than enough for me!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I figured you could do with something more than that this time around, good sir.

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 我真的太高兴了，殿下！你真的不必给我什么东西，我是说，有你的陪伴就足够！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我想你这次能做的应该不只这些，好先生。

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Oh, but this is just too much for me, Your Highness, thank you, really. I don't know how I can ever repay you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: How about you keep on helping me not die as quickly as I might have otherwise, deal?

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 但是这个我真的承受不起，殿下，谢谢你，真的。这恩情我永远报答不完。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那你就帮我让我不要死得那么快，怎么样？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sisyphus, sir? You've helped me selflessly time after time without so much as asking anything in return. Wanted to say I'm very grateful, and thought you might like to try this. Here, for a special occasion!

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Why, Prince, is this...? It is...! I've not so much as seen a bottle of it, much less sampled it, thank you so much! Although, with all respect, I cannot rightfully accept such a fine gift. Unless...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Unless...? Oh no, you're not making me take something in return, you know this was a gift not an exchange, sir, right? Wait, what is that?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: This, Highness, is a little friend of mine kept tucked away in Bouldy's care. Wherever you'll be going next, he'll make a worthy traveling companion. And when he's with you, Bouldy and I... we'll be with you in spirit, too.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 西西弗斯大人？你多次无私地帮助了我，从没有要求回报。我要告诉你我对此充满感激，而且想着你在特殊的场合可能会用到这个，就在这里！

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 什么，王子，这是……？是的……！我很少见过满满一瓶，更没有品尝过，非常感谢你！不过，恕我冒昧，我没有正当的理由接受这么珍贵的礼物。除非……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 除非……？噢……不，这可不是什么物品交换，这是一件礼物啊，先生。等下，这是什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 殿下，这是我的一个小朋友，一直由石头秘密照看着。接下来无论你走到哪里，他都会跟着你，让你不再孤单。而且，有他在你身边，石头和我……我们都会在精神上支持你。

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Prince, that vintage Ambrosia bottle that you gave me, my! That was the greatest thing I ever tried, I think! Even Bouldy enjoyed the stuff!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I thought you'd like it, sir. And so, I'm pleased to offer you another! Almost a shame we seldom get such imports from Olympus around here. I hope I can appreciate it for myself sometime. Once all this is over with, I think.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: What? You mean that you've never touched the stuff yourself? You've much more self control than I have, there. Perhaps someday we'll have a chance to share some between us!

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 王子，你送我的那瓶陈酿仙馔密酒，简直是！我觉得它是我收过的最好的礼物！甚至连石头都非常喜欢！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我想着你会喜欢的，大人。如果你喜欢的话，我愿意再给你拿来一瓶。遗憾的是，我们这里很少能拿到这种来自奥林匹斯山的好东西。我希望有机会我也能亲自品尝一番。等这一切都尘埃落定吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 等等，你说你从没碰过这东西？那你的自制力比我强多了。也许某天，咱俩能有机会坐下来一起尝尝！

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Prince, that vintage Ambrosia bottle that you gave me, my! That was the greatest thing I ever tried, I think! Even Bouldy enjoyed the stuff!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I thought you'd like it, sir. And so, I'm pleased to offer you another! Almost a shame we seldom get such imports from Olympus around here.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Ah, look at what the Prince has brought for us, Bouldy! Perhaps someday we'll have a chance to share some between us!

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 王子，你送我的那瓶陈酿仙馔密酒，简直是！我觉得它是我收过的最好的礼物！甚至连石头都非常喜欢！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我想着你会喜欢的，大人。如果你喜欢的话，我愿意再给你拿来一瓶。遗憾的是，我们这里很少能拿到这种来自奥林匹斯山的好东西。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，快看看王子殿下给我们拿来了什么好东西，石头！或许有朝一日，我们可以有机会坐下来，一起喝上几杯！

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: All this, for someone such as me. You know I'm down here for a reason, don't you, Prince? Not just because your father and good Thanatos don't care for me. Yet, from the very first, you showed me decency I'd not experienced since I was a king. Perhaps not even then.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Whoever it was you used to be, sir, I believe you've changed. And I'm proud to say that you're my friend. And Bouldy there as well. It's odd for me to say, but I am glad you're here. I think I've learned a lot from you, about all this.

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Well, Your Highness, I am honored very much indeed, and having you amongst my list of friends makes it perhaps the greatest such a list a fellow such as I has ever had. Isn't that right, Bouldy?

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Take it from me, Prince Z., Bouldy concurs.

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 所有这些，对于像我这样的人来说。你知道我被困在这里的原因吧，王子？并不只是你的父亲和塔纳托斯大人不喜欢我。从一开始，你对我的尊重是我走下国王宝座之后再也没遇过的。甚至当我还在位时都没有过。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 无论过去是怎样的人，大人，我相信你早已脱胎换骨了。作为你的朋友，还有巨石的朋友，我感到非常自豪。这么说听起来有点矫情，但我真的很庆幸有你在。我从你那里学到很多东西，关于这一切纷纷扰扰。

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 王子殿下，我感到特别荣幸，真的，有你这样的朋友是我这种人想都不敢想的。你说对吗，石头？

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 请收下吧，扎格王子，石头附和着说。

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: Wait, really, this, this is for me, you mean it, Prince? I mean, I won't say no, I can't say no to such a thing, so, thank you! Thank you kindly.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're more than welcome, sir. For all you've done for me, it's the least I could do.

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: 等下，真的，这，这是给我的？真的吗，王子？我是说，我不会拒绝的，这种东西我怎么能拒绝呢，谢谢你！非常感谢。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你真的太客气了，先生。你为我做了这么多，这是我应该做的。

en.speaker: Sisyphus
en.text: ...I'm really rather speechless, Your Highness. I'm just a shade doing my time. I don't deserve your generosity.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Come on, sir, what's a priceless bottle of the drink of the gods between friends?

zh-CN.speaker: 西西弗斯
zh-CN.text: …我真的不知道该说什么了，殿下。我只是个本分的暗灵。怎值得你如此慷慨。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 来吧，先生，只是朋友间分享的一瓶无价的美酒而已。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, Bouldy...? I'm Zagreus, good to make your acquaintance. I know that friends are difficult to come by here in Tartarus, and so, I'm grateful that you seem to be a trusty one.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 额，石头……？我是扎格列欧斯，很高兴认识你。我知道在塔耳塔罗斯很难交到朋友，但你是值得深交的，我对此心怀感恩。

en.speaker: Zagreus
