en.text: Bouldy, while on one hand I know that making offerings to you won't really help get me out of here, on the other hand... maybe it will?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 石头，我知道送礼物给你对于从这里逃脱没有帮助，但另一方面……没准可以呢？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Bouldy, how do you handle being trapped in Tartarus for all eternity, doomed to be pushed up and down a hill repeatedly for no good reason?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 石头，你对于永世被困在塔耳塔罗斯有什么想法，难道你命中注定要被反复机械地推上、滚下？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So, erm, there something you like to do for entertainment out here, Bouldy? Or just, I don't know, take it all in, I guess?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那么，呃，你这里有什么娱乐消遣吗？或者只是，怎么说呢，就这么坦然接受？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What's the latest, Bouldy? Had any good tumbles down that hill of late?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 最近还好吗，石头？最近仍然要从那座山上滚下来吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know, I think I'm growing more accustomed to relating to a giant stone.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道吗，我渐渐对有一个巨石朋友习以为常了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Don't know why I keep doing this, Bouldy, yet here we are.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道我为什么一直要这样做吗，像现在这样，石头。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You take good care of Sisyphus, there, won't you, Bouldy?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你一直在细心地照顾西西弗斯，不是吗，石头？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Sometimes a conversation with a friend is its own reward, isn't that right, Bouldy?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 有时候和朋友聊聊天本身就会令人感到非常愉快，对吗，石头？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're looking as stately as ever, there, Bouldy.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你看起来一直这么威严，石头。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: A tribute to the greatest boulder of all time.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 向有史以来最伟大的石头致敬。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: To our most famous boulder!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 致我们最负盛名的石头！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: May you roll smoothly for eternity.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 祝你在滚动时永远不会受到阻碍。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Thank you for keeping my friend company.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 感谢你一直以来的陪伴，我的朋友。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: This is for you, Bouldy.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这是送给你的，石头。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Bouldy, please accept this humble offering.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 石头，请收下这份微薄的礼物。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Bouldy, lend your favor to me, won't you?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 石头，可以请你帮个忙吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: An offering to the finest boulder in all of Tartarus.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 给整个塔耳塔罗斯最伟大的石头的礼物。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Cheers, Bouldy! Thank you for brightening my day or night.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 开心点，石头！感谢你驱散我生命中的阴霾。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Bouldy, ever get the feeling that we've had this conversation in the past?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 石头，你是不是感觉我们的对话好像似曾相识？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Let's be sure to do this again sometime, Bouldy my friend.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我们下次找个时间再来一次，我的朋友，就这么说定了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Any advice for me on this occasion, Bouldy?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 对于此时此刻的我，你有什么建议吗，石头？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Bouldy, you can speak up if there's something on your mind, you know.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 石头，你心里想什么可以尽管说。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're always here for me, Bouldy! Cheers.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你总是愿意帮我的忙，谢了，石头！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: How's everything going lately, there, Bouldy?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 最近你还好吗，石头？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Looks like you and Sisyphus are doing just fine, Bouldy.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 看起来你和西西弗斯都很好，石头。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Good seeing you as ever, there, Bouldy.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 见到你还是那么让人高兴，石头。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're a good friend, Bouldy. I'm glad you're here.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你是位好朋友，石头，很高兴能有你在。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You'd tell me if anything was on your mind, right, Bouldy?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果有什么困扰的话，你会告诉我的吧，石头？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey Bouldy, what's your favorite color?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，石头，你最喜欢的颜色是哪个？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey Bouldy, what's your favorite form of sustenance?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，石头，你最喜欢的食物是什么？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey Bouldy, what do you like to do in your spare time?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，石头，你闲着的时候都会做些什么？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey Bouldy, how's everything of late?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，石头，最近都还好吗？

en.text: ...Go on, stranger. Plenty more shades looking to fight with you out there.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm just passing through. You seem less warlike than the rest. May I ask your name, sir? I'm Zagreus.
Names are there to be forgotten, stranger. You shouldn't be here. May the Fates favor your journey. But just in case they don't, here. Why don't you take this?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText03

zh-CN.text: …继续，陌生人。很多暗灵都期待着能与你在外面打一场。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我只是路过。你看上去比其他人要更和平一点。容我问一下你的名字，先生。我是扎格列欧斯。
名字是会被忘记的，陌生人。你不应该在这里，愿命运三女神眷顾你。不过，万一她们没有的话，拿着这个吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText03

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Is something wrong, there, sir? I mean, shouldn't you be up and about, competing for eternal pride and glory and all that?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: What's the use? Let's say we fought, if anybody asks. Now, go. I've no quarrel with you, besides. I'll just remain here, comfortably at rest, for some untold millennia, I guess. Have a nice... whatever time it is.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 有什么问题吗，先生？我是说，你不是应该为了永恒的骄傲和荣耀而战吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 那又有什么意义呢？如果别人问起来，我就说我们打过了。走吧，我也不想跟你有争执。我猜我会一直呆在这里，呆到地老天荒吧。祝你愉快……不用管时间了。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Is something wrong, there, sir? I mean, shouldn't you be up and about, competing for eternal pride and glory and all that?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: What's the use? Let's say we fought, if anybody asks, now go. I've no quarrel with you, besides. I'll just remain here, comfortably at rest, for some untold millennia, I guess. Have a nice... whatever time it is.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 有什么问题吗，先生？我是说，你不是应该为了永恒的骄傲和荣耀而战吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 那又有什么意义呢？如果别人问起来，我就说我们打过了。走吧，我也不想跟你有争执。我猜我会一直呆在这里，呆到地老天荒吧。祝你愉快……不用管时间了。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Still toiling around within Elysium, I see. Battling my brethren, in the name of glory, is that it?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm heading for the surface. Though your brethren are slowing me down. Whether for glory or at my father's behest.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Your father...? Ah, that's right, but you're the Prince, aren't you. You must see plainly, then, what your birthright amounts to: You're no better off than any of us here. Now, go.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 还是在至福乐土受苦啊。以荣耀之名，与我的弟兄们战斗。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我要去凡界。但是你的弟兄们拖慢了我的速度。不管是因为荣誉还是因为我父亲的要求。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你父亲…？啊，没错，你是王子，对吧。你也清楚看到了，你与生俱来的能力：其实也不比我们这里的人好多少。走吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You again. I told you to stay clear of me. Your father's quite the big shot around here, but that means nothing to me, understand? Go, and tell him he can cast me in the pits of Tartarus, for all I care. It'd be a welcome change of pace from being put to pasture here.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText05

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 又是你。我说了离我远点。你父亲也许是个大人物，但是这跟我没关系，知道吗？走吧，告诉你父亲他大可把我扔进塔耳塔罗斯深渊，我不在乎。那应该比在这里要有趣得多。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText05

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I was unkind last time, stranger. Forgive my indiscretions there. Or don't. But I wished to apologize.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Think nothing of it, sir. Though if there's something I could do to help, you'd tell me, wouldn't you?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You have no power to release me from this coil, I'm afraid. So just go on about your business, and leave me to mine.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 上回是我不对，陌生人。请原谅我的失礼。不原谅也可以。但我希望向你道歉。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没事，先生。如果有什么事我可以帮上忙，请尽管说，好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 恐怕你没有能够将我从这里放走的力量。所以，你忙你自己的事情去吧，不用管我。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Stranger, I am warning you: If you keep showing up like this, I'm going to have to find a new nickname for you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No need to go out of your way, there, sir. We're just acquaintances. I don't know anything about you, either.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: And you are better off. This place is for the greatest of the Greeks. Do I seem like the sort to fit in, here? Go on and chat with Theseus, or someone of that sort.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 陌生人，我警告你：如果你继续像这样出现在我面前，我就要给你找个新外号了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不用麻烦了，先生。我们只是刚认识而已。我对你也是一无所知。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 那你最好离开。这个地方只提供给最伟大的希腊人。我看上去像是这样的人吗？去跟忒修斯谈谈吧，或者其他的什么类似的人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Stranger, I am warning you: If you keep showing up like this, I'm going to have to find a new nickname for you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No need to go out of your way, there, sir. I rather feel like a stranger around here. I have no plans to extend my stay.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: And you are better off. This place is for the greatest of the Greeks. Do I seem like the sort to fit in, here? Go on and chat with Theseus, or someone of that sort.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 陌生人，我警告你：如果你继续像这样出现在我面前，我就要给你找个新外号了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不用麻烦了，先生。我在这里就是个异乡人。我也不打算在这里久留。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 那你最好离开。这个地方只提供给最伟大的希腊人。我看上去像是这样的人吗？去跟忒修斯谈谈吧，或者其他的什么类似的人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Tell me, stranger, if it pleases you. How is it you keep running into me...? I thought this the remotest corner of Elysium.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: The ever-shifting chambers of the Underworld leave quite a bit to chance. I took our meetings merely for coincidence.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: When chance is too far-fetched to be believed, then it's the Fates at play. Or something else. I don't know whether to believe you, but I know that I want you to leave me, now.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 告诉我吧，陌生人，如果可以的话。你为什么老是碰到我…？我还以为这是至福乐土最偏远的地方。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不断变化的冥界房间包含了相当多的可能性。我以为我们的会面只是巧合罢了。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 当你觉得这一切不可思议的时候，那就是命运之神在作怪了。或者其他的什么原因。我不知道该不该相信你，但是我知道，我现在要你离开。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Tell me, stranger, if it pleases you. How is it you keep running into me...? I thought this the remotest corner of Elysium.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: The ever-shifting chambers of the Underworld leave quite a bit to chance. I took our meetings merely for coincidence.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: When chance is too far-fetched to be believed, then it's the Fates at play. Or something else.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 告诉我吧，陌生人，如果可以的话。你为什么老是碰到我…？我还以为这是至福乐土最偏远的地方。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不断变化的冥界房间包含了相当多的可能性。我以为我们的会面只是巧合罢了。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 即使是偶然也过于牵强，那应该就是命运使然吧。或者别的什么东西。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: What is it this time, stranger? You're quite effective at locating me, but not so good at leaving me in peace.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Just on one of my little jaunts through paradise is all, sir. Happened to be on the way toward my destination.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You think this place a paradise? At least down in the depths, there are so many other souls with whom to share one's misery. No offense... I know that you're just passing through.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 这次又怎么了，陌生人？你找我找得倒挺快的，希望你离开时候也能这样。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 就当是我在这仙境里的一次小旅行吧，先生。正好在去目的地的路上碰到你了。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你觉得这里是仙境？至少在下面深处，有很多灵魂会跟你分享他们的痛苦。无意冒犯……我知道你只是路过而已。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: So, stranger. How goes willful disobedience of late? Would that I, too, had it within me to defy the gods.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, you know, it's going. That I've been able to make it this far means I am getting somewhere, I suppose. No thanks to all your brethren in Elysium.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: No use trying to reason with my brethren here. Many of the shades whom you've encountered, why, I watched them throw away their lives when they were men. Yet still they seek to prove to one another and themselves that they are great warriors.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 那么，陌生人。你的任性抗争计划进展如何了？真希望我也有反抗诸神的勇气。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，没什么，正在进行呢。既然我能走到这里，我觉得应该离成功不远了。感谢你在至福乐土里的所有弟兄。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我的弟兄们是没法讲道理的。你遇到的这些暗灵们，他们活着的时候都不曾珍惜自己的生命。现在他们依然在证明自己是伟大的战士。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Say, isn't that the Lethe right nearby? You've been through so much, don't you ever... you could just drink deeply of the River of Forgetfulness, and be done with, no?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: It has been rather tempting, yes. And I have taken sips, from time to time. But I've some memories I'm not quite ready to give up on, yet.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我说，这条河不就是遗忘之河吗？你肯定经历过很多事情吧，你就没想过要……你可以直接喝上一口河水，之后把一切都忘掉，这不好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 没错，这听起来确实很诱人，我时不时地也会抿上一小口。不过，有些记忆我现在还不想忘记。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You ever want to travel past this glade, sir? Elysium in all its splendors... there's a lot to see. Sure you're all right?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I'm sure enough, stranger. I traveled far and wide whilst I drew breath. That got me rid of any wanderlust. This little corner suits me well, I think. I have the statue there, the river... it's quite nice.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你打算穿过这片林地吗，先生？至福乐土这么美妙的地方……这里还有好多怡人的景色，你真的确定吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我很确定，陌生人。我还活着的时候，就已经去过太多地方了，已经哪里都不想去了。我觉得这个小角落刚好适合我。那里有座雕像，还有条河……已经很好了。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: What is that on your wrist, there, stranger? Let me see, is that... a bracer of the myrmidons. But, then...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, this? How did you know? It's just a keepsake from a friend.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: A keepsake? From a friend...? You tell your friend, then, that Patroclus waits for him, and that he holds no grudge, should he return to him.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你手腕上那个是什么，陌生人？我看看，这是…密尔弥冬护腕。但是…

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等等，这个吗？你怎么知道？这只是一个朋友送的纪念品。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 纪念品？一个朋友…？你告诉你那个朋友，你说普特洛克勒斯在等他，如果他回到我身边，我便不再记恨。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: What is that on your wrist, there, stranger? Let me see, is that... a bracer of the myrmidons. But, then...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You recognize it, then. Of course. It's from Achilles, sir. He gifted it to me. He trained me.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I see... a gift. Well, then, you let Achilles know Patroclus waits for him, and holds no grudge, should he return to him.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你手腕上那个是什么，陌生人？我看看，这是…密尔弥冬护腕。但是…

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你认得这个。当然认得。这是阿喀琉斯的东西，先生。是他送给我的礼物。他训练了我。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我明白了…礼物。你告诉阿喀琉斯，你说普特洛克勒斯在等他，如果他回到我身边，我便不再记恨。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.text: What is that on your wrist, there, stranger? Let me see, is that... a bracer of the myrmidons. But, then...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, this? How did you know? It's just a keepsake from a friend.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: A keepsake? From a friend...? You tell your friend, then, that Patroclus waits for him, and that he holds no grudge, should he return to him.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等等，这个吗？你怎么知道？这只是一个朋友送的纪念品。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯

zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You recognize it, then. Of course. It's from Achilles, sir. He gifted it to me. He trained me.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I see... a gift. Well, then, you let Achilles know Patroclus waits for him, and holds no grudge, should he return to him.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.text: 你手腕上那个是什么，陌生人？我看看，这是…密尔弥冬护腕。但是…

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你认得这个。当然认得。这是阿喀琉斯的东西，先生。是他送给我的礼物。他训练了我。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我明白了…礼物。你告诉阿喀琉斯，你说普特洛克勒斯在等他，如果他回到我身边，我便不再记恨。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: What is that on your wrist, there, stranger? Let me see, is that... a bracer of the myrmidons. Achilles...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: This is his bracer, yes. You recognize it, then. Were you a myrmidon, yourself? I heard they were unstoppable.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Well, now... if we were so unstoppable, we'd not be here, would we? May that bracer protect you more than its like protected our phalanxes.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你手腕上那个是什么，陌生人？我看看，这是……密尔弥冬护腕，是阿喀琉斯的……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没错，你认出来了，这就是他的护腕。你以前也是位密尔弥冬吗？我听说你们无人能敌。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧……如果真的无人能敌的话，我们就不会来这个地方了，不是吗？希望那个护腕能好好地保护你，让你不要落得它之前主人的下场。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Must say that's an impressive spear you've got, there, stranger. Rather like the one Achilles held. He gave it to you, then? Followed him beyond the grave, only to be handed off.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's... a bit more complicated than that, sir, though yes. This is the very same as he once wielded. I am honored to carry it now.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I'll bet. Perhaps you'll even come to surpass the body count Achilles piled up with it back in his day, seeing as you seem to have limitless opportunity to use it.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 不得不说，你这把长矛真是不错，陌生人，很像阿喀琉斯以前用过的那把。所以说，是他把这把长矛给了你，是吗？这把矛陪着他出生入死，到头来却被他送给了别人。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 事情……实际上要更加复杂。不过你说得没错，这就是他以前用过的那把长矛，我感到很自豪。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我想也是。你有无限的时间来使用这把长矛，说不定你以后杀死的人，要比阿喀琉斯活着的时候杀的还多呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You know, stranger, there was a time Achilles would have killed someone for taking up his spear. But there you are, like you own it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I don't think anybody owns this spear, sir. I'm hanging onto it for the time being. Though I don't think I'll be the last to do so.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Oh, there's no need to get all philosophical about it. It's a killing weapon. Nothing more.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 老实说，陌生人，以前要是有谁敢动这把长矛，阿喀琉斯一定会杀了他。不过你却活得好好的，仿佛它就属于你一样。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我认为这把长矛不属于任何人，先生。我只是它暂时的使用者，不过我认为，我肯定不会是最后一个挥舞它的人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，没必要把它上升到这种哲学的高度。它不过是把用来杀人的武器，仅此而已。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You mentioned something of your parentage, stranger. I have a question on that subject, if you please.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I please, sir. What's your question? Ask away.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Your father must have records of the dead. So I was wondering if you might do for me a favor, and look up the whereabouts of someone I once knew.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You've done a lot for me. The least I can do is ask around. Who is it that you're looking for?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I seek one called Achilles. Was rather famous once among the living, but among the dead, who knows. I thought he would be here, but he is not.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...Achilles... I've heard the name before. And, erm, can I ask why you wish to know of him? In case it happens to come up.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: It's just... I simply miss him, stranger. That is all.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你似乎提到过你的出身，陌生人。如果可以的话，我想就此问一个问题。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没问题，先生。你想知道什么？问吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你父亲一定有死者记录吧。你愿不愿意帮我一个忙，帮我找一找我认识的一个人的所在。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那样的话真的帮了我大忙。至少我可以帮你四处打听一下。你要找的人是谁？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 他叫阿喀琉斯。他还活着的时候，非常出名，但是在死后世界，就不知道了。我以为他会在这里，但是并没有。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: …阿喀琉斯…我听过这个名字。那么，唔，请问你为何要找到他呢？以防万一。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 就是…我只是想他了，陌生人。就是这样。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Something the matter, there, stranger? Or have you come to torment me some more with idle chat?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know Achilles, don't you, sir. You're Patroclus. Achilles... serves us at my home. He trained me. He sends you his regards and love. He says to tell you he is thinking of you always.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: ...That name. So then you've seen him, have you. In your father's house. And want me to believe he said all that? Tsk. You'll forgive me if I am a little skeptical. In life, I left Achilles. And in death, he left me. We're even. And we've nothing left to say to one another, now.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: But, that can't possibly be true. There must be some misunderstanding here. You haven't spoken since you died?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: We haven't, no. And I don't think we shall. But, you can humor him for me, I guess. Tell him I'm doing perfectly all right, won't you?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 有什么问题吗，陌生人？还是你又想用闲聊来作弄我了？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你认识阿喀琉斯，对吧，先生。你是普特洛克勒斯。阿喀琉斯…现在在我家中工作。他训练了我。他托我向你带来他的问候与爱。他说他无时无刻不在想念你。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: …那个名字。那么你见过他，对吧。在你父亲的家中。还想让我相信这些？啧。如果我起了疑心，你应当可以理解。活着时，是我离开了阿喀琉斯。死后，他离开了我。我们扯平了。现在我们之间没什么好说的了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 但是，这不可能啊。这其中一定有什么误会。你们死后就一直没有说过话吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 没有，而且我也不认为有必要。但是，你可以为了我迎合一下他。就告诉他我现在过得非常好，怎么样？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Something the matter, there, stranger? Or have you come to torment me some more with idle chat?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Patroclus. I know who you are, sir. And, you know Achilles. He serves us at my home. He trained me. He sends you his regards and love. He says to tell you he is thinking of you always.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: ...Ah. So then you've seen him, have you. In your father's house. And want me to believe he said all that? Tsk. You'll forgive me if I am a little skeptical. In life, I left Achilles. And in death, he left me. We're even. And we've nothing left to say to one another, now.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: But, that can't possibly be true. There must be some misunderstanding here. You haven't spoken since you died?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: We haven't, no. And I don't think we shall. But, you can humor him for me, I guess. Tell him I'm doing perfectly all right, won't you?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 有什么问题吗，陌生人？还是你又想用闲聊来作弄我了？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 普特洛克勒斯。我知道你是谁，先生。并且，你认识阿喀琉斯。他目前在我家中工作。他训练了我。他托我向你带来他的问候与爱。他说他无时无刻不在想念你。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: ……啊，所以你已经见过他了，是吗，他在你父亲的圣殿里。你还想让我相信他说过那些话？啧，你得理解我有点多疑。活着时，是我离开了阿喀琉斯。死后，他离开了我。我们扯平了。现在我们之间没什么好说的了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 但是，这不可能啊。这其中一定有什么误会。你们死后就一直没有说过话吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 没有，而且我也不认为有必要。但是，你可以为了我迎合一下他。就告诉他我现在过得非常好，怎么样？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Something the matter, there, stranger? Or have you come to torment me some more with idle chat?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Patroclus. I know who you are, sir. And, you know Achilles. He serves us at my home. He trained me. He sends you his regards and love. He says to tell you he is thinking of you always.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: But, that can't possibly be true. There must be some misunderstanding here. You haven't spoken since you died?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: We haven't, no. And I don't think we shall. But, you can humor him for me, I guess. Tell him I'm doing perfectly all right, won't you?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 有什么问题吗，陌生人？还是你又想用闲聊来作弄我了？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 普特洛克勒斯。我知道你是谁，先生。并且，你认识阿喀琉斯。他目前在我家中工作。他训练了我。他托我向你带来他的问候与爱。他说他无时无刻不在想念你。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: ……啊，所以你已经见过他了，是吗，他在你父亲的圣殿里。你还想让我相信他说过那些话？啧，你得理解我有点多疑。活着时，是我离开了阿喀琉斯。死后，他离开了我。我们扯平了。现在我们之间没什么好说的了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 但是，这不可能啊。这其中一定有什么误会。你们死后就一直没有说过话吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 没有，而且我也不认为有必要。但是，你可以为了我迎合一下他。就告诉他我现在过得非常好，怎么样？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: So, how's Achilles doing lately, stranger? I figured you could tell me since you've all this access to him, and I don't.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: He's forced to do my father's bidding. And sworn to secrecy, apparently. I don't pretend to fully understand. But, all in all, I think he's doing well. I hope... you'll see him for yourself.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You don't fully understand, but hope. I see. Well, if you do get to the bottom of this little mystery at some point, you'll indulge me, won't you?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'll... see what I can do about it, sir.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯最近怎么样，陌生人？我觉得既然你能够天天看到他，而我不能，所以你应该可以回答。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我父亲强迫他做事。并且发誓要保守秘密，很明显。我不会装成我完全理解一样。不过，总而言之，我觉得他过得还可以。我希望…你可以自己去看他。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你没法完全理解，只能希望如此。我明白了。看来你要等自己弄明白这些谜团之后才能帮到我了，对吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我会…看看我能做点什么，先生。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: He's never going to return to me, is he. He's in your father's service now. He's never getting out. Neither are you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No. That's not acceptable to me. None of it.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: How bold. So what do you intend to do? You're leaving, anyway.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'll figure something out. But you do something for me, in the mean time: Don't give in to what you're feeling now, all right? Achilles loves you still, like you don't know.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Does he? I'm past the point of making promises, but... I pray the Fates help you in your endeavors, there.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 他不可能再回来我身边了，对吧。他现在为你的父亲工作。他从来没有出来过。你也一样。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不，这我无法接受。全都无法接受。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 太无耻了。那么你现在要怎么做？你要走了吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我要弄明白一些事。但你现在要帮我点忙，与此同时：不要被自己所谓的感觉给骗了。好吗？阿喀琉斯依然爱着你，但你不知道。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 真的吗？现在我做出承诺已经没有任何意义了，但是…我祈祷命运之神能在你的前进道路上眷顾你。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: He's never going to return to me, is he. He's in your father's service now. He's never getting out. Neither are you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No. That's not acceptable to me. None of it.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: How bold. So what do you intend to do? You're leaving, anyway.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'll figure something out. But you do something for me, in the meantime: Don't give in to what you're feeling now, all right? Achilles loves you still, like you don't know.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I'm past the point of making promises, but... thank you for your words. I love him still, in turn. I pray the Fates help you in your endeavors, there.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 他不可能再回来我身边了，对吧。他现在为你的父亲工作。他从来没有出来过。你也一样。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不，这我无法接受。全都无法接受。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 太无耻了。那么你现在要怎么做？你要走了吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我要弄明白一些事。但你现在要帮我点忙，与此同时：不要被自己所谓的感觉给骗了。好吗？阿喀琉斯依然爱着你，但你不知道。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 现在我做出承诺已经没有任何意义了，但是…谢谢你说的话。我也依然爱着他。我祈祷命运之神能在你的前进道路上眷顾你。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: He's just as obstinate as ever, isn't he? Always refused to budge. He ever tell you of the war in which we fought? I fought, I should say. He could have ended it. But he refused to take up arms.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Achilles hasn't been particularly forthcoming about his mortal days, no. So he wouldn't fight? I've heard that mortals sometimes frown on that, but... why should he have fought if he didn't believe in the cause?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: He shared our cause! So what if it was not completely his? If not for his stubbornness, I... well... I would have come here just a bit later, I think.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: He blames himself for what happened to you, you know. I figured he failed to defend you or something, not that... he didn't fight at all. Although, he said something about how, once you died, he shortly followed in a rage...

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I wouldn't know a thing about that, stranger, for you see... I was already dead. Getting my place here in the afterlife all sorted out. Took quite some time, getting accustomed to all this.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 他还是和以前一样顽固，总是不肯让步，不是吗？他有没有告诉过你我们参加的那场战争？不对，应该说是我参加的，他本可以结束这场争端，但他就是不肯拿起武器。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 关于他活着的时候，他并没怎么和我说过。所以说，阿喀琉斯那个时候不肯参战，是吗？我知道，凡人有时候会对不肯参加战斗的士兵大为光火，可……如果连他自己都不相信战争的动机，他为什么还要参战呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 他要与我们同生共死！难道这不全是他的问题吗？要不是他这么固执，我根本……好吧……我可能得晚点才会来冥界。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你也知道，他一直为你的惨死而自责。我觉得，他没能保护好你，而不是……根本没有参加战斗。不过，他也确实说过一些事情。他说你死了之后，他马上就气得发疯了，之类的吧……

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我对此一无所知，陌生人，你也明白……我已经死了，我在思考来世的事情。我花了不少时间，才渐渐地适应了这里的生活。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: A question, if you don't mind, stranger? Because, I've had one nagging at me since we last discussed the subject. What, exactly, happened to Achilles, can you say? After I died, that is. I've heard the rumors, but... I don't trust any of this boastful lot.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, from what I gathered, sir... after you fell, he was overcome with grief. And anger. He joined the war, just like you urged. And, single-handedly, he almost ended it.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: So then, he threw away his life. Soon enough after I lost mine. Yet, despite vanquishing an army on his own, he wound up in the lowest pits of Tartarus? Instead of here, among the great?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You should know, sir. You were buried together. Your ashes, that is. It was his final request. As for how he came to be at my father's house, that's something I think he can best explain. And I will do everything I can to make sure that he has the opportunity.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: ...Our ashes, you say. Together? Tsk. The fool. We could have lived! Not been reduced to meal for the worms. But... I appreciate the information, stranger. Now... please, go.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 不介意的话，可以问你个问题吗，陌生人？上次和你谈过之后，这个问题就一直在折磨着我。我死了之后，阿喀琉斯到底怎么样了，可以告诉我吗？我听说过一些传闻，不过……我并不相信那群满口跑火车的家伙。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 据我所知，先生……你一死，他就被悲痛击垮了，陷入了狂怒之中。他像你希望的那样，上了战场，而且几乎靠一己之力就结束了这场战争。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 所以说，在我死后不久，他也战死了。而且，尽管他靠着一己之力就消灭了一支军队，他却被困在了塔耳塔罗斯最阴暗的深渊之中，不能来到这里，与英雄们欢聚一堂？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你应该明白，先生，你们的骨灰被葬在了一起，那是他最后的遗愿。至于他怎么跑到了我父亲的圣殿，我想他肯定能解释清楚。而我要做的，就是确保他有这个解释的机会。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: ……你是说，我们的骨灰？被埋在了一起？啧，那个傻瓜，我们本可以活下来的！而不是变成蛆虫的食粮。不过……很感谢你告诉我这件事情，陌生人。现在……请离开吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: ...Forgive me, stranger. For, in retrospect, I was too terse after you told me what became of my Achilles. Tales of his climactic battle, I had heard. The stuff about... his ashes, and my own... that was all new.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No need to even ask forgiveness, sir. Achilles is one of my closest friends, but.. he doesn't care to talk about himself. About those times. It must be very painful. For the both of you.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Oh, we've all seen our share of pain, by now. But... knowing that he cared for me, in the end... after the end... it dulls the feeling of it, for a bit. As do these conversations, I guess.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: ……我很抱歉，陌生人。想想看，你告诉了我阿喀琉斯发生了什么事情，而我的态度实在是太生硬了。是你告诉我他最后的战斗，关于……他的骨灰……和我的骨灰的事情……这些事情我都是第一次听说。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不用客气，先生。阿喀琉斯差不多是我最亲密的朋友，可是……他从来不说他自己的事情，也不说曾经的事情。这对你们两个而言，一定非常痛苦吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，到了这个时候，我们都尝过该尝的那份痛苦了。可我知道……他还在乎我，哪怕是生命结束的时候……哪怕是生命结束之后……我的感觉都有点变得迟钝了，我猜，这场谈话也是如此吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I've meant to ask you something, stranger. Would you mind doing me a favor, please? If it happens to come up along your path. Suppose I ought to tell it to you first, prior to asking a response.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No, of course, sir, what is it? What's on your mind?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: If I know my Achilles, then he's being rather guarded, when it comes to this predicament we're in. How can somebody be so brash yet hate to take unnecessary risks? Just let him know I said to risk it all.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Risk it all? Risk what all? He wants what's best for you. He wouldn't want anything to happen.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: It's already long since happened. I daresay that, right now, provided what you've said is true, then... it appears we've more to gain than lose. Isn't fear for the weak?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 有件事想和你说一下，陌生人。如果你顺道的话，可以帮我个忙吗？在得到你的答案之前，我应该先告诉你是什么事情。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没问题，先生，是什么事情？你有什么打算？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 如果他是我熟悉的那个阿喀琉斯的话，当我们处于这种困境的时候，他应该会相当谨慎。可如果是勇敢的人，又怎么能逃避不确定的风险呢？你告诉他，我打算放手一搏了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 放手一搏？搏什么？他希望你能一切都好，他不希望你发生任何意外。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 那一切发生到现在，已经过了很久了。这么说吧，如果你说的一切都是真的的话……那我觉得，我们已经没什么好失去的了。只有弱者才会恐惧，不是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I thought we might run into you, but... how strange to see you face-to-face out here, lad. To see this place myself. I still can't quite believe any of this...

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: He really can't. Though I keep telling him, it's true. Nothing's accomplished without risk, isn't that so? But, we of course have you to thank, stranger. Our troubles needn't have been your concern.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nonsense, sir. You're my friend. And Achilles... I don't know where I would even be, if not for you.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Well, no need to get emotional, is there? We myrmidons, we're not the sentimental type. Achilles is simply on break, is all. From a demanding job. You've a demanding job as well, so here! My customary gift.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Achilles_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 我还以为我们会偶然遇到你呢，不过……和你面对面地站在这里，小伙子，能亲眼看到这个地方，这真是太古怪了。我到现在都不敢相信这一切是真的……

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，我一直在告诉他这是真的，可他就是不信。如果不肯冒险的话，就什么都得不到，不是吗？当然，我们得好好感谢你，陌生人，你其实本没必要插手这桩麻烦事。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这就不对了，先生。你是我的朋友，阿喀琉斯也是……如果没了你们，我都不知道自己现在会在什么地方。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，没必要这么感情用事，不是吗？我们是密尔弥冬，不是那种多愁善感的家伙。阿喀琉斯仅仅是想从累人的工作中抽身，休息一下而已。你也完成了一份累人的工作，来吧！这是我给的谢礼。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Well if it isn't the ward of Achilles, come to visit us. I don't know how I can ever repay you, stranger. I'm quite sure that it isn't possible.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I reached more or less the same conclusion, Pat.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: How about you just keep offering me those premium goods you have no interest in when I pass through, and we can call it even, sir?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: That I had plans to do, regardless, though... if you should think of something else at any point, please do let either of us know.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 等阿喀琉斯不用站岗的时候，过来看看我们吧。我也不知道该怎么答谢你，陌生人，我觉得你的恩情我们无以为报。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Achilles_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 我多多少少也是这么想的，小普。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这样吧，等我路过这里的时候，你们继续向我提供那些你们不感兴趣的好东西吧。这样我们就扯平了，你们觉得呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我也是这么打算的，不过……如果你想到其它的事情，我们能帮得上忙的话，尽管和我们开口。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Good, there you are, stranger. Settle something for us quickly, hm? Would Achilles not make for the perfect Champion of Elysium? For I think almost anybody would be better than the current one.

en.speaker: Achilles
en.text: I think I'd rather maintain watch over a nearly empty hall than battle all the shades around here, Pat.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I, too, would vastly prefer having to contend with Theseus rather than yourself, Achilles. Although, that's not to say I disagree that almost anybody would be better in the role than him.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: It seems, then, I am overruled. But I know Champion material when I see it, and I see it now.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你好啊，陌生人，这么快就来找我们了？不应该是阿喀琉斯才是至福乐土的最强战士吗？我觉得随便挑个谁，都比现在的那个要厉害。

zh-CN.speaker: NPC_Achilles_Story_01
zh-CN.text: 我宁可待在空空荡荡的大厅里，也不想和这附近所有的幽灵刀剑相向，小普。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我也是。比起和你交手，阿喀琉斯，我更愿意去和忒修斯打一场。你说随便挑个什么人都比忒修斯能打，我也没什么异议。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 看起来我的提议被否决了。不过，我一眼就能看出谁有成为最强战士的资格，而我现在就看到了有资格的人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Achilles is returned to work for now... but, waiting for him, knowing he'll return... rather than waiting for the sake of it, for nothing... such a different feeling, stranger. I'd forgotten it entirely, I think.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm happy for the both of you. So, is everything all right, then? The circumstances under which you were separated in life... it's unimaginable, really. How does one move on from a thing like that?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Anger fades, I guess, stranger. Even the famous anger of Achilles. Anger burns hot, then burns out. What's left is a dull ache, but... underneath it, there was something else. It felt as though... well, I was still alive. That feeling... it's worth holding onto.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯回去工作了……不过等着他来，知道他一定会来……而不是傻乎乎地苦等下去……这种感觉截然不同，陌生人。我想，我之前恐怕是完全忘记这种感觉了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我为你们两个感到开心。所以，一切都很顺利，是吗……？说真的，我实在是无法想象你们活着的时候生离死别的情形，那到底要怎么才能熬过来啊？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 或许怒火终将会熄灭吧，陌生人，就连阿喀琉斯那著名的怒火也不例外。愤怒愈演愈烈，之后燃烧殆尽，只剩下钝重的痛楚。不过……在那之下，还有别的东西，感觉就像是……我还活着。这种感觉……是值得坚持下去的。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: It's good to see you again, stranger. You don't mind if I keep calling you that, no? Couldn't find a better nickname for you, after all. Besides... I don't want to cause you any trouble.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Don't mind at all, Patroclus, sir. Coming from you I consider it a term of endearment.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You have my thanks for that...

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 很高兴又和你见面了，陌生人，你不介意我继续这么叫你吧？毕竟，我也找不到更适合你的称呼了，而且……我不希望让你惹上麻烦。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 别介意，普特洛克勒斯，你这么叫我让我觉得很亲切。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我感激不尽……

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Achilles tells me that you're here to stay, at least for now, stranger. A welcome bit of news. Assuming, of course, that it's for the best, for you?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I think so, sir. I'll still be passing through, and visiting the surface every opportunity I get. But it seems my place really is here. Besides, it means getting to see you every now and then, like this.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: That sounds agreeable to me. Then, you take care.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯告诉我你打算留在这里，至少目前不打算走，陌生人。这真是个好消息，我猜这对你来说也是最好的结果，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我想是的，先生。我还是会路过这里，一有机会就会去地上世界，不过看起来，冥界才是我真正的归宿。另外，这意味着我时不时地能来见你，就像这样。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 听起来真不错，多保重吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: There's been considerable talk of late about the Queen Persephone, stranger. Your mother, it would seem? Sounds to me your tale's almost as complicated as my own.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's a long story, at this point, indeed. But yes. The Queen... my mother... she's returned. And, it's been really good, having her back.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I can only begin to imagine. May she help govern all of this with wisdom and with grace.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 关于冥后珀尔塞福涅，最近有很多人都在讨论她的事情，陌生人。她是你的母亲，是吗？在我看来，你的故事和我的故事差不多同样曲折。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，说来话长。不过，没错，冥后……我的母亲……她回来了。而且有她在身边，我真的很开心。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我只能想象这样的情形了，愿她以智慧与优雅帮助管理这里的一切。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: This spearpoint that you gave me, sir. It's been quite useful, though I have to ask you... is there any particular significance to it? Most spearpoints aren't imbued with power such as this.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Oh, that. Just something I'd been meaning to get rid of, but... it can be difficult, discarding trifles from the past. Knowing it's provided you some benefit is welcome news.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你送给我的矛头非常有用，不过我想问一句……这个矛头有什么特别的地方吗？绝大部分的矛头都没有这么强大的力量。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，这个啊，只不过是我一直都想处理掉的东西罢了，不过……想要抛弃过去的琐事，真的很困难。知道它派上用场了，这真是件可喜的事情。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Did you once wield a spear yourself, sir? In your fighting days?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Did I once wield a spear? You could say that I did. I had my moments with it, anyway. Even once slew a demigod! He's probably somewhere about. Quite awkward, running into those you killed. But in Elysium it's all taken in stride.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你以前也是用矛的吗，先生？在你还活着的时候？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我以前也是用矛的吗？可以这么说吧，我以前用矛也很厉害，甚至还杀过一个半神呢！他可能也在这附近什么地方吧，碰到自己杀过的人真的是件令人尴尬的事情，不过至福乐土就是这么个地方。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Whatever happened with that war you mentioned, sir? If you don't mind my asking.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Well, truth be told, here, stranger... I do mind. You speak as one who's not experienced a war. Those of us who survived... or, you know what I mean... we do bear some responsibility to history. But, all the same, it's not a time and place to which I would return. I trust you'll understand.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你提到的那场战争，后来怎么样了，先生？希望你不介意我这么问。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 老实说吧，陌生人……我很介意。从你说话的语气来看，你从来没经历过战争。我们之中活下来的人……或者说，你明白我的意思……我们要对历史负下责任。可也一样，如果还可以回到那个时候、那个地点的话，我绝不会想回去。我相信你能明白我的意思。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I always wondered, sir. What was Achilles like...? During his youth, I mean. If you can say.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Hah. How to describe what somebody was like? Everyone who saw him on the battlefield agreed he was magnificent, stranger. His allies and his enemies alike. But, there was more to him, I think. A certain outlook. A sense of justice. I knew him before he was a warrior. Only reason I suppose I liked him.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我很好奇，先生。阿喀琉斯以前是什么样子……？我是说，他年轻的时候，可以告诉我吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 哈，该怎么描述一个人是什么样子呢？每个在战场上见过他的人，无论是他的敌人还是盟友，都会同意他是个所向无敌的战士。但我觉得，他不仅仅如此，他还是个有远见、有正义感的人。早在他成为战士之前，我就认识他了。大概也正是如此，我才会喜欢他的吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I heard you've vanquished Theseus however many times of late. Or... someone matching your description has, stranger. Almost had to laugh when I heard that. Though, I suspect he hasn't learnt a thing.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What, you know him? Though, yes, he does seem rather set in his ways. Convinced himself that I'm some sort of demon from the lowest depths. Which... well, it's partly true, I guess.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You're quite notorious, around these parts. The tales of your father's monstrous son, kept under lock and key within his House. Fear and ignorance make for great stories, no?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我听说你最近不知道打败了忒修斯多少次，或者说……是某个和你长得一模一样的人干的，陌生人。我听说这件事的时候，差点就被逗笑了，不过我怀疑那家伙一点教训都没学到。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等等，你认识他吗？不过你说得没错，他有些方面确实一成不变。他坚信我是来自地狱最深处的恶魔，不过……某种程度上来说，倒也没错吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你在这里已经臭名昭著了，大家都听说了你父亲有个像怪物一样的儿子，被锁在圣殿里禁止外出。恐惧和无知总是能让人编出有趣的故事，不是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Couldn't help but hear the rattling of battle chariots of late. Raucous laughter and the like. You've really riled up the locals this time, stranger.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Must be Theseus and his fancy Macedonian. So he's been joyriding about in that thing? Showing it off?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Your arrivals are becoming a bit of an event, I'd say. And, yes, the Champion and his bull friend are likely at the center of it. You'll have to forgive me that I've no intent on attending your contests, but... well, here.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我最近听到了战车轰隆的声音、喧嚣的笑声，以及其它的什么声音。你这次真的是把当地人给惹毛了啊，陌生人。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那肯定是忒修斯和他花哨的马其顿号吧。所以他一直都乘着那架战车，到处耀武扬威吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 不得不说，你的到来已经引起了轰动。而且没错，最强战士和他的的公牛朋友很可能处于这场轰动的中心位置。很抱歉，我并不打算去看你那场战斗，不过……祝你一切顺利。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know, for such a loudmouth obnoxious braggart, Theseus does seem to have formed a strong kinship with the Bull of Minos, hasn't he. Are they truly as inseparable as they seem? I feel bad for the Bull.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Sometimes it's our differences that make us drawn to one another, no? And, at other times, there's no accounting for taste. I often don't know which is which, and they can have each other, far as I'm concerned.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 说真的，那个臭名昭著的牛皮大王忒修斯，似乎和那头米诺斯的公牛结成了牢固的盟友关系。他们的感情真的像看起来那么亲密无间吗？我真为那头牛感到难过。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 有的时候，人与人之间正是因为有了差异才会相互吸引，不是吗？而且有的时候，我们也没得挑。在我看来，很多时候我其实分不清到底是因为哪一种，很多时候都是两者都有的。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Even the Bull of Minos couldn't stop you, huh. That's one whose way I would stay out of if I could, but... well, you'd not be here if you couldn't handle yourself, I guess.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You heard I battled with Asterius, here, sir? I thought you kept more to your own devices. Weren't much for conversation with the other shades.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Oh, you're correct in that assessment, stranger. But, as you've seen, I've no ability to stop others from coming and going as they please. So I do tend to hear a thing or two from passersby.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 就连米诺斯的公牛都不是你的对手，哈。换做是我的话，我恐怕不想和他交手，不过……这么说吧，如果你搞不定他的话，你也不会站在这里了，是吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你已经听说我和阿斯忒里俄斯打了一仗，是吗？我还以为你对外面的事情都不感兴趣呢，你好像不怎么和其他的幽灵来往。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，你这个评价倒是完全正确，陌生人。不过你也看到了，我没办法阻止其他人随意进出这个地方，所以我偶尔也会从过路的人那里听到些事情。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You must have met so many great heroes in your day, having fought alongside Achilles... do you still keep in touch with any of them, here?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Great heroes... haven't you seen, by now, what they are like, stranger? Not all entirely what they're cracked up to be. But, there were good ones, yes. Suppose they're mostly keeping to themselves. Like I am here. Perhaps we'll run into each other, down the line.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你活着的时候与阿喀琉斯并肩作战，肯定遇到过很多伟大的英雄吧……来这里之后，你们还保持联系吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 伟大的英雄……难道你还没认清他们的真面目吗，陌生人？不是所有人都是名副其实的英雄，不过，也确实有些不错的家伙。我猜他们大部分都像我一样，过着独来独往的生活吧。或许有朝一日，我们会见面的。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Never quite considered... you're related to the gods upon Olympus, aren't you, stranger...? I should be far more careful around you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What do you mean by that, sir? Though, yes, my father being who he is, it means I have a lot of uncles, cousins, and the like, up on the surface, there.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Well... you would be wise to watch yourself, with some of them, I think. Don't get on anyone's bad side, if you can help it. Which, when I yet lived, none of us could.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 有件事情我没怎么考虑过……你和奥林匹斯山上的众神有血缘关系，是吧，陌生人……？我在你身边应该更加小心才是。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你这么说是什么意思，先生？不过确实，我的父亲是冥界之王，我也有很多叔叔和表亲之类的亲戚住在凡界。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧……那遇到其中一部分人的时候，你最好能小心点。如果可以的话，不要去做会惹怒别人的事情，不过，我还活着的时候，我们之中没人能做到这一点。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You ever been in love with someone, stranger? Might be a mortals-only thing, for all I know. You gods have strange relationships, I hear.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I have been, sir. Or, I should say, I am.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Ah, that's good. Cling to the feeling, then. And if you lose it... reach for it. Search for it, no matter what, all right? Because, without it... well, there isn't much of a comparison, I think.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你爱过什么人吗，陌生人？据我所知，或许只有凡人才会爱上谁吧，我听说你们神明的关系比较古怪。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我爱过，先生。或者说，我现在爱着某个人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，这很好，那就记住这种感觉吧。如果忘记了这种感觉……无论付出什么代价，都要去寻找它，把它找回来，好吧？因为没有爱的话……好吧，我实在是不知道该怎么比喻才好。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You ever been in love with someone, stranger? Might be a mortals-only thing, for all I know. You gods have strange relationships, I hear.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Not sure that I have been, sir. I understand it's one of those things where, you'll know it when it happens.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Perhaps you shall, someday or night down here. The feeling comes with pain, and plenty of it, but... the pain is worth it, in my limited experience. And once you find that feeling, cling to it. As tightly as you can. If you don't mind my saying.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你爱过什么人吗，陌生人？据我所知，或许只有凡人才会爱上谁吧，我听说你们神明的关系比较古怪。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我不太清楚有没有爱过，先生。我知道，当爱来了的时候，你就会明白了。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 那或许你应该去试试看。以我有限的经验来看，爱会使人痛苦，相当痛苦，不过……这种痛苦是值得的。一旦你明白了爱的感觉，就要牢牢地记住，永远不要松手。希望你不会介意我这么说。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Well, what's it going to be this time, stranger? The HydraLite? Maybe the Kiss of Styx?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You sure you don't need any of this stuff, sir? I really appreciate it, but... I don't want to take it for granted.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Oh, come, this is Elysium. Taking such things for granted is the point. We gloried shades receive our stipend of the finest goods, so we can battle till we've had our fill. But I've already had my fill, I think.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 怎么，这次想尝尝什么呢，陌生人？是九头蛇轻饮？还是冥河之吻？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你真的不想要这些东西了吗，先生？我是很喜欢啦，不过……我不想把这当成理所当然的礼物。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 拜托，这里可是至福乐土，不就是应该理所当然才对吗？我们这些享受荣耀的幽灵可以享受到最好的东西，这样我们才能打到不想再打为止。不过，我觉得我已经打够了。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You've ample time for fishing, have you, stranger? And here I thought you'd more important business to attend to, though it's not for me to judge, I guess.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'll have you know some of us take matters of fishing very seriously, sir! Besides... helps take my mind off having to fight your Elysian brethren nonstop.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Oh I'd not take your mind off this fight if it's one that you hope to win, stranger. I once took my mind off a fight, and, well... I wound up here.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你花了不少时间钓鱼，是吧，陌生人？我还以为你有更重要的事情要做呢。不过，我猜我也不应该对你指手画脚吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我得和你说清楚，我们之中有些人非常认真对待钓鱼这件事情，先生！另外……我得和你在至福乐土的同胞们不停地战斗，钓鱼有助于让我转移注意力。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，如果你很想赢得这场战斗的话，那你可不应该转移注意力，陌生人。我有一次也在战斗中转移过注意力，结果……就跑到这个地方了。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I have to tell you, sir, it was a real sight to see you fighting alongside Achilles. You two were amazing!

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Oh, I'm a little rusty. But he's not. Still very much in tiptop shape, except more able to control his temper, I should think.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Don't sell yourself so short! Though, I thought you laid down your spear forever. Why choose to fight again?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Achilles swayed me into realizing some activity may be quite good for me. And besides... if we can aid you in a pinch, that's worth my while.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我不得不说，先生，看你和阿喀琉斯一起战斗真是场视觉盛宴，你们两个真是太了不起了！

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，我已经有点生疏了，但他可没有。我觉得，他依然处于巅峰状态，而且更擅长控制自己的脾气了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 别这么低估自己嘛！不过，我还以为你再也不打算挥舞长矛了呢，为什么又打算战斗了？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯让我意识到，适当活动活动筋骨对我很有益处。而且……如果我们能帮得上你的忙，我是不会袖手旁观的。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You look positively beaten, there, stranger. Let's see if we can't get you on your feet. For I can do the listless sitting for the both of us.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你看起来被揍得好惨，陌生人，咱们看看你还能不能站起来吧。像没精打采地坐着这种事情，我一个人做就够了。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Oh, you look terrible, if I may say, stranger. Perhaps one of these trinkets can be of some small help.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，你看起来糟透了，陌生人，或许这件小饰品能帮得到你。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You again? Then, here. Fates know I'll not be needing this.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 又是你？来吧。命运之神知道我已经不需要这些了。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Move right along, stranger. Let's skip the pleasantries.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 继续前进吧，陌生人。没什么好寒暄的。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: And here I thought you must have given up already.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我还以为你已经放弃了呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Enjoying the splendors of Elysium, yet, stranger?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 至福乐土还呆的惯吗，陌生人？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Don't let me interrupt your stay in paradise, stranger.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 可别让我打扰你的仙境之旅，陌生人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Returned to take more of these trinkets off my hands, have you?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 又回来从我手里拿走这些小饰品了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Oh, it's only you again, stranger. It's only me, as well.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，只能是你了，陌生人。确实是我。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Take one of these and then just leave me be, stranger.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 拿上这个，就离开吧，陌生人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I'd like to be alone again, stranger, so you go on ahead.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我想继续一个人呆着，陌生人，你只管前进便是。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: No need to linger with me, stranger. Go.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 没必要在我这里磨蹭。走吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Why your path keeps on crossing mine, I've not the slightest clue.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我完全不明白，为什么你老是来到我这里？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Some other time, stranger. Right now I'm preoccupied with sitting here.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 下次再见，陌生人。现在我要继续坐在这里了。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: There's nothing you can do to help me, stranger.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你没什么能帮到我的，陌生人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Can't you see I'm busy whiling away for all eternity?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你没看到我正忙着消磨永无止尽的时间吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: A fine whatever time it is to you, stranger.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 真是个美好的随便什么时间，陌生人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You haven't lost your will just yet, I see.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 看来你还没有丢失意志。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Expecting I'll still be right here next time, stranger.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 下次来的时候我还会在这里，陌生人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Just go, already, towards your next death or whatever else awaits.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 走吧，朝着你下一次死亡或者其他什么的继续前进。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You're back again, I see. And just in time to take one of these blasted things from me.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I'll wait for him, however long it takes. You tell him that.

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你又回来了。又来从我这里拿走这些该死的东西。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 不管多久，我都会等他。你这么跟他说。

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I pray Achilles is surviving well. And same for you.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我祈祷阿喀琉斯活得很好。你也一样。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: It's good of you to visit, though there's little I can offer in return.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你能来真是好啊，不过我能给你的东西不多了。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Please make yourself at home here in this corner of eternal paradise.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 在这个永恒仙境的角落里请不要拘束自己。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Do let Achilles know I'm doing well, and I'll be ever patient, here.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 一定要让阿喀琉斯知道，我在这里很好，这样我就会更有耐心。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I doubt there's much that I can do for you.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 恐怕我没什么可以帮你的了。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You're interfering with my quiet time, you know.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你在打扰我安静的时间，你知道吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Yes, what is it, this time?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，这次又怎么了？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Here's what I have that I can spare right now.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Might I somehow assist you, then?

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 这是我现在可以拿出手的东西。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我能协助你吗？

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Oh good, somebody's here to save me from myself.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，太好了，有人来陪我了。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: How can I be of use to you, stranger?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 有什么可以帮到你的，陌生人？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I've no shortage of time to spare, I guess.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我想我有的是时间。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Ah, just a stranger passing through, I see.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，我明白了，是有个陌生人来了。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Not in the mood for conversation now, stranger.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我现在没什么心情聊天，陌生人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Go on about your business, there, stranger.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 去忙你自己的事情吧，陌生人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Good fortune getting out of here, stranger.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 祝你顺利逃出冥界，陌生人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Here's something for the journey still to come.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 希望它能在你未来的旅途中帮得上忙。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Prepared to face the champion, soon, stranger?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 马上就要面对最强战士了，你准备好了吗，陌生人？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: May this aid you against the champion, out there.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 希望它能在你对抗最强战士的战斗中发挥作用。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Be careful with my brethren out there, stranger.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 要小心我那些同胞，陌生人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Battle with glory and all that, all right, stranger?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 心怀荣耀地战斗吧，好吗，陌生人？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I would prefer to be alone for now, stranger.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我想一个人待一会儿，陌生人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Just don't go starting any wars you don't intend to finish, stranger.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 如果不打算收拾烂摊子，就别随便挑起冲突，陌生人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.text: Leave me be to my eternal paradise, damn you.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText03

zh-CN.text: 让我一个人在这永恒仙境里呆着吧，走开。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText03

en.text: I shall not take up arms again, stranger, not even against you.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText03

zh-CN.text: 我不会再去战斗了，陌生人，对你也一样。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText03

en.text: Begone from here, we've nothing to discuss.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText03

zh-CN.text: 你走吧，我们没有什么好谈的。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText03

en.text: Go haunt some other corner of this realm; this one is mine.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText03

zh-CN.text: 到这个世界其他角落里烦人去吧，这里是我的。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText03

en.text: I thought I told you to leave me alone?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText04

zh-CN.text: 我不是让你离我远点吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText04

en.text: Do I look like I want to talk to you?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText04

zh-CN.text: 我看上去像是想跟你聊天的样子吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText04

en.text: What is it that you want from me this time?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText04

zh-CN.text: 你这次又想我怎么样？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText04

en.text: What would it take for you to leave me be?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText04

zh-CN.text: 你要我怎样你才肯走？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText04

en.text: Yes, what is it this time?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText04

zh-CN.text: 嗯，这次又怎么了？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText04

en.text: What would you have me do?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText04

zh-CN.text: 你想要我做什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText04

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: It's good to see you once again, stranger. Now, here.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 很高兴又见到你了，陌生人，过来吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: We're faring well enough, and may you fare the same.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我们一切都很顺利，也祝你一切顺利。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You've come to be a welcome sight, stranger.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 这里随时欢迎你，陌生人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: May you prevail in your battles still to come, stranger.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 祝你在接下来的战斗中旗开得胜，陌生人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: We were just wondering when you'd arrive, stranger.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我们刚刚还在想你什么时候会过来呢，陌生人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Achilles and I were just passing the time I guess.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜，我和阿喀琉斯之前只不过是在虚度时光吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I and Achilles here still have a lot of catching up to do.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我和阿喀琉斯还有很多事情要去做呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Fight like my friend here used to fight, stranger.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 勇猛地战斗吧，陌生人，就像我的朋友以前那样。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: May all your fears leave you behind once you walk past that door.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 当你踏出这扇门时，愿你所有的恐惧离你而去。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You'll show that champion of ours, won't you, stranger?

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你会让那个最强战士尝尝我们的厉害，没错吧，陌生人？

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I'm pleased to be of any help at all.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我很乐意为你效劳。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: First a visit from Achilles, and now you.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 阿喀琉斯刚刚来看过我了，现在你也来了。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Please stay as long as you would like here in our little glade.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 如果你喜欢这片小林地的话，愿意呆多久都可以。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Take caution with our battle-loving brethren around here.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 要当心我们那些沉迷于战斗的同胞们。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: If you can make yourself at home in such a place, please do, stranger.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 如果这里能给你像家一样的感觉的话，请不要拘束，陌生人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Just restocked on these battle-trinkets, if you'd like one, stranger.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我刚刚补充了战斗饰品的库存，不知道有没有你喜欢的，陌生人。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You've become quite the talk of all Elysium of late.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你最近成了至福乐土的焦点人物。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Our so-called champion isn't as popular around here as he used to be.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 在这个地方，我们那个所谓的“最强战士”，可不像他以前那么受人欢迎了。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I'm grateful for everything you've done.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 我很感激你所做的一切。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: For all your patience and your kindness.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 向你的耐心与仁慈致敬。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: I want you to have this.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 希望你能收下这个。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: Patroclus_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, look, I can tell you're struggling right now, and... maybe this isn't the way to help you through it all, but... I want you to have this.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Ahh, so you are taking pity on me, then? Well, I've no pride like many others here, so I shall take it. Though, let's make it a fair exchange, shall we?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道你现在内心煎熬……这也许不能帮你解决问题，但…我想让你收下这个。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，你又开始同情我了。我跟这里大部分骄傲的家伙不一样，我收下了。不过，我们还是要来场公平交易，怎么样？

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Why would you waste a proper vintage on the likes of me? Questions that are better left unanswered, I would guess.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: If this eases your burden even for a little while, then it's in good hands, as far as I'm concerned.

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 为何要在我身上浪费这样好的葡萄酒呢？我想这些问题还是不要回答的好。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果这些东西能稍微减轻哪怕一丁点你的负担，我的目的也就达到了。

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Ah, a means to drown my sorrows temporarily. That's good. And rather kind of you, I have to say.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's nothing. Thank you for not trying to slay me where I stand and boast about it, like seemingly everyone else around here.

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，借酒消愁。不错。我得说，你真是太好了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没什么的。感谢你没有跟这里其他人一样一个劲想杀死我，然后到处吹嘘。

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Oh. Here in Elysium you have to win this stuff, so I have rarely had occasion to enjoy it. Thanks.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'd say you earned it more than anybody else I've seen around here, lately. Though I don't make the rules.

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 噢。在至福乐土这里，你得自己去争取这些东西，所以我很少有机会能品尝这些。谢谢你。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 要我说，你比这里的其他任何人都配得上这东西。可惜，规矩也不是我定的。

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You owe me neither time nor generosity, and certainly not this. But if you truly have no better use for it...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's not a matter of owe, sir. Please open your mind to the possibility, nay the fact, that there are those who care about your wellbeing.

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你既不欠我时间也不欠我慷慨，更不欠我这个。但是如果你不需要它的话…

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这不是什么欠不欠的问题，先生。还请你敞开心扉，接受那些关心你的人。

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Just the relief from misery that I was looking for. A fleeting feeling, really, but I'll take a fleeting feeling over none.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That's both very dejected and very astute of you to say. Take care of yourself, will you?

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 只是从我寻求的痛苦中解脱出来。这种转瞬即逝的感觉，真的，总比没感觉好。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你这种说法，沮丧中又透露出一丝狡猾。自己保重，好吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Here, sir. The drink of the gods, themselves. Thought maybe you would like to try it! Just a small token of my appreciation for your selflessness with me, time after time.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You'd give the precious gift of Ambrosia to someone like me, stranger? A gloried thing like that. Why bother...? I should be just another shade to you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, you're not. You're someone I look forward to seeing here in Elysium, which is more than I can say for just about anybody else around here, so... please, enjoy it. Perhaps with Achilles.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Well... perhaps I'll try. You're not so bad, you know that, stranger? Careful with that, or you'll undermine the ruthless reputation that you have.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这是给你的礼物，先生。是众神的蜜酒，我觉得你可能会喜欢！你一次又一次毫无私心地帮助了我，这是我给你的小小回礼。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 这么珍贵的仙馔密酒，你真的要送给像我这样的人吗，陌生人？这么贵重的东西，太破费了吧……？对你来说，我应该不过就是个普普通通的幽灵而已吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 才不是呢，你就是我在至福乐土一直想遇到的人。我在这里见过了这么多人，几乎没人能比得上你。所以请好好享受蜜酒吧，如果能和阿喀琉斯一起的话，就再好不过了。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧……我会尝尝的。你知道吗？你其实并不太邪恶，陌生人。以善意待人的时候一定要小心，否则可能会损害你残忍无情的名声。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I don't see that last bottle of Ambrosia anywhere, which I can only take to mean... you need another. Here, sir. Thanks for seeing me through all of this, time after time.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You're thanking me, stranger? I've been here for some time, I think, and yet... some of your customs I'll admit remain quite strange to me. You've done more for me than I've any right to expect, from anyone.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's just a bottle of Ambrosia, sir, it's really no big deal. OK, fine, it's rather difficult to come by, but still!

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You jest, but I do not. I'd offer you my lifelong gratitude, but... well, you know.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You've got the rest of your life ahead of you, as far as I'm concerned. Here's to starting anew, right? You can call me Zagreus, or stranger, whatever suits you.

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: And... I'm Patroclus, by the way. I'm realizing now... we've not officially met. It's good to know you, Zagreus. Stranger.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 之前那瓶仙馔密酒已经不见了，我觉得这意味着……是时候再给你拿一瓶过来了。收下吧，先生，感谢你一次又一次地帮助我渡过难关。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你是在感谢我吗，陌生人？我已经来这里一段时间了，可你们的一些习俗在我看来还是很奇怪。你为我所做的一切，已经远远超出了我应得的待遇。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不过是瓶仙馔密酒罢了，算不上什么大不了的事情。没错，这瓶酒确实不太容易弄到，但我还是弄到了！

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你在开玩笑，但我是认真的。我今生今世都对你充满感激，不过……嗯，你懂的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 在我看来，你的余生才刚刚开始。你打算让一切重新开始，是吧？你可以叫我扎格列欧斯，或者叫我陌生人，只要你叫着顺口就行。

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 顺便一提……我叫普特洛克勒斯。我发现……我们还没正式地打过招呼呢。见到你很高兴，扎格列欧斯，陌生人。

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: You're much too kind to such a wretched shade, you know. But I'll not turn away this type of thing.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You don't attack me indiscriminately, I give you Nectar. I don't think I'm being over-generous!

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 你对一个可怜的暗灵来说真是太慷慨了。不过我不会拒绝这种东西。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
