zh-CN.text: 你不要无缘无故攻击我，我就会送你这蜜露。我可不认为我这是慷慨过头！

en.speaker: Patroclus
en.text: Forgive my bluntness, but, why go out of your way for me like this...?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm not going out of my way, sir. Look, I don't pretend to know the depths of your despair. But when I look at you, I'm reminded of how I've often felt. When I was in that dark place, someone said to me: Don't give up. If nothing else... it gives you something to do.

zh-CN.speaker: 普特洛克勒斯
zh-CN.text: 请原谅我的直言，但是你为什么要为了我这样的人做这种事呢…？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没你说的那么严重，先生。我不是假装知道你有多绝望。但是当我看到你的时候，我就会想起我曾经常有过的感觉。我在那黑暗的地方，有人对我说：不要放弃。哪怕没别的…这也会让你有事可做。

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hey, you must be the Hades kid! How's it going, then, Your Royal Majesty? Nice to meet you, I'm Eurydice. What brings a big important guy like you up to a place like this?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hi there! No need for formalities, I'm Zagreus. Just heading out on some official business! Surveying the magma situation firsthand. Don't mean to be rude, though I'm in a bit of a rush.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Well don't you have your hands full, hon! I'll let you go, but there's one rule in my place, which is: Nobody leaves here empty-handed, you got that? So take your pick, my treat!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你一定是哈迪斯的孩子吧！最近怎么样，我尊贵的殿下？很高兴见到你，我是欧律狄克。是什么风把你这样的大人物吹到我这个小地方来了？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你好！不用这样正式啦，我叫扎格列欧斯。只是出来例行公事。调查一下岩浆问题。不太好意思，但是我着实赶时间。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 可别把自己忙坏了，亲！你可以走，但是我这里有一条规矩：谁都不能空手而归，明白吗？那么拿好了噢，我请你的！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText01

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hey you must be the Hades kid! How's it going, then, Your Royal Majesty? Nice to meet you, I'm Eurydice. What brings a big important guy like you up to a place like this?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hi there! No need for formalities, I'm Zagreus. Just heading out on some official business. Past the menacing Bone Hydra. Don't mean to be rude, though I'm in a bit of a rush.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Well don't you have your hands full, hon! I'll let you go, but there's one rule in my place, which is: Nobody leaves here empty-handed, you got that? So take your pick, my treat!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你一定是哈迪斯的孩子吧！最近怎么样，我尊贵的殿下？很高兴见到你，我是欧律狄克。是什么风把你这样的大人物吹到我这个小地方来了？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你好！不用这样正式啦，我叫扎格列欧斯。只是出来例行公事。经过凶恶的骸骨九头蛇。不太好意思，但是我着实赶时间。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 可别把自己忙坏了，亲！你可以走，但是我这里有一条规矩：谁都不能空手而归，明白吗？那么拿好了噢，我请你的！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText01

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hey you must be the Hades kid! How's it going, then, Your Royal Majesty? Nice to meet you, I'm Eurydice. What brings a big important guy like you up to a place like this?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hi there! No need for formalities, I'm Zagreus. Just heading out on some official business. Say, if your name's Eurydice, I don't suppose you know an Orpheus, do you? Quite musically inclined, a little dour, impressive hair?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: He put you up to this? Look, hon, why don't you get on with your business, then. But you can't leave empty-handed, that's the rule, so take your pick, my treat! Nothing for him, though.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText01

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 嘿，你一定是哈迪斯的孩子吧！最近怎么样，我尊贵的殿下？很高兴见到你，我是欧律狄克。是什么风把你这样的大人物吹到我这个小地方来了？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你好！不用这样正式啦，我叫扎格列欧斯。只是出来例行公事。这么说，如果你是欧律狄克，你应该认识俄耳甫斯把？喜好音乐，有点严肃，引人注目的头发？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 他让你来的？听着，亲，你还是趁早离开吧。但是你不能空手而归，这是规矩，拿好了，我请的！没他的份。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText01

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hey, hon, what's going on, speak up! I know when something's up down to my roots, and something's up.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well it's just, I think that you may know an Orpheus, don't you? Quite musically inclined, a little dour, impressive hair? He's court musician in my father's house. Calls you his muse. Says he misses you terribly. I... thought you should know.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Orpheus said all that, huh? Tell you what, the next time you run into him, you ask him about the time that he came all this way to try and save me, even though I was already dead. Can you guess how that turned out?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm... yes, I do believe I can. Look, I didn't mean to upset you.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Yeah, well, neither did he! But you know what? Actions beat intentions, hon. Now, here, how about a treat and you can be on your way.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 嘿，亲，怎么了，跟我说说吧！当我觉得有问题的时候，就肯定有问题。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯就是，你认不认识俄耳甫斯？喜好音乐，有点严肃，引人注目的头发？他现在是我父亲圣殿里的宫廷乐师。他说你是她的缪斯。还说他非常想你。我…认为你应该要知道。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯亲口说的？告诉你，下次你碰到他的时候，你就问他，问他当时历尽艰难来救我的事情，尽管我当时就已经死了。你知道后来怎么了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃…我想我知道了。我不是想让你感到不快。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 是啊，没错，他也不想！你知道吗？行动才是一切，亲。别说了，拿好了，不送。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hey, hon, what's going on, speak up! I know when something's up down to my roots, and something's up.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well it's just, I think I wanted to tell you more of Orpheus, since... he's court musician in my father's house. Calls you his muse. Says he misses you terribly. I... thought you should know.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Orpheus said all that, huh? Tell you what, the next time you run into him, you ask him about the time that he came all this way to try and save me, even though I was already dead. Can you guess how that turned out?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm... yes, I do believe I can. Look, I didn't mean to upset you.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Yeah, well, neither did he! But you know what? Actions beat intentions, hon. Now, here, how about a treat and you can be on your way.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 嘿，亲，怎么了，跟我说说吧！当我觉得有问题的时候，就肯定有问题。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 就是，我认为我要多跟你说说俄耳甫斯的事，因为…他现在是我父亲圣殿里的宫廷乐师。他说你是她的缪斯。还说他非常想你。我…认为你应该要知道。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯亲口说的？告诉你，下次你碰到他的时候，你就问他，问他当时历尽艰难来救我的事情，尽管我当时就已经死了。你知道后来怎么了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃…我想我知道了。我不是想让你感到不快。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 是啊，没错，他也不想！你知道吗？行动才是一切，亲。别说了，拿好了，不送。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: What is it, hon? Oh no, don't tell me you've come all the way from Tartarus to ask me more about your good-for-nothing court musician friend.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Certainly not! I'm merely here for your wonderful singing, cooking, or conversational ability. Though, since you mentioned it, you... seem to have a lot to say to him. Is there anything I can do?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: So let me see if I understand. Orpheus blew it with me like an idiot, but now I'm supposed to be reaching out to him? Sorry, hon, but that's not happening. The two of us are finished. And, you know what? I think we're finished here, too. If you'll excuse me!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 怎么了，亲？噢不，别告诉我你一路从塔耳塔罗斯过来，就为了向我打听你那个一无是处的宫廷乐师朋友。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 当然不是！我来这里只是为了欣赏你美妙的歌唱、烹饪以及交流技巧。不过，既然你提到了，你…好像有很多话要对他说。有什么我能帮忙的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 看看我是否能理解。俄耳甫斯像个白痴一样把事情搞砸了，现在还指望我去找他？对不起，亲，这是不可能的。我跟他之间已经结束了。还有。你也趁早走吧。不好意思！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hey there, hon! So what do you think, pretty good tune, right? Don't know how come everybody doesn't sing. Lightens the mood, passes the time. What's not to like?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's a beautiful song. Even though you're angry with him... Orpheus, I mean... you're always singing, still?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Oh it's not Orpheus' song, you kidding me? This one's all mine. He always did like going on about how I'm his muse, well, that's 'cause I wrote half his songs for him! Bet he didn't mention that, did he.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, not exactly in those words, but... Orpheus can be a little hard to parse.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: He can be a little hard to tolerate. A quality I hope isn't going to rub off on any of his mates. I should get back to practicing, see you.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 你好，亲！你觉得怎么样，非常好的曲子，对吧？不知道为什么其他人不唱歌。放松心情，消磨时间。有什么不好的？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 真是首不错的歌啊。尽管你生他的气。俄耳甫斯，我是说…你现在还经常在唱歌吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 噢，这不是俄耳甫斯的歌，开玩笑吗？这首歌是我自己创作的。他总说我是他的缪斯女神，因为他的歌有一半都是我给他写的！我敢说他从没提到过这件事。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，只是说法有点不同…俄耳甫斯他有点复杂。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 他也有点难让人接受。希望这种品质不会影响到他的同伴。我要回去继续练习了，再见。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Look, Eurydice, I promise not to bother you with this each time, but... you should know your husband's shattered by what happened with the two of you. He's genuinely sorry, and he loves you very deeply, still, I'm sure of it.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Tsk... and what am I supposed to do with that, Your Royal Majesty...?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I... I don't know yet. Though, you know what? You shouldn't take my word for it. You should take his.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Don't think I will be running into him anytime soon from what I understand. But you're the Hades kid! You want to pull some strings on our behalf, go right ahead, I guess. But I won't hold my breath. Even if I could.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 听着，欧律狄克，我每次都保证不会拿这个烦扰你，但是…你俩的事情让你的丈夫很受打击。他真的非常内疚，而且他还是深爱着你，这点我敢肯定。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 啧…那我应该怎么做呢，我的王子殿下…？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我…我不知道。我告诉你噢。你不应该只听我说的。你也要听他怎么说。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 据我所知，我近期内应该不会再遇到他了。但你可是哈迪斯的孩子啊！如果你想在我俩之间牵线搭桥，做就是了。但这是不可能的。就算我有这个能力。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: So, uh, how's Orpheus been doing lately, anyway? Still keeping his hair in those neat little curls? I guess his tan must have faded by now.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Curls? Erm, not exactly, no. But he's doing all right! For him. He's started singing again, lately, which was a big step. He never used to, before. Would go on about how he'd lost his muse.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: And now he knows I'm out there, still, huh. That's... well, thank you for the update, hon. Music's his gift. Good to know he's not thrown everything away.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 那么，呃，俄耳甫斯最近怎么样了？还是留着那头整洁的小卷发吗？我敢说他的皮肤一定都褪色了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 卷发？呃，算不上吧，不过他现在过得还不错，最近又开始唱歌了！这是个相当不错的进步，因为他以前从来没唱过歌，他总是不断地说他是如何失去了他的缪斯。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 现在他知道我就在这外头了。真是…嗯，谢谢你带来的消息，亲。他没把自己的音乐天赋荒废掉，真是太好了。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Eurydice, can I ask you for a favor here? Not that you owe me anything, but, would you hear me out?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Yeah, sure, hon, what is it? Though you had better not be asking for my recipes. Closely guarded family secret! I'd say I'd take them to my grave, but... yeah.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's not your recipes, though they are wonderful. It's your song. I'm sure it'd be a hit around the House! And, I know someone who really needs to hear it. Don't suppose you've got a parchment-copy I could have?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Your Royal Majesty, you want my song? You are aware it's called 'Good Riddance', right? Tsk, but sure, why not. If music's going to be playing in your House, it might as well be great. And let me give you something to go with it.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 欧律狄克，我能请你帮个忙吗？不是说你欠我什么，不过，你能听我说吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 没问题，亲，你说吧。不过你最好不要问我食谱的事。这是家族秘密！要我说，我会把这个秘密带进坟墓里，不过…

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不是食谱的事，尽管真的非常美味。是你的歌。这首歌一定能在圣殿里爆红的！而且，我知道有谁要去听一听这歌。你应该有羊皮纸副本吧，能给我吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 王子殿下，你想要我的歌？你应该知道歌名叫《彻底解放》对吧？啧，那好吧，给你了。如果音乐在你的圣殿中奏响，应该也不错。然后我要给你点东西你才能走。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: ...What'd he say, hon? I mean about the song. Bet he loved it, didn't he! But, I don't know for sure. And I've been wondering, kind of a lot, I guess.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No need to wonder any longer. He sings it beautifully, around the House sometimes. It... has a sadder sound to it than when you sing, but... you've inspired him again. As you've done many times before, from what I know.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Huh. So it's a hit, is what you're saying, then. I had a feeling about that one. Sometimes you put some words together and right then and there, you know that you've got something special.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: ……关于这首歌，他是怎么说的，亲爱的？我打赌他肯定喜欢，是不是！但我不敢确定。这段时间，我一直不断想起这个问题。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不用再想了。他唱歌非常动听，有时候他会绕着圣殿唱。听起来比你唱的时候要多一点哀伤，但是…你又给了他灵感。就像你以前做的那样，就我所知。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 嗯。大获成功，你是这么说的吧？我预感到了。有时候你总是可以在正确的场合说正确的话，你知道，你很有天赋。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: What happens now, hon...? What I mean is... now you got me thinking about Orpheus again, so... what am I supposed to do with that?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Even if you can't be together right now, I hope it feels better knowing how much he cares for you. And I will try to pull some strings, like you said. I can't make promises where my father's concerned, but... I'll do everything I can.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Well, what can I tell you? Thanks, Your Royal Majesty. That means a lot. No pressure, though. I've been all right without him all this time, and I will be all right, no matter what. If only he could say the same.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 现在怎么了，亲…？我意思是…你现在又让我想起俄耳甫斯了，所以…我要怎么做才好？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 即使你们现在无法在一起，我希望在知道他很关心你以后，你可以好过些。而且我会私底下想想办法，就像你说的那样。我没办法打包票说我的父亲关心什么，但是……我会竭尽所能。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 嗯，我要怎么说呢？谢谢你，王子殿下。这件事意义重大。不过别有压力。我在没有他的日子里不也过得挺好的嘛，以后也会一样的。如果他也能这样说的话。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hey, listen here a moment, Hades kid. Look, I... Thank you. From the bottom of my heart. For bringing Orphy back to me again, and everything.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Eurydice, you're more than welcome, really. You've helped me through the flames of hell, time after time. Least I could do is coax old Orpheus out of his private pit of despair so you and he could set things right between the two of you.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Well, you're a real sweetheart, hon. You'll still be seeing Orphy all the time around your House, but now, I get to see him, too. Nice having something to look forward to, you know? Bet someone out there feels that about you.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 嗨，听我一下，哈迪斯的小孩。 是这样，我... 从我的心底，谢谢你。 再次将俄耳带回我身边，还有其他一切。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 真的，欧律狄刻，你真是太客气了。你一次又一次助我闯过了这地狱之火。帮老俄耳甫斯摆脱内心的绝望，让他能够处理好你们之间的问题，这是我应该做的。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 你真是太贴心了，亲爱的。你现在依然能在圣殿见到俄耳，不过这次我也要去见他了。有点期待，真的很不错啊，你说呢？我敢说肯定有人对你也有同样的感觉。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hey! What's the matter, Your Royal Majesty? You're looking kind of down. Normally you're all smiles, for whatever reason!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, I... well, looking back, all this stuff between you and Orpheus, I realized... well, I hope I wasn't too pushy about the whole thing. It wasn't any of my business to pry into your personal life. I should have asked.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Oh, that? Pff, come on, don't even worry about it. If you were being too pushy, you better believe I would have put you back in your place, royalty or not. But hey, can't ever be too careful when it comes to people's past and feelings and stuff, right?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 嘿！这是怎么了，殿下？你看起来很低落啊。平时无论发生什么，你都是满面笑容的！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，我……回头想想你和俄耳甫斯之间的事情，我突然意识到……希望我没有太操之过急吧。我并不应该窥探你们之间的私事，我应该提前和你说一声才对。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 哦，这件事吗？噗，你可千万别担心这件事情。如果你真的操之过急的话，那我恐怕早就把你撵回去了，才不会管你是不是什么王子呢。不过，当涉及到别人的过去、感受之类的事情，再怎么谨慎也不为过，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Got to tell you, hon. Orpheus sure is different since last he and I met. You know, back when he was still living and breathing and all.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I think the experience of trying to rescue you, failing, dying, becoming court musician, refusing to sing, then being locked in solitary confinement, then finding out about you probably did a number on him. Why, is everything all right? You seemed to be getting along last I saw.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Oh, we're getting along great! Better than ever. He used to be a bit more of a hotshot, but now it's like, he's a little more... what's the word... sensitive? Now I can always tell exactly what's on his mind.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 说真的，亲爱的，俄耳甫斯和上次见面的时候变得不一样了。我是说，他变得充满生机，就像是还活着的时候那样。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜这可能是因为他试着救你，结果失败了，自己后来也死了，死后成了宫廷乐师，却拒绝唱歌，结果被单独监禁了起来，之后得知了你的事情，可能这一切给他的压力太大了吧。怎么了，一切还好吗？自从上次见到你们之后，你们好像一直相处得很好。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 哦，我们相处得很好！比以前更好了。他以前多多少少有点端着架子，不过现在呢，他变得更加……那个词怎么说来着……多愁善感？他现在在想什么，我一眼就看得出来。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hey, Your Royal Majesty! I must say you've accomplished some truly amazing feats, according to Orphy at least! But don't worry. Your secret's safe with me.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, no, he's been boasting of my fabricated exploits to you? I've tried to tell him I was only joking with him but now he just thinks I'm being modest.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: That modesty won't get you anywhere with me, either, hon, Your Greatness. I'm honored to merely be in the presence of one with so many wild exploits to sing or speak of!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 嘿，王子殿下！不得不说你完成了一些相当了不起的壮举，至少在俄耳看来是这么回事！不过不用担心，你的秘密我是不会说出去的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，不是吧，他真的把我编出来的传奇故事和你说了？我之前想让他明白，我只是在和他开玩笑而已，但他似乎觉得我只是谦虚而已。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 跟我你就不用谦虚了，亲爱的王子殿下。你有那么多值得传颂的丰功伟绩，仅仅是站在你面前，我就已经感觉非常光荣了！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey did Orpheus really use to have curls, and... something called a tan? I've only ever seen him looking... well, how he does now.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: He did! And a tan is like... well, when you stay out in the hot sun up there long enough, your skin kind of starts to bake a little bit. But nicer than that sounds! Got to say, though, the years have been kind to Orphy, don't you think?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯以前真的留着卷发吗，而且……据说还“晒黑”了？我只见过他……呃，他现在的样子。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 是啊！晒黑的意思就是……这么说吧，当你在烈日之下呆了太长时间之后，你的皮肤就会开始发黑，不过实际上要比我说得好多了！不过我得说，俄耳这些年里一直保养得不错，你不这么觉得吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Say, tell me something, there, Your Royal Majesty. You know a lot of shades. You wouldn't happen to know an Orpheus, would you? Spindly little thing, whiny voice? Heard he's officially serving in your court. Making music!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Of course I know Orpheus, we're mates! Wait, why do you ask?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: You're mates, huh. Just as long as you don't count on him for anything. Hasn't even mentioned me, has he. Well if he ever does, you tell him I am doing great! I'm great.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 有件事我想了解一下，王子殿下。你认识很多幽灵，不会碰巧认识一个叫俄耳甫斯的吧？身材纤瘦，嘀嘀咕咕的？听说他是你们的宫廷乐师，还负责创作音乐！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我当然认识俄耳甫斯了，我们可是朋友呢！等下，你问这个干什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 呵，你们是朋友啊。他这人，别的都好，就是有点不靠谱。他提都没提过我，是不是。如果他有问起我的话，你就跟他说，我很好！很好。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: What's the latest, hon, anything been happening down in your fancy House lately?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, you mentioned Orpheus... my father had him locked up for a little while for refusing to sing. Being court musician and all. But he's out now, and doing OK! I think.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Not following instructions, huh. Sounds like Orpheus, all right. Well, if that's the most exciting thing you've got going on, then I haven't missed much being out here.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 最近怎么样，亲爱的？你漂亮的圣殿里最近发生什么事情了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，你之前提到的俄耳甫斯……他是宫廷乐师之类的，但他拒绝给我父亲唱歌，所以我父亲把他关了一阵子。不过他已经出来了，我觉得他挺好的。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 不肯听令吗，呵，听起来还真像是俄耳甫斯的风格。好吧，如果这就是你那边最有意思的事情的话，那我看来没错过太多。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hey, what's up, hon? Say, you must know a lot of big shots, don't you? Other gods and all that?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I know a few. As a matter of fact, I heard recently from Hermes, wanted you to know he felt sorry for how things ended up. That something to do with when Orpheus went in here after you?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Oh, that's sweet of him! Nice enough guy, for an Olympian. Yeah, he was the one who dropped me off here in the first place. No hard feelings here, he was just doing his job. It was Orpheus who messed everything up.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 嘿，怎么了，亲爱的？你肯定认识很多重要人物吧？比如其他的神之类的？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我确实认识几个。说实话，我最近还听到了赫尔墨斯的消息，他想让我告诉你，他对你们之间的事情很遗憾。你来这里之后，俄耳甫斯也来了，是和这件事有关吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 哦，他可真贴心！以奥林匹斯神的标准看，他已经相当好了。是啊，当初把我送到这里的人就是他。不过我不难过，他只是公事公办而已，把事情搞砸的人是俄耳甫斯。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Sure don't see a lot of other nymphs around here, huh! We don't die too easy, most of us. Makes me feel all special!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I've never met another nymph, now that you mention it. Heard of a few! The goddess Artemis, sounds like she spends more time with nymphs than the other Olympians.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: That's what I heard! Though it's not like we all hang out, I mean, you've got the dryads, and the naiads, and the nereids, and the oceanids... pretty much every type of terrain up top, there's a kind of nymph who loves it! Maybe we need a name for Underworld nymphs, too.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 这个地方确实没多少仙女，是吧！我们仙女不怎么容易死，绝大多数是这样，这让我感觉自己与众不同！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 被你这么一说，我发现确实没见过其它仙女，不过我听说过几个！阿尔忒弥斯女神似乎更喜欢和仙女们呆在一起，而不是和其他的奥林匹斯众神打交道。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 我也是这么听说的！不过我们也并不是全都能打成一片。我是说，这世上有林中仙女、溪中仙女、湖中仙女、海中仙女……差不多无论是什么样的地方，总会有一种仙女很喜欢！说不定咱们也应该弄个冥界仙女出来才是。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Eurydice, did you by any chance ever meet a Persephone during the whole thing when Orpheus came down to try to get you?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Oh, her? Yeah, she was with Hades Senior, why? Wait. Whoa. Are you...? I thought...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's complicated. And, please keep it quiet. I was just wondering... what was she like? If you recall.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Didn't get much of an impression, but I can tell you this: She had good taste in music! Orpheus and I, think we won her over with our little duet. Haven't seen or heard from her lately, though. Look, I hope everything's OK.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 欧律狄刻，俄耳甫斯过来找你，想把你救出冥界的这个过程中，你有没有刚好见过一个叫珀尔塞福涅的人？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 哦，她吗？是啊，她那时和哈迪斯大人在一起，怎么了？等等，哇啊，你该不会是……？我就在想……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这件事情很复杂，希望你不要说出去。我很好奇……她是个什么样子的人呢？如果你还能想起来的话。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 她的样子我没太记住，不过有件事可以告诉你：她在音乐方面的品味非常出色！我觉得，那时我和俄耳甫斯的二重奏赢得了她的好感。不过最近我都没怎么见过她了，希望一切都还好。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Eurydice, did you by any chance ever meet a Persephone during the whole thing when Orpheus came down to try to get you?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Oh, her? Yeah, she was with Hades Senior, why? Wait. Whoa. Are you...? I thought...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's complicated. And, please keep it quiet. I was just wondering... what was she like? If you recall.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Didn't get much of an impression, but I can tell you this: She had good taste in music! Orpheus and I, think we won her over with our little duet. Haven't seen or heard from her lately, though.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 欧律狄刻，俄耳甫斯过来找你，想把你救出冥界的这个过程中，你有没有刚好见过一个叫珀尔塞福涅的人？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 哦，她吗？是啊，她那时和哈迪斯大人在一起，怎么了？等等，哇啊，你该不会是……？我就在想……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这件事情很复杂，希望你不要说出去。我很好奇……她是个什么样子的人呢？如果你还能想起来的话。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 她的事情我不太清楚，不过这一点我可以肯定：她在音乐方面的品味非常出色！我觉得，之前我和俄耳甫斯的二重奏赢得了她的好感。不过最近我都没怎么见过她了。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hey, everybody's saying Persephone... she's back? That sounds like a bit of good news, there, isn't that right, hon?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, she is back, and yes, it is good news, thank you. She and I have a lot of making up for lost time left to do, though I think we're off to a pretty decent start.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Well, that's a relief. And, you're still here! So I guess you've got more official business to take care of, which means I've still got somebody to taste-test for me every now and then!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 嘿，每个人都在谈论珀尔塞福涅的事情……她回来了吗？听起来像是个不错的消息，你不怎么觉得吗，亲爱的？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，她是回来了。而且没错，这是个好消息，谢谢。我和她得好好弥补一下错过的时光，不过我觉得已经有了个不错的开端。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 哎呀，这可真让人欣慰，而且你也还会留在这里！所以我猜你有更多公务要处理了，也就是说，还会有人时不时地来看看我，尝尝我做的点心！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Orphy tells me the Queen, she's been settling in just fine down at your House! Must be different having a lady like that around. How's Hades Senior taking it, if I may ask?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, he's taking it... about as well as he's taken anything ever, now that you mention it. Still very much himself, mind you, but still... it's been a welcome change.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Glad to hear it! Orphy always liked singing for an audience more than I did, and it sounds like she's a good one.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 俄耳和我说，冥后刚刚在你的圣殿里安顿下来了！那个地方有了女主人之后，肯定和以前大不一样了。哈迪斯大人怎么样了，不知方不方便透露一下？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哦，既然你提起来了，父亲正在接受这些变化……就像他接受其它的事情一样。我得提醒你，他和之前没什么太大区别，不过……这总归是个可喜的变化。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 真是个好消息！和我相比，俄耳更喜欢唱歌的时候有人听，听起来她是个不错的听众。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: You ever play any music, or sing or anything yourself, Hades kid? It's good for you, you know!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I play a bit of the lyre, as a matter of fact! Orpheus himself gave me some pointers on it. Never really tried singing, though. I can't even imagine it, really.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Well, might I recommend giving it a shot at some point? Who knows, you might be the next Orpheus!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 你有没有演奏过，或是唱过歌什么的，哈迪斯之子？这对你的身心有好处，真的！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 老实说，我试过弹奏里拉琴！俄耳甫斯本人也给了我一些建议。不过我还没试过唱歌呢，老实说，我根本想象不出来我唱歌的样子。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，或许你有空的话可以试试？说不定你就是下一个俄耳甫斯，谁知道呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: You been snacking on onions or something, there, hon? No offense or anything, but you smell like you ate a whole one of them raw.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, yes, but... wait. How else are you supposed to eat those things?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: What, are you kidding me? You can grill them, sauté them, fry them, boil them, pickle them, roast them! Oh, hon. You've been missing out.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 你最近是吃了洋葱之类的东西吗，亲爱的？无意冒犯，但你的味道闻起来像是生吃了一整颗洋葱。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，是啊，不过……等等，洋葱不就是应该生吃的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 怎么，你是认真的吗？洋葱可以烤、可以炸、可以炒、可以煮、可以腌、可以熏！哦，亲爱的。你错过了多少美味啊。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: You got anyone special in your life, by the way, hon? You seem like you'd be good for somebody out here.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know what, yes, I do, Eurydice. Things have moved so fast for me lately I barely stopped to think about it, though. It helps not having to go through everything alone... just knowing I'll see them again soon.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Know what you mean. And hey, that's great! Long as you can still be yourself. I've known too many nymphs, their whole lives revolved around somebody they loved. I bet whoever it is that loves you... it's because of who you are.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 顺便问一句，你的心里有没有某个特别的人，亲爱的？你看起来似乎对这里的某个人有好感。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 老实说，是啊，欧律狄刻。不过，最近发生的事情实在是太多了，我都没什么机会好好思考这些事情。这样一来，我就不用什么事情都自己扛着了……我知道，我很快就能再见到那个人了。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 我明白你的意思，这不是很好嘛！只要你依然能坚持内心就好。有的仙女一生都在追逐她们心爱的人，这种仙女我已经见过太多了。在我看来，无论是谁爱你……都是因为她们爱的是你这个人。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Eurydice, how long have you been down here, anyway, if you don't mind my asking? Seems like you're pretty settled in. It's quite a lovely place!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: How long have I been down here, hon? Huh! I don't have the faintest. You lose your sense of time once you're a shade, or maybe once there's not a sun or moon over your head. But yeah, I found myself a decent spot and fixed it up a bit!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 欧律狄克，你来这里多久了，不介意我问的话？你好像很自在的样子，这地方真的挺不错的！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 我来这里多久了啊，亲爱的？哈！我自己都不记得了。一旦成为了暗灵，你就失去时间观念了，或者头顶没有太阳也没有月亮的时候。不过，我给自己找到了一块好地方，稍微修缮了一下！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: You're just in time, Your Royal Majesty! Got something real good cooking right here that you are going to love. You hungry, yeah?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Am I ever. You're always so generous. And you're always cooking! And singing. Do you have many guests come by? Your place seems... somewhat off the beaten path.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: What, you think I get a lot of guests, here? Haha, no, but I like cooking anyway! It's like singing, in a way. Keep getting better the more you try, turns out a bit different each time.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 你来的正是时候，我的殿下！我正在做饭呢，一定会让你胃口大开的。你饿了吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 非常饿。你总是如此慷慨。你总是在烹饪！在唱歌！经常有客人来吗？你的这个地方…有点偏僻。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 怎么了，你觉得我这里经常来客人？哈哈，不，但是我喜欢烹饪！某些方面来说，这就像唱歌。尝试次数越多，就会变得更好，但是每次都好像有点不同。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Eurydice, how can you cook so much with all the searing heat around these parts? Has it been magma-flooded like this all the time?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: The searing heat? Haha, I am dead, Your Royal Majesty! Searing's just a cooking technique to me. Don't need to sleep, either! I can just keep cooking up a storm. It's not so bad!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 欧律狄克，你是怎么在这种炙热环境下煮出这些东西的？这里一直都是这样烈焰滚滚吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 炙热的温度？哈哈，我已经是个死人了，王子殿下！炙热对我来说只能拿来烹饪。我也不用睡觉！我想怎么烹就怎么烹。还不错！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know, I've never met a nymph before. You're closer to the gods than mortals, right?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Yeah, gods that can die! How is that fair? Was just a stupid snake bite in my case, can you imagine something more embarrassing? You're just minding your business, and then snap! You're dead, and on your way down here.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I... know the feeling better than you might expect.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Well, I was going to end up here sooner or later. Might as well while I'm still looking good. Though, I guess you do kind of get to lock in whatever age when you register. Bet everybody dying of old age pushed that one through.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道，我从来没有遇见过仙女呢。你比凡人更接近神，对吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 是啊，会死的神！太不公平了？我只不过是被一条愚蠢的蛇咬了一口，你知道这有多尴尬吗？你在那正忙着自己的事呢，然后突然间！你就死了，一路到了这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我…对这种感觉理解颇深。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 我是一直困在这里了。希望我一直这样好下去。不过，我想你们应该是在进来的时候就锁定了年龄了吧？要是每个人都老死可就难堪了。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: What's your official business, anyway, Your Royal Majesty? Seems like it's bringing you through Asphodel an awful lot lately.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's... look, the truth is, I am trying to get out of here. I've hit some stumbling blocks along the way, but, I think I will make it there, eventually.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Oh really! Say no more, I know how that is. Hope the Fates will look the other way for you. Getting out of here, huh. Not thought of that myself in I don't know how long...

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 那你的公事是什么呢，王子殿下？似乎你最近经常到水仙花平原里来。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 就是…我还是说实话吧，我打算逃离这个地方。我在前进的路上遇到了一些障碍，不过我觉得自己一定能够成功的。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 真的吗！别说了，我知道你的意思。希望命运之神眷顾你。逃离这里，嗯。连我自己都不知道多久产生过这个想法了。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Of all the lava rocks in Asphodel, the Hades kid found this one once again, wouldn't you know! You got a map or something to this place, or what?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Don't know that a map would help me much since things keep shifting out here every single time. Though it is an interesting coincidence how I keep running into you.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Coincidence? Come on, hon, you're a god. Someone out there is sending you my way. Maybe it's just the Fates. Ah well! I sure don't mind a little company. And I have lots to eat!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 在水仙花平原上所有的岩浆岩中，哈迪斯的孩子又找到了我这个地方！你是有张地图吗，还是什么别的？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 外头的东西时刻都在变化，我想地图应该没什么用处吧。但我不停地碰见你真是有趣的巧合啊。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 巧合？别傻了，亲，你可是神。一定是有人把你送到我这里来。也许是命运之神呢。啊好吧！我不介意有人陪伴。我这里吃的也不少！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Eurydice, wanted to thank you once again for this enchanted acorn that you gave me. So this is what plants and things grow from, up on the surface?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Oh, not just any plants, hon! Trees! Big gnarled oaks and things. Some of them live hundreds of years! Way up there as mortals go. You take good care of it like that, maybe it'll grow to be something special for you, too!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 欧律狄克，再次谢谢你送我这颗令人着迷的橡子。这是凡界的植物长出来的？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 哦，它可不是普普通通的植物，亲爱的！是一种树！长满树叶的高大橡树。有些可以活几百年呢！它比凡人的生命长得多。你像这样看管好它，没准它也能长成一棵与众不同的树呢！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hey, this is sort of a weird question, but... this Evergreen Acorn, it's not... related to you, is it? Since, you know, you're... partly oak, aren't you?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Yeah, I'm part oak, that's right. But maybe not the part you're thinking of, I mean, you think I would just hand you one of my babies or something? Hahahaha, that's disgusting!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嘿，我有个奇怪的问题……这颗常绿橡子，应该和你……没什么关系吧？因为，一半的你也是……橡树，对吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 没错，我有一半是橡树。但可能和你想得不一样，你以为我会把我的宝贝或其他什么送给你吗？哈哈哈哈，那也太恶心了！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hold on, hon, is that... huh! Almost felt like Orpheus was with you there. Would you listen to me? Must have been singing too many high notes, or something.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No, wait, you're onto something... I think you must have sensed Orpheus' Distant Memory! He gave it to me as a keepsake of our friendship. Though, something like this... I feel like it should belong to you.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Oh, that's him in there all right! See, I never should have second-guessed myself. Well, you hang onto that, as I've got plenty memories of him already, thanks!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 等等，亲爱的，那是……呃！我感觉好像俄耳甫斯就在你身边一样。我这是在说什么傻话呢？肯定是我最近练高音练得太多了吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不，等等，你说得没错……我觉得肯定是感觉到了俄耳甫斯的遥远记忆！他把这件礼物给了我，作为我们友情的信物。不过像这样的东西……我觉得给你更合适。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 噢，所以说那就是他嘛！你看，我就知道自己的感觉没错。没事，这件礼物你继续留着吧，我这里关于他的记忆已经够多了，谢谢！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Oh, hon, you look awful. What did you get yourself into? Here, one of these should make you feel a little better.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 哦，亲爱的，你看起来糟透了。你这是碰上了什么事情啊？来，吃点点心吧，这样应该能让你舒服一些。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Oh, you look like you've been through a lot, Hades kid. Maybe a decent bite to eat will help!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 哦，你看起来真是经历了不少磨难啊，哈迪斯之子。或许吃点好东西就能舒服些了！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Oof, you're a mess, there, hon. You save your strength and see if this will do you any good.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 哎唷，你的情况真是糟透了，亲爱的。你得省着点体力，看看这些能不能帮得上忙吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hey, don't go bleeding on my floor, hon. I just cleaned the place! Take one of these, maybe it'll tide you over.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 嘿，可别把血弄到我的地板上，亲爱的。这地方我才刚刚擦干净！来吃点东西吧，或许这样你就能挺过去了。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Why not have a quick bite of something to eat before you head on out, hon?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 临走之前尝一尝这里的美味佳肴吧，亲爱的？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Sing when you're happy, sing when you're not, Your Royal Majesty.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 如果开心你就唱唱歌，如果不开心，你也唱唱歌，王子殿下。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hey, it's the Hades kid! So what's it going to be this time, Your Royal Majesty?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 嘿，是哈迪斯的孩子！这次有什么事呢，王子殿下？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: I'd say make yourself at home, hon, but you look like you got cooler places to be!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 在这里可别太拘束，亲，不过你看上去好像很热的样子！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: You are just in time, Your Royal Majesty! Cooked up something special just for you.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 你来的正好，王子殿下！专门为你做了好吃的噢。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Why, Your Royal Majesty, you're back! Well, see you later!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 什么，王子殿下，你回来了！嗯，回头见！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: And here I was just thinking it's been too long since the Hades kid stopped by!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 我还在想怎么哈迪斯的孩子这么久都没来了！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: So what'll it be this time, Your Royal Majesty, hmm?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 这次有什么事呢，王子殿下？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Oh you look positively famished, hon! Here let me help with that.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 你看起来很饿呢，亲！我来帮帮你。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: You must be hungry, hon. Got something ought to keep you going!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 你一定饿了吧，亲。来吃点东西好继续前进！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: How nice of you to stop on by, Your Royal Highness! Here!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 你能来看我真是太好了，王子殿下！这里！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: How's it going lately, hon, you eating well and everything?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 最近怎么样，亲，有吃好睡好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Just singing to myself and cooking up a storm. You know me, hon.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 边唱歌边烹饪。你知道我的，亲！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eat up, hon! Not like I got other mouths to feed!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 吃完，亲！我又没有其他人可以喂了！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: All's well in Asphodel, Your Royal Majesty! You take care of yourself. I'll be here.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 水仙花平原一切如常，王子殿下！你一定要照顾好自己，我会在这里等你的。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: You want the best cooking in all of Asphodel, you know where to go!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 如果想尝尝整个水仙花平原最美味的点心，该去哪里你再清楚不过了！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hey, it's the Hades kid! What's it going to be this time, hm?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 嘿，这不是哈迪斯之子嘛！这次又有什么事了呢，嗯？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Take care of yourself out there, all right, Your Royal Majesty?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 在外面的时候要照顾好自己，好吗，王子殿下？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Don't let Hades Senior get you down, hon. Here.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 可别被哈迪斯大人打垮，亲爱的。来，给你的。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: I know you've got important business to attend to, so thanks for checking in, Your Royal Majesty.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 我知道你有很重要的事情要办，所以谢谢你能抽空来看我，王子殿下。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: You look like you're in a rush, though there's always time for a quick snack, right?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 你看起来很急，不过吃点点心的时间总归是有的，是吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hey, welcome back, Your Royal Majesty, you're just in time!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 嘿，欢迎回来，王子殿下，你来得正是时候！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Been trying to perfect these recipes for I don't know how long!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 我一直在不断改进那些配方，我自己都不知道做了多久！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: You look like you haven't eaten since you were here last!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 您看起来就像上次来这里之后，就再也没吃过东西了！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: You're always welcome here Your Royal Majesty.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 这里的大门永远为您敞开，我的殿下。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: I get you something for the road there, hon?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 亲爱的，我这里有些路上用的东西，需要吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: What's it going to be, Your Royal Majesty?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 您有什么吩咐，王子殿下？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: You just be sure to tell that good-for-nothing Orpheus I'm looking good.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 你一定要告诉那个一无是处的俄耳甫斯我现在很好！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hon, I'd ask how old what's-his-name is doing, but I don't even care!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 亲，我想问一下老东西现在怎么样了，但是我不想知道答案！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Bet you Orpheus hasn't had any strokes of musical genius lately, now, has he?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯最近应该没有任何突如其来的天才音乐灵感吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Better not be Orpheus putting you up to visiting here all the time like this.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 最好别是俄耳甫斯让你一天到晚往这里跑的。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: This song's better than anything Orpheus ever came up with I can tell you that.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 我可以告诉你这首歌比俄耳甫斯写的任何歌都要好！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: If you'll excuse me, Your Royal Majesty, I'm not exactly in the mood for an extended chat.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 如果你不介意的话，王子殿下，我现在没有心情聊天。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: You best have no more messages from no-good Orpheus this time.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 你这次最好不要带来任何没用的俄耳甫斯的消息。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Here, have a snack, hon, and tell Orpheus it was delicious.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 来吧，吃点点心，亲，然后回去告诉俄耳甫斯好吃极了。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: You keep an eye on Orpheus for me, all right, hon?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 帮我看好俄耳甫斯好吗，亲？

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Do one thing for me, hon. Make sure Orpheus knows I'll be right here.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 帮我个忙好吗，亲。一定让俄耳甫斯知道，我就在这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: I've got to be honest with you, hon. Sometimes I kind of miss him.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 我要跟你说实话，亲，有时候，我还挺想他的。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Sometime you'll visit me like this and Orpheus is going to be here too.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 总有一天，你来看我的时候，俄耳甫斯也会在这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Don't let Orpheus get into too much trouble, won't you, hon?

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 可别让俄耳甫斯惹太多麻烦噢，亲。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: I'm fine here on my own, hon. But, I wouldn't mind if he was here.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 我一个人在这里过得挺好的。但是，我不介意他也能过来。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hope Orpheus is on the up-and-up down where you live.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 希望俄耳甫斯在你那里能过得越来越好。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: I'd ask you to bring one of these to Orpheus, but they're no good unless they're perfectly fresh.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 我本想让你给俄耳甫斯带些点心，不过如果不新鲜的话，就一点都不好吃了。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Orpheus tells me you've been a good friend. Thanks, hon.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯告诉我，说你一直都是位好朋友。谢谢你，亲爱的。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: I love Orpheus and all, hon, but it's nice having a little time here to myself!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: I know you can't stay long, hon, so eat up and stay safe out there, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 我很爱俄耳甫斯，亲爱的，但能享受一个人独处的时间也很不错！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 我知道你不能在这里长待，亲爱的。所以好好吃点东西，一路顺风，好吗？

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: I sing when Orpheus is here, I sing when he isn't. Simple!

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 俄耳甫斯在的时候我会唱歌，不在的时候我也一样会唱，就是这么简单！

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: Eurydice_OfferText02

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Eurydice, thank you for making me feel welcome in your pleasant home. Can't say the same for most places I've been lately. I've a small gift I wanted you to have.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Aw, that's awful sweet of you, Your Royal Majesty. Bringing me fresh ingredients like this! Know what, here's something for you, too, help keep you safe out there!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 欧律狄克，谢谢你让我在你温馨的家中受到如此款待。我最近去过的大多数地方都不如这里。我这里有个小礼物希望你可以收下。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 噢，你真是太贴心了，王子殿下。给我送来新鲜的原料！我也有东西要给你，能保证你的安全！

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Just the ingredient I needed, hon, thank you so much! You know, you aren't near as bad as I'd heard!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Oh, don't worry, we're still getting to know each other! Plenty of time for me to live up to my notorious reputation. Though I'm surprised you've heard of me at all.

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 这正是我想要的原料，亲爱的，太感谢你了！你知道吗，你也不是别人说的那么坏嘛！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 噢，没事，我们还在互相了解当中呢！我有足够的时间来不辜负我的恶名。不过我很惊讶你竟然听说过我。

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Aw, for me, really, Your Majesty? This will be perfect for my latest recipes.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know, of all the souls I've ever met, I feel like you put this stuff to the best possible use.

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 啊，给我的，真的吗，殿下？这个完美契合我最新的食谱。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道吗，在我认识的所有灵魂当中，只有你知道这东西怎么用最好。

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: You read my mind, hon! I go through this stuff awful fast sometimes.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: And I, in turn, shall go through your incredible cooking awful fast, given the opportunity.

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 你真的知道我在想什么，亲！有时候我很快就能掌握这些东西。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果有机会的话，我也会想尝试一下你美味的料理。

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Hey, mighty generous of you to keep me stocked up on this stuff, Your Royal Majesty!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: My pleasure! I'm always pleased to see you during my otherwise generally unfortunate travels in Asphodel.

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 王子殿下你真是太慷慨了，帮我准备了这么多东西！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 很荣幸！我能在水仙花平原的悲惨旅程中遇到你，真的非常欣慰。

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Thanks, Your Majesty! Though you're not going to get in trouble bringing me this stuff, are you?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Hah, no! I don't think I can get into more trouble at the moment. May this make your dishes that much more delectable!

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 谢谢您，我的陛下！送我这些应该不会给您添麻烦吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 当然不会了！我是想不出有什么比我现在的处境还麻烦的事了。希望这东西能让你的菜肴更加美味！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Eurydice, I was thinking maybe this would benefit your culinary practice. Here, please.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Whoa, this is Ambrosia! Hard to come by this stuff around here. You sure I can have this?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Absolutely! Least I could do for all your friendship and support. Always happy to hear your voice when I'm out here.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 欧律狄刻，我觉得这件礼物说不定能提高你的厨艺。来，收下吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 哇啊，这不是仙馔密酒嘛！这种酒在这里很少见吧，我真的可以收下吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 当然了！为了答谢你的友谊与支持，至少这些是我该做的。只要在这里的时候，我总是很高兴能听到你的声音。

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: I ever tell you you're a real sweetheart, hon? Because, if not, I'm telling you right now. Where would my culinary practice be if not for you?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I think your culinary practice would be every bit as extraordinary, though I'm pleased to have done small service to you in this great pursuit.

en.speaker: Eurydice
en.text: Well, we both know you've done a lot more for me than that. I wasn't expecting to make any new friends here anytime soon, so all the more reason it's been a real treat to get to know you. If I may say? You're a hell of a guy, Your Royal Majesty.

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 你真的很贴心，你知道吗，亲爱的？因为，如果你之前不知道，那我现在就告诉你。要是没有你，我的烹饪练习不知道要拖到什么时候呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我认为您的烹饪手艺还是会非常出色，尽管我很荣幸在这一伟大的追求中为您提供了一点帮助。

zh-CN.speaker: 欧律狄克
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，咱们都清楚，你为我做的可远远不止这些。我从来没想过这么快就能在这里结交到新的朋友，所以我想说，能认识你真的是我的荣幸。可以这么说吗？这真是“冥冥”之中自有贵人，王子殿下。

en.text: Pray, who might you be, wandering all the way out here? You're trespassing on private property, you know. Speak up!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, you must be... Persephone. My name is Zagreus, and... I think I might be your son.
What?! How dare...! Get out of here! Get out, or I shall make you!! Out with you!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No!! So then you are her. I, I don't care if you hate me, but I'm not leaving until I get some answers! I never even knew you existed. Why did you leave me?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: You died! You, you died...! Those burning feet, they... sputtered out, when you were born. But... now you're standing here before me. How...?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I died? I died... what, you mean permanently died, but, I'm alive! Oh, gods... you never even knew I existed, either.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Alive! Zagreus, he... even kept your name! You live, how can this be, you live? You live...! Oh, the cruel Fates! My son!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...In short, I beat him, finally, though he did everything he could to prevent our meeting here like this. But there's something he wanted me to tell you, in the end. He said to tell you Cerberus is doing very well.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Ah. He told you that, did he. That's good. That's good! Though, tell me something, Zagreus. How... is it that you found me? To have journeyed all this way, I scarce believe it.... Zagreus?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Ugh... Oh, it's... guess I'm just a little tired, that's all. Not accustomed to the weather, as I think you call it.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: No... no, that isn't it, it's that... you cannot stay here. You can't stay here.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Really, you're... heh... kicking me out? Why?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: The Fates are cruel, Zagreus. You're bound to that place... same as your father. So they would have us say good-bye, for now. My heart soars, knowing you live. Then it breaks, that our time together was so brief.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No... I can... come back... I can come back, now that I found you, he... maybe he'll just let me come back.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: You tell him I demand it. And I demand he also tell me how come he, or for that matter Nyx, never sent notice that you lived! Olympus is all rife with schemers, but I was so naive to think that they were different.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'll tell him... I'll tell him, I... feel awful. I... I have to go.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: The Styx shall take you, then. Oh, Zagreus. Farewell, my son. Won't you come back to me? When you are able, please. Come back. I shall be waiting here. However long it takes.

zh-CN.text: 我想问一下，你是哪位，一直在这里徘徊？你该明白，你正在非法闯入他人的住处。开口吧！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，你一定是……珀尔塞福涅了。我的名字是扎格列欧斯，而且……我想我应该是你的儿子。
什么？！你竟敢……滚出去！赶紧滚出去，否则我就亲自把你撵走！！别让我再见到你！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不！！所以说你就是她。我、我不在乎你讨不讨厌我，但我在得到答案之前是不会走的！我根本不知道你还活着，你为什么要离开我？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 可你已经死了！你、你死了……！你那双燃烧的双脚……你出生的时候，它熄灭了。可……你现在就站在我面前，这怎么可能……？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我死了？我死了……等等，你说的是彻底死了，可我还活着啊！哦，天啊……你也不知道我还活着。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 你还活着！扎格列欧斯，他……连你的名字都没改过！你还活着，这怎么可能，你还活着？你还活着……！哦，残酷的命运女神啊，是我的儿子！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: ……简单地说，虽然他竭尽全力阻止我们像这样见面，但我还是把他打败了。不过有些事情他想让我告诉你，他想让我告诉你，刻耳柏洛斯一切都相当好。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 啊，是他告诉你的，是吧？这太好了，这太好了！不过和我说说吧，扎格列欧斯。莫非……你就是这样找到我的吗？你走了这么远来到这里，我简直不敢相信……扎格列欧斯？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃啊……哦，我猜……我可能有点累了，没什么的。我还不怎么适应这里的“天气”，是这么说的吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 不……不是这么回事，而是……你不能留在这里，你没办法留在这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 真的吗，你真的……呵……要赶走我吗？为什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 命运女神很残酷，扎格列欧斯。你被束缚在了冥界……就像你的父亲一样。所以，我们恐怕只能暂时分开了。知道你还活着，我的心都要飞起来了。可知道我们能在一起的时间如此短暂，我的心都要碎了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不……我还会……回来的……既然我找到你了，那我就还能回来。他……或许他也会允许我回来的。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 你告诉他，是我要求你回来的。而且我要求他说清楚，为什么无论是他，还是倪克斯，都没告诉过我你还活着呢？奥林匹斯山上到处都是阴谋家，可那时的我太天真了，还以为他们会不一样呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我会告诉他……我会告诉他的，我……感觉很难受，我……我得走了。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 冥河要带你回去了。噢，扎格列欧斯，再见了，我的儿子。你还会来我身边吧？有时间的话，请一定要回来。无论要等多久，我都会等下去的。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I begged the Fates that you'd return to me. Perhaps I ought to be more careful how I speak of them. Tell me, how was your journey? What happened?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Father didn't make it any easier for me. Nor would he tell me why he never sent for you, after you left. So, I don't know, what's going on, still, but... I wanted to see you, again.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I wanted to see you, too. Come, speak quickly with me, that our time together here may be as full as possible, all right?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I just... I need to know what happened, between you and Father. Why are you here, and not with us?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I couldn't live with myself anymore, down there. After I left Olympus, a long story in itself, I came to be with your father, in the Underworld. It was a shock, to say the least. The others in your father's house were welcoming enough, but... I never felt that I belonged.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I know the feeling, I think. But you stayed. Long enough to have me. Those whom I've spoken to about you, it's as you said, they have fond memories of you. And then, you even had a child. Did Father... did he mistreat you?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: No, no. Your father could be very difficult. Though, he was gentle, with me. Soon enough, we got on fine, better than fine, at times, but... when I was with child... why, I struggled terribly. Because... a child born of surface-dwellers could not live, down there.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Could not live down there, according to whom, exactly? The Fates?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: According to them, yes. According to your father, and to Nyx. Even having heard... I took my chances, anyway. But when you emerged stillborn... it was too much. I fled. I fled, and came to reside here. Above the notice of the Underworld. Beneath the notice of Olympus.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Urgh... but... why would Father lie to you? If he never wanted you... or never wanted me... surely he had the means.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I don't know. I'm wondering the same. But, oh, look at you, Zagreus! We're running out of time. It's happening again! Stay with me, please?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...I'm trying... but I can't... stay that much longer... I don't think.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Oh, my dear son! Then please... ask Hades what you asked of me! Why he would lie? Tell him I must know, the same as you. And you farewell. Until we meet again!

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我恳求命运女神，祈祷你会回到我身边。或许提起她们的时候，我应该更小心才是。和我说说，你的旅程还顺利吗？都发生了什么事情？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲并没有对我手下留情，也没告诉过我你离开之后，他为什么没来找你。所以，我也不知道发生了什么，不过……我希望能再见到你。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我也希望能再见到你。来吧，快点和我聊聊吧，好好利用我们在一起的时间，好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我只想……我想知道你和父亲之间发生了什么事情。你为什么在这里，而不是和我们在一起呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我无法继续在冥界独自生活。说来话长，我离开奥林匹斯山之后，就和你父亲一起去了冥界。即使委婉说来，那里也让我很是震惊。虽然你父亲圣殿里的其他人都很热情，但……我自己从未属于那里。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我觉得我明白这种感觉，但你还是留在了那里，一直留到生下我为止。我和其他人提起过你的事情，就像你说的，他们都很喜欢和你在一起。而且，你甚至还生了个孩子。父亲他……他有没有虐待过你？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 没有，没有。你父亲可能是个很难相处的人，但他对我一直很温和。没过多久，我们的感情就变得很好，有的时候甚至不仅仅是很好，可……当我怀孕的时候……我的心里非常难受，因为……地上世界的人生出来的孩子，是没办法在冥界生存的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没办法在冥界生存，这到底是谁说的？是命运三女神吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 是啊，是她们说的，你的父亲和倪克斯也都说过这样的话。但即便如此……我还是打算冒险。可看到你一出生就夭折的时候……我实在是受不了了。我逃出来了，逃到了这里，无论是冥界还是奥林匹斯山，都不知道这个地方。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃……可是……父亲为什么要对你撒谎？如果他根本不想你……或者说，根本不想我诞生……他肯定应该有办法才对。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我不清楚，我也疑惑这个问题。不过，哦，看看你啊，扎格列欧斯！我们的时间不多了，又要这样了！求求你，呆在我身边吧！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: ……我也想……但我已经……没办法呆太久了……我恐怕不行了。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 啊，我亲爱的儿子！那就去吧……问哈迪斯你问我的那个问题！他为什么要撒谎？告诉他，你和我一定要知道答案。祝你一路顺利，我们下次见吧！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Mother, I... discovered how come Father led you to believe that I could not survive past birth. He didn't lie to you, exactly. So he says.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Wait, slow down, Zagreus, what do you mean? He told me you would not survive your birth, yet here you are. How wasn't that a lie?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Because... he thought it was the truth. The Fates appointed him dominion over the entire Underworld. But he would never have an heir, so he was led to understand. He never expected me to be born, much less survive.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: He never expected you to survive? Then, forgive my asking, but... why did you? How did you? The Fates are not known for making mistakes when it comes to such things.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Nyx saved my life. Or gave me life, I guess. Then raised me in your absence. The Fates are her daughters, right? Maybe she persuaded them to go easier on me. She cannot say more. In any case, apparently it took her quite a while to revive me, and... by then, you were gone.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Nyx... of course she was involved. I only managed to escape because of her. Then, she restored my stillborn son to life, and nurtured him? And, I never would have known, unless that child, fully grown and having learned the truth, defied his father, and then found me here?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Yes. Although, we still don't know how come Father and Nyx never sent for you. Though, ungh, let me ask you something, Mother, if you please. If you had found out... that I was born, and very much alive... would you have come back?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Would I have come back... to see my only child? Had I but known you lived... I would have gladly gone through hell again to see you, Zagreus. Of course I would have.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well then... what if... urgh... what if Father... didn't want you... doing that?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: What if he didn't want me coming back to him? Or seeing you? Oh no, you're fading again, Zagreus. You've pushed yourself too hard! But what is it you meant, by what you said?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 母亲，我……我弄清楚父亲是怎么让你相信，我一生出来就会死了。确切地说，他并没有对你撒谎，他是这么说的。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 等等，我跟不上了，扎格列欧斯，这是什么意思？他说过，你一生出来就会死，可你就站在我面前。这不就是他在撒谎吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 因为……他以为这是真的。命运女神让他统治整个冥界，但他没办法拥有子嗣，于是他就是这么理解的。他根本不认为我会出生，更不认为我会活下来。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 他根本不认为你会活下来？请原谅我这么冒昧，可……你为什么还活着？你是怎么活下来的？像这样的事情，命运三女神是绝不会搞错的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是倪克斯救了我一命，或者说，是她赐予了我生命。你不在的时候，是她养大了我。命运三女神都是她的女儿，是吧？说不定是她劝她们别对我这么刻薄。她不能透露更多内情了。总之，她为了救我，花了相当大的力气……等我活过来的时候，你已经走了。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯……是啊，她肯定帮忙了。我能逃到这里，也都是多亏了她。在那之后，她把我死去的孩子救了回来，把他养大成人？而且我对这一切一无所知，直到那个孩子长大成人，知道真相之后，违抗他父亲的意愿，来这里找到了我，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，不过我们还是不清楚，为什么父亲和倪克斯从来没找过你。不过，呃，如果可以的话，有件事我想问你，母亲。如果你发现……我还活着，而且活得好好的……你愿意回来吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我愿意回到冥界……与我唯一的儿子团聚吗？我要是早知道你活着的话……我愿意再次横穿整个冥界去见你，扎格列欧斯。我一定会这么做的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 可如果……如果……呃……如果父亲……不希望你……这么做呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 如果他不希望我回到他身边呢？还是不希望我去见你？哦，不，你又要消失了，扎格列欧斯，你把自己逼得太狠了！不过，你刚刚说的话到底是什么意思？

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: So good to see you, again, Zagreus. Since last you left, I couldn't help but think the worst, about what happened after I had left... or soon before. You mentioned Nyx... you don't suppose that she and Hades... wanted me out of the way?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I just... don't think that can be. Though, let me ask you. How long did you know Father? And Nyx, for that matter? Did they seem trustworthy?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Yes. I knew them long enough to have decided yes, that they were trustworthy. As much as anyone I've ever met. But I also know never to be trusting to a fault. I have to consider the possibility I was deceived.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Especially since neither of them is being forthcoming with me even now, right? And yet, I have this feeling something else is going on, Mother. The way that Father speaks of you, the way Nyx speaks of you... I think... they care for you.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Ah, hahaha! Well, they have a funny way of showing it, I think. Your father, so... you have to get through him each time you visit me?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I do. Mother, what if... what if Father thinks that he's protecting you? Have you... considered that?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Protecting me? Why Zagreus, what do you mean by that? As you can see, I can fend for myself.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well... urgh... you're from Olympus, aren't you? But... the gods, none of them seem to know... you're here... so...

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: What, how would you know something like that? Zagreus? Ah, curse the Fates, you're leaving me again...

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 真高兴又见到你了，扎格列欧斯。你上次离开之后，我就情不自禁地在想那些最可怕的事情，我离开之后……或是不久之前的事情。你上次提到了倪克斯……你觉得她和哈迪斯……应该不会不希望我回去吧？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我……不觉得他们是这样的人。不过我想问你，你和我的父亲认识了多久？和倪克斯认识了多久？他们看起来可信吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 可信，我和他们已经认识很久了，我觉得他们是可信的人，和我遇到的其他人一样可信。但我也知道，千万别把信任托付给错误的人，我必须考虑他们骗我的可能性。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 尤其是他们谁都没和我一起来，是这样吧？不过，我和你的感觉不太一样，母亲。父亲谈起你时的样子，还有倪克斯谈起你的样子……我觉得……他们很在乎你。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 啊，哈哈哈！那我觉得，他们关心人的方式可太有意思了。你的父亲，这么说吧……你每次来都得先打败他，才能见到我，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，母亲。可如果……如果父亲觉得他这么做是在保护你呢？你有没有……这么想过？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 保护我？你这么说是什么意思，扎格列欧斯？如你所见，我一个人也能过得很好。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧……呃……你来自奥林匹斯山，是吧？可……奥林匹斯众神好像都不知道……你在这里……所以……

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 什么？这件事情你是怎么知道的？扎格列欧斯？啊，该死的命运女神，你又要离开我了……

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Son, I have to ask you, how much do you know about your relatives upon Olympus?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I think I know quite a bit by now. I've been in steady contact with Athena, Zeus, and other members of the family ever since I first left Father's House... they've been assisting me in getting here.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: No... Zagreus, what have you done? You've led them here?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No, no, they think... they think I'm trying to escape from Father so that I can join them on their mountaintop. At least I think that's what they think. Most of them, anyway.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: But then... does Hades know of this? That Olympus is involved?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: He does. Both he and Nyx. In fact, it's Nyx who put me and Olympus into contact. I could never have broken free of the Underworld if not for their help.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: So Nyx and Hades are against each other, then. And Olympus is helping you... but they don't know I'm here, as far as you're aware?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That's right. More or less. Nyx and Father seem to put up with each other. Don't seem to have much of a choice. Though, ever since I learned of you, Nyx has been helping me to find you... while Father's tried to stop me.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: That fool... what was he thinking? What is he thinking...? Do you suppose... he thinks that he's protecting me from them? Oh, no...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I... urgh... I think maybe he does think so, indeed... because, now having met my relatives upon Olympus, I... can definitely see that they can be a bit... vindictive about things.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Vindictiveness runs in the family, my son. Then, if Olympus is involved, that would explain a lot. I'm here, not there with them, as you can see. But, oh, it seems we'll have to speak some more, when next you return...

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 儿子，我想问问你。关于你在奥林匹斯山上的亲戚们，你对他们有多少了解？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我觉得我已经对他们相当了解了。自从我第一次离开父亲的圣殿起，我就一直与雅典娜、宙斯，还有很多其他神明一直保持联系……来这里的路上，他们一直在帮我。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 不……扎格列欧斯，你做了什么啊？你把他们带到了这里？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不，不，他们以为……他们以为我打算逃出父亲的王国，去奥林匹斯山与他们相聚。至少我觉得他们是这么想的，反正大部分是这么想的。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 可是……哈迪斯知道这件事吗？他知道奥林匹斯众神也插手了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 知道，他和倪克斯都知道。老实说，是倪克斯让我和奥林匹斯众神取得联系的。要不是因为他们的帮助，我绝对没办法逃出冥界。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 所以倪克斯和哈迪斯彼此敌视，奥林匹斯众神在帮助你……而据你所知，他们并不知道我在这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 差不多算是这样吧，倪克斯和父亲看起来只能忍着对方，他们似乎也别无选择。不过，自从我得知了你的下落之后，倪克斯一直在帮我找你……而父亲一直试图阻止我。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 那个蠢货……他之前想什么呢？他在想什么呢……？你觉得……他是想保护我不被他们找到吗？哦，不……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我……呃……我觉得说不定他以为是在保护你……因为我已经见过奥林匹斯山的亲戚们了，我……很明显看得出来，他们对很多事情都有点……复仇心切。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 复仇心切是我们家族的传统，我的儿子。不过如果奥林匹斯众神也参与进来了，那很多事情就说得通了。如你所见，我在这里生活，而没有回去和他们在一起。不过，哦，看来我们只能下次再说了，等你下次再来吧……

zh-CN.text: 儿子，我想问问你。关于你在奥林匹斯山上的亲戚们，你对他们有多少了解？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不是很了解，自从我第一次离开父亲的圣殿起，我就一直与雅典娜、宙斯，还有很多其他神明一直保持联系……来这里的路上，他们一直在帮我。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 不……扎格列欧斯，你做了什么啊？你把他们带到了这里？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不，不，他们以为……他们以为我打算逃出父亲的王国，去奥林匹斯山与他们相聚。至少我觉得他们是这么想的，反正大部分是这么想的。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 可是……哈迪斯知道这件事吗？他知道奥林匹斯众神也插手了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 知道，他和倪克斯都知道。老实说，是倪克斯让我和奥林匹斯众神取得联系的。要不是因为他们的帮助，我绝对没办法逃出冥界。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 所以倪克斯和哈迪斯彼此敌视，奥林匹斯众神在帮助你……而据你所知，他们并不知道我在这里。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 差不多算是这样吧，倪克斯和父亲看起来只能忍着对方，他们似乎也别无选择。不过，自从我得知了你的下落之后，倪克斯一直在帮我找你……而父亲一直试图阻止我。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 那个蠢货……他之前想什么呢？他在想什么呢……？你觉得……他是想保护我不被他们找到吗？哦，不……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我……呃……我觉得说不定他以为是在保护你……因为我已经见过奥林匹斯山的亲戚们了，我……很明显看得出来，他们对很多事情都有点……复仇心切。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 复仇心切是我们家族的传统，我的儿子。不过如果奥林匹斯众神也参与进来了，那很多事情就说得通了。如你所见，我在这里生活，而没有回去和他们在一起。不过，哦，看来我们只能下次再说了，等你下次再来吧……

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I could not stand it on Olympus, Zagreus. The blustering, the posturing... my overbearing mother... none of it. I would have left the mountain voluntarily, except...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...Except Father absconded with you, didn't he? Dragged you down with him into the Underworld. So if Olympus were to find that out... I shudder to think of the consequences.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: That fool is trying to protect me even now. It wasn't he who absconded with me, my son. And it's more complicated even than that. I was content to leave. Willing to make my life within the Underworld. With your father.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I dare not ask who did bring you to Father, then. So, essentially, you ran away from home, to live with him? I mean no disrespect, but... did you realize what you were getting yourself into?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: We have a tendency to be impetuous when we are younger, Zagreus. I'd heard all about your father before we met. Admired paintings of him. It was very awkward, at first. But he had a bluntness I fancied. A sense of principle. I much preferred him to his brothers, I can tell you that.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So, urgh... then you secretly left Mount Olympus to be with the god of the dead in the Underworld. And Olympus never found out. What do you suppose would happen... if they did?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: ...I think... there would be war between Olympus and your father, Zagreus, if they found out. Especially now. After all this. And after all this time. They slew their parents once. If the Titans could be wiped from this world, so can we all.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So it makes sense... if Father, he agrees with you, and thinks... that leaving you in hiding here, that it's the only way... he can prevent that war...

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I can see how your father, shrewd but also single-minded as he was, might have followed such a line of reasoning as that. Oh, Zagreus... what have I done?

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我受不了在奥林匹斯山上的生活，扎格列欧斯。那所有的喧闹，惺惺作态……还有我那专横的母亲……我都不喜欢。我本打算自己离开奥林匹斯山的，可……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: ……可父亲带你私奔了，是吧？他带着你私奔到了冥界。所以，如果奥林匹斯众神发现了这件事情的话……我都不敢想象会发生什么后果。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 就算是现在，那个傻瓜也想要保护我。并不是他把我强行带到这里的，我的儿子，事情比这要复杂得多。能离开那里，我很开心。我很愿意在冥界生活，与你的父亲一起生活。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我还是不问是谁把你带到父亲那里的了。所以大体而言，你从家里私奔出来，要和他一起生活，是吗？我无意冒犯，可……你知不知道这样做会惹出什么麻烦？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我们年轻的时候都会比较莽撞，扎格列欧斯。早在见到你父亲之前，我就听说过很多关于他的事情，还欣赏过他的画像。虽然我们一开始相处得很别扭，但他那股率真劲儿让我着迷，他是个有原则的人。我可以告诉你，我觉得他比他的兄弟们好得多。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 所以，呃……你偷偷离开了奥林匹斯山，是为了能和冥王一起生活，而且奥林匹斯众神并不知道这件事情。你觉得，如果他们知道了的话……会怎么样呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: ……我猜……如果他们发现的话，他们多半会和你的父亲开战，尤其是这种时候，已经经历了这么多事情。他们以前就杀父弑母。如果他们连泰坦都能消灭的话，那我们肯定也无法幸免于难。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这就说得通了……如果父亲也和你想得一样，觉得……只有让你藏在这里……才能阻止这场战争的话……

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 你父亲是个既精明、又一根筋的人，我看得出来，他应该一直都是这么想的。哦，扎格列欧斯啊……我都做了什么啊？

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Zagreus... it's wonderful to see you, but... I need to ask something of you. That you not visit me again, here in this place. Both for your safety, and for mine.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, what? Because of what would happen if the Olympians found out? So, after everything, you're taking Father's side in all of this?!

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I am. Your father is no fool when it comes to matters such as this. Besides... all that has happened... it's my fault. I was selfish! And now both sides of our family threaten to be torn apart.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Your fault? So let's say you never left Olympus! Then it'd be just like you thought, until quite recently, I think. That I'd never existed! Besides, they haven't found out any of this. What makes you so sure they will, all the sudden?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Nyx may be veiling you from them as she veiled me when I fled here myself. But even her own powers aren't infallible. Each time you visit me, you are incurring risk. One small slip, and they shall find me. Discover your deception. Go home, Zagreus. Please.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Go home with me, Mother! You came here under false pretenses. I haven't fought all this way, over and over again, only to turn back now. I need you in my life! How can you just... turn me away like this?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Oh, Zagreus... I cannot return. After all that happened between Hades and me, and everyone, I just cannot fathom the idea. Besides... the risks we're taking would be even greater if Olympus were to find me there, with him. And you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Then... ungh... you're just... going to stay here? Alone, in the middle of nowhere, in this little garden... forever? After we part ways, just like that?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: My son... I know you've made hard choices and sacrifices to be here with me. And I'm forever grateful to have finally met you. But this is my home, now, yes. While your home is below. Please, if not for your sake, then for mine... do not return. I love you, Zagreus. Good-bye.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯……能见到你我真高兴，不过……有件事我需要你帮忙。我希望你别再这里来看我了，这既是为你的安全着想，也是为我的安全着想。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等等，你说什么？你害怕奥林匹斯众神发现这件事情可能带来的后果吗？所以说，经历了这么多之后，你还是站在父亲那一边吗？！

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 是啊，涉及到这样的事情，你父亲绝对不傻。而且……所发生的一切……都是我的错，是我太自私了！如今，我们两边的家庭都有分崩离析的风险。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 都是你的错？这么说吧，假设你根本没有离开过奥林匹斯山！那一切就都会和你预想的那样。那我根本就不会出生了！而且奥林匹斯众神一直都没发现这件事情。你为什么觉得他们现在就会突然发现呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 当你逃到这里的时候，是倪克斯隐去了你的行踪，就像她当年把我藏起来一样。但就算是她的力量，也不是绝对可靠的。你每次来见我，都是在冒着风险。一旦走错一小步，他们就会找到我，就会发现你在欺骗他们。回家吧，扎格列欧斯，拜托了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 和我一起回去吧，母亲！你是因为误会才会来这里的。我一遍又一遍地冲到这里，可不是为了这种时候扭头就走的。我的人生需要你！你怎么能……就这样赶我走呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 哦，扎格列欧斯……我不能回去了。我和哈迪斯，和所有人之间发生了这样的事情之后，我不清楚大家都是怎么想的。而且……如果奥林匹斯众神发现我和他，和你在一起，我们的风险就更高了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 所以……呃……你就打算……留在这里吗？一个人孤苦伶仃，呆在这座小花园里……呆一辈子吗？就这样和我们分开吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我的儿子……我知道为了来这里见我，你做出了很多艰难的决定，付出了很多牺牲。能见到你，我非常感激。可没错，这里如今就是我的家了，而你的家在冥界。拜托了，就算不是为了你，也是为了我吧……别再回来了。我爱你，扎格列欧斯，再见了。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You can't do this to me, Mother. You said Father is no fool, and neither are you. There has to be a way to fix this. Not just with you and Father, but with everyone. There has to be a way!

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: ...You have your father's stubbornness. Listen to me. You're endangering everything you care about by coming here. Don't you understand? Besides...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What? Besides what? Tell me, please.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: ...The truth is that I like it here, Zagreus. I have done well for myself on my own. And your father, he has his domain to look after. The feelings he once had for me... feelings we shared... they fade, with time. You'll understand, someday.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No! I won't be understanding anything of the sort. Father still loves you. I'm sure of it! And, he owes you an apology, damn it! I cannot make amends with you on his behalf. It's something only you can do together.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: What do you mean he still loves me, Zagreus...? How would you know?

en.speaker: Zagreus
