en.text: Because... ungh... I'm his blasted son, that's how I know! But trust me isn't ever good enough, I know that, too. I'll prove it to you, Mother! Just you wait and see.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: You're fading, Son... you don't need to prove anything to me. Please don't do anything rash. All of us made our choices. Now we have to live with them. Isn't it enough, to know that I am safe? That I'm content to be alone?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No... urgh... it's not... it's not enough, for me, because... this blasted family... it cannot just keep hiding from its problems! Running from them! We're stuck with one another, we... we have to do everything we can... for one another!

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I... oh, my dear boy...

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你不能这么对我，母亲。你说过父亲并不傻，你也不傻，那肯定会有什么办法解决问题才对。不仅仅是解决你和父亲的问题，而是解决所有人的问题。肯定会有什么方法才对！

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: ……你和你的父亲一样顽固。听我说，你来这里会让你在乎的一切处于危险之中，你还不明白吗？而且……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么？而且什么？拜托了，告诉我吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: ……老实说，我很喜欢这个地方，扎格列欧斯。我一个人过得很好。至于你的父亲，他还要管理他的王国呢。他曾经对我的爱……我们在一起的那些感情……是会随着时间冲淡的。总有一天，你会明白这一点。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我不！我才不想理解这些事情呢。父亲还爱着你，我很肯定！而且他还欠你个道歉呢，该死！我可没办法替他来让你们破镜重圆。只有你们齐心协力，才能办得到。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 你说他还爱着我，这是什么意思，扎格列欧斯……？你是怎么知道的？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 与某位……呃……我是他该死的儿子，所以我知道！不过只有一句“相信我”是不够的，我也明白。我会向你证明这一点的，母亲！你等着看吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 你要消失了，儿子……你什么都不用向我证明。求求你了，千万别做莽撞的事情。我们所有人都做出了选择，如今我们必须承受后果。知道我很安全，我一个人很满足，难道这还不够吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不够……呃……不够，对我来说不够。因为……这个该死的家庭……不能总是对问题视而不见！不能总是逃避问题！我们都是家人，我们……我们必须尽我们所能……为了家人！

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我……哦，我亲爱的孩子……

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: ...Of everything down in that gloomy House, I miss old Cerberus the most, I think. But, I miss other things as well. The lack of light was gentler on my skin. Not being as cold. And Nyx, and her young sons. It was all very odd, but...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Mother... in Father's bedchambers... mind you, there's almost nothing there, just neatly sorted rows of all his samey capes... but on his nightstand... is a portrait of you. Wearing a regal crown of red laurels. A Queen. His Queen.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I was fitted for those garments when I first arrived. They... were not my customary style. So Hades has a portrait of me, still. Why would he put it back on display, now?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No, no, he's never let anybody in his bedchambers! I broke in. Don't you see? He didn't put your portrait back on display. It's always been there! Ever since you left. So, Mother, why do you suppose he would do that?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Because he... because he loves me still. Is that what you want me to say?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Have you ever loved him, yourself?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: All I really wanted was to leave Olympus. I didn't exactly abscond. I doubt I had much of a choice, but I went willingly. Perhaps Zeus knew how I felt, and thought he was doing me a favor. As for Hades... I grew to love him, yes. He always gave me my space.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Won't you... urgh... won't you please talk to him? Or visit Cerberus again, or Nyx? As for Olympus... surely all of you... can figure something out...?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: ...I just don't know, my son. Olympus is behind me. And the Underworld... I cannot imagine I would be very welcome there after all this time.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: ……那座阴郁圣殿所有的东西里，我最想念的就是刻耳柏洛斯，不过其它的东西我也一样想念。那里没什么光照，对我的皮肤更好，也没上面这么冷，还有倪克斯和她年轻的儿子们。一切都很怪异，不过……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 母亲……在父亲的卧室里……我想告诉你，那里几乎什么都没有，只整齐地摆着一大排一模一样的披肩……不过在他的床头柜上……却摆着你的肖像。你戴着红色的桂冠，是那里的皇后，他的皇后。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我刚到那里的时候，就穿着那样的衣服。那……并不是我一直以来的风格。所以说，哈迪斯还摆着一张我的画像，他干嘛要挑这种时候把它摆回去，做样子给别人看？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不，不，他根本不让任何人进入他的卧室！是我闯进去的。你还看不出来吗？他才不是把它摆回去做样子。你走了之后，那副画像一直就摆在那里。所以说，母亲，你觉得他为什么要这么做？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 因为他……因为他还爱着我，这就是你想听到的答案吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你有没有爱过他？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我那时真正的愿望，不过是离开奥林匹斯山而已，我并不真的打算私奔。我觉得那时我也有很多其它选择，但我还是跑了。或许宙斯明白我的感受，他觉得他那样是在帮我。至于哈迪斯……我渐渐地爱上了他，是啊，他总是愿意给我私人空间。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你就不想……呃……就不想和他聊聊天吗？就不想再见见刻耳柏洛斯，或是倪克斯吗？至于奥林匹斯众神……你们齐心协力的话……总能想出什么办法吧……？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: ……我不知道，儿子。奥林匹斯众神就在我身后，至于冥界……已经过了这么久了，我觉得恐怕大家不会太欢迎我吧。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Mother, wait, what is all this?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Oh, Zagreus, I almost missed you. Truthfully, I hoped that I could make it a surprise...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Make what a surprise?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: My arrival. I'm going. To your home. To Cerberus. Nyx. Your father.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're... really?! Mother, you, you're serious?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I am. Now if you could just help me pack up my remaining things? Only a few loose odds I'm bringing, just in case. If we hurry, maybe you could join me, rather than return the customary way. Not something a mother ever wants to see.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Join you, but... wait, how are you going to get back? I... hadn't thought that far ahead.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Just so happens I know somebody who can give us a ride.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Doubtless he has pressing matters to attend to. So let's not keep him waiting any longer, Son. Come on, then!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: <Sigh> ...I'm still alive... but, how?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: You're on the River Styx. No longer in the mortal realm, entirely.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I can't believe that this is happening.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I know. My heart is racing. Nothing like a river journey to remind oneself that there's no turning back.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Seriously. Though, even after all of this... it's like we only just met. I have so many questions for you still.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: We'll have plenty of time for them, I think! For now, best we keep quiet. Pretend we're just a couple of dead souls on their final voyage.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 母亲，等等，这是怎么回事？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 哦，扎格列欧斯，差点就没见到你。不过说实话，我本想给你个惊喜来着……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么惊喜？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我的到来啊。我打算走了，去你那边，去找刻耳柏洛斯、倪克斯，还有你的父亲。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你……真的吗？！母亲，你，你是认真的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 是真的，可以帮我收拾一下剩下的东西吗？我只带了一些杂七杂八的东西，不过最好还是别漏下什么吧。如果动作快些的话，说不定你可以和我一起回去，而不用像你平时那么回去。像那样的场景，做母亲的是绝对不想看到的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 和你一起回去，可……你打算怎么回去呢？我……还没做过这么远的打算。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我刚好认识个人，可以顺道载我们一程。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 不过他肯定还有很重要的事情要忙，所以咱们还是别让他干等着了，儿子。快来吧！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: <叹气>……我还活着……但这怎么可能？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 你在冥河上，已经不在凡间了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我真不敢相信，这一切居然成真了。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我明白，我的心也跳得厉害。来到了这条河上，就好像在提醒我已经没有回头路了一样。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，不过就算经历了这么多……我感觉好像还是刚刚见到你一样，我还有那么多问题要问。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我觉得咱们有的是时间！至于现在，还是保持安静吧，就当咱们只是是死去的凡人，准备踏上最后的旅途吧。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: This is embarrassing, but... I don't know the way to get back in. Except, you know, the customary way.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: That's quite all right; I do. In the name of Persephone, the Queen!! Open the gates!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这说起来有点尴尬，不过……我不知道回去的路，我是说，除了我平时回去的那条路之外。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 没关系，我知道。以冥后珀尔塞福涅之名！！把门打开！

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: How has it been for you so far, Mother? Reacclimating to all this. You said before it was a struggle. Must be very strange, being back. Being in darkness all the time.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: You know, I think it's gone all right so far! Thank you for asking, Son. Everyone has been quite welcoming. The darkness is a pleasant change of pace, and while this dress can be a little difficult to move in... I quite like it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That's good to hear. I have to admit I was a little worried you'd be desperate to return to your cottage by now. This place can be a little much.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I'm sure it can. And I do miss my little cottage here and there, but... I think I'm through running away. There may be times when it is necessary, of course. But no matter how far you run, it doesn't make your problems go away. You taught me that, you know.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I did? But... I tried desperately to run away, myself.... Oh.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 最近还好吗，母亲？要再次适应这里的一切。你之前说过，在这里的生活很折磨人。如今你又回来了，永远生活在黑暗之中，这种感觉肯定很古怪吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 说实话，我觉得到目前为止一切都不错！谢谢你的关心，儿子，每个人都很热情。能回到黑暗之中也蛮不错的，虽然这条裙子可能不怎么容易穿……不过我还挺喜欢的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这就好。不得不说，我刚刚还在担心你会不会特别想回到那座小屋里，这个地方可能有点太压抑了。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 确实有点压抑，而且我确实挺怀念我的小屋的，不过……我觉得我已经不想再逃了。逃避问题有时候或许有用，但无论你逃到多远，那些问题也不会消失。你知道吗，这是你让我明白的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是我吗？可……我自己也一直都想逃跑啊……哦。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Turns out there's still an awful lot to do around here, isn't there, Zagreus? I'm still getting caught up on day-to-day affairs.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Day-to-day, how can you even tell it's day around here, anyway, Mother?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Well that was just a guess, now that you mention it. In any case, forgive me if I don't get swooped up in every household detail, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 结果我发现，这里要做的事情实在是太多了，是吧，扎格列欧斯？我还在没日没夜忙这里的事务呢。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 没日没夜？你是怎么知道什么时候是白天，什么时候是晚上的，母亲？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我只是随口一说罢了。总之，如果我没办法做得面面俱到的话，你可不能怪我，好吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So, Mother, all the pomegranates around here... those are your doing?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Not a lot of fruit trees take to this environment, my son. Though, there's something about pomegranates! Maybe it's that their seeds so resemble the gemstones your father likes so much. Or that they don't need much water.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: ...Fruit trees, huh. I grew up around all these poms and never thought much of it. Are there many other types of fruit trees on the surface, then?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Well... I suppose there are a few. But I like pomegranates most of all.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 母亲，这里所有的石榴……都是你种的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 能适应这里环境的果树并不多，我的孩子，不过石榴确实是个例外！可能是因为它们的种子和你父亲最喜欢的宝石长得很像吧？也可能是因为它们不用浇水。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: ……果树，嗯，我长大的地方到处都是石榴树，可我却从来没怎么考虑过这个问题。那就是说，凡间还有很多其它的果树吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧……我猜应该有几种，不过我最喜欢的还是石榴。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: This garden isn't quite the sight yours was back on the surface, is it, Mother.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: On the contrary, Zagreus! It has its own unique charm. As each garden does. I was impressed it wasn't left entirely to rot after my absence.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It was totally off limits to me. Though I guess Father must have taken care to maintain it as best he could.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: He did, all right. Minus the part where you weren't allowed. Though, let's look after it from here, shall we?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这里的花园看起来不如上面的漂亮，是吧，母亲？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 恰恰相反，扎格列欧斯！这座花园有它自己的特色，每座花园都有自己的特色。我不在的这段时间，它居然没有凋零，我很意外。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 父亲根本不允许我来这里，不过我猜，他肯定尽他所能地照顾这座花园吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 是啊，他尽力了，要是也能让你进来就更好了。不过，从现在开始，咱们一起来打理这座花园吧，怎么样？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You know, that painting in Father's... I mean your bedchambers, it turned out rather well, didn't it? Some very talented shades around here.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Oh, it's beautiful! I tried to persuade your father to hang it out in the hall but he's too coy about such things. Though, I like it where it is... a reminder to us, every day and night.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你知道，父亲卧室里那副画……我是说，你卧室里的画，其实画的还挺不错的，是吧？对明暗的处理很有天分。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 哦，真的是太美了！我试过让你父亲把它挂在大厅里，但这种事情他总是羞于去做。不过，我很喜欢，它……就像是个提醒一样，日日夜夜都陪着我们。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: This garden may not have all the varieties available up on the surface... though it's coming along rather nicely, I should say!

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 不得不说，虽然这座花园里的植物不像地上世界那么丰富……但也打理得相当漂亮了！

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: It's lovely what you've done to this place, Zagreus! It's looking better than ever, thank you.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 你把这里装点得真是太可爱了，扎格列欧斯！这里看起来比以前更漂亮了，谢谢。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Were you able to make it to my cottage on the surface, Zagreus? I hope my lavender patches are doing all right.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I, erm... I couldn't make it all the way there, Mother. It's like... without your presence on the surface, I'm unable to hang on for very long at all.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Ah, I was afraid of that. Well, don't despair. I placed a charm upon my seedlings there that ought to keep them flourishing well on their own. Your duty now is simply to escape. You keep it up!

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 你可以帮我去上面那座小屋里看看吗，扎格列欧斯？希望我的薰衣草长得都还好。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我，呃……我已经没办法再回到那里了，母亲。就好像是……你离开了地上世界之后，我就根本没办法再在上面呆太久了。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 啊，我担心的就是这个。好吧，不用担心，我已经给种子施过法了，它们自己应该也能长得很好。你现在只要专心逃出这里就好了，再接再厉吧！

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Tell me something, Zagreus... sometimes I fear... do you hate him? I mean your father. Regardless of his intentions... it sounds as though he made your life extraordinarily difficult. All his pent-up fear and anger... you bore the brunt of it.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Do I hate him...? Mother, I don't know that I hate anybody, really. The tales of him and the Olympians rending their immortal Titan parents to bits... I can't relate to how they must have felt. But, I resented him, for sure. And... I don't know if I'll ever get over that, entirely.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I understand. I think that when Hades told you he asked no forgiveness, he understood as well, and meant it. Well, for all his failings, I'm thankful that he did not teach you how to hate. For your own sake, if not for his.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 有件事想问你，扎格列欧斯……有的时候我会担心……你恨他吗？我是说，你的父亲。虽然他无意这样……但听起来他让你的生活非常糟糕。他那些压抑着的恐惧和愤怒……你总是第一个变成出气筒。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我恨他吗……？母亲，我觉得我谁都不恨，真的。关于他和奥林匹斯众神的故事，他们合力杀死了他们的父母，那些不朽的泰坦……我这点怒火和他们比起来，恐怕要差远了。不过我对他有怨气，这是肯定的，而且……我也不知道以后能不能完全化解这股怨气。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我明白。哈迪斯对你说并不奢求你的原谅的时候，我觉得他也明白这一点，他的话也是真心实意的。尽管他有那么多缺点，但他并没有教你如何憎恨别人，这一点我很感激。就算不是为了他，也是为了你自己。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: So, how has it been between you and your father lately, Zagreus? I know the two of you have lots of work ahead of you. Especially him.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, it's been all right, I guess. I think he's set in some of his ways. But at least we have some sort of understanding now. Even if he acts like everything is still the same when I'm out there on the job.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: He says it's so you put forth your fullest effort every time. All this is a big adjustment for him as well. Not that it's any excuse for how he's treated you. Are you... all right, seeing us together?

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 所以，你和你父亲最近还好吗，扎格列欧斯？我知道你们两个还有很多问题需要解决，尤其是他那边。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜都挺好的吧。我觉得他有些事情很固执，但至少我们多多少少可以相互理解了。即便是我工作的时候，他和以前一点都没变，也不要紧。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 他说这么做是为了让你每次都全力以赴。这不是在为他对待你的态度找借口，对他来说，这也是个巨大的变化。看到我们在一起，你……开心吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, so are things with you and Father... everything all right, so far?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Things are good, Zagreus. I'm from Olympus... all the relationships I've ever known have been the complicated sort. But with your father... despite our different dispositions and interests... beneath it all, we share a simple understanding.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: And... what understanding is that? If you can share.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: That we're all we've got. And that we love each other. Through thick and thin.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, you're not... you're not thinking about having more children, are you...?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 唔，到现在为止，你和父亲……一切都还好吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 一切都好，扎格列欧斯。我是从奥林匹斯山来的……我所知道的人际关系，全都特别复杂。可和你的父亲在一起时……尽管我们的性格与兴趣都不太一样……我们的理念却是相通的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那……是什么样的理念呢？可以告诉我吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我们只要有彼此就够了。无论发生什么，我们都会爱着对方。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等等，你们该不是……你们该不是打算生出更多孩子吧……？

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Nyx has a very steady presence, doesn't she? I want to say she hasn't changed a bit since before you were born, but... I know that she's been through a lot.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: She's always managed, and quite gracefully at that. Never seen her break a sweat over anything. Even when I confronted her about you. Though, you two seem closer than I realized, I think.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Well, your father isn't always the conversationalist, and Nyx... she was the first chthonic god I ever met. I suppose she welcomed having another lady about the House.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯一直都是这个样子，是吧？从你出生之前到现在，她看起来几乎一点都没变，不过……我知道她经历了很多事情。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 她总是井井有条，而且非常优雅。我从来没见过她因为任何事情流汗，就算是我去质问她关于你的事情，她也面不改色。不过我觉得，你们之间的关系比我想象得更加亲密。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，你父亲并不怎么擅长言谈，而倪克斯……她是我在冥界见到的第一位神明。我猜她很欢迎这座圣殿里能有另一位女士吧。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Zagreus... how am I doing? As a mother. Tell me honestly. Nyx has had so much to share about raising you. Foods you hated or enjoyed, your natural abilities, your friendships... she knows everything! Sometimes I wonder how I can ever compete?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Mother, I think you're doing great. And I'm sure you know it's not a competition between you and Nyx. I just get the benefit of having two great mothers rather than one. Or zero.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Thank you, my son. I know I wasn't there for most of the hard part, but... I'm here, now. Though, when I inevitably, inadvertently trample all over your feelings at some point, please tell me, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯……实话告诉我，身为母亲，我做得好吗？倪克斯和我说了很多养育你的事情，说到了你喜欢和讨厌的食物，说到了你的神力、你的朋友们……她简直无所不知！有时我不禁想，我哪能和她比呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 母亲，我觉得你做得很好啊。而且我确定，你明白你并不需要和倪克斯比什么。能有两位了不起的母亲照顾我，总比只有一位，或者根本没有要好。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 谢谢你，我的儿子。我知道你最难熬的那段日子我不在你身边，可……我现在在了。我知道这在所难免，不过如果我无意间伤害了你的感情，请一定要告诉我，好吗？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Mother, one thing I was wondering about was, how did you summon Charon to your surface residence? Especially without, you know, being dead.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Oh, why... he gave me his calling card after he graciously helped get me out of here the first time. No doubt at Nyx's request, but still. Never thought I'd use it, but... I still kept it. Just in case.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 母亲，有件事我一直很好奇。你是怎么把卡戎召唤到你在凡间的住处的？尤其是，我是说，你还没死。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 哦，这么说吧……他慷慨地帮我离开这里之后，就把名片给我了。毫无疑问，这是倪克斯的要求，不过我还是很感激。我以为我不会再用了，但……我还是留着了，以防万一。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Mother, you'll forgive my asking, but... your mother used to call you by a different name, didn't she?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Ah, don't remind me. Imagine if I called you Zaggie-poo from when you were born to this very moment, that's how that name felt to me. I much preferred the name my father gave to me.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Your mortal father, right...? So he called you Persephone. What was he like?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: He was kind to me. And funny! Little bringer of destruction, I was to him. I liked that. He was right, I was a terror. But then he passed. I was very little still. My mother never spoke of him again.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Demeter mentioned him a bit to me. She seems... I don't know, but I don't sense that she regrets the relationship or anything. Just sad about the outcome I think.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I suppose I can see that. I thought I might end up like Father... growing old, wasting away. Then the time flew by, and I realized I was closer to Mother's side. Mortals certainly don't have it easy. But their limited days, it means... they live their lives to the fullest, I think.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 母亲，这么问可能很唐突，不过……外婆以前给你起了另外一个名字，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 啊，别和我提这个名字。想象一下，如果自打你生出来，我就一直叫你扎狗蛋儿，你是什么感觉？我差不多就是这个感觉。我父亲给我起的名字要好听多了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是你的凡人父亲，是吗……？所以，是他给你起名叫珀尔塞福涅，他是个什么样的人？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 他对我很好，我很喜欢他，而我对他而言就像个惹祸精，真有意思！他说得没错，我就是个灾星。后来，他去世了，那时我还很小，我的母亲也再没有提起过他。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 得墨忒尔倒是和我提起过他，她看起来……我也说不好，不过我觉得，她对这段关系并不后悔，只是对这样的结果很难过。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我猜我也懂，我还以为我也会像父亲一样……越来越老，日益虚弱。而随着时光流逝，我发现我和母亲更加相似。凡人的生活并不容易，他们的生命很有限，这意味着……他们每一天都过的非常充实，我是这么想的。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Mother, just how long has it been snowing on the surface, do you know? Because, it seems to me that Demeter... Grandmother, I should say, she... well, it's been very cold up there each time I've been.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I was afraid of that... I wanted to believe the snow about my cottage, it was native to the climate there, but... seems that Mother took my absence harder than I thought. Oh, what have I done. All those poor people.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's not your fault. You couldn't have known. And we can fix this, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 母亲，我想问问，凡间的大雪已经下了多久了，你知道吗？因为我觉得得墨忒尔……我的外婆，我觉得她……呃，我每次上去的时候，都觉得很冷。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我担心的就是这个……我本以为我的小屋附近有积雪，是因为那里的气候就是那样，不过……看起来我的离开，对母亲造成的打击比我想象得更大。哦，我都做了什么啊，那些凡人太可怜了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这不是你的错，你也预料不到这种事情。而且咱们可以解决这个问题，是吧？

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Nyx told me that you helped her reconnect with her parent... after a long, long time. That was very kind of you. She never asks for anything. But we all owe her a lot, don't we?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I think so. If not for her... I can't even imagine, really. Did Nyx ever speak to you of Chaos, before I was born?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Not really, no. Nyx is very private when it comes to personal matters. But she has feelings and desires same as anybody. Well, mostly, but the point is... I know this meant a lot to her.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯告诉我，你帮助她和她的父母团聚了……他们已经很久很久没见面了。你做得真好。虽然她从来不求回报，但我们都欠她很多人情，不是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，如果没有她……我都想象不出会是什么样子，真的。我出生之前，倪克斯有没有和你提起过卡俄斯的事情？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 没有，没提过。倪克斯对她自己的事情守口如瓶，但她也像其他人一样，有她自己的感情与愿望。这么说吧，和大部分人一样，不过我想说……这对她来说意义重大。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: It seems Achilles had a complicated arrangement with your father. I understand you simplified things for the better, there, and he was able to visit Elysium at last. Well done.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 看起来，阿喀琉斯和你父亲之前的协议很复杂。我明白你把事情变得更简单、更清楚了，而且他终于可以去至福乐土了，干得漂亮。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: So Orpheus was finally able to reunite with Eurydice because of you, my son? Ah, I'm so glad! Your father's arrangement with him was quite severe. Though he did ask for a lot, for a mortal soul to return to the land of the living...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Is it even possible, for Father to return a mortal back to life if he so chose? Just by letting their shade escape, or something?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Oh, I've no idea, probably not? But we were so moved by Orpheus' plea and song, that, well... I think your father took pity on him.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Wait, we were so moved? You were there when Orpheus came to try and rescue Eurydice?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I was. Your father knew I loved their music. Imagine my surprise to see him as our court musician, here!

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 所以，因为你的缘故，俄耳甫斯终于和欧律狄刻团聚了，是吗，我的儿子？啊，我太开心了！你父亲对他的处置太严苛了，不过他要求的也太多了，想要带着某个凡人的灵魂回到生者的世界……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果父亲愿意的话，他真的能让凡人的灵魂回到凡间吗？比如说，放幽灵们逃跑之类的？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 哦，我也说不好，或许不能吧？但俄耳甫斯的歌声和请愿真的是深深地打动了我们……我觉得你父亲只是在同情他吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 等等，深深地打动了我们？俄耳甫斯打算救走欧律狄刻的时候，你也在场吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我在啊，你父亲知道我很喜欢他们的音乐。所以，当我看到他成了宫廷乐师的时候，你想象一下我有多惊喜！

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I always fancied Thanatos, you know. So put together and everything! I'm pleased to see you've grown so close. Things good between you two?

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我一直都很喜欢塔纳托斯，所以祝你们一切都好！看到你们关系这么亲密，我很高兴，你们两个都还好吧？

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: That Dusa sure has quite the uplifting presence around here, doesn't she, Zagreus? Sometimes I see you chatting and it warms my heart.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 杜莎真的让这里的气氛活跃了不少，是吧，扎格列欧斯？有时候我会看到你们聊天，这让我心里充满了暖意。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Zagreus, I know you're upset about what happened between Nyx and Dusa. Before you ask... I need to respect Nyx's space and authority on this one, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，我知道倪克斯和杜莎之间的事情让你很难过。不过在你开口之前……我希望你能尊重倪克斯的想法与决定，好吗？

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I saw that Dusa had returned. I trust Nyx's judgment, though I must admit I was pleased to see she decided to give her another chance.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我看到杜莎回来了。我很信任倪克斯的决定，但我必须承认，看到她决定再给她一次机会，我很开心。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: All right. We've matters with Olympus to resolve. They don't know I'm here, most of them, besides Zeus, maybe Athena. They think you're Nyx's son rather than mine, and that your goal is still to join them on their mountaintop.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What a mess. What can we do? The gods of Olympus have all been very good to me, for the most part. I don't feel great about deceiving them. They keep trying to help me escape!

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: What can we do? We can make peace with them. And let them know the truth. So much of it as they would tolerate. Diplomacy is not your father's strong suit. But I am going to need you two to do exactly as I say. Do you understand?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Yes, Mother. So what do you intend to do, and how do I fit in?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: We're going to invite all of them to a little family gathering! Here. And you shall personally deliver them their invitations, Zagreus.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Mother, are you serious? So, we're just going to have a bash with them, and they'll just see you after all this time, and be fine with everything?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: They certainly shall not be fine with everything. But, Hades and I, we'll be prepared to tell them what they need to hear. Don't worry, I shall do the talking.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What are you going to say?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Oh, you know! That we met, fell in love, eloped. Had a child. A child who, once grown, sought desperately to reconnect with his extended family. To the chagrin of his grim lord father...

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: That's... that's all true. As individual statements, at least.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: ...Fortunately, our loving and dutiful son at last persuaded his mother and father to reveal their secretive relationship, and make an effort to rejoin their great family.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Your mother won't be happy that you left.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I'll deal with her. Perhaps I'll have to visit her and the rest of them from time to time, if that's what it shall take. But I'll be back. I've no choice! Did you know that if you eat the seeds of an Underworld pomegranate, then you cannot leave for one month out of the year, per seed?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: What? No, I never knew that.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Neither do they.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: How soon is this family gathering you have in mind going to take place?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Soon after you invite them all, I hope. Now, go. And trust in me, all right? We have a lot to learn of trust, I think.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 好了，咱们得解决奥林匹斯众神的问题了。他们还不知道我在这里，我是说绝大多数人，包括宙斯，也或许包括雅典娜。他们以为你是倪克斯的儿子，而不是我的儿子，以为你还打算去奥林匹斯山见他们一面。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这可真是一团糟啊，咱们该怎么办？奥林匹斯众神绝大多数时候都对我很好，欺骗他们让我很过意不去，他们可是一直都在帮助我逃走啊！

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 咱们该怎么办呢？咱们可以和他们讲和，让他们在可以容忍的范围内知道真相。外交并不是你父亲的强项，不过，我需要你们两个严格地按照我说的去做，你明白了吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 明白了，母亲。所以你打算怎么做呢？我又该怎么帮忙呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我们要把他们所有人邀请过来，举行一场小型家族聚会！而你要负责私下里把请柬交给他们，扎格列欧斯。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 母亲，你是认真的吗？所以，我们就这么和他们一起庆祝一番，让他们时隔这么久再见你一面，让他们觉得一切都能接受？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 他们肯定不会一切都接受，不过，我和哈迪斯会好好准备一番，告诉他们他们需要听到的话。别担心，交流的部分交给我就好。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你打算怎么说？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 哦，你也懂的！说我们见了面，坠入爱河，私奔了，还生了个孩子。说我们的孩子长大之后，拼命想要见到他其他的亲人们，让他严厉的父亲大为光火……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 这……这倒是真的，至少从个人陈述的角度来看是真的。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: ……幸运的是，我们充满爱心、尽职尽责的儿子最终说服了他的父母公开他们的秘密关系，努力帮助他们重返大家庭。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你的母亲肯定会对你的离开感到不满。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我来负责对付她吧。或许我是不是得去见她一面，拜访拜访其他人，才能真正地解决问题。不过我会回来的，因为我别无选择！你知道吗，如果你吃了冥界石榴的种子，每吃下一颗种子，你一年内都会有一个月无法离开冥界？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 什么？不，我从来没听说过这种事情。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 他们也没听说过。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你策划的这场家族盛宴，要多久之后举行呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 等你邀请了所有人之后，很快就会举行了，去吧。另外，要相信我，好吗？我觉得咱们得好好学学如何相信别人。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: How goes the doling out of invitations, Zagreus? Have the Olympians been amenable to the idea?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Not just amenable, Mother. Positively intrigued. I can't believe you scrambled the invitations in such a way that, only with the lot of them combined will they get all of the details!

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: A bit of collaboration seemed in the spirit of things. We're a great, big family, Zagreus. Past time we started acting like one, no? Now, keep it up. And thank you for your help.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 请柬发得怎么样了，扎格列欧斯？奥林匹克众神都喜欢这个主意吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不仅仅是喜欢，母亲，他们非常感兴趣。我真不敢相信，你居然用这么巧妙的办法发出了请柬。只有所有人把请柬放在一起，才能知道全部信息！

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 一点点合作似乎能让大家更有兴趣。咱们可是个伟大的大家庭，扎格列欧斯，也该努力做出点家人的样子了，是不是？好了，继续努力吧。谢谢你的帮助。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Mother, this family gathering you're planning... are all our relatives welcome? Because I was wondering if I could extend the invitation to a distant ancestor... you know... Chaos.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Nyx's parent... you've been in contact, then? Look, if you feel it's the right thing to do, I trust your judgment. The spirit of this event is to bring the family together.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Thanks. I doubt Chaos would be able to attend, though would still appreciate the thought.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 母亲，你策划的这场盛宴……是所有的家人都欢迎吗？我在想，我要不要邀请某位血缘关系较远的先祖……你懂的……卡俄斯。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯的双亲……你已经遇到他了，是吗？好吧，如果你觉得应该，那就这么做吧，我相信你的判断。毕竟这场盛宴的初衷，就是让所有的家人都聚在一起。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 谢谢，我不知道卡俄斯能不能来，不过我还是很喜欢这个初衷。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's done, Mother! Father. The invitations. Personally sent to everyone with whom I've been in contact. So, what do we do now?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Excellent, Zagreus! Congratulate him, Hades! On a job well done.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Grr. Persephone, how can you be so certain your request was executed to your satisfaction?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: It's known as trust, Hades. Or faith? They're similar. Try one, sometime! It'll be good for you. As for what we do next... why, we've a great, big feast we must prepare!

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: This House is not a suitable location for such guests! Dionysus, alone, shall bring ruin to this place! Or... urgh... the faith thing that you said.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Yes, good! Now then... we have a lot of work to go around, so why don't we call everyone on staff, and let them in on this, and dole out suitable responsibilities, all right?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: All right....

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: All right.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: All right!

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: ...Whew! I'd say that went about as well as could have been expected! And the cleanup wasn't all that bad. For the most part.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: We're fortunate Uncle Zeus seemed to catch on right away, and went along with it. But, this whole elaborate tale you spun... I remember how hurt I felt when I found out Father lied to me about you. Now we're lying to Olympus. What if they find out? Even if they don't... I don't like it.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Zagreus... I may not be an expert... but here's what I've come to understand about how families work. At least our own. The thing is... how we speak to one another is even more important than the words we use. I think, deep down, everyone in our family knows this.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You're saying they all knew you weren't being perfectly honest, and went along with it anyway? I guess the pomegranate thing in particular was a bit of a stretch.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: The common ground in our family is that we want peace. Besides Ares, though even he would rather the conflict occur elsewhere. That elaborate tale... it's less a deception, and more a concession. A way of saying let's move on from the past, and start anew. No hard feelings.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: You don't have hard feelings? What about Father? What about Demeter?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Well, let's see. My hard feelings are nothing next to the joy of having my son in my life. Your father never imagined his relationship with me could be out in the open. And my mother... she's just glad I'm alive.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: And Uncle Zeus is glad things didn't turn out worse for him. I get the sense he acts a bit impulsively at times, and deals with the consequences later.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: What can I tell you, Zagreus? We're family. You said it yourself to me before: We're stuck with one another. That any of us like each other in the slightest... it's a wonder and a blessing, I think.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Yeah. I know what you mean. Thanks, Mother. Think I'll be heading out again soon. See you when I get back?

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 邀请好了，母亲！父亲。我已经把所有的请柬都私下里送给每个遇到过的人了。所以，咱们现在该做什么？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 太棒了，扎格列欧斯！祝贺他吧，哈迪斯！他做得很好。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，珀尔塞福涅，你怎么就能这么确定，一切都会按照你希望的进行呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 这叫做信任，哈迪斯。或者说，信念？都差不多啦。你偶尔也试试吧！对你会有好处的。至于接下来该干什么……咱们还有盛大的庆典要准备呢！

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 这座圣殿不适合招待这些客人！迪奥尼索司一个人就能把这里搞得一团乱！或者说……呃……我就相信你说的什么信念吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 很好！既然如此……咱还有很多事情要做呢。不如把所有人都叫来，让大家都参与进来，让他们做适合他们的事情吧，怎么样？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧……

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好啊。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 很好！

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: ……呼！不得不说，和我想象得一样顺利！而且清扫工作也没那么糟糕嘛，至少大多数情况下并不糟糕。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我们很幸运，宙斯叔叔似乎马上就明白了我们的意图，配合我们一起圆谎。可这个故事是你精心编造出来的……我还记得，关于你的事情，当我发现父亲对我撒谎的时候，我当时有多伤心。现在我们又欺骗了奥林匹斯的众神。如果他们发现了呢？就算他们没发现……我也不喜欢这样。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯……我可能不是处理家庭问题的专家，但这是我对家庭的理解，至少对我们这个大家庭是这样。确切地说……我们彼此之间交流的方式，比我们说了什么更加重要。我觉得，这个家庭中的每个人，内心深处都明白这一点。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你是说，他们明知道你没把所有的真相都说出来，但也还是接受了，是吗？我猜石榴那部分确实有点太牵强了。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我们这个大家庭的所有人都希望能保持和睦。虽然阿瑞斯喜欢冲突，但他也希望冲突都发生在外面。至于那个精心编造的故事……与其说是欺骗，不如说是让步。这可以让我们从过去的阴影中走出来，重新开始，我并不觉得有什么难受的。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 你不觉得难受吗？那父亲的事情呢？得墨忒尔的事情呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，这些确实让我很难受，但和能和孩子在一起的喜悦相比，简直就不值一提了。你父亲从来没想过我们之间的关系有朝一日能公开于众。至于我的母亲……我还活着，她就很开心了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 而且宙斯叔叔也很高兴，因为这一切并没有把他推到风口浪尖。我明白了，他有时会凭冲动做事，之后再去处理后果。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我该怎么和你说呢，扎格列欧斯？我们是一家人。你以前也和我说过，说我们生来血脉相连。如果我们之中某个人，对另一位家人哪怕抱有一丝丝好感的话……我认为这也是个奇迹，是种祝福。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，我明白你的意思。谢谢你，母亲。我觉得我马上就得再次出发了，等我回来之后再见吧？

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I have to say, Mother, that was a clever plan. Convincing Father to finally let somebody have some fun around here.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Haha, well! I'm glad it worked out for the best. There's just one thing that happened that I ought to tell you about, Son. No secrets between us, and all. This... is quite difficult for me to say.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It's about Demeter, isn't it. You two were talking half the night. She wants you to come home with her, doesn't she? You'll always be her little one, something like that?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Indeed... something like that. You're quite perceptive, have I ever told you, Zagreus? But yes, my mother, she was quite conflicted. Didn't know whether to smite me or to hold me, maybe both. And, yes. She asked that I come home... to my responsibilities.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: So... you're leaving...? No, Mother, you can't be leaving, you just got here!

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Oh, it's not as bad as that, it's just... if we are to keep the peace down here, then, I must spend some time up there. Every so often! But, I shall always return, in no time at all. I promised Hades, and I promise you.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well then... when are you going to go?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Soon, Zagreus. Perhaps by the time you're back.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I don't suppose... I can come with you, can I?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Tsk, you know the surface isn't good for you! Besides, you're needed here. But, if you really want to see it for yourself, someday, who knows? Perhaps eventually we'll figure out a way.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I'm going to miss you, Mother.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不得不说，母亲，你的计划真是太妙了。你终于说服了父亲，让大家可以在这里开心地玩了。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 哈哈，是啊！一切都很顺利，我很高兴。不过有件事我必须告诉你，孩子。这并不是我们之间的秘密，只是……我很难开口而已。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是关于得墨忒尔的事情吧？你们昨天聊到了后半夜。她希望你能和她一起回去，是吗？她希望永远能把你当做小女儿，是类似这样的事情吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 是啊……确实如此。你的感觉真的很敏锐，不知我有没有和你说过，扎格列欧斯。不过，是啊，我的母亲，她相当矛盾。她也不知道是该责骂我，还是该拥抱我，或者两个都是吧。而且，没错，她想让我回去……让我履行我的职责。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 所以……你要走了吗……？不要，母亲！你不能走，你才刚回来呢！

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 哦，也没有那么糟糕啦，只是……如果想维持这里的和平生活，我就必须时不时得花些时间和他们在一起！不过我会经常回来的，很快就回来了。我和哈迪斯保证过，我也和你保证。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 好吧那……你什么时候走呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 很快就走了，或许你回来之前我就走了吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我猜……我没法和你一起走，是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 哎呀，你也知道，外面的环境对你的身体不好！而且这里也需要你。不过如果你真的打算去看看的话，谁知道呢？说不定真的能找到让你出去的办法。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我会想念你的，母亲。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Welcome home, Mother! How was your trip, things go all right with you and Demeter? With... Grandmother. Still getting used to thinking of her that way.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: You know, it's funny... I think she was so overwhelmed to see me again that maybe something finally changed in her. I always thought she was utterly unyielding. She asked me if I truly came here by choice, and I put her at ease.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Ah, that's a relief. Grandmother can be rather intense, but... she's been kind to me, and very helpful, too. Do you suppose she'll ease up on the whole eternal winter thing there on the surface, now that she knows you're safe?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I asked. She told me that she would. Warmth shall return to the surface. Some of the time, at least. Likely on a rigid schedule, knowing her. And perhaps not in the vicinity of our domain. She's not the sort to forgive and simply forget.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 欢迎回家，母亲！这一路还顺利吗？你和得墨忒尔的关系怎么样了？我是说……外婆，我正在努力适应这么称呼她。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 说真的，很有趣……我觉得她真的是太想再见到我了，或许是她终于变了一些吧，我一直以为她是个绝不服软的人呢。她问我是不是真的出于自愿才来冥界的，我让她放心了。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 啊，这我就放心了。外婆有时候会咄咄逼人，不过……她一直都对我很好，也一直都在帮我。如今，她知道你平安无事了，你觉得她会不会让凡间无尽的寒冬缓和一些呢？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我问过她，她说她会的。温暖终于要重归凡间了，至少一段时间如此。以我对她的了解，应该会按照某种严格的日程吧。或许冥界附近的积雪并不会融化，她并不是那种简简单单就原谅别人的人。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: ...Oh, come on, Hades! Mortals are much more resilient than that! What, you think they'll show up at your gates here, all at once? They have our family looking out for them.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: That is what I'm afraid of. Do you truly believe my brothers and the rest shall take the sort of care of them while they draw breath, as we do here after they have expired?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: It's true we have to look out for them indefinitely, while Olympus need only look out for them for a little while. But our relatives are always watching from their mountain! And if they do turn a blind eye once in a while... mortals aren't bad at fending for themselves.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: But they are never satisfied! Always begging us to provide more, and more.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: They like us, Hades! They praise us, tell one another about us. What do you expect? Would you rather they forgot about us?

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: ...No. No, I suppose not. But they need us!

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: ……哦，拜托，哈迪斯！凡人可比你说得坚强多了！怎么，你以为他们一股脑地冲到你的大门口吗？我们的家人得努力去寻找他们才行。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 这正是我担心的事情。你真的觉得，我的兄弟们和其他神明会尽心尽力照顾那些活着的凡人吗，就像我们一样尽心尽力？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 确实如此，奥林匹斯的众神们只要照顾他们一阵子就行了，而我们必须得没完没了照顾他们。不过我们的亲戚们永远都是站在高山上看着一切！而且，就算他们对凡人视而不见一段时间……凡人们也能把自己照顾得不错。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 但凡人永远不知满足！他们总是在祈求我们，想得到更多，更多。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 他们喜欢我们，哈迪斯！他们赞美我们，和别人说着我们的事情。你还指望能怎么样？莫非你希望他们忘了我们吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: ……不，不，我不这么想，可他们那是需要我们！

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: ...And what of the complaints from Elysium? They wanted the lawns thoroughly manicured for their athletic contests.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Already taken care of. Though, the flooding in Asphodel, hm, that doesn't look like something we can clear up for quite some time. Fortunately, the residents seem to be getting accustomed to it.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: There have been fewer reports about it as of late. And what of the Satyr problem? Blasted things are rampant up there, still.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Well, they're probably contained up there, at least. And Zagreus has been keeping them in check, hasn't he?

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: ……至福乐土那些抱怨怎么样了？他们希望能彻底修剪一下草坪，好为运动会做准备。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 已经解决好了。不过水仙花平原发生的洪水，嗯，似乎一时半会儿不会消退。不过还好，当地的居民似乎已经习惯了。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 最近关于这个问题的投诉变少了。另外，萨提尔的麻烦呢？那些该死的东西还是肆无忌惮。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 这么说吧，他们差不多已经被关起来了，而且扎格列欧斯一直在留意它们的情况，不是吗？

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: ...Well, be that as it may... if they pester you at all, do let me know, and I shall have them dealt with quickly.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Oh, Hades... I think the shades around here have been through enough as it is! I don't mind them. After all the time I spent on my own, having some company has been a welcome change.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You are certain all your needs have been provided for? Because if there is anything that you require...

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Require? Look at this place, Hades. Look at me! I have everything! And so do you. Try not to worry quite so much. And be patient with your son. That's all I ask.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: Persephone, I cannot promise you such things, they're... not my strengths. Besides, I have a reputation to uphold! God of the dead! If the wretches do not fear me, or you for that matter... what, then?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I'm not going to tell you how to balance your work, your marriage, and your parental responsibilities. I don't think anybody on Olympus or below knows quite how best to manage that. So long as we do our best.

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: ……呃，我就是这么一说……如果那些幽灵让你觉得心烦的话，一定要告诉我，我马上把它们处理掉。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 哦，哈迪斯……我觉得这附近的幽灵就待在这里好了，我不介意他们。我一个人呆了那么长时间，现在能有人陪着，我觉得挺不错的。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 你确定不需要什么别的了吗？我是说，如果你有什么别的要求的话……

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 要求？看看这个地方吧，哈迪斯。看看我吧！这一切都是我的！也都是你的。所以别总是担心了，对你自己的儿子耐心点，我对你的要求就这么多。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 珀尔塞福涅，这个我没法向你保证，这……不是我的强项。而且我还得维护我的名声呢！我可是冥王！如果暗灵都不怕我了，或者说，不怕你了……那会变成什么样子？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我可不打算教你如何在工作、婚姻和为人父母的责任中找到平衡。我觉得关于这件事情，无论是奥林匹斯的众神，还是众神之下的凡人，都做不太好，我们只能尽力而为罢了。

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: ...Sometimes, I... still cannot believe that you are here. Returned to us. Your radiance, in all this darkness... you must miss seeing the coast.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: The coast was nice enough, Hades. But nothing is ever perfect, right? No matter how hard you try. Still... I think we get quite close around here, every once in a while.

en.speaker: Hades
en.text: You have taken much less time adjusting to this place than when first you joined us. Part of my surprise. I, myself, was forced to be here. I never thought anyone would come from the surface here by choice.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: The heart can make us do the strangest things, can't it?

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: ……有时候，我……我还是不敢相信你回来了，回到了我们身边。你如此明艳照人，却身处黑暗之中……你肯定很怀念海岸的景色吧。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 海岸真的很漂亮，哈迪斯，不过没什么能永远完美，不是吗？无论怎么努力都不行。不过……我还是觉得，我们应该每隔一段时间，就在这里呆上一阵子。

zh-CN.speaker: 哈迪斯
zh-CN.text: 刚来这里的时候，你花了好长时间才适应，现在你适应得快多了，这多少让我很惊讶。我当初是被迫来这里的，我从来没想过地上世界的人，会甘愿来这个地方。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我们的心声总会促使我们做各种古怪的事情，不是吗？

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: ...So if there's anything that I can do for you, Nyx, you need but ask, all right? I plan to pull my weight.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: Your services were always welcome, here. Please acclimate yourself at your own rate. I am available to answer any questions you may have at any time.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Thank you, my friend. I have to tell you... it's good to be back.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: ……所以，如果有什么可以帮你做的，尽管开口，好吗，倪克斯？我准备尽我所能。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 你的服务随时欢迎，请以你自己的节奏来适应这个地方吧。如果遇到什么问题的话，我随意愿意回答。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 谢谢你，我的朋友。我不得不说……回来的感觉真好。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: ...I just don't know how I can ever repay you. For raising him. For everything. After I left... besides old Cerberus, I think maybe I missed you most of all.

en.speaker: Nyx
en.text: I can remember feeling similar emotions at the time. However, it is quite unnecessary to give thanks to me this way. You are the Queen, safely returned where you belong. I did what anybody would have in my place.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Anybody would have lovingly raised my estranged son, while keeping safe my secret, eventually orchestrating an elaborate plot to reunite him with me, so that I might someday return, to have a Nectar with them in the lounge?

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: ……我真不知道该怎么报答你。你把他养大成人，你做了这一切。我走之后……除了老刻耳柏洛斯之外，我觉得我最想念的大概就是你了。

zh-CN.speaker: 倪克斯
zh-CN.text: 我记得那个时候感觉到了类似的情绪。不过，你真的没必要用这种方式来感谢我。你是这里的皇后，已经回到了安全的地方，我只不过做了每个人都会做的事情罢了。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 你满怀爱意地抚养我阔别已久的儿子，同时保守着我的秘密。你还精心地策划了计划，好让我和我儿子团聚，等我有朝一日回来的时候，能与他们一起在休息室里共饮蜜露。这真的是每个人都能做到的吗？

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Oh, Cerberus! Doubtless you deserve the biggest thanks that this House still stands, don't you? Did you enjoy the treat I brought you from the surface?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: The surface-treat-devouring hound of hell provides the Queen a most decidedly affirmative response.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I thought you might. You wouldn't know it wasn't made of meat, I'll bet! I'll see if we can't grow you plenty more.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 哦，刻耳柏洛斯！这座圣殿还能立在这里，你才是最大的功臣，对不对？你还喜欢我从地上世界给你带来的零食吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 那只地狱犬吞掉了所有来自地上世界的零食，向冥后做出了最坚定、最肯定的回应。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我想也是。我敢打赌，你绝对看不出来它不是用肉做的！看看能不能让你长得更壮吧。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: You're such a good boy, aren't you, Cerberus? Yes you are! Guarded the place while I was out. And even let my son come visit me!

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: The ever-vigilant and terrifying Cerberus merely accepts the praise.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 你可真是只乖狗狗，是不是，刻耳柏洛斯？没错，你就是！我不在的时候，你一直看守着这里，还让我儿子来见我！

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 相貌骇人、无比机警的刻耳柏洛斯接受了夸奖。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I'm sorry, Zagreus, I've pressing matters to attend to now.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我很抱歉，扎格列欧斯，我有很重要的事情要忙。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Do let me know if I can help with anything, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 如果能帮上什么忙的话，尽管开口，好吗？

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Your father's prouder of you than you think.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 你父亲为你感到骄傲，超乎你的想象。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Go make us proud, my son.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 让我们为你骄傲吧，我的儿子。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Keeping the realm secure as ever, right?

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 像以前一样，继续保护这里的安全，好吗？

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: It's always nice to have a chat with you.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 能和你聊天总是很开心。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I think the House is well enough in order as of late.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我觉得这座圣殿最近井井有条。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I hope your last assignment turned out well.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 希望你之前的工作做得还顺利。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Do give yourself a break from time to time!

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 别忘了时不时地休息休息！

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I ever tell you you're the best son that a mother's ever had?

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我有没有告诉过你，不可能有比你更出色的儿子了？

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Hope my little cottage on the coast is holding up!

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 希望岸边的那座小屋还撑得住！

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Please keep an eye on my garden on the surface when you get a chance.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 如果有机会的话，替我照料一下我在凡间的那座花园吧。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I'd say this garden's doing quite all right for now.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我觉得这座花园已经相当漂亮了。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Don't let your father get to you too much, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 别太被你父亲影响了心情，好吗？

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: You're looking just as well as ever, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 你看起来一直都很好，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: You show your father who's in charge next chance you get, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 下次有机会的话，让你父亲见识一下你的本事，怎么样？

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: The pomegranate trees are coming in nicely still, the tough old things.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 这些古老的石榴树耐性很好，依然长势喜人。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: You'll let me know if there's something that I can do for you?

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 如果有什么能替你做的事情，记得告诉我，好吗？

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: We have to say farewell again, for now, my son. Olympus calls, but I'll be back, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我们暂时又得分开了，儿子。奥林匹斯山在召唤我了，不过我马上就回来，好吗？

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I shall be leaving again for Olympus soon. I'll miss you, Son.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我马上又得去奥林匹斯山了。我会想你的，儿子。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I must go visit Mother on Olympus, Zagreus. I'll tell her you said hi.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我得去奥林匹斯山见母亲一面了，扎格列欧斯。我会替你给她带好的。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I have to go again, soon, Zagreus, all right? I'll see you soon.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我马上又得走了，扎格列欧斯，好吗？下次再见吧。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I'm due to visit Mount Olympus once again, so please be good to one another while I'm out.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我又得去奥林匹斯山了。我不在的时候，希望你们两个能对对方好一点。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Time that I headed up to Mount Olympus, though you keep an eye on things till I get back?

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我又得去奥林匹斯山了。我回来之前，你替我照看好这边的事情，好吗？

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I have to go now, Zagreus, but I shall see you just as soon as I return.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我又得走了，扎格列欧斯，不过我一回来就去找你。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Things are well enough upon Olympus. Though, it's a relief to have come home again.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 奥林匹斯山那边一切都很好，不过还是回家能让人如释重负。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Don't think I'll ever get fully accustomed to Olympus, Son.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我觉得我大概没办法完全适应奥林匹斯山的生活，儿子。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Zagreus, you're the most welcome sight I've seen in quite some time.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 扎格列欧斯，还是见到你最让我开心。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Always such an exhausting journey, from Olympus down to here.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 从奥林匹斯山到这里的这段路，总是让人精疲力尽。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I trust that you and Hades have been good to one another since I left?

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我走了之后，你和哈迪斯相处得还好吗？

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I'll tell you, it is so much colder up there on that mountaintop.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 说真的，山上比这里冷多了。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: This is a welcome sight from all the snow-capped mountaintops.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 和白雪皑皑的奥林匹斯山相比，还是这里看着舒服。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Oh we're busy just formulating more of our dark schemes together, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 哦，我们正一起忙着酝酿更加邪恶的阴谋呢，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Nyx here is a wellspring of parental advice, as it turns out!

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 从结果上看，倪克斯提出了许多为人父母的建议！

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Nyx was just telling me some more about your early days, my son.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 倪克斯在给我讲你以前的故事呢，我的儿子。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: It seems I failed once again to persuade Nyx to take some personal time!

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我打算劝说倪克斯留些时间给她自己，但看来我又失败了！

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Please excuse your father and me for the moment, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 请让我和你父亲单独待一会儿，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Go on, Hades. Try saying something nice to him, for once.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 去吧，哈迪斯。试试对他说句好听的话吧，一句就好。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Your father and I still have a bit of work here to wrap up.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我和你父亲还有些事情要做。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: The work certainly never ceases, Zagreus!

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 工作真是一刻都不会停止啊，扎格列欧斯！

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: More than enough parchmentwork to go around!

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 要办的契约文书实在是太多了！

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Plenty of parchmentwork to contend with, I can assure you, Zagreus!

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 要对付的契约文书实在是太多了，我不骗你，扎格列欧斯！

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Don't go too hard on each other out there, all right?

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 你们两个对对方别太严厉了，好吗？

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I've heard that you've been doing great out there lately, Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我听说你最近做得都很不错，扎格列欧斯。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Erm, Mother? Was it always a custom in Father's House to secretly give Nectar to those you care about? I guess it also could have been a thing on Olympus. Look, I wanted you to have this. I'm so glad I found you.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Oh, Zagreus, you're so thoughtful, truly! Your father never permitted Nectar out in the open so I'd practically forgotten its savor. Though, just a moment, I have something for you, too!

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 呃，母亲？在父亲的大殿里有件约定成俗的事，就是把蜜露送给自己在乎的人，这是向来如此吗？我猜这也可能是从奥林匹斯山上传过来的。我想送给你这个。我真的非常高兴自己终于找到你了。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 哦，扎格列欧斯，你真是太贴心了，真的！你的父亲一直严禁蜜露运进来，我几乎已经忘了它的味道了。不过，稍微等一下，我也有礼物要给你！

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: For me? Are you quite sure? You know, this vintage must have made it all the way up from the surface, to the mountains, then to here. We've both had distant journeys, haven't we?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, I, for one, am certain this vintage here has journeyed to the right place. Please enjoy it.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 给我的？你确定吗？酿成这个的葡萄一定从人间前往高山，然后被一路运往这里。我们都经历了漫长的旅程，不是吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 嗯，就我自己而言，我确信那一季的葡萄来到了对的地方。请你尽情享用。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I must confess I do enjoy having a good bottle of Nectar, every now and then. And you appear to have a careful eye for such bottles, from what I can tell!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: My careful eye has got to be the green one, hasn't it. To having a discerning eye, Mother!

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 不得不说，无论何时我都很乐意享用这么好的一瓶蜜露。而且我能看出，你一定很注意盯着保管这么脆弱的瓶子。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 那我一定是用那只绿色的眼睛盯着的。您给了我一只目光敏锐的眼睛，母亲！

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Thank you very much, my son! You know, gift-giving customs of the Underworld are just so much more straightforward than the complicated social graces of Olympus!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: If there are other ways of showing one's appreciation than with Nectar and the like, well, they must pale in comparison I'm sure!

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 太感谢了，我的儿子！比起奥林匹斯山上繁复的社交礼节，在冥界互赠礼物的习俗可真是真诚直白呀！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 如果还有除蜜露以外的表达爱意的方式，那么我敢肯定它们都会显得苍白无力！

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Oh, this is wonderful, except... I'm wracked with guilt for having nothing much to give you, in return. You never even got a mother's love from me.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Please don't say that, it's just a gift, all right? Besides... can't we start now? Mother and son type things. If you would like.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I'd like that even more than this fine Nectar, Zagreus!

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 噢，这真好，但……我无法给你很多回报，这让我很内疚。你从未从我这里得到过母爱。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 请别这样说，这只是我送给你的一个礼物，好吗？而且……我们不能从现在开始吗？就是母子关系之类的。如果你愿意的话。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 那比这瓶上好的蜜露还要合我心意，扎格列欧斯！

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Somebody raised you very well indeed, my son. Nyx, I suppose. I'll never be half the mother she is. She's done it for aeons! While I'm only getting started.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: For what it's worth, I happen to think you're off to an excellent start. Nyx did teach me a lot. Achilles, too, and Father, in a way. But there is no replacing your presence. I felt that before we ever met. And now I know for sure.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Thank you, Zagreus. Let's hope you're right. I nurtured very many plants, at least, of that I can assure you! Perhaps my gardening experience provided a bit of a head start on this whole mothering thing.

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 有一个人非常用心抚养你，我的儿子。我想应该是倪克斯。身为母亲，我连她的一半都赶不上。她从上古开始就是一位母亲，而我才刚刚开始。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 值得一提的是，我认为这正是一个绝佳的开始。倪克斯的确教会了我很多东西。阿喀琉斯也是，还有父亲——以他独特的方式。但没有任何人能替代你。在我们相见之前我就这样感觉，现在我更确定了。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 谢谢你，扎格列欧斯。希望你是对的。我可以向你保证，至少我照料了许多植物！也许我的园艺可以引领我做好一个母亲。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Mother, I know there may not be many things you miss from living on Olympus, though I wondered if perhaps Ambrosia may be one of them. And got you some, because... well, here.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: ...Why, this really is Ambrosia! How did you even acquire this, Zagreus? It brings back memories, for certain. And, never the bad ones, which... I think it must be why we prize this stuff so much. This is for me?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It is, it is, of course! And, it's my dearest hope that, at some point long from now, when you're relaxing with a bottle of Ambrosia, dare I say perhaps with Father... that these memories will be among the ones that spring to mind.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Oh, my son... I shall certainly not need Ambrosia to think back upon getting to know you with the greatest fondness. Thank you very much.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 母亲，我知道你对奥林匹斯山并没有太多留恋，但也许仙馔密酒会是个例外？我给你找来了一点，因为……好吧，给你。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: ……怎么，这真的是仙馔密酒！扎格列欧斯，你是怎么弄来的？当然了，它使我回想起很多东西，而且无一例外都是好事……这应该就是我们如此赞赏它的原因。这是给我的吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 是啊，是啊，当然了！而且我衷心希望，在很久之后当你正享用着一瓶仙馔密酒放松时——或许还是和父亲一起，这些美好的记忆也会涌上你的心头。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 噢，我的儿子……我不必借助仙馔密酒也能够回想起这段怀着爱意逐渐了解你的日子。真的非常感谢你。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Here, Mother. More bottled pleasant memories for you. I know you're glad you've long since left Olympus, but... I'm glad you were there, because the experience of it must have played no small part in making you who you are.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: You know, the last bottle you gave me brought more pleasant memories than I expected. No telling just how many more of them I've tucked away. Say, would it be all right if I shared this with your father?

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: It is yours to do with as you please.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Haha, almost sounded like a no to me!

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: No! I mean, yes, please share it with Father, if he would be willing... I imagine what few pleasant memories he has are all of you.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: Nonsense, there's also Cerberus! Present company excluded. Come on, Son. Your father has a lot of work to do, but I'm absolutely certain that he has fond memories of you. Though, I know that isn't reassuring, coming from me.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Everything is somehow reassuring, coming from you, Mother.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 母亲，这儿有更多的甜美回忆给您。我知道您对于长久地离开奥林匹斯山感到很高兴，但……我很高兴你曾留在那儿，因为你在那里的经历也造就了如今的你，那是你的一部分。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 你知道吗，上次你给我的那瓶让我回想起预料之外的许多美好之事，我几乎不敢想象我还遗忘了多少。好吧，我可以和你的父亲分享这个吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 悉听尊便。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 哈哈，听起来你像是在说不！

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不是！我是说，好的，请你和父亲一同享用，如果他愿意的话……在我的印象里，他仅有的美好回忆都与你有关。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 胡言乱语，还有刻耳柏洛斯呢！公务除外。好啦，孩子，你的父亲尽管很忙，但我敢肯定他也非常珍惜和你在一起的回忆。不过，这话由我来说可能不那么令人安心。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 不知为何，你的一举一动都很令人安心，母亲。

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I thought about it more, Mother, and I would like very much if you and Father were to share this. Though, maybe don't let on where you got it, just in case?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: This is splendid, Zagreus, but please! If there's one thing I've learned since we met, it's that the trust we share is at the very foundation of our relationships. Why shouldn't he know who this is from? Besides, I think he could figure it out.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Well, when it came to the Olympians, you said yourself that there was only so much truth that they could tolerate. Are you sure Father would be tolerant knowing I got this for the both of you?

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: I'm sure enough! And if he isn't, I suppose it's more for me.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: Haha, well! Just as long as someone puts it to good use.

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: ...You know I always wanted to be a mother, Zagreus? But after you were born... I was certain I had lost my chance. Then one fine morning you just walked into my life. And here we are. I still cannot entirely believe it. What I mean is... I love you, Son. I'm doing my best.

en.speaker: Zagreus
en.text: I know. I love you, too, Mother.

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我又想了一下，母亲，我真的十分乐意让你和父亲一起享受这个。不过，以防万一，你能不能别说是我给的？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 这酒真的很好，扎格列欧斯，但拜托！自我们相见以来，我起码知道了我们之间的信赖还处在起点。为什么他不能知道这酒是从哪儿来的？而且，我觉得他肯定清楚。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 可是，当你谈到奥林匹斯神的时候，你亲口说他们容不下太多真相。我拿来这个给你们，你真的确定父亲会对此置之不理吗？

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: 我当然确定！如果他不宽容的话，我想原因大概在我。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 哈哈，好吧！只要某人善加利用它就行了。

zh-CN.speaker: 珀尔塞福涅
zh-CN.text: ……扎格列欧斯，你知道我一直都渴望成为一名母亲吗？但你出生之后……我断定自己失去了这个机会。于是，之后的一个美好的清晨，你走进了我的生命，所以我们现在在此。我仍然不敢完全相信这个现实。我只是想说……我爱你，儿子。我在尽我所能。

zh-CN.speaker: 扎格列欧斯
zh-CN.text: 我知道。我也爱你，母亲。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Concealed in the dark recesses of the Underworld is the land of Erebus, wherein the dead await eternal sentencing; they long for the attention and good graces of their master, the Lord Hades.

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The infernal wares of the stygian boatman, Charon, lie sprawled about, available for sale to whomever would be willing to quench the boatman's great thirst for riches.

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The River Styx flows infamously through the Underworld, offering the boatman Charon expeditious travel from the realm of mortals to the lowest depths, where many of their shades reside forever.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 厄瑞玻斯黑暗世界隐藏在冥界无边的黑暗深处，死者在这里等待着永恒的审判；他们渴望得到主人冥王哈迪斯的关注和恩典。

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 冥河摆渡人卡戎在摊位上出售地狱物件，任何人都可以购买，只是这位摆渡人向来贪财，要价不菲。

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 臭名昭著的冥河流经冥界，只有摆渡人卡戎可以在凡界和冥界深渊自由穿行，让许多暗灵得以永远安息。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: A hidden stretch of the boundless river Styx cuts through misty Erebus, providing for the river-boatman Charon a locale in which to deal with the unruliest of souls.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 无尽的冥河之中有一条隐藏的河段，可以穿过浓雾笼罩的厄瑞玻斯。这为船夫卡戎提供了一个合适的场所，让他能好好处理那些最为桀骜不驯的灵魂。

en.speaker: Persephone
en.text: 'Hades: I can no longer tolerate my life here in this place. So, I am leaving, even if it kills me. I won't be returning to Olympus. If there is a place where I belong in this world, it must be somewhere between heaven and hell. Perhaps it's on the coast and has a little garden. Take care of Cerberus; I shall miss him. --Persephone'

zh-CN.speaker: Persephone
zh-CN.text: “哈迪斯：我不想再在这个地方折磨自己了。我要离开，付出生命的代价也在所不惜。我不会再回奥林匹斯。如果这世界有可以包容我的地方，那它一定在天堂与地狱之间。也许是在海岸边，附带一个小花园。照顾好刻耳柏洛斯；我会想他的。”

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Having traversed the flaming river Phlegethon to gain this vantage point, relentless Zagreus must now confront a foe of unimaginable savagery, who lies ahead, awaiting patiently its time to strike.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 穿过地狱之河的无边火海，占据这个有利位置，冷酷无情的扎格列欧斯现在必须面对无比野蛮的敌人，它就在前方，耐心地等待着进攻的时机。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Well past the flaming river escalates the hidden stair toward the most well-guarded, splendorous environment within the Underworld: the heavenly Elysium, home eternal to the greatest souls which ever lived.

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: From within a humble residence in Asphodel reverberates the golden-sounding voice of lorn Eurydice, who once attempted to escape the Underworld, and failed, utterly, much like Prince Zagreus.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 穿过烈焰重重的地狱之河，就可以通过隐藏的楼梯向上攀爬，通向冥界守卫最森严、最壮丽的环境：天堂的极乐世界，这里是伟大亡灵永恒的家园。

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 从水仙花平原的简陋屋子中传出欧律狄克悲凉的金铃般的声音，他曾经试图逃离冥界，但最后彻底失败了，就像扎格列欧斯王子一样。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The act of sorcery often ends in an untimely death and an eternity in Tartarus for careless souls, though some are able to perfect the trade, and take up permanent residence elsewhere...

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 对那些的粗心大意的灵魂而言，从事巫术活动通常会让他们死于非命，永生永世被困在塔耳塔罗斯。不过，也有某些灵魂能够精通此道，改去别处生活……

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The searing flame and ashes of the river Phlegethon mean nothing to the ferryman, Charon, who travels all the waters of the Underworld, bearing the dead, the damned, and all their fineries.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 对摆渡人卡戎而言，地狱之河的烈焰和灰烬都算不了什么，他载着各种亡灵、被诅咒的人和他们所有的服饰渡过冥界所有的水域。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Hidden well within the limitless inferno of the river Phlegethon, somehow, a trickle of life-giving water yet remains; as though provided by the Fates themselves unto the very lucky Prince.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 不知为何，在地狱之河无边无际的地狱深处，竟有一股生命之水的涓涓细流；仿佛是命运之神为幸运的王子奉上的礼物。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The once-verdant plains of Asphodel are now engulfed in scintillating flame, having been flooded by the river Phlegethon, whose hideously superheated contents could bring death swiftly even to those resistant to most heat.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 曾经郁郁葱葱的水仙花平原现在被烈焰吞没，淹没在地狱之河汹涌的波涛下，河中可怕的滚滚烈焰顷刻间就会让人粉身碎骨，万劫不复，就算是金刚之身也难以抵挡。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Within the suffocating heat of Asphodel reside the vast majority of those who lived upon the earth and died. There they persist until the end of time.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 在水仙花平原令人窒息的高温中居住着绝大多数曾经在凡界生活，最后死掉的人。他们在那里苦苦煎熬，直到世界末日的来临。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The magnificently ominous facade of the great Elysian Stadium looms tall above the rabble-rousing Prince, as if to goad him into such a competition which he cannot hope to win.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 宏伟森严的极乐园高墙耸立，镇压着这位鼓动人心的王子，仿佛要把他引入一场不可能获胜的对抗中。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The vast and multitudinous riches of both the surface and the Underworld are hoarded by the river-boatman, Charon, whose services are often tendered to the wealthiest within Elysium.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 摆渡人卡戎私吞凡界和冥界的大量财富，并谨献给至福乐土里最富有的人。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Within the delicately hewn constructions of Elysium exist places of peace so utterly serene and absolute as mortalkind is seldom to experience during the average short and often-painful coil.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 在雕梁画栋、巧夺天工的至福乐土有一片凡人在人世间纷纷扰扰的短暂轮回中鲜有感悟、宁静祥和的净土。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Amid Elysium's moss-covered chambers, carved of stone, stand untold numbers of eternal monuments in tribute to the greatest heroes which mortality can offer, there to honor them in life as well as death.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 在至福乐土布满青苔的石室中，供奉着无数高大不朽的纪念碑，用来纪念逝世的大英雄，生荣死哀。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The rare, heavenly splendors of Elysium, reserved for only the most great of mortal souls, spread forth luxuriantly all about the fire-stepping Prince.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 只有最完美无瑕的亡灵才能享有至福乐土难得一见的天堂圣境，王子穿过火海才最终看到。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The enshrouded river of forgetfulness, Lethe, flows through the hallowed chambers of Elysium, numbing old pains and memories of the most-noble shades residing there.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 水汽弥漫的遗忘之河流过至福乐土的神室，让幽闭于此的高贵暗灵得以忘却生前尘世间的痛苦和记忆。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The deepest reaches of the Underworld... the void from which all life and consciousness sprang forth during the dawn of time... the realm of Chaos. A land almost unseen even to denizens of death's kingdom.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 冥界的最深处……黎明时分，所有的生命和灵体从虚空中涌现出来……混沌的领域。甚至死亡国度的居民也几乎无法看到这片神秘的土地。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The fathomless expanses hidden in darkest corners of the Underworld stretch well past the notice of Lord Hades himself; and yet, the interfering Prince somehow discovers passage there.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 隐藏在冥界最黑暗的角落，深不可测，遥不可及，甚至冥王哈迪斯自己都无法察觉；然而，事事关心的王子不知怎么发现了通往这里的密道。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Within the Underworld's quietest, most solitary, darkest abyss lies hidden evidence of the beginning of all things, of Chaos! The most ancient sculptor that has shaped this world.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 在冥界最安静、最孤独、最黑暗的深渊里，隐藏着万物起源的证据，这里就是混沌！世界起源的远古幻境。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Inside the filth-encrusted lairs carved into the looming edifices of the Underworld lie such terrible abominations that not even grim Lord Hades is inclined to speak of them.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 冥界那些阴森的巨大建筑之中有一些洞穴，盘踞其中的则是令冥王哈迪斯本人都谈其色变的污秽之物。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Deep within the desecrated lair of the god-defiling Satyrs lie the noisome contents of their profane rituals, so foul as to be indescribable.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 在亵渎神灵的萨提尔肮脏巢穴深处，隐藏着他们在世俗仪式中令人厌恶的勾当，肮脏得难以形容。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: At last the willful prince has ventured all the way up to the surface of the mortal realm, yet still he is encased within the earth itself: the gateway to the Underworld, a threshold from which there is no escape.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 最后，这位任性的王子冒险来到了凡尘，但他仍然被困在地下：这里是通往冥界的大门，一个无法逃脱的禁地。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The vast Temple of Styx and its innumerable dangers now are all that separate the Underworld Prince from the land outside, which he so desperately longs to see.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 巨大的冥河神庙及其周边无数的险境阻碍着冥界王子来到地面世界，亲眼看看外面的风景。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Not far from here, the dead begin their journey to their final resting-place down in the depths below; and so the river-boatman Charon often passes through.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 逝者的灵魂会在离这里不远的地方开始往生旅程，前往地下深处的最后安息之地；正因如此，冥河摆渡人卡戎常常在这里穿行。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The widely-feared and many-headed Cerberus, the Underworld's sentinel, presides over the entrance to this realm, devouring whole those fool enough to make attempts to flee.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 令人生畏的多头冥界守卫犬刻耳柏洛斯控制着这一神秘空间的入口，它会将那些冥顽不灵，企图逃跑的亡灵一口吞下。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: A crudely-hewn network of tunnels grows from one of the cold Temple's flanks, containing vicious denizens unwelcome in this realm, even in death.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 一个简单开凿的地下隧道网从冰冷神殿的一个侧殿延伸出来，里面住着现世和往生世界都不受欢迎的邪恶居民。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The surface, wind-swept, wracked by freezing cold, nonetheless instills within the prince a sense of awe, and the sublime. For it is unlike anything that he has seen.

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: All manner of fruits and vegetables thrive within the hidden gardens of Persephone, the one-time Queen of all the Underworld. A world of life, far from the realm of death.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 地上世界狂风怒号，遭受着冰冻与寒霜的肆虐。即便如此，王子的心里还是充满了敬畏与崇高的感觉，因为他从未见过这样的景象。

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 珀尔塞福涅曾是整个冥界的皇后，如今，各种各样的水果和蔬菜在她的秘密花园中繁衍生息。这个世界充满了生机，与死亡毫无关系。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Beyond the present chamber lies the outermost perimeter of Tartarus, promising terrifying dangers far beyond the Underworld Prince's reckoning.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 现在的密室之外就是塔耳塔罗斯的最外围，预示着可怕的危险远远超出冥界王子的控制范围。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The Erinyes; known also as the Furies, they are the trusted sentinels of Lord Hades, charged with torturing the worst of mortalkind... and ridding the Underworld of any fool enough to trespass where they do not belong.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 厄里倪厄斯，又名复仇三女神，她们是冥王哈迪斯的得力干将。她们的使命，是折磨那些生前罪大恶极的人，顺便在冥府里清理胆敢越界游走的傻子。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The path from Tartarus is finally laid bare. Far above, the heat from Phlegethon, the river of flame, is faintly felt already... even as its dangers lie in wait.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 从塔耳塔罗斯出发的道路终于显现出来。我们已经可以隐约感受到远处地狱之河灼热的烈焰……就好像重重机关正等着那些不知天高地厚的家伙自投罗网。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: None, other than those in the trusted inner circle of Lord Hades, are authorized to enter the intricate chambers connecting the vast regions of the Underworld; but the Prince decides to barge in, anyway.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 唯有冥王哈迪斯最为亲信之人，才有资格在冥府地区的迷宫里行走。王子才不管这一套，硬是要闯它一闯。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: The most violent wretches of Tartarus are sealed away even from other condemned souls; their only visitors, those fool enough to attempt escape.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 塔耳塔罗斯最残暴的暗灵们被单独监禁，不得与其它被诅咒的灵魂相见。而它们唯一的访客，就是那些试图逃出这里的蠢货。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Damned, lost souls with nowhere left to turn congregate in deepest Tartarus, where they fuse together with the earth itself into odious forms which defy description.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 遭到诅咒、迷失方向的灵魂无处可去，便聚集在塔耳塔罗斯深的最深处，与大地融为一体，变成了难以言述的丑陋畸怪。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: A place of calm and respite, whilst perhaps unimaginable in the Underworld, occasionally is to be found, in fact.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 实际上，我们偶尔也能在冥界找到一个安静祥和的地方，一个也许无法想象的地方。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Composed of such innumerable ever-shifting interlocking chambers, the Underworld of Lord Hades all but guarantees the dead shall there remain until the end of time.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 冥王哈迪斯的冥界由无数不断变化的连环密室组成，逝者的亡灵基本上都可以在这里安息，直到世界末日的来临。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Each time the Prince delves back into the Underworld, its ever-shifting chambers realign to frustrate his attempts to perhaps map it out.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 每次王子深入到冥界时，不断变化的密室都会重新组合，让他无法画出地图。

en.speaker: Storyteller
en.text: Within the depths of Tartarus reside the most wretched of all the shades who linger for eternity within the Underworld, whose Lord and Master is especially unkind to those attempting to cheat death.

zh-CN.speaker: Storyteller
zh-CN.text: 塔耳塔罗斯的万丈深渊囚禁着冥界永世不得超生的暗灵，冥界之主对那些试图逃离的亡灵特别残酷无情。
